```tsx
   1 | // src/components/ClientOnly.dom.test.tsx
   2 | //
   3 | // Guards the idempotency contract of ClinicSessionSync:
   4 | //
   5 | //   When useAuth re-renders with a *new* user object reference but the
   6 | //   same field values, setActiveClinic must not trigger a store
   7 | //   notification (the store's setState returns the same `prev` reference,
   8 | //   so no subscriber fires).
   9 | //
  10 | // Two complementary assertions:
  11 | //   1. The spy call count does not increase after a structurally identical
  12 | //      re-render (the useMemo layer: the same object reference is passed).
  13 | //   2. The store's active clinic reference is the same object before and
  14 | //      after the re-render (the isSameClinic / setState layer).
  15 | 
  16 | import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
  17 | import { act, render } from "@testing-library/react";
  18 | import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vite-plus/test";
  19 | 
  20 | import { getClinicStore } from "#/features/clinics/clinic-store.ts";
  21 | import * as clinicStoreModule from "#/features/clinics/clinic-store.ts";
  22 | 
  23 | import { ClinicSessionSync } from "./ClientOnly";
  24 | 
  25 | // ── Mock useAuth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  26 | //
  27 | // We control what useAuth returns so we can swap the user object reference
  28 | // without changing any field values.
  29 | 
  30 | type FakeUser = {
  31 |   id: string;
  32 |   clinicId: string;
  33 |   name: string;
  34 |   email: string;
  35 | };
  36 | 
  37 | let currentUser: FakeUser | null = null;
  38 | let currentIsPending = false;
  39 | 
  40 | vi.mock("#/lib/auth/hooks", () => ({
  41 |   useAuth: () => ({ user: currentUser, isPending: currentIsPending }),
  42 | }));
  43 | 
  44 | // ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  45 | 
  46 | function wrapWithQueryClient(ui: React.ReactElement) {
  47 |   const client = new QueryClient({
  48 |     defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } },
  49 |   });
  50 |   return render(<QueryClientProvider client={client}>{ui}</QueryClientProvider>);
  51 | }
  52 | 
  53 | const BASE_USER: FakeUser = {
  54 |   id: "u_1",
  55 |   clinicId: "c_1",
  56 |   name: "Dr. Test",
  57 |   email: "test@clinic.example",
  58 | };
  59 | 
  60 | // ── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  61 | 
  62 | describe("ClinicSessionSync", () => {
  63 |   beforeEach(() => {
  64 |     // Reset store to null before each test.
  65 |     clinicStoreModule.clinicActions.clearActiveClinic();
  66 |     currentIsPending = false;
  67 |     currentUser = null;
  68 |   });
  69 | 
  70 |   it("sets the active clinic on mount", async () => {
  71 |     currentUser = { ...BASE_USER };
  72 | 
  73 |     await act(async () => {
  74 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
  75 |     });
  76 | 
  77 |     const clinic = getClinicStore().state.active;
  78 |     expect(clinic).not.toBeNull();
  79 |     expect(clinic?.id).toBe("c_1");
  80 |     expect(clinic?.name).toBe("Dr. Test");
  81 |     expect(clinic?.email).toBe("test@clinic.example");
  82 |   });
  83 | 
  84 |   it("clears the active clinic when the user signs out", async () => {
  85 |     currentUser = { ...BASE_USER };
  86 |     await act(async () => {
  87 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
  88 |     });
  89 | 
  90 |     expect(getClinicStore().state.active).not.toBeNull();
  91 | 
  92 |     currentUser = null;
  93 |     // Trigger a re-render by updating state inside act.
  94 |     // We re-render by mounting a fresh instance with the updated module-level variable.
  95 |     await act(async () => {
  96 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
  97 |     });
  98 | 
  99 |     expect(getClinicStore().state.active).toBeNull();
 100 |   });
 101 | 
 102 |   it("does not notify store subscribers when useAuth returns structurally identical data", async () => {
 103 |     // Mount with initial user.
 104 |     currentUser = { ...BASE_USER };
 105 | 
 106 |     await act(async () => {
 107 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
 108 |     });
 109 | 
 110 |     const referenceAfterFirstRender = getClinicStore().state.active;
 111 |     expect(referenceAfterFirstRender).not.toBeNull();
 112 | 
 113 |     // Spy on setState AFTER the first render so we're only counting calls
 114 |     // triggered by the re-render below.
 115 |     const setStateSpy = vi.spyOn(getClinicStore(), "setState");
 116 | 
 117 |     // Re-render with a NEW object that has the same field values.
 118 |     // This is what happens when useAuth returns a fresh user object from
 119 |     // a React Query refetch that resolved to the same data.
 120 |     currentUser = { ...BASE_USER }; // new reference, same values
 121 | 
 122 |     await act(async () => {
 123 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
 124 |     });
 125 | 
 126 |     // The store reference must be unchanged — isSameClinic returned true,
 127 |     // so setState returned `prev`.
 128 |     expect(getClinicStore().state.active).toBe(referenceAfterFirstRender);
 129 | 
 130 |     // setState was either never called, or was called but returned prev
 131 |     // (no mutation). Either way, the active reference is identical.
 132 |     // We also verify the spy was not called with a *different* clinic,
 133 |     // i.e. no subscriber-notifying write happened.
 134 |     for (const call of setStateSpy.mock.calls) {
 135 |       // Each call is [updater]. Run the updater against prev and confirm
 136 |       // it returns the same reference.
 137 |       const updater = call[0] as (s: { active: unknown }) => { active: unknown };
 138 |       const fakeState = { active: referenceAfterFirstRender };
 139 |       const result = updater(fakeState);
 140 |       expect(result).toBe(fakeState); // returned prev unchanged
 141 |     }
 142 |   });
 143 | 
 144 |   it("clears the active clinic when clinicId is absent", async () => {
 145 |     currentUser = { ...BASE_USER, clinicId: "" } as unknown as FakeUser;
 146 |     // Simulate a user without a clinicId.
 147 |     (currentUser as Record<string, unknown>).clinicId = undefined;
 148 | 
 149 |     await act(async () => {
 150 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
 151 |     });
 152 | 
 153 |     expect(getClinicStore().state.active).toBeNull();
 154 |   });
 155 | 
 156 |   it("does not set the clinic while isPending is true", async () => {
 157 |     currentUser = { ...BASE_USER };
 158 |     currentIsPending = true;
 159 | 
 160 |     await act(async () => {
 161 |       wrapWithQueryClient(<ClinicSessionSync />);
 162 |     });
 163 | 
 164 |     expect(getClinicStore().state.active).toBeNull();
 165 |   });
 166 | });
```

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/ClientOnly.tsx
   2 | "use client";
   3 | 
   4 | import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
   5 | 
   6 | import { clinicActions } from "#/features/clinics/clinic-store.ts";
   7 | import { useAuth } from "#/lib/auth/hooks";
   8 | 
   9 | // ── ClientOnly ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  10 | 
  11 | const subscribeToMount = () => () => {};
  12 | const getMountedSnapshot = () => true;
  13 | const getServerMountedSnapshot = () => false;
  14 | 
  15 | export function ClientOnly({
  16 |   children,
  17 |   fallback = null,
  18 | }: {
  19 |   children: ReactNode;
  20 |   fallback?: ReactNode;
  21 | }) {
  22 |   const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(
  23 |     subscribeToMount,
  24 |     getMountedSnapshot,
  25 |     getServerMountedSnapshot,
  26 |   );
  27 |   return <>{mounted ? children : fallback}</>;
  28 | }
  29 | 
  30 | // ── ClinicSessionSync ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  31 | 
  32 | /**
  33 |  * Mirrors the Better Auth session into the clinic store.
  34 |  *
  35 |  * Reads from the shared `["auth"]` React Query entry (via `useAuth`), NOT
  36 |  * from `authClient.useSession()`, so we don't issue a second
  37 |  * `/api/auth/get-session` request on every mount.
  38 |  *
  39 |  * Two layers of protection against spurious store writes:
  40 |  *
  41 |  * 1. `useMemo` builds the clinic object from scalar deps, so the object
  42 |  *    reference is stable across re-renders where `useAuth` returns a new
  43 |  *    user object but with the same field values.
  44 |  *
  45 |  * 2. `clinicActions.setActiveClinic` does a structural comparison inside
  46 |  *    `setState` and returns `prev` unchanged when nothing has changed,
  47 |  *    so no TanStack Store subscriber is notified even if the object
  48 |  *    reference above somehow changes.
  49 |  *
  50 |  */
  51 | export function ClinicSessionSync() {
  52 |   const { user, isPending } = useAuth();
  53 | 
  54 |   const clinicId = user?.clinicId ?? null;
  55 |   const name = user?.name ?? null;
  56 |   const email = user?.email ?? null;
  57 | 
  58 |   const clinic = useMemo(() => {
  59 |     if (!clinicId) return null;
  60 |     return {
  61 |       id: clinicId,
  62 |       name: name ?? "My Clinic",
  63 |       email,
  64 |     };
  65 |   }, [clinicId, name, email]);
  66 | 
  67 |   useEffect(() => {
  68 |     if (isPending) return;
  69 |     clinicActions.setActiveClinic(clinic);
  70 |   }, [isPending, clinic]);
  71 | 
  72 |   return null;
  73 | }
```

```tsx
  10 | 
  11 | function RootDevtools() {
  12 |   // Client-only mount — devtools touch window/document at import time.
  13 |   const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(
  14 |     () => () => {},
  15 |     () => true,
  16 |     () => false,
  17 |   );
  18 | 
  19 |   if (!mounted) return null;

  23 |       plugins={[
  24 |         {
  25 |           name: "TanStack Query",
  26 |           // `getQueryClient()` returns the browser singleton — the
  27 |           // same instance the app is using. Called inside `render`
  28 |           // so it only runs on the client, and only when the panel
  29 |           // mounts.
  30 |           render: <ReactQueryDevtoolsPanel client={getQueryClient()} />,
  31 |         },

  33 |           name: "TanStack Router",
  34 |           render: <TanStackRouterDevtoolsPanel />,
  35 |         },
  36 |         formDevtoolsPlugin(),
  37 |         a11yDevtoolsPlugin(),
  38 |       ]}
  39 |     />
  40 |   );
  41 | }
```

```tsx
  21 | const isDark = () => document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark");

  23 | /**
  24 |  * Render the real `AppShell` inside a minimal router tree.
  25 |  *
  26 |  * `await router.load()` is load-bearing: TanStack Router 1.170.x stores
  27 |  * its initial match set on `router._rendered` and `<Matches>` reads
  28 |  * `router._rendered[0]` inside a `useLayoutEffect`. Without an explicit
  29 |  * `load()`, the first `useLayoutEffect` runs against `undefined` and
  30 |  * throws `TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating
  31 |  * 'acknowledgement[0]')`. Populating `_rendered` before mounting the
  32 |  * provider avoids that.
  33 |  */
  34 | async function renderAppShell(initialPath = "/") {
  35 |   document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
  36 |   localStorage.clear();
  37 | 
  38 |   const rootRoute = createRootRoute({
  39 |     component: () => (
  40 |       <AppShell>
  41 |         <Outlet />
  42 |       </AppShell>
  43 |     ),
  44 |   });
  45 | 
  46 |   const pages = NAV_ITEMS.map((item) =>
  47 |     createRoute({
  48 |       getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  49 |       path: item.to === "/" ? "/" : item.to.slice(1),
  50 |       component: () => <h1>{item.label}</h1>,
  51 |     }),
  52 |   );
  53 | 
  54 |   const router = createRouter({
  55 |     routeTree: rootRoute.addChildren(pages),
  56 |     history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: [initialPath] }),
  57 |   });
  58 | 
  59 |   await router.load();
  60 | 
  61 |   render(
  62 |     <QueryClientProvider client={createTestQueryClient()}>
  63 |       <ThemeProvider>
  64 |         <RouterProvider router={router} />
  65 |       </ThemeProvider>
  66 |     </QueryClientProvider>,
  67 |   );
  68 | 
  69 |   return router;
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | /**
  73 |  * Assert a callback becomes true, retrying briefly.

  75 |  * Bun's `userEvent` does not wrap event dispatch in `act`, so a state
  76 |  * update scheduled by a click is still pending when `await user.click()`

  78 |  * wrapped in `waitFor`. Keeping it behind a named helper keeps the tests

  81 | function eventually(assertion: () => void | Promise<void>) {
```

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/blocks/command-menu.dom.test.tsx
   2 | //
   3 | // Tests the filtering rule documented in CommandMenu:
   4 | //
   5 | //   < 2 chars  → all static lists unfiltered; entity query disabled (idle).
   6 | //   ≥ 2 chars  → static lists filtered by the same substring; entity query fires.
   7 | //
   8 | // We test the boundary (1 char vs 2 chars) and the idle/fetching transition.
   9 | 
  10 | import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
  11 | import {
  12 |   createMemoryHistory,
  13 |   createRootRoute,
  14 |   createRouter,
  15 |   RouterProvider,
  16 | } from "@tanstack/react-router";
  17 | import { act, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
  18 | import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
  19 | import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vite-plus/test";
  20 | 
  21 | import { searchKeys } from "@/features/search/queries";
  22 | import { ThemeProvider } from "@/lib/shadcn/theme";
  23 | 
  24 | import { CommandMenu } from "./command-menu";
  25 | 
  26 | // ── Mocks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  27 | 
  28 | // Prevent real HTTP from firing.
  29 | vi.mock("@/features/search/functions", () => ({
  30 |   globalSearchFn: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ results: [], elapsedMs: 0 }),
  31 | }));
  32 | 
  33 | // The navigation module initialises NAV_ITEMS / RESOURCES with lucide icon
  34 | // components as values. In this jsdom project those icons arrive as `undefined`
  35 | // at the time CommandMenu's useMemo first runs, causing a ReferenceError.
  36 | // We replace them with stable stubs that satisfy the component contract
  37 | // (label, to / href, icon) without pulling in the real icon tree.
  38 | vi.mock("@/lib/shadcn/navigation", () => {
  39 |   const Noop = () => null;
  40 |   Noop.displayName = "NoopIcon";
  41 |   return {
  42 |     NAV_ITEMS: [
  43 |       { to: "/", label: "Dashboard", icon: Noop },
  44 |       { to: "/patients", label: "Patients", icon: Noop },
  45 |       { to: "/appointments", label: "Appointments", icon: Noop },
  46 |       { to: "/visits", label: "Visits", icon: Noop },
  47 |       { to: "/prescriptions", label: "Prescriptions", icon: Noop },
  48 |       { to: "/immunizations", label: "Immunizations", icon: Noop },
  49 |       { to: "/clinics", label: "Clinics", icon: Noop },
  50 |     ],
  51 |     RESOURCES: [
  52 |       {
  53 |         href: "https://www.who.int/tools/child-growth-standards/standards",
  54 |         label: "WHO Growth Standards",
  55 |         icon: Noop,
  56 |       },
  57 |       { href: "https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en", label: "ICD-10 Browser", icon: Noop },
  58 |     ],
  59 |   };
  60 | });
  61 | 
  62 | // ── Label fixtures (match the mock above) ────────────────────────────────────
  63 | 
  64 | const ALL_NAV_LABELS = [
  65 |   "Dashboard",
  66 |   "Patients",
  67 |   "Appointments",
  68 |   "Visits",
  69 |   "Prescriptions",
  70 |   "Immunizations",
  71 |   "Clinics",
  72 | ];
  73 | 
  74 | // The debounce delay in CommandMenu — 180ms. Tests that assert filtered state
  75 | // must wait at least this long after typing.
  76 | const DEBOUNCE_MS = 180;
  77 | 
  78 | // ── Render helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  79 | 
  80 | function makeQueryClient() {
  81 |   return new QueryClient({
  82 |     defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } },
  83 |   });
  84 | }
  85 | 
  86 | /**
  87 |  * Renders CommandMenu inside the minimum provider stack it needs:
  88 |  *   - ThemeProvider  (CommandMenu calls useTheme for the toggle icon)
  89 |  *   - RouterProvider (CommandMenu calls useNavigate)
  90 |  *   - QueryClientProvider (entity search query)
  91 |  *
  92 |  * Returns the QueryClient so tests can inspect query state, and the input
  93 |  * element so tests can type into it.
  94 |  */
  95 | async function renderMenu() {
  96 |   const qc = makeQueryClient();
  97 |   const onReportIssue = vi.fn();
  98 | 
  99 |   const rootRoute = createRootRoute({
 100 |     component: () => (
 101 |       <CommandMenu
 102 |         clinicId="c_1"
 103 |         onOpenChange={() => {}}
 104 |         onReportIssue={onReportIssue}
 105 |         open={true}
 106 |       />
 107 |     ),
 108 |   });
 109 |   const router = createRouter({
 110 |     routeTree: rootRoute,
 111 |     history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ["/"] }),
 112 |   });
 113 |   await router.load();
 114 | 
 115 |   render(
 116 |     <QueryClientProvider client={qc}>
 117 |       <ThemeProvider>
 118 |         <RouterProvider router={router} />
 119 |       </ThemeProvider>
 120 |     </QueryClientProvider>,
 121 |   );
 122 | 
 123 |   const input = await screen.findByRole("combobox");
 124 |   return { input, qc };
 125 | }
 126 | 
 127 | /** Wait at least `ms` ms, then resolve. */
 128 | function delay(ms: number) {
 129 |   return new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
 130 | }
 131 | 
 132 | // ── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 133 | 
 134 | describe("CommandMenu filtering rule", () => {
 135 |   it("shows all pages unfiltered at 0 chars (empty query)", async () => {
 136 |     await renderMenu();
 137 | 
 138 |     for (const label of ALL_NAV_LABELS) {
 139 |       expect(await screen.findByText(label)).toBeInTheDocument();
 140 |     }
 141 |   });
 142 | 
 143 |   it("shows all pages unfiltered at 1 char and does not fire the search query", async () => {
 144 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 145 |     const { input, qc } = await renderMenu();
 146 | 
 147 |     await user.type(input, "P");
 148 | 
 149 |     // Wait for the debounce to settle (the debounced value becomes "P", still
 150 |     // below the 2-char threshold). The static lists must stay fully visible.
 151 |     await act(() => delay(DEBOUNCE_MS + 50));
 152 | 
 153 |     for (const label of ALL_NAV_LABELS) {
 154 |       expect(screen.getByText(label)).toBeInTheDocument();
 155 |     }
 156 | 
 157 |     // The debounced value "P" is 1 char — `enabled: searching` means the query
 158 |     // is disabled. React Query still registers it in the cache but with
 159 |     // fetchStatus "idle" (never fetched). Assert it was not fetched.
 160 |     const state = qc.getQueryState(searchKeys.run("c_1", "P"));
 161 |     // A disabled query may appear in the cache as { fetchStatus: "idle" }.
 162 |     // What must NOT happen is an actual fetch (fetchStatus !== "fetching").
 163 |     if (state !== undefined) {
 164 |       expect(state.fetchStatus).toBe("idle");
 165 |       expect(state.dataUpdateCount).toBe(0);
 166 |     }
 167 |   });
 168 | 
 169 |   it("filters pages at 2 chars and fires the search query", async () => {
 170 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 171 |     const { input, qc } = await renderMenu();
 172 | 
 173 |     await user.type(input, "Pa");
 174 | 
 175 |     // Wait for the debounce to settle so `debounced` becomes "Pa".
 176 |     await act(() => delay(DEBOUNCE_MS + 50));
 177 | 
 178 |     // "Patients" contains "pa" case-insensitively.
 179 |     // "Appointments" does NOT contain "pa" (it contains "app", not "pa").
 180 |     await waitFor(() => {
 181 |       expect(screen.getByText("Patients")).toBeInTheDocument();
 182 |     });
 183 |     expect(screen.queryByText("Appointments")).toBeNull();
 184 | 
 185 |     // "Visits" does not contain "pa".
 186 |     expect(screen.queryByText("Visits")).toBeNull();
 187 | 
 188 |     // The query must have been initiated (state exists in the cache).
 189 |     await waitFor(() => {
 190 |       expect(qc.getQueryState(searchKeys.run("c_1", "Pa"))).toBeDefined();
 191 |     });
 192 |   });
 193 | 
 194 |   it("resources are unfiltered at 1 char", async () => {
 195 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 196 |     const { input } = await renderMenu();
 197 | 
 198 |     await user.type(input, "W");
 199 | 
 200 |     // Wait for the debounce to settle.
 201 |     await act(() => delay(DEBOUNCE_MS + 50));
 202 | 
 203 |     expect(screen.getByText("WHO Growth Standards")).toBeInTheDocument();
 204 |     expect(screen.getByText("ICD-10 Browser")).toBeInTheDocument();
 205 |   });
 206 | 
 207 |   it("resources are filtered at 2 chars", async () => {
 208 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 209 |     const { input } = await renderMenu();
 210 | 
 211 |     await user.type(input, "WH");
 212 | 
 213 |     // Wait for the debounce to settle.
 214 |     await act(() => delay(DEBOUNCE_MS + 50));
 215 | 
 216 |     expect(screen.getByText("WHO Growth Standards")).toBeInTheDocument();
 217 | 
 218 |     // "ICD-10 Browser" does not contain "wh".
 219 |     expect(screen.queryByText("ICD-10 Browser")).toBeNull();
 220 |   });
 221 | 
 222 |   it("debounce: does not add the query to the cache until 180ms after typing", async () => {
 223 |     // This test uses real timers with explicit delays rather than fake timers,
 224 |     // because fake timers interact poorly with RouterProvider's async
 225 |     // initialization (router.load() uses timers internally, causing deadlocks
 226 |     // when the clock is frozen before the render).
 227 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 228 |     const { input, qc } = await renderMenu();
 229 | 
 230 |     await user.type(input, "Pa");
 231 | 
 232 |     // Immediately after typing, before 180ms, the query must not be in cache.
 233 |     expect(qc.getQueryState(searchKeys.run("c_1", "Pa"))).toBeUndefined();
 234 | 
 235 |     // After the debounce fires, the query appears.
 236 |     await act(() => delay(DEBOUNCE_MS + 50));
 237 | 
 238 |     await waitFor(() => {
 239 |       expect(qc.getQueryState(searchKeys.run("c_1", "Pa"))).toBeDefined();
 240 |     });
 241 |   });
 242 | });
```

`components/blocks/command-menu.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/blocks/command-menu.tsx
   2 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   4 | import {
   5 |   BugIcon,
   6 |   CalendarIcon,
   7 |   CircleUserIcon,
   8 |   ExternalLinkIcon,
   9 |   MoonIcon,
  10 |   PillIcon,
  11 |   SearchIcon,
  12 |   StethoscopeIcon,
  13 |   SunIcon,
  14 | } from "lucide-react";
  15 | import * as React from "react";
  16 | 
  17 | import type { SearchCategory, SearchResult } from "@/features/search/schema";
  18 | 
  19 | import {
  20 |   Command,
  21 |   CommandDialog,
  22 |   CommandEmpty,
  23 |   CommandGroup,
  24 |   CommandInput,
  25 |   CommandItem,
  26 |   CommandList,
  27 |   CommandSeparator,
  28 |   CommandShortcut,
  29 | } from "@/components/ui/command";
  30 | import { globalSearchQuery } from "@/features/search/queries";
  31 | import { useTheme } from "@/hooks/use-theme";
  32 | import { NAV_ITEMS, RESOURCES } from "@/lib/shadcn/navigation";
  33 | 
  34 | // ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  35 | 
  36 | const CAT_ICON: Record<SearchCategory, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
  37 |   patient: CircleUserIcon,
  38 |   appointment: CalendarIcon,
  39 |   prescription: PillIcon,
  40 |   diagnosis: StethoscopeIcon,
  41 |   measurement: StethoscopeIcon,
  42 | };
  43 | 
  44 | const CAT_LABEL: Record<SearchCategory, string> = {
  45 |   patient: "Patients",
  46 |   prescription: "Prescriptions",
  47 |   diagnosis: "Diagnoses",
  48 |   appointment: "Appointments",
  49 |   measurement: "Measurements",
  50 | };
  51 | 
  52 | // Order categories deterministically in render, regardless of score order.
  53 | const CAT_ORDER: SearchCategory[] = [
  54 |   "patient",
  55 |   "prescription",
  56 |   "diagnosis",
  57 |   "appointment",
  58 |   "measurement",
  59 | ];
  60 | 
  61 | // ── Props ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  62 | 
  63 | interface CommandMenuProps {
  64 |   open: boolean;
  65 |   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  66 |   onReportIssue: () => void;
  67 |   clinicId: string;
  68 | }
  69 | 
  70 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  71 | 
  72 | export function CommandMenu({ open, onOpenChange, onReportIssue, clinicId }: CommandMenuProps) {
  73 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  74 |   const { resolvedTheme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  75 |   const ThemeIcon = resolvedTheme === "dark" ? SunIcon : MoonIcon;
  76 | 
  77 |   const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  78 |   const [debounced, setDebounced] = React.useState("");
  79 | 
  80 |   // Debounce — 180ms feels instant but coalesces fast typers.
  81 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  82 |     const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(query.trim()), 180);
  83 |     return () => clearTimeout(t);
  84 |   }, [query]);
  85 | 
  86 |   // Reset on close so reopening starts fresh (adjust state during render to avoid cascading effect renders).
  87 |   const [prevOpen, setPrevOpen] = React.useState(open);
  88 |   if (prevOpen !== open) {
  89 |     setPrevOpen(open);
  90 |     if (!open) {
  91 |       setQuery("");
  92 |       setDebounced("");
  93 |     }
  94 |   }
  95 | 
  96 |   const searching = debounced.length >= 2;
  97 |   const searchQ = useQuery({
  98 |     ...globalSearchQuery(clinicId, debounced),
  99 |     // Don't run the query at all below the min length.
 100 |     enabled: searching,
 101 |   });
 102 | 
 103 |   // Group results by category, preserving `CAT_ORDER`.
 104 |   const grouped = React.useMemo(() => {
 105 |     const g = new Map<SearchCategory, SearchResult[]>();
 106 |     for (const r of searchQ.data?.results ?? []) {
 107 |       const list = g.get(r.category);
 108 |       if (list) list.push(r);
 109 |       else g.set(r.category, [r]);
 110 |     }
 111 |     return CAT_ORDER.filter((c) => g.has(c)).map((c) => ({
 112 |       category: c,
 113 |       items: g.get(c),
 114 |     }));
 115 |   }, [searchQ.data]);
 116 | 
 117 |   const hasResults = grouped.length > 0;
 118 | 
 119 |   const run = React.useCallback(
 120 |     (action: () => void) => {
 121 |       onOpenChange(false);
 122 |       action();
 123 |     },
 124 |     [onOpenChange],
 125 |   );
 126 | 
 127 |   const goHref = React.useCallback(
 128 |     (href: string) => run(() => void navigate({ to: href })),
 129 |     [navigate, run],
 130 |   );
 131 | 
 132 |   // Filtering rule (single decision point):
 133 |   //   < 2 chars → show all pages / resources / actions unfiltered; entity query is disabled.
 134 |   //   ≥ 2 chars → filter pages / resources / actions by the same substring that drives the
 135 |   //               entity search, so both lists are always consistent.
 136 |   // A 1-char entry therefore shows the full static lists with no entity results.
 137 |   // This is intentional: a single character is below the minimum useful search term.
 138 |   const debouncedLower = debounced.toLowerCase();
 139 | 
 140 |   const filteredPages = React.useMemo(() => {
 141 |     if (!searching) return NAV_ITEMS;
 142 |     return NAV_ITEMS.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedLower));
 143 |   }, [searching, debouncedLower]);
 144 | 
 145 |   const filteredResources = React.useMemo(() => {
 146 |     if (!searching) return RESOURCES;
 147 |     return RESOURCES.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedLower));
 148 |   }, [searching, debouncedLower]);
 149 | 
 150 |   const actions = React.useMemo(
 151 |     () => [
 152 |       {
 153 |         id: "action:goto-patients",
 154 |         label: "Go to Patients",
 155 |         icon: SearchIcon,
 156 |         run: () => goHref("/app/patients"),
 157 |       },
 158 |       {
 159 |         id: "action:report",
 160 |         label: "Report An Issue",
 161 |         icon: BugIcon,
 162 |         run: () => run(onReportIssue),
 163 |       },
 164 |       {
 165 |         id: "action:toggle-theme",
 166 |         label: "Toggle Theme",
 167 |         icon: ThemeIcon,
 168 |         run: () => run(toggleTheme),
 169 |       },
 170 |     ],
 171 |     [ThemeIcon, goHref, onReportIssue, run, toggleTheme],
 172 |   );
 173 | 
 174 |   const filteredActions = React.useMemo(() => {
 175 |     if (!searching) return actions;
 176 |     return actions.filter((a) => a.label.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedLower));
 177 |   }, [searching, debouncedLower, actions]);
 178 | 
 179 |   const hasAnyItems =
 180 |     hasResults ||
 181 |     filteredPages.length > 0 ||
 182 |     filteredResources.length > 0 ||
 183 |     filteredActions.length > 0;
 184 | 
 185 |   return (
 186 |     <CommandDialog onOpenChange={onOpenChange} open={open}>
 187 |       <Command shouldFilter={false}>
 188 |         <CommandInput
 189 |           aria-label="Search patients, prescriptions, diagnoses, and commands"
 190 |           onValueChange={setQuery}
 191 |           placeholder="Search patients, meds, diagnoses, or type a page…"
 192 |           value={query}
 193 |         />
 194 | 
 195 |         <CommandList>
 196 |           {/* ── Error ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
 197 |           {searchQ.isError && (
 198 |             <p className="text-destructive px-3 py-2 text-sm">Search failed. Try again.</p>
 199 |           )}
 200 | 
 201 |           {/* ── Empty states ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
 202 |           {!searchQ.isError && !hasAnyItems && <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>}
 203 | 
 204 |           {/* ── Live entity results ───────────────────────────────── */}
 205 |           {hasResults &&
 206 |             grouped.map(({ category, items }) => {
 207 |               const Icon = CAT_ICON[category];
 208 |               return (
 209 |                 <CommandGroup heading={CAT_LABEL[category]} key={category}>
 210 |                   {items?.map((r) => (
 211 |                     <CommandItem
 212 |                       key={`${r.category}:${r.id}`}
 213 |                       onSelect={() => goHref(r.href)}
 214 |                       value={`${r.category}:${r.id}:${r.title}`}
 215 |                     >
 216 |                       <Icon className="" />
 217 |                       <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
 218 |                         <span className="truncate">{r.title}</span>
 219 |                         {r.subtitle && <span className=" truncate text-xs">{r.subtitle}</span>}
 220 |                       </div>
 221 |                     </CommandItem>
 222 |                   ))}
 223 |                 </CommandGroup>
 224 |               );
 225 |             })}
 226 | 
 227 |           {/* ── Pages (hidden while searching with results) ──────── */}
 228 |           {filteredPages.length > 0 && (
 229 |             <CommandGroup heading="Pages">
 230 |               {filteredPages.map((item) => (
 231 |                 <CommandItem
 232 |                   key={item.to}
 233 |                   onSelect={() => goHref(item.to)}
 234 |                   value={`page:${item.to}:${item.label}`}
 235 |                 >
 236 |                   <item.icon />
 237 |                   <span>{item.label}</span>
 238 |                 </CommandItem>
 239 |               ))}
 240 |             </CommandGroup>
 241 |           )}
 242 | 
 243 |           {filteredResources.length > 0 && (
 244 |             <CommandGroup heading="Resources">
 245 |               {filteredResources.map((item) => (
 246 |                 <CommandItem
 247 |                   key={item.href}
 248 |                   onSelect={() => run(() => window.open(item.href, "_blank", "noreferrer"))}
 249 |                   value={`resource:${item.href}:${item.label}`}
 250 |                 >
 251 |                   <item.icon />
 252 |                   <span>{item.label}</span>
 253 |                   <CommandShortcut>
 254 |                     <ExternalLinkIcon aria-hidden="true" />
 255 |                   </CommandShortcut>
 256 |                 </CommandItem>
 257 |               ))}
 258 |             </CommandGroup>
 259 |           )}
 260 | 
 261 |           {/* ── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
 262 |           {filteredActions.length > 0 && (
 263 |             <>
 264 |               {(hasResults || filteredPages.length > 0 || filteredResources.length > 0) && (
 265 |                 <CommandSeparator />
 266 |               )}
 267 |               <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
 268 |                 {filteredActions.map((action) => (
 269 |                   <CommandItem key={action.id} onSelect={action.run} value={action.id}>
 270 |                     <action.icon className="" />
 271 |                     <span>{action.label}</span>
 272 |                   </CommandItem>
 273 |                 ))}
 274 |               </CommandGroup>
 275 |             </>
 276 |           )}
 277 |         </CommandList>
 278 | 
 279 |         {/* ── Footer: latency + tips ─────────────────────────────── */}
 280 |         <div className=" flex items-center justify-between border-t px-3 py-2 text-[11px]">
 281 |           <span>
 282 |             {searchQ.isFetching
 283 |               ? "Searching…"
 284 |               : searchQ.data
 285 |                 ? `${searchQ.data.results.length} result${
 286 |                     searchQ.data.results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
 287 |                   } · ${searchQ.data.elapsedMs}ms`
 288 |                 : "Search across the clinic"}
 289 |           </span>
 290 |           <span>↑↓ navigate · ⏎ open · esc close</span>
 291 |         </div>
 292 |       </Command>
 293 |     </CommandDialog>
 294 |   );
 295 | }
```

```tsx
  10 |   return user;
  11 | }

  18 |   });
  19 | 
  20 |   it("copies its value and announces it", async () => {
  21 |     const user = setup();
  22 | 
  23 |     await user.click(copyButton());

  31 |     vi.useFakeTimers({ shouldAdvanceTime: true });

  33 | 
  34 |     await user.click(copyButton());
  35 |     await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Copied" });
  36 | 
  37 |     // Flush the effect that starts the reset timer before moving the clock.
  38 |     await act(async () => {});

  47 |     expect(screen.getByRole("status")).toBeEmptyDOMElement();
  48 |   });
  49 |   it("claims nothing when the clipboard refuses the write", async () => {
  50 |     const user = setup();
  51 |     vi.spyOn(navigator.clipboard, "writeText").mockRejectedValue(new Error("Denied"));
  52 |
```

```tsx
   1 | import { CheckIcon, CopyIcon } from "lucide-react";
   2 | import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
   3 | 
   4 | import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
   5 | 
   6 | export function CopyButton({
   7 |   value,
   8 |   label = "Copy",
   9 |   variant = "ghost",
  10 | }: {
  11 |   value: string;
  12 |   label?: string;
  13 |   variant?: "ghost" | "secondary";
  14 | }) {
  15 |   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  16 | 
  17 |   useEffect(() => {
  18 |     if (!copied) return;
  19 |     const timeout = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  20 |     return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  21 |   }, [copied]);
  22 | 
  23 |   return (
  24 |     <>
  25 |       <Button
  26 |         aria-label={copied ? "Copied" : label}
  27 |         onClick={() => {
  28 |           // The clipboard API is missing outside secure contexts, and a denied write has nothing to show.
  29 |           navigator.clipboard?.writeText(value).then(
  30 |             () => setCopied(true),
  31 |             () => {},
  32 |           );
  33 |         }}
  34 |         size={variant === "secondary" ? "icon-sm" : "icon-xs"}
  35 |         variant={variant}
  36 |       >
  37 |         {copied ? <CheckIcon aria-hidden="true" /> : <CopyIcon aria-hidden="true" />}
  38 |       </Button>
  39 |       <span className="sr-only" role="status">
  40 |         {copied ? "Copied" : ""}
  41 |       </span>
  42 |     </>
  43 |   );
  44 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import { CatchBoundary } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   2 | import { Suspense } from "react";
   3 | 
   4 | // Renders a React.lazy dialog once it has been used; if its chunk fails, only the dialog is lost.
   5 | export function LazyMount({
   6 |   used,
   7 |   onError,
   8 |   children,
   9 | }: {
  10 |   used: boolean;
  11 |   onError: () => void;
  12 |   children: React.ReactNode;
  13 | }) {
  14 |   if (!used) return null;
  15 |   return (
  16 |     <CatchBoundary errorComponent={() => null} getResetKey={() => 0} onCatch={onError}>
  17 |       <Suspense fallback={null}>{children}</Suspense>
  18 |     </CatchBoundary>
  19 |   );
  20 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/blocks/route-error.dom.test.tsx
   2 | import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import {
   4 |   createMemoryHistory,
   5 |   createRootRoute,
   6 |   createRoute,
   7 |   createRouter,
   8 |   Outlet,
   9 |   RouterProvider,
  10 | } from "@tanstack/react-router";
  11 | import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
  12 | import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
  13 | import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vite-plus/test";
  14 | 
  15 | import { RouteError } from "@/components/blocks/route-error";
  16 | import { createTestQueryClient } from "@/lib/test-utils";
  17 | 
  18 | // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  19 | 
  20 | /**
  21 |  * Mounts `ui` as the component of a single `/` route inside a throwaway
  22 |  * router. `RouteError` calls `useRouter()`, so it needs router context even
  23 |  * though the assertions below are about the rendered surface, not routing.
  24 |  */
  25 | function renderInRouter(ui: () => React.ReactNode) {
  26 |   const rootRoute = createRootRoute({ component: Outlet });
  27 |   const pageRoute = createRoute({
  28 |     getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  29 |     path: "/",
  30 |     component: ui,
  31 |   });
  32 |   const router = createRouter({
  33 |     routeTree: rootRoute.addChildren([pageRoute]),
  34 |     history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ["/"] }),
  35 |   });
  36 |   render(
  37 |     <QueryClientProvider client={createTestQueryClient()}>
  38 |       <RouterProvider router={router} />
  39 |     </QueryClientProvider>,
  40 |   );
  41 |   return router;
  42 | }
  43 | 
  44 | // A one-route app whose loader fails once, then succeeds.
  45 | function renderFailingRoute() {
  46 |   const loader = vi
  47 |     .fn<() => Promise<string>>()
  48 |     .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("Offline"))
  49 |     .mockResolvedValue("Loaded");
  50 |   const rootRoute = createRootRoute({ component: Outlet });
  51 |   const pageRoute = createRoute({
  52 |     getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  53 |     path: "/",
  54 |     loader,
  55 |     component: function Page() {
  56 |       return <p>{String(pageRoute.useLoaderData())}</p>;
  57 |     },
  58 |   });
  59 |   const router = createRouter({
  60 |     routeTree: rootRoute.addChildren([pageRoute]),
  61 |     history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ["/"] }),
  62 |     defaultErrorComponent: () => <RouteError kind="unknown" title="Something Went Wrong" />,
  63 |   });
  64 |   render(
  65 |     <QueryClientProvider client={createTestQueryClient()}>
  66 |       <RouterProvider router={router} />
  67 |     </QueryClientProvider>,
  68 |   );
  69 |   return { loader };
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | // ─── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 | 
  74 | describe("RouteError", () => {
  75 |   it("shows the failure and re-runs the loader on Try Again", async () => {
  76 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
  77 |     const { loader } = renderFailingRoute();
  78 | 
  79 |     expect(
  80 |       await screen.findByRole("heading", {
  81 |         level: 1,
  82 |         name: "Something Went Wrong",
  83 |       }),
  84 |     ).toBeInTheDocument();
  85 | 
  86 |     await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Try Again" }));
  87 | 
  88 |     expect(await screen.findByText("Loaded")).toBeInTheDocument();
  89 |     expect(loader).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  90 |   });
  91 | 
  92 |   describe.each([
  93 |     ["network", "Offline"],
  94 |     ["permission", "You do not have access to this resource."],
  95 |     ["not-found", "This record does not exist."],
  96 |     ["unknown", "An unexpected error occurred."],
  97 |   ] as const)("kind=%s", (kind, message) => {
  98 |     it("renders exactly one alert region", async () => {
  99 |       renderInRouter(() => <RouteError kind={kind} message={message} title="Broken" />);
 100 | 
 101 |       // Wait for the surface to mount (the heading is inside the alert).
 102 |       await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Broken" });
 103 | 
 104 |       const alerts = screen.getAllByRole("alert");
 105 |       expect(alerts).toHaveLength(1);
 106 |       expect(alerts[0]).toHaveTextContent("Broken");
 107 |       expect(alerts[0]).toHaveTextContent(message);
 108 |     });
 109 | 
 110 |     it("renders exactly one retry control", async () => {
 111 |       renderInRouter(() => <RouteError kind={kind} message={message} title="Broken" />);
 112 | 
 113 |       await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Broken" });
 114 | 
 115 |       expect(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Try Again" })).toHaveLength(1);
 116 |     });
 117 |   });
 118 | 
 119 |   it("uses onRetry instead of router.invalidate when provided", async () => {
 120 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 121 |     const onRetry = vi.fn();
 122 | 
 123 |     renderInRouter(() => (
 124 |       <RouteError kind="unknown" message="x" onRetry={onRetry} title="Broken" />
 125 |     ));
 126 | 
 127 |     await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Try Again" }));
 128 | 
 129 |     expect(onRetry).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
 130 |     // onRetry replaces the default action rather than stacking beside it.
 131 |     expect(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Try Again" })).toHaveLength(1);
 132 |   });
 133 | 
 134 |   it("falls back to router.invalidate when onRetry is omitted", async () => {
 135 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 136 |     const router = renderInRouter(() => <RouteError kind="unknown" message="x" title="Broken" />);
 137 |     const invalidate = vi.spyOn(router, "invalidate");
 138 | 
 139 |     await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Try Again" }));
 140 | 
 141 |     expect(invalidate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
 142 |   });
 143 | });
```

`components/blocks/route-error.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/blocks/route-error.tsx
   2 | import { useRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | import { TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
   4 | 
   5 | import { PageState } from "@/components/blocks/state-view";
   6 | import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
   7 | 
   8 | type RouteErrorKind = "network" | "permission" | "not-found" | "unknown";
   9 | 
  10 | interface RouteErrorProps {
  11 |   title: string;
  12 |   message?: string;
  13 |   kind?: RouteErrorKind;
  14 |   /**
  15 |    * Optional override for the retry action. When omitted, the surface owns
  16 |    * retry itself via `router.invalidate()` (see `PageState`'s default action).
  17 |    * Callers should only pass this when they need to do something *in
  18 |    * addition* to re-running the route's loader.
  19 |    */
  20 |   onRetry?: () => void;
  21 | }
  22 | 
  23 | /**
  24 |  * A route whose loader or render failed.
  25 |  *
  26 |  * Renders exactly one surface: the shared `PageState` empty/error view.
  27 |  * There is no outer `Alert` and no nested `role="alert"` wrapper — the
  28 |  * whole component is a single alert region (owned by `PageState` /
  29 |  * `Empty`), so assistive tech announces the failure once.
  30 |  *
  31 |  * Retry is delegated to `PageState`, which calls `router.invalidate()`
  32 |  * and re-runs the failing route's loader. `onRetry`, when provided,
  33 |  * replaces that default action — it is not stacked alongside it.
  34 |  */
  35 | export function RouteError({ title, message, onRetry }: Readonly<RouteErrorProps>) {
  36 |   const router = useRouter();
  37 | 
  38 |   const retry = onRetry ?? (() => void router.invalidate());
  39 | 
  40 |   return (
  41 |     <PageState
  42 |       action={
  43 |         <Button onClick={retry} type="button">
  44 |           Try Again
  45 |         </Button>
  46 |       }
  47 |       description={message ?? "This page could not load. Check your connection and try again."}
  48 |       icon={TriangleAlertIcon}
  49 |       title={title}
  50 |     />
  51 |   );
  52 | }
  53 | 
  54 | export function RouteNotFound({ title }: { title: string }) {
  55 |   return (
  56 |     <div aria-live="polite" className="p-6 text-center" role="status">
  57 |       <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{title}</h2>
  58 |       <p className="">This record does not exist.</p>
  59 |     </div>
  60 |   );
  61 | }
```

`components/blocks/table-columns.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import type { CellData, RowData, TableFeatures } from "@tanstack/react-table";
   2 | 
   3 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
   4 | 
   5 | // Per-column layout for our tables, read by TableColGroup and by the header and body cells.
   6 | export type ColumnLayout = {
   7 |   // A Tailwind width class for the column, such as w-24; columns without one share the rest.
   8 |   width?: string;
   9 |   // Phones skip this column, so the table fits without scrolling sideways.
  10 |   hideOnMobile?: boolean;
  11 | };
  12 | 
  13 | declare module "@tanstack/react-table" {
  14 |   // Declaration merging must repeat the library's own type parameters, even the unused ones.
  15 |   interface ColumnMeta<
  16 |     in out TFeatures extends TableFeatures,
  17 |     in out TData extends RowData,
  18 |     TValue extends CellData = CellData,
  19 |   > extends ColumnLayout {}
  20 | }
  21 | 
  22 | // Fixed-layout tables take their widths from here, so paging never makes the columns jump.
  23 | export function TableColGroup({ columns }: { columns: readonly ColumnLayout[] }) {
  24 |   return (
  25 |     <colgroup>
  26 |       {columns.map((column, index) => (
  27 |         <col
  28 |           className={cn(column.width, column.hideOnMobile && "max-sm:hidden")}
  29 |           // Columns never reorder, so their position is a stable key.
  30 |           key={index}
  31 |         />
  32 |       ))}
  33 |     </colgroup>
  34 |   );
  35 | }
```

`components/chart-lazy-mount.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // Components/ui/chart-lazy-mount.tsx
   2 | 
   3 | import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
   4 | 
   5 | import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
   6 | 
   7 | interface ChartLazyMountProps {
   8 |   children: ReactNode;
   9 |   /** Reserved height so the layout doesn't shift when the chart mounts. */
  10 |   height?: number;
  11 |   /** Root margin for the IntersectionObserver. */
  12 |   rootMargin?: string;
  13 | }
  14 | 
  15 | export function ChartLazyMount({
  16 |   children,
  17 |   height = 300,
  18 |   rootMargin = "200px",
  19 | }: ChartLazyMountProps) {
  20 |   const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  21 |   const [visible, setVisible] = useState(() => typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined");
  22 | 
  23 |   useEffect(() => {
  24 |     const el = ref.current;
  25 |     if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
  26 |       return;
  27 |     }
  28 | 
  29 |     const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
  30 |       ([entry]) => {
  31 |         if (entry?.isIntersecting) {
  32 |           setVisible(true);
  33 |           observer.disconnect();
  34 |         }
  35 |       },
  36 |       { rootMargin },
  37 |     );
  38 | 
  39 |     observer.observe(el);
  40 |     return () => {
  41 |       observer.disconnect();
  42 |     };
  43 |   }, [rootMargin]);
  44 | 
  45 |   return (
  46 |     <div ref={ref} style={{ minHeight: height }}>
  47 |       {visible ? children : <Skeleton className="w-full" style={{ height }} />}
  48 |     </div>
  49 |   );
  50 | }
```

```tsx
  46 |           </Button>
  47 |         ) : (
  48 |           <Button
  49 |             nativeButton={false}
  50 |             render={

  59 |             variant="secondary"
  60 |           >
```

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/forms/context.dom.test.tsx
   2 | //
   3 | // Tests for FormErrors / FormErrorMessageList in context.tsx.
   4 | //
   5 | // 1. normalizeErrors handles all three error shapes correctly.
   6 | // 2. FormErrors renders nothing when errors is empty.
   7 | // 3. FormErrors renders messages when the form has errors.
   8 | // 4. The message list updates exactly once per field-value change, not twice.
   9 | //    (Guards against the render-prop computing messages on every parent render
  10 | //    rather than only when `errors` changes.)
  11 | 
  12 | import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form";
  13 | import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
  14 | import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
  15 | import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vite-plus/test";
  16 | import { z } from "zod";
  17 | 
  18 | import { formContext, FormErrors, normalizeErrors } from "./context";
  19 | 
  20 | // ── normalizeErrors unit tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  21 | 
  22 | describe("normalizeErrors", () => {
  23 |   it("handles plain strings", () => {
  24 |     expect(normalizeErrors(["bad input", "another error"])).toEqual(["bad input", "another error"]);
  25 |   });
  26 | 
  27 |   it("handles { message } objects", () => {
  28 |     expect(normalizeErrors([{ message: "Name is required" }])).toEqual(["Name is required"]);
  29 |   });
  30 | 
  31 |   it("handles TanStack Form aggregated maps", () => {
  32 |     const err = { name: [{ message: "Too short" }, { message: "Required" }] };
  33 |     expect(normalizeErrors([err])).toEqual(["Too short", "Required"]);
  34 |   });
  35 | 
  36 |   it("deduplicates identical messages", () => {
  37 |     expect(normalizeErrors(["dup", "dup", { message: "dup" }])).toEqual(["dup"]);
  38 |   });
  39 | 
  40 |   it("ignores non-record non-string values", () => {
  41 |     expect(normalizeErrors([null, undefined, 42, true])).toEqual([]);
  42 |   });
  43 | });
  44 | 
  45 | // ── FormErrors integration tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  46 | //
  47 | // We build a minimal form using TanStack Form's raw API so we don't need the
  48 | // full `createFormHook` setup (which requires all the shadcn field wrappers).
  49 | // `FormErrors` only needs `formContext` and `form.Subscribe`.
  50 | 
  51 | const nameSchema = z.string().min(3, "Name must be at least 3 characters");
  52 | 
  53 | /**
  54 |  * A self-contained form that:
  55 |  *   - has a "name" field with an `onChange` validator (fires on every change)
  56 |  *   - renders `<FormErrors />` above the input
  57 |  *   - exposes `data-testid="render-count"` whose text increments each time
  58 |  *     `FormErrorMessageList` renders — so we can assert render frequency
  59 |  */
  60 | function TestForm() {
  61 |   const form = useForm({
  62 |     defaultValues: { name: "" },
  63 |     validators: {
  64 |       onChange: z.object({ name: nameSchema }),
  65 |     },
  66 |   });
  67 | 
  68 |   return (
  69 |     <formContext.Provider value={form}>
  70 |       <form
  71 |         noValidate
  72 |         onSubmit={(e) => {
  73 |           e.preventDefault();
  74 |           void form.handleSubmit();

  94 | describe("FormErrors", () => {

 119 |     const user = userEvent.setup();

 122 |     // Trigger validation.
 123 |     await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));
 124 |     await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole("list")).toBeInTheDocument());
 125 | 
 126 |     // Type a valid value.
 127 |     await user.type(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name" }), "Ana");

 130 |       expect(screen.queryByRole("list")).toBeNull();
 131 |     });
 132 |   });

 135 |     // We instrument the render by wrapping FormErrorMessageList indirectly
 136 |     // through the spy passed to TestForm.
 137 |     const renderSpy = vi.fn();
 138 | 
 139 |     // Build a wrapper that counts how many times the error list re-renders.
 140 |     function InstrumentedForm() {
 141 |       const form = useForm({
 142 |         defaultValues: { name: "" },
 143 |         validators: {
 144 |           onChange: z.object({ name: nameSchema }),
 145 |         },
 146 |       });

 148 |       return (

 154 |               void form.handleSubmit();
 155 |             }}

 158 |             <FormErrors />

 160 |             <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.errors}>
 161 |               {(errors) => {
 162 |                 renderSpy(errors);
 163 |                 return null;
 164 |               }}
 165 |             </form.Subscribe>

 167 |               {(field) => (
 168 |                 <input
 169 |                   aria-label="Name"
 170 |                   onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 171 |                   onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 172 |                   value={field.state.value}
 173 |                 />
 174 |               )}
 175 |             </form.Field>
 176 |             <button type="submit">Submit</button>
 177 |           </form>
 178 |         </formContext.Provider>
 179 |       );
 180 |     }
 181 | 
 182 |     const user = userEvent.setup();
 183 |     render(<InstrumentedForm />);
 184 | 
 185 |     // Trigger initial validation by submitting.
 186 |     await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));
 187 |     await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole("list")).toBeInTheDocument());
 188 | 
 189 |     const countAfterSubmit = renderSpy.mock.calls.length;
 190 | 
 191 |     // Type a single character — this changes the error array once.
 192 |     await user.type(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name" }), "A");
 193 | 
 194 |     await waitFor(() => {
 195 |       // The spy should have been called at most once more than before the type.
 196 |       // (It may fire twice if TanStack Form emits two error-array updates on
 197 |       // `onChange` + re-validate. We allow 2 total additional renders as the
 198 |       // upper bound; the important thing is not an unbounded cascade.)
 199 |       const delta = renderSpy.mock.calls.length - countAfterSubmit;
 200 |       expect(delta).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
 201 |       expect(delta).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
 202 |     });
 203 |   });
 204 | });
```

```tsx
   3 | /**
   4 |  * Shared primitives for the TanStack Form + shadcn/ui integration.
   5 |  *
   6 |  * Exports:
   7 |  *   - `fieldContext` / `formContext` — TanStack Form contexts, consumed by
   8 |  *     `createFormHook` in `tanstack-form.tsx`.
   9 |  *   - `useFieldContext` / `useFormContext` — hooks used inside field and form
  10 |  *     components.
  11 |  *   - `FormField` / `FormFieldError` / `FormFieldSet` — shadcn wrappers that
  12 |  *     add `aria-*` wiring and error visibility rules on top of the base
  13 |  *     `ui/field` primitives.
  14 |  *   - `createFormField` — higher-order wrapper that turns a plain field
  15 |  *     component into one registrable with `createFormHook`.
  16 |  *   - `typedField` — helper for narrowing a component's `name` prop to
  17 |  *     `DeepKeys<TValues>` at the call site.
  18 |  *   - `FormErrors` / `scrollToFirstError` — form-level error summary and
  19 |  *     scroll-to-first-error helper for submit handlers.
  20 |  *
  21 |  * ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  22 |  * Layering contract (why `FormFieldSet` is the boundary)
  23 |  * ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  24 |  * Field components read their field API via `useFieldContext()`. That hook
  25 |  * reads a single merged context (`FormItemContext`) that contains BOTH:
  26 |  *   - the field API injected by `createFormField` via `fieldContext`, and
  27 |  *   - a stable DOM `id` generated per field.
  28 |  *
  29 |  * The merge happens in `FormFieldSet`, which is therefore the required
  30 |  * boundary. Consumers must render:
  31 |  *
  32 |  *     <FormFieldSet>          ← reads TanStack's fieldContext, generates id
  33 |  *       <FieldComponent />    ← calls useFieldContext() safely
  34 |  *     </FormFieldSet>
  35 |  *
  36 |  * If a leaf calls `useFieldContext()` ABOVE its own `<FormFieldSet>`, the
  37 |  * provider it needs has not mounted yet and the hook throws.
  38 |  * ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  39 |  */
  40 | 
  41 | import type { VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
  42 | 
  43 | import { createFormHookContexts, useSelector } from "@tanstack/react-form";
  44 | import * as React from "react";
  45 | 
  46 | import type { fieldVariants } from "@/components/ui/field";
  47 | import type { FieldConfig, FormFieldSlot, FormItemContextValue, WithTypedName } from "@/types/form";
  48 | 
  49 | import {
  50 |   Field as DefaultField,
  51 |   FieldError as DefaultFieldError,
  52 |   FieldSet as DefaultFieldSet,

  54 | 
  55 | /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  56 | /* Small type guard — avoids `as Record<string, unknown>` casts        */
  57 | /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  58 | 
  59 | function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  60 |   return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
  61 | }
  62 | 
  63 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  64 | // 1. Contexts
  65 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66 | 
  67 | const {
  68 |   fieldContext,
  69 |   formContext,
  70 |   useFieldContext: _useFieldContext,
  71 |   useFormContext,
  72 | } = createFormHookContexts();
  73 | 
  74 | /**
  75 |  * The merged per-field context consumed by `useFieldContext`.
  76 |  *
  77 |  * `null` default (rather than `{} as FormItemContextValue`) so a missing
  78 |  * `<FormFieldSet>` wrapper is caught at runtime instead of producing
  79 |  * `undefined-form-item` ids silently.
  80 |  */
  81 | const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue | null>(null);
  82 | 
  83 | /**
  84 |  * Read the merged field context.

  87 |  * that provides `FormItemContext`). The provider is populated by `FieldSet`.

  91 | const useFieldContext = (): FormItemContextValue => {
  92 |   const context = React.useContext(FormItemContext);
  93 |   if (!context) {
  94 |     throw new Error("useFieldContext must be used within a <FormFieldSet>");
  95 |   }
  96 |   return context;

  98 | 
  99 | /**
 100 |  * `FieldSet` is the merge point between TanStack Form's field API and the
 101 |  * DOM ids this module hands to `Field` / `FieldError` for `aria-*` wiring.
 102 |  *
 103 |  * `_useFieldContext()` is safe to call here because `createFormField` always
 104 |  * renders the field component *inside* `fieldContext.Provider`. `useSelector`
 105 |  * is called unconditionally at the top level — NOT inside `useMemo` — so the
 106 |  * Rules of Hooks hold across renders.
 107 |  */
 108 | /**
 109 |  * Outer component: reads context with the safe hook, branches on the
 110 |  * *value*, and only then renders the inner component that owns the id
 111 |  * and store hooks.
 112 |  */
 113 | function FieldSet(props: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"fieldset">) {
 114 |   const fieldApi = _useFieldContext(); // may return null? see below
 115 | 
 116 |   if (!fieldApi) {
 117 |     throw new Error(
 118 |       "FormFieldSet must be rendered inside a field created by " +
 119 |         "createFormField / AppField (no field context available).",
 120 |     );
 121 |   }
 122 | 
 123 |   // All remaining hooks live in the inner component, so this component
 124 |   // has exactly ONE hook: useContext. Its hook count is stable across
 125 |   // every render — even the render that throws has already committed
 126 |   // to exactly one hook before the throw.
 127 |   return <FieldSetInner fieldApi={fieldApi} {...props} />;
 128 | }
 129 | 
 130 | function FieldSetInner({
 131 |   fieldApi,
 132 |   className,
 133 |   children,
 134 |   ...props
 135 | }: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"fieldset"> & {
 136 |   fieldApi: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof _useFieldContext>>;
 137 | }) {
 138 |   const id = React.useId();
 139 |   const errors = useSelector(fieldApi.store, (state) => state.meta.errors);
 140 |   const contextValue = React.useMemo<FormItemContextValue>(
 141 |     () => ({
 142 |       field: fieldApi,
 143 |       id,
 144 |       store: fieldApi.store,
 145 |       formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
 146 |       formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
 147 |       formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
 148 |       errors,
 149 |     }),
 150 |     [id, fieldApi, errors],
 151 |   );
 152 | 
 153 |   return (
 154 |     <FormItemContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
 155 |       <DefaultFieldSet className={className} {...props}>
 156 |         {children}
 157 |       </DefaultFieldSet>
 158 |     </FormItemContext.Provider>
 159 |   );
 160 | }

 162 | function Field({
 163 |   children,
 164 |   ...props
 165 | }: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DefaultField> & VariantProps<typeof fieldVariants>) {
 166 |   const { field, errors, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFieldContext();
 167 |   const form = useFormContext();
 168 |   const isTouched = useSelector(field.store, (state) => state.meta.isTouched);
 169 |   const hasSubmitted = useSelector(form.store, (s) => s.submissionAttempts > 0);
 170 |   const hasVisibleErrors = errors.length > 0 && (isTouched || hasSubmitted);
 171 | 
 172 |   return (
 173 |     <DefaultField
 174 |       aria-describedby={

 176 |       }
 177 |       aria-invalid={hasVisibleErrors}
 178 |       data-invalid={hasVisibleErrors}
 179 |       id={formItemId}
 180 |       {...props}
 181 |     >
 182 |       {children}
 183 |     </DefaultField>

 185 | }

 187 | function FieldError({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
 188 |   const { errors, formMessageId, store } = useFieldContext();
 189 |   const form = useFormContext();
 190 |   const isTouched = useSelector(store, (state) => state.meta.isTouched);
 191 |   const hasSubmitted = useSelector(form.store, (s) => s.submissionAttempts > 0);

 193 |   if (!(errors.length > 0 && (isTouched || hasSubmitted))) return null;

 197 |       className={className}
 198 |       data-slot="form-message"

 202 |       // Our `errors` is `unknown[]` because that's what TanStack exposes.

 204 |       errors={errors as Array<{ message?: string } | undefined>}
 205 |     />
 206 |   );

 209 | /**
 210 |  * Normalizes TanStack Form's `unknown[]` error array into deduplicated
 211 |  * human-readable strings. Handles three shapes:
 212 |  *   - `string` — a plain message
 213 |  *   - `{ message: string }` — the common Zod/validator shape
 214 |  *   - `{ fieldName: Array<{ message: string }> }` — TanStack Form's aggregated
 215 |  *     error map for whole-form validators
 216 |  */
 217 | function normalizeErrors(errs: unknown[]): string[] {
 218 |   const messages: string[] = [];
 219 | 
 220 |   for (const err of errs) {
 221 |     if (typeof err === "string") {
 222 |       messages.push(err);
 223 |       continue;
 224 |     }
 225 |     if (!isRecord(err)) continue;
 226 | 
 227 |     if ("message" in err && typeof err.message === "string") {
 228 |       messages.push(err.message);
 229 |       continue;
 230 |     }
 231 | 
 232 |     for (const key of Object.keys(err)) {
 233 |       const issues = err[key];
 234 |       if (!Array.isArray(issues)) continue;
 235 |       for (const issue of issues) {
 236 |         if (isRecord(issue) && typeof issue.message === "string") {
 237 |           messages.push(issue.message);
 238 |         } else if (typeof issue === "string") {
 239 |           messages.push(issue);
 240 |         }
 241 |       }
 242 |     }
 243 |   }
 244 | 
 245 |   return [...new Set(messages)];
 246 | }
 247 | 
 248 | /**
 249 |  * Inner component so `useMemo` runs at the top level of a real component,
 250 |  * not inside a render-prop callback (where hooks are forbidden).
 251 |  *
 252 |  * Re-renders only when `errors` changes (the `form.Subscribe` selector
 253 |  * guarantees that). The `useMemo` avoids re-running `normalizeErrors`
 254 |  * on unrelated re-renders of the outer component tree.
 255 |  */
 256 | function FormErrorMessageList({ errors }: { errors: unknown[] }) {
 257 |   const messages = React.useMemo(() => normalizeErrors(errors), [errors]);
 258 |   if (messages.length === 0) return null;
 259 | 
 260 |   return (
 261 |     <ul className="text-destructive ms-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
 262 |       {messages.map((message) => (
 263 |         <li key={message}>{message}</li>
 264 |       ))}
 265 |     </ul>
 266 |   );
 267 | }
 268 | 
 269 | /**
 270 |  * Renders a summary of every error currently attached to the form.
 271 |  *
 272 |  * Useful at the top of a form (or in a `FormActions` block) so a user sees
 273 |  * why submission failed even when the offending field is scrolled out of view.
 274 |  * Silently renders nothing when there are no errors.
 275 |  */
 276 | function FormErrors() {
 277 |   const form = useFormContext();
 278 |   const selector = React.useCallback((state: { errors: unknown[] }) => state.errors, []);
 279 | 
 280 |   return (
 281 |     <form.Subscribe selector={selector}>
 282 |       {(errors) => {
 283 |         if (errors.length === 0) return null;
 284 |         return <FormErrorMessageList errors={errors} />;
 285 |       }}
 286 |     </form.Subscribe>
 287 |   );
 288 | }

 290 | /**
 291 |  * Smooth-scrolls the first field marked `data-invalid="true"` into view and
 292 |  * focuses its first focusable child.
 293 |  *
 294 |  * Call this from a form's `onSubmit` after `form.handleSubmit()` fails
 295 |  * validation — the check runs inside `requestAnimationFrame` so React has
 296 |  * flushed the invalid state before the query selector runs.
 297 |  */
 298 | function scrollToFirstError() {
 299 |   requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 300 |     const firstError = document.querySelector('[data-invalid="true"]');
 301 |     if (firstError) {
 302 |       firstError.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
 303 |       const focusable = firstError.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
 304 |         "input, textarea, select, button, [tabindex]",
 305 |       );
 306 |       focusable?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
 307 |     }
 308 |   });
 309 | }

 311 | /**
 312 |  * Wraps a field component so it can be registered with `createFormHook` and
 313 |  * used as `<form.TextField name="..." label="..." />`.
 314 |  *
 315 |  * The wrapper handles three concerns:
 316 |  *   1. Injects the field API into `fieldContext` so `FormFieldSet` (rendered
 317 |  *      by the field component itself) can merge it with a DOM id and hand
 318 |  *      the result to `useFieldContext`.
 319 |  *   2. Forwards the standard `FieldConfig` props (`validators`, `listeners`,
 320 |  *      `asyncDebounceMs`, `mode`, `defaultValue`) to `form.Field`.
 321 |  *   3. Auto-disables the field while the form is submitting.
 322 |  *
 323 |  * The generic is `P extends object` (not `Record<string, unknown>`) because
 324 |  * concrete props interfaces — like `TextareaFieldProps` — do not have an
 325 |  * index signature and therefore do not satisfy `Record<string, unknown>`.
 326 |  */
 327 | function createFormField<P extends object>(FieldComponent: React.ComponentType<P>) {
 328 |   type Props = { name: string } & FieldConfig &
 329 |     Omit<P, keyof FieldConfig | "name" | "disabled"> & {
 330 |       disabled?: boolean;
 331 |     };
 332 | 
 333 |   function ComposedFormField({
 334 |     name,
 335 |     validators,
 336 |     asyncDebounceMs,
 337 |     listeners,
 338 |     mode,
 339 |     defaultValue,
 340 |     ...rest
 341 |   }: Props) {
 342 |     const form = useFormContext();
 343 |     const isSubmitting = useSelector(form.store, (state) => state.isSubmitting);
 344 |     const finalDisabled = rest.disabled || isSubmitting;
 345 | 
 346 |     // `rest` holds every P-specific prop except the config keys extracted
 347 |     // above. At runtime these are the exact props `FieldComponent` reads.
 348 | 
 349 |     const componentProps = rest as P;
 350 | 
 351 |     // `form.Field`'s generic slot signature does not infer cleanly against
 352 |     // our concrete `FormFieldSlot` type. The shapes match at runtime.
 353 | 
 354 |     const FieldSlot = form.Field as FormFieldSlot;
 355 | 
 356 |     return (
 357 |       <FieldSlot
 358 |         asyncDebounceMs={asyncDebounceMs}
 359 |         // oxlint-disable-next-line ui/no-uncontrolled-input -- defaultValue is a TanStack Form field API prop, not an uncontrolled input default
 360 |         defaultValue={defaultValue}
 361 |         listeners={listeners}
 362 |         mode={mode}
 363 |         name={name}
 364 |         validators={validators}
 365 |       >
 366 |         {(fieldApi) => (
 367 |           <fieldContext.Provider value={fieldApi}>
 368 |             {/*
 369 |               The leaf component MUST wrap its own contents in `<FormFieldSet>`
 370 |               so its descendants can call `useFieldContext()`. See the
 371 |               layering contract at the top of this file.
 372 |             */}
 373 |             <FieldComponent {...componentProps} disabled={finalDisabled} />
 374 |           </fieldContext.Provider>
 375 |         )}
 376 |       </FieldSlot>
 377 |     );
 378 |   }
 379 |   ComposedFormField.displayName = `FormField(${FieldComponent.displayName ?? FieldComponent.name})`;
 380 | 
 381 |   return ComposedFormField;
 382 | }
 383 | 
 384 | /**
 385 |  * Narrows a field component's `name` prop to `DeepKeys<TValues>`. Returns the
 386 |  * same component, only retyped.
 387 |  *
 388 |  * The cast is unavoidable: TypeScript cannot verify that a component accepting
 389 |  * `name: string` is safely assignable to one accepting `name: DeepKeys<TValues>`
 390 |  * because prop types are contravariant. The runtime component is unchanged.
 391 |  *
 392 |  * Using `React.ComponentType<never>` as the upper bound sidesteps the
 393 |  * contravariance trap: since `never` is the bottom type, every
 394 |  * `ComponentType<P>` satisfies `ComponentType<never>`. The `WithTypedName`
 395 |  * conditional then independently checks that the inferred props include
 396 |  * `name: string` before narrowing.
 397 |  */
 398 | function narrowFieldName<C extends React.ComponentType<never>, TValues>(
 399 |   Component: C,
 400 | ): WithTypedName<C, TValues> {
 401 |   return Component as WithTypedName<C, TValues>;
 402 | }
 403 | 
 404 | /**
 405 |  * Narrows a field component's `name` prop to `DeepKeys<TValues>` at the call
 406 |  * site. Returns the same component, only retyped.
 407 |  *
 408 |  * Usage:
 409 |  *
 410 |  *     const fields = useFormFields<PatientFormValues>();
 411 |  *     <fields.FormTextField name="firstName" label="First name" />
 412 |  */
 413 | function typedField<TValues extends Record<string, unknown>>() {
 414 |   return <C extends React.ComponentType<never>>(Component: C): WithTypedName<C, TValues> =>
 415 |     narrowFieldName<C, TValues>(Component);
 416 | }
 417 | 
 418 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 419 | // Exports
 420 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 421 | 
 422 | export {
 423 |   createFormField,
 424 |   fieldContext,
 425 |   formContext,
 426 |   FormErrorMessageList,
 427 |   FormErrors,
 428 |   Field as FormField,
 429 |   FieldError as FormFieldError,
 430 |   FieldSet as FormFieldSet,
 431 |   FormItemContext,
 432 |   normalizeErrors,
 433 |   scrollToFirstError,
 434 |   typedField,
 435 |   useFieldContext,
 436 |   useFormContext,
 437 | };
```

```ts
   1 | /**
   2 |  * TanStack Form exposes field errors as `unknown[]` (it accepts strings,
   3 |  * Zod issues, standard-schema issues, and thrown errors). Normalise to a
   4 |  * displayable string or `undefined`.
   5 |  */
   6 | export function fieldErrorMessage(err: unknown): string | undefined {
   7 |   if (!err) return undefined;
   8 |   if (typeof err === "string") return err;
   9 |   if (typeof err === "object" && "message" in err) {
  10 |     const m = (err as { message: unknown }).message;
  11 |     if (typeof m === "string") return m;
  12 |   }
  13 |   return undefined;
  14 | }
  15 | 
  16 | /** Read the first field error and normalise it. */
  17 | export function firstFieldError(errors: readonly unknown[]): string | undefined {
  18 |   return fieldErrorMessage(errors[0]);
  19 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 | 
   3 | /**
   4 |  * Shared open/close + reset-on-close behaviour for dialog-hosted forms.
   5 |  * `reset` should be a stable callback (use `React.useCallback` or a
   6 |  * module-level `buildDefaults`).
   7 |  */
   8 | export function useDialogForm<TForm extends { reset: (values?: unknown) => void }>(
   9 |   form: TForm,
  10 |   resetValues: unknown,
  11 | ) {
  12 |   const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  13 | 
  14 |   const handleOpenChange = React.useCallback(
  15 |     (next: boolean) => {
  16 |       setOpen(next);
  17 |       if (!next) form.reset(resetValues);
  18 |     },
  19 |     [form, resetValues],
  20 |   );
  21 | 
  22 |   return { open, setOpen, handleOpenChange };
  23 | }
```

```ts
   9 |   submit: (values: TValues) => Promise<TResult>;
  10 |   /** Called after a successful submit — reset the form, close the dialog, etc. */
  11 |   onSuccess?: (result: TResult, values: TValues) => void;
  12 |   /** Toast shown on success. Omit to suppress. */
  13 |   successToast?: string;
  14 |   /** Toast shown on failure. Defaults to the thrown error's message. */
  15 |   errorToast?: string | ((error: unknown) => string);
  16 | }
  17 | 
  18 | /**
  19 |  * Wraps TanStack Form's `onSubmitAsync` contract (return `undefined` on
  20 |  * success, `{ form: string }` on failure) around a mutation, so every form
  21 |  * gets the same toast + error-map behaviour without copy-paste.
  22 |  */
  23 | export function useMutationFormSubmit<TValues, TResult>({
  24 |   submit,
  25 |   onSuccess,
  26 |   successToast,
  27 |   errorToast,
  28 | }: UseMutationFormOptions<TValues, TResult>) {
  29 |   return React.useCallback(
  30 |     async ({ value }: { value: TValues }): Promise<SubmitOutcome> => {
  31 |       try {
  32 |         const result = await submit(value);
  33 |         if (successToast) toast.add({ type: "success", description: successToast });
  34 |         onSuccess?.(result, value);
  35 |         return undefined;
  36 |       } catch (error) {
  37 |         const message =
  38 |           typeof errorToast === "function"
  39 |             ? errorToast(error)
  40 |             : (errorToast ?? (error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed"));
  41 |         return { form: message };
  42 |       }
  43 |     },
  44 |     [submit, onSuccess, successToast, errorToast],
  45 |   );
  46 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import type { Indicator, Sex, XAxis } from "#/features/growth/types/types.ts";
   2 | 
   3 | /** A single measured point to overlay on the reference curves. */
   4 | export interface GrowthPoint {
   5 |   /** X value: age in months (age-based) or length in cm (weight-for-length). */
   6 |   x: number;
   7 |   /** Measured value (kg, cm, or BMI). */
   8 |   y: number;
   9 |   /** When the point was recorded, ISO string. */
  10 |   visitedAt?: string | Date;
  11 |   /** Pre-computed Z-score (or null when it couldn't be computed). */
  12 |   zScore?: number | null;
  13 | }
  14 | 
  15 | export const SERIES_COLORS = {
  16 |   sd3neg: "#ef4444",
  17 |   sd2neg: "#f97316",
  18 |   sd1neg: "#eab308",
  19 |   median: "#16a34a",
  20 |   sd1: "#22c55e",
  21 |   sd2: "#3b82f6",
  22 |   sd3: "#8b5cf6",
  23 | } as const;
  24 | 
  25 | export type BandKey = keyof typeof SERIES_COLORS;
  26 | 
  27 | /** Draw order: widest first, median last so it renders on top. */
  28 | export const BAND_DRAW_ORDER: readonly BandKey[] = [
  29 |   "sd3neg",
  30 |   "sd2neg",
  31 |   "sd1neg",
  32 |   "median",
  33 |   "sd1",
  34 |   "sd2",
  35 |   "sd3",
  36 | ] as const;
  37 | 
  38 | /** Solid for −2/median/+2; dashed for the ±1 and ±3 bands. */
  39 | export const BAND_STROKE_DASHARRAY: Partial<Record<BandKey, string>> = {
  40 |   sd3neg: "4 3",
  41 |   sd1neg: "4 3",
  42 |   sd1: "4 3",
  43 |   sd3: "4 3",
  44 | };
  45 | 
  46 | export const BAND_LABELS = {
  47 |   sd3neg: "−3 SD",
  48 |   sd2neg: "−2 SD",
  49 |   sd1neg: "−1 SD",
  50 |   median: "Median",
  51 |   sd1: "+1 SD",
  52 |   sd2: "+2 SD",
  53 |   sd3: "+3 SD",
  54 | } as const;
  55 | 
  56 | export function axisLabel(xAxis: XAxis): string {
  57 |   return xAxis === "age" ? "Age (months)" : "Length (cm)";
  58 | }
  59 | 
  60 | export function valueLabel(indicator: Indicator): string {
  61 |   switch (indicator) {
  62 |     case "weight-for-age":
  63 |     case "weight-for-length":
  64 |       return "Weight (kg)";
  65 |     case "length-for-age":
  66 |       return "Length / height (cm)";
  67 |     case "bmi-for-age":
  68 |       return "BMI (kg/m²)";
  69 |     default:
  70 |       return "";
  71 |   }
  72 | }
  73 | 
  74 | export function defaultAriaLabel(indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex): string {
  75 |   const who = sex === "male" ? "boy" : "girl";
  76 |   return `Egyptian 2021 ${indicator} reference chart for a ${who}`;
  77 | }
  78 | 
  79 | /** 1-decimal formatting used by the tooltip and hidden table. */
  80 | export function formatValue(v: number): string {
  81 |   return v.toFixed(1);
  82 | }
```

```tsx
 114 | function TitledSvg({
 115 |   title,
 116 |   children,
 117 |   ...props
 118 | }: IconProps & { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
 119 |   return (

 122 |       {children}
 123 |     </svg>
 124 |   );
 125 | }

 137 |     </svg>
 138 |   );
```
