```tsx
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 | 
   3 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
   4 | 
   5 | type VisualProps = {
   6 |   className?: string;
   7 |   priority?: boolean;
   8 |   aspect?: string;
   9 | };
  10 | 
  11 | // Mapped to your exact public/images folder
  12 | const IMAGE_MAP = {
  13 |   hero: "/images/hero.webp",
  14 |   growth: "/images/growth-development.webp",
  15 |   immunization: "/images/vaccination.webp",
  16 |   dosing: "/images/consultation.webp",
  17 |   appointments: "/images/development.webp",
  18 |   sick: "/images/sick-child.webp",
  19 | } as const;
  20 | 
  21 | function VisualFrame({
  22 |   src,
  23 |   priority = false,
  24 |   className,
  25 |   aspect = "aspect-[5/3]",
  26 | }: VisualProps & { src: string }) {
  27 |   const [errored, setErrored] = React.useState(false);
  28 | 
  29 |   if (errored) {
  30 |     return (
  31 |       <div
  32 |         className={cn(
  33 |           "from-primary/15 via-secondary/10 w-full rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br to-transparent",
  34 |           aspect,
  35 |           className,
  36 |         )}
  37 |       />
  38 |     );
  39 |   }
  40 | 
  41 |   return (
  42 |     <div
  43 |       className={cn("bg-muted/40 relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl", aspect, className)}
  44 |     >
  45 |       <img
  46 |         alt=""
  47 |         className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 ease-out group-hover:scale-[1.04]"
  48 |         decoding="async"
  49 |         draggable={false}
  50 |         fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : "auto"}
  51 |         height={1200}
  52 |         loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
  53 |         onError={() => setErrored(true)}
  54 |         sizes={
  55 |           priority
  56 |             ? "(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 50vw"
  57 |             : "(max-width: 768px) 100vw, (max-width: 1200px) 50vw, 33vw"
  58 |         }
  59 |         src={src}
  60 |         width={1200}
  61 |       />
  62 |     </div>
  63 |   );
  64 | }
  65 | 
  66 | export function HeroVisual(props: VisualProps) {
  67 |   return <VisualFrame src={IMAGE_MAP.hero} {...props} />;
  68 | }
  69 | 
  70 | export function GrowthChartVisual(props: VisualProps) {
  71 |   return <VisualFrame src={IMAGE_MAP.growth} {...props} />;
  72 | }
  73 | 
  74 | export function ImmunizationVisual(props: VisualProps) {
  75 |   return <VisualFrame src={IMAGE_MAP.immunization} {...props} />;
  76 | }
  77 | 
  78 | export function DosingVisual(props: VisualProps) {
  79 |   return <VisualFrame src={IMAGE_MAP.dosing} {...props} />;
  80 | }
  81 | 
  82 | export function AppointmentsVisual(props: VisualProps) {
  83 |   return <VisualFrame src={IMAGE_MAP.appointments} {...props} />;
  84 | }
  85 | 
  86 | export function SickChildVisual(props: VisualProps) {
  87 |   return <VisualFrame src={IMAGE_MAP.sick} {...props} />;
  88 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | // Src/components/root-components.tsx
   2 | import { type ErrorComponentProps, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | 
   4 | /**
   5 |  * Root-level error boundary.
   6 |  *
   7 |  * Rendered by the router when a route throws. TanStack Router passes
   8 |  * `{ error, reset, info, router }` — we use `error` for display and
   9 |  * `reset` to retry the failed route without a full page reload.
  10 |  *
  11 |  * Prefer `reset()` over `window.location.reload()`: it re-runs the
  12 |  * route's loaders and components in place, preserving router state
  13 |  * (scroll position, query cache, sibling route data).
  14 |  */
  15 | export function RootErrorComponent({ error, reset }: ErrorComponentProps) {
  16 |   // In production, forward to your error reporter here.
  17 |   if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
  18 |     console.error("[RootErrorComponent]", error);
  19 |   }
  20 | 
  21 |   return (
  22 |     <main className="page-wrap flex min-h-[60vh] flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-16 text-center">
  23 |       <h1 className="display-title text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">Something went wrong.</h1>
  24 |       <p className="mt-3 max-w-md text-sm text-[var(--muted-foreground)]">
  25 |         {error instanceof Error
  26 |           ? error.message
  27 |           : "The page failed to load. This has been logged. Try reloading, or head back to the dashboard."}
  28 |       </p>
  29 |       <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
  30 |         <button className="btn-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold" onClick={reset} type="button">
  31 |           Try again
  32 |         </button>
  33 |         <Link className="btn-ghost px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold" to="/app">
  34 |           Go to dashboard
  35 |         </Link>
  36 |       </div>
  37 |     </main>
  38 |   );
  39 | }
  40 | 
  41 | /**
  42 |  * Root-level 404.
  43 |  *
  44 |  * Rendered when a URL matches no route. Kept as a separate component
  45 |  * from `components/NotFound.tsx` so the router can register it as
  46 |  * `notFoundComponent` on the root route without a circular import
  47 |  * (NotFound.tsx itself imports `useRouter` from the router package).
  48 |  */
  49 | export function RootNotFoundComponent() {
  50 |   return (
  51 |     <main className="page-wrap flex min-h-[60vh] flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-16 text-center">
  52 |       <p className="kicker mb-2">404</p>
  53 |       <h1 className="display-title text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">
  54 |         We couldn't find that page.
  55 |       </h1>
  56 |       <p className="mt-3 max-w-md text-sm text-[var(--muted-foreground)]">
  57 |         The link may be broken, or the page may have been moved.
  58 |       </p>
  59 |       <Link className="btn-ghost mt-6 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold" to="/app">
  60 |         Go to dashboard
  61 |       </Link>
  62 |     </main>
  63 |   );
  64 | }
```

`components/sign-out-button.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // src/components/sign-out-button.tsx
   2 | import { useRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | import * as React from "react";
   4 | 
   5 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   6 | import { authClient } from "#/lib/auth-client";
   7 | import { cn } from "#/lib/utils";
   8 | 
   9 | /** The sign-out action + pending state. Reusable anywhere. */
  10 | export function useSignOut() {
  11 |   const router = useRouter();
  12 |   const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  13 | 
  14 |   const signOut = React.useCallback(async () => {
  15 |     setPending(true);
  16 |     try {
  17 |       await authClient.signOut();
  18 |       await router.invalidate();
  19 |     } finally {
  20 |       setPending(false);
  21 |     }
  22 |   }, [router]);
  23 | 
  24 |   return { pending, signOut };
  25 | }
  26 | 
  27 | /** Standalone destructive button. */
  28 | export function SignOutButton({
  29 |   className,
  30 |   label = "Sign out",
  31 |   pendingLabel = "Signing out…",
  32 | }: {
  33 |   className?: string;
  34 |   label?: string;
  35 |   pendingLabel?: string;
  36 | } = {}) {
  37 |   const { signOut, pending } = useSignOut();
  38 | 
  39 |   return (
  40 |     <Button
  41 |       className={cn("w-fit", className)}
  42 |       disabled={pending}
  43 |       onClick={() => void signOut()}
  44 |       size="sm"
  45 |       type="button"
  46 |       variant="destructive"
  47 |     >
  48 |       {pending ? pendingLabel : label}
  49 |     </Button>
  50 |   );
  51 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | // Src/components/table/components/sync-status-indicator.tsx
   2 | 
   3 | import { AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
   4 | 
   5 | import { cn } from "#/lib/utils";
   6 | import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
   7 | 
   8 | export type SyncStatus = "synced" | "pending" | "failed";
   9 | 
  10 | interface SyncStatusIndicatorProps {
  11 |   className?: string;
  12 |   status: SyncStatus | undefined;
  13 | }
  14 | 
  15 | /**
  16 |  * Renders a per-row sync indicator.
  17 |  *
  18 |  *   pending → spinner (the write is queued locally)
  19 |  *   failed  → destructive alert icon (the write was rejected)
  20 |  *   synced  → nothing (the common case; keep the cell quiet)
  21 |  */
  22 | export function SyncStatusIndicator({ status, className }: SyncStatusIndicatorProps) {
  23 |   if (!status || status === "synced") {
  24 |     return null;
  25 |   }
  26 | 
  27 |   if (status === "pending") {
  28 |     return <Spinner aria-label="Pending sync" className={cn(" size-3", className)} />;
  29 |   }
  30 | 
  31 |   return (
  32 |     <AlertCircle
  33 |       aria-label="Sync failed"
  34 |       className={cn("text-destructive size-3", className)}
  35 |       role="img"
  36 |     />
  37 |   );
  38 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import type { AnyRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   2 | import type { ReactTable, RowData, TableFeatures } from "@tanstack/react-table";
   3 | import type * as React from "react";
   4 | 
   5 | import { CircleAlertIcon, SearchXIcon } from "lucide-react";
   6 | 
   7 | import { SectionState } from "@/components/blocks/state-view";
   8 | import { type ColumnLayout, TableColGroup } from "@/components/blocks/table-columns";
   9 | import { type PageSize, TablePagination } from "@/components/tables/table-pagination";
  10 | import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  11 | import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
  12 | import {
  13 |   Table as TablePrimitive,
  14 |   TableBody,
  15 |   TableCell,
  16 |   TableHead,
  17 |   TableHeader,
  18 |   TableRow,
  19 | } from "@/components/ui/table";
  20 | 
  21 | /** Minimal shape of the `useQuery` result we need — keeps the shell query-library agnostic. */
  22 | interface QueryLike {
  23 |   isError: boolean;
  24 |   isFetching: boolean;
  25 |   error: unknown;
  26 |   refetch: () => unknown;
  27 | }
  28 | 
  29 | function getHideOnMobile(meta: unknown): boolean {
  30 |   return (
  31 |     typeof meta === "object" &&
  32 |     meta !== null &&
  33 |     "hideOnMobile" in meta &&
  34 |     meta.hideOnMobile === true
  35 |   );
  36 | }
  37 | 
  38 | function getColumnLayout(meta: unknown): ColumnLayout {
  39 |   if (typeof meta !== "object" || meta === null) return {};
  40 |   return {
  41 |     width: "width" in meta && typeof meta.width === "string" ? meta.width : undefined,
  42 |     hideOnMobile: getHideOnMobile(meta),
  43 |   };
  44 | }
  45 | 
  46 | /**
  47 |  * The table instance owns rendering and column metadata; the shell owns the
  48 |  * shared loading, error, empty, and optional route-pagination presentation.
  49 |  */
  50 | export interface DataTableProps<TFeatures extends TableFeatures, TData extends RowData> {
  51 |   table: ReactTable<TFeatures, TData>;
  52 |   query?: QueryLike;
  53 |   ariaLabel: string;
  54 |   emptyMessage: React.ReactNode;
  55 |   errorTitle?: string;
  56 |   errorDescription?: string;
  57 |   /** Rows of skeleton to render while fetching with no data. Default 3. */
  58 |   skeletonRowCount?: number;
  59 |   /** Out-of-range guard. Omit to disable (e.g. manual pagination with `pageCount: -1`). */
  60 |   outOfRange?: {
  61 |     backTo: () => React.ReactElement;
  62 |   };
  63 |   /** URL pagination. Omit for tables that render all rows without page controls. */
  64 |   pagination?: {
  65 |     page: number;
  66 |     pageCount: number;
  67 |     size: PageSize;
  68 |     route?: AnyRoute;
  69 |   };
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | export function DataTable<TFeatures extends TableFeatures, TData extends RowData>({
  73 |   table,
  74 |   query,
  75 |   ariaLabel,
  76 |   emptyMessage,
  77 |   errorTitle = "Could Not Load Data",
  78 |   errorDescription,
  79 |   skeletonRowCount = 3,
  80 |   outOfRange,
  81 |   pagination,
  82 | }: DataTableProps<TFeatures, TData>) {
  83 |   if (query?.isError) {
  84 |     return (
  85 |       <SectionState
  86 |         action={
  87 |           <Button
  88 |             disabled={query.isFetching}
  89 |             onClick={() => void query.refetch()}
  90 |             variant="outline"
  91 |           >
  92 |             {query.isFetching ? "Retrying…" : "Try Again"}
  93 |           </Button>
  94 |         }
  95 |         description={
  96 |           errorDescription ??
  97 |           (query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred.")
  98 |         }
  99 |         icon={CircleAlertIcon}
 100 |         title={errorTitle}
 101 |       />
 102 |     );
 103 |   }
 104 | 
 105 |   const isFetching = query?.isFetching ?? false;
 106 | 
 107 |   // v9: `pageCount` may be `-1` for cursor pagination; only guard when finite.
 108 |   if (
 109 |     outOfRange &&
 110 |     pagination &&
 111 |     pagination.pageCount > 0 &&
 112 |     pagination.page > pagination.pageCount
 113 |   ) {
 114 |     return (
 115 |       <SectionState
 116 |         action={outOfRange.backTo()}
 117 |         description={`There are only ${pagination.pageCount.toLocaleString("en-US")} pages.`}
 118 |         icon={SearchXIcon}
 119 |         title="Page Not Found"
 120 |       />
 121 |     );
 122 |   }
 123 | 
 124 |   const columnLayout = table
 125 |     .getAllLeafColumns()
 126 |     .map((column) => getColumnLayout(column.columnDef.meta));
 127 |   const leafColumnCount = columnLayout.length;
 128 |   const rows = table.getRowModel().rows;
 129 |   const showEmpty = rows.length === 0 && !isFetching;
 130 | 
 131 |   return (
 132 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
 133 |       <TablePrimitive aria-busy={isFetching} aria-label={ariaLabel} layout="fixed">
 134 |         <TableColGroup columns={columnLayout} />
 135 |         <TableHeader>
 136 |           {table.getHeaderGroups().map((group) => (
 137 |             <TableRow key={group.id}>
 138 |               {group.headers.map((header) => (
 139 |                 <TableHead
 140 |                   hideOnMobile={getHideOnMobile(header.column.columnDef.meta)}
 141 |                   key={header.id}
 142 |                 >
 143 |                   <table.FlexRender header={header} />
 144 |                 </TableHead>
 145 |               ))}
 146 |             </TableRow>
 147 |           ))}
 148 |         </TableHeader>
 149 |         <TableBody>
 150 |           {showEmpty && (
 151 |             <TableRow>
 152 |               <TableCell colSpan={leafColumnCount}>
 153 |                 <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm">{emptyMessage}</div>
 154 |               </TableCell>
 155 |             </TableRow>
 156 |           )}
 157 |           {!showEmpty &&
 158 |             rows.map((row) => (
 159 |               <TableRow key={row.id}>
 160 |                 {row.getAllCells().map((cell) => (
 161 |                   <TableCell
 162 |                     hideOnMobile={getHideOnMobile(cell.column.columnDef.meta)}
 163 |                     key={cell.id}
 164 |                   >
 165 |                     <table.FlexRender cell={cell} />
 166 |                   </TableCell>
 167 |                 ))}
 168 |               </TableRow>
 169 |             ))}
 170 |           {isFetching &&
 171 |             Array.from({ length: skeletonRowCount }, (_, i) => (
 172 |               <TableRow aria-hidden="true" key={`loading-${i}`}>
 173 |                 <TableCell colSpan={leafColumnCount}>
 174 |                   <Skeleton className="h-7 w-full" />
 175 |                 </TableCell>
 176 |               </TableRow>
 177 |             ))}
 178 |         </TableBody>
 179 |       </TablePrimitive>
 180 | 
 181 |       {pagination && (
 182 |         <TablePagination
 183 |           ariaLabel={`${ariaLabel} Pages`}
 184 |           page={pagination.page}
 185 |           pageCount={pagination.pageCount === 0 ? 1 : pagination.pageCount}
 186 |           route={pagination.route}
 187 |           size={pagination.size}
 188 |         />
 189 |       )}
 190 |     </div>
 191 |   );
 192 | }
```

```tsx
  44 |             <input

  46 |               onChange={(e) => {

  48 |               }}
  49 |               placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
  50 |               type="search"
  51 |               value={searchValue}
  52 |             />
  53 |             {searchValue ? (

  57 |                 onClick={() => {

  67 | 
  68 |         {filters.map((filter) => (

  71 |             key={filter.allLabel}

  84 |

  90 |           >
```

```tsx
   1 | import type React from "react";
```

```tsx
   4 | 
   5 | export interface TablePaginationFooterProps {
   6 |   pageIndex: number;
   7 |   pageCount: number;
   8 |   pageSize: number;
   9 |   total: number;
  10 |   onPageChange: (pageIndex: number) => void;
  11 |   onPageSizeChange?: (pageSize: number) => void;
  12 |   pageSizeOptions?: number[];
  13 | }
  14 | 
  15 | const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS = [10, 20, 50, 100];
  16 | 
  17 | export function TablePaginationFooter({
  18 |   pageIndex,
  19 |   pageCount,
  20 |   pageSize,
  21 |   total,
  22 |   onPageChange,
  23 |   onPageSizeChange,
  24 |   pageSizeOptions = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS,
  25 | }: TablePaginationFooterProps): React.ReactNode {
  26 |   if (total === 0) {
  27 |     return null;
  28 |   }
  29 | 
  30 |   const firstRow = pageIndex * pageSize + 1;
  31 |   const lastRow = Math.min((pageIndex + 1) * pageSize, total);
  32 | 
  33 |   return (
  34 |     <nav className="text-base-500 border-border flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t pt-4  sm:flex-row">
  35 |       <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  36 |         <span>
  37 |           Showing {firstRow}–{lastRow} of {total}
  38 |         </span>
  39 |         {onPageSizeChange ? (
  40 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
  41 |             <span>Rows per page:</span>
  42 |             <select
  43 |               className="text-base-700 border-border focus:ring-ring rounded-lg border bg-transparent px-2 py-1  focus:ring-1 focus:outline-none"
  44 |               onChange={(e) => {
  45 |                 onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value));
  46 |               }}
  47 |               value={pageSize}
  48 |             >
  49 |               {pageSizeOptions.map((size) => (
  50 |                 <option key={size} value={size}>
  51 |                   {size}
  52 |                 </option>
  53 |               ))}
  54 |             </select>
  55 |           </div>
  56 |         ) : null}
  57 |       </div>
  58 | 
  59 |       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  60 |         <button
  61 |           className="border-border hover:bg-background rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
  62 |           disabled={pageIndex === 0}
  63 |           onClick={() => {
  64 |             onPageChange(Math.max(0, pageIndex - 1));
  65 |           }}
  66 |           type="button"
  67 |         >
  68 |           <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5" />
  69 |         </button>
  70 |         <span>
  71 |           Page {pageIndex + 1} of {Math.max(1, pageCount)}
  72 |         </span>
  73 |         <button
  74 |           className="border-border hover:bg-background rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
  75 |           disabled={pageIndex >= pageCount - 1}
  76 |           onClick={() => {
  77 |             onPageChange(Math.min(pageCount - 1, pageIndex + 1));
  78 |           }}
  79 |           type="button"
  80 |         >
  81 |           <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" />
  82 |         </button>
  83 |       </div>
  84 |     </nav>
  85 |   );
  86 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/components/tables/table-pagination-constants.ts
   2 | /**
   3 |  * Page sizes shared by every table. Kept in a non-component module so
   4 |  * `table-pagination.tsx` stays a pure client module (the
   5 |  * `react/only-export-components` rule fires on mixed modules even with
   6 |  * a local disable in some configs).
   7 |  */
   8 | export const PAGE_SIZES = [10, 20, 50, 100] as const;
   9 | export type PageSize = (typeof PAGE_SIZES)[number];
  10 | export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE: PageSize = 20;
  11 | 
  12 | export type PageSizeString = `${PageSize}`;
  13 | 
  14 | const PAGE_SIZE_SET: ReadonlySet<number> = new Set(PAGE_SIZES);
  15 | 
  16 | export function isPageSize(value: string | null | undefined): value is PageSizeString {
  17 |   if (value == null) return false;
  18 |   return PAGE_SIZE_SET.has(Number(value));
  19 | }
```

`components/tables/table-pagination.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import type { ReactNode } from "react";
   2 | 
   3 | // src/components/tables/table-pagination.tsx
   4 | import { type AnyRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   5 | import { ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react";
   6 | 
   7 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   8 | import { buttonVariants } from "#/components/ui/button-variants";
   9 | import {
  10 |   isPageSize,
  11 |   PAGE_SIZES,
  12 |   type PageSize,
  13 | } from "@/components/tables/table-pagination-constants";
  14 | import {
  15 |   Pagination,
  16 |   PaginationContent,
  17 |   PaginationEllipsis,
  18 |   PaginationItem,
  19 | } from "@/components/ui/pagination";
  20 | import {
  21 |   Select,
  22 |   SelectContent,
  23 |   SelectItem,
  24 |   SelectTrigger,
  25 |   SelectValue,
  26 | } from "@/components/ui/select";
  27 | import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile";
  28 | import { pageRange } from "@/lib/shadcn/page-range";
  29 | 
  30 | export type { PageSize } from "@/components/tables/table-pagination-constants";
  31 | 
  32 | const SIZE_ITEMS = PAGE_SIZES.map((size) => ({
  33 |   value: String(size),
  34 |   label: String(size),
  35 | }));
  36 | 
  37 | type TablePaginationProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute> = {
  38 |   route?: TRoute;
  39 |   page: number;
  40 |   pageCount: number;
  41 |   size: PageSize;
  42 |   ariaLabel: string;
  43 | };
  44 | 
  45 | /**
  46 |  * Pagination control for a paginated route.
  47 |  *
  48 |  * Pass the route object (`Route` from the route file) — not a string path.
  49 |  * The route's `validateSearch` must include `page` and `size`; the shared
  50 |  * `paginationSearchSchema` is the one to spread into each paginated route.
  51 |  */
  52 | export function TablePagination<TRoute extends AnyRoute>(props: TablePaginationProps<TRoute>) {
  53 |   // `route` is optional in the public API, but hooks cannot be called
  54 |   // conditionally. Delegate to the inner component which always receives
  55 |   // a defined route, so its hooks run unconditionally.
  56 |   if (!props.route) return null;
  57 |   return <TablePaginationInner {...props} route={props.route} />;
  58 | }
  59 | 
  60 | function TablePaginationInner<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
  61 |   route,
  62 |   page,
  63 |   pageCount,
  64 |   size,
  65 |   ariaLabel,
  66 | }: TablePaginationProps<TRoute> & { route: TRoute }) {
  67 |   const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  68 |   const navigate = route.useNavigate();
  69 |   const search = route.useSearch();
  70 | 
  71 |   // Drop `page` so a page-size change starts at the first page.
  72 |   const onSizeChange = (value: string | null) => {
  73 |     if (!value || !isPageSize(value)) return;
  74 |     const { page: _page, ...rest } = search;
  75 |     void navigate({
  76 |       search: (prev) => ({ ...prev, ...rest, size: value }) as never,
  77 |       resetScroll: false,
  78 |     });
  79 |   };
  80 | 
  81 |   // `page: 1` is the implicit default — omit it from the URL.
  82 |   const searchForPage = (next: number) =>
  83 |     next > 1 ? { ...search, page: next } : { ...search, page: undefined };
  84 | 
  85 |   return (
  86 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
  87 |       <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 max-sm:self-center">
  88 |         <span className=" text-xs" id="rows-per-page">
  89 |           Rows Per Page
  90 |         </span>
  91 |         <Select items={SIZE_ITEMS} onValueChange={onSizeChange} value={String(size)}>
  92 |           <SelectTrigger aria-labelledby="rows-per-page" size="sm">
  93 |             <SelectValue />
  94 |           </SelectTrigger>
  95 |           <SelectContent align="start" alignItemWithTrigger={false} side="bottom">
  96 |             {SIZE_ITEMS.map((item) => (
  97 |               <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
  98 |                 {item.label}
  99 |               </SelectItem>
 100 |             ))}
 101 |           </SelectContent>
 102 |         </Select>
 103 |       </div>
 104 | 
 105 |       <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1">
 106 |         <Pagination aria-label={ariaLabel}>
 107 |           <PaginationContent>
 108 |             <PaginationItem>
 109 |               <StepLink
 110 |                 disabled={page <= 1}
 111 |                 label="Previous Page"
 112 |                 page={page - 1}
 113 |                 route={route}
 114 |                 searchForPage={searchForPage}
 115 |               >
 116 |                 <ChevronLeftIcon aria-hidden="true" />
 117 |               </StepLink>
 118 |             </PaginationItem>
 119 | 
 120 |             {pageRange(page, pageCount, isMobile ? 0 : 1).map((item, index) =>
 121 |               item === "gap" ? (
 122 |                 <PaginationItem key={`gap-${index}`}>
 123 |                   <PaginationEllipsis />
 124 |                 </PaginationItem>
 125 |               ) : (
 126 |                 <PaginationItem key={item}>
 127 |                   <PageLink
 128 |                     isActive={item === page}
 129 |                     label={`Page ${item}`}
 130 |                     page={item}
 131 |                     route={route}
 132 |                     searchForPage={searchForPage}
 133 |                   >
 134 |                     {item}
 135 |                   </PageLink>
 136 |                 </PaginationItem>
 137 |               ),
 138 |             )}
 139 | 
 140 |             <PaginationItem>
 141 |               <StepLink
 142 |                 disabled={page >= pageCount}
 143 |                 label="Next Page"
 144 |                 page={page + 1}
 145 |                 route={route}
 146 |                 searchForPage={searchForPage}
 147 |               >
 148 |                 <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
 149 |               </StepLink>
 150 |             </PaginationItem>
 151 |           </PaginationContent>
 152 |         </Pagination>
 153 |       </div>
 154 |     </div>
 155 |   );
 156 | }
 157 | 
 158 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 159 | // Internal: link builders
 160 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 161 | 
 162 | type SearchForPage<TRoute extends AnyRoute> = (
 163 |   next: number,
 164 | ) => Partial<TRoute["types"]["fullSearchSchema"]>;
 165 | 
 166 | function PageLink<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
 167 |   route,
 168 |   page,
 169 |   isActive = false,
 170 |   label,
 171 |   searchForPage,
 172 |   children,
 173 | }: {
 174 |   route: TRoute;
 175 |   page: number;
 176 |   isActive?: boolean;
 177 |   label: string;
 178 |   searchForPage: SearchForPage<TRoute>;
 179 |   children: ReactNode;
 180 | }) {
 181 |   return (
 182 |     <Link
 183 |       aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
 184 |       aria-label={label}
 185 |       className={buttonVariants({
 186 |         variant: isActive ? "secondary" : "ghost",
 187 |         size: "icon-sm",
 188 |       })}
 189 |       resetScroll={false}
 190 |       search={(prev) => ({ ...prev, ...searchForPage(page) }) as never}
 191 |       to={route.fullPath}
 192 |     >
 193 |       {children}
 194 |     </Link>
 195 |   );
 196 | }
 197 | 
 198 | function StepLink<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
 199 |   route,
 200 |   page,
 201 |   disabled,
 202 |   label,
 203 |   searchForPage,
 204 |   children,
 205 | }: {
 206 |   route: TRoute;
 207 |   page: number;
 208 |   disabled: boolean;
 209 |   label: string;
 210 |   searchForPage: SearchForPage<TRoute>;
 211 |   children: ReactNode;
 212 | }) {
 213 |   if (disabled) {
 214 |     return (
 215 |       <Button aria-label={label} disabled size="icon-sm" variant="ghost">
 216 |         {children}
 217 |       </Button>
 218 |     );
 219 |   }
 220 |   return (
 221 |     <PageLink label={label} page={page} route={route} searchForPage={searchForPage}>
 222 |       {children}
 223 |     </PageLink>
 224 |   );
 225 | }
```

`components/ui/chart.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // Packages/ui/src/components/chart.tsx
   2 | 
   3 | import { areaY, type ChartPoint, d3Curve, defineChart } from "@tanstack/charts";
   4 | import { motion } from "@tanstack/charts/motion";
   5 | import { RendererChart } from "@tanstack/charts/react/tooltip";
   6 | import { tooltip } from "@tanstack/charts/tooltip";
   7 | import { scaleLinear, scalePoint } from "d3-scale";
   8 | import { curveNatural } from "d3-shape";
   9 | import * as React from "react";
  10 | 
  11 | const NATURAL_CURVE = d3Curve(curveNatural);
  12 | 
  13 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
  14 | 
  15 | // ============================================================
  16 | // Types
  17 | // ============================================================
  18 | const Reg = /-?(bars|lines|areas|slices|values|radar)$/u;
  19 | export type ChartConfig = Record<
  20 |   string,
  21 |   {
  22 |     label?: React.ReactNode;
  23 |     icon?: React.ComponentType;
  24 |     color?: string;
  25 |   }
  26 | >;
  27 | 
  28 | export type ChartDataPoint = Record<string, string | number>;
  29 | 
  30 | export interface ChartSeries {
  31 |   dataKey: string;
  32 |   label: string;
  33 |   color: string;
  34 | }
  35 | 
  36 | // ============================================================
  37 | // Constants
  38 | // ============================================================
  39 | 
  40 | const DEFAULT_COLORS = [
  41 |   "#3b82f6", // Blue
  42 |   "#8b5cf6", // Violet
  43 |   "#ec4899", // Pink
  44 |   "#f59e0b", // Amber
  45 |   "#10b981", // Emerald
  46 |   "#ef4444", // Red
  47 | ];
  48 | 
  49 | // ============================================================
  50 | // Context
  51 | // ============================================================
  52 | 
  53 | interface ChartContextProps {
  54 |   config: ChartConfig;
  55 | }
  56 | 
  57 | const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null);
  58 | 
  59 | export function useChart() {
  60 |   const context = React.useContext(ChartContext);
  61 |   if (!context) {
  62 |     throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />");
  63 |   }
  64 |   return context;
  65 | }
  66 | 
  67 | // ============================================================
  68 | // Chart Container
  69 | // ============================================================
  70 | 
  71 | type ChartContainerProps = {
  72 |   children: React.ReactNode;
  73 |   config: ChartConfig;
  74 |   height?: number;
  75 |   width?: number | string;
  76 | } & React.ComponentProps<"div">;
  77 | 
  78 | export function ChartContainer({
  79 |   id,
  80 |   className,
  81 |   children,
  82 |   config,
  83 |   height = 300,
  84 |   width = "100%",
  85 |   ...props
  86 | }: ChartContainerProps) {
  87 |   const uniqueId = React.useId();
  88 |   const chartId = `chart-${id ?? uniqueId.replaceAll(":", "")}`;
  89 |   const contextValue = React.useMemo(() => ({ config }), [config]);
  90 | 
  91 |   return (
  92 |     <ChartContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
  93 |       <div
  94 |         className={cn(
  95 |           "flex w-full justify-center text-xs",
  96 |           "[&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground",
  97 |           "[&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50",
  98 |           "[&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border",
  99 |           className,
 100 |         )}
 101 |         data-chart={chartId}
 102 |         data-slot="chart"
 103 |         {...props}
 104 |       >
 105 |         <div className="w-full" style={{ height, width }}>
 106 |           {children}
 107 |         </div>
 108 |       </div>
 109 |     </ChartContext.Provider>
 110 |   );
 111 | }
 112 | 
 113 | // ============================================================
 114 | // Chart Tooltip
 115 | // ============================================================
 116 | 
 117 | function shadcnTooltipContent<TDatum>(points: readonly ChartPoint<TDatum>[]) {
 118 |   return {
 119 |     rows: points.map((point) => ({
 120 |       color: point.color,
 121 |       label: String(point.group ?? point.markId.replace(Reg, "")),
 122 |       value: Number(point.yValue ?? point.xValue ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-US"),
 123 |     })),
 124 |     title: String(points[0]?.xValue ?? ""),
 125 |   };
 126 | }
 127 | 
 128 | // ============================================================
 129 | // Chart Components
 130 | // ============================================================
 131 | 
 132 | interface ChartProps {
 133 |   colors?: string[];
 134 |   data: ChartDataPoint[];
 135 |   dataKeys: string[];
 136 |   height?: number;
 137 |   width?: number;
 138 |   xAxisKey?: string;
 139 | }
 140 | type ChartVariant = "area" | "line" | "bar";
 141 | 
 142 | const VARIANT_STYLES: Record<
 143 |   ChartVariant,
 144 |   {
 145 |     fillOpacity: number;
 146 |     strokeWidth: number;
 147 |     ariaLabel: string;
 148 |   }
 149 | > = {
 150 |   area: { ariaLabel: "Area chart", fillOpacity: 0.4, strokeWidth: 2 },
 151 |   bar: { ariaLabel: "Bar chart", fillOpacity: 0.8, strokeWidth: 0 },
 152 |   line: { ariaLabel: "Line chart", fillOpacity: 0.1, strokeWidth: 2.5 },
 153 | };
 154 | 
 155 | function BaseChart({
 156 |   variant,
 157 |   data,
 158 |   dataKeys,
 159 |   colors = DEFAULT_COLORS,
 160 |   xAxisKey = "month",
 161 |   height = 300,
 162 |   width,
 163 | }: ChartProps & { variant: ChartVariant }) {
 164 |   const style = VARIANT_STYLES[variant];
 165 | 
 166 |   const renderer = React.useMemo(
 167 |     () =>
 168 |       motion({
 169 |         initial: "always",
 170 |         transition: {
 171 |           damping: 18,
 172 |           mass: 1,
 173 |           stiffness: 170,
 174 |           type: "spring",
 175 |         },
 176 |       }),
 177 |     [],
 178 |   );
 179 | 
 180 |   // Stabilize array identities. Callers frequently pass inline literals
 181 |   // (`colors={["var(--chart-1)"]}`), which would otherwise invalidate the
 182 |   // `definition` memo on every render and rebuild every `areaY` mark.
 183 |   // We join-then-split so the dependency is a primitive string, not an array.
 184 |   const colorsKey = colors.join("\u0000");
 185 |   const dataKeysKey = dataKeys.join("\u0000");
 186 | 
 187 |   const stableColors = React.useMemo(() => colorsKey.split("\u0000"), [colorsKey]);
 188 |   const stableDataKeys = React.useMemo(() => dataKeysKey.split("\u0000"), [dataKeysKey]);
 189 | 
 190 |   const definition = React.useMemo(() => {
 191 |     const fallbackColor = stableColors[0] ?? "currentColor";
 192 |     const marks = stableDataKeys.map((key, index) =>
 193 |       areaY(data, {
 194 |         // Hoisted — not re-created per memo invalidation.
 195 |         curve: NATURAL_CURVE,
 196 |         fill: stableColors[index % stableColors.length] ?? fallbackColor,
 197 |         fillOpacity: style.fillOpacity,
 198 |         id: key,
 199 |         stroke: stableColors[index % stableColors.length] ?? fallbackColor,
 200 |         strokeWidth: style.strokeWidth,
 201 |         x: xAxisKey,
 202 |         y: (point: ChartDataPoint) => Number(point[key]),
 203 |       }),
 204 |     );
 205 | 
 206 |     return defineChart(
 207 |       {
 208 |         color: { domain: stableDataKeys, range: stableColors },
 209 |         margin: { bottom: 35, left: 40, right: 10, top: 10 },
 210 |         marks,
 211 |         scales: {
 212 |           x: {
 213 |             axis: { line: false, ticks: { padding: 10, size: 0 } },
 214 |             scale: scalePoint,
 215 |           },
 216 |           y: {
 217 |             axis: { line: false, tickLabels: false, ticks: false },
 218 |             grid: true,
 219 |             scale: scaleLinear,
 220 |           },
 221 |         },
 222 |         theme: {
 223 |           background: "transparent",
 224 |           foreground: "var(--muted-foreground)",
 225 |           grid: "var(--border)",
 226 |         },
 227 |       },
 228 |       {
 229 |         focus: "group-x",
 230 |         svgAnimation: false,
 231 |         tooltip: {
 232 |           anchor: "group-center",
 233 |           className: "sc-chart-tooltip",
 234 |           content: (points) => shadcnTooltipContent(points),
 235 |           placement: "auto",
 236 |           sort: "color-domain",
 237 |           use: tooltip,
 238 |         },
 239 |       },
 240 |     );
 241 |   }, [data, stableDataKeys, stableColors, xAxisKey, style]);
 242 | 
 243 |   return (
 244 |     <div style={{ height, width: width ?? "100%" }}>
 245 |       <RendererChart
 246 |         ariaLabel={style.ariaLabel}
 247 |         definition={definition}
 248 |         height={height}
 249 |         initialWidth={width ?? 600}
 250 |         renderer={renderer}
 251 |         {...(width !== undefined ? { width } : {})}
 252 |       />
 253 |     </div>
 254 |   );
 255 | }
 256 | 
 257 | export function AreaChart(props: ChartProps) {
 258 |   return <BaseChart variant="area" {...props} />;
 259 | }
 260 | 
 261 | export function LineChart(props: ChartProps) {
 262 |   return <BaseChart variant="line" {...props} />;
 263 | }
 264 | 
 265 | export function BarChart(props: ChartProps) {
 266 |   return <BaseChart variant="bar" {...props} />;
 267 | }
 268 | 
 269 | // ============================================================
 270 | // Chart Tooltip Content
 271 | // ============================================================
 272 | 
 273 | export interface ChartTooltipContentProps {
 274 |   active?: boolean;
 275 |   label?: string;
 276 |   payload?: {
 277 |     name: string;
 278 |     value: number;
 279 |     color: string;
 280 |   }[];
 281 | }
 282 | 
 283 | export function ChartTooltipContent({ active, payload, label }: ChartTooltipContentProps) {
 284 |   if (!(active && payload?.length)) {
 285 |     return null;
 286 |   }
 287 | 
 288 |   return (
 289 |     <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-lg dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800">
 290 |       {Boolean(label) && (
 291 |         <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{label}</p>
 292 |       )}
 293 |       <div className="space-y-1">
 294 |         {payload.map((item, index) => (
 295 |           <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4" key={index}>
 296 |             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 297 |               <div className="size-3 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} />
 298 |               <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">{item.name}</span>
 299 |             </div>
 300 |             <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
 301 |               {typeof item.value === "number" ? item.value.toLocaleString() : String(item.value)}
 302 |             </span>
 303 |           </div>
 304 |         ))}
 305 |       </div>
 306 |     </div>
 307 |   );
 308 | }
 309 | 
 310 | // ============================================================
 311 | // Chart Legend
 312 | // ============================================================
 313 | 
 314 | export interface ChartLegendProps {
 315 |   config: ChartConfig;
 316 | }
 317 | 
 318 | export function ChartLegend({ config }: ChartLegendProps) {
 319 |   const entries = Object.entries(config);
 320 | 
 321 |   if (entries.length === 0) {
 322 |     return null;
 323 |   }
 324 | 
 325 |   return (
 326 |     <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4 pt-3">
 327 |       {entries.map(([key, item]) => (
 328 |         <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5" key={key}>
 329 |           <div className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} />
 330 |           <span className=" text-sm">{item.label}</span>
 331 |         </div>
 332 |       ))}
 333 |     </div>
 334 |   );
 335 | }
 336 | 
 337 | // ============================================================
 338 | // Export
 339 | // ============================================================
 340 | 
 341 | export type { ChartContextProps };
```

```tsx
 153 | function FieldError({
 154 |   className,
 155 |   children,
 156 |   errors,
 157 |   ...props
 158 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
 159 |   errors?: Array<{ message?: string } | undefined>;
 160 | }) {
 161 |   const content = useMemo(() => {
 162 |     if (children) {
 163 |       return children;
 164 |     }
 165 | 
 166 |     if (!errors?.length) {
 167 |       return null;
 168 |     }
 169 | 
 170 |     const uniqueErrors = [...new Map(errors.map((error) => [error?.message, error])).values()];
 171 | 
 172 |     if (uniqueErrors?.length === 1) {
 173 |       return uniqueErrors[0]?.message;
 174 |     }
 175 | 
 176 |     return (
 177 |       <ul className="ms-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1">
 178 |         {uniqueErrors.map((error, index) => error?.message && <li key={index}>{error.message}</li>)}
 179 |       </ul>
 180 |     );
 181 |   }, [children, errors]);
 182 | 
 183 |   if (!content) {
 184 |     return null;
 185 |   }
 186 | 
 187 |   return (
 188 |     <div
 189 |       className={cn("text-destructive text-sm font-normal", className)}
 190 |       data-slot="field-error"
 191 |       role="alert"
 192 |       {...props}
 193 |     >
 194 |       {content}
 195 |     </div>
 196 |   );
 197 | }
 198 |

 204 |   FieldGroup,
 205 |   FieldLabel,
 206 |   FieldLegend,
 207 |   FieldSeparator,

 209 |   FieldTitle,
 210 |   fieldVariants,
 211 | };
```

```ts
   3 | interface CacheEntry<T> {
   4 |   data: T;
   5 |   timestamp: number;
   6 |   expiresAt: number;
   7 |   staleUntil: number;
   8 |   ttl: number;
   9 | }
  10 | export type CacheLookup<T> =
  11 |   | { state: "fresh"; data: T }
  12 |   | { state: "stale"; data: T }
  13 |   | { state: "miss" };
  14 | 
  15 | interface CacheOptions {
  16 |   staleWhileRevalidate?: number;
  17 |   tags?: string[];
  18 |   ttl: number;
  19 | }
  20 | 
  21 | const DEFAULT_MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 10_000;
  22 | /** Fraction of the cache to drop when the size cap is exceeded. */
  23 | const OVERFLOW_DROP_RATIO = 0.2;
  24 | 
  25 | export class QueryCache {
  26 |   private readonly cache = new Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>();
  27 |   private readonly tagMap = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  28 |   private readonly defaultTTL = 60_000;
  29 |   private readonly maxSize: number;
  30 |   private lastSweep = 0;
  31 |   private static readonly SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 5000;
  32 | 
  33 |   private readonly ttlConfig: Record<string, number> = {
  34 |     appointment: 15_000,
  35 |     clinic: 60_000,
  36 |     patient: 30_000,
  37 |     static: 300_000,
  38 |   };
  39 | 
  40 |   constructor(maxSize = DEFAULT_MAX_CACHE_SIZE) {
  41 |     this.maxSize = maxSize;
  42 |   }
  43 | 
  44 |   getTTL(entityType: string): number {
  45 |     return this.ttlConfig[entityType] ?? this.defaultTTL;
  46 |   }
  47 |   lookup<T>(key: string, guard: (v: unknown) => v is T): CacheLookup<T> {
  48 |     this.maybeSweep();
  49 |     const entry = this.cache.get(key);
  50 |     if (!entry) return { state: "miss" };
  51 | 
  52 |     const now = Date.now();
  53 |     if (now < entry.expiresAt) {
  54 |       return guard(entry.data) ? { state: "fresh", data: entry.data } : { state: "miss" };
  55 |     }
  56 |     if (now < entry.staleUntil) {
  57 |       return guard(entry.data) ? { state: "stale", data: entry.data } : { state: "miss" };
  58 |     }
  59 |     this.cache.delete(key);
  60 |     this.removeFromTags(key);
  61 |     return { state: "miss" };
  62 |   }
  63 |   private maybeSweep(): void {
  64 |     const now = Date.now();
  65 |     if (now - this.lastSweep < QueryCache.SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS) return;
  66 |     if (this.cache.size <= this.maxSize) return;
  67 |     this.lastSweep = now;
  68 |     this.sweepIfOversized();
  69 |   }
  70 | 
  71 |   invalidatePrefix(prefix: string): void {
  72 |     for (const key of this.cache.keys()) {
  73 |       if (key.startsWith(prefix)) {
  74 |         this.removeFromTags(key);
  75 |         this.cache.delete(key);
  76 |       }
  77 |     }
  78 |   }
  79 | 
  80 |   /**
  81 |    * Raw access — returns whatever was stored as `unknown`.
  82 |    * Callers must narrow (`if (typeof v === 'string') …`) or cast.
  83 |    */
  84 |   get(key: string): unknown {
  85 |     this.maybeSweep();
  86 |     this.sweepIfOversized();
  87 | 
  88 |     const entry = this.cache.get(key);
  89 |     if (!entry) return null;
  90 | 
  91 |     const now = Date.now();
  92 |     if (now < entry.expiresAt) return entry.data;
  93 |     if (now < entry.staleUntil) return entry.data;
  94 | 
  95 |     this.cache.delete(key);
  96 |     this.removeFromTags(key);
  97 |     return null;
  98 |   }
  99 | 
 100 |   /**
 101 |    * Typed access — caller supplies a type guard. The guard is the
 102 |    * *only* thing that makes the return type safe. On miss or type
 103 |    * mismatch, returns `null`.
 104 |    */
 105 |   getAs<T>(key: string, guard: (value: unknown) => value is T): T | null {
 106 |     const value = this.get(key);
 107 |     return value !== null && guard(value) ? value : null;
 108 |   }
 109 | 
 110 |   /**

 112 |    * so the type parameter is genuinely doing work (`T` appears in the
 113 |    * parameter *and* the return position).
 114 |    */
 115 |   set<T>(key: string, data: T, options: Partial<CacheOptions> = {}): T {
 116 |     this.maybeSweep();
 117 |     this.sweepIfOversized();
 118 |     this.removeFromTags(key);
 119 | 
 120 |     const now = Date.now();
 121 |     const ttl = Math.max(0, options.ttl ?? this.defaultTTL);
 122 |     const staleWhileRevalidate = Math.max(0, options.staleWhileRevalidate ?? ttl * 0.5);
 123 | 
 124 |     this.cache.set(key, {
 125 |       data,
 126 |       expiresAt: now + ttl,
 127 |       staleUntil: now + ttl + staleWhileRevalidate,
 128 |       timestamp: now,
 129 |       ttl,
 130 |     });
 131 | 
 132 |     for (const tag of options.tags ?? []) {
 133 |       let keys = this.tagMap.get(tag);
 134 |       if (!keys) {
 135 |         keys = new Set();
 136 |         this.tagMap.set(tag, keys);
 137 |       }
 138 |       keys.add(key);
 139 |     }
 140 | 
 141 |     return data;
 142 |   }

 144 |   invalidate(key: string): void {
 145 |     this.cache.delete(key);
 146 |     this.removeFromTags(key);
 147 |   }
 148 | 
 149 |   invalidateTag(tag: string): void {

 151 |     if (!keys) return;

 153 |     // Snapshot: `removeFromTags` mutates `tagMap` while we iterate.
 154 |     for (const key of keys) {
 155 |       this.cache.delete(key);
 156 |       this.removeFromTags(key);
 157 |     }
 158 |     this.tagMap.delete(tag);
 159 |   }

 161 |   invalidatePattern(pattern: RegExp): void {
 162 |     for (const key of this.cache.keys()) {
 163 |       if (pattern.test(key)) {

 165 |         this.removeFromTags(key);
 166 |       }
 167 |     }
 168 |   }

 172 |   }
 173 | 
 174 |   get size(): number {

 176 |   }

 178 |   private removeFromTags(key: string): void {
 179 |     for (const [tag, keys] of this.tagMap) {
 180 |       keys.delete(key);
 181 |       if (keys.size === 0) this.tagMap.delete(tag);
 182 |     }
 183 |   }
 184 |   // src/db/cache.ts
 185 |   private lastOversizeSweep = 0;
 186 |   private static readonly OVERSIZE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000;
 187 | 
 188 |   private sweepIfOversized(): void {
 189 |     if (this.cache.size <= this.maxSize) return;
 190 | 
 191 |     const now = Date.now();
 192 |     if (now - this.lastOversizeSweep < QueryCache.OVERSIZE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS) return;
 193 |     this.lastOversizeSweep = now;
 194 | 
 195 |     // Pass 1: drop expired.
 196 |     for (const [key, entry] of this.cache) {
 197 |       if (now > entry.staleUntil) {
 198 |         this.cache.delete(key);
 199 |         this.removeFromTags(key);
 200 |       }
 201 |     }
 202 |     if (this.cache.size <= this.maxSize) return;
 203 | 
 204 |     // Pass 2: drop the oldest 20%.
 205 |     const entries = [...this.cache.entries()].toSorted((a, b) => a[1].timestamp - b[1].timestamp);
 206 |     const dropCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(entries.length * OVERFLOW_DROP_RATIO));
 207 |     for (let i = 0; i < dropCount; i += 1) {
 208 |       const entry = entries[i];
 209 |       if (!entry) continue;
 210 |       this.cache.delete(entry[0]);
 211 |       this.removeFromTags(entry[0]);
 212 |     }
 213 |   }
 214 | 
 215 |   clear(): void {
 216 |     this.cache.clear();
 217 |     this.tagMap.clear();
 218 |   }
 219 | 
 220 |   getStats(): { size: number; tagCount: number } {
 221 |     return { size: this.cache.size, tagCount: this.tagMap.size };
 222 |   }

 231 | export class PreparedQueryCache {
 232 |   private readonly prepared = new Map<string, unknown>();
 233 | 
 234 |   /** Raw access — callers must narrow. */
 235 |   get(key: string): unknown {
 236 |     return this.prepared.has(key) ? this.prepared.get(key) : null;
 237 |   }
 238 | 
 239 |   /** Typed access with a guard, mirroring `QueryCache.getAs`. */
 240 |   getAs<T>(key: string, guard: (value: unknown) => value is T): T | undefined {
 241 |     const value = this.prepared.get(key);
 242 |     return value !== undefined && guard(value) ? value : undefined;
 243 |   }
 244 | 
 245 |   /**
 246 |    * Stores `query`. Returns it for symmetry with `QueryCache.set`
 247 |    * (keeps `T` in both parameter and return positions).
 248 |    */
 249 |   set<T>(key: string, query: T): T {
 250 |     this.prepared.set(key, query);
 251 |     return query;
 252 |   }
 253 | 
 254 |   has(key: string): boolean {
 255 |     return this.prepared.has(key);
 256 |   }
 257 | 
 258 |   clear(): void {
 259 |     this.prepared.clear();
 260 |   }
 261 | }

 263 | export const preparedQueries = new PreparedQueryCache();
 264 | // src/db/cache.ts
 265 | export async function cached<T>(
 266 |   cache: QueryCache,
 267 |   key: string,
 268 |   guard: (v: unknown) => v is T,
 269 |   revalidate: () => Promise<T>,
 270 |   options: CacheOptions,
 271 | ): Promise<T> {
 272 |   const hit = cache.lookup(key, guard);
 273 |   if (hit.state === "fresh") return hit.data;
 274 |   if (hit.state === "stale") {
 275 |     // Serve stale immediately, revalidate in the background.
 276 |     void revalidate()
 277 |       .then((fresh) => cache.set(key, fresh, options))
 278 |       .catch((err) => console.error("SWR revalidation failed", key, err));
 279 |     return hit.data;
 280 |   }
 281 |   const fresh = await revalidate();
 282 |   cache.set(key, fresh, options);
 283 |   return fresh;
 284 | }
```

```ts
  28 | import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite";
  29 | 
  30 | import { relations } from "./relations";
  31 | import { authRelations } from "./schema";
  32 | 
  33 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  34 | // Client
  35 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  36 | 
  37 | const sqlite = new Database(process.env.DB_FILE_NAME ?? "clinic.sqlite");
  38 | 
  39 | // Pragmas are applied once, before the client serves any query.
  40 | //   • WAL          — readers never block the writer (long-lived server +
  41 | //                    background seeding).
  42 | //   • busy_timeout — wait up to 5s on a locked writer instead of failing
  43 | //                    immediately with SQLITE_BUSY.
  44 | //   • foreign_keys — SQLite defaults this OFF; our FKs and `onDelete: cascade`
  45 | //                    only work when it is ON.
  46 | //   • synchronous  — NORMAL is durable under WAL and much faster than FULL.
  47 | //   • temp_store   — keep transient sorts/indices in memory.
  48 | //   • cache_size   — 64 MiB page cache (negative value is in KiB).
  49 | sqlite.run("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL");
  50 | sqlite.run("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000");
  51 | sqlite.run("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON");
  52 | sqlite.run("PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL");
  53 | sqlite.run("PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY");
  54 | sqlite.run("PRAGMA cache_size = -64000");
  55 | 
  56 | // Merge relations in the required order:
  57 | //   1. `defineRelations` — the base relations object
  58 | //   2. `defineRelationsPart` results — auth, clinic
  59 | const mergedRelations = {
  60 |   ...relations,
  61 |   ...authRelations,
  62 | };
  63 | 
  64 | export const db = drizzle({
  65 |   client: sqlite,
  66 |   relations: mergedRelations,
  67 | });
  68 | 
  69 | export type DB = typeof db;
  70 | export type Transaction = Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0];
  71 | 
  72 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 | // Readiness & shutdown
  74 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  75 | 
  76 | let isClosed = false;
  77 | 
  78 | export async function checkIsDbReady(): Promise<boolean> {
  79 |   if (isClosed) return false;
  80 |   try {
  81 |     sqlite.query("SELECT 1").get();
  82 |     return true;
  83 |   } catch (error) {
  84 |     console.error("Database readiness check failed", error);
  85 |     return false;
  86 |   }
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | /** Idempotent: closing an already-closed client is a no-op. */
  90 | export async function closeDb(): Promise<void> {
  91 |   if (isClosed) return;
  92 |   isClosed = true;
  93 | 
  94 |   try {
  95 |     db.$client.close();
  96 |   } catch (error) {
  97 |     console.error("Error closing database connection", error);
  98 |   }
  99 | }
 100 | 
 101 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 102 | // Transactions
 103 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 104 | 
 105 | export type TransactionOptions = {
 106 |   /**
 107 |    * Locking mode. `immediate` (the default) takes SQLite's write lock at
 108 |    * `BEGIN`, avoiding the lock-upgrade deadlock `deferred` can hit when two
 109 |    * writers overlap.
 110 |    */
 111 |   behavior?: "deferred" | "immediate" | "exclusive";
 112 | };
 113 | 
 114 | export type RunWithDbOptions = TransactionOptions & {
 115 |   /** Extra attempts after a transient failure. Total tries = maxRetries + 1. */
 116 |   maxRetries?: number;
 117 | };
 118 | 
 119 | // SQLite reports contention via `SQLITE_BUSY` / `SQLITE_LOCKED`. bun:sqlite
 120 | // surfaces these on `error.code` (and in the message as "database is locked").
 121 | // The database runs in WAL mode with a 5s busy_timeout, so a short retry is
 122 | // enough to ride out a transient writer collision.
 123 | const RETRYABLE_SQLITE_CODES = new Set<string>(["SQLITE_BUSY", "SQLITE_LOCKED"]);
 124 | 
 125 | function isRetryableTxError(error: unknown): boolean {
 126 |   if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null) return false;
 127 | 
 128 |   const code = (error as { code?: unknown }).code;
 129 |   if (typeof code === "string") {
 130 |     if (RETRYABLE_SQLITE_CODES.has(code)) return true;
 131 |     if (/SQLITE_(BUSY|LOCKED)/i.test(code)) return true;
 132 |   }
 133 | 
 134 |   const message = (error as { message?: unknown }).message;
 135 |   return (
 136 |     typeof message === "string" &&
 137 |     /(SQLITE_BUSY|SQLITE_LOCKED|database is locked|database table is locked)/i.test(message)
 138 |   );
 139 | }
 140 | 
 141 | const MAX_BACKOFF_MS = 2_000;
 142 | 
 143 | /**
 144 |  * Run `fn` inside a SQLite transaction, retrying on transient contention.
 145 |  *
 146 |  * bun:sqlite is a **synchronous** driver: Drizzle wraps the callback in a
 147 |  * native `BEGIN`/`COMMIT`, so `fn` must be synchronous. An `async` callback
 148 |  * would resolve *after* the commit and silently run outside the transaction —
 149 |  * keep every statement on `tx`.
 150 |  */
 151 | export async function withTransaction<T>(
 152 |   fn: (tx: Transaction) => T,
 153 |   options: RunWithDbOptions = {},
 154 | ): Promise<T> {
 155 |   const { maxRetries = 2, behavior = "immediate" } = options;
 156 | 
 157 |   let attempt = 0;
 158 |   for (;;) {
 159 |     try {
 160 |       // Drizzle types the callback return as a conditional that rejects
 161 |       // "could-be-Promise" generics; the cast satisfies it without giving
 162 |       // up the sync callback contract enforced above.
 163 |       return db.transaction(fn as never, { behavior }) as T;
 164 |     } catch (error: unknown) {
 165 |       if (attempt >= maxRetries || !isRetryableTxError(error)) throw error;
 166 |       attempt += 1;
 167 |       const backoff = Math.min(50 * 2 ** (attempt - 1), MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
 168 |       await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, backoff + Math.random() * 50));
 169 |     }
 170 |   }
 171 | }
 172 | 
 173 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 174 | // Re-exports
 175 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 176 | 
 177 | export type { SQL, SQLWrapper };
 178 | export {
```

```ts
   1 | import {and, db, eq, gte, lte, sql} from "@/db";

   4 | import type {
   5 |     AppointmentInput,
   6 |     AppointmentUpdate,
   7 |     Status,
   8 | } from "../../features/appointments/schema";
   9 | 
  10 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  11 | // Double-booking guard
  12 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  13 | 
  14 | /** Longest allowed appointment — widens the overlap scan window. */
  15 | const MAX_APPOINTMENT_MINUTES = 240;
  16 | 
  17 | /** Only these statuses occupy a slot; cancelled / no-show / completed don't. */
  18 | const BLOCKING_STATUSES: Status[] = ["scheduled"];
  19 | 
  20 | export class AppointmentConflictError extends Error {
  21 |   readonly conflictingAppointmentId: string;
  22 | 
  23 |   constructor(message: string, conflictingAppointmentId: string) {
  24 |     super(message);
  25 |     this.name = "AppointmentConflictError";
  26 |     this.conflictingAppointmentId = conflictingAppointmentId;
  27 |   }
  28 | }
  29 | 
  30 | /**
  31 |  * Find an active same-doctor appointment whose [start, end) window overlaps
  32 |  * the candidate slot, or `null` when the slot is free.
  33 |  */
  34 | async function findDoctorOverlap(args: {
  35 |   clinicId: string;
  36 |   doctorId: string;
  37 |   start: Date;
  38 |   durationMinutes: number;
  39 |   excludeAppointmentId?: string;
  40 | }) {
  41 |   const startMs = args.start.getTime();
  42 |   const endMs = startMs + args.durationMinutes * 60_000;
  43 |   // Widen the window by the longest possible appointment so a slot that
  44 |   // starts on a previous/next day can't slip past the range filter.
  45 |   const windowMs = MAX_APPOINTMENT_MINUTES * 60_000;
  46 |   const from = new Date(startMs - windowMs);
  47 |   const to = new Date(endMs + windowMs);
  48 | 
  49 |   const candidates = await db.query.appointments.findMany({
  50 |     where: {
  51 |       clinicId: args.clinicId,
  52 |       doctorId: args.doctorId,
  53 |       status: { in: BLOCKING_STATUSES },
  54 |       scheduledAt: { gte: from, lte: to },
  55 |     },
  56 |     columns: {
  57 |       id: true,
  58 |       scheduledAt: true,
  59 |       durationMinutes: true,
  60 |     },
  61 |   });
  62 | 
  63 |   return (
  64 |     candidates.find((row) => {
  65 |       if (row.id === args.excludeAppointmentId) return false;
  66 |       const rowStart = row.scheduledAt.getTime();
  67 |       const rowEnd = rowStart + row.durationMinutes * 60_000;
  68 |       return rowStart < endMs && rowEnd > startMs;
  69 |     }) ?? null
  70 |   );
  71 | }
  72 | 
  73 | // --- Create ---
  74 | 
  75 | export async function createAppointment(
  76 |   input: Omit<AppointmentInput, "durationMinutes" | "status"> & {
  77 |     durationMinutes?: number;
  78 |     status?: Status;
  79 |   },
  80 | ) {
  81 |   const durationMinutes = input.durationMinutes ?? 15;
  82 |   const status = input.status ?? "scheduled";
  83 | 
  84 |   if (input.doctorId && status === "scheduled") {
  85 |     const overlap = await findDoctorOverlap({
  86 |       clinicId: input.clinicId,
  87 |       doctorId: input.doctorId,
  88 |       start: input.scheduledAt,
  89 |       durationMinutes,
  90 |     });
  91 |     if (overlap) {
  92 |       throw new AppointmentConflictError(
  93 |         "This doctor already has an appointment that overlaps this time.",
  94 |         overlap.id,
  95 |       );
  96 |     }
  97 |   }
  98 | 
  99 |   const [row] = await db
 100 |     .insert(appointments)
 101 |     .values({ ...input, durationMinutes, status })
 102 |     .returning();
 103 |   return row;
 104 | }

 199 |     },

 204 |     },

 207 | 
 208 | // --- Update / status transitions ---
 209 | 
 210 | export async function updateAppointment(
 211 |   id: string,
 212 |   patch: Partial<AppointmentUpdate> & {
 213 |     scheduledAt?: Date;
 214 |     durationMinutes?: number;
 215 |     status?: Status;
 216 |     reason?: string | null;
 217 |     notes?: string | null;
 218 |     doctorId?: string | null;
 219 |   },
 220 | ) {
 221 |   const [current] = await db
 222 |     .select({
 223 |       clinicId: appointments.clinicId,
 224 |       doctorId: appointments.doctorId,
 225 |       scheduledAt: appointments.scheduledAt,
 226 |       durationMinutes: appointments.durationMinutes,
 227 |       status: appointments.status,
 228 |     })
 229 |     .from(appointments)
 230 |     .where(eq(appointments.id, id))
 231 |     .limit(1);
 232 | 
 233 |   if (!current) return undefined;
 234 | 
 235 |   // Resolve the slot the row will have after the patch, then guard the
 236 |   // doctor's calendar only when that slot actually changes.
 237 |   const nextDoctorId = patch.doctorId === undefined ? current.doctorId : patch.doctorId;
 238 |   const nextScheduledAt = patch.scheduledAt ?? current.scheduledAt;
 239 |   const nextDuration = patch.durationMinutes ?? current.durationMinutes;
 240 |   const nextStatus = patch.status ?? current.status;
 241 | 
 242 |   const slotChanged =
 243 |     nextDoctorId !== current.doctorId ||
 244 |     nextScheduledAt.getTime() !== current.scheduledAt.getTime() ||
 245 |     nextDuration !== current.durationMinutes;
 246 | 
 247 |   if (nextDoctorId && nextStatus === "scheduled" && slotChanged) {
 248 |     const overlap = await findDoctorOverlap({
 249 |       clinicId: current.clinicId,
 250 |       doctorId: nextDoctorId,
 251 |       start: nextScheduledAt,
 252 |       durationMinutes: nextDuration,
 253 |       excludeAppointmentId: id,
 254 |     });
 255 |     if (overlap) {
 256 |       throw new AppointmentConflictError(
 257 |         "This doctor already has an appointment that overlaps this time.",
 258 |         overlap.id,
 259 |       );
 260 |     }
 261 |   }
 262 | 
 263 |   const [row] = await db.update(appointments).set(patch).where(eq(appointments.id, id)).returning();
 264 |   return row;
 265 | }
 266 | 
 267 | export async function markCompleted(id: string) {
 268 |   return updateAppointment(id, { status: "completed" });
 269 | }
 270 | 
 271 | export async function markCancelled(id: string) {
 272 |   return updateAppointment(id, { status: "cancelled" });
 273 | }
 274 | 
 275 | export async function markNoShow(id: string) {
 276 |   return updateAppointment(id, { status: "no-show" });
 277 | }
 278 | 
 279 | export async function deleteAppointment(id: string) {

 281 | }
 282 | 
 283 | // --- Aggregates ---
 284 | 
 285 | export async function countAppointmentsByStatus(clinicId: string, from: Date, to: Date) {
 286 |   return db
 287 |     .select({
 288 |       status: appointments.status,
 289 |       count: sql<number>`COUNT(*)`,
 290 |     })
 291 |     .from(appointments)
 292 |     .where(
 293 |       and(
 294 |         eq(appointments.clinicId, clinicId),
 295 |         gte(appointments.scheduledAt, from),
 296 |         lte(appointments.scheduledAt, to),
 297 |       ),
 298 |     )
 299 |     .groupBy(appointments.status);
 300 | }
 301 | 
 302 | export async function countAppointmentsForPatient(patientId: string) {
 303 |   const [row] = await db
 304 |     .select({ count: sql<number>`COUNT(*)` })
 305 |     .from(appointments)
 306 |     .where(eq(appointments.patientId, patientId));
 307 |   return row?.count ?? 0;
 308 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/development/queries.ts
   2 | import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
   3 | 
   4 | import { db } from "@/db";
   5 | import { milestones } from "@/db/schema";
   6 | 
   7 | import {
   8 |   DEVELOPMENTAL_MILESTONES,
   9 |   type PatientDevelopmentSnapshot,
  10 |   type PatientMilestone,
  11 | } from "../../features/development/types";
  12 | 
  13 | export type { PatientDevelopmentSnapshot, PatientMilestone };
  14 | 
  15 | const CHECKUP_BRACKETS = [2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36, 60] as const;
  16 | 
  17 | function decimalMonthsBetween(dobIso: string, at: Date): number {
  18 |   const dob = new Date(`${dobIso}T00:00:00Z`);
  19 |   return (at.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / (86_400_000 * 30.4375);
  20 | }
  21 | 
  22 | function computeCorrectedAge(
  23 |   dobIso: string,
  24 |   gaWeeks: number | null,
  25 |   at: Date,
  26 | ): {
  27 |   ageMonths: number;
  28 |   correctedAgeMonths: number;
  29 |   isPreterm: boolean;
  30 |   weeksPremature: number;
  31 | } {
  32 |   const ageMonths = decimalMonthsBetween(dobIso, at);
  33 |   const ga = gaWeeks ?? 40;
  34 |   const isPreterm = ga < 37;
  35 |   const weeksPremature = isPreterm ? 40 - ga : 0;
  36 |   const correctedAgeMonths = isPreterm
  37 |     ? Math.max(0, ageMonths - (weeksPremature * 7) / 30.4375)
  38 |     : ageMonths;
  39 |   return {
  40 |     ageMonths,
  41 |     correctedAgeMonths,
  42 |     isPreterm,
  43 |     weeksPremature,
  44 |   };
  45 | }
  46 | 
  47 | function pickNextCheckup(correctedAgeMonths: number): number {
  48 |   for (const bracket of CHECKUP_BRACKETS) {
  49 |     if (correctedAgeMonths < bracket - 0.5) return bracket;
  50 |   }
  51 |   return CHECKUP_BRACKETS[CHECKUP_BRACKETS.length - 1];
  52 | }
  53 | 
  54 | /**
  55 |  * Merge the static milestone catalog with the patient's own records.
  56 |  * Unrecorded milestones default to "not achieved".
  57 |  */
  58 | export async function getPatientDevelopmentSnapshot(
  59 |   patientId: string,
  60 |   now: Date = new Date(),
  61 | ): Promise<PatientDevelopmentSnapshot | null> {
  62 |   const patient = await db.query.patients.findFirst({
  63 |     where: { id: patientId },
  64 |     columns: {
  65 |       id: true,
  66 |       firstName: true,
  67 |       lastName: true,
  68 |       sex: true,
  69 |       dateOfBirth: true,
  70 |       gestationalAgeWeeks: true,
  71 |     },
  72 |   });
  73 |   if (!patient) return null;
  74 | 
  75 |   const recorded = await db.query.milestones.findMany({
  76 |     where: { patientId },
  77 |     columns: {
  78 |       id: true,
  79 |       milestoneId: true,
  80 |       isAchieved: true,
  81 |       achievedDate: true,
  82 |       notes: true,
  83 |     },
  84 |   });
  85 | 
  86 |   const recordByCatalogId = new Map(recorded.map((r) => [r.milestoneId, r] as const));
  87 | 
  88 |   const milestonesMerged: PatientMilestone[] = DEVELOPMENTAL_MILESTONES.map((m) => {
  89 |     const rec = recordByCatalogId.get(m.id);
  90 |     return {
  91 |       ...m,
  92 |       recordId: rec?.id ?? null,
  93 |       isAchieved: rec?.isAchieved ?? false,
  94 |       achievedDate: rec?.achievedDate ?? null,
  95 |       notes: rec?.notes ?? null,
  96 |     };
  97 |   });
  98 | 
  99 |   const ages = computeCorrectedAge(patient.dateOfBirth, patient.gestationalAgeWeeks, now);
 100 | 
 101 |   return {
 102 |     patient,
 103 |     ageMonths: ages.ageMonths,
 104 |     correctedAgeMonths: ages.correctedAgeMonths,
 105 |     isPreterm: ages.isPreterm,
 106 |     weeksPremature: ages.weeksPremature,
 107 |     nextCheckupMonths: pickNextCheckup(ages.correctedAgeMonths),
 108 |     milestones: milestonesMerged,
 109 |   };
 110 | }
 111 | 
 112 | /**
 113 |  * Insert or update a single milestone record for a patient.
 114 |  * `achievedDate` is stored as `YYYY-MM-DD` (schema uses string).
 115 |  */
 116 | export async function setPatientMilestone(input: {
 117 |   patientId: string;
 118 |   milestoneId: string;
 119 |   isAchieved: boolean;
 120 |   achievedDate?: string | null;
 121 |   notes?: string | null;
 122 | }) {
 123 |   const existing = await db.query.milestones.findFirst({
 124 |     where: {
 125 |       patientId: input.patientId,
 126 |       milestoneId: input.milestoneId,
 127 |     },
 128 |     columns: { id: true },
 129 |   });
 130 | 
 131 |   const value = {
 132 |     isAchieved: input.isAchieved,
 133 |     achievedDate: input.isAchieved ? (input.achievedDate ?? isoToday()) : null,
 134 |     notes: input.notes ?? null,
 135 |   };
 136 | 
 137 |   if (existing) {
 138 |     const [row] = await db
 139 |       .update(milestones)
 140 |       .set(value)
 141 |       .where(eq(milestones.id, existing.id))
 142 |       .returning();
 143 |     return row;
 144 |   }
 145 | 
 146 |   const [row] = await db
 147 |     .insert(milestones)
 148 |     .values({
 149 |       patientId: input.patientId,
 150 |       milestoneId: input.milestoneId,
 151 |       ...value,
 152 |     })
 153 |     .returning();
 154 |   return row;
 155 | }
 156 | 
 157 | /** Marks multiple milestone records achieved in one query. */
 158 | export async function bulkSetPatientMilestones(
 159 |   patientId: string,
 160 |   items: ReadonlyArray<{
 161 |     milestoneId: string;
 162 |     isAchieved: boolean;
 163 |     achievedDate?: string | null;
 164 |   }>,
 165 | ) {
 166 |   if (items.length === 0) return [];
 167 |   const ids = items.map((i) => i.milestoneId);
 168 |   const existingRows = await db.query.milestones.findMany({
 169 |     where: { patientId, milestoneId: { in: ids } },
 170 |     columns: { id: true, milestoneId: true },
 171 |   });
 172 |   const existingByCatalog = new Map(existingRows.map((r) => [r.milestoneId, r.id] as const));
 173 | 
 174 |   const today = isoToday();
 175 |   const toInsert = items
 176 |     .filter((i) => !existingByCatalog.has(i.milestoneId))
 177 |     .map((i) => ({
 178 |       patientId,
 179 |       milestoneId: i.milestoneId,
 180 |       isAchieved: i.isAchieved,
 181 |       achievedDate: i.isAchieved ? (i.achievedDate ?? today) : null,
 182 |     }));
 183 | 
 184 |   const toUpdate = items.filter((i) => existingByCatalog.has(i.milestoneId));
 185 | 
 186 |   if (toInsert.length > 0) {
 187 |     await db.insert(milestones).values(toInsert);
 188 |   }
 189 |   await Promise.all(
 190 |     toUpdate.map(async (u) => {
 191 |       const id = existingByCatalog.get(u.milestoneId);
 192 |       if (!id) return;
 193 |       await db
 194 |         .update(milestones)
 195 |         .set({
 196 |           isAchieved: u.isAchieved,
 197 |           achievedDate: u.isAchieved ? (u.achievedDate ?? today) : null,
 198 |         })
 199 |         .where(eq(milestones.id, id));
 200 |     }),
 201 |   );
 202 | 
 203 |   return [...toInsert, ...toUpdate];
 204 | }
 205 | 
 206 | function isoToday(): string {
 207 |   return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 208 | }
```

```ts
  47 |   if (!Number.isFinite(birth)) throw new Error(`Patient ${patientId} has an invalid date of birth`);
  48 |

  55 |     with: { visit: { columns: { visitedAt: true } } },
  56 |     orderBy: { measuredAt: "asc" },

  70 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  71 | // Internal: domain guard

  73 | 
  74 | function assertInDomain<I extends Indicator>(indicator: I, range: RangeFor<I>): void {
  75 |   const bounds = DOMAIN[indicator][range.xAxis as "age" | "length"] as DomainEntry | undefined;
  76 |   if (!bounds) {
  77 |     throw new LmsDomainError(`${indicator} has no ${range.xAxis}-axis coverage`, {
  78 |       indicator,
  79 |       xAxis: range.xAxis,
  80 |     });
  81 |   }
  82 |   if (!Number.isFinite(range.min) || !Number.isFinite(range.max)) {
  83 |     throw new LmsDomainError("min/max must be finite", { indicator, range });
  84 |   }
  85 |   if (range.min > range.max) {
  86 |     throw new LmsDomainError("min > max", { indicator, range });
  87 |   }
  88 |   if (range.min < bounds.min || range.max > bounds.max) {
  89 |     throw new LmsDomainError(
  90 |       `${indicator}/${range.xAxis} domain is [${bounds.min}, ${bounds.max}]; ` +
  91 |         `requested [${range.min}, ${range.max}]`,
  92 |       { indicator, range, bounds },
  93 |     );
  94 |   }
  95 | }

  97 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  98 | // Internal: band construction
  99 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100 | 
 101 | export async function getGrowthChartCurves<I extends Indicator>(
 102 |   indicator: I,
 103 |   sex: Sex,
 104 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
 105 | ): Promise<ChartCurves> {
 106 |   assertInDomain(indicator, range);
 107 | 
 108 |   const refs = await db.query.lmsReferences.findMany({
 109 |     where: {
 110 |       indicator,
 111 |       sex,
 112 |       xAxis: range.xAxis,
 113 |       version: REFERENCE_VERSION,
 114 |       xValue: { gte: range.min, lte: range.max },
 115 |     },
 116 |     orderBy: { xValue: "asc" },
 117 |   });
 118 | 
 119 |   const points: ChartPoint[] = refs.map((r) => ({
 120 |     ...bandFor(r),
 121 |     x: r.xValue,
 122 |   }));
 123 | 
 124 |   return { indicator, sex, xAxis: range.xAxis, points };
 125 | }
 126 | 
 127 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 128 | // Public: many curves in parallel (dashboards)
 129 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 130 | 
 131 | /**
 132 |  * A single curve request, discriminated so `RangeFor<I>` narrowing survives
 133 |  * across the map. `weight-for-length` is length-based; everything else is
 134 |  * age-based.
 135 |  */
 136 | export type CurveRequest =
 137 |   | {
 138 |       indicator: "weight-for-length";
 139 |       sex: Sex;
 140 |       range: { xAxis: "length"; min: number; max: number };
 141 |     }
 142 |   | {
 143 |       indicator: Exclude<Indicator, "weight-for-length">;
 144 |       sex: Sex;
 145 |       range: { xAxis: "age"; min: number; max: number };
 146 |     };
 147 | 
 148 | /**
 149 |  * Fetch several curve sets concurrently. Rejects if any single request fails;
 150 |  * the thrown `LmsDomainError` carries `{ index, indicator, sex, range }` in
 151 |  * its `context` and the original error as `cause`.
 152 |  */
 153 | export async function getGrowthChartCurvesMany(
 154 |   requests: ReadonlyArray<CurveRequest>,
 155 | ): Promise<ChartCurves[]> {
 156 |   return Promise.all(
 157 |     requests.map(async (req, i) => {
 158 |       try {
 159 |         // Both branches narrow `req.range` to the exact `RangeFor<I>` the
 160 |         // generic expects — no `as never` needed.
 161 |         return await getGrowthChartCurves(req.indicator, req.sex, req.range);
 162 |       } catch (err) {
 163 |         if (err instanceof LmsDomainError) {
 164 |           throw new LmsDomainError(
 165 |             `getGrowthChartCurvesMany[${i}] (${req.indicator}/${req.sex}): ${err.message}`,
 166 |             {
 167 |               ...err.context,
 168 |               index: i,
 169 |               indicator: req.indicator,
 170 |               sex: req.sex,
 171 |               range: req.range,
 172 |               cause: err,
 173 |             },
 174 |           );
 175 |         }
 176 |         throw err;
 177 |       }
 178 |     }),
 179 |   );
 180 | }
 181 | 
 182 | export async function getGrowthChartBand<I extends Indicator>(
 183 |   indicator: I,
 184 |   sex: Sex,
 185 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
 186 |   x: number,
 187 | ): Promise<(ChartBand & { indicator: I; sex: Sex; xAxis: RangeFor<I>["xAxis"] }) | null> {
 188 |   assertInDomain(indicator, range);
 189 |   if (!Number.isFinite(x) || x < range.min || x > range.max) return null;
 190 | 
 191 |   const [below, above] = await Promise.all([
 192 |     db.query.lmsReferences.findFirst({
 193 |       where: {
 194 |         indicator,
 195 |         sex,
 196 |         xAxis: range.xAxis,
 197 |         version: REFERENCE_VERSION,
 198 |         xValue: { lte: x },
 199 |       },
 200 |       orderBy: { xValue: "desc" },
 201 |     }),
 202 |     db.query.lmsReferences.findFirst({
 203 |       where: {
 204 |         indicator,
 205 |         sex,
 206 |         xAxis: range.xAxis,
 207 |         version: REFERENCE_VERSION,
 208 |         xValue: { gte: x },
 209 |       },
 210 |       orderBy: { xValue: "asc" },
 211 |     }),
 212 |   ]);
 213 | 
 214 |   // The seed does not cover `x` on at least one side: refuse to extrapolate.
 215 |   if (!below || !above) return null;
 216 | 
 217 |   const interpolated: LmsTriple =
 218 |     below.xValue === above.xValue
 219 |       ? { l: below.l, m: below.m, s: below.s }
 220 |       : interpolateLms(
 221 |           x,
 222 |           { x: below.xValue, l: below.l, m: below.m, s: below.s },
 223 |           { x: above.xValue, l: above.l, m: above.m, s: above.s },
 224 |         );
 225 | 
 226 |   return {
 227 |     x,
 228 |     indicator,
 229 |     sex,
 230 |     xAxis: range.xAxis,
 231 |     ...bandFor(interpolated),
 232 |   };
 233 | }
```
