```ts
   1 | import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
   2 | 
   3 | import { db } from "@/db";
   4 | import { type Immunization, immunizations, patients } from "@/db/schema";
   5 | 
   6 | import type {
   7 |   ImmunizationInput,
   8 |   UpdateImmunizationInput,
   9 | } from "../../features/immunizations/schema";
  10 | 
  11 | import {
  12 |   type ImmunizationCoverage,
  13 |   type MatrixResult,
  14 |   type MatrixRow,
  15 |   type MatrixVaccine,
  16 |   type PatientVaccinationRecord,
  17 |   ROUTINE_CHILDHOOD_SCHEDULE,
  18 | } from "../../features/immunizations/types";
  19 | 
  20 | export type { ImmunizationCoverage, MatrixResult, MatrixRow, MatrixVaccine };
  21 | 
  22 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  23 | // Write
  24 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  25 | 
  26 | export async function recordImmunization(input: ImmunizationInput): Promise<Immunization> {
  27 |   const [row] = await db
  28 |     .insert(immunizations)
  29 |     .values({
  30 |       ...input,
  31 |       administeredDate: input.status === "given" ? (input.administeredDate ?? new Date()) : null,
  32 |     })
  33 |     .returning();
  34 | 
  35 |   if (!row) {
  36 |     throw new Error("Failed to record immunization");
  37 |   }
  38 |   return row;
  39 | }
  40 | 
  41 | export async function updateImmunization(
  42 |   id: string,
  43 |   patch: UpdateImmunizationInput,
  44 | ): Promise<Immunization | null> {
  45 |   const [row] = await db
  46 |     .update(immunizations)
  47 |     .set(patch)
  48 |     .where(eq(immunizations.id, id))
  49 |     .returning();
  50 |   return row ?? null;
  51 | }
  52 | 
  53 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  54 | // Read: one patient
  55 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  56 | 
  57 | const MS_PER_MONTH = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30.4375;
  58 | 
  59 | /**
  60 |  * Full immunization schedule for a patient, with DB records merged in.
  61 |  *
  62 |  * When `patientDob` is omitted the function reads `patients.dateOfBirth`
  63 |  * itself — never silently treats the patient as 0 months old.
  64 |  */
  65 | export async function getPatientImmunizations(
  66 |   patientId: string,
  67 |   patientDob?: Date,
  68 | ): Promise<PatientVaccinationRecord[]> {
  69 |   const [dob, recorded] = await Promise.all([
  70 |     patientDob ??
  71 |       db.query.patients
  72 |         .findFirst({
  73 |           where: { id: patientId },
  74 |           columns: { dateOfBirth: true },
  75 |         })
  76 |         .then((p) => (p ? new Date(p.dateOfBirth) : null)),
  77 |     db.query.immunizations.findMany({
  78 |       where: { patientId },
  79 |       orderBy: { targetAgeMonths: "asc" },
  80 |     }),
  81 |   ]);
  82 | 
  83 |   const recordMap = new Map<string, Immunization>();
  84 |   for (const r of recorded) {
  85 |     recordMap.set(`${r.vaccineKey}-${r.doseNumber}`, r);
  86 |   }
  87 | 
  88 |   const now = new Date();
  89 |   const patientAgeMonths = dob ? (now.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / MS_PER_MONTH : 0;
  90 | 
  91 |   return ROUTINE_CHILDHOOD_SCHEDULE.map((scheduled) => {
  92 |     const key = `${scheduled.vaccineKey}-${scheduled.doseNumber}`;
  93 |     const entry = recordMap.get(key);
  94 | 
  95 |     // If there's a DB record, its status is authoritative. Otherwise,
  96 |     // derive "overdue" from the schedule + age.
  97 |     const status: PatientVaccinationRecord["status"] = entry
  98 |       ? entry.status
  99 |       : patientAgeMonths > scheduled.targetAgeMonths + 1
 100 |         ? "overdue"
 101 |         : "due";
 102 | 
 103 |     return {
 104 |       ...scheduled,
 105 |       recordId: entry?.id,
 106 |       patientId,
 107 |       status,
 108 |       administeredDate: entry?.administeredDate ?? null,
 109 |       lotNumber: entry?.lotNumber ?? null,
 110 |       administeredBy: entry?.administeredById ?? null,
 111 |       adverseEvents: entry?.adverseEvents ?? null,
 112 |     };
 113 |   });
 114 | }
 115 | 
 116 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 117 | // Read: clinic-wide coverage
 118 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 119 | 
 120 | export async function getCoverage(clinicId: string): Promise<ImmunizationCoverage> {
 121 |   const schedule = ROUTINE_CHILDHOOD_SCHEDULE;
 122 |   const now = new Date();
 123 |   const weekEnd = new Date(now);
 124 |   weekEnd.setDate(weekEnd.getDate() + 7);
 125 | 
 126 |   const rows = await db
 127 |     .select({
 128 |       patientId: patients.id,
 129 |       dob: patients.dateOfBirth,
 130 |       vaccineKey: immunizations.vaccineKey,
 131 |       doseNumber: immunizations.doseNumber,
 132 |       status: immunizations.status,
 133 |       administeredDate: immunizations.administeredDate,
 134 |     })
 135 |     .from(patients)
 136 |     .leftJoin(immunizations, eq(immunizations.patientId, patients.id))
 137 |     .where(eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId));
 138 | 
 139 |   // One dob per patient — avoids re-scanning `rows` in the outer loop.
 140 |   const dobByPatient = new Map<string, Date>();
 141 |   for (const r of rows) {
 142 |     if (!dobByPatient.has(r.patientId)) {
 143 |       dobByPatient.set(r.patientId, new Date(r.dob));
 144 |     }
 145 |   }
 146 | 
 147 |   // Last-recorded status per (patient, vaccine, dose). Duplicate rows can
 148 |   // occur if a patient has multiple records for the same dose — the DB has
 149 |   // no unique constraint enforcing one.
 150 |   const recordedByKey = new Map<string, { status: string; administeredDate: Date | null }>();
 151 |   for (const r of rows) {
 152 |     if (!r.vaccineKey || r.status === null) continue;
 153 |     const k = `${r.patientId}:${r.vaccineKey}:${r.doseNumber}`;
 154 |     recordedByKey.set(k, {
 155 |       status: r.status,
 156 |       administeredDate: r.administeredDate,
 157 |     });
 158 |   }
 159 | 
 160 |   let dueThisWeek = 0;
 161 |   let overdue = 0;
 162 |   let refusedOrDeferred = 0;
 163 |   const perVaccine = new Map<string, { given: number; due: number; overdue: number }>();
 164 | 
 165 |   for (const [patientId, dob] of dobByPatient) {
 166 |     for (const s of schedule) {
 167 |       const k = `${patientId}:${s.vaccineKey}:${s.doseNumber}`;
 168 |       const recorded = recordedByKey.get(k);
 169 | 
 170 |       const target = new Date(dob);
 171 |       target.setMonth(target.getMonth() + s.targetAgeMonths);
 172 | 
 173 |       let bucket: "given" | "due" | "overdue" | "refused";
 174 |       if (recorded?.status === "given") {
 175 |         bucket = "given";
 176 |       } else if (recorded?.status === "deferred" || recorded?.status === "refused") {
 177 |         bucket = "refused";
 178 |         refusedOrDeferred += 1;
 179 |       } else if (target < now) {
 180 |         bucket = "overdue";
 181 |       } else {
 182 |         bucket = "due";
 183 |       }
 184 | 
 185 |       if (bucket === "overdue") overdue += 1;
 186 |       if (bucket === "due" && target <= weekEnd) dueThisWeek += 1;
 187 | 
 188 |       const acc = perVaccine.get(s.vaccineKey) ?? {
 189 |         given: 0,
 190 |         due: 0,
 191 |         overdue: 0,
 192 |       };
 193 |       if (bucket === "given") acc.given += 1;
 194 |       if (bucket === "due") acc.due += 1;
 195 |       if (bucket === "overdue") acc.overdue += 1;
 196 |       perVaccine.set(s.vaccineKey, acc);
 197 |     }
 198 |   }
 199 | 
 200 |   const totals = Array.from(perVaccine.values()).reduce(
 201 |     (acc, v) => ({
 202 |       given: acc.given + v.given,
 203 |       due: acc.due + v.due + v.overdue,
 204 |     }),
 205 |     { given: 0, due: 0 },
 206 |   );
 207 | 
 208 |   // Refused/deferred are counted in the denominator so a fully-refused
 209 |   // clinic does not misleadingly show 100% coverage.
 210 |   const denominator = totals.given + totals.due + refusedOrDeferred;
 211 |   const coveragePct = denominator === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((totals.given / denominator) * 100);
 212 | 
 213 |   const byVaccine = Array.from(perVaccine.entries()).map(([key, v]) => {
 214 |     const meta = schedule.find((s) => s.vaccineKey === key);
 215 |     const denom = v.given + v.due + v.overdue;
 216 |     return {
 217 |       vaccineKey: key,
 218 |       vaccineName: meta?.name ?? key,
 219 |       given: v.given,
 220 |       due: v.due,
 221 |       overdue: v.overdue,
 222 |       pct: denom === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((v.given / denom) * 100),
 223 |     };
 224 |   });
 225 | 
 226 |   return { dueThisWeek, overdue, coveragePct, refusedOrDeferred, byVaccine };
 227 | }

 229 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 230 | // Read: clinic-wide matrix
 231 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 232 | 
 233 | export async function getImmunizationMatrix(
 234 |   clinicId: string,
 235 |   filter: {
 236 |     ageBracket?: "0-6" | "6-12" | "12-24" | ">24";
 237 |     onlyOverdue?: boolean;
 238 |   },
 239 | ): Promise<MatrixResult> {
 240 |   const schedule = ROUTINE_CHILDHOOD_SCHEDULE;
 241 | 
 242 |   // ── Column plan ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 243 |   const perVaccine = new Map<string, MatrixVaccine>();
 244 |   for (const s of schedule) {
 245 |     const existing = perVaccine.get(s.vaccineKey);
 246 |     if (existing) {
 247 |       if (!existing.doseNumbers.includes(s.doseNumber)) {
 248 |         existing.doseNumbers.push(s.doseNumber);
 249 |         existing.doseNumbers.sort((a, b) => a - b);
 250 |       }
 251 |     } else {
 252 |       perVaccine.set(s.vaccineKey, {
 253 |         vaccineKey: s.vaccineKey,
 254 |         vaccineName: s.name,
 255 |         doseNumbers: [s.doseNumber],
 256 |         doses: undefined,
 257 |       });
 258 |     }
 259 |   }
 260 |   const vaccines = Array.from(perVaccine.values());
 261 | 
 262 |   // ── Patients ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 263 |   const patients = await db.query.patients.findMany({
 264 |     where: { clinicId },
 265 |     orderBy: (t, { asc }) => [asc(t.lastName), asc(t.firstName)],
 266 |     columns: {
 267 |       id: true,
 268 |       mrn: true,
 269 |       firstName: true,
 270 |       lastName: true,
 271 |       sex: true,
 272 |       dateOfBirth: true,
 273 |     },
 274 |   });
 275 | 
 276 |   const now = new Date();
 277 |   const filtered = patients.filter((p) => matchesAgeBracket(p.dateOfBirth, filter.ageBracket, now));
 278 | 
 279 |   // Guard: Drizzle's `in: []` is dialect-dependent (sqlite returns all,
 280 |   // pg errors). Return an empty matrix instead of risking a full-table scan.
 281 |   if (filtered.length === 0) {
 282 |     return { vaccines, rows: [] };
 283 |   }
 284 | 
 285 |   const records = await db.query.immunizations.findMany({
 286 |     where: { patientId: { in: filtered.map((p) => p.id) } },
 287 |   });
 288 | 
 289 |   const recordMap = new Map<string, (typeof records)[number]>();
 290 |   for (const r of records) {
 291 |     recordMap.set(`${r.patientId}:${r.vaccineKey}:${r.doseNumber}`, r);
 292 |   }
 293 | 
 294 |   // ── Rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 295 |   const rows: MatrixRow[] = filtered.map((p) => {
 296 |     const dob = new Date(p.dateOfBirth);
 297 |     const cells: MatrixRow["cells"] = {};
 298 | 
 299 |     for (const s of schedule) {
 300 |       const rec = recordMap.get(`${p.id}:${s.vaccineKey}:${s.doseNumber}`);
 301 |       cells[`${s.vaccineKey}-${s.doseNumber}`] = resolveStatus({
 302 |         record: rec,
 303 |         dateOfBirth: dob,
 304 |         targetAgeMonths: s.targetAgeMonths,
 305 |         now,
 306 |       });
 307 |     }
 308 | 
 309 |     return {
 310 |       patientId: p.id,
 311 |       mrn: p.mrn,
 312 |       firstName: p.firstName,
 313 |       lastName: p.lastName,
 314 |       sex: p.sex as "male" | "female",
 315 |       dateOfBirth: p.dateOfBirth,
 316 |       cells,
 317 |     };
 318 |   });
 319 | 
 320 |   const finalRows = filter.onlyOverdue
 321 |     ? rows.filter((r) => Object.values(r.cells).some((v) => v === "overdue"))
 322 |     : rows;
 323 | 
 324 |   return { vaccines, rows: finalRows };
 325 | }
 326 | 
 327 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 328 | // Helpers
 329 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 330 | 
 331 | type AgeBracket = "0-6" | "6-12" | "12-24" | ">24";
 332 | 
 333 | /** Pure, exhaustively-typed age bracket test. Always returns a boolean. */
 334 | function matchesAgeBracket(
 335 |   dateOfBirth: string,
 336 |   bracket: AgeBracket | undefined,
 337 |   now: Date,
 338 | ): boolean {
 339 |   if (!bracket) return true;
 340 |   const ageMonths = (now.getTime() - new Date(dateOfBirth).getTime()) / MS_PER_MONTH;
 341 |   switch (bracket) {
 342 |     case "0-6":
 343 |       return ageMonths >= 0 && ageMonths < 6;
 344 |     case "6-12":
 345 |       return ageMonths >= 6 && ageMonths < 12;
 346 |     case "12-24":
 347 |       return ageMonths >= 12 && ageMonths < 24;
 348 |     case ">24":
 349 |       return ageMonths >= 24;
 350 |     default: {
 351 |       // Exhaustiveness check — adding a bracket to the union and not
 352 |       // handling it here becomes a compile error.
 353 |       const _exhaustive: never = bracket;
 354 |       return false;
 355 |     }
 356 |   }
 357 | }
 358 | 
 359 | /**
 360 |  * Resolve a single cell's display status.
 361 |  *
 362 |  * Rules:
 363 |  *   1. Recorded "given"        → given      (DB wins)
 364 |  *   2. Recorded "refused"      → refused    (persistent user decision)
 365 |  *   3. Recorded "deferred"     → due        (postponed, not failed)
 366 |  *   4. No record + past target → overdue
 367 |  *   5. Otherwise               → due
 368 |  */
 369 | function resolveStatus(input: {
 370 |   record: { status: "given" | "due" | "overdue" | "deferred" | "refused" } | undefined;
 371 |   dateOfBirth: Date;
 372 |   targetAgeMonths: number;
 373 |   now: Date;
 374 | }): "given" | "due" | "overdue" | "refused" {
 375 |   const { record, dateOfBirth, targetAgeMonths, now } = input;
 376 | 
 377 |   if (record?.status === "given") return "given";
 378 |   if (record?.status === "refused") return "refused";
 379 |   if (record?.status === "deferred") return "due";
 380 | 
 381 |   const target = new Date(dateOfBirth);
 382 |   target.setMonth(target.getMonth() + targetAgeMonths);
 383 | 
 384 |   return target < now ? "overdue" : "due";
 385 | }
```

```ts
  40 |     eq(lmsReferences.version, LMS_VERSION),

  55 |     .limit(1);

 100 | // --- Standalone measurement insert (creates a measurement-only visit) -----
 101 | 
 102 | /**
 103 |  * Create a "measurement-only" visit + insert all measurements with
 104 |  * z-scores where LMS is available. Used by the standalone
 105 |  * `/patients/$patientId/measurements/new` route.
 106 |  */
 107 | export async function insertMeasurementsStandalone(input: {
 108 |   patientId: string;
 109 |   clinicId: string;
 110 |   rows: Array<{
 111 |     indicator: Indicator;
 112 |     value: number;
 113 |     lengthCm?: number | null;
 114 |   }>;
 115 | }) {
 116 |   const [patient] = await db
 117 |     .select({
 118 |       sex: patients.sex,
 119 |       dateOfBirth: patients.dateOfBirth,
 120 |     })
 121 |     .from(patients)
 122 |     .where(eq(patients.id, input.patientId))
 123 |     .limit(1);
 124 | 
 125 |   if (!patient) throw new Error("Patient not found");
 126 | 
 127 |   const visitedAt = new Date();
 128 |   const ageMonths =
 129 |     (visitedAt.getTime() - new Date(patient.dateOfBirth).getTime()) / (86_400_000 * 30.4375);
 130 |   const years = Math.floor(ageMonths / 12);
 131 |   const remainder = Math.round(ageMonths - years * 12);
 132 | 
 133 |   const [visit] = await db
 134 |     .insert(visits)
 135 |     .values({
 136 |       patientId: input.patientId,
 137 |       clinicId: input.clinicId,
 138 |       visitedAt,
 139 |       ageMonths,
 140 |       ageYears: years,
 141 |       ageMonthsRemainder: remainder >= 12 ? 0 : remainder,
 142 |     })
 143 |     .returning({ id: visits.id });
 144 | 
 145 |   if (!visit) throw new Error("Failed to create visit");
 146 | 
 147 |   const prepared = await Promise.all(
 148 |     input.rows.map(async (row) => {
 149 |       const measurement = {
 150 |         visitId: visit.id,
 151 |         patientId: input.patientId,
 152 |         measuredAt: visitedAt,
 153 |         indicator: row.indicator,
 154 |         value: row.value,
 155 |       };
 156 |       let lms: LmsTriple | null = null;
 157 |       try {
 158 |         if (row.indicator === "weight-for-length") {
 159 |           if (!row.lengthCm) {
 160 |             return measurement;
 161 |           }
 162 |           lms = await getLmsByLength(patient.sex, row.lengthCm);
 163 |         } else if (row.indicator !== "head-circumference-for-age") {
 164 |           lms = await getLmsByAge(row.indicator, patient.sex, ageMonths);
 165 |         }
 166 |       } catch {
 167 |         return measurement;
 168 |       }
 169 | 
 170 |       if (!lms) return measurement;
 171 | 
 172 |       const zScore = zScoreForValue(lms, row.value);
 173 |       return {
 174 |         ...measurement,
 175 |         zScore,
 176 |         lmsL: lms.l,
 177 |         lmsM: lms.m,
 178 |         lmsS: lms.s,
 179 |       };
 180 |     }),
 181 |   );
 182 | 
 183 |   return db.insert(measurements).values(prepared).returning();
 184 | }

 244 | export async function addMeasurementWithZScore(
 245 |   visitId: string,
 246 |   indicator: StoredIndicator,
 247 |   value: number,
 248 |   sex: "male" | "female",
 249 |   ageMonths: number,
 250 |   lengthCm?: number,
 251 | ) {
 252 |   if (indicator === "head-circumference-for-age") {
 253 |     throw new Error("No Egyptian LMS reference data is available for head circumference.");
 254 |   }
 255 | 
 256 |   // 1. Resolve LMS — length-based for WFL, age-based otherwise.
 257 |   const lms: LmsTriple | null =

 262 |       : await getLmsByAge(indicator, sex, ageMonths);

 264 |   if (!lms) {
 265 |     throw new Error(
 266 |       indicator === "weight-for-length"
 267 |         ? `No LMS reference found for ${indicator}, ${sex}, length ${lengthCm ?? "(required)"}`
 268 |         : `No LMS reference found for ${indicator}, ${sex}, age ${ageMonths}`,
 269 |     );
 270 |   }

 272 |   // 2. Z-score. `zScoreForValue` throws `LmsDomainError` on invalid value/LMS,

 274 |   // bad input, which silently classified junk as "median".

 278 |   const visitContext = await getMeasurementVisitContext(visitId);

 280 |     .insert(measurements)
 281 |     .values([
 282 |       {
 283 |         visitId,
 284 |         ...visitContext,
 285 |         indicator,
 286 |         value,
 287 |         zScore,

 289 |         lmsM: lms.m,

 434 | /**
 435 |  * Latest value per indicator, flattened across visits.
 436 |  *
 437 |  * Two-query approach (SELECT + reduce in JS) rather than one clever SQL:
 438 |  * readable, and the row count per patient is tiny.
 439 |  */
 440 | export async function latestPanelForPatient(patientId: string) {
 441 |   const rows = await db
 442 |     .select({
 443 |       indicator: measurements.indicator,
 444 |       value: measurements.value,
 445 |       zScore: measurements.zScore,
 446 |       percentile: measurements.percentile,
 447 |       classification: measurements.classification,
 448 |       visitedAt: visits.visitedAt,
 449 |       ageMonths: visits.ageMonths,
 450 |     })
 451 |     .from(measurements)
 452 |     .innerJoin(visits, eq(measurements.visitId, visits.id))
 453 |     .where(eq(visits.patientId, patientId))
 454 |     .orderBy(desc(visits.visitedAt));
 455 | 
 456 |   const seen = new Map<string, (typeof rows)[number]>();
 457 |   for (const r of rows) if (!seen.has(r.indicator)) seen.set(r.indicator, r);
 458 |   return Array.from(seen.values());
 459 | }

 535 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 536 | // LMS Reference Data
 537 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 538 | 
 539 | /** Whatever `db.select().from(lmsReferences)` returns. */
 540 | type LmsRefRow = typeof lmsReferences.$inferSelect;
 541 | 
 542 | function toLmsRow(row: LmsRefRow): LmsRow {
 543 |   return {
 544 |     indicator: row.indicator as Indicator,
 545 |     sex: row.sex as Sex,
 546 |     xAxis: row.xAxis as XAxis,
 547 |     xValue: row.xValue,
 548 |     l: row.l,
 549 |     m: row.m,
 550 |     s: row.s,
 551 |   };
 552 | }
 553 | 
 554 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 555 | // Seed
 556 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 557 | 
 558 | /**
 559 |  * Insert the LMS seed exactly once. Idempotent via `onConflictDoNothing`.
 560 |  *
 561 |  * Chunks by **parameter count**, not row count — SQLite's default
 562 |  * SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER is 999, and each row binds 9 params.
 563 |  * Wraps the whole seed in one transaction so a failed chunk doesn't leave
 564 |  * the table half-populated.
 565 |  */
 566 | export async function seedLmsReferences(seed: readonly LmsRow[]): Promise<void> {
 567 |   const COLS_PER_ROW = 9;
 568 |   const MAX_PARAMS = 900;
 569 |   const CHUNK = Math.floor(MAX_PARAMS / COLS_PER_ROW);
 570 | 
 571 |   const values = seed.map((r) => ({
 572 |     indicator: r.indicator,
 573 |     sex: r.sex,
 574 |     xAxis: r.xAxis,
 575 |     xValue: r.xValue,
 576 |     l: r.l,
 577 |     m: r.m,
 578 |     s: r.s,
 579 |     version: LMS_VERSION,
 580 |   }));
 581 | 
 582 |   db.transaction((tx) => {
 583 |     for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i += CHUNK) {
 584 |       tx.insert(lmsReferences)
 585 |         .values(values.slice(i, i + CHUNK))
 586 |         .onConflictDoNothing()
 587 |         .run();
 588 |     }
 589 |   });
 590 | }
 591 | 
 592 | /**
 593 |  * Replace all rows for `LMS_VERSION`. Use during dev/migrations.
 594 |  * (Other versions are preserved.)
 595 |  */
 596 | export async function replaceLmsReferences(seed: readonly LmsRow[]): Promise<void> {
 597 |   await db.delete(lmsReferences).where(eq(lmsReferences.version, LMS_VERSION));
 598 |   await seedLmsReferences(seed);
 599 | }
 600 | 
 601 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 602 | // Lookup: exact grid point
 603 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 604 | 
 605 | /**
 606 |  * Exact LMS row for `(indicator, sex, xAxis, xValue)`, or `null` if that
 607 |  * tuple isn't tabulated. Use `getLmsInterpolated` for off-grid x.
 608 |  */
 609 | export async function getLms(params: {
 610 |   indicator: Indicator;
 611 |   sex: Sex;
 612 |   xAxis: XAxis;
 613 |   xValue: number;
 614 | }): Promise<LmsRow | null> {
 615 |   const [row] = await db
 616 |     .select()
 617 |     .from(lmsReferences)
 618 |     .where(
 619 |       and(
 620 |         eq(lmsReferences.indicator, params.indicator),
 621 |         eq(lmsReferences.sex, params.sex),
 622 |         eq(lmsReferences.xAxis, params.xAxis),
 623 |         eq(lmsReferences.xValue, params.xValue),
 624 |         eq(lmsReferences.version, LMS_VERSION),
 625 |       ),
 626 |     )
 627 |     .limit(1);
 628 | 
 629 |   return row ? toLmsRow(row) : null;
 630 | }
 631 | 
 632 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 633 | // Lookup: interpolated
 634 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 635 | 
 636 | /**
 637 |  * Linearly interpolate L/M/S between the two bracketing grid points.
 638 |  *
 639 |  * Returns `null` when `xValue` is outside the tabulated coverage — this
 640 |  * function never extrapolates from the nearest row.
 641 |  */
 642 | export async function getLmsInterpolated(params: {
 643 |   indicator: Indicator;
 644 |   sex: Sex;
 645 |   xAxis: XAxis;
 646 |   xValue: number;
 647 | }): Promise<LmsRow | null> {
 648 |   const { indicator, sex, xAxis, xValue } = params;
 649 | 
 650 |   const baseWhere = and(
 651 |     eq(lmsReferences.indicator, indicator),
 652 |     eq(lmsReferences.sex, sex),
 653 |     eq(lmsReferences.xAxis, xAxis),
 654 |     eq(lmsReferences.version, LMS_VERSION),
 655 |   );
 656 | 
 657 |   const [belowRows, aboveRows] = await Promise.all([
 658 |     db
 659 |       .select()
 660 |       .from(lmsReferences)
 661 |       .where(and(baseWhere, lte(lmsReferences.xValue, xValue)))
 662 |       .orderBy(desc(lmsReferences.xValue))
 663 |       .limit(1),
 664 |     db
 665 |       .select()
 666 |       .from(lmsReferences)
 667 |       .where(and(baseWhere, gte(lmsReferences.xValue, xValue)))
 668 |       .orderBy(asc(lmsReferences.xValue))
 669 |       .limit(1),
 670 |   ]);
 671 | 
 672 |   const below = belowRows[0];
 673 |   const above = aboveRows[0];
 674 | 
 675 |   if (!below || !above) return null;
 676 |   if (below.xValue === above.xValue) return toLmsRow(below);
 677 | 
 678 |   const tri = interpolateLms(
 679 |     xValue,
 680 |     { x: below.xValue, l: below.l, m: below.m, s: below.s },
 681 |     { x: above.xValue, l: above.l, m: above.m, s: above.s },
 682 |   );
 683 | 
 684 |   return {
 685 |     indicator,
 686 |     sex,
 687 |     xAxis,
 688 |     xValue,
 689 |     l: tri.l,
 690 |     m: tri.m,
 691 |     s: tri.s,
 692 |   };
 693 | }
 694 | 
 695 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 696 | // Lookup: type-safe wrappers
 697 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```ts
 155 | export async function updatePatient(
 156 |   id: string,
 157 |   patch: Partial<Omit<typeof patients.$inferInsert, "id">>,
 158 |   baseVersion?: string,
 159 | ) {
 160 |   if (baseVersion === undefined) {
 161 |     const [row] = await db.update(patients).set(patch).where(eq(patients.id, id)).returning();
 162 |     return row ?? null;
 163 |   }
 164 | 
 165 |   // Compare-and-swap on `updated_at`. A stale `baseVersion` matches no row,
 166 |   // so a concurrent edit can never silently clobber the newer one.
 167 |   const [row] = await db
 168 |     .update(patients)
 169 |     .set(patch)
 170 |     .where(and(eq(patients.id, id), eq(patients.updatedAt, new Date(baseVersion))))
 171 |     .returning();
 172 |   return row ?? null;
 173 | }

 218 | export async function createPatient(input: PatientInput) {
 219 |   const year = new Date().getFullYear();
 220 |   const prefix = `MRN-${year}-`;
 221 |   const mrnSuffix = sql<number>`CAST(SUBSTR(${patients.mrn}, ${prefix.length + 1}) AS INTEGER)`;
 222 | 
 223 |   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
 224 |     const [row] = await db
 225 |       .select({ max: sql<number>`COALESCE(MAX(${mrnSuffix}), 0)` })
 226 |       .from(patients)
 227 |       .where(and(eq(patients.clinicId, input.clinicId), sql`${patients.mrn} LIKE ${`${prefix}%`}`));
 228 |     const next = (row?.max ?? 0) + 1;
 229 |     const mrn = `${prefix}${String(next).padStart(3, "0")}`;
 230 |     try {
 231 |       const [created] = await db
 232 |         .insert(patients)
 233 |         .values({ ...input, mrn })
 234 |         .returning();
 235 |       return created;
 236 |     } catch (err) {
 237 |       if (!(err instanceof Error) || !/UNIQUE|unique/i.test(err.message)) {
 238 |         throw err;
 239 |       }
 240 |     }
 241 |   }
 242 |   throw new Error("Could not allocate a unique MRN after retries");
 243 | }
```

```ts
  94 | /**

  98 |  *   - prior courses of the same drug (for "already on this")
  99 |  *
 100 |  * Returns every status; the caller filters by `status === "active"`
 101 |  * where appropriate, because the safety rail also wants to show
 102 |  * "recently discontinued" as context.
 103 |  */
 104 | export async function listComposerActiveMeds(patientId: string): Promise<ComposerActiveMed[]> {
 105 |   const rows = await db
 106 |     .select({
 107 |       id: prescriptions.id,
 108 |       medicationName: prescriptions.medicationName,
 109 |       dosage: prescriptions.dosage,
 110 |       frequency: prescriptions.frequency,
 111 |       durationDays: prescriptions.durationDays,
 112 |       prescribedAt: prescriptions.prescribedAt,
 113 |       status: prescriptions.status,
 114 |     })
 115 |     .from(prescriptions)
 116 |     .where(eq(prescriptions.patientId, patientId))
 117 |     .orderBy(desc(prescriptions.prescribedAt));
 118 | 
 119 |   return rows.map((r) => ({
 120 |     ...r,
 121 |     status: r.status as ComposerActiveMed["status"],
 122 |   }));
 123 | }

 132 |   patientId: string;

 135 |   dosage: string;
 136 |   frequency: string;

 141 | /**
 142 |  * Create or update a prescription from composer values.
 143 |  *
 144 |  * `prescribedAt` is always set to now — the composer never backdates.
 145 |  * If you need backdating, extend this input.
 146 |  */
 147 | export async function saveComposerPrescription(input: SaveComposerPrescriptionInput) {
 148 |   const patch = {
 149 |     patientId: input.patientId,
 150 |     visitId: input.visitId,
 151 |     medicationName: input.medicationName,
 152 |     dosage: input.dosage,
 153 |     frequency: input.frequency,
 154 |     durationDays: input.durationDays,
 155 |     instructions: input.instructions,
 156 |     prescribedAt: new Date(),
 157 |   };
 158 | 
 159 |   if (input.prescriptionId) {
 160 |     const [row] = await db
 161 |       .update(prescriptions)
 162 |       .set(patch)
 163 |       .where(eq(prescriptions.id, input.prescriptionId))
 164 |       .returning();
 165 |     return row ?? null;
 166 |   }
 167 | 
 168 |   const [row] = await db.insert(prescriptions).values(patch).returning();
 169 |   return row ?? null;
 170 | }

 172 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 173 | // Discontinue
 174 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 176 | /**
 177 |  * Mark a prescription as cancelled. Returns the updated row, or `null`
 178 |  * if the id doesn't exist (so the caller can 404 rather than silently
 179 |  * assume success).
 180 |  */
 181 | export async function discontinueComposerPrescription(prescriptionId: string) {
 182 |   const [row] = await db
 183 |     .update(prescriptions)
 184 |     .set({ status: "cancelled", statusChangedAt: new Date() })
 185 |     .where(eq(prescriptions.id, prescriptionId))
 186 |     .returning();
 187 |   return row ?? null;
 188 | }
```

```ts
 186 | export async function listPrescriptionRegister(
 187 |   clinicId: string,
 188 |   search: {
 189 |     q?: string;
 190 |     medication?: string;
 191 |     prescriberId?: string;
 192 |     status: "all" | "active" | "completed" | "cancelled";
 193 |     from?: string;
 194 |     to?: string;
 195 |     page: number;
 196 |     size: number;
 197 |   },
 198 | ): Promise<{ rows: PrescriptionRegisterRow[]; total: number }> {
 199 |   const conditions = [eq(visits.clinicId, clinicId)];
 200 |   if (search.status !== "all") {
 201 |     conditions.push(eq(prescriptions.status, search.status));
 202 |   }
 203 |   if (search.prescriberId) {
 204 |     conditions.push(eq(prescriptions.prescribedById, search.prescriberId));
 205 |   }
 206 |   if (search.medication) {
 207 |     conditions.push(ilike(prescriptions.medicationName, `%${search.medication}%`));
 208 |   }
 209 |   if (search.from) {
 210 |     conditions.push(gte(prescriptions.prescribedAt, new Date(`${search.from}T00:00:00Z`)));
 211 |   }
 212 |   if (search.to) {
 213 |     conditions.push(lte(prescriptions.prescribedAt, new Date(`${search.to}T23:59:59Z`)));
 214 |   }
 215 | 
 216 |   const where = and(...conditions);
 217 |   const offset = (search.page - 1) * search.size;
 218 | 
 219 |   const [rows, [{ count }]] = await Promise.all([
 220 |     db
 221 |       .select({
 222 |         id: prescriptions.id,
 223 |         medicationName: prescriptions.medicationName,
 224 |         dosage: prescriptions.dosage,
 225 |         frequency: prescriptions.frequency,
 226 |         durationDays: prescriptions.durationDays,
 227 |         status: prescriptions.status,
 228 |         prescribedAt: prescriptions.prescribedAt,
 229 |         prescriber: { id: user.id, name: user.name },
 230 |         patient: {
 231 |           id: patients.id,
 232 |           mrn: patients.mrn,
 233 |           firstName: patients.firstName,
 234 |           lastName: patients.lastName,
 235 |         },
 236 |       })
 237 |       .from(prescriptions)
 238 |       .innerJoin(visits, eq(visits.id, prescriptions.visitId))
 239 |       .innerJoin(patients, eq(patients.id, prescriptions.patientId))
 240 |       .leftJoin(user, eq(user.id, prescriptions.prescribedById))
 241 |       .where(where)
 242 |       .orderBy(desc(prescriptions.prescribedAt))
 243 |       .limit(search.size)
 244 |       .offset(offset),
 245 |     db
 246 |       .select({ count: sql<number>`COUNT(*)` })
 247 |       .from(prescriptions)
 248 |       .innerJoin(visits, eq(visits.id, prescriptions.visitId))
 249 |       .where(where),
 250 |   ]);
 251 | 
 252 |   return {
 253 |     total: count,
 254 |     rows: rows.map((r) => ({
 255 |       ...r,
 256 |       status: r.status as PrescriptionRegisterRow["status"],
 257 |       brandName: null,
 258 |       flagsInteraction: false, // computed client-side by the row from a formulary lookup
 259 |     })),
 260 |   };
 261 | }
```

`db/queries/search.queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/db/queries/search.queries.ts
   2 | import { and, desc, eq, ilike, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
   3 | 
   4 | import type { SearchCategory, SearchResponse, SearchResult } from "@/features/search/schema";
   5 | 
   6 | import { db } from "@/db";
   7 | import { diagnoses, patients, prescriptions, visits } from "@/db/schema";
   8 | import { formatDate, formatTime } from "@/lib/dates";
   9 | 
  10 | const PATIENT_LIMIT = 8;
  11 | const APPOINTMENT_LIMIT = 5;
  12 | const PRESCRIPTION_LIMIT = 5;
  13 | const DIAGNOSIS_LIMIT = 5;
  14 | // const MEASUREMENT_LIMIT = 0; // off by default — no free-text fields
  15 | 
  16 | interface Args {
  17 |   clinicId: string;
  18 |   query: string;
  19 |   categories?: SearchCategory[];
  20 |   limit: number;
  21 | }
  22 | 
  23 | function wants(all: SearchCategory[] | undefined, cat: SearchCategory) {
  24 |   return !all || all.includes(cat);
  25 | }
  26 | 
  27 | export async function searchAcrossEntities({
  28 |   clinicId,
  29 |   query,
  30 |   categories,
  31 |   limit,
  32 | }: Args): Promise<SearchResponse> {
  33 |   const started = performance.now();
  34 |   const q = `%${query}%`;
  35 | 
  36 |   const [patientHits, apptHits, rxHits, dxHits] = await Promise.all([
  37 |     wants(categories, "patient")
  38 |       ? db
  39 |           .select({
  40 |             id: patients.id,
  41 |             mrn: patients.mrn,
  42 |             firstName: patients.firstName,
  43 |             lastName: patients.lastName,
  44 |             dob: patients.dateOfBirth,
  45 |             phone: patients.phone,
  46 |           })
  47 |           .from(patients)
  48 |           .where(
  49 |             and(
  50 |               eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId),
  51 |               or(
  52 |                 ilike(patients.mrn, q),
  53 |                 ilike(patients.firstName, q),
  54 |                 ilike(patients.lastName, q),
  55 |                 ilike(sql`${patients.firstName} || ' ' || ${patients.lastName}`, q),
  56 |                 ilike(patients.phone, q),
  57 |               ),
  58 |             ),
  59 |           )
  60 |           .orderBy(
  61 |             // exact MRN match ranks first
  62 |             sql`case when ${patients.mrn} = ${query} then 0 else 1 end`,
  63 |             patients.lastName,
  64 |           )
  65 |           .limit(PATIENT_LIMIT)
  66 |       : [],
  67 | 
  68 |     wants(categories, "appointment")
  69 |       ? db.query.appointments.findMany({
  70 |           where: {
  71 |             clinicId: clinicId, // equality shorthand
  72 |             scheduledAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 86_400_000) },
  73 |           },
  74 |           with: { patient: true },
  75 |           orderBy: { scheduledAt: "desc" },
  76 |           limit: APPOINTMENT_LIMIT * 4,
  77 |         })
  78 |       : [],
  79 | 
  80 |     wants(categories, "prescription")
  81 |       ? db
  82 |           .select({
  83 |             id: prescriptions.id,
  84 |             medicationName: prescriptions.medicationName,
  85 |             dosage: prescriptions.dosage,
  86 |             patientId: prescriptions.patientId,
  87 |             patientFirst: patients.firstName,
  88 |             patientLast: patients.lastName,
  89 |             prescribedAt: prescriptions.prescribedAt,
  90 |           })
  91 |           .from(prescriptions)
  92 |           .innerJoin(patients, eq(patients.id, prescriptions.patientId))
  93 |           .where(and(eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId), ilike(prescriptions.medicationName, q)))
  94 |           .orderBy(desc(prescriptions.prescribedAt))
  95 |           .limit(PRESCRIPTION_LIMIT)
  96 |       : [],
  97 | 
  98 |     wants(categories, "diagnosis")
  99 |       ? db
 100 |           .select({
 101 |             id: diagnoses.id,
 102 |             icdCode: diagnoses.icdCode,
 103 |             description: diagnoses.description,
 104 |             visitId: diagnoses.visitId,
 105 |             patientId: visits.patientId,
 106 |             patientFirst: patients.firstName,
 107 |             patientLast: patients.lastName,
 108 |           })
 109 |           .from(diagnoses)
 110 |           .innerJoin(visits, eq(visits.id, diagnoses.visitId))
 111 |           .innerJoin(patients, eq(patients.id, visits.patientId))
 112 |           .where(
 113 |             and(
 114 |               eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId),
 115 |               or(ilike(diagnoses.icdCode, q), ilike(diagnoses.description, q)),
 116 |             ),
 117 |           )
 118 |           .limit(DIAGNOSIS_LIMIT)
 119 |       : [],
 120 |   ]);
 121 | 
 122 |   const results: SearchResult[] = [];
 123 |   const lower = query.toLowerCase();
 124 | 
 125 |   // ── Patients
 126 |   for (const p of patientHits) {
 127 |     results.push({
 128 |       category: "patient",
 129 |       id: p.id,
 130 |       title: `${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}`,
 131 |       subtitle: `MRN ${p.mrn}`,
 132 |       href: `/app/patients/${p.id}?tab=overview`,
 133 |       score: p.mrn.toLowerCase() === lower ? 100 : 70,
 134 |       meta: { phone: p.phone },
 135 |     });
 136 |   }
 137 |   // ── Appointments (filter in-memory: we over-fetched)
 138 |   const apptResults = apptHits
 139 |     .filter((a) => {
 140 |       const name = `${a.patient?.firstName ?? ""} ${a.patient?.lastName ?? ""}`;
 141 |       return (
 142 |         name.toLowerCase().includes(lower) || (a.reason?.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ?? false)
 143 |       );
 144 |     })
 145 |     .slice(0, APPOINTMENT_LIMIT);
 146 |   for (const a of apptResults) {
 147 |     const when = new Date(a.scheduledAt);
 148 |     results.push({
 149 |       category: "appointment",
 150 |       id: a.id,
 151 |       title: `${a.patient?.firstName ?? "?"} ${a.patient?.lastName ?? ""} — ${formatDate(when)}`,
 152 |       subtitle: a.reason ?? null,
 153 |       href: `/app/appointments?date=${when.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
 154 |       score: 50,
 155 |       meta: {
 156 |         time: formatTime(when),
 157 |       },
 158 |     });
 159 |   }
 160 | 
 161 |   // ── Prescriptions
 162 |   for (const r of rxHits) {
 163 |     results.push({
 164 |       category: "prescription",
 165 |       id: r.id,
 166 |       title: r.medicationName,
 167 |       subtitle: `${r.dosage} · ${r.patientFirst} ${r.patientLast}`,
 168 |       href: `/app/patients/${r.patientId}?tab=prescriptions`,
 169 |       score: 60,
 170 |     });
 171 |   }
 172 | 
 173 |   // ── Diagnoses
 174 |   for (const d of dxHits) {
 175 |     results.push({
 176 |       category: "diagnosis",
 177 |       id: d.id,
 178 |       title: `${d.icdCode} · ${d.description}`,
 179 |       subtitle: `${d.patientFirst} ${d.patientLast}`,
 180 |       href: `/app/patients/${d.patientId}?tab=diagnoses`,
 181 |       score: d.icdCode.toLowerCase() === lower ? 90 : 55,
 182 |     });
 183 |   }
 184 | 
 185 |   // Rank: score desc, then patients > meds > dx > appts
 186 |   const catWeight: Record<SearchCategory, number> = {
 187 |     patient: 4,
 188 |     prescription: 3,
 189 |     diagnosis: 2,
 190 |     appointment: 1,
 191 |     measurement: 0,
 192 |   };
 193 |   results.sort(
 194 |     (a, b) =>
 195 |       b.score - a.score ||
 196 |       catWeight[b.category] - catWeight[a.category] ||
 197 |       a.title.localeCompare(b.title),
 198 |   );
 199 | 
 200 |   const byCategory = results.reduce<Record<SearchCategory, number>>(
 201 |     (acc, r) => {
 202 |       acc[r.category] = (acc[r.category] ?? 0) + 1;
 203 |       return acc;
 204 |     },
 205 |     {} as Record<SearchCategory, number>,
 206 |   );
 207 |   return {
 208 |     query,
 209 |     results: results.slice(0, limit),
 210 |     byCategory,
 211 |     elapsedMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
 212 |   };
 213 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // features/visits/composer/queries.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Pure DB layer for the visit composer. No TanStack Start, no React,
   4 | // no queryOptions. Only Drizzle + your domain helpers.
   5 | 
   6 | import type { AuthUser, SaveVisitInput, SaveVisitResult } from "@/features/visits/composer/schema";
   7 | 
   8 | import { db, eq } from "#/db/index.ts";
   9 | import { diagnoses, measurements, patients, prescriptions, visits } from "#/db/schema.ts";
  10 | 
  11 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  12 | // Snapshot reads
  13 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  14 | 
  15 | /** Everything the composer's patient card and weight sparkline need. */
  16 | export async function fetchPatientSnapshot(patientId: string) {
  17 |   const patient = await db.query.patients.findFirst({
  18 |     where: { id: patientId },
  19 |     columns: {
  20 |       id: true,
  21 |       mrn: true,
  22 |       firstName: true,
  23 |       lastName: true,
  24 |       sex: true,
  25 |       dateOfBirth: true,
  26 |       allergies: true,
  27 |     },
  28 |   });
  29 |   if (!patient) return null;
  30 | 
  31 |   const [lastVisit] = await db.query.visits.findMany({
  32 |     where: { patientId },
  33 |     orderBy: { visitedAt: "desc" },
  34 |     limit: 1,
  35 |     columns: { visitedAt: true },
  36 |   });
  37 | 
  38 |   const weightSeries = await db.query.measurements.findMany({
  39 |     where: { patientId, indicator: "weight-for-age" },
  40 |     orderBy: { measuredAt: "asc" },
  41 |     columns: { value: true, measuredAt: true },
  42 |   });
  43 | 
  44 |   return {
  45 |     patient,
  46 |     lastVisitAt: lastVisit?.visitedAt ?? null,
  47 |     weightSeries: weightSeries.map((w) => ({
  48 |       value: w.value,
  49 |       at: w.measuredAt,
  50 |     })),
  51 |   };
  52 | }
  53 | 
  54 | /** Active prescriptions — used by the safety rail's interaction check. */
  55 | export async function fetchActiveMedications(patientId: string) {
  56 |   return db.query.prescriptions.findMany({
  57 |     where: { patientId, status: "active" },
  58 |     columns: { id: true, medicationName: true, dosage: true },
  59 |   });
  60 | }
  61 | 
  62 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  63 | // Save
  64 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  65 | 
  66 | const MS_PER_MONTH = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30.44;
  67 | 
  68 | function monthsBetween(from: Date, to: Date): number {
  69 |   return (to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / MS_PER_MONTH;
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | /**
  73 |  * One transaction type, aliased once. Previously every helper repeated
  74 |  * `Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0]`, which is both
  75 |  * noisy and easy to drift from the actual type when Drizzle changes.
  76 |  */
  77 | type Tx = Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0];
  78 | 
  79 | function assertVisitAccess(
  80 |   tx: Tx,
  81 |   input: Pick<SaveVisitInput, "patientId" | "clinicId">,
  82 |   user: AuthUser,
  83 | ): { dob: string } {
  84 |   const [patient] = tx
  85 |     .select({ dob: patients.dateOfBirth, clinicId: patients.clinicId })
  86 |     .from(patients)
  87 |     .where(eq(patients.id, input.patientId))
  88 |     .limit(1)
  89 |     .all();
  90 | 
  91 |   if (!patient) {
  92 |     throw new Error(`Patient ${input.patientId} not found`);
  93 |   }
  94 |   if (patient.clinicId !== input.clinicId) {
  95 |     throw new Error(`Patient belongs to clinic ${patient.clinicId}, not ${input.clinicId}`);
  96 |   }
  97 |   if (user.role !== "admin" && user.clinicId !== input.clinicId) {
  98 |     throw new Error("Forbidden: cross-clinic access denied");
  99 |   }
 100 |   return { dob: patient.dob };
 101 | }
 102 | 
 103 | function upsertVisit(tx: Tx, input: SaveVisitInput, ageMonths: number): string {
 104 |   const base = {
 105 |     clinicId: input.clinicId,
 106 |     doctorId: input.doctorId,
 107 |     visitedAt: input.visitedAt,
 108 |     ageMonths,
 109 |     chiefComplaint: input.chiefComplaint?.trim() || null,
 110 |     symptoms: input.symptoms.join(", "),
 111 |     physicalExam: input.examFindings?.trim() || null,
 112 |     plan: input.plan?.trim() || null,
 113 |   };
 114 | 
 115 |   if (input.visitId) {
 116 |     const rows = tx
 117 |       .update(visits)
 118 |       .set(base)
 119 |       .where(eq(visits.id, input.visitId))
 120 |       .returning({ id: visits.id })
 121 |       .all();
 122 | 
 123 |     const row = rows[0];
 124 |     if (!row) throw new Error(`Visit ${input.visitId} not found`);
 125 |     return row.id;
 126 |   }
 127 | 
 128 |   const rows = tx
 129 |     .insert(visits)
 130 |     .values({ ...base, patientId: input.patientId })
 131 |     .returning({ id: visits.id })
 132 |     .all();
 133 | 
 134 |   const row = rows[0];
 135 |   if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to create visit");
 136 |   return row.id;
 137 | }
 138 | 
 139 | function insertChildren(
 140 |   tx: Tx,
 141 |   input: SaveVisitInput,
 142 |   visitId: string,
 143 |   prescriberId: string,
 144 | ): void {
 145 |   if (input.measurements.length > 0) {
 146 |     tx.insert(measurements)
 147 |       .values(
 148 |         input.measurements.map((m) => ({
 149 |           visitId,
 150 |           patientId: input.patientId,
 151 |           measuredAt: input.visitedAt,
 152 |           indicator: m.indicator,
 153 |           value: m.value,
 154 |           lengthCmAtMeasurement: m.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (m.lengthCm ?? null) : null,
 155 |         })),
 156 |       )
 157 |       .run();
 158 |   }
 159 | 
 160 |   if (input.diagnoses.length > 0) {
 161 |     tx.insert(diagnoses)
 162 |       .values(
 163 |         input.diagnoses.map((d) => ({
 164 |           visitId,
 165 |           icdCode: d.icdCode,
 166 |           description: d.description,
 167 |           type: d.type,
 168 |         })),
 169 |       )
 170 |       .run();
 171 |   }
 172 | 
 173 |   if (input.prescriptions.length > 0) {
 174 |     tx.insert(prescriptions)
 175 |       .values(
 176 |         input.prescriptions.map((p) => ({
 177 |           visitId,
 178 |           patientId: input.patientId,
 179 |           prescribedById: prescriberId,
 180 |           medicationName: p.medicationName,
 181 |           dosage: p.dosage,
 182 |           frequency: p.frequency,
 183 |           durationDays: p.durationDays ?? null,
 184 |           instructions: p.instructions?.trim() || null,
 185 |           prescribedAt: input.visitedAt,
 186 |         })),
 187 |       )
 188 |       .run();
 189 |   }
 190 | }
 191 | 
 192 | function clearChildren(tx: Tx, visitId: string): void {
 193 |   tx.delete(measurements).where(eq(measurements.visitId, visitId)).run();
 194 |   tx.delete(diagnoses).where(eq(diagnoses.visitId, visitId)).run();
 195 |   tx.delete(prescriptions).where(eq(prescriptions.visitId, visitId)).run();
 196 | }
 197 | 
 198 | export function saveVisit(input: SaveVisitInput, user: AuthUser): SaveVisitResult {
 199 |   return db.transaction((tx) => {
 200 |     const { dob } = assertVisitAccess(tx, input, user);
 201 |     const ageMonths = monthsBetween(new Date(dob), input.visitedAt);
 202 |     const visitId = upsertVisit(tx, input, ageMonths);
 203 | 
 204 |     if (input.visitId) clearChildren(tx, visitId);
 205 | 
 206 |     const prescriberId = input.doctorId || user.id;
 207 |     insertChildren(tx, input, visitId, prescriberId);
 208 | 
 209 |     return { visitId };
 210 |   });
 211 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import lhfaBoys from "@data/who/lhfa-boys.json";
   2 | import lhfaGirls from "@data/who/lhfa-girls.json";
   3 | import wfaBoys from "@data/who/wfa-boys.json";

  10 | import { growthStandards } from "../schema";
  11 | 
  12 | interface WhoGrowthRow {
  13 |   Day: number;
  14 |   L: number;
  15 |   M: number;
  16 |   S: number;
  17 |   SD4neg: number;
  18 |   SD3neg: number;
  19 |   SD2neg: number;
  20 |   SD1neg: number;
  21 |   SD0: number;
  22 |   SD1: number;
  23 |   SD2: number;
  24 |   SD3: number;
  25 |   SD4: number;
  26 | }
  27 | 
  28 | const datasets = [
  29 |   { metric: "lhfa", gender: "boys", rows: lhfaBoys },
  30 |   { metric: "lhfa", gender: "girls", rows: lhfaGirls },
  31 |   { metric: "wfa", gender: "boys", rows: wfaBoys },
  32 |   { metric: "wfa", gender: "girls", rows: wfaGirls },
  33 | ] satisfies ReadonlyArray<{
  34 |   metric: "lhfa" | "wfa";
  35 |   gender: "boys" | "girls";
  36 |   rows: WhoGrowthRow[];
  37 | }>;
  38 | 
  39 | function assertValidDataset(dataset: (typeof datasets)[number]): void {
  40 |   if (dataset.rows.length !== 1857) {
  41 |     throw new Error(
  42 |       `WHO ${dataset.metric}/${dataset.gender} must contain 1,857 daily rows; got ${dataset.rows.length}`,
  43 |     );
  44 |   }
  45 | 
  46 |   for (const [index, row] of dataset.rows.entries()) {
  47 |     if (row.Day !== index) {
  48 |       throw new Error(
  49 |         `WHO ${dataset.metric}/${dataset.gender} has a missing or unordered day at row ${index}`,
  50 |       );
  51 |     }
  52 | 
  53 |     const values = [
  54 |       row.L,
  55 |       row.M,
  56 |       row.S,
  57 |       row.SD4neg,
  58 |       row.SD3neg,
  59 |       row.SD2neg,
  60 |       row.SD1neg,
  61 |       row.SD0,
  62 |       row.SD1,
  63 |       row.SD2,
  64 |       row.SD3,
  65 |       row.SD4,
  66 |     ];
  67 |     if (values.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value))) {
  68 |       throw new Error(
  69 |         `WHO ${dataset.metric}/${dataset.gender} contains a non-finite value on day ${row.Day}`,
  70 |       );
  71 |     }
  72 |     if (row.M <= 0 || row.S <= 0) {
  73 |       throw new Error(
  74 |         `WHO ${dataset.metric}/${dataset.gender} has invalid LMS values on day ${row.Day}`,
  75 |       );
  76 |     }
  77 | 
  78 |     const bands = [
  79 |       row.SD4neg,
  80 |       row.SD3neg,
  81 |       row.SD2neg,
  82 |       row.SD1neg,
  83 |       row.SD0,
  84 |       row.SD1,
  85 |       row.SD2,
  86 |       row.SD3,
  87 |       row.SD4,
  88 |     ];
  89 |     if (bands.some((value, bandIndex) => bandIndex > 0 && value <= bands[bandIndex - 1])) {
  90 |       throw new Error(
  91 |         `WHO ${dataset.metric}/${dataset.gender} has unordered SD bands on day ${row.Day}`,
  92 |       );
  93 |     }
  94 |   }
  95 | }
  96 | 
  97 | function toInsert(dataset: (typeof datasets)[number]) {
  98 |   return dataset.rows.map((row) => ({
  99 |     metric: dataset.metric,
 100 |     gender: dataset.gender,
 101 |     day: row.Day,
 102 |     l: row.L,
 103 |     m: row.M,
 104 |     s: row.S,
 105 |     sd4neg: row.SD4neg,
 106 |     sd3neg: row.SD3neg,
 107 |     sd2neg: row.SD2neg,
 108 |     sd1neg: row.SD1neg,
 109 |     sd0: row.SD0,
 110 |     sd1: row.SD1,
 111 |     sd2: row.SD2,
 112 |     sd3: row.SD3,
 113 |     sd4: row.SD4,
 114 |   }));
 115 | }
 116 | 
 117 | export async function seedWhoGrowthStandards() {
 118 |   for (const dataset of datasets) assertValidDataset(dataset);
 119 | 
 120 |   await db.delete(growthStandards);
 121 |   for (const dataset of datasets) {
 122 |     const rows = toInsert(dataset);
 123 |     for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 100) {
 124 |       await db.insert(growthStandards).values(rows.slice(index, index + 100));
 125 |     }
 126 |     console.log(`Seeded WHO ${dataset.metric}/${dataset.gender}: ${rows.length} rows`);
 127 |   }
 128 | }
 129 | 
 130 | const entryPath = process.argv[1];
 131 | if (entryPath && resolve(entryPath) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
 132 |   seedWhoGrowthStandards()
 133 |     .catch((error: unknown) => {
 134 |       console.error("Failed to seed WHO growth standards:", error);
 135 |       process.exitCode = 1;
 136 |     })
 137 |     .finally(() => {
 138 |       void closeDb();
 139 |     });
 140 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/db/seed.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Run with:  npx tsx src/db/seed.ts
   4 | // (or "tsx src/db/seed" / "bun src/db/seed" if tsx isn't installed: npm i -D tsx)
   5 | //
   6 | // Idempotent: safe to re-run. LMS rows use onConflictDoNothing on the composite PK.
   7 | // Patient/visit/measurement data uses deterministic IDs so re-runs won't duplicate.
   8 | 
   9 | import { sql as drizzleSql } from "drizzle-orm";
  10 | 
  11 | import { closeDb, db } from "@/db";
  12 | import { DEVELOPMENTAL_MILESTONES } from "@/features/development/types";
  13 | // TODO: Run `pnpm exec tsx scripts/parse-lms.ts` to generate the full seed file
  14 | import { type Indicator, LMS_SEED, LMS_VERSION, type Sex } from "@/features/growth/types/lms-seed";
  15 | 
  16 | import * as schema from "../schema";
  17 | import { CLINIC_HURGHADA_ID } from "./seed-config";
  18 | import { seedFormulary } from "./seed-formulary";
  19 | import { seedWhoGrowthStandards } from "./seed-who";
  20 | 
  21 | const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_FILE_NAME ?? "./clinic.sqlite";
  22 | const SQLITE_PARAM_LIMIT_CHUNK = 100;
  23 | 
  24 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  25 | // Deterministic helpers
  26 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  27 | 
  28 | /** Deterministic UUID-ish ID derived from a seed string (stable across runs). */
  29 | function stableId(seed: string): string {
  30 |   let h1 = 0xdeadbeef ^ seed.length;
  31 |   let h2 = 0x41c6ce57 ^ seed.length;
  32 |   for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) {
  33 |     const ch = seed.charCodeAt(i);
  34 |     h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch, 2654435761);
  35 |     h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ ch, 1597334677);
  36 |   }
  37 |   h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ (h1 >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(h2 ^ (h2 >>> 13), 3266489909);
  38 |   h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (h2 >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(h1 ^ (h1 >>> 13), 3266489909);
  39 |   let h3 = Math.imul(h1 ^ 0x9e3779b9, 2654435761);
  40 |   let h4 = Math.imul(h2 ^ 0x85ebca6b, 1597334677);
  41 |   h3 = Math.imul(h3 ^ (h3 >>> 16), 2246822507);
  42 |   h4 = Math.imul(h4 ^ (h4 >>> 16), 2246822507);
  43 |   const hi = (h2 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  44 |   const lo = (h1 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  45 |   const hi2 = (h4 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  46 |   const lo2 = (h3 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  47 |   const raw = (hi + lo + hi2 + lo2).split("");
  48 |   raw[12] = "4";
  49 |   raw[16] = ((Number.parseInt(raw[16], 16) & 0x3) | 0x8).toString(16);
  50 |   const s = raw.join("");
  51 |   return `${s.slice(0, 8)}-${s.slice(8, 12)}-${s.slice(12, 16)}-${s.slice(16, 20)}-${s.slice(20, 32)}`;
  52 | }
  53 | 
  54 | /** Chunk an array into groups of `size`. */
  55 | function chunk<T>(arr: readonly T[], size: number): T[][] {
  56 |   const out: T[][] = [];
  57 |   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) out.push(arr.slice(i, i + size));
  58 |   return out;
  59 | }
  60 | 
  61 | /**
  62 |  * Insert in chunks, sequentially. better-sqlite3 is sync under the hood, so
  63 |  * parallel inserts gain nothing and lose error attribution. Chunking exists
  64 |  * only to stay under SQLite's 999-parameter limit.
  65 |  */
  66 | async function insertInChunks<T>(
  67 |   rows: readonly T[],
  68 |   insert: (part: T[]) => Promise<unknown>,
  69 |   size = SQLITE_PARAM_LIMIT_CHUNK,
  70 | ): Promise<void> {
  71 |   for (const part of chunk(rows, size)) {
  72 |     // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
  73 |     await insert(part);
  74 |   }
  75 | }
  76 | 
  77 | /** Small deterministic PRNG so re-runs produce identical patient data. */
  78 | function mulberry32(seed: number) {
  79 |   let a = seed >>> 0;
  80 |   return () => {
  81 |     a |= 0;
  82 |     a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  83 |     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
  84 |     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
  85 |     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  86 |   };
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | const rand = mulberry32(20210501);
  90 | const pick = <T>(arr: readonly T[]): T => arr[Math.floor(rand() * arr.length)];
  91 | const randBetween = (min: number, max: number) => min + rand() * (max - min);
  92 | const round = (n: number, d = 2) => Math.round(n * 10 ** d) / 10 ** d;
  93 | 
  94 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  95 | // Date helpers
  96 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97 | 
  98 | /** ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD. */
  99 | function isoDate(y: number, m: number, d: number): string {
 100 |   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
 101 |   return dt.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 102 | }
 103 | 
 104 | /** Add months to a YYYY-MM-DD date, preserving day-of-month (clamped). */
 105 | function addMonths(iso: string, months: number): string {
 106 |   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
 107 |   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1 + months, d));
 108 |   return dt.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 109 | }
 110 | 
 111 | /** Age in fractional months between DOB and visit date. */
 112 | function ageMonths(dob: string, visitedAt: string): number {
 113 |   const [dy, dm, dd] = dob.split("-").map(Number);
 114 |   const [vy, vm, vd] = visitedAt.slice(0, 10).split("-").map(Number);
 115 |   const dobD = Date.UTC(dy, dm - 1, dd);
 116 |   const visD = Date.UTC(vy, vm - 1, vd);
 117 |   const days = (visD - dobD) / 86_400_000;
 118 |   return round(days / 30.4375, 2);
 119 | }
 120 | 
 121 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 122 | // Stats helpers
 123 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 124 | 
 125 | /** Normal CDF (Abramowitz & Stegun 7.1.26). */
 126 | function normalCdf(z: number): number {
 127 |   const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(z));
 128 |   const d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp((-z * z) / 2);
 129 |   let p = d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
 130 |   if (z > 0) p = 1 - p;
 131 |   return p;
 132 | }
 133 | 
 134 | /** Clamp a gaussian-ish draw to ±3. */
 135 | function clampGaussian(z: number): number {
 136 |   if (z > 3) return 3;
 137 |   if (z < -3) return -3;
 138 |   return z;
 139 | }
 140 | 
 141 | /** Compute an approximate z-score from LMS for a given value (for display). */
 142 | function zFromLms(value: number, l: number, m: number, s: number): number {
 143 |   if (Math.abs(l) < 1e-9) return Math.log(value / m) / s;
 144 |   return ((value / m) ** l - 1) / (l * s);
 145 | }
 146 | 
 147 | function classify(
 148 |   indicator: Indicator | "head-circumference-for-age",
 149 |   z: number | null,
 150 | ): string | null {
 151 |   if (z === null) return null;
 152 |   if (indicator === "weight-for-age") {
 153 |     if (z < -3) return "Severely underweight";
 154 |     if (z < -2) return "Underweight";
 155 |     if (z > 3) return "Severely overweight";
 156 |     if (z > 2) return "Overweight";
 157 |     return "Normal weight";
 158 |   }
 159 |   if (indicator === "length-for-age") {
 160 |     if (z < -3) return "Severely stunted";
 161 |     if (z < -2) return "Stunted";
 162 |     if (z > 2) return "Tall";
 163 |     return "Normal length";
 164 |   }
 165 |   if (indicator === "bmi-for-age") {
 166 |     if (z < -3) return "Severely wasted";
 167 |     if (z < -2) return "Wasted";
 168 |     if (z > 3) return "Severely obese";
 169 |     if (z > 2) return "Obese";
 170 |     if (z > 1) return "Overweight risk";
 171 |     return "Normal BMI";
 172 |   }
 173 |   return null;
 174 | }

 513 | 
 514 | interface PatientSpec {
 515 |   seedKey: string;
 516 |   firstName: string;
 517 |   lastName: string;
 518 |   sex: Sex;
 519 |   dob: string;
 520 |   clinicId: string;
 521 | }
 522 | 
 523 | /** Pinned so DOB (and thus stableId) never drifts across calendar years. */
 524 | const REFERENCE_YEAR = 2025;
 525 | 
 526 | function buildPatientSpecs(n: number): PatientSpec[] {
 527 |   const specs: PatientSpec[] = [];
 528 |   for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 529 |     const isMale = rand() > 0.5;
 530 |     const first = isMale ? pick(EGYPTIAN_FIRST_M) : pick(EGYPTIAN_FIRST_F);
 531 |     const last = pick(EGYPTIAN_LAST);
 532 |     const clinic = pick(CLINICS).id;
 533 | 
 534 |     const yearsAgo = Math.floor(randBetween(0, 5));
 535 |     const month = 1 + Math.floor(randBetween(0, 12));
 536 |     const day = 1 + Math.floor(randBetween(0, 28));
 537 |     const dob = isoDate(REFERENCE_YEAR - yearsAgo, month, day);
 538 | 
 539 |     specs.push({
 540 |       seedKey: `patient:${i}:${first}:${last}:${dob}`,
 541 |       firstName: first,
 542 |       lastName: last,
 543 |       sex: isMale ? "male" : "female",
 544 |       dob,
 545 |       clinicId: clinic,
 546 |     });
 547 |   }
 548 |   return specs;
 549 | }
 550 | 
 551 | function referenceValue(
 552 |   indicator: Indicator | "head-circumference-for-age",
 553 |   sex: Sex,
 554 |   ageMo: number,
 555 | ): number {
 556 |   if (indicator === "head-circumference-for-age") {
 557 |     const base = sex === "male" ? 34.5 : 33.9;
 558 |     return round(base + Math.min(ageMo, 24) * 0.35 + randBetween(-0.6, 0.6), 1);
 559 |   }
 560 | 
 561 |   const rows = LMS_SEED.filter(
 562 |     (r) => r.indicator === indicator && r.sex === sex && r.xAxis === "age",
 563 |   );
 564 |   if (!rows.length) return round(randBetween(3, 10), 2);
 565 | 
 566 |   let best = rows[0];
 567 |   let bestD = Math.abs(best.xValue - ageMo);
 568 |   for (const r of rows) {
 569 |     const d = Math.abs(r.xValue - ageMo);
 570 |     if (d < bestD) {
 571 |       best = r;
 572 |       bestD = d;
 573 |     }
 574 |   }
 575 | 
 576 |   const { l: L, m, s } = best;
 577 |   const z = clampGaussian(randBetween(-2, 2));
 578 |   const value = Math.abs(L) < 1e-9 ? m * Math.exp(s * z) : m * (1 + L * s * z) ** (1 / L);
 579 |   return round(value, 2);
 580 | }
 581 | 
 582 | async function seedPatients() {
 583 |   console.log("\n🧒 Seeding patients, visits, measurements…");
 584 | 
 585 |   const specs = buildPatientSpecs(60);
 586 | 
 587 |   const patientRows = specs.map((s) => ({
 588 |     id: stableId(s.seedKey),
 589 |     clinicId: s.clinicId,
 590 |     mrn: `MRN-${s.seedKey.split(":")[1].padStart(5, "0")}`,
 591 |     firstName: s.firstName,
 592 |     lastName: s.lastName,
 593 |     sex: s.sex,
 594 |     dateOfBirth: s.dob,
 595 |     parentName: `${pick(EGYPTIAN_FIRST_F)} ${s.lastName}`,
 596 |     parentPhone: `+20 10${String(100_000_000 + Math.floor(rand() * 899_999_999)).slice(0, 9)}`,
 597 |     address: `${pick(["Nasr City", "Maadi", "Smouha", "Dokki", "Hurghada"] as const)}, Egypt`,
 598 |   }));
 599 | 
 600 |   await insertInChunks(patientRows, (part) =>
 601 |     db
 602 |       .insert(schema.patients)
 603 |       .values(part)
 604 |       .onConflictDoUpdate({
 605 |         target: schema.patients.id,
 606 |         set: { clinicId: drizzleSql`excluded.clinic_id` },
 607 |       }),
 608 |   );
 609 |   console.log(`   ✔ ${patientRows.length} patients ensured`);
 610 | 
 611 |   const visitInserts: (() => Promise<unknown>)[] = [];
 612 |   const measurementInserts: (() => Promise<unknown>)[] = [];
 613 | 
 614 |   for (const p of patientRows) {
 615 |     const nVisits = 2 + Math.floor(rand() * 4);
 616 |     const maxAgeMonths = Math.floor(ageMonths(p.dateOfBirth, new Date().toISOString()));
 617 | 
 618 |     for (let v = 0; v < nVisits; v++) {
 619 |       const visitAgeMonths = Math.floor(((v + 1) * maxAgeMonths) / (nVisits + 1));
 620 |       const visitedAt = addMonths(p.dateOfBirth, visitAgeMonths);
 621 |       const ageMo = ageMonths(p.dateOfBirth, visitedAt);
 622 |       const visitId = stableId(`visit:${p.id}:${visitedAt}`);
 623 | 
 624 |       visitInserts.push(() =>
 625 |         db
 626 |           .insert(schema.visits)
 627 |           .values({
 628 |             id: visitId,
 629 |             patientId: p.id,
 630 |             clinicId: p.clinicId,
 631 |             visitedAt: new Date(visitedAt),
 632 |             ageMonths: ageMo,
 633 |             ageYears: Math.floor(ageMo / 12),
 634 |             ageMonthsRemainder: Math.floor(ageMo % 12),
 635 |           })
 636 |           .onConflictDoUpdate({
 637 |             target: schema.visits.id,
 638 |             set: { clinicId: drizzleSql`excluded.clinic_id` },
 639 |           }),
 640 |       );
 641 | 
 642 |       const chosen: Array<Indicator | "head-circumference-for-age"> = [
 643 |         "weight-for-age",
 644 |         "length-for-age",
 645 |       ];
 646 |       if (ageMo >= 24) chosen.push("bmi-for-age");
 647 |       if (ageMo < 24) chosen.push("head-circumference-for-age");
 648 | 
 649 |       for (const indicator of chosen) {
 650 |         const value = referenceValue(indicator, p.sex, ageMo);
 651 | 
 652 |         let lmsL: number | null = null;
 653 |         let lmsM: number | null = null;
 654 |         let lmsS: number | null = null;
 655 |         let zScore: number | null = null;
 656 | 
 657 |         if (indicator !== "head-circumference-for-age") {
 658 |           const rows = LMS_SEED.filter(
 659 |             (r) => r.indicator === indicator && r.sex === p.sex && r.xAxis === "age",
 660 |           );
 661 |           if (rows.length) {
 662 |             let best = rows[0];
 663 |             let bestD = Math.abs(best.xValue - ageMo);
 664 |             for (const r of rows) {
 665 |               const d = Math.abs(r.xValue - ageMo);
 666 |               if (d < bestD) {
 667 |                 best = r;
 668 |                 bestD = d;
 669 |               }
 670 |             }
 671 |             lmsL = best.l;
 672 |             lmsM = best.m;
 673 |             lmsS = best.s;
 674 |             try {
 675 |               zScore = round(zFromLms(value, best.l, best.m, best.s), 2);
 676 |             } catch {
 677 |               zScore = null;
 678 |             }
 679 |           }
 680 |         }
 681 | 
 682 |         const percentile = zScore === null ? null : round(normalCdf(zScore) * 100, 1);
 683 |         const classification = classify(indicator, zScore);
 684 |         const measId = stableId(`meas:${visitId}:${indicator}`);
 685 | 
 686 |         measurementInserts.push(() =>
 687 |           db
 688 |             .insert(schema.measurements)
 689 |             .values([
 690 |               {
 691 |                 id: measId,
 692 |                 visitId,
 693 |                 patientId: p.id,
 694 |                 measuredAt: new Date(visitedAt),
 695 |                 indicator,
 696 |                 value,
 697 |                 zScore,
 698 |                 percentile,
 699 |                 classification,
 700 |                 lmsL,
 701 |                 lmsM,
 702 |                 lmsS,
 703 |               },
 704 |             ])
 705 |             .onConflictDoNothing(),
 706 |         );
 707 |       }
 708 |     }
 709 |   }
 710 | 
 711 |   await Promise.all(visitInserts.map((run) => run()));
 712 |   await Promise.all(measurementInserts.map((run) => run()));
 713 | 
 714 |   console.log(`   ✔ ${visitInserts.length} visits ensured`);
 715 |   console.log(`   ✔ ${measurementInserts.length} measurements ensured`);
 716 | }
```

`db/test-worker.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/db/test-worker.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Bun entry point for integration tests (`bun test:worker`).
   4 | //
   5 | // Not a Cloudflare Worker: this project runs on Bun + TanStack Start, so
   6 | // "worker" here means a minimal HTTP server that boots the server-side
   7 | // stack (env → Drizzle → Better Auth → query cache) and exposes a health
   8 | // endpoint. If any layer fails to import or initialize, `/health` returns
   9 | // 500 with the failing layer, so integration tests fail with a useful
  10 | // message instead of a mysterious 404 from the app.
  11 | //
  12 | // Why this file exists:
  13 | //   - Fallow treats it as an entry point, which is how `src/db/index.ts`,
  14 | //     `src/db/schema.ts`, and `src/lib/auth.ts` become reachable without
  15 | //     marking every route as an entry.
  16 | //   - `bun test:worker` runs against a real Bun server, so Drizzle's
  17 | //     `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` and Better Auth's handler are exercised
  18 | //     exactly as they are in production.
  19 | 
  20 | import {checkIsDbReady, closeDb} from "#/db/index.ts";
  21 | import {queryCache} from "#/db/cache.ts";
  22 | import {env} from "#/env.ts";
  23 | import {auth} from "#/lib/auth.ts";
  24 | 
  25 | const PORT = Number(env.PORT ?? 0); // 0 = OS-assigned, printed below
  26 | 
  27 | type Layer = "env" | "db" | "auth" | "cache";
  28 | 
  29 | const layerStatus: Record<Layer, "ok" | "fail" | "unchecked"> = {
  30 |   env: "ok", // reaching this line means env parsed
  31 |   db: "unchecked",
  32 |   auth: "unchecked",
  33 |   cache: "unchecked",
  34 | };
  35 | 
  36 | // Declare the server without an initializer so `fetch` can reference it
  37 | // (via `server.port`) without creating a circular inference. Assign with a
  38 | // `let` + explicit type.
  39 | let server: ReturnType<typeof Bun.serve>;
  40 | let boundPort = 0;
  41 | 
  42 | server = Bun.serve({
  43 |   port: PORT,
  44 |   fetch: async (request: Request): Promise<Response> => {
  45 |     const url = new URL(request.url);
  46 | 
  47 |     if (url.pathname === "/health") {
  48 |       // Probe each layer independently so one failure doesn't mask another.
  49 |       layerStatus.db = (await checkIsDbReady()) ? "ok" : "fail";
  50 | 
  51 |       layerStatus.auth =
  52 |         typeof auth?.api?.getSession === "function" ? "ok" : "fail";
  53 | 
  54 |       layerStatus.cache =
  55 |         typeof queryCache?.get === "function" &&
  56 |         typeof queryCache?.set === "function"
  57 |           ? "ok"
  58 |           : "fail";
  59 | 
  60 |       const failed = (Object.entries(layerStatus) as [Layer, string][]).filter(
  61 |         ([, v]) => v === "fail",
  62 |       );
  63 | 
  64 |       const body: {
  65 |         ok: boolean;
  66 |         layers: Record<Layer, "ok" | "fail" | "unchecked">;
  67 |         failed: Layer[];
  68 |         pid: number;
  69 |         port: number;
  70 |       } = {
  71 |         ok: failed.length === 0,
  72 |         layers: layerStatus,
  73 |         failed: failed.map(([k]) => k as Layer),
  74 |         pid: process.pid,
  75 |         port: boundPort,
  76 |       };
  77 | 
  78 |       return Response.json(body, { status: body.ok ? 200 : 500 });
  79 |     }
  80 | 
  81 |     // Better Auth mounts its handler under /api/auth/*. Forwarding here
  82 |     // proves the handler is wired the same way the app wires it, without
  83 |     // pulling in TanStack Start's router.
  84 |     if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/auth/")) {
  85 |       return auth.handler(request);
  86 |     }
  87 | 
  88 |     return new Response(null, { status: 404 });
  89 |   },
  90 | });
  91 | 
  92 | boundPort = server.port??0;
  93 | console.log(`[test-worker] listening on http://localhost:${boundPort}`);
  94 | 
  95 | // Graceful shutdown so `bun test:worker` cleans up the SQLite handle.
  96 | const shutdown = async (): Promise<void> => {
  97 |   await closeDb();
  98 |   server.stop();
  99 |   process.exit(0);
 100 | };
 101 | process.on("SIGINT", shutdown);
 102 | process.on("SIGTERM", shutdown);
```

```tsx
 123 | function PatientSearch({ clinicId, onSelect, onClear }: PatientSearchProps) {
 124 |   const [q, setQ] = React.useState("");
 125 |   const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);

 131 |       if (!wrapperRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
 132 |     };
 133 |     document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handler);
 134 |     return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handler);
 135 |   }, [open]);
 136 | 
 137 |   const searchQuery = useQuery(searchPatientsQuery(clinicId, q));

 139 |   const showDropdown = open && q.trim().length >= 2;

 142 |     onSelect(patient);
 143 |     setQ(`${patient.firstName} ${patient.lastName}`);
 144 |     setOpen(false);
 145 |   };
 146 | 
 147 |   const clear = () => {
 148 |     setQ("");
 149 |     onClear?.();
 150 |   };

 153 |     <div className="relative" ref={wrapperRef}>
 154 |       <div className="relative">
 155 |         <SearchIcon className="absolute top-1/2 left-0 size-3.5 -translate-y-1/2" />
 156 |         <Input

 158 |           aria-haspopup="listbox"
 159 |           aria-label="Search patient"
 160 |           onChange={(e) => {
 161 |             setQ(e.target.value);
 162 |             setOpen(true);
 163 |           }}
 164 |           onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
 165 |           placeholder="Search patient by name or MRN…"
 166 |           value={q}
 167 |         />
 168 |         {q && (
 169 |           <button
 170 |             aria-label="Clear patient"
 171 |             className="hover:text-foreground absolute top-1/2 right-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1"
 172 |             onClick={clear}
 173 |             type="button"
 174 |           >
 175 |             <XIcon className="size-3.5" />
 176 |           </button>
 177 |         )}
 178 |       </div>
 179 | 
 180 |       {showDropdown && (
 181 |         <div
 182 |           className="bg-popover ring-foreground/10 absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-lg ring-1"
 183 |           role="listbox"
 184 |         >
 185 |           {searchQuery.isPending ? (
 186 |             <div className="px-3 py-2 text-sm">Searching…</div>
 187 |           ) : searchQuery.isError ? (
 188 |             <div className="text-destructive px-3 py-2 text-sm">
 189 |               {searchQuery.error instanceof Error ? searchQuery.error.message : "Search failed."}
 190 |             </div>
 191 |           ) : results.length === 0 ? (

 197 |                 key={p.id}
 198 |                 onClick={() => pick(p)}
 199 |                 role="option"
 200 |                 type="button"
 201 |               >
 202 |                 <Avatar size="sm">

 206 |                   </AvatarFallback>

 211 |                   </span>
 212 |                 <span className="font-mono text-xs">

 214 | </span>

 220 |                 </div>

 230 | // ── Duration stepper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 231 | 
 232 | const DURATION_STEPS = [10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90] as const;
 233 | 
 234 | function DurationStepper({ value, onChange }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void }) {
 235 |   const currentIdx = DURATION_STEPS.indexOf(value as (typeof DURATION_STEPS)[number]);
 236 | const dec = () => {
 237 |   if (currentIdx > 0) {
 238 |     onChange(DURATION_STEPS[currentIdx - 1]);
 239 |   } else if (currentIdx === -1) {
 240 |     const lower = [...DURATION_STEPS].reverse().find((s) => s < value);
 241 |     onChange(lower ?? DURATION_STEPS[0]);
 242 |   }
 243 | };
 244 | const inc = () => {
 245 |   if (currentIdx >= 0 && currentIdx < DURATION_STEPS.length - 1) {
 246 |     onChange(DURATION_STEPS[currentIdx + 1]);
 247 |   } else if (currentIdx === -1) {
 248 |     onChange(DURATION_STEPS.find((s) => s > value) ?? DURATION_STEPS[DURATION_STEPS.length - 1]);
 249 |   }
 250 | };
 251 | 
 252 |   return (
 253 |     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 254 |       <button
 255 |         aria-label="Decrease duration"
 256 |         className="border-border hover:bg-muted flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border text-sm transition-colors disabled:opacity-30"
 257 |         disabled={currentIdx <= 0}
 258 |         onClick={dec}
 259 |         type="button"
 260 |       >
 261 |         −
 262 |       </button>
 263 |       <span className="min-w-[4.5rem] text-center font-mono text-sm tabular-nums">{value} min</span>
 264 |       <button
 265 |         aria-label="Increase duration"
 266 |         className="border-border hover:bg-muted flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border text-sm transition-colors disabled:opacity-30"
 267 |         disabled={currentIdx >= DURATION_STEPS.length - 1}
 268 |         onClick={inc}
 269 |         type="button"
 270 |       >
 271 |         +
 272 |       </button>
 273 |     </div>
 274 |   );
 275 | }
```
