```tsx
 277 | // ── Sheet ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 278 | 
 279 | export function AppointmentSheet({
 280 |   open,
 281 |   onOpenChange,
 282 |   appointmentId,
 283 |   defaultPatientId,
 284 |   defaultScheduledAt,
 285 |   clinicId,
 286 |   onSaved,
 287 |   onClosed,
 288 | }: AppointmentSheetProps) {
 289 |   const isEdit = Boolean(appointmentId);
 290 | 
 291 |   const existingQuery = useQuery({
 292 |     ...appointmentByIdQuery(appointmentId ?? ""),
 293 |     enabled: isEdit && open,
 294 |   });
 295 |   const existing = existingQuery.data;
 296 | 
 297 |   const createMutation = useCreateAppointmentMutation();
 298 |   const updateMutation = useUpdateAppointmentMutation();
 299 | 
 300 |   const [localSelectedPatientId, setLocalSelectedPatientId] = React.useState(
 301 |     defaultPatientId ?? "",
 302 |   );
 303 |   const selectedPatientId = existing?.patientId ?? localSelectedPatientId;
 304 | 
 305 |   const scheduledAtDefault = React.useMemo(
 306 |     () =>
 307 |       defaultScheduledAt
 308 |         ? toLocalDateTimeString(defaultScheduledAt)
 309 |         : roundToNextSlot(30),
 310 |     [defaultScheduledAt],
 311 |   );
 312 | 
 313 |   const form = useForm({
 314 |     defaultValues: {
 315 |       patientId: defaultPatientId ?? "",
 316 |       scheduledAt: scheduledAtDefault,
 317 |       durationMinutes: 15,
 318 |       reason: "",
 319 |       notes: "",
 320 |     },
 321 |     validators: {
 322 |       onSubmitAsync: async ({ value }) => {
 323 |         try {
 324 |           if (isEdit && appointmentId) {
 325 |             await updateMutation.mutateAsync({
 326 |               data: {
 327 |                 appointmentId,
 328 |                 patch: {
 329 |                   scheduledAt: new Date(value.scheduledAt),
 330 |                   durationMinutes: value.durationMinutes,
 331 |                   reason: value.reason || null,
 332 |                   notes: value.notes || null,
 333 |                 },
 334 |               },
 335 |             });
 336 |             toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Appointment updated" });
 337 |           } else {
 338 |             if (!value.patientId) return { form: "Select a patient first" };
 339 |             if (!value.scheduledAt) return { form: "Choose a date and time" };
 340 |             await createMutation.mutateAsync({
 341 |               data: {
 342 |                 patientId: value.patientId,
 343 |                 clinicId,
 344 |                 scheduledAt: new Date(value.scheduledAt),
 345 |                 durationMinutes: value.durationMinutes,
 346 |                 status: "scheduled",
 347 |                 reason: value.reason || null,
 348 |                 notes: value.notes || null,
 349 |               },
 350 |             });
 351 |             toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Appointment scheduled" });
 352 |           }
 353 |           onSaved?.();
 354 |           onOpenChange(false);
 355 |           return undefined;
 356 |         } catch (err) {
 357 |           const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Something went wrong";
 358 |           toast.add({ type: "error", description: message });
 359 |           return { form: message };
 360 |         }
 361 |       },
 362 |     },
 363 |   });
 364 | 
 365 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 366 |     if (!open || isEdit) return;
 367 |     form.setFieldValue("scheduledAt", scheduledAtDefault);
 368 |   }, [form, isEdit, open, scheduledAtDefault]);
 369 | 
 370 |   // Sync loaded appointment into form (once per id).
 371 |   const lastSyncedIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
 372 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 373 |     if (!existing) return;
 374 |     if (lastSyncedIdRef.current === existing.id) return;
 375 |     lastSyncedIdRef.current = existing.id;
 376 |     form.setFieldValue("patientId", existing.patientId);
 377 |     form.setFieldValue("scheduledAt", toLocalDateTimeString(new Date(existing.scheduledAt)));
 378 |     form.setFieldValue("durationMinutes", existing.durationMinutes);
 379 |     form.setFieldValue("reason", existing.reason ?? "");
 380 |     form.setFieldValue("notes", existing.notes ?? "");
 381 |   }, [existing, form]);
 382 | 
 383 |   const findNextSlot = () => {
 384 |     form.setFieldValue("scheduledAt", roundToNextSlot(60));
 385 |   };
 386 | 
 387 |   const handleOpenChange = (next: boolean) => {
 388 |     if (!next) {
 389 |       // Reset to a clean slate so a reopened sheet doesn't show stale data.
 390 |       form.reset();
 391 |       lastSyncedIdRef.current = null;
 392 |       setLocalSelectedPatientId(defaultPatientId ?? "");
 393 |     }
 394 |     onOpenChange(next);
 395 |     if (!next) onClosed?.();
 396 |   };
 397 | 
 398 |   return (
 399 |     <Sheet onOpenChange={handleOpenChange} open={open}>
 400 |       <SheetContent className="flex w-full flex-col sm:max-w-lg" side="right">
 401 |         <SheetHeader className="mx-6 my-4 flex-row items-center justify-between">
 402 |           <SheetTitle>{isEdit ? "Edit Appointment" : "New Appointment"}</SheetTitle>
 403 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 404 |             {isEdit && existing && <AppointmentStatusBadge status={existing.status} />}
 405 |             <SheetClose render={<Button size="icon-sm" variant="ghost" />}>
 406 |               <XIcon className="size-4" />
 407 |               <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
 408 |             </SheetClose>
 409 |           </div>
 410 |         </SheetHeader>
 411 | 
 412 |      {isEdit && (existingQuery.isPending || !existing) ? (
 413 |   <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center">
 414 |     <Spinner />
 415 |   </div>
 416 | ) : (
 417 |           <ScrollArea className="flex-1">
 418 |             <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 p-6">
 419 |               <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
 420 |                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 421 |                   <UserIcon className="size-3.5" />
 422 |                   <span className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">Patient</span>
 423 |                 </div>
 424 | 
 425 |                 {!isEdit && !defaultPatientId ? (
 426 |                   <PatientSearch
 427 |                     clinicId={clinicId}
 428 |                     onClear={() => {
 429 |                       setLocalSelectedPatientId("");
 430 |                       form.setFieldValue("patientId", "");
 431 |                     }}
 432 |                     onSelect={(p) => {
 433 |                       setLocalSelectedPatientId(p.id);
 434 |                       form.setFieldValue("patientId", p.id);
 435 |                     }}
 436 |                   />
 437 |                 ) : null}
 438 | 
 439 |                 {selectedPatientId ? <PatientPreview patientId={selectedPatientId} /> : null}
 440 |               </div>
 441 | 
 442 |               <Separator />
 443 | 
 444 |               <form
 445 |                 className="flex flex-col gap-5"
 446 |                 noValidate
 447 |                 onSubmit={(e) => {
 448 |                   e.preventDefault();
 449 |                   void form.handleSubmit();
 450 |                 }}
 451 |               >
 452 |                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 453 |                   <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 454 |                     <CalendarIcon className="size-3.5" />
 455 |                     <span className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">Schedule</span>
 456 |                   </div>
 457 |                   <button
 458 |                     className="text-primary flex items-center gap-1 text-xs hover:underline"
 459 |                     onClick={findNextSlot}
 460 |                     type="button"
 461 |                   >
 462 |                     <SparklesIcon className="size-3" />
 463 |                     Find next open slot
 464 |                   </button>
 465 |                 </div>
 466 | 
 467 |                 <form.Field name="scheduledAt">
 468 |                   {(field) => (
 469 |                     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
 470 |                       <Label htmlFor={field.name}>
 471 |                         <ClockIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mr-1.5 inline size-3" />
 472 |                         Date &amp; Time
 473 |                       </Label>
 474 |                       <input
 475 |                         aria-invalid={field.state.meta.errors.length > 0}
 476 |                         className="border-b-input focus-visible:border-b-ring h-10 w-full border border-transparent bg-transparent px-0 py-1 font-mono text-sm [color-scheme:light_dark] transition-[color,border-color] outline-none"
 477 |                         id={field.name}
 478 |                         onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 479 |                         required
 480 |                         type="datetime-local"
 481 |                         value={field.state.value}
 482 |                       />
 483 |                     </div>
 484 |                   )}
 485 |                 </form.Field>
 486 | 
 487 |                 <form.Field name="durationMinutes">
 488 |                   {(field) => (
 489 |                     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
 490 |                       <Label>Duration</Label>
 491 |                       <DurationStepper
 492 |                         onChange={(v) => field.handleChange(v)}
 493 |                         value={field.state.value}
 494 |                       />
 495 |                     </div>
 496 |                   )}
 497 |                 </form.Field>
 498 | 
 499 |                 <Separator />
 500 | 
 501 |                 <form.Field name="reason">
 502 |                   {(field) => (
 503 |                     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
 504 |                       <Label htmlFor={field.name}>
 505 |                         Reason <span className="font-normal normal-case">(optional)</span>
 506 |                       </Label>
 507 |                       <Input
 508 |                         id={field.name}
 509 |                         maxLength={1000}
 510 |                         onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 511 |                         placeholder="e.g. Well-child check, fever…"
 512 |                         value={field.state.value}
 513 |                       />
 514 |                     </div>
 515 |                   )}
 516 |                 </form.Field>
 517 | 
 518 |                 <form.Field name="notes">
 519 |                   {(field) => (
 520 |                     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
 521 |                       <Label htmlFor={field.name}>
 522 |                         Notes <span className="font-normal normal-case">(optional)</span>
 523 |                       </Label>
 524 |                       <Textarea
 525 |                         id={field.name}
 526 |                         maxLength={5000}
 527 |                         onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 528 |                         placeholder="Any special instructions or context…"
 529 |                         rows={3}
 530 |                         value={field.state.value}
 531 |                       />
 532 |                     </div>
 533 |                   )}
 534 |                 </form.Field>
 535 | 
 536 |                 <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.errorMap.onSubmit}>
 537 |                   {(err) => {
 538 |                     const message = formErrorMessage(err);
 539 |                     return message ? (
 540 |                       <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 541 |                         {message}
 542 |                       </p>
 543 |                     ) : null;
 544 |                   }}
 545 |                 </form.Subscribe>
 546 | 
 547 |                 <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
 548 |                   <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.isSubmitting}>
 549 |                     {(isSubmitting) => (
 550 |                       <Button className="flex-1" disabled={isSubmitting} type="submit">
 551 |                         {isSubmitting ? (
 552 |                           <Spinner className="size-3.5" />
 553 |                         ) : isEdit ? (
 554 |                           <SaveIcon className="size-3.5" />
 555 |                         ) : (
 556 |                           <PlusIcon className="size-3.5" />
 557 |                         )}
 558 |                         {isEdit ? "Save changes" : "Schedule"}
 559 |                       </Button>
 560 |                     )}
 561 |                   </form.Subscribe>
 562 |                   <Button onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)} type="button" variant="outline">
 563 |                     Cancel
 564 |                   </Button>
 565 |                 </div>
 566 |               </form>
 567 |             </div>
 568 |           </ScrollArea>
 569 |         )}
 570 |       </SheetContent>
 571 |     </Sheet>
 572 |   );
 573 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import {useQuery} from "@tanstack/react-query";
   2 | import { type AnyRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";

   5 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   6 | import { DataTable } from "@/components/tables/data-table";

   8 | // ── read ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   9 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
  10 | 
  11 | import { todayAppointmentsQuery } from "../queries";
  12 | import { type AppointmentRow } from "../types";
  13 | import { appointmentColumns, appointmentTableFeatures } from "./columns";
  14 | 
  15 | const EMPTY_APPOINTMENTS: AppointmentRow[] = [];
  16 | 
  17 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  18 | 
  19 | export interface AppointmentsTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute = AnyRoute> {
  20 |   route?: TRoute;
  21 |   /**
  22 |    * The clinic whose today-queue to show. Required when the caller
  23 |    * doesn't supply `appointments` — the previous `"clinic-main"`
  24 |    * placeholder wasn't a valid UUID and would have produced an empty
  25 |    * query with no visible error.
  26 |    */
  27 |   clinicId?: string;
  28 |   page?: number;
  29 |   size?: PageSize;
  30 |   appointments?: AppointmentRow[];
  31 | }
  32 | 
  33 | export function AppointmentsTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
  34 |   route,
  35 |   clinicId,
  36 |   page = 1,
  37 |   size = 20,
  38 |   appointments: initialAppointments,
  39 | }: AppointmentsTableProps<TRoute>) {
  40 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  41 | 
  42 |   const query = useQuery({
  43 |     ...todayAppointmentsQuery(clinicId ?? ""),
  44 |     enabled: Boolean(clinicId) && !initialAppointments,
  45 |   });
  46 | 
  47 |   const allAppointments = initialAppointments ?? query.data ?? EMPTY_APPOINTMENTS;
  48 | 
  49 |   const table = useTable({
  50 |     data: allAppointments,
  51 |     columns: appointmentColumns,
  52 |     features: appointmentTableFeatures,
  53 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
  54 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
  55 |   });
  56 | 
  57 |   const pageCount = table.getPageCount();
  58 |   const backToFirstPage = () => {
  59 |     if (!route) {
  60 |       void navigate({ to: "/app/appointments", search: {} as never });
  61 |       return;
  62 |     }
  63 |    void navigate({
  64 |   to: route.fullPath,
  65 |   search: ((prev: Record<string, unknown>) => ({ ...prev, page: undefined })) as never,
  66 | });
  67 |   };
  68 | 
  69 |   if (!clinicId && !initialAppointments) {
  70 |     return (
  71 |       <div className="border-border rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 text-center">
  72 |         <p className="text-sm font-medium">No clinic selected</p>
  73 |         <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
  74 |           Pick a clinic to view today's appointments.
  75 |         </p>
  76 |       </div>
  77 |     );
  78 |   }
  79 | 
  80 |   return (
  81 |     <DataTable
  82 |       ariaLabel="Appointments"
  83 |       emptyMessage="No appointments scheduled for today."
  84 |       errorDescription={
  85 |         query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
  86 |       }
  87 |       errorTitle="Failed to Load Appointments"
  88 |       outOfRange={
  89 |         query.data
  90 |           ? {
  91 |               backTo: () => (
  92 |                 <Button className={cn("w-full sm:w-auto")} nativeButton onClick={backToFirstPage}>
  93 |                   Back To First Page
  94 |                 </Button>
  95 |               ),
  96 |             }
  97 |           : undefined
  98 |       }
  99 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
 100 |       query={query}
 101 |       skeletonRowCount={size}
 102 |       table={table}
 103 |     />
 104 |   );
 105 | }
```

```tsx
  39 | 
  40 | function MiniMonth({ anchor, onSelect, onNavigate }: MiniMonthProps) {
  41 |   const base = startOfMonth(anchor);

  52 |   ];
  53 |   while (cells.length % 7 !== 0) cells.push(null);
  54 | 
  55 |   const goToMonth = (delta: number) => {

  57 |     if (onNavigate) onNavigate(next);
  58 |     else onSelect(next);
  59 |   };

  62 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">

  71 |         </Button>
  72 |         <span aria-live="polite" className="text-xs font-semibold">
  73 |           {formatMonth(base)}
  74 |         </span>
  75 |         <Button aria-label="Next month" onClick={() => goToMonth(1)} size="icon-xs" variant="ghost">

  77 |         </Button>
  78 |       </div>
  79 | 
  80 |       <div aria-hidden="true" className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-px">
  81 |         {["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"].map((d, i) => (
  82 |           <span className="text-center text-[0.55rem] font-semibold uppercase" key={i}>
  83 |             {d}
  84 |           </span>
  85 |         ))}
  86 |       </div>
  87 | 
  88 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-px">
  89 |         {cells.map((day, i) =>
  90 |           day === null ? (

  92 |           ) : (

 101 |                 isSameDay(day, anchor) && "bg-primary text-primary-foreground",

 165 | const MAX_SLOTS = 12;

 167 | function WeekView({ weekStart, byDay, isLoading, onEdit, onNewAt }: WeekViewProps) {

 217 |                 />
 218 |               </div>
 219 |             </div>
 220 |           </div>
 221 |         );
 222 |       })}

 224 |       {days.map((day) => {

 272 | // ── Month view ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 273 | 
 274 | interface MonthViewProps {
 275 |   monthStart: Date;
 276 |   byDay: Map<string, AppointmentInRange[]>;
 277 |   isLoading: boolean;
 278 |   onEdit: (id: string) => void;
 279 |   onNewAt: (d: Date) => void;
 280 | }
 281 | 
 282 | const MAX_VISIBLE = 3;
 283 | 
 284 | function MonthView({ monthStart, byDay, isLoading, onEdit, onNewAt }: MonthViewProps) {
 285 |   const today = React.useMemo(() => startOfDay(new Date()), []);
 286 |   const year = monthStart.getFullYear();
 287 |   const month = monthStart.getMonth();
 288 |   const firstDayOfWeek = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
 289 |   const offset = firstDayOfWeek === 0 ? 6 : firstDayOfWeek - 1;
 290 |   const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
 291 | 
 292 |   const cells: (Date | null)[] = React.useMemo(() => {
 293 |     const arr: (Date | null)[] = [
 294 |       ...Array.from({ length: offset }, () => null),
 295 |       ...Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => new Date(year, month, i + 1)),
 296 |     ];
 297 |     while (arr.length % 7 !== 0) arr.push(null);
 298 |     return arr;
 299 |   }, [year, month, offset, daysInMonth]);
 300 | 
 301 |   const weekdayHeaders = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"];
 302 | 
 303 |   return (
 304 |     <div aria-label="Month calendar" className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-px" role="group">
 305 |       {weekdayHeaders.map((h) => (
 306 |         <div
 307 |           className="pb-2 text-center text-[0.65rem] font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase"
 308 |           key={h}
 309 |           role="presentation"
 310 |         >
 311 |           {h}
 312 |         </div>
 313 |       ))}
 314 | 
 315 |       {cells.map((day, i) => {
 316 |         if (day === null) {
 317 |           return (
 318 |             <div
 319 |               aria-hidden="true"
 320 |               className="bg-muted/20 min-h-[6rem] rounded-xl"
 321 |               key={`empty-${i}`}
 322 |             />
 323 |           );
 324 |         }
 325 | 
 326 |         const dayAppts = byDay.get(toDateKey(day)) ?? [];
 327 |         const visible = dayAppts.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE);
 328 |         const overflow = dayAppts.length - MAX_VISIBLE;
 329 |         const isToday = isSameDay(day, today);
 330 |         const isWeekend = day.getDay() === 0 || day.getDay() === 6;
 331 | 
 332 |         return (
 333 |           <div
 334 |             aria-label={`${formatDayHeading(day)} — ${dayAppts.length} appointment${dayAppts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}
 335 |             className={cn(
 336 |               "group min-h-[6rem] rounded-xl p-2",
 337 |               isToday ? "bg-primary/[0.04]" : "bg-muted/20",
 338 |               isWeekend && "bg-muted/40",
 339 |             )}
 340 |             key={day.toISOString()}
 341 |             role="group"
 342 |           >
 343 |             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 344 |               <span
 345 |                 className={cn(
 346 |                   "flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-semibold",
 347 |                   isToday && "bg-primary text-primary-foreground",
 348 |                 )}
 349 |               >
 350 |                 {day.getDate()}
 351 |               </span>
 352 |               <button
 353 |                 aria-label={`Add appointment on ${formatDayHeading(day)}`}
 354 |                 className={cn(
 355 |                   "bg-muted/40 hover:bg-muted/60",
 356 |                   "focus-visible:ring-ring rounded-sm opacity-0 transition-opacity",
 357 |                   "group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none",
 358 |                 )}
 359 |                 onClick={() => onNewAt(day)}
 360 |                 type="button"
 361 |               >
 362 |                 <PlusIcon className="size-3" />
 363 |               </button>
 364 |             </div>
 365 | 
 366 |             {isLoading ? (
 367 |               <Skeleton className="mt-1 h-4 w-full" />
 368 |             ) : (
 369 |               <div className="mt-1 flex flex-col gap-0.5">
 370 |                 {visible.map((appt) => (
 371 |                   <AppointmentPill appt={appt} compact key={appt.id} onEdit={onEdit} />
 372 |                 ))}
 373 |                 {overflow > 0 && (
 374 |                 <button
 375 |   aria-label={`Show all ${dayAppts.length} appointments on ${formatDayHeading(day)}`}
 376 |   className="hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-ring rounded-sm text-[0.6rem] hover:underline focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none"
 377 |   onClick={() => onEdit(dayAppts[0]?.id ?? "")}
 378 |   type="button"
 379 | >
 380 |   +{overflow} more
 381 | </button>
 382 |                 )}
 383 |               </div>
 384 |             )}
 385 |           </div>
 386 |         );
 387 |       })}
 388 |     </div>
 389 |   );
 390 | }

 392 | // ── Main CalendarView ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 393 | 
 394 | interface CalendarViewProps {
 395 |   clinicId: string;
 396 |   onEdit: (appointmentId: string) => void;
 397 |   onNew: (date?: Date) => void;
 398 | }
 399 | 
 400 | export function CalendarView({ clinicId, onEdit, onNew }: CalendarViewProps) {
 401 |   const [view, setView] = React.useState<ViewMode>("week");
 402 |   const [anchor, setAnchor] = React.useState<Date>(() => startOfDay(new Date()));
 403 | 
 404 |   const rangeStart = React.useMemo(
 405 |     () => (view === "week" ? startOfWeek(anchor) : startOfMonth(anchor)),
 406 |     [view, anchor],
 407 |   );
 408 | 
 409 |   const rangeEnd = React.useMemo(() => {
 410 |     if (view === "week") return addDays(rangeStart, 7);
 411 |     return new Date(rangeStart.getFullYear(), rangeStart.getMonth() + 1, 1);
 412 |   }, [view, rangeStart]);
 413 | 
 414 |   const query = useQuery(
 415 |     appointmentsInRangeQuery(clinicId, rangeStart.toISOString(), rangeEnd.toISOString()),
 416 |   );
 417 | 
 418 |   const appointments = React.useMemo(() => query.data ?? [], [query.data]);
 419 |   const byDay = React.useMemo(() => {
 420 |     return new Map(Object.entries(groupByDay(appointments)));
 421 |   }, [appointments]);
 422 | 
 423 |   const goTo = React.useCallback(
 424 |     (direction: -1 | 1) => {
 425 |       setAnchor((a) => {
 426 |         if (view === "week") return addDays(a, direction * 7);
 427 |         return new Date(a.getFullYear(), a.getMonth() + direction, 1);
 428 |       });
 429 |     },
 430 |     [view],
 431 |   );
 432 | 
 433 |   const goToday = React.useCallback(() => setAnchor(startOfDay(new Date())), []);
 434 | 
 435 |   const goToRef = React.useRef(goTo);
 436 |   const goTodayRef = React.useRef(goToday);
 437 |   const onNewRef = React.useRef(onNew);
 438 | 
 439 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 440 |     goToRef.current = goTo;
 441 |     goTodayRef.current = goToday;
 442 |     onNewRef.current = onNew;
 443 |   }, [goTo, goToday, onNew]);
 444 | 
 445 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 446 |     function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
 447 |       if (isEditableTarget(document.activeElement)) return;
 448 |       if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
 449 | 
 450 |       if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
 451 |         e.preventDefault();
 452 |         goToRef.current(-1);
 453 |       } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") {
 454 |         e.preventDefault();
 455 |         goToRef.current(1);
 456 |       } else if (e.key === "t") {
 457 |         e.preventDefault();
 458 |         goTodayRef.current();
 459 |       } else if (e.key === "n") {
 460 |         e.preventDefault();
 461 |         onNewRef.current();
 462 |       }
 463 |     }
 464 |     document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
 465 |     return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
 466 |   }, []);
 467 | 
 468 |   const rangeLabel =
 469 |     view === "week" ? formatWeekRange(rangeStart, addDays(rangeStart, 6)) : formatMonth(rangeStart);
 470 | 
 471 |   return (
 472 |     <div className="flex gap-6">
 473 |       <aside className="hidden w-44 shrink-0 flex-col gap-6 lg:flex">
 474 |         <MiniMonth anchor={anchor} onSelect={(d) => setAnchor(d)} />
 475 |         <Button className="w-full" onClick={goToday} size="sm" variant="outline">
 476 |           Today
 477 |         </Button>
 478 |         <Button className="w-full" onClick={() => onNew()} size="sm">
 479 |           <PlusIcon className="size-3" />
 480 |           New appointment
 481 |         </Button>
 482 |       </aside>
 483 | 
 484 |       <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-4">
 485 |         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
 486 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 487 |             <Button aria-label="Previous" onClick={() => goTo(-1)} size="icon-sm" variant="outline">
 488 |               <ChevronLeftIcon className="size-4" />
 489 |             </Button>
 490 |             <Button aria-label="Next" onClick={() => goTo(1)} size="icon-sm" variant="outline">
 491 |               <ChevronRightIcon className="size-4" />
 492 |             </Button>
 493 |             <span aria-live="polite" className="text-sm font-semibold">
 494 |               {rangeLabel}
 495 |             </span>
 496 |             <Button onClick={goToday} size="xs" variant="ghost">
 497 |               Today
 498 |             </Button>
 499 |           </div>
 500 | 
 501 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 502 |             <div
 503 |               aria-label="View mode"
 504 |               className="bg-muted flex items-center rounded-lg p-1 text-xs font-medium"
 505 |               role="group"
 506 |             >
 507 |               {(["week", "month"] as const).map((v) => (
 508 |                 <button
 509 |                   aria-pressed={view === v}
 510 |                   className={cn(
 511 |                     "focus-visible:ring-ring rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium capitalize transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none",
 512 |                     view === v
 513 |                       ? "bg-background text-foreground shadow-sm"
 514 |                       : "hover:text-foreground",
 515 |                   )}
 516 |                   key={v}
 517 |                   onClick={() => setView(v)}
 518 |                   type="button"
 519 |                 >
 520 |                   {v}
 521 |                 </button>
 522 |               ))}
 523 |             </div>
 524 | 
 525 |             <Button onClick={() => onNew()} size="sm">
 526 |               <PlusIcon className="size-3" />
 527 |               New
 528 |             </Button>
 529 |           </div>
 530 |         </div>
 531 | 
 532 |         <ScrollArea>
 533 |           {query.isPending && appointments.length === 0 ? (
 534 |             <div className="flex justify-center py-16">
 535 |               <Spinner />
 536 |             </div>
 537 |           ) : query.isError ? (
 538 |             <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-12 text-center" role="alert">
 539 |               <p className="text-destructive text-sm font-medium">Could not load appointments</p>
 540 |               <Button onClick={() => void query.refetch()} size="sm" variant="outline">
 541 |                 Retry
 542 |               </Button>
 543 |             </div>
 544 |           ) : view === "week" ? (
 545 |             <WeekView
 546 |               byDay={byDay}
 547 |               isLoading={query.isFetching}
 548 |               onEdit={onEdit}
 549 |               onNewAt={onNew}
 550 |               weekStart={rangeStart}
 551 |             />
 552 |           ) : (
 553 |             <MonthView
 554 |               byDay={byDay}
 555 |               isLoading={query.isFetching}
 556 |               monthStart={rangeStart}
 557 |               onEdit={onEdit}
 558 |               onNewAt={onNew}
 559 |             />
 560 |           )}
 561 |         </ScrollArea>
 562 |       </div>
 563 |     </div>
 564 |   );
 565 | }
```

```tsx
 191 | // ── Mutation wiring ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 193 | function useQueueActions(): QueueActions {
 194 |   const completeMutation = useCompleteAppointmentMutation();
 195 |   const noShowMutation = useMarkNoShowMutation();
 196 |   const cancelMutation = useCancelAppointmentMutation();
 197 | 
 198 |   const onError = (err: unknown) =>
 199 |     toast.add({
 200 |       type: "error",
 201 |       description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Update failed",
 202 |     });
 203 | 
 204 |   return {
 205 |     complete: {
 206 |       mutate: (id) => {
 207 |         completeMutation.mutate(
 208 |           { data: { appointmentId: id } },
 209 |           {
 210 |             onSuccess: () => toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Marked as completed" }),
 211 |             onError,
 212 |           },
 213 |         );
 214 |       },
 215 |       isPending: completeMutation.isPending,
 216 |     },
 217 |     noShow: {
 218 |       mutate: (id) => {
 219 |         noShowMutation.mutate(
 220 |           { data: { appointmentId: id } },
 221 |           {
 222 |             onSuccess: () => toast.add({ type: "warning", description: "Marked as no-show" }),
 223 |             onError,
 224 |           },
 225 |         );
 226 |       },
 227 |       isPending: noShowMutation.isPending,
 228 |     },
 229 |     cancel: {
 230 |       mutate: (id) => {
 231 |         cancelMutation.mutate(
 232 |           { data: { appointmentId: id } },
 233 |           {
 234 |             onSuccess: () => toast.add({ type: "info", description: "Appointment cancelled" }),
 235 |             onError,
 236 |           },
 237 |         );
 238 |       },
 239 |       isPending: cancelMutation.isPending,
 240 |     },
 241 |   };
 242 | }
 243 | 
 244 | // ── Summary strip ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 245 | 
 246 | const SUMMARY_ORDER = ["scheduled", "completed", "no-show", "cancelled"] as const;
 247 | 
 248 | function QueueSummary({ counts }: { counts: Record<AppointmentStatus, number> }) {
 249 |   const visible = SUMMARY_ORDER.filter((s) => counts[s] > 0);
 250 |   if (visible.length === 0) return null;
 251 | 
 252 |   return (
 253 |    <output
 254 |   aria-label="Appointment counts by status"
 255 |   aria-live="polite"
 256 |   className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5"
 257 | >
 258 |   {(["scheduled", "completed", "no-show", "cancelled"] as const).map((s) => {
 259 |     if (counts[s] === 0) return null;
 260 |     const cfg = STATUS_CONFIG[s];
 261 |     return (
 262 |       <span
 263 |         key={s}
 264 |         className={cn(
 265 |           "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-xss font-medium",
 266 |           cfg.pillClass,
 267 |         )}
 268 |       >
 269 |         <span className={cn("inline-block size-1.5 rounded-full", cfg.dotClass)} />
 270 |         {counts[s]} {cfg.label.toLowerCase()}
 271 |       </span>
 272 |     );
 273 |   })}
 274 | </output>
 275 |   );
 276 | }
 277 | 
 278 | // ── Keyboard navigation hook ───────────────────────────────────────────
 279 | 
 280 | function useQueueKeyboard(
 281 |   ids: string[],
 282 |   setActiveId: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>,
 283 |   onNew: () => void,
 284 | ) {
 285 |   const idsRef = React.useRef(ids);
 286 |   const onNewRef = React.useRef(onNew);
 287 | 
 288 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 289 |     idsRef.current = ids;
 290 |   }, [ids]);
 291 | 
 292 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 293 |     onNewRef.current = onNew;
 294 |   }, [onNew]);
 295 | 
 296 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 297 |     function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
 298 |       if (isEditableTarget(document.activeElement)) return;
 299 |       if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
 300 | 
 301 |       const current = idsRef.current;
 302 |       if (current.length === 0 && e.key !== "n") return;
 303 | 
 304 |       if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "ArrowDown") {
 305 |         e.preventDefault();
 306 |         setActiveId((prev) => {
 307 |           const i = prev ? current.indexOf(prev) : -1;
 308 |           const next = Math.min(i + 1, current.length - 1);
 309 |           return current[next] ?? null;
 310 |         });
 311 |       } else if (e.key === "k" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
 312 |         e.preventDefault();
 313 |         setActiveId((prev) => {
 314 |           const i = prev ? current.indexOf(prev) : 0;
 315 |           const next = Math.max(i - 1, 0);
 316 |           return current[next] ?? null;
 317 |         });
 318 |       } else if (e.key === "n") {
 319 |         e.preventDefault();
 320 |         onNewRef.current();
 321 |       } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
 322 |         setActiveId(null);
 323 |       }
 324 |     }
 325 |     document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
 326 |     return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
 327 |   }, [setActiveId]);
 328 | }
 329 | 
 330 | // ── Main component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 331 | 
 332 | interface TodayQueueProps {
 333 |   clinicId: string;
 334 |   onEdit: (appointmentId: string) => void;
 335 |   onNew: () => void;
 336 | }
 337 | 
 338 | export function TodayQueue({ clinicId, onEdit, onNew }: TodayQueueProps) {
 339 |   const [activeId, setActiveId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
 340 |   const rowsRef = React.useRef(new Map<string, HTMLDivElement>());
 341 | 
 342 |   const query = useQuery({
 343 |     ...todayAppointmentsQuery(clinicId),
 344 |     refetchInterval: 60_000,
 345 |   });
 346 | 
 347 |   const appointments = React.useMemo(() => query.data ?? [], [query.data]);
 348 |   const appointmentsData = query.data;
 349 |   const actions = useQueueActions();
 350 | 
 351 |   const activeIdx = React.useMemo(() => {
 352 |     if (!activeId) return -1;
 353 |     return appointments.findIndex((a) => a.id === activeId);
 354 |   }, [activeId, appointments]);
 355 | 
 356 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 357 |     if (!activeId) return;
 358 |     rowsRef.current.get(activeId)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
 359 |   }, [activeId]);
 360 | 
 361 |   useQueueKeyboard(
 362 |     appointments.map((a) => a.id),
 363 |     setActiveId,
 364 |     onNew,
 365 |   );
 366 | 
 367 |   const counts = React.useMemo(() => {
 368 |     const c: Record<AppointmentStatus, number> = {
 369 |       scheduled: 0,
 370 |       "in-progress": 0,
 371 |       completed: 0,
 372 |       cancelled: 0,
 373 |       "no-show": 0,
 374 |     };
 375 |     for (const a of appointmentsData ?? []) {
 376 |       c[normalizeStatus(a.status)]++;
 377 |     }
 378 |     return c;
 379 |   }, [appointmentsData]);
 380 | 
 381 |   const setRowRef = React.useCallback(
 382 |     (id: string) => (el: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
 383 |       if (el) rowsRef.current.set(id, el);
 384 |       else rowsRef.current.delete(id);
 385 |     },
 386 |     [],
 387 |   );
 388 | 
 389 |   return (
 390 |     <div className="flex flex-col">
 391 |       {/* Header */}
 392 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3">
 393 |         <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
 394 |           <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">Today&rsquo;s Queue</h2>
 395 |           <p className="text-xs">{formatDayHeading(new Date())}</p>
 396 |         </div>
 397 |         <Button onClick={onNew} size="xs" title="New appointment (N)" variant="outline">
 398 |           New
 399 |         </Button>
 400 |       </div>
 401 | 
 402 |       <QueueSummary counts={counts} />
 403 | 
 404 |       {/* Body */}
 405 |       {query.isPending ? (
 406 |         <div className="flex justify-center py-8">
 407 |           <Spinner />
 408 |         </div>
 409 |       ) : query.isError ? (
 410 |         <SectionState
 411 |           action={
 412 |             <Button onClick={() => void query.refetch()} size="sm" variant="outline">
 413 |               Retry
 414 |             </Button>
 415 |           }
 416 |           description={
 417 |             query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
 418 |           }
 419 |           icon={CalendarClockIcon}
 420 |           title="Could not load queue"
 421 |         />
 422 |       ) : appointments.length === 0 ? (
 423 |         <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-12 text-center">
 424 |           <div className="bg-muted rounded-full p-3">
 425 |             <CalendarClockIcon className="size-6" />
 426 |           </div>
 427 |           <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
 428 |             <p className="text-sm font-medium">No appointments today</p>
 429 |             <p className="text-xs">The schedule is clear. Block a slot to get started.</p>
 430 |           </div>
 431 |           <Button onClick={onNew} size="sm" variant="outline">
 432 |             Block a slot
 433 |           </Button>
 434 |         </div>
 435 |       ) : (
 436 |         <div aria-label="Today's appointment queue" className="flex flex-col gap-1" role="list">
 437 |           {appointments.map((appt, idx) => (
 438 |             <QueueItem
 439 |               actions={actions}
 440 |               appt={appt}
 441 |               isActive={idx === activeIdx}
 442 |               key={appt.id}
 443 |               onEdit={onEdit}
 444 |               onFocus={() => setActiveId(appt.id)}
 445 |               rowRef={setRowRef(appt.id)}
 446 |             />
 447 |           ))}
 448 |         </div>
 449 |       )}
 450 | 
 451 |       {/* Keyboard hint */}
 452 |       {appointments.length > 0 && (
 453 |         <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[0.65rem]">
 454 |           <kbd className="bg-muted rounded py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.6rem]">j</kbd>
 455 |           {" / "}
 456 |           <kbd className="bg-muted rounded py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.6rem]">k</kbd> navigate
 457 |           &middot; <kbd className="bg-muted rounded py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.6rem]">n</kbd> new
 458 |         </p>
 459 |       )}
 460 |     </div>
 461 |   );
 462 | }
```

```tsx
  11 | const MAX_DOTS = 8;
  12 | 
  13 | // ── Day cell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  14 | 
  15 | function DayCell({
  16 |   date,
  17 |   count,
  18 |   isToday,
  19 |   selected,
  20 |   onSelect,
  21 | }: {
  22 |   date: Date;
  23 |   count: number;

  25 |   selected: boolean;
  26 |   onSelect: (d: Date) => void;
  27 | }) {
  28 |   const dots = Math.min(count, MAX_DOTS);
  29 |   const overflow = count > MAX_DOTS ? count - MAX_DOTS : 0;
  30 |   const pct = Math.min(count / 12, 1);
  31 |   const isWeekend = date.getDay() === 0 || date.getDay() === 6;
  32 | 
  33 |   return (
  34 |     <button
  35 |       aria-label={`${formatDayHeading(date)}, ${count} appointment${count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
  36 |       aria-pressed={selected}
  37 |       className={cn(
  38 |         "flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl  py-2.5 transition-colors",
  39 |         isWeekend && "bg-muted/40",
  40 |         selected && "bg-primary/10 ring-primary/20 ring-1",
  41 |         !selected && !isWeekend && "hover:bg-muted/40",
  42 |         isToday && !selected && "ring-primary/30 ring-1",
  43 |       )}
  44 |       onClick={() => onSelect(date)}
  45 |       type="button"

  48 |         className={cn(

  55 | 
  56 |       <span

  58 |           "flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums",
  59 |           isToday
  60 |             ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
  61 |             : selected
  62 |               ? "text-primary"
  63 |               : "text-foreground",
  64 |         )}
  65 |       >
  66 |         {date.getDate()}
  67 |       </span>
  68 | 
  69 |       <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-[2px]">
  70 |         {Array.from({ length: dots }, (_, i) => (
  71 |           <span className="bg-primary/60 size-[4px] rounded-full" key={i} />
  72 |         ))}
  73 |         {overflow > 0 && <span className=" text-[0.5rem]">+{overflow}</span>}
  74 |       </div>

  96 | 
  97 | export function WeekStrip({ clinicId, selectedDate, onSelectDate }: WeekStripProps) {
  98 |   const today = startOfDay(new Date());
  99 | 
 100 |   // Week starting Monday
 101 |   const weekStart = React.useMemo(() => {
 102 |     const d = startOfDay(new Date());
 103 |     const day = d.getDay();
 104 |     const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday
 105 |     d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
 106 |     return d;
 107 |   }, []);
 108 | 
 109 |   const weekEnd = addDays(weekStart, 7);
 110 | 
 111 |   // ── read via factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 112 |   const rangeQuery = useQuery(
 113 |     appointmentsInRangeQuery(clinicId, weekStart.toISOString(), weekEnd.toISOString()),
 114 |   );
 115 | 
 116 |   const countByDay = React.useMemo(() => {
 117 |     const map: Record<string, number> = {};
 118 |     for (const appt of rangeQuery.data ?? []) {
 119 |       const d = new Date(appt.scheduledAt);
 120 | const key = toDateKey(d);
 121 |       map[key] = (map[key] ?? 0) + 1;
 122 |     }
 123 |     return map;
 124 |   }, [rangeQuery.data]);
 125 | 
 126 |   const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekStart, i));
 127 | 
 128 | const selKey = selectedDate ? toDateKey(selectedDate) : null;
 129 |   return (
 130 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
 131 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 132 |         <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">This Week</h2>
 133 |         <span className=" text-xs">
 134 |           {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
 135 |             month: "short",
 136 |             day: "numeric",
 137 |           }).format(weekStart)}
 138 |           {" – "}
 139 |           {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
 140 |             month: "short",
 141 |             day: "numeric",
 142 |           }).format(addDays(weekStart, 6))}
 143 |         </span>
 144 |       </div>
 145 |       <div className="flex gap-0.5">
 146 |         {days.map((day) => (
 147 |           <DayCell
 148 |             count={countByDay[toDateKey(day)] ?? 0}
 149 | date={day}
 150 | isToday={toDateKey(day) === toDateKey(today)}
 151 | key={toDateKey(day)}
 152 | onSelect={(d) => onSelectDate?.(d)}
 153 | selected={selKey === toDateKey(day)}
 154 |           />
 155 |         ))}
 156 |       </div>
 157 |     </div>
 158 |   );
 159 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import type {z} from "zod";
   2 | import type {QueryClient} from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | // src/features/appointments/queries.ts
   4 | import {queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient} from "@tanstack/react-query";
   5 | import {useServerFn} from "@tanstack/react-start";
   6 | 
   7 | import type {appointmentStatusSchema} from "./schema";
   8 | 
   9 | import {
  10 |     cancelAppointmentFn,
  11 |     completeAppointmentFn,
  12 |     createAppointmentFn,
  13 |     deleteAppointmentFn,
  14 |     fetchAppointmentById,
  15 |     fetchAppointmentStatusCounts,
  16 |     fetchAppointments,
  17 |     fetchAppointmentsForPatient,
  18 |     fetchAppointmentsInRange,
  19 |     fetchPatientAppointmentCount,
  20 |     fetchTodayAppointments,
  21 |     fetchUpcomingForDoctor,
  22 |     markAppointmentNoShowFn,
  23 |     updateAppointmentFn,
  24 | } from "./functions";
  25 | 
  26 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  27 | // Constants
  28 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  29 | 
  30 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  31 |   DETAIL: 30_000,
  32 |   TODAY: 30_000,
  33 |   PATIENT: 60_000,
  34 |   RANGE: 30_000,
  35 |   UPCOMING: 60_000,
  36 |   STATS: 120_000,
  37 | } as const;
  38 | 
  39 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  40 | // Query key factory
  41 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  42 | 
  43 | export const appointmentKeys = {
  44 |   all: () => ["appointments"] as const,
  45 | 
  46 |   clinic: (clinicId: string) => ["appointments", "clinic", clinicId] as const,
  47 | 
  48 |   detail: (appointmentId: string) => ["appointments", "detail", appointmentId] as const,
  49 | 
  50 |   byPatient: (patientId: string, status?: string) =>
  51 |     ["appointments", "patient", patientId, status ?? "all"] as const,
  52 | 
  53 |   today: (clinicId: string) => ["appointments", "clinic", clinicId, "today"] as const,
  54 | 
  55 |   byClinic: (clinicId: string) => ["appointments", "clinic", clinicId, "list"] as const,
  56 | 
  57 |   byRange: (clinicId: string, from: string, to: string, doctorId?: string) =>
  58 |     ["appointments", "clinic", clinicId, "range", from, to, doctorId ?? "all"] as const,
  59 | 
  60 |   upcomingForDoctor: (doctorId: string, limit: number) =>
  61 |     ["appointments", "doctor", doctorId, "upcoming", limit] as const,
  62 | 
  63 |   statusCounts: (clinicId: string, from: string, to: string) =>
  64 |     ["appointments", "clinic", clinicId, "counts", from, to] as const,
  65 | 
  66 |   patientCount: (patientId: string) => ["appointments", "patient", patientId, "count"] as const,
  67 | } as const;
  68 | 
  69 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  70 | // Query options
  71 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  72 | 
  73 | export function appointmentByIdQuery(appointmentId: string) {
  74 |   return queryOptions({
  75 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.detail(appointmentId),
  76 |     queryFn: () => fetchAppointmentById({ data: { appointmentId } }),
  77 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
  78 |   });
  79 | }
  80 | 
  81 | export function appointmentsForPatientQuery(
  82 |   patientId: string,
  83 |   status?: z.infer<typeof appointmentStatusSchema>,
  84 | ) {
  85 |   return queryOptions({
  86 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.byPatient(patientId, status),
  87 |     queryFn: () => fetchAppointmentsForPatient({ data: { patientId, status } }),
  88 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.PATIENT,
  89 |   });
  90 | }
  91 | 
  92 | export function todayAppointmentsQuery(clinicId: string) {
  93 |   return queryOptions({
  94 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.today(clinicId),
  95 |     queryFn: () => fetchTodayAppointments({ data: { clinicId } }),
  96 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.TODAY,
  97 |   });
  98 | }
  99 | 
 100 | export function appointmentsForClinicQuery(clinicId: string) {
 101 |   return queryOptions({
 102 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.byClinic(clinicId),
 103 |     queryFn: () => fetchAppointments({ data: { clinicId } }),
 104 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.TODAY,
 105 |   });
 106 | }
 107 | 
 108 | export function appointmentsInRangeQuery(
 109 |   clinicId: string,
 110 |   from: string,
 111 |   to: string,
 112 |   doctorId?: string,
 113 | ) {
 114 |   return queryOptions({
 115 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.byRange(clinicId, from, to, doctorId),
 116 |     queryFn: () =>
 117 |       fetchAppointmentsInRange({
 118 |         data: { clinicId, from, to, doctorId },
 119 |       }),
 120 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.RANGE,
 121 |   });
 122 | }
 123 | 
 124 | export function upcomingForDoctorQuery(doctorId: string, limit = 50) {
 125 |   return queryOptions({
 126 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.upcomingForDoctor(doctorId, limit),
 127 |     queryFn: () => fetchUpcomingForDoctor({ data: { doctorId, limit } }),
 128 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.UPCOMING,
 129 |   });
 130 | }
 131 | 
 132 | export function appointmentStatusCountsQuery(clinicId: string, from: string, to: string) {
 133 |   return queryOptions({
 134 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.statusCounts(clinicId, from, to),
 135 |     queryFn: () => fetchAppointmentStatusCounts({ data: { clinicId, from, to } }),
 136 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.STATS,
 137 |   });
 138 | }
 139 | 
 140 | export function patientAppointmentCountQuery(patientId: string) {
 141 |   return queryOptions({
 142 |     queryKey: appointmentKeys.patientCount(patientId),
 143 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientAppointmentCount({ data: { patientId } }),
 144 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.STATS,
 145 |   });
 146 | }
 147 | 
 148 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 149 | // Invalidation helper
 150 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 151 | //
 152 | // Every mutation hook below calls this. The set of caches touched by an
 153 | // appointment write is the same for create, update, and every status
 154 | // transition, so centralising the list here prevents the four hooks from
 155 | // drifting apart.
 156 | 
 157 | interface AppointmentWriteResult {
 158 |   id: string;
 159 |   clinicId: string;
 160 |   patientId: string;
 161 | }
 162 | function invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(
 163 |   queryClient: QueryClient,
 164 |   row: AppointmentWriteResult,
 165 | ): Promise<unknown> {
 166 |   return Promise.all([
 167 |     // Every cached view of the clinic's appointments: today, list, all
 168 |     // date ranges, status counts.
 169 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 170 |       queryKey: appointmentKeys.clinic(row.clinicId),
 171 |     }),
 172 |     // The appointment's own detail entry.
 173 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 174 |       queryKey: appointmentKeys.detail(row.id),
 175 |     }),
 176 |     // The patient's appointment history (used by the patient detail
 177 |     // page and by the safety rail in the prescription composer).
 178 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 179 |       queryKey: ["appointments", "patient", row.patientId],
 180 |     }),
 181 |     // The patient's total appointment count.
 182 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 183 |       queryKey: appointmentKeys.patientCount(row.patientId),
 184 |     }),
 185 |   ]);
 186 | }
 187 | 
 188 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 189 | // Mutation hooks
 190 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 191 | 
 192 | /**
 193 |  * Create a new appointment.
 194 |  *
 195 |  * Invalidates the clinic's appointment caches (today, list, all ranges,
 196 |  * counts) and the patient's appointment history. Returns the created row
 197 |  * so callers can navigate to `/app/appointments/$appointmentId` or use
 198 |  * `row.id` in a callback.
 199 |  */
 200 | export function useCreateAppointmentMutation() {
 201 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 202 |   const createAppointment = useServerFn(createAppointmentFn);
 203 | 
 204 |   return useMutation({
 205 |     mutationFn: createAppointment,
 206 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 207 |       if (!row) return;
 208 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
 209 |     },
 210 |   });
 211 | }
 212 | 
 213 | /**
 214 |  * Update an existing appointment (time, duration, reason, notes, doctor).
 215 |  *
 216 |  * Same invalidation set as create — the update could change the
 217 |  * appointment's slot on any date, so every clinic range cache must refresh.
 218 |  */
 219 | export function useUpdateAppointmentMutation() {
 220 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 221 |   const updateAppointment = useServerFn(updateAppointmentFn);
 222 | 
 223 |   return useMutation({
 224 |     mutationFn: updateAppointment,
 225 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 226 |       if (!row) return;
 227 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
 228 |     },
 229 |   });
 230 | }
 231 | 
 232 | /**
 233 |  * Mark an appointment as completed.
 234 |  *
 235 |  * The status field changed, so both the row itself and the clinic's
 236 |  * status-count aggregates need to refresh.
 237 |  */
 238 | export function useCompleteAppointmentMutation() {
 239 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 240 |   const completeAppointment = useServerFn(completeAppointmentFn);
 241 | 
 242 |   return useMutation({
 243 |     mutationFn: completeAppointment,
 244 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 245 |       if (!row) return;
 246 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
 247 |     },
 248 |   });
 249 | }
 250 | 
 251 | /**
 252 |  * Cancel an appointment.
 253 |  *
 254 |  * Same invalidation set as complete — only the status value differs.
 255 |  */
 256 | export function useCancelAppointmentMutation() {
 257 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 258 |   const cancelAppointment = useServerFn(cancelAppointmentFn);
 259 | 
 260 |   return useMutation({
 261 |     mutationFn: cancelAppointment,
 262 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 263 |       if (!row) return;
 264 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
 265 |     },
 266 |   });
 267 | }
 268 | 
 269 | /**
 270 |  * Mark an appointment as no-show.
 271 |  */
 272 | export function useMarkNoShowMutation() {
 273 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 274 |   const markNoShow = useServerFn(markAppointmentNoShowFn);
 275 | 
 276 |   return useMutation({
 277 |     mutationFn: markNoShow,
 278 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 279 |       if (!row) return;
 280 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
 281 |     },
 282 |   });
 283 | }
 284 | export function useDeleteAppointmentMutation() {
 285 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 286 |   const deleteAppointment = useServerFn(deleteAppointmentFn);
 287 | 
 288 |   return useMutation({
 289 |     mutationFn: deleteAppointment,
 290 |     onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
 291 |       const { appointmentId } = variables.data;
 292 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 293 |         queryKey: appointmentKeys.detail(appointmentId),
 294 |       });
 295 |       // Refresh every appointments list so the deleted row disappears
 296 |       // from the queue and calendar immediately.
 297 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 298 |         queryKey: appointmentKeys.all(),
 299 |       });
 300 |     },
 301 |   });
 302 | }
```

```ts
  67 | export function ageLabel(dateOfBirth: string | null | undefined): string {
  68 |   if (!dateOfBirth) return "—";
  69 |   const birth = new Date(dateOfBirth);
  70 |   if (Number.isNaN(birth.getTime())) return "—";
  71 |   const today = new Date();
  72 |   let years = today.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear();
  73 |   const hadBirthday =
  74 |     today.getMonth() > birth.getMonth() ||
  75 |     (today.getMonth() === birth.getMonth() && today.getDate() >= birth.getDate());
  76 |   if (!hadBirthday) years -= 1;
  77 |   if (years > 0) return `${years}y`;
  78 |   const months =
  79 |     (today.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear()) * 12 +
  80 |     (today.getMonth() - birth.getMonth()) -
  81 |     (today.getDate() < birth.getDate() ? 1 : 0);
  82 |   if (months > 0) return `${months}mo`;
  83 |   const days = Math.max(0, Math.floor((today.getTime() - birth.getTime()) / 86400000));
  84 |   return `${days}d`;
  85 | }
```

`features/assistant/components/AssistantPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { fetchServerSentEvents, useChat, type UIMessage } from "@tanstack/ai-react";
   2 | import React, { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
   3 | 
   4 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   5 | import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "#/components/ui/card";
   6 | import { Textarea } from "#/components/ui/textarea";
   7 | 
   8 | export function AssistantPanel({ patientId }: { patientId?: string }) {
   9 |   const threadId = useId();
  10 |   const inputId = useId();
  11 |   const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  12 |   const forwardedProps = useMemo(() => (patientId ? { patientId } : {}), [patientId]);
  13 |   const { messages, sendMessage, isLoading, error, stop } = useChat({
  14 |     connection: fetchServerSentEvents("/api/assistant"),
  15 |     threadId,
  16 |     forwardedProps,
  17 |   });
  18 | 
  19 |   const handleSubmit = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
  20 |     event.preventDefault();
  21 |     const text = input.trim();
  22 |     if (!text || isLoading) return;
  23 |     setInput("");
  24 |     void sendMessage(text);
  25 |   };
  26 | 
  27 |   return (
  28 |     <Card>
  29 |       <CardHeader>
  30 |         <CardTitle>{patientId ? "Clinical chart assistant" : "Clinic roster assistant"}</CardTitle>
  31 |       </CardHeader>
  32 |       <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
  33 |         <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" role="note">
  34 |           {patientId
  35 |             ? "Draft chart summaries only. It does not diagnose, recommend treatment, or calculate medication doses. Verify information and review all output as a clinician."
  36 |             : "Roster search only. No individual patient history is available until you open that patient's chart."}
  37 |         </p>
  38 | 
  39 |         <div aria-live="polite" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
  40 |           {messages.map((message) => (
  41 |             <AssistantMessage key={message.id} message={message} />
  42 |           ))}
  43 |         </div>
  44 | 
  45 |         {error && (
  46 |           <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
  47 |             The assistant response was interrupted. Please retry.
  48 |           </p>
  49 |         )}
  50 | 
  51 |         <form className="flex flex-col gap-3" noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  52 |           <label className="text-sm font-medium" htmlFor={inputId}>
  53 |             {patientId ? "Ask about this patient’s documented chart" : "Search the clinic roster"}
  54 |           </label>
  55 |           <Textarea
  56 |             id={inputId}
  57 |             maxLength={4_000}
  58 |             onChange={(event) => setInput(event.currentTarget.value)}
  59 |             placeholder={
  60 |               patientId
  61 |                 ? "Summarize recent visits or documented growth measurements"
  62 |                 : "Find a patient by name or MRN"
  63 |             }
  64 |             value={input}
  65 |           />
  66 |           <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
  67 |             {isLoading && (
  68 |               <Button onClick={stop} type="button" variant="outline">
  69 |                 Stop
  70 |               </Button>
  71 |             )}
  72 |             <Button disabled={!input.trim() || isLoading} type="submit">
  73 |               Send
  74 |             </Button>
  75 |           </div>
  76 |         </form>
  77 |       </CardContent>
  78 |     </Card>
  79 |   );
  80 | }
  81 | 
  82 | function AssistantMessage({ message }: { message: UIMessage }) {
  83 |   const text = message.parts
  84 |     .filter((part) => part.type === "text")
  85 |     .map((part) => (part.type === "text" ? part.content : ""))
  86 |     .join("");
  87 | 
  88 |   if (!text.trim()) return null;
  89 | 
  90 |   return (
  91 |     <div className="rounded-md border p-3">
  92 |       <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
  93 |         {message.role === "user" ? "You" : "Assistant"}
  94 |       </p>
  95 |       <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">{text}</p>
  96 |     </div>
  97 |   );
  98 | }
```

```ts
   1 | const permittedRoles = new Set(["admin", "doctor", "staff"]);
   2 | 
   3 | export function canUseAssistantRole(role: string | undefined): boolean {
   4 |   return role !== undefined && permittedRoles.has(role);
   5 | }
   6 | 
   7 | export function resolveAssistantClinicId(
   8 |   role: string | undefined,
   9 |   userClinicId: string | null | undefined,
  10 |   patientClinicId?: string | null,
  11 | ): string | null {
  12 |   if (!canUseAssistantRole(role)) return null;
  13 | 
  14 |   const clinicId = patientClinicId ?? userClinicId;
  15 |   if (!clinicId) return null;
  16 |   if (role !== "admin" && clinicId !== userClinicId) return null;
  17 | 
  18 |   return clinicId;
  19 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import { toolDefinition } from "@tanstack/ai";
   2 | import { z } from "zod";
   3 | 
   4 | import { and, db, desc, eq, ilike, isNull, or } from "#/db/index.ts";
   5 | import { measurements, measurementIndicators, patients, prescriptions } from "#/db/schema.ts";
   6 | 
   7 | const noInputSchema = z.strictObject({});
   8 | 
   9 | export function createAssistantTools(clinicId: string, patientId?: string) {
  10 |   const listPatients = toolDefinition({
  11 |     name: "list_patients",
  12 |     description: "Search the clinic roster by patient name or MRN. Returns names only.",
  13 |     inputSchema: z.object({
  14 |       query: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120).optional().describe("Partial name or MRN"),
  15 |       limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(5),
  16 |     }),
  17 |   }).server(async ({ query, limit }) => {
  18 |     const conditions = [
  19 |       eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId),
  20 |       eq(patients.isActive, true),
  21 |       isNull(patients.deletedAt),
  22 |     ];
  23 |     if (query) {
  24 |       conditions.push(
  25 |         or(
  26 |           ilike(patients.firstName, `%${query}%`),
  27 |           ilike(patients.lastName, `%${query}%`),
  28 |           ilike(patients.mrn, `%${query}%`),
  29 |         )!,
  30 |       );
  31 |     }
  32 | 
  33 |     const rows = await db
  34 |       .select({
  35 |         firstName: patients.firstName,
  36 |         lastName: patients.lastName,
  37 |       })
  38 |       .from(patients)
  39 |       .where(and(...conditions))
  40 |       .limit(limit ?? 5);
  41 |     return rows;
  42 |   });
  43 | 
  44 |   if (!patientId) return [listPatients];
  45 | 
  46 |   const getPatientHistory = toolDefinition({
  47 |     name: "get_patient_history",
  48 |     description: "Recent visit summaries and diagnoses for the selected patient.",
  49 |     inputSchema: noInputSchema,
  50 |   }).server(async () => {
  51 |     return db.query.visits.findMany({
  52 |       where: { patientId, clinicId },
  53 |       orderBy: { visitedAt: "desc" },
  54 |       limit: 5,
  55 |       columns: {
  56 |         visitedAt: true,
  57 |         ageMonths: true,
  58 |         chiefComplaint: true,
  59 |         diagnosis: true,
  60 |         symptoms: true,
  61 |         plan: true,
  62 |       },
  63 |       with: {
  64 |         diagnoses: {
  65 |           columns: {
  66 |             icdCode: true,
  67 |             description: true,
  68 |             type: true,
  69 |           },
  70 |         },
  71 |       },
  72 |     });
  73 |   });
  74 | 
  75 |   const listActivePrescriptions = toolDefinition({
  76 |     name: "list_active_prescriptions",
  77 |     description:
  78 |       "List active, already-prescribed medications for the selected patient. Do not recommend or change doses.",
  79 |     inputSchema: noInputSchema,
  80 |   }).server(async () => {
  81 |     const rows = await db
  82 |       .select({
  83 |         medicationName: prescriptions.medicationName,
  84 |         dosage: prescriptions.dosage,
  85 |         frequency: prescriptions.frequency,
  86 |         durationDays: prescriptions.durationDays,
  87 |         prescribedAt: prescriptions.prescribedAt,
  88 |       })
  89 |       .from(prescriptions)
  90 |       .innerJoin(patients, eq(prescriptions.patientId, patients.id))
  91 |       .where(
  92 |         and(
  93 |           eq(prescriptions.patientId, patientId),
  94 |           eq(prescriptions.status, "active"),
  95 |           eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId),
  96 |         ),
  97 |       )
  98 |       .orderBy(desc(prescriptions.prescribedAt))
  99 |       .limit(20);
 100 |     return rows;
 101 |   });
 102 | 
 103 |   const getGrowthSummary = toolDefinition({
 104 |     name: "get_growth_summary",
 105 |     description:
 106 |       "Latest documented measurement per indicator for the selected patient, including stored z-score and classification.",
 107 |     inputSchema: noInputSchema,
 108 |   }).server(async () => {
 109 |     const latestByIndicator = await Promise.all(
 110 |       measurementIndicators.map(async (indicator) => {
 111 |         const [row] = await db
 112 |           .select({
 113 |             indicator: measurements.indicator,
 114 |             value: measurements.value,
 115 |             measuredAt: measurements.measuredAt,
 116 |             zScore: measurements.zScore,
 117 |             percentile: measurements.percentile,
 118 |             classification: measurements.classification,
 119 |           })
 120 |           .from(measurements)
 121 |           .innerJoin(patients, eq(measurements.patientId, patients.id))
 122 |           .where(
 123 |             and(
 124 |               eq(measurements.patientId, patientId),
 125 |               eq(measurements.indicator, indicator),
 126 |               eq(patients.clinicId, clinicId),
 127 |             ),
 128 |           )
 129 |           .orderBy(desc(measurements.measuredAt))
 130 |           .limit(1);
 131 |         return row;
 132 |       }),
 133 |     );
 134 | 
 135 |     return latestByIndicator.filter((measurement) => measurement !== undefined);
 136 |   });
 137 | 
 138 |   return [getPatientHistory, listActivePrescriptions, getGrowthSummary];
 139 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import type { ModelMessage } from "@tanstack/ai";
   2 | 
   3 | import { z } from "zod";
   4 | 
   5 | export const MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES = 40;
   6 | export const MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_CHARS = 4_000;
   7 | export const MAX_ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_CHARS = 20_000;
   8 | 
   9 | const medicationAdvicePatterns = [
  10 |   /\b(?:recommend|calculate|suggest|prescribe)\b.{0,50}\b(?:dose|dosage|medication|drug)\b/i,
  11 |   /\b(?:dose|dosage)\b.{0,50}\b(?:should|recommend|calculate|give|use|take)\b/i,
  12 |   /\bhow much\b.{0,50}\b(?:medicine|medication|drug|mg|ml)\b/i,
  13 |   /\b(?:mg|mcg|μg|ml)\s*\/\s*kg\b/i,
  14 | ];
  15 | 
  16 | const messageSchema = z.object({
  17 |   id: z.string().max(128),
  18 |   role: z.enum(["user", "assistant", "tool"]),
  19 |   parts: z.array(z.unknown()).max(24).optional(),
  20 |   content: z.union([z.string().max(16_000), z.array(z.unknown()).max(24)]).optional(),
  21 | });
  22 | 
  23 | export const assistantRequestSchema = z
  24 |   .object({
  25 |     messages: z.array(messageSchema).min(1).max(MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES),
  26 |     threadId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(),
  27 |     runId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(),
  28 |     patientId: z.uuid().optional(),
  29 |     forwardedProps: z
  30 |       .object({
  31 |         patientId: z.uuid().optional(),
  32 |       })
  33 |       .optional(),
  34 |   })
  35 |   .superRefine((request, context) => {
  36 |     if (
  37 |       request.patientId &&
  38 |       request.forwardedProps?.patientId &&
  39 |       request.patientId !== request.forwardedProps.patientId
  40 |     ) {
  41 |       context.addIssue({
  42 |         code: "custom",
  43 |         message: "Conflicting patient identifiers",
  44 |         path: ["patientId"],
  45 |       });
  46 |     }
  47 | 
  48 |     const lastMessage = request.messages.at(-1);
  49 |     if (lastMessage?.role !== "user" || !extractText(lastMessage).trim()) {
  50 |       context.addIssue({
  51 |         code: "custom",
  52 |         message: "The last assistant message must be a non-empty user message",
  53 |         path: ["messages"],
  54 |       });
  55 |     }
  56 | 
  57 |     let totalCharacters = 0;
  58 |     for (const [index, message] of request.messages.entries()) {
  59 |       const messageCharacters = extractText(message).length;
  60 |       if (messageCharacters > MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_CHARS) {
  61 |         context.addIssue({
  62 |           code: "custom",
  63 |           message: "Message exceeds the maximum length",
  64 |           path: ["messages", index],
  65 |         });
  66 |       }
  67 |       totalCharacters += messageCharacters;
  68 |     }
  69 | 
  70 |     if (totalCharacters > MAX_ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_CHARS) {
  71 |       context.addIssue({
  72 |         code: "custom",
  73 |         message: "Conversation exceeds the maximum context length",
  74 |         path: ["messages"],
  75 |       });
  76 |     }
  77 |   });
  78 | 
  79 | type ValidatedMessage = z.infer<typeof messageSchema>;
  80 | 
  81 | function extractText(message: ValidatedMessage): string {
  82 |   if (message.role === "tool") return "";
  83 | 
  84 |   const contents = message.parts ?? (Array.isArray(message.content) ? message.content : []);
  85 |   const textFromParts = contents
  86 |     .flatMap((part) => {
  87 |       if (typeof part !== "object" || part === null || !("type" in part) || part.type !== "text") {
  88 |         return [];
  89 |       }
  90 | 
  91 |       if ("content" in part && typeof part.content === "string") return [part.content];
  92 |       if ("text" in part && typeof part.text === "string") return [part.text];
  93 |       return [];
  94 |     })
  95 |     .join("");
  96 | 
  97 |   if (message.parts || Array.isArray(message.content)) return textFromParts;
  98 |   return typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : "";
  99 | }
 100 | 
 101 | export function toAssistantModelMessages(messages: ValidatedMessage[]): ModelMessage[] {
 102 |   return messages.flatMap((message) => {
 103 |     const content = extractText(message);
 104 |     return content.trim() ? [{ role: message.role, content }] : [];
 105 |   });
 106 | }
 107 | 
 108 | export function requestsMedicationAdvice(text: string): boolean {
 109 |   return medicationAdvicePatterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text));
 110 | }
```
