```ts
   1 | // src/stores/clinic-store.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // The active clinic — a client-side mirror of the fields on the Better Auth
   4 | // session that every clinic-scoped surface needs.
   5 | //
   6 | // Design notes
   7 | // ------------
   8 | //
   9 | // 1. SSR safety
  10 | //    A module-level `createStore(...)` is a singleton per process. Under
  11 | //    TanStack Start that process serves *every* request — so a server-side
  12 | //    `setActiveClinic(acmeClinic)` on request A would leak into request B's
  13 | //    server-render of `clinicStore.state`. We therefore construct the store
  14 | //    through `getClinicStore()`, which returns a fresh store on the server
  15 | //    and a cached singleton on the client. This mirrors the
  16 | //    `getQueryClient()` pattern from `integrations/tanstack-query/query-client`.
  17 | //
  18 | // 2. Idempotency
  19 | //    `ClinicSessionSync` runs inside a `useEffect` whose deps include every
  20 | //    session field it observes. Each `useAuth()` refresh — profile edit,
  21 | //    `refetch()`, cross-tab invalidate — re-runs it with a *new* object
  22 | //    literal for the same clinic. Without a structural compare,
  23 | //    `setActiveClinic` would push a fresh reference into the store on every
  24 | //    refresh, notifying every subscriber and invalidating every
  25 | //    clinic-scoped query downstream. `isSameClinic` short-circuits that.
  26 | //
  27 | // 3. Null = "no clinic"
  28 | //    A signed-out user (or a user whose account isn't yet linked to a
  29 | //    clinic) legitimately has no active clinic. `null` is the canonical
  30 | //    representation, never `{}`. Consumers should branch on `active === null`
  31 | //    rather than on any field being empty.
  32 | //
  33 | // 4. No mutation of the input
  34 | //    `setActiveClinic` copies the incoming object before storing it, so a
  35 | //    caller that later mutates its own `clinic` variable can't corrupt the
  36 | //    store. Cheap insurance; a `Clinic` object is 5 primitives.
  37 | 
  38 | import { createStore, useSelector } from "@tanstack/react-store";
  39 | 
  40 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  41 | // Types
  42 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  43 | 
  44 | /**
  45 |  * The subset of clinic identity that most surfaces need. Intentionally
  46 |  * smaller than `Clinic` in `db/schema.ts` — the store is a *session*
  47 |  * mirror, not a cache of the full clinic row. If a surface needs `createdAt`,
  48 |  * `notes`, etc., it fetches the row via React Query (`clinicByIdQuery`).
  49 |  */
  50 | export interface ActiveClinic {
  51 |   /** The id used to scope clinic data. Callers are responsible for supplying a resolved value. */
  52 |   id: string;
  53 |   name: string;
  54 |   email: string | null;
  55 |   // phone: string | null;
  56 |   // address: string | null;
  57 | }
  58 | 
  59 | interface ClinicState {
  60 |   /**
  61 |    * The currently active clinic, or `null` when signed out / not linked.
  62 |    *
  63 |    * Never `undefined`: `undefined` means "we haven't hydrated yet" and would
  64 |    * force every consumer to handle a third state. Use `useHasActiveClinic()`
  65 |    * or `active === null` instead.
  66 |    */
  67 |   active: ActiveClinic | null;
  68 | }
  69 | 
  70 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  71 | // Structural equality
  72 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 | 
  74 | /**
  75 |  * True iff `a` and `b` describe the same clinic.
  76 |  *
  77 |  * Hand-written (rather than a generic deep-equal) because the shape is tiny
  78 |  * and fixed. If `ActiveClinic` grows a field, TypeScript won't force you to
  79 |  * update this — so keep the two in sync manually. There's a test below that
  80 |  * guards against this.
  81 |  */
  82 | function isSameClinic(a: ActiveClinic | null, b: ActiveClinic | null): boolean {
  83 |   if (a === b) return true; // covers both null, same reference
  84 |   if (a === null || b === null) return false;
  85 |   return (
  86 |     a.id === b.id && a.name === b.name && a.email === b.email // a.phone === b.phone &&
  87 |     // a.address === b.address
  88 |   );
  89 | }
  90 | 
  91 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  92 | // Store factory — SSR-safe
  93 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  94 | 
  95 | const INITIAL_STATE: ClinicState = { active: null };
  96 | 
  97 | function createClinicStore() {
  98 |   return createStore<ClinicState>(INITIAL_STATE);
  99 | }
 100 | 
 101 | export type ClinicStore = ReturnType<typeof createClinicStore>;
 102 | 
 103 | let clientStore: ClinicStore | undefined;
 104 | 
 105 | /**
 106 |  * Return the clinic store for the current environment.
 107 |  *
 108 |  * - **Browser:** a module-level singleton. Every `useClinicStore()` call
 109 |  *   returns the same instance, so all components share state.
 110 |  * - **Server:** a fresh store per call. Because TanStack Start renders each
 111 |  *   request in its own call, no state can leak between requests. (If you
 112 |  *   ever render two sibling components that both call `getClinicStore()`
 113 |  *   inside *one* request, they'll each get a fresh store — which is why
 114 |  *   server-side components must read clinic data from React Query, not from
 115 |  *   this store. That's the same rule as `getQueryClient()`.)
 116 |  */
 117 | export function getClinicStore(): ClinicStore {
 118 |   if (typeof window === "undefined") {
 119 |     return createClinicStore();
 120 |   }
 121 |   clientStore ??= createClinicStore();
 122 |   return clientStore;
 123 | }
 124 | 
 125 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 126 | // Actions
 127 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 128 | 
 129 | /**
 130 |  * The action surface consumed by `ClinicSessionSync` and any future caller
 131 |  * that wants to change the active clinic (e.g. an admin "switch clinic"
 132 |  * picker).
 133 |  *
 134 |  * Writes go through `getClinicStore()` so the same call works on the client
 135 |  * (mutating the singleton) and on the server (mutating a per-render store —
 136 |  * which is a no-op for output, but keeps the call sites uniform).
 137 |  */
 138 | export const clinicActions = {
 139 |   /**
 140 |    * Set or clear the active clinic.
 141 |    *
 142 |    * Idempotent: if the incoming clinic is structurally equal to the current
 143 |    * one, the store is left untouched and no subscribers are notified. This
 144 |    * is the property `ClinicSessionSync` relies on — it can call this on every
 145 |    * `useAuth()` refresh without causing a downstream refetch storm.
 146 |    */
 147 |   setActiveClinic(next: ActiveClinic | null): void {
 148 |     const store = getClinicStore();
 149 |     store.setState((prev) => {
 150 |       if (isSameClinic(prev.active, next)) return prev;
 151 |       return {
 152 |         ...prev,
 153 |         // Copy so a caller that later mutates its own object can't corrupt
 154 |         // the store. Clone the primitives; no deep clone needed.
 155 |         active: next === null ? null : { ...next },
 156 |       };
 157 |     });
 158 |   },
 159 | 
 160 |   /** Clear the active clinic. Equivalent to `setActiveClinic(null)`. */
 161 |   clearActiveClinic(): void {
 162 |     clinicActions.setActiveClinic(null);
 163 |   },
 164 | };
 165 | 
 166 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 167 | // Selectors / hooks
 168 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 169 | 
 170 | /**
 171 |  * Read the whole clinic state.
 172 |  *
 173 |  * Prefer the narrower `useActiveClinic()` when you only need the clinic —
 174 |  * selecting the whole state object re-renders on any field change, which
 175 |  * today is only `active`, but will stop being true the moment we add a
 176 |  * second slice (e.g. `switching: boolean`).
 177 |  */
 178 | export function useClinicStore(): ClinicState {
 179 |   return useSelector(getClinicStore(), (s) => s);
 180 | }
 181 | 
 182 | /**
 183 |  * The active clinic, or `null` when signed out / not linked.
 184 |  *
 185 |  * This is the hook 95% of components want. The selector returns
 186 |  * `s.active` directly, so a component using it re-renders only when the
 187 |  * clinic identity changes — not on unrelated store writes.
 188 |  */
 189 | export function useActiveClinic(): ActiveClinic | null {
 190 |   return useSelector(getClinicStore(), (s) => s.active);
 191 | }
 192 | 
 193 | /**
 194 |  * Boolean convenience for gating UI that requires a clinic
 195 |  * (e.g. "New patient" buttons, appointment filters).
 196 |  */
 197 | export function useHasActiveClinic(): boolean {
 198 |   return useSelector(getClinicStore(), (s) => s.active !== null);
 199 | }
 200 | 
 201 | /**
 202 |  * The active clinic, throwing if there isn't one.
 203 |  *
 204 |  * Use inside components that are mounted only under `_auth/app/*` — the
 205 |  * layout already guarantees a signed-in user, so `null` here means a bug
 206 |  * upstream (e.g. `ClinicSessionSync` not mounted). Throwing gives you a
 207 |  * loud failure instead of a silently-broken page.
 208 |  */
 209 | export function useRequiredActiveClinic(): ActiveClinic {
 210 |   const clinic = useActiveClinic();
 211 |   if (!clinic) {
 212 |     throw new Error(
 213 |       "useRequiredActiveClinic: no active clinic. Is <ClinicSessionSync /> " +
 214 |         "mounted, and is the current user linked to a clinic?",
 215 |     );
 216 |   }
 217 |   return clinic;
 218 | }
 219 | 
 220 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 221 | // Non-reactive reads (for handlers, analytics, edge cases)
 222 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 223 | 
 224 | /**
 225 |  * The current active clinic, read synchronously without subscribing.
 226 |  *
 227 |  * Use inside event handlers or `beforeLoad` — not in render, because it
 228 |  * doesn't trigger re-renders when the value changes. On the server this
 229 |  * always returns `null` (fresh store per call), which is what you want:
 230 |  * server-side code should resolve the clinic from the session/DB, not from
 231 |  * a client store.
 232 |  */
 233 | export function getActiveClinicSnapshot(): ActiveClinic | null {
 234 |   return getClinicStore().state.active;
 235 | }
```

`features/clinics/queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/clinics/queries.ts
   2 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   4 | 
   5 | import {
   6 |   createClinicFn,
   7 |   fetchClinicById,
   8 |   fetchClinicCount,
   9 |   fetchClinics,
  10 |   fetchClinicWithRoster,
  11 |   fetchClinicWithStats,
  12 |   updateClinicFn,
  13 | } from "./functions";
  14 | 
  15 | /**
  16 |  * Create a new clinic.
  17 |  *
  18 |  * Invalidates the clinic list and count. The new clinic has no cached
  19 |  * `detail` or `stats` yet, so those don't need invalidation — the first
  20 |  * visit to `$clinicId` fetches fresh.
  21 |  *
  22 |  * Returns the created row so the caller can navigate to
  23 |  * `/app/clinics/$clinicId` or use `row.id` in a callback.
  24 |  */
  25 | export function useCreateClinicMutation() {
  26 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  27 |   const createClinic = useServerFn(createClinicFn);
  28 | 
  29 |   return useMutation({
  30 |     mutationFn: createClinic,
  31 |     onSuccess: () => {
  32 |       void Promise.all([
  33 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.list() }),
  34 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.count() }),
  35 |       ]);
  36 |     },
  37 |   });
  38 | }
  39 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  40 |   /** Single clinic detail. */
  41 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
  42 |   /** Clinic list — changes only when admins add/remove clinics. */
  43 |   LIST: 120_000,
  44 |   /** Clinic with stats or roster — aggregations. */
  45 |   STATS: 60_000,
  46 |   /** Total clinic count. */
  47 |   COUNT: 120_000,
  48 | } as const;
  49 | 
  50 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  51 | // Query key factory
  52 | //
  53 | // Every key starts with "clinics". Invalidate the whole tree with
  54 | // `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.all() })`, or a
  55 | // per-clinic subtree with `clinicKeys.detail(clinicId)` (which drops
  56 | // stats and roster at once).
  57 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  58 | 
  59 | export const clinicKeys = {
  60 |   all: () => ["clinics"] as const,
  61 | 
  62 |   /** The full list of clinics (admin only). */
  63 |   list: () => ["clinics", "list"] as const,
  64 | 
  65 |   /** Total clinic count (admin only). */
  66 |   count: () => ["clinics", "count"] as const,
  67 | 
  68 |   /**
  69 |    * Per-clinic subtree. Invalidating this drops `stats` and `roster`
  70 |    * automatically, because they are nested under `detail`.
  71 |    */
  72 |   detail: (clinicId: string) => ["clinics", "detail", clinicId] as const,
  73 | 
  74 |   /** One clinic with aggregated stats (patient count, upcoming appointments). */
  75 |   stats: (clinicId: string) => ["clinics", "detail", clinicId, "stats"] as const,
  76 | 
  77 |   /** One clinic with its full staff roster. */
  78 |   roster: (clinicId: string) => ["clinics", "detail", clinicId, "roster"] as const,
  79 | } as const;
  80 | 
  81 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  82 | // Query options
  83 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  84 | 
  85 | export function clinicsQuery() {
  86 |   return queryOptions({
  87 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.list(),
  88 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinics(),
  89 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.LIST,
  90 |   });
  91 | }
  92 | 
  93 | export function clinicByIdQuery(clinicId: string) {
  94 |   return queryOptions({
  95 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.detail(clinicId),
  96 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicById({ data: { clinicId } }),
  97 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
  98 |   });
  99 | }
 100 | 
 101 | export function clinicWithStatsQuery(clinicId: string) {
 102 |   return queryOptions({
 103 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.stats(clinicId),
 104 |     queryFn: async () => {
 105 |       const clinic = await fetchClinicWithStats({ data: { clinicId } });
 106 |       return clinic ? { ...clinic, staff: clinic.users } : clinic;
 107 |     },
 108 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.STATS,
 109 |   });
 110 | }
 111 | 
 112 | export function clinicWithRosterQuery(clinicId: string) {
 113 |   return queryOptions({
 114 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.roster(clinicId),
 115 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicWithRoster({ data: { clinicId } }),
 116 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.STATS,
 117 |   });
 118 | }
 119 | 
 120 | export function clinicCountQuery() {
 121 |   return queryOptions({
 122 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.count(),
 123 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicCount(),
 124 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.COUNT,
 125 |   });
 126 | }
 127 | 
 128 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 129 | // Invalidation helpers
 130 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 131 | 
 132 | /**
 133 |  * Call this after a clinic mutation succeeds.
 134 |  *
 135 |  * - **Create** — pass only `clinicId: undefined`; invalidates the list and count.
 136 |  * - **Update** — pass `clinicId`; invalidates the list, count, and the
 137 |  *   clinic's own subtree (`detail` → `stats` + `roster`).
 138 |  * - **Delete** — pass `clinicId`; same as update, plus the deleted clinic's
 139 |  *   subtree is safe to drop even though it 404s on next read.
 140 |  *
 141 |  * The count is invalidated on every mutation because creating or deleting
 142 |  * a clinic changes it. Updates do not — but invalidating an already-fresh
 143 |  * count is cheap, and branching on "was this a create or delete?" here
 144 |  * would push that knowledge into every call site.
 145 |  */
 146 | export function invalidateAfterClinicMutation(
 147 |   queryClient: {
 148 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
 149 |   },
 150 |   args: { clinicId?: string },
 151 | ): Promise<unknown> {
 152 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
 153 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.list() }),
 154 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.count() }),
 155 |   ];
 156 | 
 157 |   if (args.clinicId) {
 158 |     // `detail` is the parent of `stats` and `roster` — one invalidation
 159 |     // drops all three.
 160 |     promises.push(
 161 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 162 |         queryKey: clinicKeys.detail(args.clinicId),
 163 |       }),
 164 |     );
 165 |   }
 166 | 
 167 |   return Promise.all(promises);
 168 | }
 169 | export function useUpdateClinicMutation() {
 170 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 171 |   const updateClinic = useServerFn(updateClinicFn);
 172 | 
 173 |   return useMutation({
 174 |     mutationFn: updateClinic,
 175 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 176 |       if (!row) return;
 177 |       void Promise.all([
 178 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 179 |           queryKey: clinicKeys.detail(row.id),
 180 |         }),
 181 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.list() }),
 182 |       ]);
 183 |     },
 184 |   });
 185 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import { createInsertSchema, createSelectSchema, createUpdateSchema } from "drizzle-orm/zod";

   4 | import { clinics } from "@/db/schema";
   5 | import { optionalText, requiredText } from "@/features/shared/helpers";
   6 | 
   7 | export const clinicSelectSchema = createSelectSchema(clinics);
   8 | export const clinicInsertSchema = createInsertSchema(clinics);
   9 | export const clinicUpdateSchema = createUpdateSchema(clinics);
  10 | 
  11 | export type Clinic = typeof clinics.$inferSelect;
  12 | export type NewClinic = typeof clinics.$inferInsert;

  14 | export const clinicInputSchema = z.object({
  15 |   name: requiredText(200),
  16 |   address: optionalText(500),
  17 |   phone: optionalText(40),
  18 |   email: z
  19 |     .email("Invalid email")
  20 |     .max(200)
  21 |     .optional()
  22 |     .nullable()
  23 |     .transform((v) => (v === "" ? null : (v ?? null))),
  24 | });
  25 |
```

`features/dashboard/use-clinic-pulse.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import type { ComponentType } from "react";
   2 | 
   3 | import { useSuspenseQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   4 | import { CalendarClockIcon, ClipboardListIcon, ClockIcon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
   5 | 
   6 | export type StatTone = "default" | "warning" | "positive" | "critical";
   7 | 
   8 | export type ClinicPulseStat = {
   9 |   label: string;
  10 |   value: string | number;
  11 |   sub?: string;
  12 |   tone?: StatTone;
  13 |   icon?: ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  14 | };
  15 | 
  16 | type PulseResponse = {
  17 |   todayCount: number;
  18 |   pendingForms: number;
  19 |   overdueFollowUps: number;
  20 |   nextAppointment: { time: string; patientName: string } | null;
  21 | };
  22 | 
  23 | async function fetchClinicPulse(clinicId: string | undefined): Promise<ClinicPulseStat[]> {
  24 |   if (!clinicId) return [];
  25 | 
  26 |   const res = await fetch(`/api/clinics/${clinicId}/pulse`, {
  27 |     headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
  28 |   });
  29 |   if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Pulse fetch failed: ${res.status}`);
  30 |   const data: PulseResponse = await res.json();
  31 | 
  32 |   return [
  33 |     {
  34 |       label: "Today",
  35 |       value: data.todayCount,
  36 |       sub: "appointments",
  37 |       icon: CalendarClockIcon,
  38 |     },
  39 |     {
  40 |       label: "Pending",
  41 |       value: data.pendingForms,
  42 |       sub: "intake forms",
  43 |       tone: data.pendingForms > 0 ? "warning" : "default",
  44 |       icon: ClipboardListIcon,
  45 |     },
  46 |     {
  47 |       label: "Overdue",
  48 |       value: data.overdueFollowUps,
  49 |       sub: "follow-ups",
  50 |       tone: data.overdueFollowUps > 0 ? "critical" : "default",
  51 |       icon: TriangleAlertIcon,
  52 |     },
  53 |     {
  54 |       label: "Next up",
  55 |       value: data.nextAppointment?.time ?? "—",
  56 |       sub: data.nextAppointment?.patientName ?? "no more today",
  57 |       icon: ClockIcon,
  58 |     },
  59 |   ];
  60 | }
  61 | 
  62 | export function useClinicPulse(clinicId: string | undefined) {
  63 |   return useSuspenseQuery({
  64 |     queryKey: ["clinic-pulse", clinicId ?? null],
  65 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicPulse(clinicId),
  66 |     staleTime: 60_000,
  67 |   });
  68 | }
```

`features/development/components/DomainRings.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // features/development/components/DomainRings.tsx
   2 | 
   3 | import { AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
   4 | 
   5 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
   6 | 
   7 | import { DOMAIN_META, DOMAIN_ORDER, type MilestoneDomain } from "../types";
   8 | 
   9 | export interface DomainRingData {
  10 |   domain: MilestoneDomain;
  11 |   /** Achieved count within this domain for the current bracket. */
  12 |   achieved: number;
  13 |   /** Total expected for this bracket (achieved + expected + red-flag). */
  14 |   expected: number;
  15 |   /** Count of red-flag milestones in this domain (unfulfilled, past target). */
  16 |   redFlags: number;
  17 | }
  18 | 
  19 | interface DomainRingsProps {
  20 |   data: readonly DomainRingData[];
  21 |   className?: string;
  22 | }
  23 | 
  24 | /**
  25 |  * 2×2 grid of animated SVG progress rings — one per domain.
  26 |  * Rings show `% achieved / expected` for the current age bracket.
  27 |  * A red-flag badge appears if `redFlags > 0`.
  28 |  */
  29 | export function DomainRings({ data, className }: DomainRingsProps) {
  30 |   return (
  31 |     <div className={cn("grid grid-cols-2 gap-3", className)} role="list">
  32 |       {DOMAIN_ORDER.map((domain) => {
  33 |         const row = data.find((r) => r.domain === domain) ?? {
  34 |           domain,
  35 |           achieved: 0,
  36 |           expected: 0,
  37 |           redFlags: 0,
  38 |         };
  39 |         return <DomainRing key={domain} row={row} />;
  40 |       })}
  41 |     </div>
  42 |   );
  43 | }
  44 | 
  45 | function DomainRing({ row }: { row: DomainRingData }) {
  46 |   const meta = DOMAIN_META[row.domain];
  47 |   const Icon = meta.icon;
  48 |   const pct = row.expected === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((row.achieved / row.expected) * 100);
  49 |   const radius = 26;
  50 |   const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  51 |   const dash = (pct / 100) * circumference;
  52 | 
  53 |   return (
  54 |     <li className="border-border/60 bg-card flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3">
  55 |       <svg
  56 |         aria-hidden="true"
  57 |         className="shrink-0 -rotate-90"
  58 |         height={64}
  59 |         viewBox="0 0 64 64"
  60 |         width={64}
  61 |       >
  62 |         <circle className="stroke-muted" cx="32" cy="32" fill="none" r={radius} strokeWidth={6} />
  63 |         <circle
  64 |           className={meta.stroke}
  65 |           cx="32"
  66 |           cy="32"
  67 |           fill="none"
  68 |           r={radius}
  69 |           strokeDasharray={`${dash} ${circumference - dash}`}
  70 |           strokeLinecap="round"
  71 |           strokeWidth={6}
  72 |           style={{ transition: "stroke-dasharray 400ms ease" }}
  73 |         />
  74 |       </svg>
  75 |       <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
  76 |         <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
  77 |           <Icon aria-hidden="true" className={cn("size-3.5 shrink-0", meta.text)} />
  78 |           <span className=" truncate text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">
  79 |             {meta.shortLabel}
  80 |           </span>
  81 |         </div>
  82 |         <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
  83 |           <span className="text-lg leading-tight font-semibold tabular-nums">{pct}</span>
  84 |           <span className=" text-xs">%</span>
  85 |           <span className=" ml-auto text-xs tabular-nums">
  86 |             {row.achieved}/{row.expected}
  87 |           </span>
  88 |         </div>
  89 |         {row.redFlags > 0 && (
  90 |           <span className="text-destructive mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium">
  91 |             <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="size-3" />
  92 |             {row.redFlags} red flag{row.redFlags > 1 ? "s" : ""}
  93 |           </span>
  94 |         )}
  95 |       </div>
  96 |     </li>
  97 |   );
  98 | }
```

```tsx
  13 | } from "@/components/ui/select";
  14 | 
  15 | import { DEVELOPMENTAL_MILESTONES, type MilestoneDomain } from "../types";
  16 | 
  17 | interface MilestoneChecklistProps {
  18 |   childAgeMonths?: number;
  19 |   correctedAgeMonths?: number;
  20 | }
  21 | 
  22 | const AGE_BRACKETS = [2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24];
  23 | 
  24 | const DOMAIN_LABELS: Record<MilestoneDomain, { label: string; variant: "secondary" | "outline" }> =
  25 |   {
  26 |     "gross-motor": {
  27 |       label: "Gross Motor",
  28 |       variant: "secondary",
  29 |     },
  30 |     "fine-motor": {
  31 |       label: "Fine Motor",
  32 |       variant: "secondary",
  33 |     },
  34 |     language: {
  35 |       label: "Language & Communication",
  36 |       variant: "secondary",
  37 |     },
  38 |     "social-emotional": {
  39 |       label: "Social & Emotional",
  40 |       variant: "secondary",
  41 |     },
  42 |   };
  43 | 
  44 | export function MilestoneChecklist({
  45 |   childAgeMonths = 6,
  46 |   correctedAgeMonths,
  47 | }: MilestoneChecklistProps) {
  48 |   const effectiveAge = correctedAgeMonths ?? childAgeMonths;
  49 | 
  50 |   // Closest bracket
  51 |   const initialBracket = useMemo(() => {
  52 |     let closest = AGE_BRACKETS[0];
  53 |     let minDiff = Math.abs(effectiveAge - closest);
  54 |     for (const b of AGE_BRACKETS) {
  55 |       const diff = Math.abs(effectiveAge - b);
  56 |       if (diff < minDiff) {
  57 |         minDiff = diff;
  58 |         closest = b;
  59 |       }
  60 |     }
  61 |     return closest;
  62 |   }, [effectiveAge]);
  63 | 
  64 |   const [selectedAge, setSelectedAge] = useState<number>(initialBracket);
  65 |   const [checkedIds, setCheckedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  66 | 
  67 |   const currentMilestones = useMemo(
  68 |     () => DEVELOPMENTAL_MILESTONES.filter((m) => m.targetAgeMonths === selectedAge),
  69 |     [selectedAge],
  70 |   );
  71 | 
  72 |   const toggleCheck = (id: string) => {
  73 |     setCheckedIds((prev) => {
  74 |       const next = new Set(prev);
  75 |       if (next.has(id)) {
  76 |         next.delete(id);
  77 |       } else {
  78 |         next.add(id);
  79 |       }
  80 |       return next;
  81 |     });
  82 |   };
  83 | 
  84 |   const achievedCount = currentMilestones.filter((m) => checkedIds.has(m.id)).length;
  85 |   const missingRedFlags = currentMilestones.filter(
  86 |     (m) => m.isRedFlagIfMissing && !checkedIds.has(m.id),
  87 |   );
  88 | 
  89 |   return (
  90 |     <Card className="w-full">
  91 |       <CardHeader>
  92 |         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4">
  93 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
  94 |             <div className="bg-primary/10 text-primary flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg">
  95 |               <Award className="size-5" />
  96 |             </div>
  97 |             <div>
  98 |               <CardTitle>Developmental Milestones & Neurodevelopmental Screening</CardTitle>
  99 |               <CardDescription>
 100 |                 Screening gross motor, fine motor, communication, and social skills at well-child
 101 |                 visits
 102 |               </CardDescription>
 103 |             </div>
 104 |           </div>
 105 | 
 106 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
 107 |             <div className="w-44">
 108 |               <Select
 109 |                 onValueChange={(val) => val && setSelectedAge(Number.parseInt(val, 10))}
 110 |                 value={String(selectedAge)}
 111 |               >
 112 |                 <SelectTrigger>
 113 |                   <SelectValue placeholder="Select check-up age" />
 114 |                 </SelectTrigger>
 115 |                 <SelectContent>
 116 |                   {AGE_BRACKETS.map((age) => (
 117 |                     <SelectItem key={age} value={String(age)}>
 118 |                       {age < 12 ? `${age} Months Check-up` : `${age / 12} Year(s) Check-up`}
 119 |                     </SelectItem>
 120 |                   ))}
 121 |                 </SelectContent>
 122 |               </Select>
 123 |             </div>
 124 | 
 125 |             <Badge variant="outline">
 126 |               {achievedCount} / {currentMilestones.length} Met
 127 |             </Badge>
 128 |           </div>
 129 |         </div>
 130 |       </CardHeader>
 131 | 
 132 |       <CardContent>
 133 |         <div className="space-y-4">
 134 |           {effectiveAge > selectedAge + 1 && missingRedFlags.length > 0 && (
 135 |             <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 p-3 text-xs text-warning dark:text-warning">
 136 |               <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
 137 |               <div>
 138 |                 <span className="font-semibold">Developmental Alert:</span> One or more key
 139 |                 milestone red flags are unverified for child's age ({effectiveAge.toFixed(1)}{" "}
 140 |                 months):
 141 |                 <ul className="mt-1 list-disc space-y-0.5 pl-4">
 142 |                   {missingRedFlags.map((rf) => (
 143 |                     <li key={rf.id}>
 144 |                       {rf.title} ({rf.ageLabel})
 145 |                     </li>
 146 |                   ))}
 147 |                 </ul>
 148 |               </div>
 149 |             </div>
 150 |           )}
 151 | 
 152 |           <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
 153 |             {currentMilestones.map((m) => {
 154 |               const isChecked = checkedIds.has(m.id);
 155 |               const domainMeta = DOMAIN_LABELS[m.domain];
 156 | 
 157 |               return (
 158 |                 <div
 159 |                   className={`flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3.5 transition-colors ${
 160 |                     isChecked
 161 |                       ? "border-module-encounters/40 bg-module-encounters/5 dark:bg-module-encounters/10"
 162 |                       : "hover:bg-muted/50"
 163 |                   }`}
 164 |                   key={m.id}
 165 |                   onClick={() => toggleCheck(m.id)}
 166 |                 >
 167 |                   <Checkbox

 169 |                     className="mt-0.5"

 171 |                   />
 172 |                   <div className="space-y-1">
 173 |                     <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
 174 |                       <span className="text-foreground text-sm font-semibold">{m.title}</span>
 175 |                       <Badge variant={domainMeta.variant}>{domainMeta.label}</Badge>
 176 |                       {m.isRedFlagIfMissing && <Badge variant="destructive">Critical</Badge>}
 177 |                     </div>
 178 |                     <p className=" text-xs">{m.description}</p>
 179 |                   </div>
 180 |                 </div>
 181 |               );
 182 |             })}
 183 |           </div>
 184 |         </div>
 185 |       </CardContent>

 188 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | // features/development/components/MilestoneTimeline.tsx
   2 | 
   3 | import { AlertTriangle, Check, Circle } from "lucide-react";
   4 | import * as React from "react";
   5 | 
   6 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
   7 | 
   8 | import type { PatientMilestone } from "../types";
   9 | 
  10 | import { type MilestoneStatus, milestoneStatus } from "../status";
  11 | import { DOMAIN_META, DOMAIN_ORDER } from "../types";
  12 | 
  13 | export interface MilestoneTimelineProps {
  14 |   milestones: readonly PatientMilestone[];
  15 |   correctedAgeMonths: number;
  16 |   selectedId: string | null;
  17 |   onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  18 | }
  19 | 
  20 | const TICKS = [0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36, 60];
  21 | const TICK_LABELS: Record<number, string> = {
  22 |   0: "Birth",
  23 |   2: "2m",
  24 |   4: "4m",
  25 |   6: "6m",
  26 |   9: "9m",
  27 |   12: "1y",
  28 |   18: "1.5y",
  29 |   24: "2y",
  30 |   36: "3y",
  31 |   60: "5y",
  32 | };
  33 | 
  34 | const LANE_HEIGHT = 64;
  35 | 
  36 | function xPercent(ageMonths: number): number {
  37 |   // Non-linear: more resolution below 24m, compressed to 60m after.
  38 |   if (ageMonths <= 24) return (ageMonths / 24) * 60;
  39 |   return 60 + ((ageMonths - 24) / 36) * 40;
  40 | }
  41 | 
  42 | interface MilestonePoint {
  43 |   id: string;
  44 |   domain: string;
  45 |   label: string;
  46 |   description: string;
  47 |   ageMonths: number;
  48 |   status: MilestoneStatus;
  49 |   achievedDate: string | null;
  50 |   isRedFlagIfMissing: boolean;
  51 | }
  52 | 
  53 | export function MilestoneTimeline({
  54 |   milestones,
  55 |   correctedAgeMonths,
  56 |   selectedId,
  57 |   onSelect,
  58 | }: MilestoneTimelineProps) {
  59 |   const grouped = React.useMemo(() => {
  60 |     const byDomain = new Map<string, MilestonePoint[]>();
  61 |     for (const domain of DOMAIN_ORDER) byDomain.set(domain, []);
  62 |     for (const m of milestones) {
  63 |       byDomain.get(m.domain)?.push({
  64 |         id: m.id,
  65 |         domain: m.domain,
  66 |         label: m.title,
  67 |         description: m.description,
  68 |         ageMonths: m.targetAgeMonths,
  69 |         status: milestoneStatus(m, correctedAgeMonths),
  70 |         achievedDate: m.achievedDate,
  71 |         isRedFlagIfMissing: Boolean(m.isRedFlagIfMissing),
  72 |       });
  73 |     }
  74 |     for (const list of byDomain.values()) {
  75 |       list.sort((a, b) => a.ageMonths - b.ageMonths);
  76 |     }
  77 |     return byDomain;
  78 |   }, [milestones, correctedAgeMonths]);
  79 | 
  80 |   const totalHeight = DOMAIN_ORDER.length * LANE_HEIGHT + 40;
  81 | 
  82 |   return (
  83 |     <div
  84 |       className="border-border/60 bg-card relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border"
  85 |       style={{ height: totalHeight }}
  86 |     >
  87 |       {/* Vertical age ticks */}
  88 |       <div className=" absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-full">
  89 |         {TICKS.map((tick) => (
  90 |           <div
  91 |             className="border-border/40 absolute top-0 bottom-0 border-l"
  92 |             key={tick}
  93 |             style={{ left: `${xPercent(tick)}%` }}
  94 |           >
  95 |             <span className="bg-background absolute top-0 left-1 rounded-br  text-[10px] tabular-nums">
  96 |               {TICK_LABELS[tick]}
  97 |             </span>
  98 |           </div>
  99 |         ))}
 100 |       </div>
 101 | 
 102 |       {/* Age marker (corrected age) */}
 103 |       <div
 104 |         aria-hidden="true"
 105 |         className="bg-foreground/50 pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 w-px"
 106 |         style={{
 107 |           left: `${xPercent(Math.min(correctedAgeMonths, 60))}%`,
 108 |           top: 20,
 109 |         }}
 110 |       >
 111 |         <span className="bg-foreground text-background absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums">
 112 |           {correctedAgeMonths.toFixed(0)}m
 113 |         </span>
 114 |       </div>
 115 | 
 116 |       {/* Domain lanes */}
 117 |       <div className="relative pt-10">
 118 |         {DOMAIN_ORDER.map((domain, laneIndex) => {
 119 |           const meta = DOMAIN_META[domain];
 120 |           const Icon = meta.icon;
 121 |           const points = grouped.get(domain) ?? [];
 122 |           const achieved = points.filter((p) => p.status === "achieved");
 123 |           return (
 124 |             <div
 125 |               className="border-border/20 relative flex items-center border-t"
 126 |               key={domain}
 127 |               style={{ height: LANE_HEIGHT }}
 128 |             >
 129 |               <div className="bg-background sticky left-0 z-10 flex w-32 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 px-2">
 130 |                 <Icon aria-hidden="true" className={cn("size-3.5", meta.text)} />
 131 |                 <span className=" truncate text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">
 132 |                   {meta.shortLabel}
 133 |                 </span>
 134 |               </div>
 135 |               <div className="relative flex-1">
 136 |                 <svg aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full">
 137 |                   {achieved.length >= 2 && (
 138 |                     <polyline
 139 |                       fill="none"
 140 |                       points={achieved
 141 |                         .map((p) => `${xPercent(p.ageMonths)}%,${LANE_HEIGHT / 2}`)
 142 |                         .join(" ")}
 143 |                       stroke={meta.hex}
 144 |                       strokeLinecap="round"
 145 |                       strokeLinejoin="round"
 146 |                       strokeOpacity={0.35}
 147 |                       strokeWidth={1.5}
 148 |                     />
 149 |                   )}
 150 |                 </svg>
 151 |                 {points.map((p) => (
 152 |                   <MilestoneDot
 153 |                     key={p.id}
 154 |                     laneIndex={laneIndex}
 155 |                     onSelect={onSelect}
 156 |                     point={p}
 157 |                     selected={p.id === selectedId}
 158 |                   />
 159 |                 ))}
 160 |               </div>
 161 |             </div>
 162 |           );
 163 |         })}
 164 |       </div>
 165 |     </div>
 166 |   );
 167 | }
 168 | 
 169 | function MilestoneDot({
 170 |   point,
 171 |   onSelect,
 172 |   selected,
 173 | }: {
 174 |   point: MilestonePoint;
 175 |   onSelect: (id: string) => void;
 176 |   selected: boolean;
 177 |   laneIndex: number;
 178 | }) {
 179 |   const meta = DOMAIN_META[point.domain as keyof typeof DOMAIN_META];
 180 |   const status = point.status;
 181 |   const isAchieved = status === "achieved";
 182 |   const isRedFlag = status === "red-flag";
 183 |   const isFuture = status === "future";
 184 | 
 185 |   return (
 186 |     <button
 187 |       aria-label={`${point.label}, ${status}`}
 188 |       aria-pressed={selected}
 189 |       className={cn(
 190 |         "group focus-visible:ring-ring absolute top-1/2 z-20 flex size-6 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 transition-transform hover:scale-110 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none",
 191 |         isAchieved && `${meta.bg} border-transparent text-white shadow-sm`,
 192 |         status === "expected" && "border-foreground/40 border-dashed",
 193 |         isRedFlag && "border-destructive/80 bg-destructive/10 animate-pulse-slow",
 194 |         isFuture && "border-border bg-background",
 195 |         selected && "ring-ring ring-2 ring-offset-2",
 196 |       )}
 197 |       onClick={() => onSelect(point.id)}
 198 |       style={{
 199 |         left: `${xPercent(point.ageMonths)}%`,
 200 |         backgroundColor: isAchieved ? meta.hex : undefined,
 201 |       }}
 202 |       title={`${point.label} — ${point.ageMonths}m`}
 203 |       type="button"
 204 |     >
 205 |       {isAchieved ? (
 206 |         <Check aria-hidden="true" className="size-3 text-white" strokeWidth={3} />
 207 |       ) : isRedFlag ? (
 208 |         <AlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" className="text-destructive size-3" />
 209 |       ) : (
 210 |         <Circle
 211 |           aria-hidden="true"
 212 |           className={cn("size-2", isFuture ? "fill-muted-foreground/30" : "fill-foreground/40")}
 213 |         />
 214 |       )}
 215 |     </button>
 216 |   );
 217 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   2 | import { getRequest, setResponseStatus } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
   3 | import { z } from "zod";
   4 | 
   5 | // src/features/development/api.ts
   6 | import { and, db, eq } from "#/db/index.ts";
   7 | import { auditLog, idempotency, milestones } from "#/db/schema.ts";
   8 | import { clinicAccessMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/clinic-middleware";
   9 | import { freshAuthMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
  10 | 
  11 | import {
  12 |   bulkSetPatientMilestones,
  13 |   getPatientDevelopmentSnapshot,
  14 |   setPatientMilestone,
  15 | } from "../../db/queries/develop.queries";
  16 | 
  17 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  18 | // Schemas
  19 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  20 | 
  21 | const IsoDateSchema = z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "Use YYYY-MM-DD");
  22 | 
  23 | // `milestoneId` mirrors the catalog IDs in `types.ts` (e.g. "m-12m-lang").
  24 | // Kept as a bounded free string so seed-driven catalog changes don't break
  25 | // the validator at build time.
  26 | const MilestoneIdSchema = z.string().min(1).max(64);
  27 | 
  28 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  29 | // Read
  30 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  31 | 
  32 | /**
  33 |  * Full snapshot for one patient's development page.
  34 |  * Returns `null` if the patient does not exist.
  35 |  *
  36 |  * `clinicAccessMiddleware` derives the patient's clinic and rejects callers
  37 |  * from a different clinic. The input carries only a `patientId`; the
  38 |  * clinicId is *not* trusted from the client.
  39 |  */
  40 | export const fetchPatientDevelopment = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  41 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
  42 |   .validator(z.object({ patientId: z.uuid() }))
  43 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => getPatientDevelopmentSnapshot(data.patientId));
  44 | 
  45 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  46 | // Write — single milestone
  47 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  48 | 
  49 | /**
  50 |  * `freshAuthMiddleware` re-validates the session against the DB before the
  51 |  * write — so a revoked session cannot record a milestone. `clinicAccessMiddleware`
  52 |  * then enforces tenant isolation on the `patientId`.
  53 |  */
  54 | export const setMilestoneAchievedFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  55 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  56 |   .validator(
  57 |     z.object({
  58 |       patientId: z.uuid(),
  59 |       milestoneId: MilestoneIdSchema,
  60 |       isAchieved: z.boolean(),
  61 |       achievedDate: IsoDateSchema.optional().nullable(),
  62 |       notes: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional().nullable(),
  63 |     }),
  64 |   )
  65 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => setPatientMilestone(data));
  66 | 
  67 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  68 | // Write — bulk (checklist "save all" / import from paper form)
  69 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  70 | 
  71 | const BulkItemSchema = z.object({
  72 |   milestoneId: MilestoneIdSchema,
  73 |   isAchieved: z.boolean(),
  74 |   achievedDate: IsoDateSchema.optional().nullable(),
  75 | });
  76 | 
  77 | export const bulkSetMilestonesFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  78 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  79 |   .validator(
  80 |     z.object({
  81 |       patientId: z.uuid(),
  82 |       items: z.array(BulkItemSchema).min(1).max(200),
  83 |     }),
  84 |   )
  85 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => bulkSetPatientMilestones(data.patientId, data.items));
  86 | 
  87 | const SetMilestoneInput = z.object({
  88 |   patientId: z.uuid(),
  89 |   milestoneId: MilestoneIdSchema,
  90 |   isAchieved: z.boolean(),
  91 |   achievedDate: IsoDateSchema.optional().nullable(),
  92 |   notes: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional().nullable(),
  93 |   baseVersion: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  94 | });
  95 | 
  96 | export const setMilestoneFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  97 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  98 |   .validator(SetMilestoneInput)
  99 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
 100 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
 101 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
 102 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
 103 |           operation: "set-milestone",
 104 |           key: idempotencyKey,
 105 |           userId: context.user.id,
 106 |           data,
 107 |         })
 108 |       : null;
 109 | 
 110 |     const patient = await db.query.patients.findFirst({
 111 |       where: { id: data.patientId },
 112 |       columns: { clinicId: true },
 113 |     });
 114 |     if (!patient || (context.user.role !== "admin" && patient.clinicId !== context.user.clinicId)) {
 115 |       throw forbidden();
 116 |     }
 117 | 
 118 |     const catalogEntry = await db.query.milestoneCatalog.findFirst({
 119 |       where: { id: data.milestoneId },
 120 |       columns: { id: true },
 121 |     });
 122 |     if (!catalogEntry) {
 123 |       setResponseStatus(422);
 124 |       throw new Error("Milestone is not present in the current catalog.");
 125 |     }
 126 | 
 127 |     const result = db.transaction((tx) => {
 128 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 129 |         const previous = tx
 130 |           .select()
 131 |           .from(idempotency)
 132 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
 133 |           .get();
 134 | 
 135 |         if (previous) {
 136 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
 137 |             setResponseStatus(409);
 138 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
 139 |           }
 140 | 
 141 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
 142 |           if (
 143 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 144 |             previousResult !== null &&
 145 |             "conflict" in previousResult &&
 146 |             previousResult.conflict === true &&
 147 |             "serverSnapshot" in previousResult
 148 |           ) {
 149 |             return {
 150 |               kind: "conflict" as const,
 151 |               serverSnapshot: previousResult.serverSnapshot,
 152 |             };
 153 |           }
 154 | 
 155 |           const milestoneId =
 156 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 157 |             previousResult !== null &&
 158 |             "milestoneId" in previousResult &&
 159 |             typeof previousResult.milestoneId === "string"
 160 |               ? previousResult.milestoneId
 161 |               : null;
 162 |           if (!milestoneId) {
 163 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
 164 |           }
 165 | 
 166 |           const previousRow = tx
 167 |             .select()
 168 |             .from(milestones)
 169 |             .where(eq(milestones.id, milestoneId))
 170 |             .get();
 171 |           if (!previousRow) {
 172 |             throw new Error("The previously saved milestone is missing.");
 173 |           }
 174 |           return { kind: "ok" as const, data: previousRow };
 175 |         }
 176 |       }
 177 | 
 178 |       const existing = tx
 179 |         .select()
 180 |         .from(milestones)
 181 |         .where(
 182 |           and(
 183 |             eq(milestones.patientId, data.patientId),
 184 |             eq(milestones.milestoneId, data.milestoneId),
 185 |           ),
 186 |         )
 187 |         .get();
 188 | 
 189 |       if (data.baseVersion && existing && existing.updatedAt.toISOString() !== data.baseVersion) {
 190 |         const serverSnapshot = existing;
 191 |         if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 192 |           tx.insert(idempotency)
 193 |             .values({
 194 |               id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 195 |               key: idempotencyKey,
 196 |               requestHash,
 197 |               result: { conflict: true, serverSnapshot },
 198 |             })
 199 |             .run();
 200 |         }
 201 |         return { kind: "conflict" as const, serverSnapshot };
 202 |       }
 203 | 
 204 |       const achievedDate = data.isAchieved
 205 |         ? (data.achievedDate ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10))
 206 |         : null;
 207 |       const row = existing
 208 |         ? tx
 209 |             .update(milestones)
 210 |             .set({
 211 |               isAchieved: data.isAchieved,
 212 |               achievedDate,
 213 |               notes: data.notes ?? null,
 214 |               updatedBy: context.user.id,
 215 |               updatedAt: new Date(),
 216 |             })
 217 |             .where(eq(milestones.id, existing.id))
 218 |             .returning()
 219 |             .get()
 220 |         : tx
 221 |             .insert(milestones)
 222 |             .values({
 223 |               patientId: data.patientId,
 224 |               milestoneId: data.milestoneId,
 225 |               isAchieved: data.isAchieved,
 226 |               achievedDate,
 227 |               notes: data.notes ?? null,
 228 |               createdBy: context.user.id,
 229 |               updatedBy: context.user.id,
 230 |             })
 231 |             .returning()
 232 |             .get();
 233 | 
 234 |       if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to save milestone.");
 235 | 
 236 |       tx.insert(auditLog)
 237 |         .values({
 238 |           actorId: context.user.id,
 239 |           action: existing ? "update" : "create",
 240 |           entity: "Milestone",
 241 |           entityId: row.id,
 242 |           metadata: {
 243 |             patientId: row.patientId,
 244 |             milestoneId: row.milestoneId,
 245 |             isAchieved: row.isAchieved,
 246 |           },
 247 |         })
 248 |         .run();
 249 | 
 250 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 251 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
 252 |           .values({
 253 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 254 |             key: idempotencyKey,
 255 |             requestHash,
 256 |             result: { milestoneId: row.id },
 257 |           })
 258 |           .run();
 259 |       }
 260 | 
 261 |       return { kind: "ok" as const, data: row };
 262 |     });
 263 | 
 264 |     if (result.kind === "conflict") {
 265 |       throw conflict(result.serverSnapshot);
 266 |     }
 267 |     return result.data;
 268 |   });
 269 | 
 270 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
 271 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
 272 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
 273 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
 274 | }
 275 | 
 276 | function forbidden(): Error {
 277 |   setResponseStatus(403);
 278 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
 279 | }
 280 | 
 281 | function conflict(serverSnapshot: unknown): Error {
 282 |   setResponseStatus(409);
 283 |   return Object.assign(new Error("Conflict (409): milestone was updated elsewhere."), {
 284 |     serverSnapshot,
 285 |   });
 286 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/development/api.ts
   2 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   4 | 
   5 | import { fetchPatientDevelopment, setMilestoneAchievedFn } from "./functions";
   6 | 
   7 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   8 | // Constants
   9 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  10 | 
  11 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  12 |   /** Per-patient development snapshot. Changes only when a milestone is
  13 |    *  recorded, so it can sit in cache a little longer than encounter lists. */
  14 |   SNAPSHOT: 60_000,
  15 | } as const;
  16 | 
  17 | export const developmentKeys = {
  18 |   all: () => ["development"] as const,
  19 | 
  20 |   /** Per-patient subtree — drops the snapshot for one child. */
  21 |   patient: (patientId: string) => ["development", "patient", patientId] as const,
  22 | } as const;
  23 | 
  24 | export function patientDevelopmentQuery(patientId: string) {
  25 |   return queryOptions({
  26 |     queryKey: developmentKeys.patient(patientId),
  27 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientDevelopment({ data: { patientId } }),
  28 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.SNAPSHOT,
  29 |   });
  30 | }
  31 | 
  32 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  33 | // Invalidation helper
  34 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  35 | 
  36 | /**
  37 |  * Call this after a milestone write succeeds. Centralising the invalidation
  38 |  * keeps every caller in sync — if a future feature depends on the snapshot
  39 |  * (e.g. a growth page that renders development summaries), add its key here
  40 |  * rather than hunting down the mutation call sites.
  41 |  */
  42 | export function invalidateAfterMilestoneUpdate(
  43 |   queryClient: {
  44 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
  45 |   },
  46 |   patientId: string,
  47 | ): Promise<unknown> {
  48 |   return queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  49 |     queryKey: developmentKeys.patient(patientId),
  50 |   }) as Promise<unknown>;
  51 | }
  52 | export function useSetMilestoneAchievedMutation(patientId: string) {
  53 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  54 |   const setAchieved = useServerFn(setMilestoneAchievedFn);
  55 | 
  56 |   return useMutation({
  57 |     mutationFn: setAchieved,
  58 |     onSuccess: () => {
  59 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  60 |         queryKey: developmentKeys.patient(patientId),
  61 |       });
  62 |     },
  63 |   });
  64 | }
```

`features/development/status.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // features/development/status.ts
   2 | import type { MilestoneDomain } from "./types";
   3 | 
   4 | export type MilestoneStatus = "achieved" | "expected" | "future" | "red-flag";
   5 | 
   6 | export interface MilestoneForStatus {
   7 |   isAchieved: boolean;
   8 |   targetAgeMonths: number;
   9 |   isRedFlagIfMissing?: boolean;
  10 | }
  11 | 
  12 | /**
  13 |  * Compute the display status of a milestone relative to a patient's
  14 |  * corrected age. `correctedAgeMonths` is what the chart should use
  15 |  * (fallback to chronological if not preterm).
  16 |  */
  17 | export function milestoneStatus(
  18 |   m: MilestoneForStatus,
  19 |   correctedAgeMonths: number,
  20 | ): MilestoneStatus {
  21 |   if (m.isAchieved) return "achieved";
  22 |   if (correctedAgeMonths >= m.targetAgeMonths) {
  23 |     return m.isRedFlagIfMissing ? "red-flag" : "expected";
  24 |   }
  25 |   return "future";
  26 | }
  27 | 
  28 | /** Counts by status across a slice of milestones. */
  29 | export function countByStatus(
  30 |   milestones: ReadonlyArray<MilestoneForStatus & { domain: MilestoneDomain }>,
  31 |   correctedAgeMonths: number,
  32 | ) {
  33 |   const result: Record<MilestoneStatus, { total: number; achieved: number; redFlag: number }> = {
  34 |     achieved: { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
  35 |     expected: { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
  36 |     future: { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
  37 |     "red-flag": { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
  38 |   };
  39 |   for (const m of milestones) {
  40 |     const s = milestoneStatus(m, correctedAgeMonths);
  41 |     result[s].total += 1;
  42 |     if (m.isAchieved) result[s].achieved += 1;
  43 |     if (s === "red-flag") result[s].redFlag += 1;
  44 |   }
  45 |   return result;
  46 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   2 | import { type AnyRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | import {
   4 |   createColumnHelper,
   5 |   createPaginatedRowModel,
   6 |   rowPaginationFeature,
   7 |   tableFeatures,
   8 |   useTable,
   9 | } from "@tanstack/react-table";
  10 | import { StethoscopeIcon } from "lucide-react";
  11 | 
  12 | import { buttonVariants } from "#/components/ui/button-variants";
  13 | import { IconTile } from "@/components/blocks/icon-tile";
  14 | import { DataTable } from "@/components/tables/data-table";
  15 | import { type PageSize } from "@/components/tables/table-pagination";
  16 | import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
  17 | import { formatDate, formatStatusLabel } from "@/lib/dates";
  18 | 
  19 | // ── read ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  20 | import { diagnosesForPatientQuery, diagnosesForVisitQuery } from "../queries";
  21 | 
  22 | // ── row type — derived from the query factory's concrete queryFn ───────
  23 | //
  24 | // `ReturnType<typeof diagnosesForVisitQuery>["queryFn"]` is
  25 | //   `QueryFunction<TData, TKey, never> | undefined`
  26 | // — an *optional* union. Two problems:
  27 | //
  28 | //   1. `Awaited<QueryFunction<...>>` does NOT unwrap to `TData`; it stays
  29 | //      `QueryFunction<...>`, because `QueryFunction` is a function, not a
  30 | //      promise. So `[number]` fails (TS2537).
  31 | //
  32 | //   2. Because the union includes `undefined`, the whole expression
  33 | //      collapses, and every downstream `row.original.*` access loses its
  34 | //      type, which then trips TS7053 on `TYPE_VARIANT[type]`.
  35 | //
  36 | // The fix is to infer the data type from the queryFn's *return* type via
  37 | // `infer R` on the function signature — no `queryFn` generic, no
  38 | // importing the server function into the component.
  39 | type QueryFnData<TQueryOptions> = TQueryOptions extends {
  40 |   queryFn?: (...args: never[]) => infer R;
  41 | }
  42 |   ? Awaited<R>
  43 |   : never;
  44 | 
  45 | type DiagnosisRow = QueryFnData<ReturnType<typeof diagnosesForVisitQuery>>[number];
  46 | 
  47 | // ── Static module-scope config ─────────────────────────────────────────
  48 | 
  49 | const features = tableFeatures({
  50 |   rowPaginationFeature,
  51 |   paginatedRowModel: createPaginatedRowModel(),
  52 | });
  53 | 
  54 | const column = createColumnHelper<typeof features, DiagnosisRow>();
  55 | const EMPTY_DIAGNOSES: DiagnosisRow[] = [];
  56 | 
  57 | const TYPE_VARIANT = {
  58 |   primary: "default",
  59 |   secondary: "secondary",
  60 | } as const satisfies Record<DiagnosisRow["type"], "default" | "secondary">;
  61 | 
  62 | const columns = column.columns([
  63 |   column.accessor("icdCode", {
  64 |     header: "ICD-10",
  65 |     meta: { width: "w-28 max-sm:w-24" },
  66 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  67 |       <span className="block truncate font-mono text-xs font-medium tabular-nums">
  68 |         {row.original.icdCode}
  69 |       </span>
  70 |     ),
  71 |   }),
  72 |   column.accessor("description", {
  73 |     header: "Description",
  74 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  75 |       <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 py-1">
  76 |         <IconTile tone="secondary">
  77 |           <StethoscopeIcon aria-hidden="true" />
  78 |         </IconTile>
  79 |         <span className="truncate font-medium">{row.original.description}</span>
  80 |       </div>
  81 |     ),
  82 |   }),
  83 |   column.accessor("type", {
  84 |     header: "Type",
  85 |     meta: { width: "w-24" },
  86 |     cell: ({ row }) => {
  87 |       const type = row.original.type;
  88 |       return <Badge variant={TYPE_VARIANT[type]}>{formatStatusLabel(type)}</Badge>;
  89 |     },
  90 |   }),
  91 |   column.accessor("createdAt", {
  92 |     header: "Visited",
  93 |     meta: { width: "w-32 max-sm:w-24", hideOnMobile: true },
  94 |     cell: ({ row }) => {
  95 |       const visitedAt = row.original.createdAt;
  96 |       if (!visitedAt) return <span className="">—</span>;
  97 |       const date = new Date(visitedAt);
  98 |       return (
  99 |         <span className=" block truncate font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{formatDate(date)}</span>
 100 |       );
 101 |     },
 102 |   }),
 103 | ]);
 104 | 
 105 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 106 | 
 107 | type DiagnosisTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute> = {
 108 |   route?: TRoute;
 109 |   page?: number;
 110 |   size?: PageSize;
 111 | } & (
 112 |   | { visitId: string; patientId?: never }
 113 |   | { patientId: string; visitId?: never }
 114 | );
 115 | 
 116 | export function DiagnosisTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>(props: DiagnosisTableProps<TRoute>) {
 117 |   const { route, page = 1, size = 20 } = props;
 118 |   const patientId = props.patientId;
 119 |   const visitId = props.visitId;
 120 |   const query = useQuery(
 121 |     patientId
 122 |       ? diagnosesForPatientQuery(patientId)
 123 |       : getVisitDiagnosisQuery(visitId),
 124 |   );
 125 | 
 126 |   const all = query.data ?? EMPTY_DIAGNOSES;
 127 | 
 128 |   const table = useTable({
 129 |     data: all,
 130 |     columns,
 131 |     features,
 132 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
 133 |     state: {
 134 |       pagination: {
 135 |         pageIndex: page - 1,
 136 |         pageSize: patientId ? Math.max(all.length, 1) : size,
 137 |       },
 138 |     },
 139 |   });
 140 | 
 141 |   const pageCount = table.getPageCount();
 142 | 
 143 |   return (
 144 |     <DataTable
 145 |       ariaLabel="Diagnoses"
 146 |       emptyMessage={
 147 |         patientId
 148 |           ? "No diagnoses recorded for this patient yet."
 149 |           : "No diagnoses recorded for this visit yet."
 150 |       }
 151 |       errorDescription={
 152 |         query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
 153 |       }
 154 |       errorTitle="Could Not Load Diagnoses"
 155 |       outOfRange={
 156 |         all.length > 0 && page > pageCount
 157 |           ? {
 158 |               backTo: () =>
 159 |                 patientId ? (
 160 |                   <Link
 161 |                     className={buttonVariants()}
 162 |                     params={{ patientId }}
 163 |                     search={{ tab: "diagnoses" }}
 164 |                     to="/app/patients/$patientId"
 165 |                   >
 166 |                     Back To First Page
 167 |                   </Link>
 168 |                 ) : visitId ? (
 169 |                   <Link
 170 |                     className={buttonVariants()}
 171 |                     params={{ visitId } as never}
 172 |                     to={route?.fullPath ?? ("/app/visits/$visitId" as never)}
 173 |                   >
 174 |                     Back To First Page
 175 |                   </Link>
 176 |                 ) : null,
 177 |             }
 178 |           : undefined
 179 |       }
 180 |       pagination={patientId ? undefined : { page, pageCount, route, size }}
 181 |       query={query}
 182 |       skeletonRowCount={Math.min(size, 3)}
 183 |       table={table}
 184 |     />
 185 |   );
 186 | }
 187 | 
 188 | function getVisitDiagnosisQuery(visitId: string | undefined) {
 189 |   if (!visitId) throw new Error("A visit ID is required to load visit diagnoses.");
 190 |   return diagnosesForVisitQuery(visitId);
 191 | }
```

`features/diagnosis/queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/diagnosis/api.ts
   2 | import { queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   4 | // src/features/diagnosis/queries.ts — append
   5 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   6 | 
   7 | import {
   8 |   fetchDiagnosesForPatient,
   9 |   fetchDiagnosesForVisit,
  10 |   fetchDiagnosisById,
  11 |   fetchTopDiagnoses,
  12 |   searchDiagnosesFn,
  13 | } from "./functions";
  14 | import { createDiagnosesFn, createDiagnosisFn } from "./functions";
  15 | 
  16 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  17 | // Mutation hooks
  18 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  19 | 
  20 | /**
  21 |  * Create one or more diagnoses for a visit.
  22 |  *
  23 |  * Both the single and bulk paths invalidate the same caches — the visit's
  24 |  * diagnosis list, the patient's diagnosis history, the visit detail, and
  25 |  * (indirectly) the patient page. The `bulk` choice is only about which
  26 |  * server function is called; the cache strategy is identical.
  27 |  */
  28 | export function useCreateDiagnosesMutation(args: { visitId: string; patientId?: string }) {
  29 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  30 |   const createMany = useServerFn(createDiagnosesFn);
  31 |   const createOne = useServerFn(createDiagnosisFn);
  32 | 
  33 |   // Two mutations on the same hook — one per shape. React Query caches
  34 |   // mutations by `mutationKey`, so we tag them.
  35 |   const invalidate = () => {
  36 |     const promises: Array<unknown> = [
  37 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  38 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
  39 |       }),
  40 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["visit", args.visitId] }),
  41 |     ];
  42 |     if (args.patientId) {
  43 |       promises.push(
  44 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  45 |           queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byPatient(args.patientId),
  46 |         }),
  47 |       );
  48 |     }
  49 |     return Promise.all(promises);
  50 |   };
  51 | 
  52 |   const bulk = useMutation({
  53 |     mutationKey: ["diagnoses", "bulk", args.visitId],
  54 |     mutationFn: (rows: Parameters<typeof createMany>[0]["data"]["rows"]) =>
  55 |       createMany({ data: { rows } }),
  56 |     onSuccess: () => {
  57 |       void invalidate();
  58 |     },
  59 |   });
  60 | 
  61 |   const single = useMutation({
  62 |     mutationKey: ["diagnoses", "single", args.visitId],
  63 |     mutationFn: (row: Parameters<typeof createOne>[0]["data"]) => createOne({ data: row }),
  64 |     onSuccess: () => {
  65 |       void invalidate();
  66 |     },
  67 |   });
  68 | 
  69 |   return { bulk, single };
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 | // Constants
  74 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  75 | 
  76 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  77 |   /** Single diagnosis detail. */
  78 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
  79 |   /** Diagnoses attached to one visit — changes when the visit is edited. */
  80 |   VISIT: 60_000,
  81 |   /** A patient's full diagnosis history. */
  82 |   PATIENT: 60_000,
  83 |   /** Clinic-wide search and aggregates. */
  84 |   CLINIC: 120_000,
  85 | } as const;
  86 | 
  87 | export const diagnosisKeys = {
  88 |   all: () => ["diagnoses"] as const,
  89 | 
  90 |   /** One diagnosis detail. */
  91 |   detail: (diagnosisId: string) => ["diagnoses", "detail", diagnosisId] as const,
  92 | 
  93 |   /** Diagnoses attached to one visit. */
  94 |   byVisit: (visitId: string) => ["diagnoses", "visit", visitId] as const,
  95 | 
  96 |   /** A patient's full diagnosis history. */
  97 |   byPatient: (patientId: string) => ["diagnoses", "patient", patientId] as const,
  98 | 
  99 |   /** Free-text search results within a clinic. */
 100 |   search: (clinicId: string, query: string) => ["diagnoses", "search", clinicId, query] as const,
 101 | 
 102 |   /** Top-N ICD codes for a clinic. */
 103 |   topForClinic: (clinicId: string, limit: number) => ["diagnoses", "top", clinicId, limit] as const,
 104 | } as const;
 105 | 
 106 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 107 | // Query options
 108 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 109 | 
 110 | export function diagnosisByIdQuery(diagnosisId: string) {
 111 |   return queryOptions({
 112 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.detail(diagnosisId),
 113 |     queryFn: () => fetchDiagnosisById({ data: { diagnosisId } }),
 114 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
 115 |   });
 116 | }
 117 | 
 118 | export function diagnosesForVisitQuery(visitId: string) {
 119 |   return queryOptions({
 120 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byVisit(visitId),
 121 |     queryFn: () => fetchDiagnosesForVisit({ data: { visitId } }),
 122 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.VISIT,
 123 |   });
 124 | }
 125 | 
 126 | export function diagnosesForPatientQuery(patientId: string) {
 127 |   return queryOptions({
 128 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byPatient(patientId),
 129 |     queryFn: () => fetchDiagnosesForPatient({ data: { patientId } }),
 130 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.PATIENT,
 131 |   });
 132 | }
 133 | 
 134 | export function searchDiagnosesQuery(clinicId: string, query: string) {
 135 |   return queryOptions({
 136 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.search(clinicId, query),
 137 |     queryFn: () => searchDiagnosesFn({ data: { clinicId, query } }),
 138 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
 139 |     // The caller should debounce `query`. When `query` is empty the server
 140 |     // rejects it (`.min(1)`), so callers must gate with `enabled: query.length > 0`.
 141 |     enabled: query.length > 0,
 142 |   });
 143 | }
 144 | 
 145 | export function topDiagnosesQuery(clinicId: string, limit = 20) {
 146 |   return queryOptions({
 147 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.topForClinic(clinicId, limit),
 148 |     queryFn: () => fetchTopDiagnoses({ data: { clinicId, limit } }),
 149 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
 150 |   });
 151 | }
 152 | 
 153 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 154 | // Invalidation helpers
 155 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 156 | 
 157 | /**
 158 |  * Call this after any diagnosis mutation succeeds. Invalidates the visit's
 159 |  * diagnoses list (which the diagnosis form saves into) and the patient's
 160 |  * history (which the patient page renders).
 161 |  *
 162 |  * The list of caches touched by a write is knowledge that belongs in one
 163 |  * place — not duplicated across every mutation's `onSuccess`.
 164 |  */
 165 | export function invalidateAfterDiagnosisChange(
 166 |   queryClient: {
 167 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
 168 |   },
 169 |   args: {
 170 |     visitId?: string;
 171 |     patientId?: string;
 172 |     diagnosisId?: string;
 173 |   },
 174 | ): Promise<unknown> {
 175 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [];
 176 | 
 177 |   if (args.diagnosisId) {
 178 |     promises.push(
 179 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 180 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.detail(args.diagnosisId),
 181 |       }),
 182 |     );
 183 |   }
 184 | 
 185 |   if (args.visitId) {
 186 |     promises.push(
 187 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 188 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
 189 |       }),
 190 |     );
 191 |   }
 192 | 
 193 |   if (args.patientId) {
 194 |     promises.push(
 195 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 196 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byPatient(args.patientId),
 197 |       }),
 198 |     );
 199 |   }
 200 | 
 201 |   return Promise.all(promises);
 202 | }
```

`features/growth/README.md`:

```md
   1 | ## Growth charts — which chart is canonical
   2 | 
   3 | There are two chart components under `features/growth/components/`, and only
   4 | **one** is used by the patient-facing UI:
   5 | 
   6 | | Component                                      | Data source                                                                               | Used by                                                                              |
   7 | | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
   8 | | **`EgyptianGrowthChart.tsx`** _(canonical)_    | `ChartCurves` (Egyptian 2021 LMS) + optional `ChartBand` marker + patient `GrowthPoint[]` | `PatientGrowthPanel` — **the** growth screen                                         |
   9 | | `NewGrowthChart.tsx` (a.k.a. `WhoGrowthChart`) | `GrowthStandard[]` (WHO, day-indexed SD bands) + `ChildMeasurement[]`                     | `WhoGrowthPanel` — the _secondary_ WHO comparison chart shown below the Egyptian one |
  10 | 
  11 | ### Rules
  12 | 
  13 | 1. **Egyptian is primary.** Clinical decisions in this app are based on the
  14 |    Egyptian 2021 reference. `PatientGrowthPanel` renders
  15 |    `EgyptianGrowthChart`. The WHO panel is a secondary, comparative view
  16 |    and is intentionally _not_ the main chart.
  17 | 2. **Never reintroduce `GrowthChart.tsx`.** It was a parallel implementation
  18 |    built on `RendererChart` + `motion` + `d3-scale`/`d3-shape` and was
  19 |    deleted in favour of `EgyptianGrowthChart` (which uses the newer
  20 |    `@tanstack/charts` `defineChart`/`Chart` API, without the extra
  21 |    `d3-*` runtime dependencies). The test file
  22 |    `GrowthChart.test.tsx` now targets `EgyptianGrowthChart`.
  23 | 3. **State lives in the panel.** `PatientGrowthPanel` owns
  24 |    `indicator` / `flaggedOnly` / `formOpen` / `useCorrectedAge` in
  25 |    `useState`. There is no `growthStore` — a per-patient global `Map` was
  26 |    removed because it leaked across navigations and had no reset
  27 |    semantics. If cross-route persistence is ever required, model it as a
  28 |    **router search param**, not a module-level store.
  29 | 4. **Weight-for-length overlay.** The x-axis for WFL is length (cm). Each
  30 |    series row's `lengthCm` is derived server-side in
  31 |    `listIndicatorSeries` from the sibling `length-for-age` measurement at
  32 |    the same `visitId`. There is no `lengthCmAtMeasurement` column and no
  33 |    backfill: the derivation is retroactive and keeps a single source of
  34 |    truth.
  35 | 5. **Corrected age.** Preterm patients (`gestationalAgeWeeks < 37`) get a
  36 |    `Use corrected age` toggle. When enabled, the patient points' x-values
  37 |    are recomputed as `decimalMonthsBetween(dob, visitedAt) - weeksPreterm*7/30.4375`,
  38 |    and the x-axis label becomes `Corrected age (months)`. The reference
  39 |    curves themselves are unchanged — correction applies only to the
  40 |    patient overlay, which is the correct clinical convention.
  41 | 
  42 | ## Which chart is canonical?
  43 | 
  44 | - **`EgyptianGrowthChart.tsx`** — canonical growth chart. Uses `@tanstack/charts` `defineChart` / `Chart`, no `d3-scale` / `d3-shape` imports. Renders LMS reference curves plus optional patient overlay, optional band marker, optional `xAxisLabel` for corrected age.
  45 | - **`WhoGrowthChart.tsx`** (formerly `NewGrowthChart.tsx`) — secondary. Used only by `WhoGrowthPanel`. Uses `d3-scale` because the WHO standards are in a separate table (`growthStandards`) indexed by day and shown on a UTC axis.
  46 | - **`GrowthChart.tsx`** — deleted. It was a parallel implementation with `RendererChart` + `motion`. Do not resurrect.
  47 | 
  48 | State for the growth panel (`indicator`, `flaggedOnly`, `formOpen`, `useCorrectedAge`) lives in `PatientGrowthPanel` via `useState`. There is no store. If cross-route persistence is ever needed, use a router search param — not a module-level `Map`.
  49 | 
  50 | Weight-for-length overlay: `IndicatorSeriesRow.lengthCm` is derived server-side in `listIndicatorSeries` from the sibling `length-for-age` measurement at the same visit. No `lengthCmAtMeasurement` column exists; do not add one — it duplicates a value that already exists on the visit.

```

```tsx
   3 | import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

   5 | import { defineChart, dot, lineY } from "@tanstack/charts";

   7 | import { scaleLinear } from "@tanstack/charts/scales/linear";
   8 | import { tooltip } from "@tanstack/charts/tooltip";
   9 | import { useMemo } from "react";
  10 | 
  11 | import type {
  12 |   ChartBand,
  13 |   ChartCurves,

  19 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

  21 | export interface GrowthPoint {
```
