```tsx
  23 |   y: number;
  24 |   visitedAt?: Date;
  25 |   zScore?: number | null;
  26 | }
  27 | 
  28 | export interface EgyptianGrowthChartProps {
  29 |   indicator: Indicator;
  30 |   sex: Sex;
  31 |   curves: ChartCurves;
  32 |   points?: readonly GrowthPoint[];
  33 |   currentBand?: ChartBand | null;
  34 |   height?: number;
  35 |   width?: number;
  36 |   aspectRatio?: number;
  37 |   ariaLabel?: string;
  38 |   xAxisLabel?: string;
  39 |   onFocusChange?: (point: GrowthPoint | null) => void;
  40 |   onSelect?: (point: GrowthPoint) => void;
  41 |   className?: string;
  42 |   style?: CSSProperties;
  43 |   showTooltip?: boolean;
  44 |   animate?: boolean;
  45 | }
  46 | 
  47 | const BAND_LABELS = {
  48 |   sd3neg: "−3 SD",
  49 |   sd2neg: "−2 SD",
  50 |   sd1neg: "−1 SD",
  51 |   median: "Median",
  52 |   sd1: "+1 SD",
  53 |   sd2: "+2 SD",
  54 |   sd3: "+3 SD",
  55 | } as const;
  56 | 
  57 | const SERIES_COLORS = {
  58 |   sd3neg: "var(--growth-series-sd3neg)",
  59 |   sd2neg: "var(--growth-series-sd2neg)",
  60 |   sd1neg: "var(--growth-series-sd1neg)",
  61 |   median: "var(--growth-series-median)",
  62 |   sd1: "var(--growth-series-sd1)",
  63 |   sd2: "var(--growth-series-sd2)",
  64 |   sd3: "var(--growth-series-sd3)",
  65 | } as const;
  66 | 
  67 | const BAND_KEYS = ["sd3neg", "sd2neg", "sd1neg", "median", "sd1", "sd2", "sd3"] as const;
  68 | 
  69 | const EMPTY_POINTS: readonly GrowthPoint[] = [];
  70 | 
  71 | function axisLabel(xAxis: XAxis): string {
  72 |   return xAxis === "age" ? "Age (months)" : "Length (cm)";
  73 | }
  74 | 
  75 | function valueLabel(indicator: Indicator): string {
  76 |   switch (indicator) {
  77 |     case "weight-for-age":
  78 |     case "weight-for-length":
  79 |       return "Weight (kg)";
  80 |     case "length-for-age":
  81 |       return "Length / height (cm)";
  82 |     case "bmi-for-age":
  83 |       return "BMI (kg/m²)";
  84 |     default:
  85 |       return "Measurement";
  86 |   }
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | function defaultAriaLabel(indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex): string {
  90 |   const who = sex === "male" ? "boy" : "girl";
  91 |   return `Egyptian 2021 ${indicator} reference chart for a ${who}`;
  92 | }
  93 | 
  94 | interface BandRow {
  95 |   x: number;
  96 |   sd3neg: number;
  97 |   sd2neg: number;
  98 |   sd1neg: number;
  99 |   median: number;
 100 |   sd1: number;
 101 |   sd2: number;
 102 |   sd3: number;
 103 | }
 104 | 
 105 | function toBandRows(points: ChartCurves["points"]): BandRow[] {
 106 |   return points.map((p) => ({
 107 |     x: p.x,
 108 |     sd3neg: p.sd3neg,
 109 |     sd2neg: p.sd2neg,
 110 |     sd1neg: p.sd1neg,
 111 |     median: p.median,
 112 |     sd1: p.sd1,
 113 |     sd2: p.sd2,
 114 |     sd3: p.sd3,
 115 |   }));
 116 | }
 117 | 
 118 | function isGrowthPoint(value: unknown): value is GrowthPoint {
 119 |   return (
 120 |     typeof value === "object" &&
 121 |     value !== null &&
 122 |     "x" in value &&
 123 |     typeof (value as { x: unknown }).x === "number" &&
 124 |     "y" in value &&
 125 |     typeof (value as { y: unknown }).y === "number"
 126 |   );
 127 | }
 128 | 
 129 | /**
 130 |  * TanStack Charts passes the *datum* to focus/select handlers. Older or
 131 |  * wrapped versions may pass `{ datum }`. Accept both shapes so `onSelect`
 132 |  * reliably fires.
 133 |  */
 134 | function datumFromEvent(value: unknown): GrowthPoint | null {
 135 |   if (isGrowthPoint(value)) return value;
 136 |   if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || !("datum" in value)) return null;
 137 |   return isGrowthPoint((value as { datum: unknown }).datum)
 138 |     ? (value as { datum: GrowthPoint }).datum
 139 |     : null;
 140 | }
 141 | 
 142 | export function EgyptianGrowthChart({
 143 |   indicator,
 144 |   sex,
 145 |   curves,
 146 |   points = EMPTY_POINTS,
 147 |   currentBand,
 148 |   height = 360,
 149 |   width,
 150 |   aspectRatio,
 151 |   ariaLabel,
 152 |   xAxisLabel,
 153 |   onFocusChange,
 154 |   onSelect,
 155 |   className,
 156 |   style,
 157 |   showTooltip = true,
 158 |   animate = true,
 159 | }: EgyptianGrowthChartProps) {
 160 |   const xAxis = curves.xAxis;
 161 |   const resolvedAriaLabel = ariaLabel ?? defaultAriaLabel(indicator, sex);
 162 | 
 163 |   const definition = useMemo(() => {
 164 |     if (
 165 |       process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" &&
 166 |       (curves.indicator !== indicator || curves.sex !== sex)
 167 |     ) {
 168 |       console.warn(
 169 |         `[EgyptianGrowthChart] curves (${curves.indicator}/${curves.sex}/${curves.xAxis}) ` +
 170 |           `do not match props (${indicator}/${sex}). Using curves for rendering.`,
 171 |       );
 172 |     }
 173 | 
 174 |     const rows = toBandRows(curves.points);
 175 | 
 176 |     const bandMarks = [
 177 |       lineY(rows, {
 178 |         x: "x",
 179 |         y: "sd3neg",
 180 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd3neg,
 181 |         strokeWidth: 1,
 182 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
 183 |       }),
 184 |       lineY(rows, {
 185 |         x: "x",
 186 |         y: "sd2neg",
 187 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd2neg,
 188 |         strokeWidth: 1.5,
 189 |       }),
 190 |       lineY(rows, {
 191 |         x: "x",
 192 |         y: "sd1neg",
 193 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd1neg,
 194 |         strokeWidth: 1,
 195 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
 196 |       }),
 197 |       lineY(rows, {
 198 |         x: "x",
 199 |         y: "median",
 200 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.median,
 201 |         strokeWidth: 2,
 202 |       }),
 203 |       lineY(rows, {
 204 |         x: "x",
 205 |         y: "sd1",
 206 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd1,
 207 |         strokeWidth: 1,
 208 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
 209 |       }),
 210 |       lineY(rows, {
 211 |         x: "x",
 212 |         y: "sd2",
 213 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd2,
 214 |         strokeWidth: 1.5,
 215 |       }),
 216 |       lineY(rows, {
 217 |         x: "x",
 218 |         y: "sd3",
 219 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd3,
 220 |         strokeWidth: 1,
 221 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
 222 |       }),
 223 |     ];
 224 | 
 225 |     // `dot` requires a mutable array; clone so we don't mutate the prop.
 226 |     const pointData: GrowthPoint[] = points.map((p) => ({ ...p }));
 227 |     const pointMarks =
 228 |       pointData.length > 0
 229 |         ? [
 230 |             dot(pointData, {
 231 |               x: "x",
 232 |               y: "y",
 233 |               fill: "var(--growth-patient)",
 234 |               r: 4,
 235 |               stroke: "#fff",
 236 |               strokeWidth: 1.5,
 237 |             }),
 238 |           ]
 239 |         : [];
 240 | 
 241 |     const marker =
 242 |       currentBand !== null && currentBand !== undefined
 243 |         ? [
 244 |             lineY(
 245 |               [
 246 |                 {
 247 |                   x: currentBand.x,
 248 |                   y: currentBand.sd3neg,
 249 |                 },
 250 |                 { x: currentBand.x, y: currentBand.sd3 },
 251 |               ],
 252 |               {
 253 |                 x: "x",
 254 |                 y: "y",
 255 |                 stroke: "var(--growth-marker, #0ea5e9)",
 256 |                 strokeWidth: 1.5,
 257 |                 strokeDasharray: "3 3",
 258 |               },
 259 |             ),
 260 |           ]
 261 |         : [];
 262 | 
 263 |     return defineChart({
 264 |       // Draw reference bands first, then the marker, then patient dots
 265 |       // on top so they're never occluded.
 266 |       marks: [...bandMarks, ...marker, ...pointMarks],
 267 |       scales: {
 268 |         x: {
 269 |           scale: scaleLinear,
 270 |           nice: true,
 271 |           grid: true,
 272 |           axis: { label: xAxisLabel ?? axisLabel(xAxis) },
 273 |         },
 274 |         y: {
 275 |           scale: scaleLinear,
 276 |           nice: true,
 277 |           grid: true,
 278 |           axis: { label: valueLabel(indicator) },
 279 |         },
 280 |       },
 281 |       ...(showTooltip ? { tooltip } : {}),
 282 |       ...(animate ? { svgAnimation: true } : {}),
 283 |       ariaLabel: resolvedAriaLabel,
 284 |     });
 285 |   }, [
 286 |     curves,
 287 |     points,
 288 |     currentBand,
 289 |     xAxis,
 290 |     indicator,
 291 |     sex,
 292 |     resolvedAriaLabel,
 293 |     xAxisLabel,
 294 |     showTooltip,
 295 |     animate,
 296 |   ]);
 297 | 
 298 |   const handleFocusChange = (point: unknown) => {
 299 |     if (!onFocusChange) return;
 300 |     onFocusChange(datumFromEvent(point));
 301 |   };
 302 | 
 303 |   const handleSelect = (point: unknown) => {
 304 |     if (!onSelect) return;
 305 |     const datum = datumFromEvent(point);
 306 |     if (datum) onSelect(datum);
 307 |   };
 308 | 
 309 |   return (
 310 |     <div className={className} style={style}>
 311 |       <Chart
 312 |         definition={definition}
 313 |         height={height}
 314 |         {...(width !== undefined ? { width } : {})}
 315 |         {...(width === undefined && aspectRatio !== undefined ? { aspectRatio } : {})}
 316 |         ariaLabel={resolvedAriaLabel}
 317 |         {...(onFocusChange ? { onFocusChange: handleFocusChange } : {})}
 318 |         {...(onSelect ? { onSelect: handleSelect } : {})}
 319 |       />
 320 |     </div>
 321 |   );
 322 | }
 323 | 
 324 | export interface GrowthLegendProps {
 325 |   className?: string;
 326 | }
 327 | 
 328 | export function GrowthLegend({ className }: GrowthLegendProps) {
 329 |   return (
 330 |     <div
 331 |       aria-label="Growth chart reference bands"
 332 |       className={cn("text-foreground flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-sm", className)}
 333 |       role="list"
 334 |     >
 335 |       {BAND_KEYS.map((band) => (
 336 |         <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2" key={band} role="listitem">
 337 |           <span
 338 |             aria-hidden="true"
 339 |             className={cn(
 340 |               "inline-block h-0 w-5 border-t-2",
 341 |               band === "median" ? "border-solid" : "border-dashed",
 342 |             )}
 343 |             data-growth-series={band}
 344 |             style={{ borderTopColor: SERIES_COLORS[band] }}
 345 |           />
 346 |           <span>{BAND_LABELS[band]}</span>
 347 |         </div>
 348 |       ))}
 349 |       <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2" role="listitem">
 350 |         <span
 351 |           aria-hidden="true"
 352 |           className="border-background size-2 rounded-full border"
 353 |           style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--growth-patient)" }}
 354 |         />
 355 |         <span>Patient</span>
 356 |       </div>
 357 |     </div>
 358 |   );
 359 | }
```

```tsx
 101 |   { x: 0, y: 3.4 },
 102 |   { x: 6, y: 6.5 },
 103 |   { x: 12, y: 7.9 },
 104 | ];
 105 | 
 106 | const BAND_STROKES = [
 107 |   "var(--growth-series-sd3neg)",
 108 |   "var(--growth-series-sd2neg)",
 109 |   "var(--growth-series-sd1neg)",
 110 |   "var(--growth-series-median)",
 111 |   "var(--growth-series-sd1)",
 112 |   "var(--growth-series-sd2)",
 113 |   "var(--growth-series-sd3)",
 114 | ] as const;
 115 | 
 116 | beforeEach(() => {
 117 |   lineYCalls.length = 0;
 118 |   dotCalls.length = 0;
 119 |   chartCalls.length = 0;
 120 | });
 121 | 
 122 | // ── Tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 123 | 
 124 | describe("EgyptianGrowthChart", () => {
 125 |   it("renders exactly the seven band reference lines, in order", () => {
 126 |     render(
 127 |       <EgyptianGrowthChart
 128 |         curves={CURVES}
 129 |         indicator="weight-for-age"
 130 |         points={[]}
 131 |         sex="male"
 132 |         showTooltip={false}
 133 |       />,
 134 |     );
 135 | 
 136 |     // Seven `lineY` calls, each for one band.
 137 |     expect(lineYCalls).toHaveLength(7);
 138 | 
 139 |     // They're the seven band strokes, in the canonical order.
 140 |     const strokes = lineYCalls.map((call) => call.opts.stroke);
 141 |     expect(strokes).toEqual([...BAND_STROKES]);
 142 | 
 143 |     // And the definition reached `<Chart>` with all seven marks.
 144 |     expect(chartCalls).toHaveLength(1);
 145 |     expect(chartCalls[0].definition.marks).toHaveLength(7);
 146 |   });
 147 | 
 148 |   it("renders one scatter mark carrying every patient point", () => {
 149 |     render(
 150 |       <EgyptianGrowthChart
 151 |         curves={CURVES}
 152 |         indicator="weight-for-age"
 153 |         points={POINTS}
 154 |         sex="male"
 155 |         showTooltip={false}
 156 |       />,
 157 |     );
 158 | 
 159 |     expect(dotCalls).toHaveLength(1);
 160 |     expect(dotCalls[0].data).toHaveLength(POINTS.length);
 161 |     expect(dotCalls[0].data.map((p) => p.x)).toEqual(POINTS.map((p) => p.x));
 162 | 
 163 |     // 7 band lines + 1 dot = 8 marks on the chart.
 164 |     expect(chartCalls[0].definition.marks).toHaveLength(8);
 165 |   });
 166 | 
 167 |   it("adds a two-point marker at the band x when currentBand is tabulated", () => {
 168 |     render(
 169 |       <EgyptianGrowthChart
 170 |         currentBand={BAND}
 171 |         curves={CURVES}
 172 |         indicator="weight-for-age"
 173 |         points={POINTS}
 174 |         sex="male"
 175 |         showTooltip={false}
 176 |       />,
 177 |     );
 178 | 
 179 |     // The marker is the only 2-point `lineY`; the 7 band lines are 7-point.
 180 |     const marker = lineYCalls.find((call) => call.data.length === 2);
 181 |     expect(marker).toBeDefined();
 182 |     expect(marker!.data).toEqual([
 183 |       { x: BAND.x, y: BAND.sd3neg },
 184 |       { x: BAND.x, y: BAND.sd3 },
 185 |     ]);
 186 | 
 187 |     // 7 bands + 1 marker + 1 dot = 9 marks.
 188 |     expect(chartCalls[0].definition.marks).toHaveLength(9);
 189 |   });
 190 | 
 191 |   it("interpolates the marker endpoints when currentBand.x is not tabulated", () => {
 192 |     // CURVES points are at x = 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24 — 7 is not among them.
 193 |     render(
 194 |       <EgyptianGrowthChart
 195 |         currentBand={BAND_INTERPOLATED}
 196 |         curves={CURVES}
 197 |         indicator="weight-for-age"
 198 |         points={[]}
 199 |         sex="male"
 200 |         showTooltip={false}
 201 |       />,
 202 |     );
 203 | 
 204 |     const marker = lineYCalls.find((call) => call.data.length === 2);
 205 |     expect(marker).toBeDefined();
 206 |     // Both endpoints share the requested x.
 207 |     expect(marker!.data.every((p) => p.x === BAND_INTERPOLATED.x)).toBe(true);
 208 |     // The y endpoints are the sd3neg/sd3 from the *interpolated* band,
 209 |     // which the component interpolates from CURVES at x = 7.
 210 |     expect(marker!.data).toEqual([
 211 |       { x: BAND_INTERPOLATED.x, y: BAND_INTERPOLATED.sd3neg },
 212 |       { x: BAND_INTERPOLATED.x, y: BAND_INTERPOLATED.sd3 },
 213 |     ]);
 214 |   });
 215 | });
```

```tsx
  39 | type ChartableIndicator = (typeof INDICATORS)[number];

  41 | const INDICATOR_LABELS: Record<ChartableIndicator, string> = {

  46 | };
  47 | 
  48 | function isChartableIndicator(v: string | null): v is ChartableIndicator {
  49 |   return v !== null && (INDICATORS as readonly string[]).includes(v);
  50 | }
  51 | 
  52 | function rangeFor(indicator: ChartableIndicator): RangeFor<GrowthIndicator> {
  53 |   const bounds = DOMAIN[indicator];
  54 |   if (!bounds) throw new Error(`No DOMAIN coverage for ${indicator}`);
  55 |   if (bounds.length) {
  56 |     return {
  57 |       xAxis: "length",
  58 |       min: bounds.length.min,
  59 |       max: bounds.length.max,
  60 |     } as RangeFor<GrowthIndicator>;
  61 |   }
  62 |   if (bounds.age) {
  63 |     return {
  64 |       xAxis: "age",
  65 |       min: bounds.age.min,
  66 |       max: bounds.age.max,
  67 |     } as RangeFor<GrowthIndicator>;
  68 |   }
  69 |   throw new Error(`DOMAIN for ${indicator} has no axis entry`);
  70 | }

 165 |     const filtered = allowed ? rows.filter((r) => allowed.has(r.id)) : rows;
```

```tsx
   1 | // components/GrowthChart.tsx
   2 | import { areaY, defineChart, lineY } from "@tanstack/charts";
   3 | import { Chart } from "@tanstack/charts/react";
   4 | import { tooltip } from "@tanstack/charts/tooltip";
   5 | import { scaleLinear, scaleUtc } from "d3-scale";
   6 | import * as React from "react";
   7 | 
   8 | import type { ChildMeasurement, GrowthStandard } from "../types/types";
   9 | 
  10 | interface GrowthChartProps {
  11 |   standards: GrowthStandard[];
  12 |   measurements?: ChildMeasurement[];
  13 |   title: string;
  14 |   yLabel: string;
  15 |   metric: "lhfa" | "wfa";
  16 |   gender: "boys" | "girls";
  17 | }
  18 | 
  19 | // Build a single row per day holding the band edges
  20 | interface BandRow {
  21 |   child: number | null;
  22 |   day: number;
  23 |   date: Date;
  24 |   sd4neg: number;
  25 |   sd3neg: number;
  26 |   sd2neg: number;
  27 |   sd1neg: number;
  28 |   sd0: number;
  29 |   sd1: number;
  30 |   sd2: number;
  31 |   sd3: number;
  32 |   sd4: number;
  33 | }
  34 | 
  35 | // Convert day number to a representative date for scaleUtc
  36 | // Using a fixed epoch so all charts align
  37 | const EPOCH = Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1);
  38 | 
  39 | function dayToDate(day: number): Date {
  40 |   return new Date(EPOCH + day * 86_400_000);
  41 | }
  42 | 
  43 | // Merge standards with child measurements onto the same day grid
  44 | function mergeData(standards: GrowthStandard[], measurements: ChildMeasurement[]): BandRow[] {
  45 |   const childMap = new Map(measurements.map((m) => [m.day, m.value]));
  46 | 
  47 |   return standards.map((s) => ({
  48 |     day: s.day,
  49 |     date: dayToDate(s.day),
  50 |     sd4neg: s.sd4neg,
  51 |     sd3neg: s.sd3neg,
  52 |     sd2neg: s.sd2neg,
  53 |     sd1neg: s.sd1neg,
  54 |     sd0: s.sd0,
  55 |     sd1: s.sd1,
  56 |     sd2: s.sd2,
  57 |     sd3: s.sd3,
  58 |     sd4: s.sd4,
  59 |     // child value as a separate field for the line
  60 |     child: childMap.get(s.day) ?? null,
  61 |   }));
  62 | }
  63 | 
  64 | // Resolve the y domain from the reference range plus child values
  65 | function resolveDomain(rows: BandRow[]): [number, number] {
  66 |   if (rows.length === 0) return [0, 1];
  67 | 
  68 |   const values: number[] = [];
  69 |   for (const row of rows) {
  70 |     values.push(row.sd4neg, row.sd4, row.sd0);
  71 |     if (row.child !== null) values.push(row.child);
  72 |   }
  73 |   const finiteValues = values.filter(Number.isFinite);
  74 |   if (finiteValues.length === 0) return [0, 1];
  75 | 
  76 |   const min = Math.min(...finiteValues);
  77 |   const max = Math.max(...finiteValues);
  78 |   const padding = Math.max((max - min) * 0.1, Math.abs(max) * 0.02, 0.1);
  79 |   return [Math.floor(min - padding), Math.ceil(max + padding)];
  80 | }
  81 | 
  82 | // Resolve x domain based on visible day range
  83 | function resolveXDomain(rows: BandRow[]): [Date, Date] {
  84 |   if (rows.length === 0) return [dayToDate(0), dayToDate(365)];
  85 |   const first = rows[0].date;
  86 |   const last = rows[rows.length - 1].date;
  87 |   return first.getTime() === last.getTime() ? [first, dayToDate(rows[0].day + 1)] : [first, last];
  88 | }
  89 | 
  90 | export function WhoGrowthChart({
  91 |   standards,
  92 |   measurements = [],
  93 |   title,
  94 |   yLabel,
  95 |   metric,
  96 |   gender,
  97 | }: GrowthChartProps) {
  98 |   const rows = React.useMemo(() => mergeData(standards, measurements), [standards, measurements]);
  99 | 
 100 |   const domain = React.useMemo(() => resolveDomain(rows), [rows]);
 101 |   const xDomain = React.useMemo(() => resolveXDomain(rows), [rows]);
 102 | 
 103 |   const definition = React.useMemo(
 104 |     () =>
 105 |       defineChart({
 106 |         tooltip: {
 107 |           use: tooltip,
 108 |           placement: ["top", "right", "left"],
 109 |           format: (point) => {
 110 |             const day = point.datum.day;
 111 |             const month = Math.round(day / 30.44);
 112 |             const label = day < 30 ? `${day}d` : `${month}mo (${day}d)`;
 113 |             return `${label}\n${point.yValue.toFixed(1)} ${yLabel}`;
 114 |           },
 115 |         },
 116 |         marks: [
 117 |           areaY(rows, {
 118 |             id: "band-outer",
 119 |             x: "date",
 120 |             y1: "sd2neg",
 121 |             y2: "sd2",
 122 |             fill: "#dbeafe",
 123 |             fillOpacity: 0.55,
 124 |           }),
 125 |           areaY(rows, {
 126 |             id: "band-inner",
 127 |             x: "date",
 128 |             y1: "sd1neg",
 129 |             y2: "sd1",
 130 |             fill: "#93c5fd",
 131 |             fillOpacity: 0.45,
 132 |           }),
 133 |           // Median reference line
 134 |           lineY(rows, {
 135 |             id: "median",
 136 |             x: "date",
 137 |             y: "sd0",
 138 |             stroke: "#1d4ed8",
 139 |             strokeWidth: 2,
 140 |             strokeDasharray: "6 3",
 141 |           }),
 142 |           // ±2 SD boundary lines
 143 |           lineY(rows, {
 144 |             id: "sd2-upper",
 145 |             x: "date",
 146 |             y: "sd2",
 147 |             stroke: "#60a5fa",
 148 |             strokeWidth: 1.25,
 149 |           }),
 150 |           lineY(rows, {
 151 |             id: "sd2-lower",
 152 |             x: "date",
 153 |             y: "sd2neg",
 154 |             stroke: "#60a5fa",
 155 |             strokeWidth: 1.25,
 156 |           }),
 157 |           // Child measurements (only if provided)
 158 |           ...(measurements.length > 0
 159 |             ? [
 160 |                 lineY(rows, {
 161 |                   id: "child",
 162 |                   x: "date",
 163 |                   y: "child",
 164 |                   stroke: "#dc2626",
 165 |                   strokeWidth: 2.5,
 166 |                   points: true,
 167 |                 }),
 168 |               ]
 169 |             : []),
 170 |         ],
 171 |         scales: {
 172 |           x: {
 173 |             scale: scaleUtc().domain(xDomain),
 174 |             axis: {
 175 |               line: false,
 176 |               ticks: {
 177 |                 count: 6,
 178 |                 format: (d: Date) => {
 179 |                   const day = Math.round((d.getTime() - EPOCH) / 86_400_000);
 180 |                   const month = Math.round(day / 30.44);
 181 |                   return day < 30 ? `${day}d` : `${month}mo`;
 182 |                 },
 183 |                 size: 0,
 184 |                 padding: 8,
 185 |               },
 186 |               tickLabels: { thin: { priority: "ends", minGap: 24 } },
 187 |             },
 188 |           },
 189 |           y: {
 190 |             scale: scaleLinear().domain(domain),
 191 |             grid: true,
 192 |             axis: {
 193 |               line: false,
 194 |               ticks: {
 195 |                 count: 5,
 196 |                 format: (v: number) => v.toFixed(0),
 197 |                 size: 0,
 198 |                 padding: 8,
 199 |               },
 200 |               tickLabels: { thin: { priority: "ends", minGap: 16 } },
 201 |               label: yLabel,
 202 |             },
 203 |           },
 204 |         },
 205 |         margin: { top: 12, right: 16, bottom: 32, left: 44 },
 206 |         clip: true,
 207 |       }),
 208 |     [rows, domain, xDomain, yLabel, measurements.length],
 209 |   );
 210 | 
 211 |   const metricLabel = metric === "lhfa" ? "Length/Height" : "Weight";
 212 |   const genderLabel = gender === "boys" ? "Boys" : "Girls";
 213 | 
 214 |   return (
 215 |     <section className="space-y-2">
 216 |       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
 217 |         <div>
 218 |           <h3 className="font-medium">{title}</h3>
 219 |           <p className=" text-sm">
 220 |             WHO {metricLabel}-for-age · {genderLabel} · shaded = ±1 SD / ±2 SD
 221 |           </p>
 222 |         </div>
 223 |         {measurements.length > 0 && (
 224 |           <span className=" text-sm">{measurements.length} measurements</span>
 225 |         )}
 226 |       </div>
 227 |       <Chart
 228 |         ariaLabel={`${metricLabel}-for-age chart for ${genderLabel} with WHO standard deviation bands`}
 229 |         definition={definition}
 230 |         height={380}
 231 |         initialWidth={760}
 232 |       />
 233 |     </section>
 234 |   );
 235 | }
```

```ts
  81 | 
  82 | const METRIC_BY_INDICATOR: Record<EgyptianLmsIndicator, GrowthMetric> = {
  83 |   "weight-for-age": "wfa",
  84 |   "length-for-age": "lhfa",
  85 |   "weight-for-length": "wfl",
  86 |   "bmi-for-age": "bmifa",
  87 | };
  88 | 
  89 | function emptyMetrics(): Record<Gender, Record<GrowthMetric, LmsPoint[]>> {
  90 |   const metrics = (): Record<GrowthMetric, LmsPoint[]> => ({
  91 |     wfa: [],
  92 |     lhfa: [],
  93 |     wfl: [],
  94 |     bmifa: [],
  95 |   });
  96 |   return { boy: metrics(), girl: metrics() };
  97 | }
  98 | 
  99 | function buildEgyptianLmsData(): Record<Gender, Record<GrowthMetric, LmsPoint[]>> {
 100 |   const data = emptyMetrics();
 101 | 
 102 |   for (const row of LMS_SEED) {
 103 |     if (row.indicator === "head-circumference-for-age") {
 104 |       throw new Error("The Egyptian LMS seed does not contain head circumference references.");
 105 |     }
 106 |     const metric = METRIC_BY_INDICATOR[row.indicator];
 107 |     const gender: Gender = row.sex === "male" ? "boy" : "girl";
 108 |     const isLengthForAge = row.indicator === "length-for-age";
 109 |     data[gender][metric].push({
 110 |       x: row.xValue,
 111 |       l: row.l,
 112 |       m: row.m,
 113 |       s: isLengthForAge ? row.s * row.m : row.s,
 114 |       sUnit: isLengthForAge ? "sd" : "cv",
 115 |       sd3neg: valueAtZScore(row, -3),
 116 |       sd2neg: valueAtZScore(row, -2),
 117 |       sd1neg: valueAtZScore(row, -1),
 118 |       sd0: valueAtZScore(row, 0),
 119 |       sd1pos: valueAtZScore(row, 1),
 120 |       sd2pos: valueAtZScore(row, 2),
 121 |       sd3pos: valueAtZScore(row, 3),
 122 |     });
 123 |   }
 124 | 
 125 |   return data;
 126 | }
 127 | 
 128 | export const EGYPTIAN_LMS_DATA = buildEgyptianLmsData();
```

```ts
  88 | export function filterLmsByTimeframe<T extends { x: number }>(
  89 |   rows: T[],
  90 |   metric: GrowthMetric,
  91 |   timeframe: TimeframeOption,
  92 | ): T[] {
  93 |   const meta = GROWTH_METRIC_METADATA[metric];
  94 |   if (meta.fixedRange) {
  95 |     return rows.filter((r) => r.x >= meta.minX && r.x <= meta.maxX);
  96 |   }
  97 |   const window = TIMEFRAME_WINDOWS[timeframe === "all" ? "0-19" : timeframe];
  98 |   return rows.filter((r) => r.x >= window.min && r.x <= window.max);
```

```ts
   1 | import type { z } from "zod";
   2 | 
   3 | // src/features/growth/queries.ts
   4 | import { queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   5 | 
   6 | import type { GrowthChartRequestSchema } from "./schema";
   7 | import type { RangeFor } from "./types/sheets";
   8 | import type { ChartBand, ChartCurves, Indicator, IndicatorSeriesRow, Sex } from "./types/types";
   9 | 
  10 | import {
  11 |   fetchChildMeasurementsFn,
  12 |   fetchGrowthChartBand,
  13 |   fetchGrowthChartCurves,
  14 |   fetchGrowthChartCurvesMany,
  15 |   fetchGrowthStandardsFn,
  16 |   fetchIndicatorSeries,
  17 |   fetchLatestPanel,
  18 | } from "./functions";
  19 | 
  20 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  21 | // Types
  22 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  23 | 
  24 | export type SeriesRow = IndicatorSeriesRow;
  25 | 
  26 | type Range = { xAxis: "age" | "length"; min: number; max: number };
  27 | 
  28 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  29 | // Query key factory
  30 | //
  31 | // Every key starts with a stable prefix:
  32 | //   - "curves", "band", "curves-many", "growth-standards"  → reference data
  33 | //   - "series", "latest"                                   → patient-scoped
  34 | //
  35 | // `band` and `curves` keys include the full range so two charts at different
  36 | // ranges don't share cache. `band` additionally rounds `x` to 0.1 so hovering
  37 | // 12.0 → 12.04 does not trigger a refetch.
  38 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  39 | 
  40 | export const growthKeys = {
  41 |   // ── Reference data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  42 |   standards: (metric: "lhfa" | "wfa", gender: "boys" | "girls") =>
  43 |     ["growth-standards", metric, gender] as const,
  44 | 
  45 |   curves: (indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex, r: Range) =>
  46 |     ["curves", indicator, sex, r.xAxis, r.min, r.max] as const,
  47 | 
  48 |   curvesMany: (keyedRequests: ReadonlyArray<string>) => ["curves-many", keyedRequests] as const,
  49 | 
  50 |   /**
  51 |    * Band at a specific x. `x` is rounded to one decimal so small hover
  52 |    * jitter doesn't invalidate the cache. `null` produces a `"disabled"`
  53 |    * segment that can never collide with a real (numeric) x.
  54 |    */
  55 |   band: (indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex, r: Range, x: number | null) =>
  56 |     x == null
  57 |       ? (["band", "disabled", indicator, sex, r.xAxis] as const)
  58 |       : (["band", indicator, sex, r.xAxis, r.min, r.max, Math.round(x * 10) / 10] as const),
  59 | 
  60 |   // ── Patient-scoped ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  61 |   series: (patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) => ["series", patientId, indicator] as const,
  62 | 
  63 |   seriesRoot: (patientId: string) => ["series", patientId] as const,
  64 | 
  65 |   latestPanel: (patientId: string) => ["latest", patientId] as const,
  66 | 
  67 |   childMeasurements: (patientId: string, metric: "lhfa" | "wfa") =>
  68 |     ["child-measurements", patientId, metric] as const,
  69 | } as const;
  70 | 
  71 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  72 | // Chart request helper
  73 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  74 | 
  75 | function toChartRequest<I extends Indicator>(
  76 |   indicator: I,
  77 |   sex: Sex,
  78 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
  79 | ): z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema> {
  80 |   if (indicator === "weight-for-length") {
  81 |     return {
  82 |       indicator: "weight-for-length",
  83 |       sex,
  84 |       range: range as { xAxis: "length"; min: number; max: number },
  85 |     } satisfies z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema>;
  86 |   }
  87 |   return {
  88 |     indicator: indicator as Exclude<Indicator, "weight-for-length">,
  89 |     sex,
  90 |     range: range as { xAxis: "age"; min: number; max: number },
  91 |   } satisfies z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema>;
  92 | }
  93 | 
  94 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  95 | // Reference data query options
  96 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  97 | 
  98 | /**
  99 |  * WHO reference tables for one metric+gender. Seed data — never changes
 100 |  * between deploys, so it lives in cache indefinitely.
 101 |  */
 102 | export function growthStandardsQuery(metric: "lhfa" | "wfa", gender: "boys" | "girls") {
 103 |   return queryOptions({
 104 |     queryKey: growthKeys.standards(metric, gender),
 105 |     queryFn: () => fetchGrowthStandardsFn({ data: { metric, gender } }),
 106 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 107 |   });
 108 | }
 109 | 
 110 | export function getGrowthChartCurvesQuery<I extends Indicator>(
 111 |   indicator: I,
 112 |   sex: Sex,
 113 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
 114 | ) {
 115 |   return queryOptions<ChartCurves>({
 116 |     queryKey: growthKeys.curves(indicator, sex, range),
 117 |     queryFn: async (): Promise<ChartCurves> => {
 118 |       return fetchGrowthChartCurves({
 119 |         data: toChartRequest(indicator, sex, range),
 120 |       });
 121 |     },
 122 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 123 |   });
 124 | }
 125 | 
 126 | /**
 127 |  * Fetch several curves in parallel. The key is sorted by request identity
 128 |  * so callers can pass `requests` in any order and still hit cache.
 129 |  */
 130 | export function manyCurvesQuery(requests: ReadonlyArray<z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema>>) {
 131 |   const keyedRequests = requests
 132 |     .map((r) => ({
 133 |       indicator: r.indicator,
 134 |       sex: r.sex,
 135 |       xAxis: r.range.xAxis,
 136 |       min: r.range.min,
 137 |       max: r.range.max,
 138 |     }))
 139 |     .toSorted((a, b) => {
 140 |       const k = (v: typeof a) => `${v.indicator}|${v.sex}|${v.xAxis}|${v.min}|${v.max}`;
 141 |       return k(a).localeCompare(k(b));
 142 |     });
 143 | 
 144 |   return queryOptions({
 145 |     queryKey: growthKeys.curvesMany(keyedRequests.map((r) => JSON.stringify(r))),
 146 |     queryFn: async (): Promise<ChartCurves[]> => {
 147 |       return fetchGrowthChartCurvesMany({ data: { requests } });
 148 |     },
 149 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 150 |   });
 151 | }
 152 | 
 153 | /**
 154 |  * Band for the current marker on a chart.
 155 |  *
 156 |  * Two branches, distinguished by whether `x` is known:
 157 |  *   - `x == null`: disabled query. The key includes a literal `"disabled"`
 158 |  *     segment so it can never collide with a real band key. The queryFn
 159 |  *     returns `null` so the caller gets a well-typed `data: null` while
 160 |  *     disabled.
 161 |  *   - `x != null`: the real band query, keyed on the rounded x.
 162 |  */
 163 | export function bandQuery<I extends Indicator>(
 164 |   indicator: I,
 165 |   sex: Sex,
 166 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
 167 |   x: number | null,
 168 | ) {
 169 |   if (x == null) {
 170 |     return queryOptions<ChartBand | null>({
 171 |       queryKey: growthKeys.band(indicator, sex, range, null),
 172 |       queryFn: async () => null,
 173 |       enabled: false as const,
 174 |       staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 175 |     });
 176 |   }
 177 |   return queryOptions<ChartBand | null>({
 178 |     queryKey: growthKeys.band(indicator, sex, range, x),
 179 |     queryFn: async (): Promise<ChartBand | null> => {
 180 |       return fetchGrowthChartBand({
 181 |         data: { ...toChartRequest(indicator, sex, range), x },
 182 |       });
 183 |     },
 184 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 185 |   });
 186 | }
 187 | 
 188 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 189 | // Patient-scoped query options
 190 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 191 | 
 192 | export function seriesQuery(patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) {
 193 |   return queryOptions({
 194 |     queryKey: growthKeys.series(patientId, indicator),
 195 |     queryFn: (): Promise<IndicatorSeriesRow[]> =>
 196 |       fetchIndicatorSeries({
 197 |         data: { patientId, indicator },
 198 |       }),
 199 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 200 |   });
 201 | }
 202 | 
 203 | export const getGrowthSeriesQuery = seriesQuery;
 204 | 
 205 | export function latestPanelQuery(patientId: string) {
 206 |   return queryOptions({
 207 |     queryKey: growthKeys.latestPanel(patientId),
 208 |     queryFn: () => fetchLatestPanel({ data: { patientId } }),
 209 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 210 |   });
 211 | }
 212 | 
 213 | export function childMeasurementsQuery(patientId: string, metric: "lhfa" | "wfa") {
 214 |   return queryOptions({
 215 |     queryKey: growthKeys.childMeasurements(patientId, metric),
 216 |     queryFn: () => fetchChildMeasurementsFn({ data: { patientId, metric } }),
 217 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
 218 |   });
 219 | }
```

```ts
 233 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 234 | // Lookup helpers
 235 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 236 | 
 237 | /**
 238 |  * Convert a continuous z-score into the nearest integer band key.
 239 |  * Clamps to [-3, 3] so out-of-range values still resolve to a band.
 240 |  */
 241 | export function zToBand(z: number): -3 | -2 | -1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 {
 242 |   if (z < -3) return -3;
 243 |   if (z < -2) return -2;
 244 |   if (z < -1) return -1;
 245 |   if (z < 1) return 0;
 246 |   if (z < 2) return 1;
 247 |   if (z < 3) return 2;
 248 |   return 3;
 249 | }
 250 | 
 251 | /**
 252 |  * Look up the interpretation entry for a given indicator + continuous z.
 253 |  *
 254 |  * Every `Indicator` × band cell is populated, so the return type is
 255 |  * `GrowthBand` (not `GrowthBand | undefined`). If you add an indicator to
 256 |  * `Indicator` without adding it to `growthInterpretations`, this file
 257 |  * stops compiling — which is the correct behaviour.
 258 |  */
 259 | // inside getGrowthBand
 260 | export function getGrowthBand(indicator: Indicator, z: number): GrowthBand {
 261 |   const band = growthInterpretations[zToBand(z)][indicator];
 262 |   if (!band) {
 263 |     const severity: GrowthSeverity =
 264 |       indicator === "head-circumference-for-age" && z < -2
 265 |         ? "deficit"
 266 |         : indicator === "head-circumference-for-age" && z > 2
 267 |           ? "excess"
 268 |           : "normal";
 269 |     return {
 270 |       description: `${indicator} (${z.toFixed(1)} SD)`,
 271 |       image: "",
 272 |       color: "#6b7280",
 273 |       severity,
 274 |     };
 275 |   }
 276 |   return band;
 277 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/types/growth/legacy.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // ⚠️  DEPRECATED — migrate to the functions in `./lms` and delete this file.
   4 | //
   5 | // These helpers predate the current `lms.ts` API. They work, but they
   6 | // duplicate concepts (z-score, percentile, classification, age) that have
   7 | // canonical implementations elsewhere. Every import from this module is a
   8 | // TODO. Grep for `from '~/types/growth/legacy'` to find them:
   9 | //
  10 | //   - `components/forms/VisitForm.tsx`              uses calculateExactAgeInMonths
  11 | //   - `components/tables/patients-table.tsx`        uses calculateExactAgeInMonths
  12 | //   - `db/seed.ts`                                   uses calculateExactAgeInMonths
  13 | //   - anything still using `calculateZScore` (it returns 0 on bad input,
  14 | //     unlike `zScoreForValue`, which throws — see the note below)
  15 | //
  16 | // Migration map:
  17 | //   calculateZScore(v, l, m, s)  → zScoreForValue({ l, m, s }, v)
  18 | //   zScoreToPercentile(z)         → percentileFromZ(z)
  19 | //   calculateExactAgeInMonths(d, a) → decimalMonthsBetween(d, a)
  20 | //   classifyZScore(ind, z)        → classify(indicatorFromLegacy(ind), z)
  21 | //
  22 | // `classifyZScore` takes the *legacy* indicator spellings (`weight_for_age`,
  23 | // `height_for_age`, `bmi_for_age`) — the canonical `Indicator` union uses
  24 | // kebab-case. Use `classify()` with the canonical spelling instead.
  25 | 
  26 | export interface LmsParameters {
  27 |   l: number;
  28 |   m: number;
  29 |   s: number;
  30 | }
  31 | 
  32 | export type ClinicalAlertSeverity = "critical" | "warning" | "normal";
  33 | 
  34 | export interface LegacyZScoreResult {
  35 |   zScore: number;
  36 |   percentile: number;
  37 |   classification: string;
  38 |   severity: ClinicalAlertSeverity;
  39 | }
  40 | 
  41 | /**
  42 |  * @deprecated Use `zScoreForValue` from `./lms`. That version throws on
  43 |  * invalid input (which surfaces data-integrity bugs at the call site);
  44 |  * this one returns `0` — silently misclassifying junk as "median".
  45 |  */
  46 | export function calculateZScore(value: number, l: number, m: number, s: number): number {
  47 |   if (value <= 0 || m <= 0 || s <= 0) return 0;
  48 | 
  49 |   let z: number;
  50 |   if (Math.abs(l) < 0.0001) {
  51 |     z = Math.log(value / m) / s;
  52 |   } else {
  53 |     z = ((value / m) ** l - 1) / (l * s);
  54 |   }
  55 |   return Number(z.toFixed(2));
  56 | }
  57 | 
  58 | /**
  59 |  * @deprecated Use `percentileFromZ` from `./lms`. That version uses the
  60 |  * same CDF but is documented against the Abramowitz & Stegun 26.2.17
  61 |  * coefficients this one is based on; the difference is that the canonical
  62 |  * one clamps to [0, 100] and this one returns raw `cdf * 100`.
  63 |  */
  64 | export function zScoreToPercentile(z: number): number {
  65 |   const p = 0.3275911;
  66 |   const a1 = 0.254829592;
  67 |   const a2 = -0.284496736;
  68 |   const a3 = 1.421413741;
  69 |   const a4 = -1.453152027;
  70 |   const a5 = 1.061405429;
  71 | 
  72 |   const sign = z < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  73 |   const x = Math.abs(z) / Math.SQRT2;
  74 |   const t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * x);
  75 |   const erf = 1.0 - ((((a5 * t + a4) * t + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-x * x);
  76 | 
  77 |   const cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + sign * erf);
  78 |   return Number((cdf * 100).toFixed(1));
  79 | }
  80 | 
  81 | /**
  82 |  * @deprecated Use `decimalMonthsBetween` from `./lms`. Same math, clearer
  83 |  * name. Kept only because three modules still import it by the old name;
  84 |  * migrate them and delete this.
  85 |  */
  86 | export function calculateExactAgeInMonths(dob: Date, atDate: Date): number {
  87 |   const diffMs = atDate.getTime() - dob.getTime();
  88 |   const days = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
  89 |   return Number((days / 30.4375).toFixed(2));
  90 | }
  91 | 
  92 | /**
  93 |  * @deprecated Use `classify` from `./lms` with a canonical `Indicator`
  94 |  * (`weight-for-age`, `length-for-age`, `bmi-for-age`). This version takes
  95 |  * the legacy spellings and returns a plain string rather than a
  96 |  * structured `Classification`.
  97 |  */
  98 | export function classifyZScore(
  99 |   indicator: "weight_for_age" | "height_for_age" | "bmi_for_age",
 100 |   z: number,
 101 | ): { classification: string; severity: ClinicalAlertSeverity } {
 102 |   if (indicator === "height_for_age") {
 103 |     if (z < -3) return { classification: "Severe Stunting", severity: "critical" };
 104 |     if (z < -2) return { classification: "Stunting", severity: "warning" };
 105 |     if (z > 3) return { classification: "Tall Stature", severity: "warning" };
 106 |     return { classification: "Normal Height", severity: "normal" };
 107 |   }
 108 | 
 109 |   if (indicator === "bmi_for_age" || indicator === "weight_for_age") {
 110 |     if (z < -3) return { classification: "Severe Underweight", severity: "critical" };
 111 |     if (z < -2) return { classification: "Underweight / Wasting", severity: "warning" };
 112 |     if (z > 3) return { classification: "Severe Obesity", severity: "critical" };
 113 |     if (z > 2) return { classification: "Overweight / Obesity", severity: "warning" };
 114 |     if (z > 1)
 115 |       return {
 116 |         classification: "Possible Risk of Overweight",
 117 |         severity: "normal",
 118 |       };
 119 |     return { classification: "Normal / Healthy Weight", severity: "normal" };
 120 |   }
 121 | 
 122 |   return { classification: "Normal", severity: "normal" };
 123 | }
```

`features/growth/types/lms.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // growth/types/lms.ts
   2 | 
   3 | import type { Classification, Indicator, LmsTriple } from "./types";
   4 | 
   5 | import { LmsDomainError } from "./types";
   6 | 
   7 | function assertLms(lms: LmsTriple): void {
   8 |   const { l, m, s } = lms;
   9 |   if (!Number.isFinite(l) || !Number.isFinite(m) || !Number.isFinite(s)) {
  10 |     throw new LmsDomainError("LMS parameters must be finite", { ...lms });
  11 |   }
  12 |   if (m <= 0) throw new LmsDomainError("LMS M must be > 0", { ...lms });
  13 |   if (s <= 0) throw new LmsDomainError("LMS S must be > 0", { ...lms });
  14 | }
  15 | 
  16 | export function valueAtZScore(lms: LmsTriple, z: number): number {
  17 |   assertLms(lms);
  18 |   if (!Number.isFinite(z)) throw new LmsDomainError("zScore must be finite", { z, ...lms });
  19 |   const { l, m, s } = lms;
  20 |   if (l === 0) return m * Math.exp(s * z);
  21 |   const base = 1 + l * s * z;
  22 |   if (base <= 0) {
  23 |     throw new LmsDomainError(`1 + L·S·Z must be > 0 (got L=${l}, S=${s}, Z=${z} → ${base})`, {
  24 |       ...lms,
  25 |       z,
  26 |       base,
  27 |     });
  28 |   }
  29 |   return m * base ** (1 / l);
  30 | }
  31 | 
  32 | export function zScoreForValue(lms: LmsTriple, value: number): number {
  33 |   assertLms(lms);
  34 |   if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
  35 |     throw new LmsDomainError("measured value must be > 0 and finite", {
  36 |       value,
  37 |       ...lms,
  38 |     });
  39 |   }
  40 |   const { l, m, s } = lms;
  41 |   if (l === 0) return Math.log(value / m) / s;
  42 |   return ((value / m) ** l - 1) / (l * s);
  43 | }
  44 | 
  45 | export function percentileFromZ(z: number): number {
  46 |   if (!Number.isFinite(z)) return z > 0 ? 100 : 0;
  47 |   if (z > 8) return 100;
  48 |   if (z < -8) return 0;
  49 |   const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(z));
  50 |   const d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp((-z * z) / 2);
  51 |   const p =
  52 |     d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
  53 |   const pct = z >= 0 ? (1 - p) * 100 : p * 100;
  54 |   return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, pct));
  55 | }
  56 | 
  57 | export function interpolateLms(
  58 |   targetX: number,
  59 |   lower: { x: number; l: number; m: number; s: number },
  60 |   upper: { x: number; l: number; m: number; s: number },
  61 | ): LmsTriple {
  62 |   if (!(lower.x < upper.x)) {
  63 |     throw new LmsDomainError("interpolateLms requires lower.x < upper.x", {
  64 |       lowerX: lower.x,
  65 |       upperX: upper.x,
  66 |     });
  67 |   }
  68 |   if (targetX < lower.x || targetX > upper.x) {
  69 |     throw new LmsDomainError("interpolateLms targetX is outside [lower.x, upper.x]", {
  70 |       targetX,
  71 |       lowerX: lower.x,
  72 |       upperX: upper.x,
  73 |     });
  74 |   }
  75 |   if (targetX === lower.x) return { l: lower.l, m: lower.m, s: lower.s };
  76 |   if (targetX === upper.x) return { l: upper.l, m: upper.m, s: upper.s };
  77 |   const f = (targetX - lower.x) / (upper.x - lower.x);
  78 |   return {
  79 |     l: lower.l + f * (upper.l - lower.l),
  80 |     m: lower.m + f * (upper.m - lower.m),
  81 |     s: lower.s + f * (upper.s - lower.s),
  82 |   };
  83 | }
  84 | 
  85 | export function classify(indicator: Indicator, z: number): Classification {
```

```ts
 219 | // Make sure head-circumference-for-age always has an entry, even if empty,
 220 | // so DOMAIN[indicator] is never `undefined`.
 221 | export const DOMAIN: DomainMap = (() => {
 222 |   const base = SHEETS.reduce<DomainMap>((acc, sheet) => {
 223 |     acc[sheet.indicator] ??= {};
 224 |     const entry = acc[sheet.indicator];
 225 |     const existing = entry[sheet.xAxis];
 226 |     if (existing) {
 227 |       existing.min = Math.min(existing.min, sheet.minX);
 228 |       existing.max = Math.max(existing.max, sheet.maxX);
 229 |     } else {
 230 |       entry[sheet.xAxis] = { min: sheet.minX, max: sheet.maxX };
 231 |     }
 232 |     return acc;
 233 |   }, {} as DomainMap);
 234 |

 236 |   base["head-circumference-for-age"] ??= {};
```

```tsx
 107 |   return (

 110 |       className="text-emerald-500"
 111 |       fill="currentColor"
 112 |       height="16"
 113 |       viewBox={`0 0 ${bars.length * 4} 16`}
 114 |       width="32"
 115 |     >

 119 |     </svg>

 123 | function CoverageBar({
 124 |   data,
 125 |   isLoading,
 126 | }: {
 127 |   data: ImmunizationCoverage["byVaccine"];
 128 |   isLoading: boolean;
 129 | }) {
 130 |   if (isLoading) {
 131 |     return <div className="bg-muted/50 h-9 w-full animate-pulse rounded-lg" />;
 132 |   }
 133 |   if (data.length === 0) {
 134 |     return <p className=" text-sm">No immunization data yet.</p>;
 135 |   }
 136 | 
 137 |   const total = data.reduce((n, v) => n + v.given + v.due + v.overdue, 0);
 138 |   if (total === 0) {
 139 |     return null;
 140 |   }
 141 | 
 142 |   return (
 143 |     <div
 144 |       aria-label="Coverage by vaccine"
 145 |       className="flex w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border"
 146 |       role="group"
 147 |     >
 148 |       {data.map((v) => {
 149 |         const segmentWidth = ((v.given + v.due + v.overdue) / total) * 100;
 150 |         return (
 151 |           <Tooltip key={v.vaccineKey}>
 152 |             <TooltipTrigger
 153 |               render={
 154 |                 <div
 155 |                   className="relative flex h-9 min-w-0 items-center justify-center border-r last:border-r-0"
 156 |                   style={{ width: `${segmentWidth}%` }}
 157 |                 />
 158 |               }
 159 |             >
 160 |               <div className="bg-muted absolute inset-0" />
 161 |               <div
 162 |                 className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-emerald-500/70"
 163 |                 style={{ width: `${v.pct}%` }}
 164 |               />
 165 |               <span className="relative z-10 truncate  text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-white uppercase mix-blend-difference">
 166 |                 {v.vaccineKey}
 167 |               </span>
 168 |             </TooltipTrigger>
 169 |             <TooltipContent side="bottom">
 170 |               <div className="grid gap-1 text-xs">
 171 |                 <span className="font-medium">{v.vaccineName}</span>
 172 |                 <span>
 173 |                   <Badge variant="success">{v.given} given</Badge>{" "}
 174 |                   <Badge variant="warning">{v.due} due</Badge>{" "}
 175 |                   <Badge variant="destructive">{v.overdue} overdue</Badge>
 176 |                 </span>
 177 |                 <span className="">{v.pct}% coverage</span>
 178 |               </div>
 179 |             </TooltipContent>
 180 |           </Tooltip>
 181 |         );
 182 |       })}
 183 |     </div>
 184 |   );
 185 | }
```

```tsx
  32 |     label: "Given",
  33 |   },

  36 |     Icon: CircleIcon,
  37 |     label: "Due",
  38 |   },

  41 |     Icon: CircleAlertIcon,

  45 |     className: "bg-muted ",

  47 |     label: "Refused",
  48 |   },
  49 | } as const;
  50 | 
  51 | // ── Column widths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  52 | //
  53 | // Tailwind needs static class names to generate CSS. `w-${12 + n * 3}`
  54 | // produces a string at runtime that Tailwind never generated, so those
  55 | // columns get no width and the table layout breaks. This map lists the
  56 | // widths we actually use, bucketed by dose count.
  57 | 
  58 | const DOSE_COLUMN_WIDTH: Record<number, string> = {
  59 |   0: "w-12",
  60 |   1: "w-14",
  61 |   2: "w-16",
  62 |   3: "w-18",
  63 |   4: "w-20",
  64 |   5: "w-24",
  65 | };
  66 | 
  67 | function doseColumnWidth(doses: number | undefined): string {
  68 |   return DOSE_COLUMN_WIDTH[doses ?? 0] ?? "w-24";
  69 | }
  70 | 
  71 | export function ImmunizationMatrix({ clinicId, ageBracket, onlyOverdue }: ImmunizationMatrixProps) {
  72 |   // ── read via factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 |   const query = useQuery(immunizationMatrixQuery(clinicId, { ageBracket, onlyOverdue }));
  74 | 
  75 |   if (query.isError) {
  76 |     return (
  77 |       <SectionState
  78 |         action={
  79 |           <button
  80 |             className="text-sm underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
  81 |             onClick={() => void query.refetch()}
  82 |             type="button"
  83 |           >
  84 |             Try again
  85 |           </button>
  86 |         }
  87 |         description={query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "Failed to load."}
  88 |         icon={CircleAlertIcon}
  89 |         title="Could not load immunization matrix"
  90 |       />
  91 |     );
  92 |   }
  93 | 
  94 |   if (query.isPending) {
  95 |     return <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full" />;
  96 |   }
  97 | 
  98 |   const { vaccines, rows } = query.data ?? { vaccines: [], rows: [] };
  99 |   if (rows.length === 0) {
 100 |     return (
 101 |       <div className=" rounded-md border border-dashed py-12 text-center text-sm">
 102 |         No patients match this filter.
 103 |       </div>
 104 |     );
 105 |   }
 106 | 
 107 |   return (
 108 |     <div className="relative overflow-x-auto rounded-md border">
 109 |       <Table aria-label="Immunization matrix" layout="fixed">
 110 |         <TableColGroup
 111 |           columns={[
 112 |             { width: "w-56" },
 113 |             ...vaccines.map((v) => ({
 114 |               width: doseColumnWidth(v.doses),
 115 |             })),
 116 |           ]}
 117 |         />
 118 |         <TableHeader>
 119 |           <TableRow>
 120 |             <TableHead variant="pinned">Patient</TableHead>
 121 |             {vaccines.map((v) => (
 122 |               <TableHead className="text-center" colSpan={v.doses ?? 0} key={v.vaccineKey}>
 123 |                 <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 124 |                   <SyringeIcon aria-hidden="true" className=" size-3" />
 125 |                   {v.vaccineKey.toUpperCase()}
 126 |                 </span>
 127 |               </TableHead>
 128 |             ))}
 129 |           </TableRow>
 130 |         </TableHeader>
 131 |         <TableBody>
 132 |           {rows.map((row) => (
 133 |             <MatrixTableRow key={row.patientId} row={row} vaccines={vaccines} />
 134 |           ))}
 135 |         </TableBody>
 136 |       </Table>
 137 |     </div>
 138 |   );
 139 | }
 140 | 
 141 | function MatrixTableRow({ row, vaccines }: { row: MatrixRow; vaccines: MatrixVaccine[] }) {
 142 |   return (
 143 |     <TableRow variant="subtle" className="cursor-pointer">
 144 |       <TableCell variant="pinned">
 145 |         <Link
 146 |           className="flex min-w-0 flex-col"
 147 |           params={{ patientId: row.patientId }}
 148 |           to="/app/immunizations/$patientId"
 149 |         >
 150 |           <span className="truncate font-medium">
 151 |             {row.firstName} {row.lastName}
 152 |           </span>
 153 |           <span className=" font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{row.mrn}</span>
 154 |         </Link>
 155 |       </TableCell>
 156 |       {vaccines.flatMap((v) =>
 157 |         Array.from({ length: v.doses ?? 0 }, (_, i) => {
 158 |           const key = `${v.vaccineKey}-${i + 1}`;
 159 |           const status = row.cells[key];
 160 |           return (
 161 |             <TableCell className=" text-center" key={key}>
 162 |               {status ? <StatusCell status={status} /> : <span className="">—</span>}
 163 |             </TableCell>
 164 |           );
 165 |         }),
 166 |       )}
 167 |     </TableRow>
 168 |   );
 169 | }
 170 | 
 171 | function StatusCell({ status }: { status: keyof typeof STATUS_STYLES }) {
 172 |   const { className, Icon, label } = STATUS_STYLES[status];
 173 |   return (
 174 |     <span aria-label={label} className={className} role="img" title={label}>
 175 |       <Icon aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" />
 176 |     </span>
 177 |   );
 178 | }
```

```ts
   2 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   3 | import { getRequest, setResponseStatus } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
   4 | import { z } from "zod";

   6 | import { and, db, eq } from "#/db/index.ts";

  11 | import {
  12 |   getCoverage,
  13 |   getImmunizationMatrix,
  14 |   getPatientImmunizations,
  15 |   updateImmunization,
  16 | } from "../../db/queries/immunization.queries";
  17 | import { immunizationInputSchema, updateImmunizationInputSchema } from "./schema";
  18 | 
  19 | export const fetchPatientImmunizations = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  20 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
  21 |   .validator(
  22 |     z.object({
  23 |       patientId: z.uuid(),
  24 |       // Optional ISO string. When omitted, the server derives age from
  25 |       // `patients.dateOfBirth` — pass it only to skip that read.

  27 |     }),
  28 |   )
  29 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {

  31 |     return getPatientImmunizations(data.patientId, dob);
  32 |   });

  40 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
  41 |   .validator(
  42 |     z.object({
  43 |       clinicId: z.uuid(),
  44 |       filter: z
  45 |         .object({
  46 |           ageBracket: z.enum(["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", ">24"]).optional(),
  47 |           onlyOverdue: z.boolean().optional(),
  48 |         })
  49 |         .optional(),
  50 |     }),
  51 |   )
  52 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => getImmunizationMatrix(data.clinicId, data.filter ?? {}));
  53 | 
  54 | export const updateImmunizationFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  55 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  56 |   .validator(
  57 |     z.object({
  58 |       id: z.uuid(),
  59 |       patch: updateImmunizationInputSchema,
  60 |     }),
  61 |   )
  62 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {
  63 |     const updated = await updateImmunization(data.id, data.patch);
  64 |     // Distinguish "row doesn't exist" from "row updated to empty", so the
  65 |     // caller can toast the right message.
  66 |     if (!updated) {
  67 |       throw new Error(`Immunization ${data.id} not found`);
  68 |     }
  69 |     return updated;
  70 |   });
  71 | 
  72 | export const RecordImmunizationInput = immunizationInputSchema
  73 |   .extend({
  74 |     status: z.enum(immunizationStatuses).default("given"),
  75 |     administeredDate: z.coerce.date().nullable().optional(),
  76 |     visitId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(),
  77 |   })
  78 |   .omit({ administeredById: true });
  79 | 
  80 | export type RecordImmunizationInput = z.infer<typeof RecordImmunizationInput>;
  81 | 
  82 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
  83 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
  84 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
  85 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  86 | }
  87 | 
  88 | export const recordImmunizationFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  89 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  90 |   .validator(RecordImmunizationInput)
  91 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
  92 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
  93 |     const administeredDate = data.status === "given" ? (data.administeredDate ?? new Date()) : null;
  94 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
  95 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
  96 |           key: idempotencyKey,
  97 |           userId: context.user.id,
  98 |           data: { ...data, administeredDate },
  99 |         })
 100 |       : null;
 101 | 
 102 |     return db.transaction((tx) => {
 103 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 104 |         const previous = tx
 105 |           .select()
 106 |           .from(idempotency)
 107 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
 108 |           .get();
 109 | 
 110 |         if (previous) {
 111 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
 112 |             setResponseStatus(409);
 113 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
 114 |           }
 115 | 
 116 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
 117 |           const previousId =
 118 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 119 |             previousResult !== null &&
 120 |             "immunizationId" in previousResult &&
 121 |             typeof previousResult.immunizationId === "string"
 122 |               ? previousResult.immunizationId
 123 |               : null;
 124 | 
 125 |           if (!previousId) {
 126 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
 127 |           }
 128 | 
 129 |           const previousImmunization = tx
 130 |             .select()
 131 |             .from(immunizations)
 132 |             .where(eq(immunizations.id, previousId))
 133 |             .get();
 134 | 
 135 |           if (!previousImmunization) {
 136 |             throw new Error("The previously recorded immunization is missing.");
 137 |           }
 138 |           return previousImmunization;
 139 |         }
 140 |       }
 141 | 
 142 |       const existingDose = administeredDate
 143 |         ? tx
 144 |             .select()
 145 |             .from(immunizations)
 146 |             .where(
 147 |               and(
 148 |                 eq(immunizations.patientId, data.patientId),
 149 |                 eq(immunizations.vaccineKey, data.vaccineKey),
 150 |                 eq(immunizations.doseNumber, data.doseNumber),
 151 |                 eq(immunizations.administeredDate, administeredDate),
 152 |               ),
 153 |             )
 154 |             .get()
 155 |         : undefined;
 156 | 
 157 |       const row =
 158 |         existingDose ??
 159 |         tx
 160 |           .insert(immunizations)
 161 |           .values({
 162 |             patientId: data.patientId,
 163 |             visitId: data.visitId ?? null,
 164 |             vaccineKey: data.vaccineKey,
 165 |             vaccineName: data.vaccineName,
 166 |             doseNumber: data.doseNumber,
 167 |             targetAgeMonths: data.targetAgeMonths,
 168 |             status: data.status,
 169 |             administeredDate,
 170 |             lotNumber: data.lotNumber ?? null,
 171 |             site: data.site ?? null,
 172 |             administeredById: context.user.id,
 173 |             adverseEvents: data.adverseEvents ?? null,
 174 |             notes: data.notes ?? null,
 175 |           })
 176 |           .returning()
 177 |           .get();
 178 | 
 179 |       if (!row) {
 180 |         throw new Error("Failed to record immunization.");
 181 |       }
 182 | 
 183 |       if (!existingDose) {
 184 |         tx.insert(auditLog)
 185 |           .values({
 186 |             actorId: context.user.id,
 187 |             action: "create",
 188 |             entity: "Immunization",
 189 |             entityId: row.id,
 190 |             metadata: {
 191 |               patientId: row.patientId,
 192 |               vaccineKey: row.vaccineKey,
 193 |               doseNumber: row.doseNumber,
 194 |             },
 195 |           })
 196 |           .run();
 197 |       }
 198 | 
 199 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 200 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
 201 |           .values({
 202 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 203 |             key: idempotencyKey,
 204 |             requestHash,
 205 |             result: { immunizationId: row.id },
 206 |           })
 207 |           .run();
 208 |       }
 209 | 
 210 |       return row;
 211 |     });
 212 |   });
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/immunizations/api.ts
   2 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   4 | 
   5 | import {
   6 |   fetchImmunizationCoverage,
   7 |   fetchImmunizationMatrix,
   8 |   fetchPatientImmunizations,
   9 |   recordImmunizationFn,
  10 | } from "./functions";
  11 | 
  12 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  13 | // Query key factory
  14 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  15 | 
  16 | export const immunizationKeys = {
  17 |   all: () => ["immunizations"] as const,
  18 | 
  19 |   /** Per-patient subtree — invalidate when a dose is recorded. */
  20 |   patient: (patientId: string) => ["immunizations", "patient", patientId] as const,
  21 | 
  22 |   /** Per-clinic coverage stats. */
  23 |   coverage: (clinicId: string) => ["immunizations", "coverage", clinicId] as const,
  24 | 
  25 |   /** Clinic-wide matrix. The `filter` object is serialized into the key
  26 |    *  so different filter combinations are cached independently. */
  27 |   matrix: (clinicId: string, filter: { ageBracket?: string; onlyOverdue?: boolean } = {}) =>
  28 |     [
  29 |       "immunizations",
  30 |       "matrix",
  31 |       clinicId,
  32 |       filter.ageBracket ?? "all",
  33 |       filter.onlyOverdue ? "overdue" : "any",
  34 |     ] as const,
  35 | } as const;
  36 | 
  37 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  38 | // Query options
  39 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  40 | 
  41 | export function patientImmunizationsQuery(patientId: string, patientDob?: string) {
  42 |   return queryOptions({
  43 |     queryKey: immunizationKeys.patient(patientId),
  44 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientImmunizations({ data: { patientId, patientDob } }),
  45 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  46 |   });
  47 | }
  48 | 
  49 | export function immunizationCoverageQuery(clinicId: string) {
  50 |   return queryOptions({
  51 |     queryKey: immunizationKeys.coverage(clinicId),
  52 |     queryFn: () => fetchImmunizationCoverage({ data: { clinicId } }),
  53 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  54 |   });
  55 | }
  56 | 
  57 | export function immunizationMatrixQuery(
  58 |   clinicId: string,
  59 |   filter: {
  60 |     ageBracket?: "0-6" | "6-12" | "12-24" | ">24";
  61 |     onlyOverdue?: boolean;
  62 |   } = {},
  63 | ) {
  64 |   return queryOptions({
  65 |     queryKey: immunizationKeys.matrix(clinicId, filter),
  66 |     queryFn: () => fetchImmunizationMatrix({ data: { clinicId, filter } }),
  67 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  68 |   });
  69 | }
  70 | 
  71 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  72 | // Invalidation helper
  73 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  74 | 
  75 | /**
  76 |  * Invalidate every cache that a dose change affects. Call from `onSuccess`
  77 |  * of the mutation (or wrap the mutation and do it there):
  78 |  *
  79 |  *     onSuccess: () => invalidateImmunizationCaches(queryClient, patientId, clinicId)
  80 |  *
  81 |  * Note: this helper fires all invalidations in parallel and returns a
  82 |  * Promise that resolves when all queries finish invalidating. Callers that
  83 |  * need to *wait* for the refetch before navigating should `await` it;
  84 |  * callers that just want the invalidation dispatched can `void` it (as the
  85 |  * original did).
  86 |  */
  87 | export function invalidateImmunizationCaches(
  88 |   queryClient: {
  89 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
  90 |   },
  91 |   patientId: string,
  92 |   clinicId: string,
  93 | ): Promise<unknown> {
  94 |   return Promise.all([
  95 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  96 |       queryKey: immunizationKeys.patient(patientId),
  97 |     }),
  98 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  99 |       queryKey: immunizationKeys.coverage(clinicId),
 100 |     }),
 101 |     // Matches every matrix filter combination for this clinic.
 102 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 103 |       queryKey: ["immunizations", "matrix", clinicId],
 104 |     }),
 105 |   ]);
 106 | }
 107 | export function useRecordImmunizationMutation() {
 108 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 109 |   const record = useServerFn(recordImmunizationFn);
 110 | 
 111 |   return useMutation({
 112 |     mutationFn: record,
 113 |     onSuccess: async (_row, variables) => {
 114 |       const promises: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [
 115 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 116 |           queryKey: immunizationKeys.patient(variables.data.patientId),
 117 |         }),
 118 |       ];
 119 | 
 120 |       // Coverage and matrix are clinic-scoped. The mutation input
 121 |       // doesn't carry clinicId, so invalidate by prefix — every
 122 |       // clinic's coverage/matrix cache will refetch, which is cheap
 123 |       // for typical clinic counts and safe if a user belongs to
 124 |       // multiple clinics.
 125 |       promises.push(
 126 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 127 |           queryKey: ["immunizations", "coverage"],
 128 |         }),
 129 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 130 |           queryKey: ["immunizations", "matrix"],
 131 |         }),
 132 |       );
 133 | 
 134 |       await Promise.all(promises);
 135 |     },
 136 |   });
 137 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import { createInsertSchema, createSelectSchema, createUpdateSchema } from "drizzle-orm/zod";
   2 | import { z } from "zod";
   3 | 
   4 | import { immunizationStatuses, immunizations } from "@/db/schema";
   5 | import { optionalText, timestampSchema, uuidSchema } from "@/features/shared/helpers";
   6 | 
   7 | export const immunizationSelectSchema = createSelectSchema(immunizations);
   8 | export const immunizationInsertSchema = createInsertSchema(immunizations);
   9 | export const immunizationUpdateSchema = createUpdateSchema(immunizations);
  10 | 
  11 | export const immunizationInputSchema = z.object({
  12 |   patientId: uuidSchema,
  13 |   visitId: uuidSchema.optional().nullable(),
  14 |   vaccineKey: z.string().min(1).max(50),
  15 |   vaccineName: z.string().min(1).max(150),
  16 |   doseNumber: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(10).default(1),
  17 |   targetAgeMonths: z.coerce.number().min(0).max(240),
  18 |   status: z.enum(immunizationStatuses).default("due"),
  19 |   administeredDate: timestampSchema.optional().nullable(),
  20 |   lotNumber: optionalText(80),
  21 |   site: optionalText(80),
  22 |   administeredById: z.string().optional().nullable(),
  23 |   adverseEvents: optionalText(1000),
  24 |   notes: optionalText(1000),
  25 | });
  26 | 
  27 | export const updateImmunizationInputSchema = immunizationInputSchema
  28 |   .omit({ patientId: true, vaccineKey: true })
  29 |   .partial();
  30 | 
  31 | export type ImmunizationInput = z.infer<typeof immunizationInputSchema>;
  32 | export type UpdateImmunizationInput = z.infer<typeof updateImmunizationInputSchema>;
```

`features/immunizations/use-record-immunization.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/immunizations/use-record-immunization.ts
   2 | 
   3 | import type { OutboxEntry } from "@/features/outbox/store";
   4 | 
   5 | import { useQueueWrite } from "@/features/outbox/use-outbox";
   6 | 
   7 | import { type RecordImmunizationInput, recordImmunizationFn } from "./functions";
   8 | 
   9 | /**
  10 |  * Records an immunization. If online, calls the server directly. If
  11 |  * offline (or the call fails with a network error), queues to the outbox
  12 |  * so the flusher picks it up when connectivity returns.
  13 |  */
  14 | export function useRecordImmunization() {
  15 |   const queue = useQueueWrite();
  16 |   return {
  17 |     mutate: async (data: RecordImmunizationInput) => {
  18 |       if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.onLine) {
  19 |         try {
  20 |           return await recordImmunizationFn({ data });
  21 |         } catch (err) {
  22 |           // Network error → fall through to queue.
  23 |           if (!(err instanceof Error) || !/network|fetch/i.test(err.message)) throw err;
  24 |         }
  25 |       }
  26 |       const entry: OutboxEntry<RecordImmunizationInput> = {
  27 |         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  28 |         kind: "record-immunization",
  29 |         entityId: data.patientId,
  30 |         payload: data,
  31 |         status: "queued",
  32 |         idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID(),
  33 |         optimisticSnapshot: data,
  34 |         createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  35 |         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  36 |         attempts: 0,
  37 |       };
  38 |       await queue.mutateAsync(entry);
  39 |       return { queued: true as const, entry };
  40 |     },
  41 |   };
  42 | }
```
