```tsx
  16 |   SelectTrigger,
  17 |   SelectValue,
  18 | } from "@/components/ui/select";
  19 | import { classify, percentileFromZ, zScoreForValue } from "@/features/measurements/lib/lms";
  20 | import {
  21 |   useCreateMeasurementsMutation,
  22 |   useCreateStandaloneMeasurementsMutation,
  23 | } from "@/features/measurements/queries";
  24 | 
  25 | import { toast } from "../../../components/ui/toast";
  26 | 
  27 | const INDICATORS = [
  28 |   { value: "weight-for-age", label: "Weight-for-age", unit: "kg" },
  29 |   { value: "length-for-age", label: "Length/height-for-age", unit: "cm" },
  30 |   { value: "weight-for-length", label: "Weight-for-length", unit: "kg" },
  31 |   { value: "bmi-for-age", label: "BMI-for-age", unit: "kg/m²" },
  32 |   {
  33 |     value: "head-circumference-for-age",
  34 |     label: "Head circumference",
  35 |     unit: "cm",
  36 |   },
  37 | ] as const;
  38 | 
  39 | // Derive the enum tuple from `INDICATORS` so the schema's inferred
  40 | // type matches the literal union. `as const` on the array above keeps
  41 | // `.value` as the literal union; the explicit tuple type below makes
  42 | // it visible to `z.enum`.
  43 | const INDICATOR_VALUES = [
  44 |   "weight-for-age",
  45 |   "length-for-age",
  46 |   "weight-for-length",
  47 |   "bmi-for-age",
  48 |   "head-circumference-for-age",
  49 | ] as const;
  50 | 
  51 | type Indicator = (typeof INDICATOR_VALUES)[number];
  52 | 
  53 | const INDICATOR_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(INDICATOR_VALUES);
  54 | 
  55 | const isIndicator = (v: unknown): v is Indicator => typeof v === "string" && INDICATOR_SET.has(v);
  56 | 
  57 | const rowSchema = z.object({
  58 |   draftId: z.string().min(1),
  59 |   indicator: z.enum(INDICATOR_VALUES),
  60 |   value: z.number().positive("Value must be positive"),
  61 | });
  62 | 
  63 | const formSchema = z.object({
  64 |   rows: z.array(rowSchema).min(1, "Add at least one measurement"),
  65 | });
  66 | 
  67 | export interface LmsLookupEntry {
  68 |   l: number;
  69 |   m: number;
  70 |   s: number;
  71 | }
  72 | 
  73 | type DraftRow = z.infer<typeof rowSchema>;
  74 | 
  75 | interface MeasurementFormProps {
  76 |   /** Preferred: log against an existing encounter. */
  77 |   visitId?: string;
  78 |   patientId: string;
  79 |   /** Required when `visitId` is absent — the server creates a visit. */
  80 |   clinicId?: string;
  81 |   patientSex: "male" | "female";
  82 |   ageMonths: number;
  83 |   lengthCm?: number;
  84 |   lmsByIndicator?: Partial<Record<Indicator, LmsLookupEntry>>;
  85 |   inline?: boolean;
  86 |   onSuccess?: () => void;
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | function emptyRow(indicator: Indicator = "weight-for-age"): DraftRow {
  90 |   return { draftId: crypto.randomUUID(), indicator, value: 0 };
  91 | }
  92 | 
  93 | const buildDefaults = () => ({ rows: [emptyRow()] });
  94 | 
  95 | export function MeasurementForm({
  96 |   visitId,
  97 |   patientId,
  98 |   clinicId,
  99 |   patientSex,
 100 |   ageMonths,
 101 |   lengthCm,
 102 |   lmsByIndicator,
 103 |   inline = false,
 104 |   onSuccess,
 105 | }: MeasurementFormProps) {
 106 |   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
 107 | 
 108 |   // The mutations are constructed once per patient — the hook owns
 109 |   // the query client, the server fn, and the invalidation. Both
 110 |   // hooks are always created so hook order is stable when `visitId`
 111 |   // toggles between renders. Only one is ever called.
 112 |   const createVisitMeasurements = useCreateMeasurementsMutation({
 113 |     patientId,
 114 |   });
 115 |   const createStandalone = useCreateStandaloneMeasurementsMutation({
 116 |     patientId,
 117 |   });
 118 | 
 119 |   // Which mutation is "the one" for this form, given the current
 120 |   // props — used to disable the submit button while it is pending.
 121 |   const activeMutation = visitId ? createVisitMeasurements : createStandalone;
 122 | 
 123 |   const form = useForm({
 124 |     defaultValues: buildDefaults(),
 125 |     validators: {
 126 |       onSubmit: formSchema,
 127 |       onSubmitAsync: async ({ value }) => {
 128 |         try {
 129 |           if (visitId) {
 130 |             const payload = value.rows.map((row) => {
 131 |               const lms = lmsByIndicator?.[row.indicator];
 132 |               const canComputeZ =
 133 |                 lms !== undefined &&
 134 |                 (row.indicator !== "weight-for-length" || lengthCm !== undefined);
 135 | 
 136 |               if (!lms || !canComputeZ) {
 137 |                 return { indicator: row.indicator, value: row.value };
 138 |               }
 139 | 
 140 |               const zScore = zScoreForValue({ l: lms.l, m: lms.m, s: lms.s }, row.value);
 141 |               const percentile = percentileFromZ(zScore);
 142 |               const classification =
 143 |                 row.indicator === "head-circumference-for-age"
 144 |                   ? undefined
 145 |                   : classify(row.indicator, zScore).label;
 146 | 
 147 |               return {
 148 |                 indicator: row.indicator,
 149 |                 value: row.value,
 150 |                 zScore,
 151 |                 percentile,
 152 |                 classification,
 153 |                 lmsL: lms.l,
 154 |                 lmsM: lms.m,
 155 |                 lmsS: lms.s,
 156 |               };
 157 |             });
 158 | 
 159 |             // NOTE: `patientId` is NOT in the mutate payload —
 160 |             // the hook already carries it via `args`.
 161 |             await createVisitMeasurements.mutateAsync({
 162 |               data: { visitId, rows: payload },
 163 |             });
 164 |           } else {
 165 |             if (!clinicId) {
 166 |               return { form: "Missing patient or clinic context" };
 167 |             }
 168 | 
 169 |             await createStandalone.mutateAsync({
 170 |               data: {
 171 |                 patientId,
 172 |                 clinicId,
 173 |                 rows: value.rows.map((r) => ({
 174 |                   indicator: r.indicator,
 175 |                   value: r.value,
 176 |                   lengthCm: r.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (lengthCm ?? null) : null,
 177 |                 })),
 178 |               },
 179 |             });
 180 |           }
 181 | 
 182 |           toast.add({
 183 |             type: "success",
 184 |             description: `${value.rows.length} measurement(s) saved`,
 185 |           });
 186 |           form.reset(buildDefaults());
 187 |           setOpen(false);
 188 |           onSuccess?.();
 189 |           return undefined;
 190 |         } catch (error) {
 191 |           return {
 192 |             form: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
 193 |           };
 194 |         }
 195 |       },
 196 |     },
 197 |   });
 198 | 
 199 |   const handleOpenChange = (next: boolean) => {
 200 |     setOpen(next);
 201 |     if (!next) form.reset(buildDefaults());
 202 |   };
 203 | 
 204 |   const body = (
 205 |     <form
 206 |       className="grid gap-4"
 207 |       noValidate
 208 |       onSubmit={(event) => {
 209 |         event.preventDefault();
 210 |         void form.handleSubmit();
 211 |       }}
 212 |     >
 213 |       <p className=" text-sm">
 214 |         Sex: <span className="capitalize">{patientSex}</span> · Age: {ageMonths.toFixed(1)} months
 215 |         {lengthCm !== undefined && ` · Length: ${lengthCm} cm`}
 216 |       </p>
 217 | 
 218 |       <form.Field mode="array" name="rows">
 219 |         {(field) => (
 220 |           <div className="grid gap-3">
 221 |             {field.state.value.map((row, index) => (
 222 |               <div className="flex items-end gap-2 rounded-md border p-3" key={row.draftId}>
 223 |                 <div className="flex-1">
 224 |                   <form.Field name={`rows[${index}].indicator`}>
 225 |                     {(sub) => (
 226 |                       <div className="grid gap-1">
 227 |                         <Label htmlFor={`m-${row.draftId}-indicator`}>Indicator</Label>
 228 |                         <Select
 229 |                           onValueChange={(v) => {
 230 |                             if (isIndicator(v)) sub.handleChange(v);
 231 |                           }}
 232 |                           value={sub.state.value}
 233 |                         >
 234 |                           <SelectTrigger id={`m-${row.draftId}-indicator`}>
 235 |                             <SelectValue />
 236 |                           </SelectTrigger>
 237 |                           <SelectContent>
 238 |                             {INDICATORS.map((opt) => (
 239 |                               <SelectItem key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
 240 |                                 {opt.label}
 241 |                               </SelectItem>
 242 |                             ))}
 243 |                           </SelectContent>
 244 |                         </Select>
 245 |                       </div>
 246 |                     )}
 247 |                   </form.Field>
 248 |                 </div>
 249 | 
 250 |                 <div className="flex-1">
 251 |                   <form.Field name={`rows[${index}].value`}>
 252 |                     {(sub) => {
 253 |                       const unit = INDICATORS.find((i) => i.value === row.indicator)?.unit ?? "";
 254 |                       return (
 255 |                         <div className="grid gap-1">
 256 |                           <Label htmlFor={`m-${row.draftId}-value`}>Value ({unit})</Label>
 257 |                           <Input
 258 |                             id={`m-${row.draftId}-value`}
 259 |                             min="0"
 260 |                             onChange={(e) => sub.handleChange(e.target.valueAsNumber || 0)}
 261 |                             step="0.01"
 262 |                             type="number"
 263 |                             value={sub.state.value || ""}
 264 |                           />
 265 |                         </div>
 266 |                       );
 267 |                     }}
 268 |                   </form.Field>
 269 |                 </div>
 270 | 
 271 |                 <Button
 272 |                   aria-label={`Remove measurement ${index + 1}`}
 273 |                   disabled={field.state.value.length <= 1}
 274 |                   onClick={() => field.removeValue(index)}
 275 |                   size="icon"
 276 |                   type="button"
 277 |                   variant="ghost"
 278 |                 >
 279 |                   <X />
 280 |                 </Button>
 281 |               </div>
 282 |             ))}
 283 | 
 284 |             <Button
 285 |               onClick={() => field.pushValue(emptyRow("length-for-age"))}
 286 |               size="sm"
 287 |               type="button"
 288 |               variant="outline"
 289 |             >
 290 |               <Plus /> Add measurement
 291 |             </Button>
 292 |           </div>
 293 |         )}
 294 |       </form.Field>
 295 | 
 296 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(state) => state.errorMap.onSubmit}>
 297 |         {(error) =>
 298 |           typeof error?.form === "string" && (
 299 |             <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 300 |               {error.form}
 301 |             </p>
 302 |           )
 303 |         }
 304 |       </form.Subscribe>
 305 | 
 306 |       {/*
 307 |        * Read `activeMutation.isPending` instead of
 308 |        * `form.state.isSubmitting`. The mutation's onSuccess
 309 |        * awaits invalidation, so `isPending` stays true through
 310 |        * the refetch — the button doesn't re-enable while the
 311 |        * chart is still refetching stale data.
 312 |        */}
 313 |       <Button disabled={activeMutation.isPending} type="submit">
 314 |         {activeMutation.isPending ? "Saving…" : "Save Measurements"}
 315 |       </Button>
 316 |     </form>
 317 |   );
 318 | 
 319 |   if (inline) return body;
 320 | 
 321 |   return (
 322 |     <Dialog onOpenChange={handleOpenChange} open={open}>
 323 |       <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} type="button">
 324 |         <Plus />
 325 |         Add Measurements
 326 |       </Button>
 327 |       <DialogContent>
 328 |         <DialogHeader>
 329 |           <DialogTitle>Record Measurements</DialogTitle>
 330 |         </DialogHeader>
 331 |         {body}
 332 |       </DialogContent>
 333 |     </Dialog>
 334 |   );
 335 | }
```

```tsx
  54 | 
  55 | const MONTH_LABEL = (months: number): string => {
  56 |   if (!Number.isFinite(months)) return "—";
  57 |   if (months < 24) return `${months.toFixed(1)} mo`;
  58 |   const years = Math.floor(months / 12);
  59 |   const rem = Math.round(months - years * 12);
  60 |   return rem === 0 ? `${years}y` : `${years}y ${rem}m`;
  61 | };
  62 | 
  63 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  64 | // Formatting helpers
  65 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  66 | 
  67 | function asNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  68 |   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
  69 | }
  70 | 
  71 | function asDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
  72 |   if (value instanceof Date) {
  73 |     return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value;
  74 |   }
  75 |   if (typeof value === "string") {
  76 |     const d = new Date(value);
  77 |     return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  78 |   }
  79 |   return null;
  80 | }
  81 | 
  82 | function zVariant(z: number | null): "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "subtle" {
  83 |   if (z === null) return "subtle";
  84 |   const abs = Math.abs(z);
  85 |   if (abs >= 3) return "destructive";
  86 |   if (abs >= 2) return "warning";
  87 |   if (abs <= 1) return "success";
  88 |   return "subtle";
  89 | }
  90 | 
  91 | function zSeverityLabel(z: number): string {
  92 |   const abs = Math.abs(z);
  93 |   if (abs >= 3) return "severe";
  94 |   if (abs >= 2) return "moderate";
  95 |   if (abs <= 1) return "normal";
  96 |   return "mild";
  97 | }

 100 | // Table config

 121 |           )}

 203 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 204 | // Component
 205 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 206 | 
 207 | interface MeasurementsTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute> {
 208 |   patientId: string;
 209 |   indicator: Indicator;
 210 |   page: number;
 211 |   size: PageSize;
 212 |   route?: TRoute;
 213 |   initialData?: IndicatorSeriesRow[];
 214 |   initialDataUpdatedAt?: number;
 215 | }
 216 | 
 217 | export function MeasurementsTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
 218 |   patientId,
 219 |   indicator,
 220 |   page,
 221 |   size,
 222 |   route,
 223 |   initialData,
 224 |   initialDataUpdatedAt,
 225 | }: MeasurementsTableProps<TRoute>) {
 226 |   // ── read via factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 227 |   const query = useQuery({
 228 |     ...seriesQuery(patientId, indicator),
 229 |     initialData,
 230 |     initialDataUpdatedAt,
 231 |   });
 232 | 
 233 |   const queryData = query.data;
 234 |   const all = queryData ?? [];
 235 |   const total = all.length;
 236 |   const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
 237 | 
 238 |   const pageRows = React.useMemo(
 239 |     () => (queryData ?? []).slice((page - 1) * size, page * size),
 240 |     [queryData, page, size],
 241 |   );
 242 | 
 243 |   const unit = INDICATOR_UNIT[indicator];
 244 |   const meta = React.useMemo<MeasurementsTableMeta>(() => ({ unit, indicator }), [unit, indicator]);
 245 | 
 246 |   const table = useTable({
 247 |     features,
 248 |     columns,
 249 |     data: pageRows,
 250 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
 251 |     manualPagination: true,
 252 |     rowCount: total,
 253 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
 254 |     meta,
 255 |   });
 256 | 
 257 |   return (
 258 |     <DataTable
 259 |       ariaLabel="Measurements"
 260 |       emptyMessage={
 261 |         <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
 262 |           <IconTile size="lg">
 263 |             <RulerIcon aria-hidden="true" />
 264 |           </IconTile>
 265 |           <p>No {INDICATOR_LABEL[indicator].toLowerCase()} measurements recorded yet.</p>
 266 |         </div>
 267 |       }
 268 |       errorDescription={
 269 |         query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "Check your connection and try again."
 270 |       }
 271 |       errorTitle="Could Not Load Measurements"
 272 |       outOfRange={
 273 |         page > pageCount && total > 0
 274 |           ? {
 275 |               backTo: () => (
 276 |                 <Link
 277 |                   className={buttonVariants()}
 278 |                   params={{ patientId }}
 279 |                   search={{ tab: "overview" }}
 280 |                   to="/app/patients/$patientId"
 281 |                 >
 282 |                   Back To First Page
 283 |                 </Link>
 284 |               ),
 285 |             }
 286 |           : undefined
 287 |       }
 288 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
 289 |       query={query}
 290 |       table={table}
 291 |     />
 292 |   );
 293 | }
```

```ts
 129 | const CreateMeasurementInput = z.object({
 130 |   patientId: z.uuid(),
 131 |   visitId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(),
 132 |   indicator: IndicatorSchema,
 133 |   value: z.number().positive(),

 136 | });
 137 | 
 138 | export const createMeasurementFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
 139 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
 140 |   .validator(CreateMeasurementInput)
 141 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
 142 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
 143 |     const measuredAt = new Date(data.measuredAt);
 144 |     measuredAt.setSeconds(0, 0);
 145 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
 146 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
 147 |           operation: "create-measurement",
 148 |           key: idempotencyKey,
 149 |           userId: context.user.id,
 150 |           data: { ...data, measuredAt },
 151 |         })
 152 |       : null;
 153 | 
 154 |     const patient = await db.query.patients.findFirst({
 155 |       where: { id: data.patientId },
 156 |       columns: {
 157 |         clinicId: true,
 158 |         sex: true,
 159 |         dateOfBirth: true,
 160 |       },
 161 |     });
 162 |     if (
 163 |       !patient?.clinicId ||
 164 |       (context.user.role !== "admin" && patient.clinicId !== context.user.clinicId)
 165 |     ) {
 166 |       throw forbidden();
 167 |     }
 168 |     const clinicId = patient.clinicId;
 169 | 
 170 |     const visitId = data.visitId ?? null;
 171 |     if (visitId) {
 172 |       const visit = await db.query.visits.findFirst({
 173 |         where: { id: visitId },
 174 |         columns: { patientId: true, clinicId: true },
 175 |       });
 176 |       if (!visit || visit.patientId !== data.patientId || visit.clinicId !== patient.clinicId) {
 177 |         throw forbidden();
 178 |       }
 179 |     }
 180 | 
 181 |     const lengthCm = data.lengthCm;
 182 |     const ageMonths =
 183 |       (measuredAt.getTime() - new Date(patient.dateOfBirth).getTime()) / (86_400_000 * 30.4375);
 184 |     if (ageMonths < 0) {
 185 |       setResponseStatus(422);
 186 |       throw new Error("Measurement date cannot be before the patient's birth.");
 187 |     }
 188 | 
 189 |     let lms = null;
 190 |     if (data.indicator === "weight-for-length") {
 191 |       if (lengthCm == null) {
 192 |         setResponseStatus(422);
 193 |         throw new Error("Length is required for a weight-for-length measurement.");
 194 |       }
 195 |       lms = await getLmsByLength(patient.sex, lengthCm);
 196 |     } else if (data.indicator !== "head-circumference-for-age") {
 197 |       lms = await getLmsByAge(data.indicator, patient.sex, ageMonths);
 198 |     }
 199 |     const growthData = lms
 200 |       ? {
 201 |           zScore: zScoreForValue(lms, data.value),
 202 |           lmsL: lms.l,
 203 |           lmsM: lms.m,
 204 |           lmsS: lms.s,
 205 |         }
 206 |       : {};
 207 | 
 208 |     const row = db.transaction((tx) => {
 209 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 210 |         const previous = tx
 211 |           .select()
 212 |           .from(idempotency)
 213 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
 214 |           .get();
 215 | 
 216 |         if (previous) {
 217 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
 218 |             setResponseStatus(409);
 219 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
 220 |           }
 221 | 
 222 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
 223 |           const previousId =
 224 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 225 |             previousResult !== null &&
 226 |             "measurementId" in previousResult &&
 227 |             typeof previousResult.measurementId === "string"
 228 |               ? previousResult.measurementId
 229 |               : null;
 230 |           if (!previousId) {
 231 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
 232 |           }
 233 | 
 234 |           const previousRow = tx
 235 |             .select()
 236 |             .from(measurements)
 237 |             .where(eq(measurements.id, previousId))
 238 |             .get();
 239 |           if (!previousRow) {
 240 |             throw new Error("The previously saved measurement is missing.");
 241 |           }
 242 |           return previousRow;
 243 |         }
 244 |       }
 245 | 
 246 |       const existing = tx
 247 |         .select()
 248 |         .from(measurements)
 249 |         .where(
 250 |           and(
 251 |             eq(measurements.patientId, data.patientId),
 252 |             eq(measurements.indicator, data.indicator),
 253 |             eq(measurements.measuredAt, measuredAt),
 254 |           ),
 255 |         )
 256 |         .get();
 257 | 
 258 |       let row = existing;
 259 |       if (!row) {
 260 |         let resolvedVisitId = visitId;
 261 |         if (!resolvedVisitId) {
 262 |           const years = Math.floor(ageMonths / 12);
 263 |           const monthsRemainder = Math.round(ageMonths - years * 12);
 264 |           const visit = tx
 265 |             .insert(visits)
 266 |             .values({
 267 |               patientId: data.patientId,
 268 |               clinicId,
 269 |               visitedAt: measuredAt,
 270 |               ageMonths,
 271 |               ageYears: years,
 272 |               ageMonthsRemainder: monthsRemainder >= 12 ? 0 : monthsRemainder,
 273 |             })
 274 |             .returning({ id: visits.id })
 275 |             .get();
 276 |           if (!visit) throw new Error("Failed to create measurement visit.");
 277 |           resolvedVisitId = visit.id;
 278 |         }
 279 | 
 280 |         row = tx
 281 |           .insert(measurements)
 282 |           .values({
 283 |             visitId: resolvedVisitId,
 284 |             patientId: data.patientId,
 285 |             indicator: data.indicator,
 286 |             value: data.value,
 287 |             measuredAt,
 288 |             lengthCmAtMeasurement: data.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? data.lengthCm : null,
 289 |             ...growthData,
 290 |           })
 291 |           .returning()
 292 |           .get();
 293 |       }
 294 |       if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to save measurement.");
 295 | 
 296 |       if (!existing) {
 297 |         tx.insert(auditLog)
 298 |           .values({
 299 |             actorId: context.user.id,
 300 |             action: "create",
 301 |             entity: "Measurement",
 302 |             entityId: row.id,
 303 |             metadata: {
 304 |               patientId: row.patientId,
 305 |               visitId: row.visitId,
 306 |               indicator: row.indicator,
 307 |             },
 308 |           })
 309 |           .run();
 310 |       }
 311 | 
 312 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 313 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
 314 |           .values({
 315 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 316 |             key: idempotencyKey,
 317 |             requestHash,
 318 |             result: { measurementId: row.id },
 319 |           })
 320 |           .run();
 321 |       }
 322 | 
 323 |       return row;
 324 |     });
 325 | 
 326 |     return row;
 327 |   });
 328 | 
 329 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
 330 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
 331 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
 332 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
 333 | }
 334 | 
 335 | function forbidden(): Error {
 336 |   setResponseStatus(403);
 337 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
 338 | }
```

`features/measurements/queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/measurements/queries.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Everything React Query reads or writes about measurements.
   4 | //
   5 | // Conventions in this file (matching `patients/queries.ts`,
   6 | // `appointments/queries.ts`, `prescriptions/queries.ts`):
   7 | //
   8 | //   1. Query keys come from `measurementKeys` — never raw arrays.
   9 | //   2. `queryOptions` factories live in this file. Components call
  10 | //      `useQuery(measurementByIdQuery(id))`, not inline fetchers.
  11 | //   3. Mutations are hooks (`useCreateMeasurementsMutation`, …) that
  12 | //      call `useServerFn` + `useMutation` and **own their invalidation**.
  13 | //      Callers do not pass `onSuccess` to invalidate — the hook does.
  14 | //   4. `invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite` is the single source of truth
  15 | //      for what a measurement write touches. If you change the cache
  16 | //      graph, change it there.
  17 | //
  18 | // Measurement writes touch three feature trees: `measurements`
  19 | // (this file), `series` (growth charts) and `latest` (dashboard).
  20 | // All three are invalidated by `invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite`.
  21 | 
  22 | import type { z } from "zod";
  23 | 
  24 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
  25 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
  26 | 
  27 | import type { IndicatorSchema } from "./schema";
  28 | 
  29 | import {
  30 |   addMeasurementWithZScoreFn,
  31 |   createMeasurementsFn,
  32 |   createMeasurementsStandaloneFn,
  33 |   deleteMeasurementFn,
  34 |   fetchClassificationCounts,
  35 |   fetchFlaggedMeasurements,
  36 |   fetchIndicatorTrend,
  37 |   fetchMeasurementById,
  38 |   fetchMeasurementsForVisit,
  39 |   fetchSevereCases,
  40 |   updateMeasurementFn,
  41 | } from "./functions";
  42 | 
  43 | type Indicator = z.infer<typeof IndicatorSchema>;
  44 | 
  45 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  46 | // Constants
  47 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  48 | 
  49 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  50 |   /** Single measurement row. */
  51 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
  52 |   /** Measurements attached to one visit. */
  53 |   VISIT: 60_000,
  54 |   /** One patient's trend for one indicator (growth chart data). */
  55 |   TREND: 30_000,
  56 |   /** Latest panel — feeds the dashboard card and the composer. */
  57 |   LATEST: 30_000,
  58 |   /** Flagged measurements feed the referral queue. Shorter because
  59 |    *  concurrent prescribers add rows at unpredictable times. */
  60 |   FLAGGED: 15_000,
  61 |   /** Clinic-wide aggregates (classification counts, severe cases). */
  62 |   CLINIC: 120_000,
  63 | } as const;
  64 | 
  65 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  66 | // Query key factory
  67 | //
  68 | // Every key starts with "measurement". The growth feature's own keys
  69 | // (`series`, `band`) are separate trees by design — measurement writes
  70 | // invalidate both, but neither key lives here. That keeps the tree
  71 | // boundaries honest.
  72 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 | 
  74 | export const measurementKeys = {
  75 |   all: () => ["measurement"] as const,
  76 | 
  77 |   /** One measurement row. */
  78 |   detail: (measurementId: string) => ["measurement", "detail", measurementId] as const,
  79 | 
  80 |   /** All measurements attached to one visit. */
  81 |   byVisit: (visitId: string) => ["measurement", "visit", visitId] as const,
  82 | 
  83 |   /** Flagged measurements for a patient, keyed by threshold so a
  84 |    *  "show >2 SD" and "show >3 SD" view don't collide. */
  85 |   flagged: (patientId: string, zThreshold: number) =>
  86 |     ["measurement", "flagged", patientId, zThreshold] as const,
  87 | 
  88 |   /** One indicator's time series for one patient. */
  89 |   trend: (patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) =>
  90 |     ["measurement", "trend", patientId, indicator] as const,
  91 | 
  92 |   /** Latest measurement per indicator, for one patient. */
  93 |   latestPanel: (patientId: string) => ["measurement", "latest-panel", patientId] as const,
  94 | 
  95 |   /** Clinic-wide classification distribution. */
  96 |   classificationCounts: (clinicId: string) =>
  97 |     ["measurement", "classification-counts", clinicId] as const,
  98 | 
  99 |   /** Clinic-wide severe-case queue (|z| ≥ 3). */
 100 |   severeCases: (clinicId: string) => ["measurement", "severe-cases", clinicId] as const,
 101 | } as const;
 102 | 
 103 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 104 | // Query options
 105 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 106 | 
 107 | export function measurementByIdQuery(measurementId: string) {
 108 |   return queryOptions({
 109 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.detail(measurementId),
 110 |     queryFn: () => fetchMeasurementById({ data: { measurementId } }),
 111 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
 112 |   });
 113 | }
 114 | 
 115 | export function measurementsForVisitQuery(visitId: string) {
 116 |   return queryOptions({
 117 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.byVisit(visitId),
 118 |     queryFn: () => fetchMeasurementsForVisit({ data: { visitId } }),
 119 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.VISIT,
 120 |   });
 121 | }
 122 | 
 123 | export function flaggedMeasurementsQuery(patientId: string, zThreshold = 2) {
 124 |   return queryOptions({
 125 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.flagged(patientId, zThreshold),
 126 |     queryFn: () => fetchFlaggedMeasurements({ data: { patientId, zThreshold } }),
 127 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.FLAGGED,
 128 |   });

 136 |   });

 162 | 
 163 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 164 | // Invalidation
 165 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 166 | //
 167 | // One helper, one list. A measurement write touches:
 168 | //
 169 | //   1. The measurement's own subtrees (detail, visit, trend, latest panel,
 170 | //      flagged at every threshold the UI might have cached).
 171 | //   2. The growth feature's `series` tree — the chart reads from a
 172 | //      different server fn than `indicatorTrend`, and both must refresh.
 173 | //   3. The growth feature's `band` tree — the current marker band
 174 | //      depends on the chart's latest x.
 175 | //   4. The dashboard's `latest` tree (aliased separately in older code).
 176 | //
 177 | // The clinic-wide aggregates (classification counts, severe cases) are
 178 | // NOT invalidated by default. They're an admin-facing report, they're
 179 | // expensive, and a fresh report is a click away. If you add a live
 180 | // clinic dashboard, extend the helper — don't add per-call invalidation
 181 | // at the mutation site.
 182 | 
 183 | interface InvalidationTarget {
 184 |   patientId: string;
 185 |   indicator?: Indicator;
 186 |   measurementId?: string;
 187 |   visitId?: string;
 188 | }
 189 | 
 190 | export function invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(
 191 |   queryClient: {
 192 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
 193 |   },
 194 |   args: InvalidationTarget,
 195 | ): Promise<unknown> {
 196 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
 197 |     // The patient's growth series (chart) — keyed in the growth feature.
 198 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["series", args.patientId] }),
 199 |     // The current band marker on the chart.
 200 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["band"] }),
 201 |     // Latest-panel card on the dashboard.
 202 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 203 |       queryKey: measurementKeys.latestPanel(args.patientId),
 204 |     }),
 205 |     // Flagged lists at both thresholds the UI actually renders
 206 |     // (filtered flagged list uses 2, referral queue uses 3).
 207 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 208 |       queryKey: measurementKeys.flagged(args.patientId, 2),
 209 |     }),
 210 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 211 |       queryKey: measurementKeys.flagged(args.patientId, 3),
 212 |     }),
 213 |   ];
 214 | 
 215 |   if (args.indicator) {
 216 |     promises.push(
 217 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 218 |         queryKey: measurementKeys.trend(args.patientId, args.indicator),
 219 |       }),
 220 |     );
 221 |   }
 222 |   if (args.measurementId) {
 223 |     promises.push(
 224 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 225 |         queryKey: measurementKeys.detail(args.measurementId),
 226 |       }),
 227 |     );
 228 |   }
 229 |   if (args.visitId) {
 230 |     promises.push(
 231 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 232 |         queryKey: measurementKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
 233 |       }),
 234 |     );
 235 |   }
 236 | 
 237 |   return Promise.all(promises);
 238 | }
 239 | 
 240 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 241 | // Mutations
 242 | //
 243 | // Each hook wraps `useServerFn` + `useMutation` and returns the standard
 244 | // React Query mutation object. `onSuccess` returns the invalidation
 245 | // promise so `isPending` stays `true` through the refetch — the submit
 246 | // button doesn't re-enable while stale data is still on screen.
 247 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 248 | 
 249 | /**
 250 |  * Create measurements against an existing visit.
 251 |  *
 252 |  * The caller passes the payload shape the server function accepts
 253 |  * (validated by `VisitRowsSchema`) plus the `patientId` so the hook
 254 |  * can invalidate the patient's growth caches.
 255 |  *
 256 |  * The `onSuccess` reads `variables.data.rows` to derive which
 257 |  * indicators to invalidate — the server function returns rows but
 258 |  * re-deriving from the request keeps the invalidation correct even if
 259 |  * the server drops some rows (e.g. dedupe).
 260 |  */
 261 | export function useCreateMeasurementsMutation(args: { patientId: string }) {
 262 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 263 |   const createForVisit = useServerFn(createMeasurementsFn);
 264 | 
 265 |   return useMutation({
 266 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "create-visit", args.patientId],
 267 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof createForVisit>[0]) => createForVisit(input),
 268 |     onSuccess: async (_data, variables) => {
 269 |       const indicators = [...new Set(variables.data.rows.map((r) => r.indicator))] as Indicator[];
 270 | 
 271 |       await Promise.all(
 272 |         indicators.map((indicator) =>
 273 |           invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
 274 |             patientId: args.patientId,
 275 |             visitId: variables.data.visitId,
 276 |             indicator,
 277 |           }),
 278 |         ),
 279 |       );
 280 |     },
 281 |   });
 282 | }
 283 | 
 284 | /**
 285 |  * Create measurements standalone — the server creates a measurement-
 286 |  * only visit first, then inserts the rows.
 287 |  *
 288 |  * Because the server owns the new visit id, we cannot invalidate the
 289 |  * `byVisit` subtree here (no id to invalidate). We DO invalidate the
 290 |  * series, latest panel, and flagged lists — those are keyed by
 291 |  * patient, not visit.
 292 |  */
 293 | export function useCreateStandaloneMeasurementsMutation(args: { patientId: string }) {
 294 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 295 |   const createStandalone = useServerFn(createMeasurementsStandaloneFn);
 296 | 
 297 |   return useMutation({
 298 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "create-standalone", args.patientId],
 299 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof createStandalone>[0]) => createStandalone(input),
 300 |     onSuccess: async (_data, variables) => {
 301 |       const indicators = [...new Set(variables.data.rows.map((r) => r.indicator))] as Indicator[];
 302 | 
 303 |       await Promise.all(
 304 |         indicators.map((indicator) =>
 305 |           invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
 306 |             patientId: args.patientId,
 307 |             indicator,
 308 |           }),
 309 |         ),
 310 |       );
 311 |     },
 312 |   });
 313 | }
 314 | 
 315 | /**
 316 |  * Add one measurement with a server-computed z-score.
 317 |  *
 318 |  * Used by the composer's vitals section, where the client doesn't have
 319 |  * LMS context and lets the server compute z, percentile, and
 320 |  * classification. The `indicator` is in the input, so the trend key
 321 |  * can be invalidated precisely.
 322 |  */
 323 | export function useAddMeasurementWithZScoreMutation(args: { patientId: string }) {
 324 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 325 |   const addWithZ = useServerFn(addMeasurementWithZScoreFn);
 326 | 
 327 |   return useMutation({
 328 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "add-with-z", args.patientId],
 329 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof addWithZ>[0]) => addWithZ(input),
 330 |     onSuccess: async (row, variables) => {
 331 |       await invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
 332 |         patientId: args.patientId,
 333 |         visitId: variables.data.visitId,
 334 |         indicator: variables.data.indicator,
 335 |         // The server returns the new row — its id is safe to
 336 |         // invalidate even though the detail query probably
 337 |         // wasn't mounted.
 338 |         measurementId: row?.id,
 339 |       });
 340 |     },
 341 |   });
 342 | }
 343 | 
 344 | /**
 345 |  * Update one measurement (value, or the computed z/percentile/
 346 |  * classification columns).
 347 |  *
 348 |  * Update is rarer than create; the invalidation list is the same.
 349 |  * `indicator` is not in the input — the caller should pass it from
 350 |  * the row they're editing, or accept that only the coarse subtrees
 351 |  * (series, band, latest, flagged) refresh.
 352 |  */
 353 | export function useUpdateMeasurementMutation(args: { patientId: string; indicator?: Indicator }) {
 354 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 355 |   const update = useServerFn(updateMeasurementFn);
 356 | 
 357 |   return useMutation({
 358 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "update", args.patientId],
 359 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof update>[0]) => update(input),
 360 |     onSuccess: async (_row, variables) => {
 361 |       await invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
 362 |         patientId: args.patientId,
 363 |         measurementId: variables.data.measurementId,
 364 |         indicator: args.indicator,
 365 |       });
 366 |     },
 367 |   });
 368 | }
 369 | 
 370 | /**
 371 |  * Delete one measurement.
 372 |  *
 373 |  * The server returns `{ ok: true }`, not the deleted row — so
 374 |  * `indicator` cannot be derived and must be passed by the caller
 375 |  * (they were rendering the row, they know it).
 376 |  */
 377 | export function useDeleteMeasurementMutation(args: {
 378 |   patientId: string;
 379 |   indicator?: Indicator;
 380 |   visitId?: string;
 381 | }) {
 382 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 383 |   const remove = useServerFn(deleteMeasurementFn);
 384 | 
 385 |   return useMutation({
 386 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "delete", args.patientId],
 387 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof remove>[0]) => remove(input),
 388 |     onSuccess: async (_result, variables) => {
 389 |       await invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
 390 |         patientId: args.patientId,
 391 |         measurementId: variables.data.measurementId,
 392 |         visitId: args.visitId,
 393 |         indicator: args.indicator,
 394 |       });
 395 |     },
 396 |   });
 397 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/outbox/flusher.ts
   2 | import { type OutboxEntry, outboxStore } from "./store";
   3 | 
   4 | type SendResult =
   5 |   | { ok: true; serverSnapshot?: unknown }
   6 |   | { ok: false; kind: "conflict"; serverSnapshot: unknown }
   7 |   | { ok: false; kind: "retry"; error: string }
   8 |   | { ok: false; kind: "fatal"; error: string };
   9 | 
  10 | /**
  11 |  * Map each outbox kind to the server function that performs it.
  12 |  * Each function MUST accept an `idempotencyKey` and the server must
  13 |  * dedupe on it — otherwise a retried write creates duplicates.
  14 |  */
  15 | const senders: Record<OutboxEntry["kind"], (entry: OutboxEntry) => Promise<SendResult>> = {
  16 |   "record-immunization": async (entry) => {
  17 |     const { recordImmunizationFn } = await import("@/features/immunizations/functions");
  18 |     try {
  19 |       const r = await recordImmunizationFn({
  20 |         data: entry.payload as never,
  21 |         headers: { "Idempotency-Key": entry.idempotencyKey },
  22 |       });
  23 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };
  24 |     } catch (err) {
  25 |       return classifyServerError(err);
  26 |     }
  27 |   },
  28 |   "save-visit": async (entry) => {
  29 |     const { saveVisitFn } = await import("@/features/visits/functions");
  30 |     try {
  31 |       const r = await saveVisitFn({
  32 |         data: entry.payload as never,
  33 |         headers: { "Idempotency-Key": entry.idempotencyKey },
  34 |       });
  35 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };
  36 |     } catch (err) {
  37 |       return classifyServerError(err);
  38 |     }
  39 |   },
  40 |   "save-prescription": async (entry) => {
  41 |     const { savePrescriptionFn } = await import("@/features/prescriptions/functions");
  42 |     try {
  43 |       const r = await savePrescriptionFn({
  44 |         data: entry.payload as never,
  45 |         headers: { "Idempotency-Key": entry.idempotencyKey },
  46 |       });
  47 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };
  48 |     } catch (err) {
  49 |       return classifyServerError(err);
  50 |     }
  51 |   },
  52 |   "set-milestone": async (entry) => {
  53 |     const { setMilestoneFn } = await import("@/features/development/functions");
  54 |     try {
  55 |       const r = await setMilestoneFn({
  56 |         data: entry.payload as never,
  57 |         headers: { "Idempotency-Key": entry.idempotencyKey },
  58 |       });
  59 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };
  60 |     } catch (err) {
  61 |       return classifyServerError(err);
  62 |     }
  63 |   },
  64 |   "create-measurement": async (entry) => {
  65 |     const { createMeasurementFn } = await import("@/features/measurements/functions");
  66 |     try {
  67 |       const r = await createMeasurementFn({
  68 |         data: entry.payload as never,
  69 |         headers: { "Idempotency-Key": entry.idempotencyKey },
  70 |       });
  71 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };
  72 |     } catch (err) {
  73 |       return classifyServerError(err);
  74 |     }
  75 |   },
  76 | };
  77 | 
  78 | function classifyServerError(err: unknown): SendResult {
  79 |   const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  80 |   if (/409|conflict/i.test(msg)) {
  81 |     // Server should return the winning record in the error body.
  82 |     const serverSnapshot = (err as { serverSnapshot?: unknown })?.serverSnapshot ?? null;
  83 |     return { ok: false, kind: "conflict", serverSnapshot };
  84 |   }
  85 |   if (/4\d\d/.test(msg)) return { ok: false, kind: "fatal", error: msg };
  86 |   return { ok: false, kind: "retry", error: msg };
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | let running = false;
  90 | 
  91 | export async function flushOutbox(): Promise<void> {
  92 |   if (running) return;
  93 |   if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && !navigator.onLine) return;
  94 |   running = true;
  95 |   try {
  96 |     // Drain in a loop so a burst of writes clears in one pass.
  97 |     // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
  98 |     while (true) {
  99 |       const entry = await outboxStore.claimNext();
 100 |       if (!entry) break;
 101 | 
 102 |       // Exponential backoff for previously-failed entries.
 103 |       const delay = Math.min(30_000, 500 * 2 ** (entry.attempts - 1));
 104 |       if (entry.attempts > 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay));
 105 | 
 106 |       const sender = senders[entry.kind];
 107 |       const result = await sender(entry);
 108 | 
 109 |       if (result.ok) {
 110 |         await outboxStore.put({
 111 |           ...entry,
 112 |           status: "synced",
 113 |           serverSnapshot: result.serverSnapshot,
 114 |           error: undefined,
 115 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 116 |         });
 117 |       } else if (result.kind === "conflict") {
 118 |         await outboxStore.put({
 119 |           ...entry,
 120 |           status: "conflict",
 121 |           serverSnapshot: result.serverSnapshot,
 122 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 123 |         });
 124 |       } else if (result.kind === "fatal") {
 125 |         await outboxStore.put({
 126 |           ...entry,
 127 |           status: "failed",
 128 |           error: result.error,
 129 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 130 |         });
 131 |       } else {
 132 |         // retry — put back to queued so the next flush picks it up.
 133 |         await outboxStore.put({
 134 |           ...entry,
 135 |           status: "queued",
 136 |           error: result.error,
 137 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 138 |         });
 139 |         // Stop draining — likely a network blip.
 140 |         break;
 141 |       }
 142 |     }
 143 |   } finally {
 144 |     running = false;
 145 |     // Housekeeping — remove synced entries older than 24h.
 146 |     await outboxStore.clearSyncedOlderThan(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 147 |   }
 148 | }
 149 | 
 150 | /** Wire this once from `_auth/app/route.tsx`. */
 151 | export function installOutboxFlusher(): () => void {
 152 |   const onOnline = () => void flushOutbox();
 153 |   const onFocus = () => void flushOutbox();
 154 |   window.addEventListener("online", onOnline);
 155 |   window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
 156 |   // Drain once on install (in case the tab was closed mid-flight).
 157 |   void flushOutbox();
 158 |   const interval = setInterval(() => void flushOutbox(), 30_000);
 159 |   return () => {
 160 |     window.removeEventListener("online", onOnline);
 161 |     window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
 162 |     clearInterval(interval);
 163 |   };
 164 | }
```

`features/outbox/store.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/outbox/store.ts
   2 | export type OutboxStatus = "queued" | "syncing" | "synced" | "conflict" | "failed";
   3 | 
   4 | export type OutboxKind =
   5 |   | "record-immunization"
   6 |   | "save-visit"
   7 |   | "save-prescription"
   8 |   | "set-milestone"
   9 |   | "create-measurement";
  10 | 
  11 | export type OutboxEntry<T = unknown> = {
  12 |   id: string;
  13 |   kind: OutboxKind;
  14 |   entityId: string;
  15 |   payload: T;
  16 |   status: OutboxStatus;
  17 |   /** Stable per *logical write* — survives retries. Server dedupes on this. */
  18 |   idempotencyKey: string;
  19 |   /** Last known server version for optimistic-concurrency (ETag/updatedAt). */
  20 |   baseVersion?: string;
  21 |   /** Local optimistic snapshot so the UI can render before sync. */
  22 |   optimisticSnapshot?: unknown;
  23 |   createdAt: string;
  24 |   updatedAt: string;
  25 |   attempts: number;
  26 |   /** Server's canonical state when a 409 comes back. */
  27 |   serverSnapshot?: unknown;
  28 |   error?: string;
  29 | };
  30 | 
  31 | const DB_NAME = "g-tracker";
  32 | const DB_VERSION = 1;
  33 | const STORE = "outbox";
  34 | 
  35 | let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase> | null = null;
  36 | 
  37 | function open(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  38 |   if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
  39 |   dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  40 |     const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
  41 |     req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
  42 |       const db = req.result;
  43 |       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) {
  44 |         const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
  45 |         store.createIndex("by-status", "status");
  46 |         store.createIndex("by-created", "createdAt");
  47 |       }
  48 |     };
  49 |     req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
  50 |     req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  51 |   });
  52 |   return dbPromise;
  53 | }
  54 | 
  55 | export const outboxStore = {
  56 |   async list(): Promise<OutboxEntry[]> {
  57 |     const db = await open();
  58 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  59 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE).objectStore(STORE).getAll();
  60 |       req.onsuccess = () =>
  61 |         resolve(
  62 |           (req.result as OutboxEntry[]).sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt)),
  63 |         );
  64 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  65 |     });
  66 |   },
  67 | 
  68 |   async byId(id: string): Promise<OutboxEntry | undefined> {
  69 |     const db = await open();
  70 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  71 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE).objectStore(STORE).get(id);
  72 |       req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result as OutboxEntry | undefined);
  73 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  74 |     });
  75 |   },
  76 | 
  77 |   async put(entry: OutboxEntry): Promise<void> {
  78 |     const db = await open();
  79 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  80 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite").objectStore(STORE).put(entry);
  81 |       req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
  82 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  83 |     });
  84 |   },
  85 | 
  86 |   async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
  87 |     const db = await open();
  88 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  89 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite").objectStore(STORE).delete(id);
  90 |       req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
  91 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  92 |     });
  93 |   },
  94 | 
  95 |   /**
  96 |    * Atomically claim the oldest `queued` entry and mark it `syncing`.
  97 |    * Uses a readwrite transaction so two tabs cannot claim the same row.
  98 |    */
  99 |   async claimNext(): Promise<OutboxEntry | undefined> {
 100 |     const db = await open();
 101 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 102 |       const tx = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
 103 |       const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
 104 |       const idx = store.index("by-status");
 105 |       const req = idx.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only("queued"));
 106 |       req.onsuccess = () => {
 107 |         const cursor = req.result;
 108 |         if (!cursor) return;
 109 |         const entry = cursor.value as OutboxEntry;
 110 |         const claimed: OutboxEntry = {
 111 |           ...entry,
 112 |           status: "syncing",
 113 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 114 |           attempts: entry.attempts + 1,
 115 |         };
 116 |         cursor.update(claimed);
 117 |         cursor.continue();
 118 |         // Resolve after tx commit — closing over `claimed` is safe
 119 |         // because IndexedDB serialises the transaction.
 120 |         tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(claimed);
 121 |       };
 122 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
 123 |       tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
 124 |     });
 125 |   },
 126 | 
 127 |   async clearSyncedOlderThan(ms: number): Promise<void> {
 128 |     const db = await open();
 129 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 130 |       const tx = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
 131 |       const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
 132 |       const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - ms).toISOString();
 133 |       const idx = store.index("by-created");
 134 |       const req = idx.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.upperBound(cutoff));
 135 |       req.onsuccess = () => {
 136 |         const cursor = req.result;
 137 |         if (!cursor) return;
 138 |         const entry = cursor.value as OutboxEntry;
 139 |         if (entry.status === "synced") cursor.delete();
 140 |         cursor.continue();
 141 |       };
 142 |       tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
 143 |       tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
 144 |     });
 145 |   },
 146 | };
```

```tsx
   3 | import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";

   5 | 
   6 | import { useOutbox } from "@/features/outbox/use-outbox";
   7 | 
   8 | export function ConnectionBanner() {
   9 |   const [online, setOnline] = React.useState(
  10 |     typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.onLine : true,
  11 |   );
  12 | 
  13 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  14 |     const on = () => setOnline(true);
  15 |     const off = () => setOnline(false);
  16 |     window.addEventListener("online", on);
  17 |     window.addEventListener("offline", off);
  18 |     return () => {
  19 |       window.removeEventListener("online", on);
  20 |       window.removeEventListener("offline", off);
  21 |     };
  22 |   }, []);
  23 | 
  24 |   const { data = [] } = useOutbox();
  25 |   const syncing = data.filter((e) => e.status === "queued" || e.status === "syncing").length;
  26 |   const conflicts = data.filter((e) => e.status === "conflict").length;
  27 |   const failed = data.filter((e) => e.status === "failed").length;
  28 | 
  29 |   const { label, tone, href } = (() => {
  30 |     if (!online)
  31 |       return {
  32 |         label: `Offline — ${syncing} change${syncing === 1 ? "" : "s"} queued`,
  33 |         tone: "warning" as const,
  34 |         href: undefined,
  35 |       };
  36 |     if (conflicts > 0)
  37 |       return {
  38 |         label: `${conflicts} conflict${conflicts === 1 ? "" : "s"} need review`,
  39 |         tone: "destructive" as const,
  40 |         href: "/app/conflicts",
  41 |       };
  42 |     if (failed > 0)
  43 |       return {
  44 |         label: `${failed} change${failed === 1 ? "" : "s"} failed to sync`,
  45 |         tone: "destructive" as const,
  46 |         href: "/app/conflicts?status=failed",
  47 |       };
  48 |     if (syncing > 0)
  49 |       return {
  50 |         label: `Syncing ${syncing} change${syncing === 1 ? "" : "s"}…`,
  51 |         tone: "info" as const,
  52 |         href: undefined,
  53 |       };
  54 |     return { label: null, tone: "info" as const, href: undefined };
  55 |   })();
  56 | 
  57 |   // Announce only when the *text* changes, not on every poll.
  58 |   const lastAnnounced = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  59 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  60 |     if (label && label !== lastAnnounced.current) {
  61 |       lastAnnounced.current = label;
  62 |     }
  63 |   }, [label]);
  64 | 
  65 |   if (!label) return null;
  66 | 
  67 |   const toneClass =
  68 |     tone === "destructive"
  69 |       ? "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20"
  70 |       : tone === "warning"
  71 |         ? "bg-warning/10 text-warning dark:text-warning border-warning/20"
  72 |         : "bg-muted text-foreground border-border";
  73 | 
  74 |   return (
  75 |     <div
  76 |       aria-atomic="true"
  77 |       aria-live="polite"
  78 |       className={`sticky top-0 z-40 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b px-4 py-2 text-sm ${toneClass}`}
  79 |       role="status"
  80 |     >
  81 |       <span>{label}</span>
  82 |       {href && (
  83 |         <Link className="text-xs font-medium underline underline-offset-2" to={href}>
  84 |           Review
  85 |         </Link>
  86 |       )}
  87 |     </div>
  88 |   );
  89 | }
```

`features/outbox/use-outbox.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/outbox/use-outbox.ts
   2 | import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | 
   4 | import { flushOutbox } from "./flusher";
   5 | import { type OutboxEntry, outboxStore } from "./store";
   6 | 
   7 | const key = ["outbox"] as const;
   8 | 
   9 | export function useOutbox() {
  10 |   return useQuery({
  11 |     queryKey: key,
  12 |     queryFn: () => outboxStore.list(),
  13 |     staleTime: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
  14 |     // Poll while anything is still in-flight so the banner updates.
  15 |     refetchInterval: (query) => {
  16 |       const data = query.state.data;
  17 |       return data?.some((e) => e.status === "queued" || e.status === "syncing") ? 2_000 : false;
  18 |     },
  19 |   });
  20 | }
  21 | 
  22 | export function useOutboxEntry(id: string) {
  23 |   return useQuery({
  24 |     queryKey: [...key, id],
  25 |     queryFn: () => outboxStore.byId(id),
  26 |     staleTime: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
  27 |   });
  28 | }
  29 | 
  30 | /**
  31 |  * Enqueue a write. Applies it optimistically to the outbox cache so the
  32 |  * banner and the per-item status badge update instantly.
  33 |  */
  34 | export function useQueueWrite() {
  35 |   const qc = useQueryClient();
  36 |   return useMutation({
  37 |     mutationFn: async (entry: OutboxEntry) => {
  38 |       await outboxStore.put(entry);
  39 |       void flushOutbox(); // kick the flusher
  40 |       return entry;
  41 |     },
  42 |     onMutate: async (entry) => {
  43 |       await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: key });
  44 |       const prev = qc.getQueryData<OutboxEntry[]>(key) ?? [];
  45 |       qc.setQueryData(key, [entry, ...prev]);
  46 |       return { prev };
  47 |     },
  48 |     onError: (_err, _entry, ctx) => {
  49 |       if (ctx) qc.setQueryData(key, ctx.prev);
  50 |     },
  51 |     onSettled: () => {
  52 |       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });
  53 |     },
  54 |   });
  55 | }
  56 | 
  57 | /**
  58 |  * Resolve a conflict. Caller picks which side wins.
  59 |  * - "keep-local": re-queue with a fresh idempotency key and the server's
  60 |  *   current `baseVersion`, so the server accepts the new write.
  61 |  * - "use-server": discard the local entry and refresh the relevant query.
  62 |  */
  63 | export function useResolveConflict() {
  64 |   const qc = useQueryClient();
  65 |   return useMutation({
  66 |     mutationFn: async ({
  67 |       id,
  68 |       resolution,
  69 |     }: {
  70 |       id: string;
  71 |       resolution: "keep-local" | "use-server";
  72 |     }) => {
  73 |       const entry = await outboxStore.byId(id);
  74 |       if (!entry) return;
  75 |       if (resolution === "use-server") {
  76 |         await outboxStore.delete(id);
  77 |       } else {
  78 |         await outboxStore.put({
  79 |           ...entry,
  80 |           status: "queued",
  81 |           idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID(),
  82 |           baseVersion: undefined,
  83 |           error: undefined,
  84 |           attempts: 0,
  85 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  86 |         });
  87 |       }
  88 |       void flushOutbox();
  89 |     },
  90 |     onSettled: () => {
  91 |       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });
  92 |     },
  93 |   });
  94 | }
```

```tsx
  33 |   lastName: z.string().trim().min(1, "Last name is required").max(120),
  34 |   sex: z.enum(["male", "female"]),

  53 | interface PatientFormProps {
```

```tsx
   1 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   2 | import { type AnyRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | import {
   4 |   createColumnHelper,
   5 |   rowPaginationFeature,
   6 |   tableFeatures,
   7 |   useTable,
   8 | } from "@tanstack/react-table";
   9 | import { UserRoundIcon } from "lucide-react";
  10 | import { useMemo } from "react";
  11 | 
  12 | import { buttonVariants } from "#/components/ui/button-variants";
  13 | // TODO: switch to `@/features/growth/math/lms` once that module exists.
  14 | import { IconTile } from "@/components/blocks/icon-tile";
  15 | import { DataTable } from "@/components/tables/data-table";
  16 | import { type PageSize } from "@/components/tables/table-pagination";
  17 | import { decimalMonthsBetween } from "@/features/shared/helpers";
  18 | 
  19 | import type { Patient } from "../schema";
  20 | 
  21 | import { patientsByClinicQuery } from "../queries";
  22 | 
  23 | // ── Static module-scope config ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  24 | 
  25 | const features = tableFeatures({ rowPaginationFeature });
  26 | 
  27 | const column = createColumnHelper<typeof features, Patient>();
  28 | const EMPTY_PATIENTS: Patient[] = [];
  29 | 
  30 | /** Format an age in fractional months as "3y 4m" / "11m". */
  31 | function formatAge(months: number): string {
  32 |   if (months < 0 || !Number.isFinite(months)) return "—";
  33 |   const years = Math.floor(months / 12);
  34 |   const rem = Math.round(months - years * 12);
  35 |   if (rem >= 12) return `${years + 1}y`;
  36 |   if (years === 0) return `${rem}m`;
  37 |   return rem === 0 ? `${years}y` : `${years}y ${rem}m`;
  38 | }
  39 | 
  40 | const MODULE_LOAD_MS = Date.now();
  41 | 
  42 | function ageMonthsFromDob(dateOfBirth: string): number | null {
  43 |   const dob = new Date(`${dateOfBirth}T00:00:00Z`);
  44 |   if (Number.isNaN(dob.getTime())) return null;
  45 |   return decimalMonthsBetween(dob, new Date(MODULE_LOAD_MS));
  46 | }
  47 | 
  48 | const columns = column.columns([
  49 |   column.accessor("mrn", {
  50 |     header: "MRN",
  51 |     meta: { width: "w-32 max-sm:w-24" },
  52 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  53 |       <span className="block truncate font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{row.original.mrn}</span>
  54 |     ),
  55 |   }),
  56 |   column.accessor((p) => `${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}`, {
  57 |     id: "name",
  58 |     header: "Patient",
  59 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  60 |       <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
  61 |         <IconTile tone="secondary">
  62 |           <UserRoundIcon aria-hidden="true" />
  63 |         </IconTile>
  64 |         <Link
  65 |           className="truncate font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
  66 |           params={{ patientId: row.original.id }}
  67 |           search={{ tab: "overview" }}
  68 |           to={"/app/patients/$patientId"}
  69 |         >
  70 |           {row.original.firstName} {row.original.lastName}
  71 |         </Link>
  72 |       </div>
  73 |     ),
  74 |   }),
  75 |   column.accessor("sex", {
  76 |     header: "Sex",
  77 |     meta: { width: "w-20", hideOnMobile: true },
  78 |     cell: (info) => <span className=" capitalize">{info.getValue()}</span>,
  79 |   }),
  80 |   column.accessor("dateOfBirth", {
  81 |     header: "Age",
  82 |     meta: { width: "w-24 max-sm:w-20" },
  83 |     cell: ({ row }) => {
  84 |       const ageMonths = ageMonthsFromDob(row.original.dateOfBirth);
  85 |       return (
  86 |         <span className="block text-right tabular-nums">
  87 |           {ageMonths === null ? "—" : formatAge(ageMonths)}
  88 |         </span>
  89 |       );
  90 |     },
  91 |   }),
  92 |   column.accessor("phone", {
  93 |     header: "Phone",
  94 |     meta: { width: "w-36", hideOnMobile: true },
  95 |     cell: (info) => (
  96 |       <span className=" block truncate" title={info.getValue() ?? undefined}>
  97 |         {info.getValue() ?? "—"}
  98 |       </span>
  99 |     ),
 100 |   }),
 101 | ]);
 102 | 
 103 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 104 | 
 105 | export interface PatientsTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute = AnyRoute> {
 106 |   route?: TRoute;
 107 |   clinicId?: string;
 108 |   page?: number;
 109 |   size?: PageSize;
 110 |   initialData?: Patient[];
 111 |   patients?: Patient[];
 112 | }
 113 | 
 114 | export function PatientsTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
 115 |   route,
 116 |   clinicId = "clinic-main",
 117 |   page = 1,
 118 |   size = 20,
 119 |   initialData,
 120 |   patients,
 121 | }: PatientsTableProps<TRoute>) {
 122 |   const query = useQuery({
 123 |     ...patientsByClinicQuery(clinicId),
 124 |     initialData,
 125 |     enabled: !patients,
 126 |   });
 127 | 
 128 |   const all = patients ?? query.data ?? EMPTY_PATIENTS;
 129 |   const total = all.length;
 130 |   const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
 131 |   const pageRows = useMemo(() => all.slice((page - 1) * size, page * size), [all, page, size]);
 132 | 
 133 |   const table = useTable(
 134 |     {
 135 |       key: "patients-table",
 136 |       features,
 137 |       columns,
 138 |       data: pageRows,
 139 |       getRowId: (patient) => patient.id,
 140 |       manualPagination: true,
 141 |       rowCount: total,
 142 |       state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
 143 |     },
 144 |     (state) => ({ pagination: state.pagination }),
 145 |   );
 146 | 
 147 |   return (
 148 |     <DataTable
 149 |       ariaLabel="Patients"
 150 |       emptyMessage="No patients registered in this clinic yet."
 151 |       errorDescription="The patient roster could not load. Check your connection and try again."
 152 |       errorTitle="Something Went Wrong"
 153 |       outOfRange={
 154 |         query.data && page > pageCount
 155 |           ? {
 156 |               backTo: () => (
 157 |                 <Link className={buttonVariants()} to={"/app/patients"}>
 158 |                   Back To First Page
 159 |                 </Link>
 160 |               ),
 161 |             }
 162 |           : undefined
 163 |       }
 164 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
 165 |       query={query}
 166 |       table={table}
 167 |     />
 168 |   );
 169 | }
```

```ts
 108 | export const updatePatientFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
 109 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
 110 |   .validator(

 113 |       patch: patientInsertSchema.partial().omit({ clinicId: true }),
 114 |       // Optimistic concurrency: the `updatedAt` ISO string the client saw.
 115 |       baseVersion: z.string().datetime().optional(),

 117 |   )
 118 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {
 119 |     const row = await updatePatient(data.patientId, data.patch, data.baseVersion);
 120 | 
 121 |     if (!row && data.baseVersion !== undefined) {

 123 |       // edit from a patient that no longer exists.

 125 |       if (existing) {
 126 |         setResponseStatus(409);
 127 |         throw new Error("This patient was updated by someone else. Reload and try again.");
 128 |       }
 129 |     }
 130 | 
 131 |     if (!row) {
 132 |       setResponseStatus(404);
 133 |       throw new Error("Patient not found.");
 134 |     }
 135 | 
 136 |     return row;
```

```ts
   1 | import type { z } from "zod";

   7 | import type { patientInsertSchema } from "./schema";
   8 | 
   9 | import {
  10 |   createPatientFn,
  11 |   fetchLapsedPatients,
  12 |   fetchPatientById,
  13 |   fetchPatientChart,
  14 |   fetchPatientForComposer,
  15 |   fetchPatientSummary,
  16 |   fetchPatientsByClinic,
  17 |   fetchPatientsSeenBetween,
  18 |   fetchPatientWithHistory,
  19 |   searchPatientsFn,
  20 |   updatePatientFn,

  22 | 
  23 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  24 | // Constants
  25 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  26 | 
  27 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  28 |   /** Single patient — name, DOB, contact details. Changes rarely. */
  29 |   DETAIL: 5 * 60_000,
  30 |   /** Patient for the composer — includes latest weight. Changes when a
  31 |    *  measurement is recorded, so slightly shorter. */
  32 |   COMPOSER: 60_000,
  33 |   /** Roster list. */
  34 |   LIST: 60_000,
  35 |   /** Full patient chart (visits, measurements, prescriptions). */
  36 |   CHART: 30_000,
  37 |   /** Summary snippet. */
  38 |   SUMMARY: 60_000,
  39 |   /** Search results — debounce the query on the client side. */
  40 |   SEARCH: 30_000,
  41 |   /** "Lost to follow-up" report — an aggregate, tolerate staleness. */
  42 |   REPORT: 120_000,
  43 | } as const;
  44 | 
  45 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  46 | // Query key factory
  47 | //
  48 | // Every key starts with "patient". Invalidate the whole tree with
  49 | // `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: patientKeys.all() })`, or a
  50 | // per-patient subtree with `patientKeys.detail(patientId)`.
  51 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  52 | 
  53 | export const patientKeys = {
  54 |   all: () => ["patient"] as const,
  55 | 
  56 |   /** The roster list for a clinic. */
  57 |   list: (clinicId: string) => ["patient", "list", clinicId] as const,
  58 | 
  59 |   /** Search results within a clinic. */
  60 |   search: (clinicId: string, query: string) => ["patient", "search", clinicId, query] as const,
  61 | 
  62 |   /** Per-patient subtree — invalidating this drops composer + history +
  63 |    *  chart + summary at once. */
  64 |   detail: (patientId: string) => ["patient", "detail", patientId] as const,
  65 | 
  66 |   /** The composer needs name, DOB, allergies, latest weight. */
  67 |   composer: (patientId: string) => ["patient", "detail", patientId, "composer"] as const,
  68 | 
  69 |   /** Patient + visit tree. */
  70 |   history: (patientId: string) => ["patient", "detail", patientId, "history"] as const,
  71 | 
  72 |   /** Full chart: visits, measurements, prescriptions, notes. */
  73 |   chart: (patientId: string) => ["patient", "detail", patientId, "chart"] as const,
  74 | 
  75 |   /** Just the identity fields. */
  76 |   summary: (patientId: string) => ["patient", "detail", patientId, "summary"] as const,
  77 | 
  78 |   /** "Lost to follow-up" report. */
  79 |   lapsed: (clinicId: string, months: number) => ["patient", "lapsed", clinicId, months] as const,
  80 | 
  81 |   /** "Seen between" report. */
  82 |   seenBetween: (clinicId: string, from: string, to: string) =>
  83 |     ["patient", "seen-between", clinicId, from, to] as const,
  84 | } as const;
  85 | 
  86 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  87 | // Query options
  88 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  89 | 
  90 | export function getPatientQueryOptions(patientId: string) {
  91 |   return queryOptions({
  92 |     queryKey: patientKeys.detail(patientId),
  93 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientById({ data: { patientId } }),
  94 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
  95 |   });
  96 | }
  97 | 
  98 | export function getPatientForComposerQueryOptions(patientId: string) {
  99 |   return queryOptions({
 100 |     queryKey: patientKeys.composer(patientId),
 101 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientForComposer({ data: { patientId } }),
 102 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.COMPOSER,
 103 |   });
 104 | }

 110 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CHART,
 111 |   });
 112 | }
 113 | 
 114 | export function patientChartQuery(patientId: string) {

 116 |     queryKey: patientKeys.chart(patientId),
 117 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientChart({ data: { patientId } }),
 118 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CHART,
 119 |   });
 120 | }

 122 | export function patientSummaryQuery(patientId: string) {

 124 |     queryKey: patientKeys.summary(patientId),

 135 |   });

 138 | /** Alias — `fetchPatients` is the same query as `fetchPatientsByClinic`. */
 139 | export const patientsListQuery = patientsByClinicQuery;
 140 | 
 141 | export function searchPatientsQuery(clinicId: string, query: string) {
 142 |   return queryOptions({
 143 |     queryKey: patientKeys.search(clinicId, query),
 144 |     queryFn: () => searchPatientsFn({ data: { clinicId, query } }),
 145 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.SEARCH,
 146 |     // Debounce `query` on the caller side. The server rejects an empty
 147 |     // query (`.min(1)`), so gate with `enabled`.
 148 |     enabled: query.trim().length > 0,
 149 |   });
 150 | }
 151 | 
 152 | export function lapsedPatientsQuery(clinicId: string, months = 6) {
 153 |   return queryOptions({
 154 |     queryKey: patientKeys.lapsed(clinicId, months),
 155 |     queryFn: () => fetchLapsedPatients({ data: { clinicId, months } }),
 156 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.REPORT,
 157 |   });
 158 | }
 159 | 
 160 | export function patientsSeenBetweenQuery(clinicId: string, from: string, to: string) {
 161 |   return queryOptions({
 162 |     queryKey: patientKeys.seenBetween(clinicId, from, to),
 163 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientsSeenBetween({ data: { clinicId, from, to } }),
 164 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.REPORT,
 165 |   });
 166 | }
 167 | 
 168 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 169 | // Invalidation helpers
 170 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 171 | 
 172 | /**
 173 |  * Call this after a patient mutation succeeds. Invalidates the roster for
 174 |  * the clinic and, for updates/deletes, the patient's own detail subtree
 175 |  * (which covers composer, history, chart, and summary).
 176 |  *
 177 |  * `createPatientFn` doesn't know the new patient's id yet, so pass only
 178 |  * `clinicId` — the roster and any list view will refetch.
 179 |  *
 180 |  * `updatePatientFn` and `deletePatientFn` should pass both.
 181 |  */
 182 | export function invalidateAfterPatientMutation(
 183 |   queryClient: {
 184 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
 185 |   },
 186 |   args: {
 187 |     clinicId: string;
 188 |     patientId?: string;
 189 |   },
 190 | ): Promise<unknown> {
 191 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
 192 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 193 |       queryKey: patientKeys.list(args.clinicId),
 194 |     }),
 195 |   ];
 196 | 
 197 |   if (args.patientId) {
 198 |     // `detail` is the parent of composer/history/chart/summary — one
 199 |     // invalidation drops all four.
 200 |     promises.push(
 201 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 202 |         queryKey: patientKeys.detail(args.patientId),
 203 |       }),
 204 |     );
 205 |   }
 206 | 
 207 |   return Promise.all(promises);
 208 | }
 209 | // src/features/patients/queries.ts — append
 210 | 
 211 | /**
 212 |  * Update a patient.
 213 |  *
 214 |  * Invalidates:
 215 |  *   - the patient's detail subtree (composer, history, chart, summary)
 216 |  *   - the roster list for the patient's clinic
 217 |  *   - the patient search results (name changes invalidate the search)
 218 |  *
 219 |  * `patientId` is required; `clinicId` is optional because the mutation
 220 |  * input doesn't carry it — the caller usually has it from `useAuthSuspense`.
 221 |  */
 222 | export function useUpdatePatientMutation(args: { patientId: string; clinicId?: string }) {
 223 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 224 |   const updatePatient = useServerFn(updatePatientFn);
 225 | 
 226 |   return useMutation({
 227 |     mutationFn: updatePatient,
 228 |     onSuccess: () => {
 229 |       void Promise.all([
 230 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 231 |           queryKey: patientKeys.detail(args.patientId),
 232 |         }),
 233 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: patientKeys.all() }),
 234 |         ...(args.clinicId
 235 |           ? [
 236 |               queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 237 |                 queryKey: patientKeys.list(args.clinicId),
 238 |               }),
 239 |             ]
 240 |           : []),
 241 |       ]);
 242 |     },
 243 |   });
 244 | }
 245 | 
 246 | type CreatePatientInput = z.infer<typeof patientInsertSchema>;
 247 | 
 248 | export function useCreatePatientMutation(args: { clinicId?: string }) {
 249 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 250 |   const createPatient = useServerFn(createPatientFn);
 251 | 
 252 |   return useMutation({
 253 |     mutationKey: ["patient", "create", args.clinicId ?? ""],
 254 |     mutationFn: (input: CreatePatientInput) => createPatient({ data: input }),
 255 |     onSuccess: (_patient, variables) => {
 256 |       // Roster for this clinic + any search results are now stale.
 257 |       void invalidateAfterPatientMutation(queryClient, {
 258 |         clinicId: variables.clinicId,
 259 |       });
 260 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: patientKeys.all() });
 261 |     },
 262 |   });
 263 | }
```
