```tsx
 294 |                   {(sub) => (
 295 |                     <div className="grid gap-1">
 296 |                       <Label htmlFor={`rx-${row.id}-instructions`}>
 297 |                         Instructions <span className=" font-normal">(optional)</span>
 298 |                       </Label>
 299 |                       <Textarea
 300 |                         id={`rx-${row.id}-instructions`}
 301 |                         maxLength={2000}
 302 |                         onBlur={sub.handleBlur}
 303 |                         onChange={(e) => sub.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 304 |                         placeholder="Take with food…"
 305 |                         rows={2}
 306 |                         value={sub.state.value}
 307 |                       />
 308 |                     </div>
 309 |                   )}
 310 |                 </form.Field>
 311 |               </div>
 312 |             ))}
 313 | 
 314 |             <Button
 315 |               onClick={() => field.pushValue(createMedication(`med-${idCounter.current++}`))}
 316 |               size="sm"
 317 |               type="button"
 318 |               variant="outline"
 319 |             >
 320 |               <Plus /> Add medication
 321 |             </Button>
 322 |           </div>
 323 |         )}
 324 |       </form.Field>
 325 | 
 326 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(state) => state.errorMap.onSubmit}>
 327 |         {(err) => {
 328 |           const message = fieldErrorMessage(err);
 329 |           return message ? (
 330 |             <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 331 |               {message}
 332 |             </p>
 333 |           ) : null;
 334 |         }}
 335 |       </form.Subscribe>
 336 | 
 337 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(state) => state.isSubmitting}>
 338 |         {(isSubmitting) => (
 339 |           <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
 340 |             {!inline && (
 341 |               <Button onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)} type="button" variant="outline">
 342 |                 Cancel
 343 |               </Button>
 344 |             )}
 345 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} type="submit">
 346 |               {isSubmitting ? "Saving…" : "Save Prescription"}
 347 |             </Button>
 348 |           </div>
 349 |         )}
 350 |       </form.Subscribe>
 351 |     </form>
 352 |   );
 353 | 
 354 |   if (inline) return body;
 355 | 
 356 |   return (
 357 |     <Dialog onOpenChange={handleOpenChange} open={open}>
 358 |       <DialogTrigger
 359 |         render={(props) => (
 360 |           <Button {...props} type="button">
 361 |             <Plus />
 362 |             New Prescription
 363 |           </Button>
 364 |         )}
 365 |       />
 366 |       <DialogContent>
 367 |         <DialogHeader>
 368 |           <DialogTitle>Prescribe Medication</DialogTitle>
 369 |           <DialogDescription>
 370 |             Add one or more medications for this visit. All are saved together.
 371 |           </DialogDescription>
 372 |         </DialogHeader>
 373 |         {body}
 374 |       </DialogContent>
 375 |     </Dialog>
 376 |   );
 377 | }
```

```tsx
  22 | 
  23 | // ── Static module-scope config ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  24 | 
  25 | const features = tableFeatures({
  26 |   rowPaginationFeature,
  27 |   paginatedRowModel: createPaginatedRowModel(),
  28 | });
  29 | 
  30 | const column = createColumnHelper<typeof features, PrescriptionRow>();
  31 | const EMPTY_PRESCRIPTIONS: PrescriptionRow[] = [];
  32 | 
  33 | /**
  34 |  * `durationDays` is nullable: null means "ongoing" (no scheduled end).
  35 |  * We render three states — a numeric duration, an "ongoing" badge, or a
  36 |  * dash when the row has no duration *and* is not marked ongoing.
  37 |  */
  38 | function durationLabel(days: number | null): {
  39 |   text: string;
  40 |   variant: "default" | "secondary" | "outline";
  41 | } {
  42 |   if (days === null) return { text: "ongoing", variant: "outline" };
  43 |   if (days === 1) return { text: "1 day", variant: "secondary" };
  44 |   return { text: `${days} days`, variant: "secondary" };
  45 | }
  46 | 
  47 | const columns = column.columns([
  48 |   column.accessor("medicationName", {
  49 |     header: "Medication",
  50 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  51 |       <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 py-1">
  52 |         <IconTile tone="secondary">
  53 |           <PillIcon aria-hidden="true" />
  54 |         </IconTile>
  55 |         <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
  56 |           <span className="truncate font-medium">{row.original.medicationName}</span>
  57 |           {row.original.instructions ? (
  58 |             <span className=" truncate text-xs">{row.original.instructions}</span>
  59 |           ) : null}
  60 |         </div>
  61 |       </div>
  62 |     ),
  63 |   }),
  64 |   column.accessor("dosage", {
  65 |     header: "Dosage",
  66 |     meta: { width: "w-28 max-sm:w-24" },
  67 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  68 |       <span className="block truncate font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{row.original.dosage}</span>
  69 |     ),
  70 |   }),
  71 |   column.accessor("frequency", {
  72 |     header: "Frequency",
  73 |     meta: { width: "w-24 max-sm:w-24" },
  74 |     cell: ({ row }) => (
  75 |       <span className=" block truncate font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">
  76 |         {row.original.frequency}
  77 |       </span>
  78 |     ),
  79 |   }),
  80 |   column.accessor("durationDays", {
  81 |     header: "Duration",
  82 |     meta: { width: "w-28", hideOnMobile: true },
  83 |     cell: ({ row }) => {
  84 |       const { text, variant } = durationLabel(row.original.durationDays);
  85 |       return <Badge variant={variant}>{text}</Badge>;
  86 |     },
  87 |   }),
  88 |   column.accessor("prescribedBy", {
  89 |     header: "Prescribed By",
  90 |     meta: { width: "w-40", hideOnMobile: true },
  91 |     cell: ({ row }) => {
  92 |       const doctor = row.original.prescribedBy;
  93 |       return <span className=" block truncate">{doctor?.name ?? "—"}</span>;
  94 |     },
  95 |   }),
  96 |   column.accessor("prescribedAt", {
  97 |     header: "Prescribed",
  98 |     meta: { width: "w-32 max-sm:w-24", hideOnMobile: true },
  99 |     cell: ({ row }) => {
 100 |       const date = new Date(row.original.prescribedAt);
 101 |       return (
 102 |         <span className=" block truncate font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{formatDate(date)}</span>
 103 |       );
 104 |     },
 105 |   }),
 106 | ]);
 107 | 
 108 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 109 | 
 110 | interface PrescriptionTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute = AnyRoute> {
 111 |   route?: TRoute;
 112 |   visitId?: string;
 113 |   patientId?: string;
 114 |   page?: number;
 115 |   size?: PageSize;
 116 | }
 117 | 
 118 | export function PrescriptionTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute = AnyRoute>({
 119 |   route,
 120 |   visitId,
 121 |   patientId,
 122 |   page = 1,
 123 |   size = 20,
 124 | }: PrescriptionTableProps<TRoute>) {
 125 |   const queryOptions = (visitId
 126 |     ? prescriptionsForVisitQuery(visitId)
 127 |     : prescriptionsForPatientQuery(patientId ?? "")) as unknown as UseQueryOptions<
 128 |     PrescriptionRow[],
 129 |     Error
 130 |   >;
 131 |   const query = useQuery({
 132 |     ...queryOptions,
 133 |     enabled: Boolean(visitId || patientId),
 134 |   });
 135 | 
 136 |   const all = query.data ?? EMPTY_PRESCRIPTIONS;
 137 | 
 138 |   const table = useTable({
 139 |     data: all,
 140 |     columns,
 141 |     features,
 142 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
 143 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
 144 |   });
 145 | 
 146 |   const pageCount = table.getPageCount();
 147 | 
 148 |   return (
 149 |     <DataTable
 150 |       ariaLabel="Prescriptions"
 151 |       emptyMessage="No prescriptions recorded for this visit yet."
 152 |       errorDescription={
 153 |         query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
 154 |       }
 155 |       errorTitle="Could Not Load Prescriptions"
 156 |       outOfRange={
 157 |         all.length > 0 && page > pageCount
 158 |           ? {
 159 |               backTo: () => (
 160 |                 <Link
 161 |                   className={buttonVariants()}
 162 |                   params={{ visitId } as never}
 163 |                   to={route?.fullPath ?? ("/app/visits/$visitId" as never)}
 164 |                 >
 165 |                   Back To First Page
 166 |                 </Link>
 167 |               ),
 168 |             }
 169 |           : undefined
 170 |       }
 171 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
 172 |       query={query}
 173 |       skeletonRowCount={Math.min(size, 3)}
 174 |       table={table}
 175 |     />
 176 |   );
 177 | }
```

```tsx
  18 | 
  19 | interface DoseRowProps {

  24 |   mgPerKgPerDay: number | null;

  26 |   concentrationIndex: number;

  28 |   onChange: (next: {

  32 |     dosesPerDay?: number | null;
  33 |     concentrationIndex?: number;

  36 | }

  40 | export function DoseRow(props: DoseRowProps) {

  44 |     useCalc &&
  45 |     drug &&
  46 |     weightKg &&
  47 |     mgPerKgPerDay &&
  48 |     dosesPerDay &&

  50 |       ? calculateNeonatalDose({

  53 |             name: drug.genericName,
  54 |             genericName: drug.genericName,
  55 |             category: "Antibiotic",
  56 |             indication: drug.indication,
  57 |             standardDose: mgPerKgPerDay,

  60 |             doseUnit: "mg/kg/day",
  61 |             frequency: "q8h",
  62 |             dosesPerDay,
  63 |             routes: ["Oral"],
  64 |             concentrations: drug.concentrations.map((c, i) => ({
  65 |               id: `c-${i}`,
  66 |               label: c.label,
  67 |               mg: c.mg,
  68 |               ml: c.ml,
  69 |               route: "Oral",
  70 |             })),
  71 |             safetyWarnings: {},
  72 |           },
  73 |           weightKg,
  74 |           dosePerKg: mgPerKgPerDay,
  75 |           dosesPerDay,
  76 |           concentration: {
  77 |             id: `c-${concentrationIndex}`,
  78 |             label: drug.concentrations[concentrationIndex].label,
  79 |             mg: drug.concentrations[concentrationIndex].mg,
  80 |             ml: drug.concentrations[concentrationIndex].ml,
  81 |             route: "Oral",
  82 |           },
  83 |         })
  84 |       : null;
  85 | 
  86 |   return (
  87 |     <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3">
  88 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
  89 |         <Label className="flex items-center">
  90 |           <CalculatorIcon className="size-3.5" />
  91 |           Dose
  92 |         </Label>
  93 |         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  94 |           <Switch
  95 |             checked={useCalc}
  96 |             id="composer-use-calc"
  97 |             onCheckedChange={(v) => props.onChange({ useCalc: v })}
  98 |           />
  99 |           <Label variant="secondary" htmlFor="composer-use-calc">
 100 |             Calculate from mg/kg
 101 |           </Label>
 102 |         </div>
 103 |       </div>
 104 | 
 105 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_110px] gap-2">
 106 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
 107 |           <Label htmlFor="composer-strength">Strength</Label>
 108 |           <Input
 109 |             disabled={useCalc}
 110 |             id="composer-strength"
 111 |             inputMode="decimal"
 112 |             min="0"
 113 |             onChange={(e) => props.onChange({ strength: e.target.valueAsNumber || 0 })}
 114 |             step="0.01"
 115 |             type="number"
 116 |             value={Number.isFinite(props.strength) ? props.strength : ""}
 117 |           />
 118 |         </div>
 119 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
 120 |           <Label htmlFor="composer-unit">Unit</Label>
 121 |           <Select
 122 |             onValueChange={(v) => {
 123 |               if (UNITS.includes(v as ComposerUnit)) {
 124 |                 props.onChange({ unit: v as ComposerUnit });
 125 |               }
 126 |             }}
 127 |             value={props.unit}
 128 |           >
 129 |             <SelectTrigger id="composer-unit">
 130 |               <SelectValue />
 131 |             </SelectTrigger>
 132 |             <SelectContent>
 133 |               {UNITS.map((u) => (
 134 |                 <SelectItem key={u} value={u}>
 135 |                   {u}
 136 |                 </SelectItem>
 137 |               ))}
 138 |             </SelectContent>
 139 |           </Select>
 140 |         </div>
 141 |       </div>
 142 | 
 143 |       {useCalc && (
 144 |         <div className="bg-muted/40 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-md p-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
 145 |           <div className="grid gap-1">
 146 |             <Label htmlFor="composer-mgkg">mg/kg/day</Label>
 147 |             <Input
 148 |               id="composer-mgkg"
 149 |               inputMode="decimal"
 150 |               min="0"
 151 |               onChange={(e) =>
 152 |                 props.onChange({
 153 |                   mgPerKgPerDay: e.target.valueAsNumber || null,
 154 |                 })
 155 |               }
 156 |               step="0.01"
 157 |               type="number"
 158 |               value={mgPerKgPerDay ?? ""}
 159 |             />
 160 |           </div>
 161 |           <div className="grid gap-1">
 162 |             <Label htmlFor="composer-doses">Doses/day</Label>
 163 |             <Input
 164 |               id="composer-doses"
 165 |               inputMode="numeric"
 166 |               max="12"
 167 |               min="1"
 168 |               onChange={(e) => props.onChange({ dosesPerDay: e.target.valueAsNumber || null })}
 169 |               step="1"

 172 |             />

 175 |             <Label htmlFor="composer-conc">Preparation</Label>
 176 |             <Select
 177 |               onValueChange={(v) => {

 181 |                 }
 182 |               }}
 183 |               value={String(concentrationIndex)}
 184 |             >
 185 |               <SelectTrigger id="composer-conc">
 186 |                 <SelectValue />
 187 |               </SelectTrigger>
 188 |               <SelectContent>
 189 |                 {(drug?.concentrations ?? []).map((c, i) => (
 190 |                   <SelectItem key={c.label} value={String(i)}>
 191 |                     {c.label}
 192 |                   </SelectItem>
 193 |                 ))}
 194 |               </SelectContent>
 195 |             </Select>
 196 |           </div>
 197 | 
 198 |           {calc && (
 199 |             <p className="col-span-full text-sm">
 200 |               <span className="">Dose: </span>
 201 |               <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
 202 |                 {calc.singleDoseMg.toFixed(2)} mg per {calc.volumeMlPerDose.toFixed(2)} mL
 203 |               </span>
 204 |               {calc.isCapped && (
 205 |                 <span className="ml-2 text-warning">(capped at formulary max)</span>
 206 |               )}
 207 |             </p>
 208 |           )}
 209 |         </div>
 210 |       )}
 211 |     </div>
 212 |   );
 213 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import { ChevronDownIcon, SearchIcon } from "lucide-react";
   2 | import * as React from "react";
   3 | 
   4 | import { Badge } from "#/components/ui/badge";
   5 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   6 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input";
   7 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
   8 | 
   9 | import { COMPOSER_DRUGS, type ComposerDrug } from "../formulary";
  10 | 
  11 | interface MedicationAutocompleteProps {
  12 |   value: string;
  13 |   onSelect: (drug: ComposerDrug) => void;
  14 |   disabled?: boolean;
  15 | }
  16 | 
  17 | const AWARE_VARIANT = {
  18 |   Access: "success",
  19 |   Watch: "warning",
  20 |   Reserve: "destructive",
  21 |   "Not Applicable": "outline",
  22 | } as const;
  23 | 
  24 | const MAX_RESULTS = 20;
  25 | const INITIAL_RESULTS = 8;
  26 | 
  27 | export function MedicationAutocomplete({ value, onSelect, disabled }: MedicationAutocompleteProps) {
  28 |   const listboxId = React.useId();
  29 |   const inputId = `${listboxId}-input`;
  30 |   const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  31 |   const [queryState, setQueryState] = React.useState({ value, query: value });
  32 |   const query = queryState.value === value ? queryState.query : value;
  33 |   const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = React.useState(0);
  34 |   const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  35 | 
  36 |   const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
  37 |     const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  38 |     if (!q) return COMPOSER_DRUGS.slice(0, INITIAL_RESULTS);
  39 |     return COMPOSER_DRUGS.filter(
  40 |       (d) =>
  41 |         d.genericName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
  42 |         d.brandNames.some((b) => b.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
  43 |         d.indication.toLowerCase().includes(q),
  44 |     ).slice(0, MAX_RESULTS);
  45 |   }, [query]);
  46 | 
  47 |   const hasResults = filtered.length > 0;
  48 | 
  49 |   const choose = React.useCallback(
  50 |     (drug: ComposerDrug) => {
  51 |       onSelect(drug);
  52 |       setQueryState({ value, query: drug.genericName });
  53 |       setOpen(false);
  54 |       inputRef.current?.focus();
  55 |     },
  56 |     [onSelect, value],
  57 |   );
  58 | 
  59 |   const onKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  60 |     if (disabled) return;
  61 | 
  62 |     if (!open) {
  63 |       if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === "Enter") {
  64 |         event.preventDefault();
  65 |         setOpen(true);
  66 |       }
  67 |       return;
  68 |     }
  69 | 
  70 |     switch (event.key) {
  71 |       case "ArrowDown":
  72 |         event.preventDefault();
  73 |         setActiveIndex((i) => Math.min(i + 1, Math.max(filtered.length - 1, 0)));
  74 |         return;
  75 |       case "ArrowUp":
  76 |         event.preventDefault();
  77 |         setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
  78 |         return;
  79 |       case "Home":
  80 |         event.preventDefault();
  81 |         setActiveIndex(0);
  82 |         return;
  83 |       case "End":
  84 |         event.preventDefault();
  85 |         setActiveIndex(Math.max(filtered.length - 1, 0));
  86 |         return;
  87 |       case "Enter": {
  88 |         event.preventDefault();
  89 |         const picked = filtered[activeIndex];
  90 |         if (picked) choose(picked);
  91 |         return;
  92 |       }
  93 |       case "Escape":
  94 |         event.preventDefault();
  95 |         setOpen(false);
  96 |         return;
  97 |       case "Tab":
  98 |         setOpen(false);
  99 |         return;
 100 |     }
 101 |   };
 102 | 
 103 |   const activeOptionId = open && hasResults ? `${listboxId}-opt-${activeIndex}` : undefined;
 104 | 
 105 |   return (
 106 |     <div className="relative">
 107 |       <div className="relative">
 108 |         <SearchIcon
 109 |           aria-hidden="true"
 110 |           className=" pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-2.5 size-4 -translate-y-1/2"
 111 |         />
 112 |         <Input
 113 |           aria-activedescendant={activeOptionId}
 114 |           aria-autocomplete="list"
 115 |           aria-controls={open ? listboxId : undefined}
 116 |           aria-expanded={open}
 117 |           aria-haspopup="listbox"
 118 |           aria-label="Search medications"
 119 |           autoComplete="off"
 120 |           disabled={disabled}
 121 |           id={inputId}
 122 |           onBlur={() => setOpen(false)}
 123 |           onChange={(event) => {
 124 |             setQueryState({ value, query: event.target.value });
 125 |             setOpen(true);
 126 |           }}
 127 |           onFocus={() => {
 128 |             if (!disabled) setOpen(true);
 129 |           }}
 130 |           onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
 131 |           placeholder="Search by generic name, brand, or indication"
 132 |           ref={inputRef}
 133 |           role="combobox"
 134 |           type="text"
 135 |           value={query}
 136 |         />
 137 |         <Button
 138 |           aria-controls={open ? listboxId : undefined}
 139 |           aria-expanded={open}
 140 |           aria-label={open ? "Close medication list" : "Open medication list"}
 141 |           className="absolute top-1/2 right-1 -translate-y-1/2"
 142 |           disabled={disabled}
 143 |           onClick={() => {
 144 |             if (open) {
 145 |               setOpen(false);
 146 |             } else {
 147 |               setOpen(true);
 148 |               inputRef.current?.focus();
 149 |             }
 150 |           }}
 151 |           onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 152 |           size="icon-xs"
 153 |           tabIndex={-1}
 154 |           type="button"
 155 |           variant="ghost"
 156 |         >
 157 |           <ChevronDownIcon
 158 |             aria-hidden="true"
 159 |             className={cn("size-4 transition-transform", open && "rotate-180")}
 160 |           />
 161 |         </Button>
 162 |       </div>
 163 | 
 164 |       {open && (
 165 |         <div
 166 |           aria-label="Medication results"
 167 |           className="absolute z-20 mt-1 max-h-72 w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-md bg-popover p-1 shadow-md ring-1 ring-foreground/10"
 168 |           id={listboxId}
 169 |           role="listbox"
 170 |         >
 171 |           {hasResults ? (
 172 |             filtered.map((drug, index) => {
 173 |               const isActive = index === activeIndex;
 174 |               return (
 175 |                 <div key={drug.key} role="presentation">
 176 |                   <Button
 177 |                     aria-selected={isActive}
 178 |                     className={cn("h-auto w-full justify-start whitespace-normal")}
 179 |                     variant={isActive ? "secondary" : "ghost"}
 180 |                     id={`${listboxId}-opt-${index}`}
 181 |                     onMouseDown={(event) => {
 182 |                       event.preventDefault();
 183 |                       choose(drug);
 184 |                     }}
 185 |                     onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
 186 |                     role="option"
 187 |                     tabIndex={-1}
 188 |                     type="button"
 189 |                   >
 190 |                     <span className="flex w-full flex-col gap-0.5 text-left">
 191 |                       <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
 192 |                         <span className="font-medium">{drug.genericName}</span>
 193 |                         <Badge variant={AWARE_VARIANT[drug.aware]}>{drug.aware}</Badge>
 194 |                       </span>
 195 |                       {drug.brandNames.length > 0 && (
 196 |                         <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
 197 |                           {drug.brandNames.slice(0, 3).map((b) => (
 198 |                             <span className="bg-muted  rounded  py-0.5 text-xsss" key={b}>
 199 |                               {b}
 200 |                             </span>
 201 |                           ))}
 202 |                         </span>
 203 |                       )}
 204 |                       <span className="truncate text-xs ">{drug.indication}</span>
 205 |                     </span>
 206 |                   </Button>
 207 |                 </div>
 208 |               );
 209 |             })
 210 |           ) : (
 211 |             <div aria-live="polite" className="px-3 py-2 text-sm " role="status">
 212 |               No results found.
 213 |             </div>
 214 |           )}
 215 |         </div>
 216 |       )}
 217 |     </div>
 218 |   );
 219 | }
```

```tsx
   7 | 
   8 | export interface PatientContext {
   9 |   id: string;
  10 |   mrn: string;
  11 |   firstName: string;

  23 |   mode: "create" | "edit" | "view";

  25 | 
  26 | export function PatientContextCard({
  27 |   patient,

  32 |   const [referenceDate] = useState(() => new Date());

  46 |           aria-hidden="true"

  49 |           {patient.firstName.charAt(0)}
  50 |           {patient.lastName.charAt(0)}
  51 |         </span>
  52 |         <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
  53 |           <span className="truncate font-semibold">
  54 |             {patient.firstName} {patient.lastName}
  55 |           </span>
  56 |           <span className="font-mono text-xs  tabular-nums">
  57 |             {patient.mrn} · {ageLabel} · {patient.sex === "male" ? "Boy" : "Girl"}
  58 |           </span>
  59 |         </div>
  60 |       </div>
  61 | 
  62 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
  63 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
  64 |           <Label htmlFor="composer-weight">Weight (kg)</Label>
  65 |           {mode === "view" ? (
  66 |             <span className="font-mono text-sm tabular-nums">
  67 |               {weightKg ? weightKg.toFixed(2) : "—"}
  68 |             </span>
  69 |           ) : (
  70 |             <Input
  71 |               id="composer-weight"
  72 |               inputMode="decimal"
  73 |               min="0.3"

  76 |                 onWeightChange(Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : null);
  77 |               }}
  78 |               step="0.01"
  79 |               type="number"
  80 |               value={weightKg ?? ""}
  81 |             />
  82 |           )}
  83 |           <p className=" text-xss">Drives mg/kg calculation.</p>
  84 |         </div>
  85 | 
  86 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
  87 |           <Label>Allergies</Label>
  88 |           {patient.allergies ? (

  90 |               {patient.allergies
  91 |                 .split(",")
  92 |                 .map((a) => a.trim())
  93 |                 .filter(Boolean)
  94 |                 .map((a) => (
  95 |                   <Badge key={a} variant="destructive">
  96 |                     {a}
  97 |                   </Badge>
  98 |                 ))}
  99 |             </div>
 100 |           ) : (
 101 |             <span className="text-xs ">None recorded</span>
 102 |           )}
 103 |         </div>
 104 |       </div>
 105 |     </div>
 106 |   );
 107 | }
```

`features/prescriptions/composer/components/interactions.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import type { ComposerDrug } from "../formulary";
   2 | import type { InteractionWarning } from "./SafetyRail";
   3 | 
   4 | export function computeInteractions(args: {
   5 |   drug: ComposerDrug | undefined;
   6 |   allergies: string | null;
   7 |   active: Array<{ medicationName: string }>;
   8 | }): InteractionWarning[] {
   9 |   const warnings: InteractionWarning[] = [];
  10 |   if (!args.drug) return warnings;
  11 | 
  12 |   const allergyList = (args.allergies ?? "")
  13 |     .split(",")
  14 |     .map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase())
  15 |     .filter(Boolean);
  16 | 
  17 |   // Red: allergy on the drug's contraindications list
  18 |   for (const c of args.drug.contraindications) {
  19 |     const lower = c.toLowerCase();
  20 |     if (allergyList.some((a) => lower.includes(a))) {
  21 |       warnings.push({
  22 |         severity: "red",
  23 |         title: `Contraindicated: ${c}`,
  24 |         detail: `Patient allergy matches a contraindication for ${args.drug.genericName}.`,
  25 |       });
  26 |     }
  27 |   }
  28 | 
  29 |   // Amber: currently active medication with a matching generic name
  30 |   for (const activeMed of args.active) {
  31 |     if (activeMed.medicationName.toLowerCase() === args.drug.genericName.toLowerCase()) {
  32 |       warnings.push({
  33 |         severity: "amber",
  34 |         title: `Already on ${args.drug.genericName}`,
  35 |         detail:
  36 |           "An active prescription for the same medication exists. Confirm this is intentional.",
  37 |       });
  38 |     }
  39 |   }
  40 | 
  41 |   return warnings;
  42 | }
```

`features/prescriptions/composer/formulary.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { EGYPTIAN_NATIONAL_FORMULARY } from "@data/formulary/egyptianNationalFormulary";
   2 | import { NEONATAL_PEDIATRIC_FORMULARY } from "@data/formulary/neonatalDrugs";
   3 | 
   4 | import type { DrugFormularyItem } from "@/features/medications/types";
   5 | 
   6 | // ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   7 | 
   8 | export interface ComposerConcentration {
   9 |   label: string;
  10 |   mg: number;
  11 |   ml: number;
  12 | }
  13 | 
  14 | export interface ComposerDrug {
  15 |   key: string;
  16 |   genericName: string;
  17 |   brandNames: string[];
  18 |   aware: "Access" | "Watch" | "Reserve" | "Not Applicable";
  19 |   indication: string;
  20 |   contraindications: string[];
  21 |   monitoring: string[];
  22 |   concentrations: ComposerConcentration[];
  23 |   dosing: {
  24 |     mgPerKgPerDay?: number;
  25 |     dosesPerDay: number;
  26 |     maxMgPerKgPerDay?: number;
  27 |     maxSingleDoseMg?: number;
  28 |     maxDailyDoseMg?: number;
  29 |   };
  30 |   crossReactivities: string[];
  31 | }
  32 | 
  33 | // ── Narrowing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  34 | 
  35 | /**
  36 |  * True iff both concentrations are present, finite, and strictly positive.
  37 |  * Returning a `value is T` type predicate narrows the *element* type, so
  38 |  * downstream `.map()` sees `number` instead of `number | undefined`.
  39 |  */
  40 | function hasUsableConcentration<P extends { concentrationMg?: number; volumeMl?: number }>(
  41 |   p: P,
  42 | ): p is P & { concentrationMg: number; volumeMl: number } {
  43 |   return (
  44 |     typeof p.concentrationMg === "number" &&
  45 |     Number.isFinite(p.concentrationMg) &&
  46 |     p.concentrationMg > 0 &&
  47 |     typeof p.volumeMl === "number" &&
  48 |     Number.isFinite(p.volumeMl) &&
  49 |     p.volumeMl > 0
  50 |   );
  51 | }
  52 | 
  53 | /**
  54 |  * Narrowing for the neonatal formulary's `DrugConcentration` shape — `mg`
  55 |  * and `ml` are required on the type but the codebase already guards against
  56 |  * `<= 0`, so we do the same.
  57 |  */
  58 | function hasUsableDrugConcentration<C extends { mg: number; ml: number }>(
  59 |   c: C,
  60 | ): c is C & { mg: number; ml: number } {
  61 |   return Number.isFinite(c.mg) && c.mg > 0 && Number.isFinite(c.ml) && c.ml > 0;
  62 | }
  63 | 
  64 | /**
  65 |  * Collect the non-empty strings out of a `safetyWarnings`-shaped object.
  66 |  * Values can be `string | undefined`; the predicate narrows to `string`.
  67 |  */
  68 | function definedStrings<T extends Record<string, string | undefined>>(obj: T): string[] {
  69 |   return Object.values(obj).filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v));
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | // ── Adapters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  73 | 
  74 | function fromEgyptian(d: (typeof EGYPTIAN_NATIONAL_FORMULARY)[number]): ComposerDrug {
  75 |   return {
  76 |     key: `eg:${d.id}`,
  77 |     genericName: d.genericName,
  78 |     brandNames: d.brandNamesEgypt,
  79 |     aware: d.awareClassification ?? "Not Applicable",
  80 |     indication: d.indications[0] ?? "",
  81 |     contraindications: d.contraindications,
  82 |     monitoring: d.monitoringParameters,
  83 |     concentrations: d.presentations
  84 |       .filter(hasUsableConcentration)
  85 |       .map<ComposerConcentration>((p) => ({
  86 |         label: p.strength,
  87 |         mg: p.concentrationMg,
  88 |         ml: p.volumeMl,
  89 |       })),
  90 |     dosing: {
  91 |       mgPerKgPerDay: d.pediatricDosing.standardDosePerKg,
  92 |       dosesPerDay: d.pediatricDosing.dosesPerDay,
  93 |       maxMgPerKgPerDay: d.pediatricDosing.maxDosePerKg,
  94 |       maxSingleDoseMg: d.pediatricDosing.maxSingleDoseMg,
  95 |       maxDailyDoseMg: d.pediatricDosing.maxDailyDoseMg,
  96 |     },
  97 |     crossReactivities: d.penicillinAllergyCrossReactive ? ["penicillin"] : [],
  98 |   };
  99 | }
 100 | 
 101 | function fromNeonatal(d: DrugFormularyItem): ComposerDrug {
 102 |   const safetyNotes = definedStrings(d.safetyWarnings);
 103 |   return {
 104 |     key: `neo:${d.id}`,
 105 |     genericName: d.genericName,
 106 |     brandNames: [],
 107 |     aware: "Not Applicable",
 108 |     indication: d.indication,
 109 |     contraindications: safetyNotes,
 110 |     monitoring: safetyNotes,
 111 |     concentrations: d.concentrations
 112 |       .filter(hasUsableDrugConcentration)
 113 |       .map<ComposerConcentration>((c) => ({
 114 |         label: c.label,
 115 |         mg: c.mg,
 116 |         ml: c.ml,
 117 |       })),
 118 |     dosing: {
 119 |       mgPerKgPerDay: undefined,
 120 |       dosesPerDay: d.dosesPerDay,
 121 |       maxMgPerKgPerDay: d.maxDose,
 122 |       maxSingleDoseMg: d.maxSingleDoseMg,
 123 |       maxDailyDoseMg: d.maxDailyDoseMg,
 124 |     },
 125 |     crossReactivities: [],
 126 |   };
 127 | }
 128 | 
 129 | // ── Public surface ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 130 | 
 131 | export const COMPOSER_DRUGS: readonly ComposerDrug[] = [
 132 |   ...EGYPTIAN_NATIONAL_FORMULARY.map(fromEgyptian),
 133 |   ...NEONATAL_PEDIATRIC_FORMULARY.map(fromNeonatal),
 134 | ];
 135 | 
 136 | export function findComposerDrug(key: string): ComposerDrug | undefined {
 137 |   return COMPOSER_DRUGS.find((d) => d.key === key);
 138 | }
 139 | 
 140 | /** Fast lookup for the picker's search — pre-computed once, not per render. */
 141 | export const COMPOSER_DRUGS_BY_KEY: ReadonlyMap<string, ComposerDrug> = new Map(
 142 |   COMPOSER_DRUGS.map((d) => [d.key, d]),
 143 | );
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/prescriptions/composer/functions.ts
   2 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   3 | import { z } from "zod";
   4 | 
   5 | import {
   6 |   discontinueComposerPrescription,
   7 |   saveComposerPrescription,
   8 | } from "@/db/queries/prescription-composer.queries";
   9 | import { clinicAccessMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/clinic-middleware";
  10 | import { freshAuthMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
  11 | 
  12 | import { prescriptionComposerSchema } from "./types";
  13 | 
  14 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  15 | // Save (create or update)
  16 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  17 | //
  18 | // The composer's save path is different from the register's `createPrescriptionFn`
  19 | // because it accepts `strength`/`unit` and composes `dosage` server-side,
  20 | // and it can both create and update depending on whether `prescriptionId`
  21 | // is provided. It's a distinct server function on purpose.
  22 | 
  23 | const SaveSchema = prescriptionComposerSchema.extend({
  24 |   prescriptionId: z.uuid().optional(),
  25 | });
  26 | 
  27 | export const savePrescription = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  28 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  29 |   .validator(SaveSchema)
  30 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {
  31 |     const row = await saveComposerPrescription({
  32 |       prescriptionId: data.prescriptionId,
  33 |       patientId: data.patientId,
  34 |       visitId: data.visitId,
  35 |       medicationName: data.medicationName,
  36 |       dosage: `${data.strength} ${data.unit}`,
  37 |       frequency: data.frequency,
  38 |       durationDays: data.durationDays,
  39 |       instructions: data.instructions,
  40 |     });
  41 | 
  42 |     if (!row) {
  43 |       throw new Error("Failed to save prescription");
  44 |     }
  45 |     return row;
  46 |   });
  47 | 
  48 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  49 | // Discontinue
  50 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  51 | 
  52 | export const discontinuePrescription = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  53 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
  54 |   .validator(z.object({ prescriptionId: z.uuid() }))
  55 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {
  56 |     const row = await discontinueComposerPrescription(data.prescriptionId);
  57 |     // Distinguish "row doesn't exist" from "row updated to cancelled",
  58 |     // so the caller can show the right toast.
  59 |     if (!row) {
  60 |       throw new Error(`Prescription ${data.prescriptionId} not found`);
  61 |     }
  62 |     return row;
  63 |   });
```

`features/prescriptions/composer/queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/prescriptions/composer/queries.ts
   2 | import { type QueryClient, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   4 | 
   5 | import {
   6 |   getActivePrescriptionsQuery,
   7 |   getPatientForComposerQueryOptions,
   8 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/queries";
   9 | 
  10 | import type { PrescriptionComposerValues } from "./types";
  11 | 
  12 | import { discontinuePrescription, savePrescription } from "./functions";
  13 | 
  14 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  15 | // Shared reads — the composer does NOT define its own
  16 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  17 | //
  18 | // The composer used to have `fetchComposerPatientContext` and
  19 | // `fetchComposerActiveMeds` as bespoke server functions with bespoke
  20 | // query keys. That meant:
  21 | //   - the same patient context lived in two cache entries, and
  22 | //   - invalidating `["prescriptions", "patient", id]` from the
  23 | //     prescriptions register would NOT refresh the composer's
  24 | //     "previous prescriptions" rail.
  25 | //
  26 | // The fix is to reuse the shared queries from the parent features.
  27 | // These re-exports exist so the composer route has a single import
  28 | // surface — call them from the composer, they hit the shared cache.
  29 | 
  30 | export { getActivePrescriptionsQuery, getPatientForComposerQueryOptions };
  31 | 
  32 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  33 | // Mutations
  34 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  35 | //
  36 | // We export mutation hooks (not raw mutation objects) so the route
  37 | // doesn't have to re-specify `onSuccess` invalidation in every caller.
  38 | // The invalidation list is exactly the same whether the save comes
  39 | // from the composer or the register, so it lives here.
  40 | 
  41 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  42 | // Invalidation
  43 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  44 | 
  45 | /**
  46 |  * The set of caches touched by a prescription write. Kept private to
  47 |  * this module — callers go through the mutation hooks above, which
  48 |  * call this for them.
  49 |  */
  50 | export async function invalidateAfterPrescriptionWrite(
  51 |   queryClient: QueryClient,
  52 |   args: { prescriptionId: string; patientId: string },
  53 | ): Promise<void> {
  54 |   await Promise.all([
  55 |     // The prescription itself.
  56 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  57 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "detail", args.prescriptionId],
  58 |     }),
  59 |     // The register list (any page/filter combination).
  60 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  61 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
  62 |     }),
  63 |     // The patient's full medication history — used by the safety rail
  64 |     // in any open composer tab.
  65 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  66 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "patient", args.patientId],
  67 |     }),
  68 |     // Visit-level prescription lists (the visit detail page).
  69 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  70 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "visit"],
  71 |     }),
  72 |   ]);
  73 | }
  74 | 
  75 | export function useSavePrescriptionMutation() {
  76 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  77 |   const saveFn = useServerFn(savePrescription);
  78 | 
  79 |   return useMutation({
  80 |     mutationFn: (values: PrescriptionComposerValues & { prescriptionId?: string }) =>
  81 |       saveFn({ data: values }),
  82 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
  83 |       if (!row) return;
  84 |       void Promise.all([
  85 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  86 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "detail", row.id],
  87 |         }),
  88 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  89 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
  90 |         }),
  91 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  92 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "patient", row.patientId],
  93 |         }),
  94 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  95 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "visit", row.visitId],
  96 |         }),
  97 |       ]);
  98 |     },
  99 |   });
 100 | }
 101 | 
 102 | export function useDiscontinuePrescriptionMutation() {
 103 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 104 |   const discontinueFn = useServerFn(discontinuePrescription);
 105 | 
 106 |   return useMutation({
 107 |     mutationFn: (input: { prescriptionId: string }) => discontinueFn({ data: input }),
 108 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
 109 |       if (!row) return;
 110 |       void Promise.all([
 111 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 112 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "detail", row.id],
 113 |         }),
 114 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 115 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
 116 |         }),
 117 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 118 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "patient", row.patientId],
 119 |         }),
 120 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 121 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "visit", row.visitId],
 122 |         }),
 123 |       ]);
 124 |     },
 125 |   });
 126 | }
```

```ts
 175 | export const savePrescriptionFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
 176 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
 177 |   .validator(SavePrescriptionInput)
 178 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
 179 |     // ── 1. Pull idempotency key + hash the *exact* request ────────────
 180 |     //
 181 |     // The hash includes userId so two different doctors who happen to
 182 |     // generate the same key can't collide. It includes the full payload
 183 |     // so a reused key with different data is a hard 409 (matching
 184 |     // recordImmunizationFn's contract).
 185 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
 186 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
 187 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
 188 |           key: idempotencyKey,
 189 |           userId: context.user.id,
 190 |           data,
 191 |         })
 192 |       : null;
 193 | 
 194 |     // ── 2. Authorise + dose-check OUTSIDE the transaction ────────────
 195 |     //
 196 |     // The formulary check is pure — no DB reads, no side effects. Doing
 197 |     // it before opening a transaction keeps the transaction short.
 198 |     // If it fails, we never even touch the idempotency table, so a
 199 |     // retry with the same key after the clinician fixes the dose is
 200 |     // allowed to succeed.
 201 |     if (context.user.role !== "admin" && data.clinicId !== context.user.clinicId) {
 202 |       throw forbidden();
 203 |     }
 204 | 
 205 |     const patient = await db.query.patients.findFirst({
 206 |       where: {
 207 |         id: data.patientId,
 208 |         clinicId: data.clinicId,
 209 |       },
 210 |       columns: { id: true, weightKg: true, allergies: true },
 211 |     });
 212 |     if (!patient) throw forbidden();
 213 |     const visit = await db.query.visits.findFirst({
 214 |       where: {
 215 |         id: data.visitId,
 216 |         patientId: data.patientId,
 217 |         clinicId: data.clinicId,
 218 |       },
 219 |       columns: { id: true },
 220 |     });
 221 |     if (!visit) throw forbidden();
 222 | 
 223 |     const medicationName = data.medicationName.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
 224 |     const keyedFormulary = data.drugKey ? findComposerDrug(data.drugKey) : undefined;
 225 |     if (data.drugKey && !keyedFormulary) {
 226 |       setResponseStatus(422);
 227 |       throw new Error("Selected medication is not in the current formulary.");
 228 |     }
 229 |     const formulary =
 230 |       keyedFormulary ??
 231 |       COMPOSER_DRUGS.find(
 232 |         (drug) =>
 233 |           drug.genericName.toLocaleLowerCase() === medicationName ||
 234 |           drug.brandNames.some((brand) => brand.toLocaleLowerCase() === medicationName),
 235 |       );
 236 |     if (formulary) {
 237 |       const doseCheck = verifyDose(formulary, {
 238 |         weightKg: data.weightKg ?? patient.weightKg ?? 0,
 239 |         strength: data.strength,
 240 |         unit: data.unit,
 241 |         dosesPerDay: data.dosesPerDay ?? 1,
 242 |         mgPerKgPerDay: data.mgPerKgPerDay,
 243 |       });
 244 |       if (!doseCheck.ok) {
 245 |         // 422 — flusher marks `failed`, clinician must fix the dose.
 246 |         setResponseStatus(422);
 247 |         throw new Error(
 248 |           `Dose could not be verified for ${formulary.genericName}: ${doseCheck.reason}`,
 249 |         );
 250 |       }
 251 |       const allergyHit = checkAllergies(formulary, patient.allergies);
 252 |       if (allergyHit) {
 253 |         setResponseStatus(422);
 254 |         throw new Error(
 255 |           `Allergy conflict: recorded allergy "${allergyHit}" matches this medication.`,
 256 |         );
 257 |       }
 258 |     }
 259 | 
 260 |     // ── 3. Single transaction: idempotency check + create/update ─────
 261 |     //
 262 |     // Mirrors `recordImmunizationFn`. All reads and writes happen on
 263 |     // `tx`, so the idempotency-cache lookup, the version check, the
 264 |     // row write, and the audit log either all commit or all roll back.
 265 |     return db.transaction((tx) => {
 266 |       // 3a. Idempotency cache hit?
 267 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 268 |         const previous = tx
 269 |           .select()
 270 |           .from(idempotency)
 271 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
 272 |           .get();
 273 | 
 274 |         if (previous) {
 275 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
 276 |             // Same key, different payload — client bug. 409.
 277 |             setResponseStatus(409);
 278 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
 279 |           }
 280 | 
 281 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
 282 |           const previousId =
 283 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 284 |             previousResult !== null &&
 285 |             "prescriptionId" in previousResult &&
 286 |             typeof previousResult.prescriptionId === "string"
 287 |               ? previousResult.prescriptionId
 288 |               : null;
 289 | 
 290 |           if (!previousId) {
 291 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
 292 |           }
 293 | 
 294 |           const previousRow = tx
 295 |             .select()
 296 |             .from(prescriptions)
 297 |             .where(eq(prescriptions.id, previousId))
 298 |             .get();
 299 | 
 300 |           if (!previousRow) {
 301 |             throw new Error("The previously saved prescription is missing.");
 302 |           }
 303 |           return previousRow;
 304 |         }
 305 |       }
 306 | 
 307 |       // 3b. CREATE path.
 308 |       if (!data.prescriptionId) {
 309 |         const row = tx
 310 |           .insert(prescriptions)
 311 |           .values({
 312 |             patientId: data.patientId,
 313 |             visitId: data.visitId,
 314 |             medicationName: data.medicationName,
 315 |             dosage: `${data.strength} ${data.unit}`,
 316 |             frequency: data.frequency,
 317 |             durationDays: data.durationDays,
 318 |             instructions: data.instructions,
 319 |             prescribedById: context.user.id,
 320 |             prescribedAt: new Date(),
 321 |             status: "active",
 322 |           })
 323 |           .returning()
 324 |           .get();
 325 | 
 326 |         if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to save prescription.");
 327 | 
 328 |         tx.insert(auditLog)
 329 |           .values({
 330 |             actorId: context.user.id,
 331 |             action: "create",
 332 |             entity: "Prescription",
 333 |             entityId: row.id,
 334 |             metadata: {
 335 |               patientId: row.patientId,
 336 |               visitId: row.visitId,
 337 |               medicationName: row.medicationName,
 338 |             },
 339 |           })
 340 |           .run();
 341 | 
 342 |         if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 343 |           tx.insert(idempotency)
 344 |             .values({
 345 |               id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 346 |               key: idempotencyKey,
 347 |               requestHash,
 348 |               result: { prescriptionId: row.id },
 349 |             })
 350 |             .run();
 351 |         }
 352 | 
 353 |         return row;
 354 |       }
 355 | 
 356 |       // 3c. UPDATE path.
 357 |       const current = tx
 358 |         .select()
 359 |         .from(prescriptions)
 360 |         .where(eq(prescriptions.id, data.prescriptionId))
 361 |         .get();
 362 | 
 363 |       if (!current) {
 364 |         setResponseStatus(404);
 365 |         throw new Error("Prescription not found.");
 366 |       }
 367 |       if (current.patientId !== data.patientId || current.visitId !== data.visitId) {
 368 |         setResponseStatus(403);
 369 |         throw new Error("Forbidden.");
 370 |       }
 371 | 
 372 |       // Optimistic concurrency — the client sends the version it
 373 |       // last saw. If the server moved on, return the current row so
 374 |       // the flusher can surface a conflict.
 375 |       if (data.baseVersion && current.updatedAt.toISOString() !== data.baseVersion) {
 376 |         setResponseStatus(409);
 377 |         throw Object.assign(new Error("Version conflict (409)."), {
 378 |           serverSnapshot: current,
 379 |         });
 380 |       }
 381 | 
 382 |       const row = tx
 383 |         .update(prescriptions)
 384 |         .set({
 385 |           medicationName: data.medicationName,
 386 |           dosage: `${data.strength} ${data.unit}`,
 387 |           frequency: data.frequency,
 388 |           durationDays: data.durationDays,
 389 |           instructions: data.instructions,
 390 |           updatedAt: new Date(),
 391 |         })
 392 |         .where(
 393 |           and(
 394 |             eq(prescriptions.id, data.prescriptionId),
 395 |             eq(prescriptions.patientId, data.patientId),
 396 |             eq(prescriptions.visitId, data.visitId),
 397 |           ),
 398 |         )
 399 |         .returning()
 400 |         .get();
 401 | 
 402 |       if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to update prescription.");
 403 | 
 404 |       tx.insert(auditLog)
 405 |         .values({
 406 |           actorId: context.user.id,
 407 |           action: "update",
 408 |           entity: "Prescription",
 409 |           entityId: row.id,
 410 |           metadata: {
 411 |             patientId: row.patientId,
 412 |             changes: {
 413 |               medicationName: {
 414 |                 from: current.medicationName,
 415 |                 to: row.medicationName,
 416 |               },
 417 |               dosage: { from: current.dosage, to: row.dosage },
 418 |               frequency: { from: current.frequency, to: row.frequency },
 419 |             },
 420 |           },
 421 |         })
 422 |         .run();
 423 | 
 424 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 425 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
 426 |           .values({
 427 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 428 |             key: idempotencyKey,
 429 |             requestHash,
 430 |             result: { prescriptionId: row.id },
 431 |           })
 432 |           .run();
 433 |       }
 434 | 
 435 |       return row;
 436 |     });
 437 |   });
 438 | 
 439 | // ─── Helpers (module-scope, all defined) ──────────────────────────────────
 440 | 
 441 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
 442 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
 443 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
 444 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
 445 | }
 446 | 
 447 | function verifyDose(
 448 |   drug: ComposerDrug,
 449 |   params: {
 450 |     weightKg: number;
 451 |     strength: number;
 452 |     unit: ComposerUnit;
 453 |     dosesPerDay: number;
 454 |     mgPerKgPerDay: number | null;
 455 |   },
 456 | ): { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: string } {
 457 |   if (params.weightKg <= 0) {
 458 |     return { ok: false, reason: "patient weight is required" };
 459 |   }
 460 | 
 461 |   let mgPerKg: number;
 462 |   let singleDoseMg: number;
 463 |   let dailyDoseMg: number;
 464 |   if (params.mgPerKgPerDay != null) {
 465 |     mgPerKg = params.mgPerKgPerDay;
 466 |     dailyDoseMg = mgPerKg * params.weightKg;
 467 |     singleDoseMg = dailyDoseMg / params.dosesPerDay;
 468 |   } else {
 469 |     const unitFactor =
 470 |       params.unit === "mg"
 471 |         ? 1
 472 |         : params.unit === "mcg"
 473 |           ? 0.001
 474 |           : params.unit === "g"
 475 |             ? 1000
 476 |             : undefined;
 477 |     if (unitFactor == null) {
 478 |       return {
 479 |         ok: false,
 480 |         reason: "dose units require a verified concentration before saving",
 481 |       };
 482 |     }
 483 |     singleDoseMg = params.strength * unitFactor;
 484 |     dailyDoseMg = singleDoseMg * params.dosesPerDay;
 485 |     mgPerKg = dailyDoseMg / params.weightKg;
 486 |   }
 487 | 
 488 |   const maximum = drug.dosing.maxMgPerKgPerDay;
 489 |   if (maximum != null && mgPerKg > maximum) {
 490 |     return {
 491 |       ok: false,
 492 |       reason: `${mgPerKg.toFixed(2)} mg/kg/day exceeds ${maximum} mg/kg/day`,
 493 |     };
 494 |   }
 495 |   if (drug.dosing.maxSingleDoseMg != null && singleDoseMg > drug.dosing.maxSingleDoseMg) {
 496 |     return {
 497 |       ok: false,
 498 |       reason: `single dose ${singleDoseMg.toFixed(2)} mg exceeds ${drug.dosing.maxSingleDoseMg} mg`,
 499 |     };
 500 |   }
 501 |   if (drug.dosing.maxDailyDoseMg != null && dailyDoseMg > drug.dosing.maxDailyDoseMg) {
 502 |     return {
 503 |       ok: false,
 504 |       reason: `daily dose ${dailyDoseMg.toFixed(2)} mg exceeds ${drug.dosing.maxDailyDoseMg} mg`,
 505 |     };
 506 |   }
 507 |   return { ok: true };
 508 | }
 509 | 
 510 | function checkAllergies(drug: ComposerDrug, allergies: string | null): string | null {
 511 |   if (!allergies) return null;
 512 |   const allergyList = allergies
 513 |     .split(",")
 514 |     .map((allergy) => allergy.trim().toLowerCase())
 515 |     .filter(Boolean);
 516 |   for (const contraindication of drug.contraindications) {
 517 |     const lowerContraindication = contraindication.toLowerCase();
 518 |     const matchedAllergy = allergyList.find((allergy) => lowerContraindication.includes(allergy));
 519 |     if (matchedAllergy) return matchedAllergy;
 520 |   }
 521 |   const crossReactiveAllergy = drug.crossReactivities.find((allergen) =>
 522 |     allergyList.some((allergy) => allergy.includes(allergen)),
 523 |   );
 524 |   if (crossReactiveAllergy) return crossReactiveAllergy;
 525 |   return (
 526 |     [drug.genericName, ...drug.brandNames].find((name) =>
 527 |       allergyList.some((allergy) => allergy.includes(name.toLowerCase())),
 528 |     ) ?? null
 529 |   );
 530 | }
 531 | 
 532 | function forbidden(): Error {
 533 |   setResponseStatus(403);
 534 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
 535 | }
```

```ts
 159 | export interface DosingCalculationResult {
 160 |   weightKg: number;
 161 |   mgPerSingleDose: number;
 162 |   mgPerDay: number;
 163 |   volumeMlPerDose: number;
 164 |   volumeMlPerDay: number;
 165 |   frequency: string;
 166 |   dosesPerDay: number;
 167 |   concentrationLabel: string;
 168 |   isMaxCapped: boolean;
 169 |   notes: string;
 170 | }
 171 | 
 172 | export function calculatePediatricDose(params: {
 173 |   drug: PediatricDrugProfile;
 174 |   weightKg: number;
 175 |   concentrationIndex?: number;
 176 |   useHighDose?: boolean;
 177 | }): DosingCalculationResult {
 178 |   const { drug, weightKg, concentrationIndex = 0, useHighDose = false } = params;
 179 |   const concentration =
 180 |     drug.commonConcentrations[concentrationIndex] ?? drug.commonConcentrations[0];
 181 | 
 182 |   let singleDoseMg = 0;
 183 |   let totalDailyMg = 0;
 184 |   let isCapped = false;
 185 | 
 186 |   if (drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDose) {
 187 |     const rawDose = weightKg * drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDose.standard;
 188 |     const maxSingle = drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDose.maxSingleDoseMg;
 189 |     if (rawDose > maxSingle) {
 190 |       singleDoseMg = maxSingle;
 191 |       isCapped = true;
 192 |     } else {
 193 |       singleDoseMg = rawDose;
 194 |     }
 195 |     totalDailyMg = singleDoseMg * drug.dosesPerDay;
 196 |   } else if (drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay) {
 197 |     const targetMgPerKg =
 198 |       useHighDose && drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.high
 199 |         ? drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.high
 200 |         : drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.standard;
 201 | 
 202 |     const rawDaily = weightKg * targetMgPerKg;
 203 |     const maxDaily = drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.maxDailyMg;
 204 | 
 205 |     if (rawDaily > maxDaily) {
 206 |       totalDailyMg = maxDaily;
 207 |       isCapped = true;
 208 |     } else {
 209 |       totalDailyMg = rawDaily;
 210 |     }
 211 | 
 212 |     singleDoseMg = totalDailyMg / drug.dosesPerDay;
 213 |   }
 214 | 
 215 |   // Calculate volume in mL: (mgNeeded / concentrationMg) * concentrationMl
 216 |   const volumeMlPerDose = (singleDoseMg / concentration.mg) * concentration.ml;
 217 |   const volumeMlPerDay = volumeMlPerDose * drug.dosesPerDay;
 218 | 
 219 |   return {
 220 |     weightKg,
 221 |     mgPerSingleDose: Math.round(singleDoseMg * 10) / 10,
 222 |     mgPerDay: Math.round(totalDailyMg * 10) / 10,
 223 |     volumeMlPerDose: Math.round(volumeMlPerDose * 10) / 10,
 224 |     volumeMlPerDay: Math.round(volumeMlPerDay * 10) / 10,
 225 |     frequency: drug.defaultFrequency,
 226 |     dosesPerDay: drug.dosesPerDay,
 227 |     concentrationLabel: concentration.label,
 228 |     isMaxCapped: isCapped,
 229 |     notes: drug.indicationNotes,
 230 |   };
 231 | }
```

```ts
   9 |   isCapped: boolean;
  10 | }
  11 | 
  12 | export function calculateNeonatalDose(input: {
  13 |   drug: DrugFormularyItem;
  14 |   weightKg: number;
  15 |   dosePerKg: number;
  16 |   dosesPerDay: number;
  17 |   concentration: DrugFormularyItem["concentrations"][number];
  18 | }): NeonatalDoseCalculation {
  19 |   const { drug, weightKg, dosePerKg, dosesPerDay, concentration } = input;
  20 | 
  21 |   if (!Number.isFinite(weightKg) || weightKg <= 0) {
  22 |     throw new Error("Enter a valid weight greater than zero.");
  23 |   }
  24 |   if (!Number.isFinite(dosePerKg) || dosePerKg <= 0) {
  25 |     throw new Error("Enter a valid dose greater than zero.");
  26 |   }
  27 |   if (dosePerKg < drug.minDose || dosePerKg > drug.maxDose) {
  28 |     throw new Error(
  29 |       `Dose must be within the formulary range of ${drug.minDose}–${drug.maxDose} ${drug.doseUnit}.`,
  30 |     );
  31 |   }
  32 |   if (
  33 |     !drug.concentrations.some(
  34 |       (item) => item.id === concentration.id && item.route === concentration.route,
  35 |     )
  36 |   ) {
  37 |     throw new Error("Select a formulation listed for this medication.");
  38 |   }
  39 |   if (
  40 |     !Number.isFinite(dosesPerDay) ||
  41 |     dosesPerDay <= 0 ||
  42 |     !Number.isFinite(concentration.mg) ||
  43 |     concentration.mg <= 0 ||
  44 |     !Number.isFinite(concentration.ml) ||
  45 |     concentration.ml <= 0
  46 |   ) {
  47 |     throw new Error("This medication does not have usable dose or concentration data.");
  48 |   }
  49 | 
  50 |   const isMicrogramDose = drug.doseUnit.startsWith("mcg/");
  51 |   const isPerDay = drug.doseUnit.endsWith("/day");
  52 |   if (!isMicrogramDose && !drug.doseUnit.startsWith("mg/")) {
  53 |     throw new Error(`Unsupported neonatal dose unit: ${drug.doseUnit}`);
  54 |   }
  55 | 
  56 |   const conversionToMg = isMicrogramDose ? 1 / 1000 : 1;
  57 |   let singleDoseMg = weightKg * dosePerKg * conversionToMg;
  58 |   if (isPerDay) singleDoseMg /= dosesPerDay;
  59 | 
  60 |   let dailyDoseMg = singleDoseMg * dosesPerDay;
  61 |   let isCapped = false;
  62 | 
  63 |   if (drug.maxDailyDoseMg !== undefined && dailyDoseMg > drug.maxDailyDoseMg) {
  64 |     dailyDoseMg = drug.maxDailyDoseMg;
  65 |     singleDoseMg = dailyDoseMg / dosesPerDay;
  66 |     isCapped = true;
  67 |   }
  68 |   if (drug.maxSingleDoseMg !== undefined && singleDoseMg > drug.maxSingleDoseMg) {
  69 |     singleDoseMg = drug.maxSingleDoseMg;
  70 |     dailyDoseMg = singleDoseMg * dosesPerDay;
  71 |     isCapped = true;
  72 |   }
  73 | 
  74 |   return {
  75 |     dosePerKg,
  76 |     dosesPerDay,
  77 |     singleDoseMg,
  78 |     dailyDoseMg,
  79 |     volumeMlPerDose: (singleDoseMg / concentration.mg) * concentration.ml,
  80 |     isCapped,
  81 |   };
  82 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/prescriptions/api.ts
   2 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | 
   4 | import type { PrescriptionRegisterSearch } from "./schema";
   5 | 
   6 | import {
   7 |   createPrescriptionsFn,
   8 |   fetchActivePrescriptions,
   9 |   fetchPatientPrescriptionCount,
  10 |   fetchPrescriptionById,
  11 |   fetchPrescriptionRegister,
  12 |   fetchPrescriptionsByPrescriber,
  13 |   fetchPrescriptionsForPatient,
  14 |   fetchPrescriptionsForVisit,
  15 |   fetchTopMedications,
  16 | } from "./functions";
  17 | 
  18 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  19 | // Constants
  20 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  21 | 
  22 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  23 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
  24 |   VISIT: 60_000,
  25 |   PATIENT: 60_000,
  26 |   ACTIVE: 15_000,
  27 |   PRESCRIBER: 60_000,
  28 |   CLINIC: 120_000,
  29 |   REGISTER: 30_000,
  30 | } as const;
  31 | 
  32 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  33 | // Query key factory
  34 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  35 | 
  36 | export const prescriptionKeys = {
  37 |   all: () => ["prescriptions"] as const,
  38 | 
  39 |   detail: (prescriptionId: string) => ["prescriptions", "detail", prescriptionId] as const,
  40 | 
  41 |   byVisit: (visitId: string) => ["prescriptions", "visit", visitId] as const,
  42 | 
  43 |   byPatient: (patientId: string) => ["prescriptions", "patient", patientId] as const,
  44 | 
  45 |   active: (patientId: string) => ["prescriptions", "patient", patientId, "active"] as const,
  46 | 
  47 |   byPrescriber: (userId: string, limit: number) =>
  48 |     ["prescriptions", "prescriber", userId, limit] as const,
  49 | 
  50 |   topForClinic: (clinicId: string, limit: number) =>
  51 |     ["prescriptions", "top", clinicId, limit] as const,
  52 | 
  53 |   patientCount: (patientId: string) => ["prescriptions", "count", patientId] as const,
  54 | 
  55 |   /** Register prefix — invalidate this to refresh every page/filter
  56 |    *  combination for one clinic. */
  57 |   registerRoot: (clinicId: string) => ["prescriptions", "register", clinicId] as const,
  58 | 
  59 |   /** One page of the register. `page` and `size` are part of the key
  60 |    *  so each page has its own cache entry; without them, page 2 would
  61 |    *  return page 1's rows until staleTime expires. */
  62 |   register: (clinicId: string, search: PrescriptionRegisterSearch) =>
  63 |     [
  64 |       "prescriptions",
  65 |       "register",
  66 |       clinicId,
  67 |       search.q ?? "",
  68 |       search.medication ?? "",
  69 |       search.prescriberId ?? "",
  70 |       search.status,
  71 |       search.from ?? "",
  72 |       search.to ?? "",
  73 |       search.page,
  74 |       search.size,
  75 |     ] as const,
  76 | } as const;
  77 | 
  78 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  79 | // Query options
  80 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  81 | 
  82 | export function prescriptionByIdQuery(prescriptionId: string) {
  83 |   return queryOptions({
  84 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.detail(prescriptionId),
  85 |     queryFn: () => fetchPrescriptionById({ data: { prescriptionId } }),
  86 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
  87 |   });
  88 | }
  89 | 
  90 | export function prescriptionsForVisitQuery(visitId: string) {
  91 |   return queryOptions({
  92 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.byVisit(visitId),
  93 |     queryFn: () => fetchPrescriptionsForVisit({ data: { visitId } }),
  94 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.VISIT,
  95 |   });
  96 | }
  97 | 
  98 | export function prescriptionsForPatientQuery(patientId: string) {
  99 |   return queryOptions({
 100 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.byPatient(patientId),
 101 |     queryFn: () => fetchPrescriptionsForPatient({ data: { patientId } }),
 102 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.PATIENT,
 103 |   });
 104 | }

 111 |   });

 113 | 
 114 | export function prescriptionsByPrescriberQuery(userId: string, limit = 100) {

 117 |     queryFn: () => fetchPrescriptionsByPrescriber({ data: { userId, limit } }),
 118 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.PRESCRIBER,
 119 |   });
 120 | }
 121 | 
 122 | export function topMedicationsQuery(clinicId: string, limit = 20) {
 123 |   return queryOptions({
 124 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.topForClinic(clinicId, limit),
 125 |     queryFn: () => fetchTopMedications({ data: { clinicId, limit } }),
 126 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
 127 |   });
 128 | }
 129 | 
 130 | export function patientPrescriptionCountQuery(patientId: string) {
 131 |   return queryOptions({
 132 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.patientCount(patientId),
 133 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientPrescriptionCount({ data: { patientId } }),
 134 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
 135 |   });
 136 | }
 137 | 
 138 | export function prescriptionRegisterQuery(clinicId: string, search: PrescriptionRegisterSearch) {
 139 |   return queryOptions({
 140 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.register(clinicId, search),
 141 |     queryFn: () => fetchPrescriptionRegister({ data: { clinicId, search } }),
 142 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.REGISTER,
 143 |   });
 144 | }
 145 | 
 146 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 147 | // Invalidation
 148 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 149 | 
 150 | interface PrescriptionInvalidationArgs {
 151 |   clinicId: string;
 152 |   patientId?: string;
 153 |   /**
 154 |    * When `visitId` is provided, the visit's prescription list is
 155 |    * invalidated. When it is not, the visit list may remain stale —
 156 |    * pass it whenever it's available. It is NOT derivable from
 157 |    * `prescriptionId` without an extra read.
 158 |    */
 159 |   visitId?: string;
 160 |   prescriptionId?: string;
 161 | }
 162 | 
 163 | export function invalidateAfterPrescriptionChange(
 164 |   queryClient: {
 165 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
 166 |   },
 167 |   args: PrescriptionInvalidationArgs,
 168 | ): Promise<unknown> {
 169 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
 170 |     // Prefix invalidation — matches every register page and filter
 171 |     // combination for this clinic.
 172 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 173 |       queryKey: prescriptionKeys.registerRoot(args.clinicId),
 174 |     }),
 175 |   ];
 176 | 
 177 |   if (args.prescriptionId) {
 178 |     promises.push(
 179 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 180 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.detail(args.prescriptionId),
 181 |       }),
 182 |     );
 183 |   }
 184 | 
 185 |   if (args.visitId) {
 186 |     promises.push(
 187 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 188 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
 189 |       }),
 190 |     );
 191 |   }
 192 | 
 193 |   if (args.patientId) {
 194 |     // `byPatient` is the parent of `active` — one invalidation drops both.
 195 |     promises.push(
 196 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 197 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.byPatient(args.patientId),
 198 |       }),
 199 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 200 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.patientCount(args.patientId),
 201 |       }),
 202 |     );
 203 |   }
 204 | 
 205 |   return Promise.all(promises);
 206 | }
 207 | 
 208 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 209 | // Composer-facing queries
 210 | //
 211 | // TODO: move to `features/composer/queries.ts` so this file stays
 212 | // scoped to prescriptions. Until then, the re-exports live here so
 213 | // the composer route has one import path.
 214 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 215 | 
 216 | export const getActivePrescriptionsQuery = activePrescriptionsQuery;
 217 | 
 218 | export { getPatientForComposerQueryOptions } from "@/features/patients/queries";
 219 | 
 220 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 221 | // Mutations
 222 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 223 | 
 224 | /**
 225 |  * Create one or more prescriptions.
 226 |  *
 227 |  * `clinicId`, `patientId`, and `visitId` are supplied at hook
 228 |  * construction so `onSuccess` can invalidate the patient's cache
 229 |  * subtree and the visit's prescription list. If the caller doesn't
 230 |  * have these at construction time, they can still be passed via the
 231 |  * mutation variables and read from `variables` in `onSuccess` — but
 232 |  * the hook signature needs them to satisfy `invalidateAfterPrescriptionChange`.
 233 |  */
 234 | export function useCreatePrescriptionsMutation(args: {
 235 |   clinicId: string;
 236 |   patientId: string;
 237 |   visitId: string;
 238 | }) {
 239 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 240 | 
 241 |   return useMutation({
 242 |     mutationKey: ["prescriptions", "create", args.visitId],
 243 |     mutationFn: (variables: Parameters<typeof createPrescriptionsFn>[0]) =>
 244 |       createPrescriptionsFn(variables),
 245 |     onSuccess: () =>
 246 |       invalidateAfterPrescriptionChange(queryClient, {
 247 |         clinicId: args.clinicId,
 248 |         patientId: args.patientId,
 249 |         visitId: args.visitId,
 250 |       }),
 251 |   });
 252 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | // src/features/search/components/SearchCommand.tsx
   2 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   4 | import { CalendarIcon, CircleUserIcon, PillIcon, StethoscopeIcon } from "lucide-react";
   5 | import * as React from "react";
   6 | 
   7 | import {
   8 |   Command,
   9 |   CommandDialog,
  10 |   CommandEmpty,
  11 |   CommandGroup,
  12 |   CommandInput,
  13 |   CommandItem,
  14 |   CommandList,
  15 | } from "@/components/ui/command";
  16 | 
  17 | import type { SearchCategory, SearchResult } from "./schema";
  18 | 
  19 | import { globalSearchQuery } from "./queries";
  20 | 
  21 | const CAT_ICON: Record<SearchCategory, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
  22 |   patient: CircleUserIcon,
  23 |   appointment: CalendarIcon,
  24 |   prescription: PillIcon,
  25 |   diagnosis: StethoscopeIcon,
  26 |   measurement: StethoscopeIcon,
  27 | };
  28 | 
  29 | const CAT_LABEL: Record<SearchCategory, string> = {
  30 |   patient: "Patients",
  31 |   appointment: "Appointments",
  32 |   prescription: "Prescriptions",
  33 |   diagnosis: "Diagnoses",
  34 |   measurement: "Measurements",
  35 | };
  36 | 
  37 | // Minimal context so the shortcut hook can open/close without prop-drilling.
  38 | const Ctx = React.createContext<{
  39 |   open: boolean;
  40 |   setOpen: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  41 | }>({ open: false, setOpen: () => {} });
  42 | 
  43 | export function useSearchDialog() {
  44 |   return React.useContext(Ctx);
  45 | }
  46 | 
  47 | interface SearchCommandProviderProps {
  48 |   clinicId: string;
  49 |   children: React.ReactNode;
  50 | }
  51 | 
  52 | export function SearchCommandProvider({ clinicId, children }: SearchCommandProviderProps) {
  53 |   const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  54 |   return (
  55 |     <Ctx.Provider value={{ open, setOpen }}>
  56 |       {children}
  57 |       <SearchCommand clinicId={clinicId} onOpenChange={setOpen} open={open} />
  58 |     </Ctx.Provider>
  59 |   );
  60 | }
  61 | 
  62 | function SearchCommand({
  63 |   clinicId,
  64 |   open,
  65 |   onOpenChange,
  66 | }: {
  67 |   clinicId: string;
  68 |   open: boolean;
  69 |   onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void;
  70 | }) {
  71 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  72 |   const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  73 |   const [debounced, setDebounced] = React.useState("");
  74 | 
  75 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  76 |     const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(query.trim()), 180);
  77 |     return () => clearTimeout(t);
  78 |   }, [query]);
  79 | 
  80 |   // Handle open state changes without triggering cascading synchronous render effects
  81 |   const handleOpenChange = React.useCallback(
  82 |     (newOpen: boolean) => {
  83 |       if (!newOpen) {
  84 |         setQuery("");
  85 |         setDebounced("");
  86 |       }
  87 |       onOpenChange(newOpen);
  88 |     },
  89 |     [onOpenChange],
  90 |   );
  91 | 
  92 |   const { data, isFetching, isError } = useQuery(globalSearchQuery(clinicId, debounced));
  93 | 
  94 |   const grouped = React.useMemo(() => {
  95 |     const g: Partial<Record<SearchCategory, SearchResult[]>> = {};
  96 |     for (const r of data?.results ?? []) {
  97 |       let bucket = g[r.category];
  98 |       if (!bucket) {
  99 |         bucket = [];
 100 |         g[r.category] = bucket;
 101 |       }
 102 |       bucket.push(r);
 103 |     }
 104 |     return g;
 105 |   }, [data]);
 106 | 
 107 |   const go = React.useCallback(
 108 |     (r: SearchResult) => {
 109 |       handleOpenChange(false);
 110 |       void navigate({ to: r.href });
 111 |     },
 112 |     [navigate, handleOpenChange],
 113 |   );
 114 | 
 115 |   return (
 116 |     <CommandDialog onOpenChange={handleOpenChange} open={open}>
 117 |       <Command shouldFilter={false}>
 118 |         <CommandInput
 119 |           onValueChange={setQuery}
 120 |           placeholder="Search patients, meds, diagnoses…"
 121 |           value={query}
 122 |         />
 123 |         <CommandList>
 124 |           {isError && (
 125 |             <p className="text-destructive px-3 py-2 text-sm">Search failed. Try again.</p>
 126 |           )}
 127 |           {!isError && debounced.length < 2 && (
 128 |             <p className="text-muted-foreground px-3 py-4 text-sm">Type at least 2 characters.</p>
 129 |           )}
 130 |           {!isError && debounced.length >= 2 && !isFetching && !data?.results.length && (
 131 |             <CommandEmpty>No matches for “{debounced}”.</CommandEmpty>
 132 |           )}
 133 |           {Object.entries(grouped).map(([cat, items]) => {
 134 |             const Icon = CAT_ICON[cat as SearchCategory];
 135 |             return (
 136 |               <CommandGroup heading={CAT_LABEL[cat as SearchCategory]} key={cat}>
 137 |                 {items?.map((r) => (
 138 |                   <CommandItem
 139 |                     key={`${r.category}:${r.id}`}
 140 |                     onSelect={() => go(r)}
 141 |                     value={`${r.category}:${r.id}`}
 142 |                   >
 143 |                     <Icon className="text-muted-foreground size-4" />
 144 |                     <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
 145 |                       <span className="truncate text-sm">{r.title}</span>
 146 |                       {r.subtitle && (
 147 |                         <span className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-xs">{r.subtitle}</span>
 148 |                       )}
 149 |                     </div>
 150 |                   </CommandItem>
 151 |                 ))}
 152 |               </CommandGroup>
 153 |             );
 154 |           })}
 155 |         </CommandList>
 156 |         <div className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center justify-between border-t px-3 py-2 text-[11px]">
 157 |           <span>
 158 |             {isFetching
 159 |               ? "Searching…"
 160 |               : data
 161 |                 ? `${data.results.length} result${data.results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} · ${data.elapsedMs}ms`
 162 |                 : "Press ⌘K to open"}
 163 |           </span>
 164 |           <span>↑↓ navigate · ⏎ open · esc close</span>
 165 |         </div>
 166 |       </Command>
 167 |     </CommandDialog>
 168 |   );
 169 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/search/queries.ts
   2 | import { keepPreviousData, queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | 
   4 | import { STALE } from "@/features/shared/stale-tiime";
   5 | 
   6 | import type { SearchCategory } from "./schema";
   7 | 
   8 | import { globalSearchFn } from "./functions";
   9 | 
  10 | export const searchKeys = {
  11 |   all: () => ["search"] as const,
  12 |   // `clinicId` is still part of the key — the cache must not bleed
  13 |   // across clinics — even though it's no longer sent on the wire.
  14 |   run: (clinicId: string, query: string, cats?: SearchCategory[]) =>
  15 |     ["search", clinicId, query, cats?.slice().sort().join(",") ?? "all"] as const,
  16 | } as const;
  17 | 
  18 | export function globalSearchQuery(clinicId: string, query: string, categories?: SearchCategory[]) {
  19 |   return queryOptions({
  20 |     queryKey: searchKeys.run(clinicId, query, categories),
  21 |     // `clinicId` is NOT in the payload — the server resolves the
  22 |     // clinic from the session (context.clinicId) so a client can
  23 |     // never search another clinic's data.
  24 |     queryFn: () => globalSearchFn({ data: { q: query, categories } }),
  25 |     staleTime: STALE.ENCOUNTERS,
  26 |     enabled: query.trim().length >= 2 && Boolean(clinicId),
  27 |     placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  28 |   });
  29 | }
```
