```ts
   1 | // src/features/search/hooks/use-search-shortcut.ts
   2 | import * as React from "react";
   3 | 
   4 | import { useSearchDialog } from "./SearchCommand";
   5 | 
   6 | export function useSearchShortcut() {
   7 |   const { setOpen } = useSearchDialog();
   8 | 
   9 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  10 |     const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
  11 |       const isCmdK = (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k";
  12 |       if (!isCmdK) return;
  13 |       e.preventDefault();
  14 |       setOpen((prev) => !prev);
  15 |     };
  16 |     window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
  17 |     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  18 |   }, [setOpen]);
  19 | }
```

```ts
  13 | /** Postgres `date` in `YYYY-MM-DD` (matches `date({ mode: "string" })`). */
  14 | export const isoDateSchema = z
  15 |   .string()
  16 |   .regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "Use YYYY-MM-DD")
  17 |   .refine((v) => {
  18 |     // Reject impossible dates like 2023-02-30
  19 |     const [y, m, d] = v.split("-").map(Number);
  20 |     const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
  21 |     return dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 && dt.getUTCDate() === d;
  22 |   }, "Invalid calendar date");

  73 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  74 | // Date utilities
  75 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  76 | 
  77 | const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;
  78 | const DAYS_PER_MONTH = 30.4375;
  79 | 
  80 | /**
  81 |  * Calculate age in months from date of birth to a reference date.
  82 |  * Returns decimal months for precise calculations.
  83 |  */
  84 | export function ageInMonths(dob: Date, referenceDate: Date = new Date()): number {
  85 |   const days = (referenceDate.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY;
  86 |   return days / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | export function decimalMonthsBetween(dob: Date, at: Date): number {
  90 |   const days = (at.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY;
  91 |   return days / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
  92 | }
  93 | 
  94 | /**
  95 |  * Calculate corrected age for premature infants (<37 weeks gestational age).
  96 |  * Standard pediatric formula:
  97 |  * Chronological Age (months) - ((40 - Gestational Weeks) * 7 / 30.4375)
  98 |  * For term infants (>=37 weeks), corrected age equals chronological age.
  99 |  */
 100 | export function calculateCorrectedAgeMonths(
 101 |   dob: Date,
 102 |   gestationalAgeWeeks?: number | null,
 103 |   referenceDate: Date = new Date(),
 104 | ): {
 105 |   chronologicalAgeMonths: number;
 106 |   correctedAgeMonths: number;
 107 |   isPreterm: boolean;
 108 |   weeksPremature: number;
 109 | } {
 110 |   const chronological = decimalMonthsBetween(dob, referenceDate);
 111 |   const ga = gestationalAgeWeeks ?? 40;
 112 |   const isPreterm = ga < 37;
 113 |   const weeksPremature = Math.max(0, 40 - ga);
 114 |   const correctionMonths = (weeksPremature * 7) / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
 115 |   const corrected = isPreterm ? Math.max(0, chronological - correctionMonths) : chronological;
 116 | 
 117 |   return {
 118 |     chronologicalAgeMonths: Math.round(chronological * 10) / 10,
 119 |     correctedAgeMonths: Math.round(corrected * 10) / 10,
 120 |     isPreterm,
 121 |     weeksPremature,
 122 |   };
 123 | }
 124 | 
 125 | /**
 126 |  * Whole calendar months between two dates (anniversary-based).
 127 |  *
 128 |  * `completedMonths(new Date('2020-01-31'), new Date('2020-02-29'))` → 0,
 129 |  * because 29 February is not the 31st. The `days < 0` branch handles
 130 |  * month-end rolling without overflowing into March.
 131 |  */
 132 | export function completedMonths(dob: Date, at: Date): number {
 133 |   const years = at.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
 134 |   const months = at.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
 135 |   const days = at.getDate() - dob.getDate();
 136 |   const raw = years * 12 + months;
 137 |   return days >= 0 ? raw : raw - 1;
 138 | }
 139 | 
 140 | /**
 141 |  * Format a date to a localized short date string.
 142 |  */
 143 | export function formatDate(date: Date, _locale = "en-US"): string {
 144 |   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
 145 |     year: "numeric",
 146 |     month: "short",
 147 |     day: "numeric",
 148 |   }).format(date);
 149 | }
 150 | 
 151 | /**
 152 |  * Format a date to include time.
 153 |  */
 154 | export function formatDateTime(date: Date, _locale = "en-US"): string {
 155 |   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
 156 |     year: "numeric",
 157 |     month: "short",
 158 |     day: "numeric",
 159 |     hour: "2-digit",
 160 |     minute: "2-digit",
 161 |   }).format(date);
 162 | }
 163 | 
 164 | /**
 165 |  * Check if a date is in the past.
 166 |  */
 167 | export function isPast(date: Date): boolean {
 168 |   return date < new Date();
 169 | }
 170 | 
 171 | /**
 172 |  * Check if a date is in the future.
 173 |  */
 174 | export function isFuture(date: Date): boolean {
 175 |   return date > new Date();
 176 | }
 177 | 
 178 | /**
 179 |  * Get the start of the day for a given date.
 180 |  */
 181 | export function startOfDay(date: Date): Date {
 182 |   const result = new Date(date);
 183 |   result.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
 184 |   return result;
 185 | }
 186 | 
 187 | /**
 188 |  * Get the end of the day for a given date.
 189 |  */
 190 | export function endOfDay(date: Date): Date {
 191 |   const result = new Date(date);
 192 |   result.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
 193 |   return result;
 194 | }

 196 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 197 | // String utilities
 198 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 199 | 
 200 | /**
 201 |  * Capitalize the first letter of a string.
 202 |  */
 203 | export function capitalize(str: string): string {
 204 |   return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1).toLowerCase();
 205 | }
 206 | 
 207 | /**
 208 |  * Format a name as "First Last".
 209 |  */
 210 | export function formatName(firstName: string, lastName: string): string {
 211 |   return `${capitalize(firstName)} ${capitalize(lastName)}`;
 212 | }
 213 | 
 214 | /**
 215 |  * Truncate a string to a maximum length with ellipsis.
 216 |  */
 217 | export function truncate(str: string, maxLength: number): string {
 218 |   if (str.length <= maxLength) return str;
 219 |   return `${str.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...`;
 220 | }
 221 | 
 222 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 223 | // Number utilities
 224 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 225 | 
 226 | /**
 227 |  * Format a number with a specified number of decimal places.
 228 |  */
 229 | export function formatNumber(num: number, decimals = 2): string {
 230 |   return num.toFixed(decimals);
 231 | }
 232 | 
 233 | /**
 234 |  * Clamp a number between min and max values.
 235 |  */
 236 | export function clamp(num: number, min: number, max: number): number {
 237 |   return Math.min(Math.max(num, min), max);
 238 | }
 239 | 
 240 | /**
 241 |  * Round a number to a specified precision.
 242 |  */
 243 | export function round(num: number, precision = 2): number {
 244 |   const factor = 10 ** precision;
 245 |   return Math.round(num * factor) / factor;
 246 | }
 247 | 
 248 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 249 | // Validation helpers
 250 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 251 | 
 252 | /** Wrap any of the above to validate server-action input safely. */
 253 | export function parseOrThrow<T extends z.ZodType>(schema: T, data: unknown): z.infer<T> {
 254 |   const result = schema.safeParse(data);
 255 |   if (!result.success) {
 256 |     throw new z.ZodError(result.error.issues);
 257 |   }
 258 |   return result.data;
 259 | }
 260 | 
 261 | /** Form-action friendly: returns flattened errors instead of throwing. */
 262 | export function parseForm<T extends z.ZodType>(schema: T, formData: FormData) {
 263 |   const raw = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());
 264 |   const result = schema.safeParse(raw);
 265 |   return result.success
 266 |     ? ({ ok: true, data: result.data } as const)
 267 |     : ({ ok: false, errors: z.treeifyError(result.error) } as const);
 268 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/shared/queryKeys.queries.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Centralised query-key factory. Two rules:
   4 | //   1. Every key is built from this object — no ad-hoc string arrays in
   5 | //      components.
   6 | //   2. The `curves` key includes (indicator, sex, min, max, xAxis) as
   7 | //      *primitives*, so structurally-equal range objects dedupe (React
   8 | //      Query hashes plain objects by shape, but being explicit here means
   9 | //      refetches survive a caller that re-creates the range each render).
  10 | 
  11 | import type { Indicator, Sex } from "../growth/types/types";
```

`features/transcription/providers.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/transcription/providers.ts
   2 | import "@tanstack/react-start/server-only";
   3 | import { generateTranscription, type AnyTranscriptionAdapter } from "@tanstack/ai";
   4 | import { openaiTranscription } from "@tanstack/ai-openai";
   5 | 
   6 | export type Language = "es" | "ar" | "en" | "auto";
   7 | 
   8 | // Updated provider IDs for local/OpenAI stack
   9 | export type ProviderId = "gpt-4o-mini" | "whisper-local";
  10 | 
  11 | export type TranscriberResult = {
  12 |   text: string;
  13 |   provider: ProviderId;
  14 |   costUsd: number;
  15 |   latencyMs: number;
  16 | };
  17 | 
  18 | const RATES_PER_MINUTE: Record<ProviderId, number> = {
  19 |   "gpt-4o-mini": 0.003,
  20 |   // If running local whisper, cost is 0. If using OpenAI whisper-1, it's $0.006/min.
  21 |   "whisper-local": 0.0,
  22 | };
  23 | 
  24 | const TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
  25 | 
  26 | function adapterFor(provider: ProviderId): AnyTranscriptionAdapter {
  27 |   switch (provider) {
  28 |     case "gpt-4o-mini":
  29 |       return openaiTranscription("gpt-4o-mini-transcribe");
  30 |     case "whisper-local":
  31 |       // Uses OpenAI's official whisper model adapter (pointing to local endpoint if configured
  32 |       // via OPENAI_BASE_URL, or standard OpenAI API if developing online)
  33 |       return openaiTranscription("whisper-1");
  34 |   }
  35 | }
  36 | 
  37 | // Map our language hint to what providers accept. "auto" = let provider detect
  38 | // (critical for Arabic/English code-switching); OpenAI accepts an ISO hint but
  39 | // detection still works with it omitted, so we omit for "auto".
  40 | function languageHint(language: Language): string | undefined {
  41 |   return language === "auto" ? undefined : language;
  42 | }
  43 | 
  44 | async function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> {
  45 |   let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  46 |   const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
  47 |     timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`transcription timed out after ${ms}ms`)), ms);
  48 |   });
  49 |   try {
  50 |     return await Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
  51 |   } finally {
  52 |     clearTimeout(timer!);
  53 |   }
  54 | }
  55 | 
  56 | async function runProvider(
  57 |   provider: ProviderId,
  58 |   audio: File,
  59 |   seconds: number,
  60 |   language: Language,
  61 | ): Promise<TranscriberResult> {
  62 |   const started = Date.now();
  63 |   const result = await withTimeout(
  64 |     generateTranscription({
  65 |       adapter: adapterFor(provider),
  66 |       threadId: `transcribe-${audio.name}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
  67 |       audio,
  68 |       language: languageHint(language) as never,
  69 |     }),
  70 |     TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT_MS,
  71 |   );
  72 |   return {
  73 |     text: result.text,
  74 |     provider,
  75 |     costUsd: (RATES_PER_MINUTE[provider] * seconds) / 60,
  76 |     latencyMs: Date.now() - started,
  77 |   };
  78 | }
  79 | 
  80 | /**
  81 |  * Primary → fallback. Fallback only fires on *retryable* errors
  82 |  * (timeout, 429, 5xx, network). Auth/validation/unsupported-format errors
  83 |  * surface immediately — retrying those on another provider won't help.
  84 |  */
  85 | export async function transcribeWithFallback(
  86 |   audio: File,
  87 |   seconds: number,
  88 |   language: Language,
  89 | ): Promise<TranscriberResult> {
  90 |   const chain: ProviderId[] = ["gpt-4o-mini", "whisper-local"];
  91 |   let lastError: unknown;
  92 |   for (const provider of chain) {
  93 |     try {
  94 |       return await runProvider(provider, audio, seconds, language);
  95 |     } catch (err) {
  96 |       lastError = err;
  97 |       if (!isRetryable(err)) throw err;
  98 |     }
  99 |   }
 100 |   throw lastError ?? new Error("All transcription providers failed");
 101 | }
 102 | 
 103 | function isRetryable(err: unknown): boolean {
 104 |   const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message.toLowerCase() : String(err).toLowerCase();
 105 |   return /timeout|timed out|429|rate limit|5\d\d|network|econnreset|fetch failed/.test(msg);
 106 | }
```

`features/transcription/queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/transcription/queries.ts
   2 | import "@tanstack/react-start/server-only";
   3 | import { withTransaction, eq } from "@/db";
   4 | import { auditLog, idempotency, medicalNotes, patients, visits } from "@/db/schema";
   5 | 
   6 | async function hashSaveRequest(args: {
   7 |   clinicId: string;
   8 |   patientId: string;
   9 |   visitId?: string;
  10 |   transcript: string;
  11 |   provider: string;
  12 |   costUsd: number;
  13 |   authorId: string;
  14 |   idempotencyKey: string;
  15 | }) {
  16 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(
  17 |     JSON.stringify({
  18 |       operation: "save-transcript",
  19 |       clinicId: args.clinicId,
  20 |       patientId: args.patientId,
  21 |       visitId: args.visitId ?? null,
  22 |       authorId: args.authorId,
  23 |       idempotencyKey: args.idempotencyKey,
  24 |     }),
  25 |   );
  26 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
  27 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  28 | }
  29 | 
  30 | export async function saveTranscript(args: {
  31 |   clinicId: string;
  32 |   patientId: string;
  33 |   visitId?: string;
  34 |   transcript: string;
  35 |   provider: string;
  36 |   costUsd: number;
  37 |   authorId: string;
  38 |   idempotencyKey: string;
  39 | }) {
  40 |   const requestHash = await hashSaveRequest(args);
  41 | 
  42 |   return withTransaction((tx) => {
  43 |     const previous = tx
  44 |       .select()
  45 |       .from(idempotency)
  46 |       .where(eq(idempotency.key, args.idempotencyKey))
  47 |       .get();
  48 | 
  49 |     if (previous) {
  50 |       if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
  51 |         throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
  52 |       }
  53 | 
  54 |       const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
  55 |       const previousNoteId =
  56 |         typeof previousResult === "object" &&
  57 |         previousResult !== null &&
  58 |         "medicalNoteId" in previousResult &&
  59 |         typeof previousResult.medicalNoteId === "string"
  60 |           ? previousResult.medicalNoteId
  61 |           : null;
  62 |       if (!previousNoteId) {
  63 |         throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
  64 |       }
  65 | 
  66 |       const existingNote = tx
  67 |         .select()
  68 |         .from(medicalNotes)
  69 |         .where(eq(medicalNotes.id, previousNoteId))
  70 |         .get();
  71 |       if (!existingNote) {
  72 |         throw new Error("The previously saved transcription is missing.");
  73 |       }
  74 |       return existingNote;
  75 |     }
  76 | 
  77 |     const patient = tx
  78 |       .select({ clinicId: patients.clinicId })
  79 |       .from(patients)
  80 |       .where(eq(patients.id, args.patientId))
  81 |       .get();
  82 |     if (!patient || patient.clinicId !== args.clinicId) {
  83 |       throw new Error("Patient not found or outside the requested clinic.");
  84 |     }
  85 | 
  86 |     if (args.visitId) {
  87 |       const visit = tx
  88 |         .select({ patientId: visits.patientId, clinicId: visits.clinicId })
  89 |         .from(visits)
  90 |         .where(eq(visits.id, args.visitId))
  91 |         .get();
  92 |       if (!visit || visit.patientId !== args.patientId || visit.clinicId !== args.clinicId) {
  93 |         throw new Error("Visit not found or does not belong to the patient and clinic.");
  94 |       }
  95 |     }
  96 | 
  97 |     const note = tx
  98 |       .insert(medicalNotes)
  99 |       .values({
 100 |         patientId: args.patientId,
 101 |         visitId: args.visitId ?? null,
 102 |         authorId: args.authorId,
 103 |         title: "Voice transcription",
 104 |         body: args.transcript,
 105 |       })
 106 |       .returning()
 107 |       .get();
 108 | 
 109 |     if (!note) {
 110 |       throw new Error("Failed to insert medical note from transcription.");
 111 |     }
 112 | 
 113 |     tx.insert(auditLog)
 114 |       .values({
 115 |         actorId: args.authorId,
 116 |         entity: "medical_note",
 117 |         entityId: note.id,
 118 |         action: "create",
 119 |         metadata: {
 120 |           source: "voice_transcription",
 121 |           provider: args.provider,
 122 |           costUsd: args.costUsd,
 123 |           needsReview: true,
 124 |           idempotencyKey: args.idempotencyKey,
 125 |         },
 126 |       })
 127 |       .run();
 128 | 
 129 |     tx.insert(idempotency)
 130 |       .values({
 131 |         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 132 |         key: args.idempotencyKey,
 133 |         requestHash,
 134 |         result: { medicalNoteId: note.id },
 135 |       })
 136 |       .run();
 137 | 
 138 |     return note;
 139 |   });
 140 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // src/features/transcription/schemas.ts
   2 | import { z } from "zod";
   3 | 
   4 | export const MAX_AUDIO_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024; // 25MB — OpenAI cap
   5 | export const MAX_AUDIO_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
   6 | 
   7 | export const languageSchema = z.enum(["es", "ar", "en", "auto"]).default("auto");
   8 | 
   9 | export const transcribeInputSchema = z.object({
  10 |   audio: z.instanceof(File).refine((f) => f.size > 0 && f.size <= MAX_AUDIO_BYTES, {
  11 |     message: "Audio must be non-empty and ≤25MB",
  12 |   }),
  13 |   seconds: z.number().positive().max(MAX_AUDIO_SECONDS),
  14 |   visitId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  15 |   patientId: z.string().uuid(),
  16 |   language: languageSchema,
  17 |   idempotencyKey: z.string().uuid(),
  18 |   save: z.boolean().default(true), // save transcript to the visit record?
  19 | });
  20 | 
  21 | export type TranscribeInput = z.infer<typeof transcribeInputSchema>;
  22 | 
  23 | export const transcriptSchema = z.object({
  24 |   text: z.string(),
  25 |   provider: z.enum(["gpt-4o-mini", "whisper-local"]),
  26 |   costUsd: z.number().nonnegative(),
  27 |   latencyMs: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  28 |   needsReview: z.boolean(), // always true when persisted to a clinical record
  29 | });
```

`features/transcription/transcribe.fn.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   2 | import { setResponseStatus } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
   3 | 
   4 | import { clinicAccessMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/clinic-middleware";
   5 | 
   6 | import { transcribeWithFallback } from "./providers";
   7 | import { saveTranscript } from "./queries";
   8 | import { transcribeInputSchema, transcriptSchema } from "./schemas";
   9 | 
  10 | export const transcribe = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  11 |   .validator((input) => transcribeInputSchema.parse(input))
  12 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
  13 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
  14 |     const result = await transcribeWithFallback(data.audio, data.seconds, data.language);
  15 |     const payload = transcriptSchema.parse({ ...result, needsReview: true });
  16 | 
  17 |     if (data.save) {
  18 |       try {
  19 |         await saveTranscript({
  20 |           clinicId: context.clinicId,
  21 |           patientId: data.patientId,
  22 |           visitId: data.visitId,
  23 |           transcript: payload.text,
  24 |           provider: payload.provider,
  25 |           costUsd: payload.costUsd,
  26 |           authorId: context.user.id,
  27 |           idempotencyKey: data.idempotencyKey,
  28 |         });
  29 |       } catch (error) {
  30 |         if (error instanceof Error && error.message.startsWith("Conflict (409):")) {
  31 |           setResponseStatus(409);
  32 |         }
  33 |         throw error;
  34 |       }
  35 |     }
  36 | 
  37 |     return payload;
  38 |   });
```

`features/transcription/use-transcription.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/features/transcription/use-transcription.ts
   2 | import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   3 | 
   4 | import type { TranscribeInput } from "./schemas";
   5 | 
   6 | import { transcriptionKeys } from "./keys"; // add to features/shared invalidation helpers
   7 | import { transcribe } from "./transcribe.fn";
   8 | 
   9 | export function useTranscribe() {
  10 |   const qc = useQueryClient();
  11 |   return useMutation({
  12 |     mutationFn: (input: TranscribeInput) => transcribe({ data: input }),
  13 |     onSuccess: (_res, input) => {
  14 |       // Invalidate the visit/patient record so the new draft note appears.
  15 |       if (input.visitId) {
  16 |         void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: transcriptionKeys.forVisit(input.visitId) });
  17 |       }
  18 |       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: transcriptionKeys.forPatient(input.patientId) });
  19 |     },
  20 |   });
  21 | }
```

```tsx
   8 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "./schema";
   9 | 
  10 | interface RightRailProps {
  11 |   snapshot: {
  12 |     patient: {
  13 |       firstName: string;
  14 |       lastName: string;
  15 |       mrn: string;
  16 |       sex: "male" | "female";
  17 |       dateOfBirth: string;
  18 |       allergies: string | null;
  19 |     };
  20 |     lastVisitAt: Date | null;
  21 |     weightSeries: Array<{ value: number; at: Date }>;
  22 |   };
  23 |   values: VisitComposerValues;
  24 |   saveState: {

  31 | 
  32 | export function RightRail({ snapshot, values, saveState }: RightRailProps) {
  33 |   const ageMonths = ageInMonths(new Date(snapshot.patient.dateOfBirth), new Date());
  34 |   const ageLabel =
  35 |     ageMonths < 24
  36 |       ? `${ageMonths.toFixed(1)} mo`
  37 |       : `${Math.floor(ageMonths / 12)}y ${Math.round(ageMonths % 12)}m`;
  38 | 
  39 |   const allergies = (snapshot.patient.allergies ?? "")
  40 |     .split(",")
  41 |     .map((s) => s.trim())
  42 |     .filter(Boolean);
  43 | 
  44 |   // Interaction warnings: naive check against existing allergies.
  45 |   const warnings: Array<{ severity: "amber" | "red"; text: string }> = [];
  46 |   for (const p of values.prescriptions) {
  47 |     for (const a of allergies) {
  48 |       if (p.medicationName.toLowerCase().includes(a.toLowerCase())) {
  49 |         warnings.push({
  50 |           severity: "red",
  51 |           text: `${p.medicationName} matches recorded allergy "${a}"`,
  52 |         });
  53 |       }
  54 |     }
  55 |   }
  56 | 
  57 |   return (
  58 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
  59 |       <p className=" text-xs">
  60 |         Save manually with the button below. Unsaved changes are lost if you leave.
  61 |       </p>
  62 |       <Card>
  63 |         <CardHeader>
  64 |           <CardTitle>Patient snapshot</CardTitle>
  65 |         </CardHeader>
  66 |         <CardContent>
  67 |           <div className="flex flex-col">
  68 |             <span className="font-semibold">
  69 |               {snapshot.patient.firstName} {snapshot.patient.lastName}
  70 |             </span>
  71 |             <span className=" font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">
  72 |               {snapshot.patient.mrn} · {ageLabel}
  73 |             </span>
  74 |           </div>
  75 | 
  76 |           <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
  77 |             {allergies.length === 0 ? (
  78 |               <span className=" text-xs">No allergies recorded</span>
  79 |             ) : (
  80 |               allergies.map((a) => (
  81 |                 <Badge key={a} variant="destructive">
  82 |                   {a}
  83 |                 </Badge>
  84 |               ))
  85 |             )}
  86 |           </div>
  87 | 
  88 |           <div className=" text-xs">
  89 |             Last visit: {snapshot.lastVisitAt ? formatDate(new Date(snapshot.lastVisitAt)) : "—"}
  90 |           </div>
  91 | 
  92 |           <WeightSparkline data={snapshot.weightSeries} />
  93 |         </CardContent>
  94 |       </Card>
  95 | 
  96 |       <Card>
  97 |         <CardHeader>
  98 |           <CardTitle>
  99 |             <AlertTriangleIcon className="size-4" />
 100 |             Safety alerts
 101 |           </CardTitle>
 102 |         </CardHeader>
 103 |         <CardContent className="grid gap-2">
 104 |           {warnings.length === 0 ? (
 105 |             <p className=" text-xs">No interactions detected.</p>
 106 |           ) : (
 107 |             warnings.map((w, i) => (
 108 |               <div
 109 |                 className={
 110 |                   w.severity === "red"
 111 |                     ? "border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5 rounded-md border p-2 text-xs"
 112 |                     : "rounded-md border border-warning/40 bg-warning/5 p-2 text-xs"
 113 |                 }
 114 |                 key={i}
 115 |               >
 116 |                 {w.text}
 117 |               </div>
 118 |             ))
 119 |           )}
 120 |         </CardContent>
 121 |       </Card>
 122 | 
 123 |       <Card>
 124 |         <CardHeader>
 125 |           <CardTitle>
 126 |             <SaveIcon className="size-4" />
 127 |             Save status
 128 |           </CardTitle>
 129 |         </CardHeader>
 130 |         <CardContent>
 131 |           {saveState.saving && <span className="text-warning">Saving…</span>}
 132 |           {!saveState.saving && saveState.error && (
 133 |             <span className="text-destructive">{saveState.error}</span>
 134 |           )}
 135 |           {!saveState.saving && !saveState.error && saveState.dirty && (
 136 |             <span className="">Unsaved changes</span>
 137 |           )}
 138 |           {!saveState.saving && !saveState.dirty && saveState.lastSavedAt && (
 139 |             <span className="text-module-encounters">
 140 |               Last saved {formatTime(saveState.lastSavedAt)}
 141 |             </span>
 142 |           )}
 143 |           <span className="">
 144 |             <SparklesIcon className="inline size-3" /> Auto-saves every 30s
 145 |           </span>
 146 |         </CardContent>
 147 |       </Card>
 148 |     </div>
 149 |   );
 150 | }
 151 | 
 152 | function WeightSparkline({ data }: { data: Array<{ value: number; at: Date }> }) {
 153 |   if (data.length < 2) return null;
 154 |   const values = data.map((d) => d.value);
 155 |   const min = Math.min(...values);
 156 |   const max = Math.max(...values);
 157 |   const range = max - min || 1;
 158 | 
 159 |   return (
 160 |     <svg
 161 |       aria-label="Weight trend"
 162 |       className="text-module-encounters"
 163 |       fill="none"
 164 |       height="40"
 165 |       stroke="currentColor"
 166 |       strokeWidth="1.5"
 167 |       viewBox={"0 0 100 40"}
 168 |       width="100%"
 169 |     >
 170 |       <polyline
 171 |         points={data
 172 |           .map((d, i) => {
 173 |             const x = (i / (data.length - 1)) * 100;
 174 |             const y = 40 - ((d.value - min) / range) * 36 - 2;
 175 |             return `${x},${y}`;
 176 |           })
 177 |           .join(" ")}
 178 |       />
 179 |     </svg>
 180 |   );
 181 | }
```

`features/visits/composer/functions.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // features/visits/composer/functions.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Server functions for the visit composer. One level of indirection
   4 | // above `queries.ts`: everything here is safe to import from a
   5 | // `createServerFn` client because it doesn't pull in `#/db`.
   6 | 
   7 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   8 | import { z } from "zod";
   9 | 
  10 | import {
  11 |   fetchActiveMedications,
  12 |   fetchPatientSnapshot,
  13 |   saveVisit,
  14 | } from "@/db/queries/visit-composer.queries";
  15 | import { authMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
  16 | 
  17 | import { type SaveVisitResult, visitComposerSchema } from "./schema";
  18 | 
  19 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  20 | // Reads
  21 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  22 | 
  23 | const patientIdInput = z.object({ patientId: z.string().min(1) });
  24 | 
  25 | export const getVisitSnapshot = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  26 |   .validator(patientIdInput)
  27 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => fetchPatientSnapshot(data.patientId));
  28 | 
  29 | export const listActiveMedicationsForVisit = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  30 |   .validator(patientIdInput)
  31 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => fetchActiveMedications(data.patientId));
  32 | 
  33 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  34 | // Save
  35 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  36 | 
  37 | const SaveVisitComposerSchema = visitComposerSchema.extend({
  38 |   visitId: z.uuid().optional(),
  39 |   doctorId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(),
  40 | });
  41 | 
  42 | export const saveVisitComposer = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  43 |   .middleware([authMiddleware])
  44 |   .validator(SaveVisitComposerSchema)
  45 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }): Promise<SaveVisitResult> =>
  46 |     saveVisit(data, {
  47 |       id: context.user.id,
  48 |       role: context.user.role,
  49 |       clinicId: context.user.clinicId ?? null,
  50 |     }),
  51 |   );
  52 | 
  53 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  54 | // Derived types — reuse these in query-options.ts so the component layer
  55 | // never touches `#/db`.
  56 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  57 | 
  58 | export type VisitSnapshot = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getVisitSnapshot>>;
  59 | export type ActiveMedication = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listActiveMedicationsForVisit>>[number];
```

```ts
   1 | // features/visits/composer/query-options.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // The single import surface for the composer's React Query hooks.
   4 | // `use-visit-composer.ts` imports `useSaveVisitComposerMutation` from
   5 | // here and nothing else from the server layer.
   6 | 
   7 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   8 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   9 | 
  10 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "./schema";

  17 | } from "./functions";
  18 | 
  19 | export type { VisitSnapshot } from "./functions";
  20 | 
  21 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  22 | // Query keys
  23 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  24 | 
  25 | export const visitComposerKeys = {
  26 |   all: () => ["visit", "composer"] as const,
  27 | 
  28 |   snapshot: (patientId: string) => ["visit", "composer", "snapshot", patientId] as const,
  29 | 
  30 |   activeMeds: (patientId: string) => ["visit", "composer", "active-meds", patientId] as const,
  31 | } as const;
  32 | 
  33 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  34 | // Query options
  35 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  36 | 
  37 | const STALE_TIMES = {
  38 |   /** Snapshot feeds the patient card and the weight sparkline. */
  39 |   SNAPSHOT: 60_000,
  40 |   /** Active meds change whenever another prescriber writes — short TTL. */
  41 |   ACTIVE_MEDS: 15_000,
  42 | } as const;
  43 | 
  44 | export function visitSnapshotQuery(patientId: string) {
  45 |   return queryOptions<VisitSnapshot>({
  46 |     queryKey: visitComposerKeys.snapshot(patientId),
  47 |     queryFn: () => getVisitSnapshot({ data: { patientId } }),
  48 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.SNAPSHOT,
  49 |   });
  50 | }
  51 | 
  52 | export function visitActiveMedsQuery(patientId: string) {
  53 |   return queryOptions({
  54 |     queryKey: visitComposerKeys.activeMeds(patientId),
  55 |     queryFn: () => listActiveMedicationsForVisit({ data: { patientId } }),
  56 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.ACTIVE_MEDS,
  57 |   });
  58 | }
  59 | 
  60 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  61 | // Invalidation
  62 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  63 | 
  64 | /**
  65 |  * Everything a successful save touches. Kept private to this module so
  66 |  * callers can't accidentally forget one of the keys.
  67 |  */
  68 | function invalidateAfterSave(
  69 |   queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
  70 |   args: { visitId: string; patientId: string },
  71 | ): Promise<unknown> {
  72 |   return Promise.all([
  73 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  74 |       queryKey: ["visit", args.visitId],
  75 |     }),
  76 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  77 |       queryKey: ["visit", args.visitId, "details"],
  78 |     }),
  79 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["visits"] }),
  80 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  81 |       queryKey: ["patient", args.patientId],
  82 |     }),
  83 |     // Measurement writes move the growth charts.
  84 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  85 |       queryKey: ["series", args.patientId],
  86 |     }),
  87 |     // The composer's own snapshot cache should reflect the new state.
  88 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  89 |       queryKey: visitComposerKeys.snapshot(args.patientId),
  90 |     }),
  91 |   ]);
  92 | }
  93 | 
  94 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  95 | // Mutation
  96 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  97 | 
  98 | /**
  99 |  * Save the composer. Callers pass `{ ...values, visitId }` — one object,
 100 |  * one mutation, one consistent invalidation list. `onSuccess` is the
 101 |  * caller's hook into the result; the hook here only handles the caches.
 102 |  */
 103 | export function useSaveVisitComposerMutation(options?: {
 104 |   onSuccess?: (data: { visitId: string }, values: VisitComposerValues) => void;
 105 |   onError?: (error: unknown) => void;
 106 | }) {
 107 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 108 |   const saveFn = useServerFn(saveVisitComposer);
 109 | 
 110 |   return useMutation<{ visitId: string }, unknown, VisitComposerValues & { visitId?: string }>({
 111 |     mutationFn: (values: VisitComposerValues & { visitId?: string }) => saveFn({ data: values }),
 112 |     onSuccess: (data, values) => {
 113 |       void invalidateAfterSave(queryClient, {
 114 |         visitId: data.visitId,
 115 |         patientId: values.patientId,
 116 |       });
 117 |       options?.onSuccess?.(data, values);
 118 |     },
 119 |     onError: (err) => {
 120 |       options?.onError?.(err);
 121 |     },
 122 |   });
 123 | }
```

```tsx
  10 | 
  11 | // ── Datetime helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  12 | 
  13 | /**
  14 |  * Render `Date` → `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` **in local time**.
  15 |  *
  16 |  * `toISOString()` converts to UTC first, so a visit at 14:00 UTC+2 renders
  17 |  * as "12:00", and the round-trip through `<input type="datetime-local">`
  18 |  * (which parses as local) silently shifts the time on every save.
  19 |  */
  20 | function toLocalDateTimeValue(date: Date): string {
  21 |   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  22 |   const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  23 |   return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
  24 | }
  25 | 
  26 | /** Parse `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` (as emitted by `<input type="datetime-local">`) in local time. */
  27 | function fromLocalDateTimeValue(value: string): Date | null {
  28 |   if (!value) return null;
  29 |   const d = new Date(value);
  30 |   return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  31 | }
  32 | 
  33 | // ── Chip helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  34 | 
  35 | function chipClass(selected: boolean, readOnly: boolean | undefined): string {
  36 |   return cn(
  37 |     "rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
  38 |     "focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none",
  39 |     selected ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "bg-muted ",
  40 |     !readOnly && !selected && "hover:bg-muted/80",
  41 |     readOnly && "opacity-60",
  42 |   );
  43 | }
  44 | 
  45 | function capitalize(value: string): string {
  46 |   return value.length === 0 ? value : value[0]?.toUpperCase() + value.slice(1);
  47 | }
  48 | 
  49 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  50 | 
  51 | interface Props {
  52 |   values: VisitComposerValues;
  53 |   patch: (p: Partial<VisitComposerValues>) => void;
  54 |   /**
  55 |    * Display name of the clinic. When absent, falls back to a short id
  56 |    * fragment. Pass `clinic.name` from the route so users see something
  57 |    * meaningful instead of "a1b2c3d4".
  58 |    */
  59 |   clinicName?: string;
  60 |   /**
  61 |    * When provided, replaces the free-text doctor input with a selectable
  62 |    * list. Pass the clinic's user roster from the route.
  63 |    */
  64 |   doctors?: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  65 |   readOnly?: boolean;
  66 | }
  67 | 
  68 | export function EncounterContextSection({ values, patch, clinicName, doctors, readOnly }: Props) {
  69 |   const [doctorError, setDoctorError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  70 | 
  71 |   const setVisitedAt = (value: string) => {
  72 |     const next = fromLocalDateTimeValue(value);
  73 |     if (next) patch({ visitedAt: next });
  74 |   };
  75 | 
  76 |   const setDoctorId = (value: string) => {
  77 |     const trimmed = value.trim();
  78 |     if (!trimmed) {
  79 |       setDoctorError(null);
  80 |       patch({ doctorId: null });
  81 |       return;
  82 |     }
  83 |     // If the caller supplied a roster, only allow known ids.
  84 |     if (doctors && !doctors.some((d) => d.id === trimmed)) {
  85 |       setDoctorError("Unknown doctor id");
  86 |       return;
  87 |     }
  88 |     setDoctorError(null);
  89 |     patch({ doctorId: trimmed });
  90 |   };
  91 | 
  92 |   const toggleSymptom = (symptom: (typeof SYMPTOM_CHIPS)[number]) => {
  93 |     const selected = values.symptoms.includes(symptom);
  94 |     patch({
  95 |       symptoms: selected
  96 |         ? values.symptoms.filter((s) => s !== symptom)
  97 |         : [...values.symptoms, symptom],
  98 |     });
  99 |   };
 100 | 
 101 |   const clearSymptoms = () => patch({ symptoms: [] });
 102 | 
 103 |   return (
 104 |     <div className="grid gap-4">
 105 |       {/* Date / clinic / doctor row */}
 106 |       <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
 107 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
 108 |           <Label htmlFor="visitedAt">Visit date</Label>
 109 |           <Input
 110 |             disabled={readOnly}
 111 |             id="visitedAt"
 112 |             max={toLocalDateTimeValue(new Date())}
 113 |             onChange={(e) => setVisitedAt(e.target.value)}
 114 |             type="datetime-local"
 115 |             value={toLocalDateTimeValue(values.visitedAt)}
 116 |           />
 117 |           <p className=" text-[11px]">
 118 |             Local time ({Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone})
 119 |           </p>
 120 |         </div>
 121 | 
 122 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
 123 |           <Label htmlFor="visitClinic">Clinic</Label>
 124 |           <Input
 125 |             disabled
 126 |             id="visitClinic"
 127 |             readOnly
 128 |             value={clinicName ?? values.clinicId.slice(0, 8)}
 129 |           />
 130 |         </div>
 131 | 
 132 |         <div className="grid gap-1">
 133 |           <Label htmlFor="visitDoctor">Doctor</Label>
 134 |           {doctors ? (
 135 |             <select
 136 |               className="border-b-input focus-visible:border-b-ring h-10 w-full rounded-none border border-transparent bg-transparent px-0 py-1 text-sm outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
 137 |               disabled={readOnly}
 138 |               id="visitDoctor"
 139 |               onChange={(e) => setDoctorId(e.target.value)}
 140 |               value={values.doctorId ?? ""}
 141 |             >
 142 |               <option value="">Unassigned</option>
 143 |               {doctors.map((d) => (
 144 |                 <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>
 145 |                   {d.name}
 146 |                 </option>
 147 |               ))}
 148 |             </select>
 149 |           ) : (
 150 |             <Input
 151 |               aria-invalid={Boolean(doctorError)}
 152 |               disabled={readOnly}
 153 |               id="visitDoctor"
 154 |               onBlur={(e) => setDoctorId(e.target.value)}
 155 |               placeholder="Unassigned"
 156 |               value={values.doctorId ?? ""}
 157 |             />
 158 |           )}
 159 |           {doctorError && (
 160 |             <p className="text-destructive text-[11px]" role="alert">
 161 |               {doctorError}
 162 |             </p>
 163 |           )}
 164 |         </div>
 165 |       </div>
 166 | 
 167 |       {/* Chief complaint */}
 168 |       <div className="grid gap-1">
 169 |         <Label htmlFor="chiefComplaint">Chief complaint</Label>
 170 |         <Input
 171 |           disabled={readOnly}
 172 |           id="chiefComplaint"
 173 |           maxLength={500}
 174 |           onChange={(e) => patch({ chiefComplaint: e.target.value })}
 175 |           placeholder="e.g. Fever for 2 days, cough"
 176 |           value={values.chiefComplaint}
 177 |         />
 178 |       </div>
 179 | 
 180 |       {/* Symptom chips */}
 181 |       <fieldset className="grid gap-1.5">
 182 |         <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
 183 |           <legend className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase">
 184 |             Symptoms <span className=" font-normal normal-case">(select all that apply)</span>
 185 |           </legend>
 186 |           {!readOnly && values.symptoms.length > 0 && (
 187 |             <button
 188 |               className=" hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-ring rounded-sm text-[11px] underline-offset-2 hover:underline focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none"
 189 |               onClick={clearSymptoms}
 190 |               type="button"
 191 |             >
 192 |               Clear ({values.symptoms.length})
 193 |             </button>
 194 |           )}
 195 |         </div>
 196 |         <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
 197 |           {SYMPTOM_CHIPS.map((symptom) => {
 198 |             const selected = values.symptoms.includes(symptom);
 199 |             return (
 200 |               <button
 201 |                 aria-pressed={selected}
 202 |                 className={chipClass(selected, readOnly)}
 203 |                 disabled={readOnly}
 204 |                 key={symptom}
 205 |                 onClick={() => toggleSymptom(symptom)}
 206 |                 type="button"
 207 |               >
 208 |                 {capitalize(symptom)}
 209 |               </button>
 210 |             );
 211 |           })}
 212 |         </div>
 213 |       </fieldset>
 214 |     </div>
 215 |   );
 216 | }
```

```tsx
  10 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "../schema";
  11 | 
  12 | // ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  13 | 
  14 | /** One entry of the LMS table for a single (indicator, sex, age). */
  15 | export interface LmsLookup {

  35 | }

  38 | 
  39 | type FieldSpec = {

  41 |   label: string;
  42 |   unit: string;
  43 |   /** The input that supplies x for WFL z-scores. Not applicable elsewhere. */
  44 |   requiresLength?: boolean;
  45 |   /**
  46 |    * Whether the Egyptian LMS reference covers this indicator.
  47 |    * Head circumference has no reference in the current seed.
  48 |    */
  49 |   hasReference: boolean;
  50 | };
  51 | 
  52 | const FIELDS: readonly FieldSpec[] = [
  53 |   {
  54 |     indicator: "weight-for-age",
  55 |     label: "Weight",
  56 |     unit: "kg",
  57 |     hasReference: true,
  58 |   },
  59 |   {
  60 |     indicator: "length-for-age",
  61 |     label: "Length",
  62 |     unit: "cm",
  63 |     hasReference: true,
  64 |   },
  65 |   {

  67 |     label: "Head circ.",
  68 |     unit: "cm",
  69 |     hasReference: false,
  70 |   },
  71 |   {

  73 |     label: "BMI",
  74 |     unit: "kg/m²",
  75 |     hasReference: true,
  76 |   },
  77 |   {
  78 |     indicator: "weight-for-length",
  79 |     label: "Weight / length",
  80 |     unit: "kg",
  81 |     requiresLength: true,
  82 |     hasReference: true,
  83 |   },
  84 | ];
  85 | 
  86 | // ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  87 | 
  88 | function isFinitePositive(v: number | null | undefined): v is number {
  89 |   return typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0;
  90 | }
  91 | 
  92 | /** Tailwind variants keyed by classification category. */
  93 | function classificationVariant(
  94 |   c: Classification,
  95 | ): "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "outline" {
  96 |   if (c.severity === "severe") return "destructive";
  97 |   if (c.severity === "moderate") return "warning";
  98 |   if (c.severity === "mild") return "warning";
  99 |   if (c.category === "normal") return "success";
 100 |   return "outline";
 101 | }
 102 | 
 103 | type ComputedZ = {
 104 |   z: number;
 105 |   percentile: number;
 106 |   classification: Classification;
 107 | };
 108 | 
 109 | function computeZ(
 110 |   indicator: Indicator,
 111 |   value: number,
 112 |   lms: LmsLookup | undefined,
 113 | ): ComputedZ | null {
 114 |   if (!lms) return null;
 115 |   try {
 116 |     const z = zScoreForValue({ l: lms.l, m: lms.m, s: lms.s }, value);
 117 |     const percentile = percentileFromZ(z);
 118 |     const classification = classify(indicator, z);
 119 |     return { z, percentile, classification };
 120 |   } catch {
 121 |     // zScoreForValue throws on domain errors (value <= 0, invalid LMS)
 122 |     return null;
 123 |   }
 124 | }
 125 | 
 126 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 127 | 
 128 | export function VitalsSection({ values, patch, lmsByIndicator, readOnly }: VitalsSectionProps) {
 129 |   const measurementByIndicator = React.useMemo(() => {
 130 |     const map = new Map<Indicator, (typeof values.measurements)[number]>();
 131 |     for (const m of values.measurements) map.set(m.indicator, m);
 132 |     return map;
 133 |   }, [values.measurements]);
 134 | 
 135 |   const setMeasurement = React.useCallback(
 136 |     (indicator: Indicator, value: number | null, lengthCm?: number | null) => {
 137 |       const others = values.measurements.filter((m) => m.indicator !== indicator);
 138 | 
 139 |       if (!isFinitePositive(value)) {
 140 |         patch({ measurements: others });
 141 |         return;
 142 |       }
 143 | 
 144 |       patch({
 145 |         measurements: [
 146 |           ...others,
 147 |           {
 148 |             draftId: `v-${indicator}`,
 149 |             indicator,
 150 |             value,
 151 |             lengthCm: indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (lengthCm ?? null) : null,
 152 |           },
 153 |         ],
 154 |       });
 155 |     },
 156 |     [patch, values.measurements],
 157 |   );
 158 | 
 159 |   return (
 160 |     <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
 161 |       {FIELDS.map((field) => (
 162 |         <VitalField
 163 |           existing={measurementByIndicator.get(field.indicator)}
 164 |           field={field}
 165 |           key={field.indicator}
 166 |           lms={lmsByIndicator?.[field.indicator]}
 167 |           onChange={setMeasurement}
 168 |           readOnly={readOnly}
 169 |         />
 170 |       ))}
 171 |     </div>
 172 |   );
 173 | }

 176 | 
 177 | interface VitalFieldProps {
 178 |   field: FieldSpec;
 179 |   existing:
 180 |     | {
 181 |         value: number;
 182 |         lengthCm?: number | null;
 183 |       }
 184 |     | undefined;
 185 |   lms: LmsLookup | undefined;
 186 |   onChange: (indicator: Indicator, value: number | null, lengthCm?: number | null) => void;
 187 |   readOnly: boolean | undefined;
 188 | }
 189 | 
 190 | function VitalField({ field, existing, lms, onChange, readOnly }: VitalFieldProps) {
 191 |   const inputId = `vital-${field.indicator}`;
 192 |   const lengthId = `${inputId}-length`;
 193 |   const badgeId = `${inputId}-z`;
 194 | 
 195 |   const lengthCm = field.requiresLength ? (existing?.lengthCm ?? null) : null;
```

`features/visits/composer/use-visit-composer.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // features/visits/composer/use-visit-composer.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // The composer's React-facing hook. Deliberately knows nothing about
   4 | // server functions or Drizzle — only about the mutation hook exported
   5 | // from `./queries`.
   6 | 
   7 | import * as React from "react";
   8 | 
   9 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "./schema";
  10 | 
  11 | import { useSaveVisitComposerMutation } from "./queries";
  12 | 
  13 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  14 | // Public types
  15 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  16 | 
  17 | export interface ComposerSaveState {
  18 |   saving: boolean;
  19 |   dirty: boolean;
  20 |   lastSavedAt: Date | null;
  21 |   error: string | null;
  22 | }
  23 | 
  24 | export type SaveOutcome = { ok: true; visitId: string } | { ok: false; error: string };
  25 | 
  26 | export interface VisitComposerHandle {
  27 |   state: ComposerSaveState & { values: VisitComposerValues };
  28 |   patch: (partial: Partial<VisitComposerValues>) => void;
  29 |   reset: () => void;
  30 |   save: () => Promise<SaveOutcome>;
  31 | }
  32 | 
  33 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  34 | // Serialisation
  35 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  36 | 
  37 | /**
  38 |  * The composer's value object is all JSON-safe. `JSON.stringify` is a
  39 |  * cheap structural signature. Two invariants make it correct:
  40 |  *
  41 |  *   1. Key insertion order is stable — `patch` always spreads into the
  42 |  *      existing object, and `initial`/`submittedValues` share one shape.
  43 |  *      Never construct `values` by spreading a differently-ordered object.
  44 |  *   2. Dates serialise as ISO strings, so same-instant Dates compare equal.
  45 |  *
  46 |  * If a field ever becomes non-JSON-safe (File, Map, …) this is the one
  47 |  * place to change.
  48 |  */
  49 | function signatureOf(values: VisitComposerValues): string {
  50 |   return JSON.stringify(values);
  51 | }
  52 | 
  53 | /** Structural key for an arbitrary JSON-safe value (used to detect prop changes). */
  54 | function stableKey(value: unknown): string {
  55 |   return JSON.stringify(value);
  56 | }
  57 | 
  58 | /**
  59 |  * Identity that, when it changes, means "load fresh data into the editor".
  60 |  * Includes `visitId` so navigating create → edit (or between visits on the
  61 |  * same route) resets the draft.
  62 |  */
  63 | function loadKey(initial: VisitComposerValues, visitId: string | undefined): string {
  64 |   return stableKey({ initial, visitId: visitId ?? null });
  65 | }
  66 | 
  67 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  68 | // State
  69 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  70 | 
  71 | type Snapshot = {
  72 |   /** Current draft the user is editing. */
  73 |   values: VisitComposerValues;
  74 |   /** Signature of the last successfully-saved (or loaded) values. */
  75 |   savedSignature: string;
  76 |   /** The last values known to be persisted — what `reset()` restores to. */
  77 |   lastPersisted: VisitComposerValues;
  78 |   lastSavedAt: Date | null;
  79 |   error: string | null;
  80 |   /** Identity of the incoming `(initial, visitId)` pair. */
  81 |   key: string;
  82 | };
  83 | 
  84 | function createSnapshot(
  85 |   initial: VisitComposerValues,
  86 |   visitId: string | undefined,
  87 |   key: string,
  88 | ): Snapshot {
  89 |   const signature = signatureOf(initial);
  90 |   return {
  91 |     values: initial,
  92 |     savedSignature: signature,
  93 |     lastPersisted: initial,
  94 |     // Only claim "last saved" on edit — a fresh create hasn't been saved yet.
  95 |     lastSavedAt: visitId ? new Date() : null,
  96 |     error: null,
  97 |     key,
  98 |   };
  99 | }
 100 | 
 101 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 102 | // Hook
 103 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 104 | 
 105 | export function useVisitComposer(
 106 |   initial: VisitComposerValues,
 107 |   visitId?: string,
 108 | ): VisitComposerHandle {
 109 |   const key = loadKey(initial, visitId);
 110 | 
 111 |   const [snap, setSnap] = React.useState<Snapshot>(() => createSnapshot(initial, visitId, key));
 112 | 
 113 |   // Derive-from-props reset: if the incoming identity changed, swap the
 114 |   // whole snapshot atomically. React discards this render's output and
 115 |   // re-renders immediately, so the old patient's values are never visible.
 116 |   if (snap.key !== key) {
 117 |     setSnap(createSnapshot(initial, visitId, key));
 118 |   }
 119 | 
 120 |   // Latest draft, mirrored OUTSIDE render so `save()` can read it from an
 121 |   // event handler without tripping the "no ref writes during render" rule.
 122 |   // Initialised from state, updated by `patch`/`reset`/`onSuccess` only.
 123 |   const latestValuesRef = React.useRef<VisitComposerValues>(snap.values);
 124 | 
 125 |   const currentSignature = React.useMemo(() => signatureOf(snap.values), [snap.values]);
 126 |   const dirty = currentSignature !== snap.savedSignature;
 127 | 
 128 |   const mutation = useSaveVisitComposerMutation({
 129 |     onSuccess: (_result, submittedValues) => {
 130 |       latestValuesRef.current = submittedValues;
 131 |       const signature = signatureOf(submittedValues);
 132 |       setSnap((prev) => ({
 133 |         ...prev,
 134 |         // Keep the user's live draft, only mark it saved.
 135 |         savedSignature: signature,
 136 |         lastPersisted: submittedValues,
 137 |         lastSavedAt: new Date(),
 138 |         error: null,
 139 |       }));
 140 |     },
 141 |     onError: (err) => {
 142 |       setSnap((prev) => ({
 143 |         ...prev,
 144 |         error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not save visit.",
 145 |       }));
 146 |     },
 147 |   });
 148 | 
 149 |   const { mutateAsync } = mutation;
 150 | 
 151 |   const patch = React.useCallback((partial: Partial<VisitComposerValues>) => {
 152 |     setSnap((prev) => {
 153 |       const nextValues = { ...prev.values, ...partial };
 154 |       latestValuesRef.current = nextValues;
 155 |       return { ...prev, values: nextValues };
 156 |     });
 157 |   }, []);
 158 | 
 159 |   const reset = React.useCallback(() => {
 160 |     setSnap((prev) => {
 161 |       const lastPersisted = prev.lastPersisted;
 162 |       latestValuesRef.current = lastPersisted;
 163 |       return {
 164 |         ...prev,
 165 |         values: lastPersisted,
 166 |         savedSignature: signatureOf(lastPersisted),
 167 |         error: null,
 168 |       };
 169 |     });
 170 |   }, []);
 171 | 
 172 |   const save = React.useCallback(async (): Promise<SaveOutcome> => {
 173 |     setSnap((prev) => ({ ...prev, error: null }));
 174 |     try {
 175 |       const submitted = latestValuesRef.current;
 176 |       const result = await mutateAsync({ ...submitted, visitId });
 177 |       return { ok: true, visitId: result.visitId };
 178 |     } catch (err) {
 179 |       // `onError` already wrote the message into state; mirror it here so
 180 |       // callers get a self-contained result without reading state.
 181 |       return {
 182 |         ok: false,
 183 |         error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not save visit.",
 184 |       };
 185 |     }
 186 |   }, [mutateAsync, visitId]);
 187 | 
 188 |   return {
 189 |     state: {
 190 |       values: snap.values,
 191 |       dirty,
 192 |       error: snap.error,
 193 |       lastSavedAt: snap.lastSavedAt,
 194 |       saving: mutation.isPending,
 195 |     },
 196 |     patch,
 197 |     reset,
 198 |     save,
 199 |   };
 200 | }
```

```ts
   3 | // Server-function adapters for visits. Nested offline visit writes are
   4 | // persisted transactionally here; TanStack Query stays in `query-options.ts`.
   5 | 
   6 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
   7 | import { getRequest, setResponseStatus } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
   8 | import { z } from "zod";
   9 | 
  10 | import { db, eq } from "#/db/index.ts";
  11 | import {
  12 |   auditLog,
  13 |   diagnoses,
  14 |   idempotency,
  15 |   measurements,
  16 |   patients,
  17 |   prescriptions,
  18 |   visits,
  19 | } from "#/db/schema.ts";
  20 | import { IndicatorSchema } from "@/features/measurements/schema";
  21 | import { clinicAccessMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/clinic-middleware";
  22 | import { freshAuthMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
  23 | 
  24 | import {
  25 |   createVisit,
  26 |   deleteVisit,
  27 |   getVisitById,
  28 |   getVisitWithDetails,
  29 |   listRecentVisitsForClinic,
  30 |   listVisitsForClinic,
  31 |   listVisitsForPatient,
  32 |   updateVisit,
  33 | } from "../../db/queries/visits.queries";
  34 | import { visitInputSchema, visitSearchSchema } from "./schema";
  35 | 
  36 | const MeasurementDraft = z
  37 |   .object({
  38 |     id: z.string().optional(),
  39 |     indicator: IndicatorSchema,
  40 |     value: z.number().positive(),
  41 |     lengthCm: z.number().positive().nullable().optional(),
  42 |   })
  43 |   .superRefine((measurement, ctx) => {
  44 |     if (measurement.indicator === "weight-for-length" && measurement.lengthCm == null) {
  45 |       ctx.addIssue({
  46 |         code: "custom",
  47 |         message: "Length is required for a weight-for-length measurement.",
  48 |         path: ["lengthCm"],
  49 |       });
  50 |     }
  51 |   });
  52 | 
  53 | const DiagnosisDraft = z.object({
  54 |   id: z.string().optional(),
  55 |   icdCode: z.string(),
  56 |   description: z.string(),
  57 |   type: z.enum(["primary", "secondary"]),
  58 | });
  59 | 
  60 | const PrescriptionDraft = z.object({
  61 |   id: z.string().optional(),
  62 |   medicationName: z.string(),
  63 |   dosage: z.string(),
  64 |   frequency: z.string(),
  65 |   durationDays: z.number().int().nullable(),
  66 |   instructions: z.string().nullable(),
  67 | });
  68 | 
  69 | const SaveVisitInput = z.object({
  70 |   visitId: z.uuid().optional(), // undefined → create
  71 |   patientId: z.uuid(),
  72 |   clinicId: z.uuid(),
  73 |   doctorId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  74 |   visitedAt: z.coerce.date(),
  75 |   chiefComplaint: z.string().nullable(),
  76 |   symptoms: z.array(z.string()),
  77 |   examFindings: z.string().nullable(),
  78 |   plan: z.string().nullable(),
  79 |   followUpWeeks: z.number().int().nullable(),
  80 |   /** Client sends the version it last saw. Omit on create. */
  81 |   baseVersion: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  82 |   measurements: z.array(MeasurementDraft).superRefine((rows, ctx) => {
  83 |     const seen = new Set<string>();
  84 |     rows.forEach((row, index) => {
  85 |       if (seen.has(row.indicator)) {
  86 |         ctx.addIssue({
  87 |           code: "custom",
  88 |           message: "A visit can only contain one measurement per indicator.",
  89 |           path: [index, "indicator"],
  90 |         });
  91 |       }
  92 |       seen.add(row.indicator);
  93 |     });
  94 |   }),
  95 |   diagnoses: z.array(DiagnosisDraft),
  96 |   prescriptions: z.array(PrescriptionDraft),
  97 | });
  98 | 
  99 | type SaveVisitValues = z.infer<typeof SaveVisitInput>;
 100 | type VisitTransaction = Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0];
 101 | type SaveVisitOutcome =
 102 |   | { kind: "ok"; visitId: string }
 103 |   | { kind: "conflict"; serverSnapshot: unknown };
 104 | 
 105 | export const saveVisitFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
 106 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
 107 |   .validator(SaveVisitInput)
 108 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
 109 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
 110 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
 111 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
 112 |           operation: "save-visit",
 113 |           key: idempotencyKey,
 114 |           userId: context.user.id,
 115 |           data,
 116 |         })
 117 |       : null;
 118 | 
 119 |     const result = db.transaction<SaveVisitOutcome>((tx) => {
 120 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 121 |         const previous = tx
 122 |           .select()
 123 |           .from(idempotency)
 124 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
 125 |           .get();
 126 |         if (previous) {
 127 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
 128 |             setResponseStatus(409);
 129 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
 130 |           }
 131 | 
 132 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
 133 |           if (
 134 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 135 |             previousResult !== null &&
 136 |             "conflict" in previousResult &&
 137 |             previousResult.conflict === true &&
 138 |             "serverSnapshot" in previousResult
 139 |           ) {
 140 |             return {
 141 |               kind: "conflict",
 142 |               serverSnapshot: previousResult.serverSnapshot,
 143 |             };
 144 |           }
 145 | 
 146 |           const previousVisitId =
 147 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
 148 |             previousResult !== null &&
 149 |             "visitId" in previousResult &&
 150 |             typeof previousResult.visitId === "string"
 151 |               ? previousResult.visitId
 152 |               : null;
 153 |           if (!previousVisitId) {
 154 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
 155 |           }
 156 |           return { kind: "ok", visitId: previousVisitId };
 157 |         }
 158 |       }
 159 | 
 160 |       const [patient] = tx
 161 |         .select({
 162 |           clinicId: patients.clinicId,
 163 |           dateOfBirth: patients.dateOfBirth,
 164 |         })
 165 |         .from(patients)
 166 |         .where(eq(patients.id, data.patientId))
 167 |         .limit(1)
 168 |         .all();
 169 |       if (!patient || patient.clinicId !== data.clinicId) {
 170 |         throw forbidden();
 171 |       }
 172 |       if (context.user.role !== "admin" && context.user.clinicId !== data.clinicId) {
 173 |         throw forbidden();
 174 |       }
 175 | 
 176 |       const dob = new Date(`${patient.dateOfBirth}T00:00:00Z`);
 177 |       if (!Number.isFinite(dob.getTime())) {
 178 |         throw new Error(`Patient ${data.patientId} has an invalid birth date.`);
 179 |       }
 180 |       const ageMonths = computeAgeMonths(data.visitedAt, dob);
 181 |       if (ageMonths < 0) {
 182 |         setResponseStatus(422);
 183 |         throw new Error("Visit date cannot be before the patient's birth.");
 184 |       }
 185 | 
 186 |       const current = data.visitId
 187 |         ? tx.select().from(visits).where(eq(visits.id, data.visitId)).get()
 188 |         : undefined;
 189 |       if (data.visitId && !current) throw notFound("Visit not found.");
 190 |       if (current && (current.patientId !== data.patientId || current.clinicId !== data.clinicId)) {
 191 |         throw forbidden();
 192 |       }
 193 | 
 194 |       if (current && data.baseVersion && current.updatedAt.toISOString() !== data.baseVersion) {
 195 |         const serverSnapshot = getVisitSnapshot(tx, current);
 196 |         if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 197 |           tx.insert(idempotency)
 198 |             .values({
 199 |               id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 200 |               key: idempotencyKey,
 201 |               requestHash,
 202 |               result: { conflict: true, serverSnapshot },
 203 |             })
 204 |             .run();
 205 |         }
 206 |         return { kind: "conflict", serverSnapshot };
 207 |       }
 208 | 
 209 |       const now = new Date();
 210 |       const visitValues = {
 211 |         doctorId: data.doctorId,
 212 |         visitedAt: data.visitedAt,
 213 |         ageMonths,
 214 |         ageYears: Math.floor(ageMonths / 12),
 215 |         ageMonthsRemainder: Math.floor(ageMonths % 12),
 216 |         chiefComplaint: data.chiefComplaint,
 217 |         symptoms: data.symptoms.join(", "),
 218 |         physicalExam: data.examFindings,
 219 |         plan: data.plan,
 220 |         updatedAt: now,
 221 |       };
 222 |       const visit = current
 223 |         ? tx.update(visits).set(visitValues).where(eq(visits.id, current.id)).returning().get()
 224 |         : tx
 225 |             .insert(visits)
 226 |             .values({
 227 |               ...visitValues,
 228 |               patientId: data.patientId,
 229 |               clinicId: data.clinicId,
 230 |             })
 231 |             .returning()
 232 |             .get();
 233 |       if (!visit) throw new Error("Failed to save visit.");
 234 | 
 235 |       if (current) {
 236 |         syncMeasurements(tx, visit, data.measurements);
 237 |         syncDiagnoses(tx, visit.id, data.diagnoses);
 238 |         syncPrescriptions(tx, visit, data.prescriptions, context.user.id);
 239 |       } else {
 240 |         insertVisitChildren(tx, visit, data, context.user.id);
 241 |       }
 242 | 
 243 |       tx.insert(auditLog)
 244 |         .values({
 245 |           actorId: context.user.id,
 246 |           action: current ? "update" : "create",
 247 |           entity: "Visit",
 248 |           entityId: visit.id,
 249 |           metadata: {
 250 |             patientId: visit.patientId,
 251 |             clinicId: visit.clinicId,
 252 |             visitedAt: visit.visitedAt.toISOString(),
 253 |           },
 254 |         })
 255 |         .run();
 256 | 
 257 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
 258 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
 259 |           .values({
 260 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 261 |             key: idempotencyKey,
 262 |             requestHash,
 263 |             result: { visitId: visit.id },
 264 |           })
 265 |           .run();
 266 |       }
 267 | 
 268 |       return { kind: "ok", visitId: visit.id };
 269 |     });
 270 | 
 271 |     if (result.kind === "conflict") {
 272 |       throw conflict(result.serverSnapshot);
 273 |     }
 274 |     const savedVisit = await getVisitWithDetails(result.visitId);
 275 |     if (!savedVisit) throw notFound("Saved visit was not found.");
 276 |     return savedVisit;
 277 |   });
 278 | 
 279 | function insertVisitChildren(
 280 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
 281 |   visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect,
 282 |   data: SaveVisitValues,
 283 |   prescriberId: string,
 284 | ): void {
 285 |   if (data.measurements.length > 0) {
 286 |     tx.insert(measurements)
 287 |       .values(
 288 |         data.measurements.map((measurement) => ({
 289 |           visitId: visit.id,
 290 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
 291 |           measuredAt: visit.visitedAt,
 292 |           indicator: measurement.indicator,
 293 |           value: measurement.value,
 294 |           lengthCmAtMeasurement:
 295 |             measurement.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (measurement.lengthCm ?? null) : null,
 296 |         })),
 297 |       )
 298 |       .run();
 299 |   }
 300 |   if (data.diagnoses.length > 0) {
 301 |     tx.insert(diagnoses)
 302 |       .values(
 303 |         data.diagnoses.map((diagnosis) => ({
 304 |           visitId: visit.id,
 305 |           icdCode: diagnosis.icdCode,
 306 |           description: diagnosis.description,
 307 |           type: diagnosis.type,
 308 |         })),
 309 |       )
 310 |       .run();
 311 |   }
 312 |   if (data.prescriptions.length > 0) {
 313 |     tx.insert(prescriptions)
 314 |       .values(
 315 |         data.prescriptions.map((prescription) => ({
 316 |           visitId: visit.id,
 317 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
 318 |           prescribedById: prescriberId,
 319 |           medicationName: prescription.medicationName,
 320 |           dosage: prescription.dosage,
 321 |           frequency: prescription.frequency,
 322 |           durationDays: prescription.durationDays,
 323 |           instructions: prescription.instructions,
 324 |           prescribedAt: visit.visitedAt,
 325 |         })),
 326 |       )
 327 |       .run();
 328 |   }
 329 | }
 330 | 
 331 | function syncMeasurements(
 332 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
 333 |   visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect,
 334 |   incoming: SaveVisitValues["measurements"],
 335 | ): void {
 336 |   const existing = tx.select().from(measurements).where(eq(measurements.visitId, visit.id)).all();
 337 |   const byId = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
 338 |   const matchFor = (measurement: SaveVisitValues["measurements"][number]) =>
 339 |     (measurement.id ? byId.get(measurement.id) : undefined) ??
 340 |     existing.find((row) => row.indicator === measurement.indicator);
 341 |   const retainedIds = new Set(
 342 |     incoming
 343 |       .map(matchFor)
 344 |       .filter((row): row is (typeof existing)[number] => row !== undefined)
 345 |       .map((row) => row.id),
 346 |   );
 347 | 
 348 |   for (const row of existing) {
 349 |     if (!retainedIds.has(row.id)) {
 350 |       tx.delete(measurements).where(eq(measurements.id, row.id)).run();
 351 |     }
 352 |   }
 353 |   for (const measurement of incoming) {
 354 |     const existingRow = matchFor(measurement);
 355 |     const values = {
 356 |       indicator: measurement.indicator,
 357 |       value: measurement.value,
 358 |       measuredAt: visit.visitedAt,
 359 |       lengthCmAtMeasurement:
 360 |         measurement.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (measurement.lengthCm ?? null) : null,
 361 |       updatedAt: new Date(),
 362 |     };
 363 |     if (existingRow) {
 364 |       tx.update(measurements).set(values).where(eq(measurements.id, existingRow.id)).run();
 365 |     } else {
 366 |       tx.insert(measurements)
 367 |         .values({
 368 |           ...values,
 369 |           visitId: visit.id,
 370 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
 371 |         })
 372 |         .run();
 373 |     }
 374 |   }
 375 | }
 376 | 
 377 | function syncDiagnoses(
 378 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
 379 |   visitId: string,
 380 |   incoming: SaveVisitValues["diagnoses"],
 381 | ): void {
 382 |   const existing = tx.select().from(diagnoses).where(eq(diagnoses.visitId, visitId)).all();
 383 |   const byId = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
 384 |   const matchFor = (diagnosis: SaveVisitValues["diagnoses"][number]) =>
 385 |     (diagnosis.id ? byId.get(diagnosis.id) : undefined) ??
 386 |     existing.find((row) => row.icdCode === diagnosis.icdCode && row.type === diagnosis.type);
 387 |   const retainedIds = new Set(
 388 |     incoming
 389 |       .map(matchFor)
 390 |       .filter((row): row is (typeof existing)[number] => row !== undefined)
 391 |       .map((row) => row.id),
 392 |   );
 393 | 
 394 |   for (const row of existing) {
 395 |     if (!retainedIds.has(row.id)) {
 396 |       tx.delete(diagnoses).where(eq(diagnoses.id, row.id)).run();
 397 |     }
 398 |   }
 399 |   for (const diagnosis of incoming) {
 400 |     const existingRow = matchFor(diagnosis);
 401 |     const values = {
 402 |       icdCode: diagnosis.icdCode,
 403 |       description: diagnosis.description,
 404 |       type: diagnosis.type,
 405 |       updatedAt: new Date(),
 406 |     };
 407 |     if (existingRow) {
 408 |       tx.update(diagnoses).set(values).where(eq(diagnoses.id, existingRow.id)).run();
 409 |     } else {
 410 |       tx.insert(diagnoses)
 411 |         .values({ ...values, visitId })
 412 |         .run();
 413 |     }
 414 |   }
 415 | }
 416 | 
 417 | function syncPrescriptions(
 418 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
 419 |   visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect,
 420 |   incoming: SaveVisitValues["prescriptions"],
 421 |   prescriberId: string,
 422 | ): void {
 423 |   const existing = tx.select().from(prescriptions).where(eq(prescriptions.visitId, visit.id)).all();
 424 |   const byId = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
 425 |   const matchFor = (prescription: SaveVisitValues["prescriptions"][number]) =>
 426 |     (prescription.id ? byId.get(prescription.id) : undefined) ??
 427 |     existing.find(
 428 |       (row) =>
 429 |         row.medicationName === prescription.medicationName &&
 430 |         row.dosage === prescription.dosage &&
 431 |         row.frequency === prescription.frequency &&
 432 |         row.durationDays === prescription.durationDays,
 433 |     );
 434 |   const retainedIds = new Set(
 435 |     incoming
 436 |       .map(matchFor)
 437 |       .filter((row): row is (typeof existing)[number] => row !== undefined)
 438 |       .map((row) => row.id),
 439 |   );
 440 | 
 441 |   for (const row of existing) {
 442 |     if (row.status === "active" && !retainedIds.has(row.id)) {
 443 |       tx.update(prescriptions)
 444 |         .set({
 445 |           status: "cancelled",
 446 |           statusChangedAt: new Date(),
 447 |           updatedAt: new Date(),
 448 |         })
 449 |         .where(eq(prescriptions.id, row.id))
 450 |         .run();
 451 |     }
 452 |   }
 453 |   for (const prescription of incoming) {
 454 |     const existingRow = matchFor(prescription);
 455 |     const values = {
 456 |       medicationName: prescription.medicationName,
 457 |       dosage: prescription.dosage,
 458 |       frequency: prescription.frequency,
 459 |       durationDays: prescription.durationDays,
 460 |       instructions: prescription.instructions,
 461 |       updatedAt: new Date(),
 462 |     };
 463 |     if (existingRow) {
 464 |       tx.update(prescriptions).set(values).where(eq(prescriptions.id, existingRow.id)).run();
 465 |     } else {
 466 |       tx.insert(prescriptions)
 467 |         .values({
 468 |           ...values,
 469 |           visitId: visit.id,
 470 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
 471 |           prescribedById: prescriberId,
 472 |           prescribedAt: visit.visitedAt,
 473 |         })
 474 |         .run();
 475 |     }
 476 |   }
 477 | }
 478 | 
 479 | function getVisitSnapshot(tx: VisitTransaction, visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect) {
 480 |   return {
 481 |     ...visit,
 482 |     measurements: tx.select().from(measurements).where(eq(measurements.visitId, visit.id)).all(),
 483 |     diagnoses: tx.select().from(diagnoses).where(eq(diagnoses.visitId, visit.id)).all(),
 484 |     prescriptions: tx.select().from(prescriptions).where(eq(prescriptions.visitId, visit.id)).all(),
 485 |   };
 486 | }
 487 | 
 488 | function computeAgeMonths(at: Date, dob: Date): number {
 489 |   return (at.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / (86_400_000 * 30.4375);
 490 | }
 491 | 
 492 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
 493 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
 494 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
 495 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
 496 | }
 497 | 
 498 | function forbidden(): Error {
 499 |   setResponseStatus(403);
 500 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
 501 | }
 502 | 
 503 | function notFound(message: string): Error {
 504 |   setResponseStatus(404);
 505 |   return new Error(message);
 506 | }
 507 | 
 508 | function conflict(serverSnapshot: unknown): Error {
 509 |   setResponseStatus(409);
 510 |   return Object.assign(new Error("Conflict (409): visit was updated elsewhere."), {
 511 |     serverSnapshot,
 512 |   });
 513 | }
```

```ts
   1 | // features/visits/query-options.ts
   2 | //
   3 | // Everything React Query reads or writes about visits. Query keys,
   4 | // queryOptions factories, and the post-mutation invalidation helper.
   5 | //
   6 | // Rule of thumb: if it imports `queryOptions` or `useMutation`, it lives

   8 | // imports `#/db`, it lives in `../../db/queries/visits.queries`.

  10 | import type { z } from "zod";
  11 | 
  12 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
  13 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
  14 | 
  15 | import type { visitSearchSchema } from "./schema";

  18 |   createVisitFn,
```
