 345 | 
 346 | export function AppointmentForm({
 347 |   patientId = "",
 348 |   clinicId,
 349 |   defaultDoctorId = null,
 350 |   defaultDurationMinutes = 15,
 351 |   inline = false,
 352 |   onSuccess,
 353 | }: AppointmentFormProps) {
 354 |   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
 355 |   const createMutation = useCreateAppointmentMutation();
 356 | 
 357 |   const defaultValues = useMemo<AppointmentFormValues>(
 358 |     () => ({
 359 |       patientId,
 360 |       clinicId,
 361 |       doctorId: defaultDoctorId ?? null,
 362 |       scheduledAt: nowLocalInput(30),
 363 |       durationMinutes: defaultDurationMinutes,
 364 |       reason: "",
 365 |       notes: "",
 366 |     }),
 367 |     [patientId, clinicId, defaultDoctorId, defaultDurationMinutes],
 368 |   );
 369 | 
 370 |   const form = useForm({
 371 |     defaultValues,
 372 |     validators: {
 373 |       onSubmit: appointmentSchema,
 374 |       onSubmitAsync: async ({ value }) => {
 375 |         try {
 376 |           const appointment = await createMutation.mutateAsync({
 377 |             data: {
 378 |               patientId: value.patientId,
 379 |               clinicId: value.clinicId,
 380 |               doctorId: value.doctorId,
 381 |               scheduledAt: new Date(value.scheduledAt),
 382 |               durationMinutes: value.durationMinutes,
 383 |               reason: value.reason.trim(),
 384 |               notes: value.notes.trim(),
 385 |             },
 386 |           });
 387 | 
 388 |           toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Appointment scheduled" });
 389 |           form.reset(defaultValues);
 390 |           setOpen(false);
 391 |           onSuccess?.(appointment as { id: string });
 392 |           return undefined;
 393 |         } catch (error) {

 395 |             error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to schedule appointment";
 396 |           return { form: message };
 397 |         }
 398 |       },
 399 |     },
 400 |   });

 402 |   // Keep the form aligned with prop-driven default changes.

 414 |       className="grid gap-4"

 430 |                 placeholder="Enter patient ID"
 431 |                 required
 432 |                 value={field.state.value}
 433 |               />
 434 |               {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (

 436 |                   {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 437 |                 </p>
 438 |               )}
 439 |             </div>
 440 |           )}
 441 |         </form.Field>
 442 |       )}
 443 | 
 444 |       <form.Field name="scheduledAt">
 445 |         {(field) => (
 446 |           <div className="grid gap-2">
 447 |             <Label htmlFor={field.name}>Scheduled At</Label>
 448 |             <Input
 449 |               aria-invalid={field.state.meta.errors.length > 0}
 450 |               id={field.name}
 451 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 452 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 453 |               required
 454 |               type="datetime-local"
 455 |               value={field.state.value}
 456 |             />
 457 |             {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (

 460 |               </p>
 461 |             )}
 462 |           </div>
 463 |         )}
 464 |       </form.Field>
 465 | 
 466 |       <form.Field name="durationMinutes">
 467 |         {(field) => (
 468 |           <div className="grid gap-2">
 469 |             <Label htmlFor={field.name}>Duration (minutes)</Label>
 470 |             <Input
 471 |               aria-invalid={field.state.meta.errors.length > 0}
 472 |               id={field.name}
 473 |               max={240}
 474 |               min={5}
 475 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 476 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(Math.round(e.target.valueAsNumber || 0))}
 477 |               required
 478 |               step={5}
 479 |               type="number"
 480 |               value={field.state.value}
 481 |             />
 482 |             {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (
 483 |               <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">

 485 |               </p>
 486 |             )}
 487 |           </div>
 488 |         )}
 489 |       </form.Field>
 490 | 
 491 |       <form.Field name="reason">
 492 |         {(field) => (
 493 |           <div className="grid gap-2">
 494 |             <Label htmlFor={field.name}>
 495 |               Reason <span className="font-normal">(optional)</span>
 496 |             </Label>
 497 |             <Input
 498 |               id={field.name}
 499 |               maxLength={1000}
 500 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 501 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 502 |               placeholder="Follow-up, vaccination, growth check…"
 503 |               value={field.state.value}
 504 |             />
 505 |             {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (

 507 |                 {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 508 |               </p>
 509 |             )}
 510 |           </div>
 511 |         )}
 512 |       </form.Field>

 524 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}

 620 | import {Textarea} from "@/components/ui/textarea";

 624 | 
 625 | import {
 626 |     appointmentByIdQuery,
 627 |     useCreateAppointmentMutation,
 628 |     useUpdateAppointmentMutation,
 629 | } from "../queries";
 630 | import {PatientSearchResult} from "../types";
 631 | import {AppointmentStatusBadge} from "./AppointmentStatusBadge";
 632 | 
 633 | // ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 634 | 
 635 | interface AppointmentSheetProps {
 636 |   open: boolean;
 637 |   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
 638 |   appointmentId?: string;
 639 |   defaultPatientId?: string;
 640 |   clinicId: string;
 641 |   onSaved?: () => void;
 642 |   onClosed?: () => void;
 643 | }
 644 | 
 645 | function formErrorMessage(err: unknown): string | null {
 646 |   if (!err) return null;
 647 |   if (typeof err === "string") return err;
 648 |   if (typeof err === "object" && "form" in err) {
 649 |     const f = (err as { form: unknown }).form;
 650 |     if (typeof f === "string") return f;
 651 |   }
 652 |   if (typeof err === "object" && "message" in err) {
 653 |     const m = (err as { message: unknown }).message;
 654 |     if (typeof m === "string") return m;
 655 |   }
 656 |   return null;
 657 | }
 658 | 
 659 | function ageLabel(dateOfBirth: string | null | undefined): string {
 660 |   if (!dateOfBirth) return "Unknown";
 661 |   const birth = new Date(dateOfBirth);
 662 |   if (Number.isNaN(birth.getTime())) return "Unknown";
 663 | 
 664 |   const today = new Date();
 665 |   let ageYears = today.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear();
 666 |   const hadBirthday =
 667 |     today.getMonth() > birth.getMonth() ||
 668 |     (today.getMonth() === birth.getMonth() && today.getDate() >= birth.getDate());
 669 |   if (!hadBirthday) ageYears -= 1;
 670 |   if (ageYears > 0) return `${ageYears}y`;
 671 | 
 672 |   const diffMonths =
 673 |     (today.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear()) * 12 +
 674 |     (today.getMonth() - birth.getMonth()) -
 675 |     (today.getDate() < birth.getDate() ? 1 : 0);
 676 |   if (diffMonths > 0) return `${diffMonths}mo`;
 677 | 
 678 |   const diffDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((today.getTime() - birth.getTime()) / 86400000));
 679 |   return `${diffDays}d`;
 680 | }
 681 | 
 682 | // ── Patient preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
 683 | 
 684 | function PatientPreview({ patientId }: { patientId: string }) {
 685 |   const q = useQuery(getPatientQueryOptions(patientId));
 686 | 
 687 |   if (q.isPending) {
 688 |     return (
 689 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
 690 |         <Spinner />
 691 |       </div>
 692 |     );
 693 |   }
 694 |   if (q.isError) {
 695 |     return (
 696 |       <div className="text-destructive rounded-lg border border-dashed p-3 text-sm">
 697 |         {q.error instanceof Error ? q.error.message : "Could not load patient."}
 698 |       </div>
 699 |     );
 700 |   }
 701 |   if (!q.data) {
 702 |     return <p className="text-sm">Patient not found (may have been deleted).</p>;

 744 | // ── Patient search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 745 | 
 746 | interface PatientSearchProps {
 747 |   clinicId: string;
 748 |   onSelect: (patient: PatientSearchResult) => void;
 749 |   onClear?: () => void;
 750 | }
 751 | 
 752 | function PatientSearch({ clinicId, onSelect, onClear }: PatientSearchProps) {
 753 |   const [q, setQ] = React.useState("");
 754 |   const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
 755 |   const wrapperRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 756 | 
 757 |   React.useEffect(() => {
 758 |     if (!open) return;
 759 |     const handler = (event: PointerEvent) => {
 760 |       if (!wrapperRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
 761 |     };
 762 |     document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handler);
 763 |     return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handler);
 764 |   }, [open]);
 765 | 
 766 |   const searchQuery = useQuery(searchPatientsQuery(clinicId, q));
 767 |   const results = (searchQuery.data ?? []) as PatientSearchResult[];
 768 |   const showDropdown = open && q.trim().length >= 2;
 769 | 
 770 |   const pick = (patient: PatientSearchResult) => {
 771 |     onSelect(patient);
 772 |     setQ(`${patient.firstName} ${patient.lastName}`);
 773 |     setOpen(false);
 774 |   };
 775 | 
 776 |   const clear = () => {
 777 |     setQ("");
 778 |     onClear?.();
 779 |   };
 780 | 
 781 |   return (
 782 |     <div className="relative" ref={wrapperRef}>
 783 |       <div className="relative">
 784 |         <SearchIcon className="absolute top-1/2 left-0 size-3.5 -translate-y-1/2" />
 785 |         <Input
 786 |           aria-expanded={showDropdown}
 787 |           aria-haspopup="listbox"
 788 |           aria-label="Search patient"
 789 |           onChange={(e) => {
 790 |             setQ(e.target.value);
 791 |             setOpen(true);
 792 |           }}
 793 |           onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
 794 |           placeholder="Search patient by name or MRN…"
 795 |           value={q}
 796 |         />
 797 |         {q && (
 798 |           <button
 799 |             aria-label="Clear patient"
 800 |             className="hover:text-foreground absolute top-1/2 right-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1"
 801 |             onClick={clear}
 802 |             type="button"
 803 |           >
 804 |             <XIcon className="size-3.5" />
 805 |           </button>
 806 |         )}
 807 |       </div>
 808 | 
 809 |       {showDropdown && (
 810 |         <div
 811 |           className="bg-popover ring-foreground/10 absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-lg ring-1"
 812 |           role="listbox"
 813 |         >
 814 |           {searchQuery.isPending ? (
 815 |             <div className="px-3 py-2 text-sm">Searching…</div>
 816 |           ) : searchQuery.isError ? (
 817 |             <div className="text-destructive px-3 py-2 text-sm">
 818 |               {searchQuery.error instanceof Error ? searchQuery.error.message : "Search failed."}
 819 |             </div>
 820 |           ) : results.length === 0 ? (
 821 |             <div className="px-3 py-2 text-sm">No patients match.</div>
 822 |           ) : (
 823 |             results.map((p) => (
 824 |               <button
 825 |                 className="hover:bg-muted flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors"
 826 |                 key={p.id}
 827 |                 onClick={() => pick(p)}
 828 |                 role="option"
 829 |                 type="button"
 830 |               >
 831 |                 <Avatar size="sm">
 832 |                   <AvatarFallback>
 833 |                     {p.firstName[0]}
 834 |                     {p.lastName[0]}
 835 |                   </AvatarFallback>
 836 |                 </Avatar>
 837 |                 <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
 838 |                   <span className="truncate font-medium">
 839 |                     {p.firstName} {p.lastName}
 840 |                   </span>
 841 |                   <span className="font-mono text-xs">
 842 |                     MRN {p.mrn} · {ageLabel(p.dateOfBirth)}
 843 |                   </span>
 844 |                 </div>
 845 |               </button>
 846 |             ))
 847 |           )}
 848 |         </div>
 849 |       )}
 850 |     </div>
 851 |   );
 852 | }

 854 | // ── Duration stepper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 855 | 
 856 | const DURATION_STEPS = [10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90] as const;
 857 | 
 858 | function DurationStepper({ value, onChange }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void }) {
 859 |   const currentIdx = DURATION_STEPS.indexOf(value as (typeof DURATION_STEPS)[number]);
 860 |   const dec = () => {
 861 |     if (currentIdx > 0) onChange(DURATION_STEPS[currentIdx - 1]);
 862 |   };
 863 |   const inc = () => {
 864 |     if (currentIdx >= 0 && currentIdx < DURATION_STEPS.length - 1) {
 865 |       onChange(DURATION_STEPS[currentIdx + 1]);
 866 |     } else if (currentIdx === -1) {
 867 |       onChange(DURATION_STEPS[0]);
 868 |     }
 869 |   };
 870 | 
 871 |   return (
 872 |     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 873 |       <button
 874 |         aria-label="Decrease duration"
 875 |         className="border-border hover:bg-muted flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border text-sm transition-colors disabled:opacity-30"
 876 |         disabled={currentIdx <= 0}
 877 |         onClick={dec}
 878 |         type="button"
 879 |       >
 880 |         −
 881 |       </button>
 882 |       <span className="min-w-[4.5rem] text-center font-mono text-sm tabular-nums">{value} min</span>
 883 |       <button
 884 |         aria-label="Increase duration"
 885 |         className="border-border hover:bg-muted flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border text-sm transition-colors disabled:opacity-30"
 886 |         disabled={currentIdx >= DURATION_STEPS.length - 1}
 887 |         onClick={inc}
 888 |         type="button"
 889 |       >
 890 |         +
 891 |       </button>
 892 |     </div>
 893 |   );
 894 | }

1074 |                 <form.Field name="scheduledAt">

2655 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
2656 | import { cn } from "cn";

2659 | import { addDays, formatDayHeading, formatShortDay, startOfDay } from "@/lib/dates";
2660 | 
2661 | // ── read: query factory ────────────────────────────────────────────────
2662 | import { appointmentsInRangeQuery } from "../queries";
2663 | 
2664 | // ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
2665 | const MAX_DOTS = 8;
2666 | 
2667 | // ── Day cell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
2668 | 
2669 | function DayCell({
2670 |   date,
2671 |   count,
2672 |   isToday,
2673 |   selected,
2674 |   onSelect,
2675 | }: {
2676 |   date: Date;
2677 |   count: number;
2678 |   isToday: boolean;
2679 |   selected: boolean;
2680 |   onSelect: (d: Date) => void;
2681 | }) {
2682 |   const dots = Math.min(count, MAX_DOTS);
2683 |   const overflow = count > MAX_DOTS ? count - MAX_DOTS : 0;
2684 |   const pct = Math.min(count / 12, 1);
2685 |   const isWeekend = date.getDay() === 0 || date.getDay() === 6;
2686 | 
2687 |   return (
2688 |     <button
2689 |       aria-label={`${formatDayHeading(date)}, ${count} appointment${count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
2690 |       aria-pressed={selected}
2691 |       className={cn(
2692 |         "flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl  py-2.5 transition-colors",
2693 |         isWeekend && "bg-muted/40",
2694 |         selected && "bg-primary/10 ring-primary/20 ring-1",
2695 |         !selected && !isWeekend && "hover:bg-muted/40",
2696 |         isToday && !selected && "ring-primary/30 ring-1",
2697 |       )}
2698 |       onClick={() => onSelect(date)}
2699 |       type="button"
2700 |     >
2701 |       <span
2702 |         className={cn(
2703 |           "text-[0.6rem] font-medium tracking-wide uppercase",
2704 |           isToday ? "text-primary" : "",
2705 |         )}
2706 |       >
2707 |         {formatShortDay(date)}
2708 |       </span>
2709 | 
2710 |       <span
2711 |         className={cn(
2712 |           "flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums",
2713 |           isToday
2714 |             ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
2715 |             : selected
2716 |               ? "text-primary"
2717 |               : "text-foreground",
2718 |         )}
2719 |       >
2720 |         {date.getDate()}
2721 |       </span>
2722 | 
2723 |       <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-[2px]">
2724 |         {Array.from({ length: dots }, (_, i) => (
2725 |           <span className="bg-primary/60 size-[4px] rounded-full" key={i} />
2726 |         ))}
2727 |         {overflow > 0 && <span className=" text-[0.5rem]">+{overflow}</span>}
2728 |       </div>
2729 | 
2730 |       <div aria-hidden="true" className="bg-muted h-[3px] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full">
2731 |         <div
2732 |           className={cn(
2733 |             "h-full rounded-full transition-all",
2734 |             pct > 0.8 ? "bg-destructive" : pct > 0.5 ? "bg-warning" : "bg-primary/50",
2735 |           )}
2736 |           style={{ width: `${Math.round(pct * 100)}%` }}
2737 |         />
2738 |       </div>
2739 |     </button>
2740 |   );
2741 | }
2742 | 
2743 | // ── Main component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
2744 | 
2745 | interface WeekStripProps {
2746 |   clinicId: string;
2747 |   selectedDate?: Date;
2748 |   onSelectDate?: (d: Date) => void;
2749 | }
2750 | 
2751 | export function WeekStrip({ clinicId, selectedDate, onSelectDate }: WeekStripProps) {
2752 |   const today = startOfDay(new Date());
2753 | 
2754 |   // Week starting Monday
2755 |   const weekStart = React.useMemo(() => {
2756 |     const d = startOfDay(new Date());
2757 |     const day = d.getDay();
2758 |     const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday
2759 |     d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
2760 |     return d;
2761 |   }, []);
2762 | 
2763 |   const weekEnd = addDays(weekStart, 7);
2764 | 
2765 |   // ── read via factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────
2766 |   const rangeQuery = useQuery(
2767 |     appointmentsInRangeQuery(clinicId, weekStart.toISOString(), weekEnd.toISOString()),
2768 |   );
2769 | 
2770 |   const countByDay = React.useMemo(() => {
2771 |     const map: Record<string, number> = {};
2772 |     for (const appt of rangeQuery.data ?? []) {
2773 |       const d = new Date(appt.scheduledAt);
2774 |       const key = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
2775 |       map[key] = (map[key] ?? 0) + 1;
2776 |     }
2777 |     return map;
2778 |   }, [rangeQuery.data]);
2779 | 
2780 |   const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekStart, i));
2781 | 
2782 |   const dateKey = (d: Date) =>
2783 |     `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
2784 | 
2785 |   const selKey = selectedDate ? dateKey(selectedDate) : null;
2786 | 
2787 |   return (
2788 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
2789 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
2790 |         <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">This Week</h2>
2791 |         <span className=" text-xs">
2792 |           {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
2793 |             month: "short",
2794 |             day: "numeric",
2795 |           }).format(weekStart)}
2796 |           {" – "}
2797 |           {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
2798 |             month: "short",
2799 |             day: "numeric",
2800 |           }).format(addDays(weekStart, 6))}
2801 |         </span>
2802 |       </div>
2803 |       <div className="flex gap-0.5">
2804 |         {days.map((day) => (
2805 |           <DayCell
2806 |             count={countByDay[dateKey(day)] ?? 0}
2807 |             date={day}
2808 |             isToday={dateKey(day) === dateKey(today)}
2809 |             key={dateKey(day)}
2810 |             onSelect={(d) => onSelectDate?.(d)}
2811 |             selected={selKey === dateKey(day)}
2812 |           />
2813 |         ))}
2814 |       </div>
2815 |     </div>
2816 |   );
2817 | }

3096 | export function fieldErrorMessage(err: unknown): string | undefined {
3097 |   if (!err) return undefined;
3098 |   if (typeof err === "string") return err;
3099 |   if (typeof err === "object" && "message" in err) {

3272 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3273 | // Invalidation helper
3274 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3275 | //
3276 | // Every mutation hook below calls this. The set of caches touched by an
3277 | // appointment write is the same for create, update, and every status
3278 | // transition, so centralising the list here prevents the four hooks from
3279 | // drifting apart.
3280 | 
3281 | interface AppointmentWriteResult {
3282 |   id: string;
3283 |   clinicId: string;
3284 |   patientId: string;
3285 | }
3286 | 
3287 | function invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(
3288 |   queryClient: {
3289 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
3290 |   },
3291 |   row: AppointmentWriteResult,
3292 | ): Promise<unknown> {
3293 |   return Promise.all([
3294 |     // Every cached view of the clinic's appointments: today, list, all
3295 |     // date ranges, status counts.
3296 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
3297 |       queryKey: appointmentKeys.clinic(row.clinicId),
3298 |     }),
3299 |     // The appointment's own detail entry.
3300 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
3301 |       queryKey: appointmentKeys.detail(row.id),
3302 |     }),
3303 |     // The patient's appointment history (used by the patient detail
3304 |     // page and by the safety rail in the prescription composer).
3305 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
3306 |       queryKey: ["appointments", "patient", row.patientId],
3307 |     }),
3308 |     // The patient's total appointment count.
3309 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
3310 |       queryKey: appointmentKeys.patientCount(row.patientId),
3311 |     }),
3312 |   ]);
3313 | }

3315 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3316 | // Mutation hooks
3317 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3318 | 
3319 | /**
3320 |  * Create a new appointment.
3321 |  *
3322 |  * Invalidates the clinic's appointment caches (today, list, all ranges,
3323 |  * counts) and the patient's appointment history. Returns the created row
3324 |  * so callers can navigate to `/app/appointments/$appointmentId` or use
3325 |  * `row.id` in a callback.
3326 |  */
3327 | export function useCreateAppointmentMutation() {
3328 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
3329 |   const createAppointment = useServerFn(createAppointmentFn);
3330 | 
3331 |   return useMutation({
3332 |     mutationFn: createAppointment,
3333 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
3334 |       if (!row) return;
3335 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
3336 |     },
3337 |   });
3338 | }
3339 | 
3340 | /**
3341 |  * Update an existing appointment (time, duration, reason, notes, doctor).
3342 |  *
3343 |  * Same invalidation set as create — the update could change the
3344 |  * appointment's slot on any date, so every clinic range cache must refresh.
3345 |  */
3346 | export function useUpdateAppointmentMutation() {
3347 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
3348 |   const updateAppointment = useServerFn(updateAppointmentFn);
3349 | 
3350 |   return useMutation({
3351 |     mutationFn: updateAppointment,
3352 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
3353 |       if (!row) return;
3354 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
3355 |     },
3356 |   });
3357 | }
3358 | 
3359 | /**
3360 |  * Mark an appointment as completed.
3361 |  *
3362 |  * The status field changed, so both the row itself and the clinic's
3363 |  * status-count aggregates need to refresh.
3364 |  */
3365 | export function useCompleteAppointmentMutation() {
3366 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
3367 |   const completeAppointment = useServerFn(completeAppointmentFn);
3368 | 
3369 |   return useMutation({
3370 |     mutationFn: completeAppointment,
3371 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
3372 |       if (!row) return;
3373 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
3374 |     },
3375 |   });
3376 | }
3377 | 
3378 | /**
3379 |  * Cancel an appointment.
3380 |  *
3381 |  * Same invalidation set as complete — only the status value differs.
3382 |  */
3383 | export function useCancelAppointmentMutation() {
3384 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
3385 |   const cancelAppointment = useServerFn(cancelAppointmentFn);
3386 | 
3387 |   return useMutation({
3388 |     mutationFn: cancelAppointment,
3389 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
3390 |       if (!row) return;
3391 |       void invalidateAfterAppointmentWrite(queryClient, row);
3392 |     },
3393 |   });
3394 | }

3396 | /**

3412 | /**
3413 |  * Delete an appointment.
3414 |  *
3415 |  * The delete endpoint returns `{ ok: true }` rather than the deleted row,
3416 |  * so we can't derive `clinicId`/`patientId` from the result. The caller
3417 |  * must pass them in `onSuccess`'s second argument (the mutation's
3418 |  * variables) — or, more ergonomically, wrap `mutate` in a closure that
3419 |  * captures them.
3420 |  *
3421 |  * Typical usage:
3422 |  *
3423 |  *     const deleteMutation = useDeleteAppointmentMutation();
3424 |  *     deleteMutation.mutate(

3426 |  *       {
3427 |  *         onSuccess: () => {

3429 |  *           // tree; nothing else to do.
3430 |  *         }
3431 |  *       }
3432 |  *     );

3434 | export function useDeleteAppointmentMutation() {

3437 |

3449 |       // prefix. To be precise about clinic/patient, the caller

3451 |     },
3452 |   });
3453 | }

3716 |             <Button disabled={!input.trim() || isLoading} type="submit">

3721 |       </CardContent>

3726 | function AssistantMessage({ message }: { message: UIMessage }) {

3729 |     .map((part) => (part.type === "text" ? part.content : ""))

3731 | 
3732 |   if (!text.trim()) return null;

3737 |         {message.role === "user" ? "You" : "Assistant"}
3738 |       </p>
3739 |       <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">{text}</p>
3740 |     </div>
3741 |   );

4093 | 
4094 | ```ts
4095 | import type { ModelMessage } from "@tanstack/ai";
4096 | 
4097 | import { z } from "zod";
4098 | 
4099 | export const MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES = 40;
4100 | export const MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_CHARS = 4_000;
4101 | export const MAX_ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_CHARS = 20_000;
4102 | 
4103 | const medicationAdvicePatterns = [
4104 |   /\b(?:recommend|calculate|suggest|prescribe)\b.{0,50}\b(?:dose|dosage|medication|drug)\b/i,
4105 |   /\b(?:dose|dosage)\b.{0,50}\b(?:should|recommend|calculate|give|use|take)\b/i,
4106 |   /\bhow much\b.{0,50}\b(?:medicine|medication|drug|mg|ml)\b/i,
4107 |   /\b(?:mg|mcg|μg|ml)\s*\/\s*kg\b/i,
4108 | ];
4109 | 
4110 | const messageSchema = z.object({
4111 |   id: z.string().max(128),
4112 |   role: z.enum(["user", "assistant", "tool"]),
4113 |   parts: z.array(z.unknown()).max(24).optional(),
4114 |   content: z.union([z.string().max(16_000), z.array(z.unknown()).max(24)]).optional(),
4115 | });
4116 | 
4117 | export const assistantRequestSchema = z
4118 |   .object({
4119 |     messages: z.array(messageSchema).min(1).max(MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES),
4120 |     threadId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(),
4121 |     runId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(),
4122 |     patientId: z.uuid().optional(),
4123 |     forwardedProps: z
4124 |       .object({
4125 |         patientId: z.uuid().optional(),
4126 |       })
4127 |       .optional(),
4128 |   })
4129 |   .superRefine((request, context) => {
4130 |     if (
4131 |       request.patientId &&
4132 |       request.forwardedProps?.patientId &&
4133 |       request.patientId !== request.forwardedProps.patientId
4134 |     ) {
4135 |       context.addIssue({
4136 |         code: "custom",
4137 |         message: "Conflicting patient identifiers",
4138 |         path: ["patientId"],
4139 |       });
4140 |     }
4141 | 
4142 |     const lastMessage = request.messages.at(-1);
4143 |     if (lastMessage?.role !== "user" || !extractText(lastMessage).trim()) {
4144 |       context.addIssue({
4145 |         code: "custom",
4146 |         message: "The last assistant message must be a non-empty user message",
4147 |         path: ["messages"],
4148 |       });
4149 |     }
4150 | 
4151 |     let totalCharacters = 0;
4152 |     for (const [index, message] of request.messages.entries()) {
4153 |       const messageCharacters = extractText(message).length;
4154 |       if (messageCharacters > MAX_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_CHARS) {
4155 |         context.addIssue({
4156 |           code: "custom",
4157 |           message: "Message exceeds the maximum length",
4158 |           path: ["messages", index],
4159 |         });
4160 |       }
4161 |       totalCharacters += messageCharacters;
4162 |     }
4163 | 
4164 |     if (totalCharacters > MAX_ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_CHARS) {
4165 |       context.addIssue({
4166 |         code: "custom",
4167 |         message: "Conversation exceeds the maximum context length",
4168 |         path: ["messages"],
4169 |       });
4170 |     }
4171 |   });
4172 | 
4173 | type ValidatedMessage = z.infer<typeof messageSchema>;
4174 | 
4175 | function extractText(message: ValidatedMessage): string {
4176 |   if (message.role === "tool") return "";
4177 | 
4178 |   const contents = message.parts ?? (Array.isArray(message.content) ? message.content : []);
4179 |   const textFromParts = contents
4180 |     .flatMap((part) => {
4181 |       if (typeof part !== "object" || part === null || !("type" in part) || part.type !== "text") {
4182 |         return [];
4183 |       }
4184 | 
4185 |       if ("content" in part && typeof part.content === "string") return [part.content];
4186 |       if ("text" in part && typeof part.text === "string") return [part.text];
4187 |       return [];
4188 |     })
4189 |     .join("");
4190 | 
4191 |   if (message.parts || Array.isArray(message.content)) return textFromParts;
4192 |   return typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : "";
4193 | }
4194 | 
4195 | export function toAssistantModelMessages(messages: ValidatedMessage[]): ModelMessage[] {
4196 |   return messages.flatMap((message) => {
4197 |     const content = extractText(message);
4198 |     return content.trim() ? [{ role: message.role, content }] : [];
4199 |   });
4200 | }
4201 | 
4202 | export function requestsMedicationAdvice(text: string): boolean {
4203 |   return medicationAdvicePatterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text));
4204 | }
4205 |

4207 | `features/clinics/clinic-store.ts`:
4208 | 
4209 | ```ts
4210 | // src/stores/clinic-store.ts
4211 | //
4212 | // The active clinic — a client-side mirror of the fields on the Better Auth
4213 | // session that every clinic-scoped surface needs.
4214 | //
4215 | // Design notes
4216 | // ------------
4217 | //
4218 | // 1. SSR safety
4219 | //    A module-level `createStore(...)` is a singleton per process. Under
4220 | //    TanStack Start that process serves *every* request — so a server-side
4221 | //    `setActiveClinic(acmeClinic)` on request A would leak into request B's
4222 | //    server-render of `clinicStore.state`. We therefore construct the store
4223 | //    through `getClinicStore()`, which returns a fresh store on the server
4224 | //    and a cached singleton on the client. This mirrors the
4225 | //    `getQueryClient()` pattern from `integrations/tanstack-query/query-client`.
4226 | //
4227 | // 2. Idempotency
4228 | //    `ClinicSessionSync` runs inside a `useEffect` whose deps include every
4229 | //    session field it observes. Each `useAuth()` refresh — profile edit,
4230 | //    `refetch()`, cross-tab invalidate — re-runs it with a *new* object
4231 | //    literal for the same clinic. Without a structural compare,
4232 | //    `setActiveClinic` would push a fresh reference into the store on every
4233 | //    refresh, notifying every subscriber and invalidating every
4234 | //    clinic-scoped query downstream. `isSameClinic` short-circuits that.
4235 | //
4236 | // 3. Null = "no clinic"
4237 | //    A signed-out user (or a user whose account isn't yet linked to a
4238 | //    clinic) legitimately has no active clinic. `null` is the canonical
4239 | //    representation, never `{}`. Consumers should branch on `active === null`
4240 | //    rather than on any field being empty.
4241 | //
4242 | // 4. No mutation of the input
4243 | //    `setActiveClinic` copies the incoming object before storing it, so a
4244 | //    caller that later mutates its own `clinic` variable can't corrupt the
4245 | //    store. Cheap insurance; a `Clinic` object is 5 primitives.
4246 | 
4247 | import { createStore, useSelector } from "@tanstack/react-store";
4248 | 
4249 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4250 | // Types
4251 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4252 | 
4253 | /**
4254 |  * The subset of clinic identity that most surfaces need. Intentionally
4255 |  * smaller than `Clinic` in `db/schema.ts` — the store is a *session*
4256 |  * mirror, not a cache of the full clinic row. If a surface needs `createdAt`,
4257 |  * `notes`, etc., it fetches the row via React Query (`clinicByIdQuery`).
4258 |  */
4259 | export interface ActiveClinic {
4260 |   /** The id used to scope clinic data. Callers are responsible for supplying a resolved value. */
4261 |   id: string;
4262 |   name: string;
4263 |   email: string | null;
4264 |   // phone: string | null;

4271 |    *

4273 |    * force every consumer to handle a third state. Use `useHasActiveClinic()`

4279 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4280 | // Structural equality
4281 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4282 | 
4283 | /**
4284 |  * True iff `a` and `b` describe the same clinic.
4285 |  *
4286 |  * Hand-written (rather than a generic deep-equal) because the shape is tiny
4287 |  * and fixed. If `ActiveClinic` grows a field, TypeScript won't force you to
4288 |  * update this — so keep the two in sync manually. There's a test below that
4289 |  * guards against this.
4290 |  */
4291 | function isSameClinic(a: ActiveClinic | null, b: ActiveClinic | null): boolean {
4292 |   if (a === b) return true; // covers both null, same reference
4293 |   if (a === null || b === null) return false;
4294 |   return (
4295 |     a.id === b.id && a.name === b.name && a.email === b.email // a.phone === b.phone &&
4296 |     // a.address === b.address
4297 |   );

4300 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4301 | // Store factory — SSR-safe
4302 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4303 | 
4304 | const INITIAL_STATE: ClinicState = { active: null };
4305 | 
4306 | function createClinicStore() {
4307 |   return createStore<ClinicState>(INITIAL_STATE);
4308 | }
4309 | 
4310 | export type ClinicStore = ReturnType<typeof createClinicStore>;
4311 | 
4312 | let clientStore: ClinicStore | undefined;
4313 | 
4314 | /**
4315 |  * Return the clinic store for the current environment.
4316 |  *
4317 |  * - **Browser:** a module-level singleton. Every `useClinicStore()` call
4318 |  *   returns the same instance, so all components share state.
4319 |  * - **Server:** a fresh store per call. Because TanStack Start renders each
4320 |  *   request in its own call, no state can leak between requests. (If you
4321 |  *   ever render two sibling components that both call `getClinicStore()`
4322 |  *   inside *one* request, they'll each get a fresh store — which is why
4323 |  *   server-side components must read clinic data from React Query, not from
4324 |  *   this store. That's the same rule as `getQueryClient()`.)
4325 |  */
4326 | export function getClinicStore(): ClinicStore {
4327 |   if (typeof window === "undefined") {
4328 |     return createClinicStore();
4329 |   }
4330 |   clientStore ??= createClinicStore();
4331 |   return clientStore;
4332 | }
4333 | 
4334 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4335 | // Actions
4336 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4337 | 
4338 | /**
4339 |  * The action surface consumed by `ClinicSessionSync` and any future caller
4340 |  * that wants to change the active clinic (e.g. an admin "switch clinic"
4341 |  * picker).
4342 |  *
4343 |  * Writes go through `getClinicStore()` so the same call works on the client
4344 |  * (mutating the singleton) and on the server (mutating a per-render store —
4345 |  * which is a no-op for output, but keeps the call sites uniform).
4346 |  */
4347 | export const clinicActions = {
4348 |   /**
4349 |    * Set or clear the active clinic.
4350 |    *
4351 |    * Idempotent: if the incoming clinic is structurally equal to the current
4352 |    * one, the store is left untouched and no subscribers are notified. This
4353 |    * is the property `ClinicSessionSync` relies on — it can call this on every
4354 |    * `useAuth()` refresh without causing a downstream refetch storm.
4355 |    */
4356 |   setActiveClinic(next: ActiveClinic | null): void {
4357 |     const store = getClinicStore();
4358 |     store.setState((prev) => {
4359 |       if (isSameClinic(prev.active, next)) return prev;
4360 |       return {
4361 |         ...prev,
4362 |         // Copy so a caller that later mutates its own object can't corrupt
4363 |         // the store. Clone the primitives; no deep clone needed.
4364 |         active: next === null ? null : { ...next },
4365 |       };
4366 |     });
4367 |   },
4368 | 
4369 |   /** Clear the active clinic. Equivalent to `setActiveClinic(null)`. */
4370 |   clearActiveClinic(): void {
4371 |     clinicActions.setActiveClinic(null);
4372 |   },
4373 | };
4374 | 
4375 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4376 | // Selectors / hooks
4377 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4378 | 
4379 | /**
4380 |  * Read the whole clinic state.
4381 |  *
4382 |  * Prefer the narrower `useActiveClinic()` when you only need the clinic —
4383 |  * selecting the whole state object re-renders on any field change, which
4384 |  * today is only `active`, but will stop being true the moment we add a
4385 |  * second slice (e.g. `switching: boolean`).
4386 |  */
4387 | export function useClinicStore(): ClinicState {
4388 |   return useSelector(getClinicStore(), (s) => s);
4389 | }
4390 | 
4391 | /**
4392 |  * The active clinic, or `null` when signed out / not linked.
4393 |  *
4394 |  * This is the hook 95% of components want. The selector returns
4395 |  * `s.active` directly, so a component using it re-renders only when the
4396 |  * clinic identity changes — not on unrelated store writes.
4397 |  */
4398 | export function useActiveClinic(): ActiveClinic | null {

4400 | }
4401 | 
4402 | /**
4403 |  * Boolean convenience for gating UI that requires a clinic

4406 | export function useHasActiveClinic(): boolean {

4409 | 
4410 | /**

4427 | }

4433 | /**

4439 |  * server-side code should resolve the clinic from the session/DB, not from
4440 |  * a client store.
4441 |  */
4442 | export function getActiveClinicSnapshot(): ActiveClinic | null {
4443 |   return getClinicStore().state.active;
4444 | }

4987 | // src/features/clinics/queries.ts
4988 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
4989 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
4990 | 
4991 | import {
4992 |   createClinicFn,
4993 |   fetchClinicById,
4994 |   fetchClinicCount,
4995 |   fetchClinics,
4996 |   fetchClinicWithRoster,
4997 |   fetchClinicWithStats,
4998 |   updateClinicFn,
4999 | } from "./functions";
5000 | 
5001 | /**
5002 |  * Create a new clinic.
5003 |  *
5004 |  * Invalidates the clinic list and count. The new clinic has no cached
5005 |  * `detail` or `stats` yet, so those don't need invalidation — the first
5006 |  * visit to `$clinicId` fetches fresh.
5007 |  *
5008 |  * Returns the created row so the caller can navigate to
5009 |  * `/app/clinics/$clinicId` or use `row.id` in a callback.
5010 |  */
5011 | export function useCreateClinicMutation() {
5012 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
5013 |   const createClinic = useServerFn(createClinicFn);
5014 | 
5015 |   return useMutation({
5016 |     mutationFn: createClinic,
5017 |     onSuccess: () => {
5018 |       void Promise.all([
5019 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.list() }),
5020 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.count() }),
5021 |       ]);
5022 |     },
5023 |   });
5024 | }
5025 | const STALE_TIMES = {
5026 |   /** Single clinic detail. */
5027 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
5028 |   /** Clinic list — changes only when admins add/remove clinics. */
5029 |   LIST: 120_000,
5030 |   /** Clinic with stats or roster — aggregations. */
5031 |   STATS: 60_000,
5032 |   /** Total clinic count. */
5033 |   COUNT: 120_000,
5034 | } as const;
5035 | 
5036 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
5037 | // Query key factory
5038 | //
5039 | // Every key starts with "clinics". Invalidate the whole tree with
5040 | // `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.all() })`, or a
5041 | // per-clinic subtree with `clinicKeys.detail(clinicId)` (which drops
5042 | // stats and roster at once).
5043 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
5044 | 
5045 | export const clinicKeys = {
5046 |   all: () => ["clinics"] as const,
5047 | 
5048 |   /** The full list of clinics (admin only). */
5049 |   list: () => ["clinics", "list"] as const,
5050 | 
5051 |   /** Total clinic count (admin only). */
5052 |   count: () => ["clinics", "count"] as const,
5053 | 
5054 |   /**
5055 |    * Per-clinic subtree. Invalidating this drops `stats` and `roster`
5056 |    * automatically, because they are nested under `detail`.
5057 |    */
5058 |   detail: (clinicId: string) => ["clinics", "detail", clinicId] as const,
5059 | 
5060 |   /** One clinic with aggregated stats (patient count, upcoming appointments). */
5061 |   stats: (clinicId: string) => ["clinics", "detail", clinicId, "stats"] as const,
5062 | 
5063 |   /** One clinic with its full staff roster. */
5064 |   roster: (clinicId: string) => ["clinics", "detail", clinicId, "roster"] as const,
5065 | } as const;
5066 | 
5067 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
5068 | // Query options
5069 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
5070 | 
5071 | export function clinicsQuery() {
5072 |   return queryOptions({
5073 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.list(),
5074 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinics(),
5075 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.LIST,
5076 |   });
5077 | }
5078 | 
5079 | export function clinicByIdQuery(clinicId: string) {
5080 |   return queryOptions({
5081 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.detail(clinicId),
5082 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicById({ data: { clinicId } }),
5083 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
5084 |   });
5085 | }
5086 | 
5087 | export function clinicWithStatsQuery(clinicId: string) {
5088 |   return queryOptions({
5089 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.stats(clinicId),
5090 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicWithStats({ data: { clinicId } }),
5091 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.STATS,
5092 |   });
5093 | }
5094 | 
5095 | export function clinicWithRosterQuery(clinicId: string) {
5096 |   return queryOptions({
5097 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.roster(clinicId),
5098 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicWithRoster({ data: { clinicId } }),
5099 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.STATS,
5100 |   });
5101 | }
5102 | 
5103 | export function clinicCountQuery() {
5104 |   return queryOptions({
5105 |     queryKey: clinicKeys.count(),
5106 |     queryFn: () => fetchClinicCount(),
5107 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.COUNT,
5108 |   });
5109 | }
5110 | 
5111 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
5112 | // Invalidation helpers
5113 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
5114 | 
5115 | /**
5116 |  * Call this after a clinic mutation succeeds.
5117 |  *
5118 |  * - **Create** — pass only `clinicId: undefined`; invalidates the list and count.
5119 |  * - **Update** — pass `clinicId`; invalidates the list, count, and the
5120 |  *   clinic's own subtree (`detail` → `stats` + `roster`).
5121 |  * - **Delete** — pass `clinicId`; same as update, plus the deleted clinic's
5122 |  *   subtree is safe to drop even though it 404s on next read.
5123 |  *
5124 |  * The count is invalidated on every mutation because creating or deleting
5125 |  * a clinic changes it. Updates do not — but invalidating an already-fresh
5126 |  * count is cheap, and branching on "was this a create or delete?" here
5127 |  * would push that knowledge into every call site.
5128 |  */
5129 | export function invalidateAfterClinicMutation(
5130 |   queryClient: {
5131 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
5132 |   },
5133 |   args: { clinicId?: string },
5134 | ): Promise<unknown> {
5135 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
5136 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.list() }),
5137 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.count() }),
5138 |   ];
5139 | 
5140 |   if (args.clinicId) {
5141 |     // `detail` is the parent of `stats` and `roster` — one invalidation
5142 |     // drops all three.
5143 |     promises.push(
5144 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
5145 |         queryKey: clinicKeys.detail(args.clinicId),
5146 |       }),
5147 |     );
5148 |   }
5149 | 
5150 |   return Promise.all(promises);
5151 | }
5152 | export function useUpdateClinicMutation() {
5153 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
5154 |   const updateClinic = useServerFn(updateClinicFn);
5155 | 
5156 |   return useMutation({
5157 |     mutationFn: updateClinic,
5158 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
5159 |       if (!row) return;
5160 |       void Promise.all([
5161 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
5162 |           queryKey: clinicKeys.detail(row.id),
5163 |         }),
5164 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: clinicKeys.list() }),
5165 |       ]);
5166 |     },
5167 |   });
5168 | }
5169 |

5639 | /**
5640 |  * 2×2 grid of animated SVG progress rings — one per domain.

5644 | export function DomainRings({ data, className }: DomainRingsProps) {

5912 | // features/development/components/MilestoneTimeline.tsx
5913 | 
5914 | import { AlertTriangle, Check, Circle } from "lucide-react";
5915 | import * as React from "react";
5916 | 
5917 | import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
5918 | 
5919 | import type { PatientMilestone } from "../types";
5920 | 
5921 | import { type MilestoneStatus, milestoneStatus } from "../status";
5922 | import { DOMAIN_META, DOMAIN_ORDER } from "../types";
5923 | 
5924 | export interface MilestoneTimelineProps {
5925 |   milestones: readonly PatientMilestone[];
5926 |   correctedAgeMonths: number;
5927 |   selectedId: string | null;
5928 |   onSelect: (id: string) => void;
5929 | }
5930 | 
5931 | const TICKS = [0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36, 60];
5932 | const TICK_LABELS: Record<number, string> = {
5933 |   0: "Birth",
5934 |   2: "2m",
5935 |   4: "4m",
5936 |   6: "6m",
5937 |   9: "9m",
5938 |   12: "1y",
5939 |   18: "1.5y",
5940 |   24: "2y",
5941 |   36: "3y",
5942 |   60: "5y",
5943 | };
5944 | 
5945 | const LANE_HEIGHT = 64;
5946 | 
5947 | function xPercent(ageMonths: number): number {
5948 |   // Non-linear: more resolution below 24m, compressed to 60m after.
5949 |   if (ageMonths <= 24) return (ageMonths / 24) * 60;
5950 |   return 60 + ((ageMonths - 24) / 36) * 40;
5951 | }
5952 | 
5953 | interface MilestonePoint {
5954 |   id: string;
5955 |   domain: string;
5956 |   label: string;
5957 |   description: string;
5958 |   ageMonths: number;
5959 |   status: MilestoneStatus;
5960 |   achievedDate: string | null;
5961 |   isRedFlagIfMissing: boolean;
5962 | }
5963 | 
5964 | export function MilestoneTimeline({
5965 |   milestones,
5966 |   correctedAgeMonths,
5967 |   selectedId,
5968 |   onSelect,
5969 | }: MilestoneTimelineProps) {
5970 |   const grouped = React.useMemo(() => {
5971 |     const byDomain = new Map<string, MilestonePoint[]>();
5972 |     for (const domain of DOMAIN_ORDER) byDomain.set(domain, []);
5973 |     for (const m of milestones) {
5974 |       byDomain.get(m.domain)?.push({
5975 |         id: m.id,
5976 |         domain: m.domain,
5977 |         label: m.title,
5978 |         description: m.description,
5979 |         ageMonths: m.targetAgeMonths,
5980 |         status: milestoneStatus(m, correctedAgeMonths),
5981 |         achievedDate: m.achievedDate,
5982 |         isRedFlagIfMissing: Boolean(m.isRedFlagIfMissing),
5983 |       });
5984 |     }
5985 |     for (const list of byDomain.values()) {
5986 |       list.sort((a, b) => a.ageMonths - b.ageMonths);
5987 |     }
5988 |     return byDomain;
5989 |   }, [milestones, correctedAgeMonths]);
5990 | 
5991 |   const totalHeight = DOMAIN_ORDER.length * LANE_HEIGHT + 40;
5992 | 
5993 |   return (
5994 |     <div
5995 |       className="border-border/60 bg-card relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border"
5996 |       style={{ height: totalHeight }}
5997 |     >
5998 |       {/* Vertical age ticks */}
5999 |       <div className=" absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-full">
6000 |         {TICKS.map((tick) => (
6001 |           <div
6002 |             className="border-border/40 absolute top-0 bottom-0 border-l"
6003 |             key={tick}
6004 |             style={{ left: `${xPercent(tick)}%` }}
6005 |           >
6006 |             <span className="bg-background absolute top-0 left-1 rounded-br  text-[10px] tabular-nums">
6007 |               {TICK_LABELS[tick]}
6008 |             </span>
6009 |           </div>
6010 |         ))}
6011 |       </div>
6012 | 
6013 |       {/* Age marker (corrected age) */}
6014 |       <div
6015 |         aria-hidden="true"
6016 |         className="bg-foreground/50 pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 w-px"
6017 |         style={{
6018 |           left: `${xPercent(Math.min(correctedAgeMonths, 60))}%`,
6019 |           top: 20,
6020 |         }}
6021 |       >
6022 |         <span className="bg-foreground text-background absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums">
6023 |           {correctedAgeMonths.toFixed(0)}m
6024 |         </span>
6025 |       </div>
6026 | 
6027 |       {/* Domain lanes */}
6028 |       <div className="relative pt-10">
6029 |         {DOMAIN_ORDER.map((domain, laneIndex) => {
6030 |           const meta = DOMAIN_META[domain];
6031 |           const Icon = meta.icon;
6032 |           const points = grouped.get(domain) ?? [];
6033 |           const achieved = points.filter((p) => p.status === "achieved");
6034 |           return (
6035 |             <div
6036 |               className="border-border/20 relative flex items-center border-t"
6037 |               key={domain}
6038 |               style={{ height: LANE_HEIGHT }}
6039 |             >
6040 |               <div className="bg-background sticky left-0 z-10 flex w-32 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 px-2">
6041 |                 <Icon aria-hidden="true" className={cn("size-3.5", meta.text)} />
6042 |                 <span className=" truncate text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">
6043 |                   {meta.shortLabel}
6044 |                 </span>
6045 |               </div>
6046 |               <div className="relative flex-1">
6047 |                 <svg aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full">
6048 |                   {achieved.length >= 2 && (
6049 |                     <polyline
6050 |                       fill="none"
6051 |                       points={achieved
6052 |                         .map((p) => `${xPercent(p.ageMonths)}%,${LANE_HEIGHT / 2}`)
6053 |                         .join(" ")}
6054 |                       stroke={meta.hex}
6055 |                       strokeLinecap="round"
6056 |                       strokeLinejoin="round"
6057 |                       strokeOpacity={0.35}
6058 |                       strokeWidth={1.5}
6059 |                     />
6060 |                   )}
6061 |                 </svg>
6062 |                 {points.map((p) => (
6063 |                   <MilestoneDot
6064 |                     key={p.id}
6065 |                     laneIndex={laneIndex}
6066 |                     onSelect={onSelect}
6067 |                     point={p}
6068 |                     selected={p.id === selectedId}
6069 |                   />
6070 |                 ))}
6071 |               </div>
6072 |             </div>
6073 |           );
6074 |         })}
6075 |       </div>
6076 |     </div>
6077 |   );
6078 | }
6079 | 
6080 | function MilestoneDot({
6081 |   point,
6082 |   onSelect,
6083 |   selected,
6084 | }: {
6085 |   point: MilestonePoint;
6086 |   onSelect: (id: string) => void;
6087 |   selected: boolean;
6088 |   laneIndex: number;
6089 | }) {
6090 |   const meta = DOMAIN_META[point.domain as keyof typeof DOMAIN_META];
6091 |   const status = point.status;
6092 |   const isAchieved = status === "achieved";
6093 |   const isRedFlag = status === "red-flag";
6094 |   const isFuture = status === "future";
6095 | 
6096 |   return (
6097 |     <button
6098 |       aria-label={`${point.label}, ${status}`}
6099 |       aria-pressed={selected}
6100 |       className={cn(
6101 |         "group focus-visible:ring-ring absolute top-1/2 z-20 flex size-6 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 transition-transform hover:scale-110 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none",
6102 |         isAchieved && `${meta.bg} border-transparent text-white shadow-sm`,
6103 |         status === "expected" && "border-foreground/40 border-dashed",

6410 |       }

6481 |         })

6484 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {

6498 |     if (result.kind === "conflict") {

6504 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
6505 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
6506 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
6507 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
6508 | }
6509 | 
6510 | function forbidden(): Error {
6511 |   setResponseStatus(403);
6512 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
6513 | }
6514 | 
6515 | function conflict(serverSnapshot: unknown): Error {
6516 |   setResponseStatus(409);
6517 |   return Object.assign(new Error("Conflict (409): milestone was updated elsewhere."), {
6518 |     serverSnapshot,
6519 |   });
6520 | }

6579 | export function invalidateAfterMilestoneUpdate(

6604 | `features/development/status.ts`:
6605 | 
6606 | ```ts
6607 | // features/development/status.ts
6608 | import type { MilestoneDomain } from "./types";
6609 | 
6610 | export type MilestoneStatus = "achieved" | "expected" | "future" | "red-flag";
6611 | 
6612 | export interface MilestoneForStatus {
6613 |   isAchieved: boolean;
6614 |   targetAgeMonths: number;
6615 |   isRedFlagIfMissing?: boolean;
6616 | }
6617 | 
6618 | /**
6619 |  * Compute the display status of a milestone relative to a patient's
6620 |  * corrected age. `correctedAgeMonths` is what the chart should use
6621 |  * (fallback to chronological if not preterm).
6622 |  */
6623 | export function milestoneStatus(
6624 |   m: MilestoneForStatus,
6625 |   correctedAgeMonths: number,
6626 | ): MilestoneStatus {
6627 |   if (m.isAchieved) return "achieved";
6628 |   if (correctedAgeMonths >= m.targetAgeMonths) {
6629 |     return m.isRedFlagIfMissing ? "red-flag" : "expected";
6630 |   }
6631 |   return "future";
6632 | }
6633 | 
6634 | /** Counts by status across a slice of milestones. */
6635 | export function countByStatus(
6636 |   milestones: ReadonlyArray<MilestoneForStatus & { domain: MilestoneDomain }>,
6637 |   correctedAgeMonths: number,
6638 | ) {
6639 |   const result: Record<MilestoneStatus, { total: number; achieved: number; redFlag: number }> = {
6640 |     achieved: { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
6641 |     expected: { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
6642 |     future: { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
6643 |     "red-flag": { total: 0, achieved: 0, redFlag: 0 },
6644 |   };
6645 |   for (const m of milestones) {
6646 |     const s = milestoneStatus(m, correctedAgeMonths);
6647 |     result[s].total += 1;
6648 |     if (m.isAchieved) result[s].achieved += 1;
6649 |     if (s === "red-flag") result[s].redFlag += 1;
6650 |   }
6651 |   return result;
6652 | }
6653 | 
6654 | ```

7316 | // ── read ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7317 | import { diagnosesForVisitQuery } from "../queries";
7318 | 
7319 | // ── row type — derived from the query factory's concrete queryFn ───────
7320 | //
7321 | // `ReturnType<typeof diagnosesForVisitQuery>["queryFn"]` is
7322 | //   `QueryFunction<TData, TKey, never> | undefined`
7323 | // — an *optional* union. Two problems:
7324 | //
7325 | //   1. `Awaited<QueryFunction<...>>` does NOT unwrap to `TData`; it stays
7326 | //      `QueryFunction<...>`, because `QueryFunction` is a function, not a
7327 | //      promise. So `[number]` fails (TS2537).
7328 | //
7329 | //   2. Because the union includes `undefined`, the whole expression
7330 | //      collapses, and every downstream `row.original.*` access loses its
7331 | //      type, which then trips TS7053 on `TYPE_VARIANT[type]`.
7332 | //
7333 | // The fix is to infer the data type from the queryFn's *return* type via
7334 | // `infer R` on the function signature — no `queryFn` generic, no
7335 | // importing the server function into the component.
7336 | type QueryFnData<TQueryOptions> = TQueryOptions extends {
7337 |   queryFn?: (...args: never[]) => infer R;
7338 | }
7339 |   ? Awaited<R>
7340 |   : never;
7341 | 
7342 | type DiagnosisRow = QueryFnData<ReturnType<typeof diagnosesForVisitQuery>>[number];

7404 | interface DiagnosisTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute> {
7405 |   route?: TRoute;
7406 |   visitId: string;
7407 |   page?: number;
7408 |   size?: PageSize;
7409 | }
7410 | 
7411 | export function DiagnosisTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
7412 |   route,
7413 |   visitId,
7414 |   page = 1,
7415 |   size = 20,
7416 | }: DiagnosisTableProps<TRoute>) {
7417 |   const query = useQuery({
7418 |     ...diagnosesForVisitQuery(visitId),
7419 |     enabled: Boolean(visitId),
7420 |   });
7421 | 
7422 |   const all = query.data ?? EMPTY_DIAGNOSES;
7423 | 
7424 |   const table = useTable({
7425 |     data: all,
7426 |     columns,
7427 |     features,
7428 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
7429 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
7430 |   });
7431 | 
7432 |   const pageCount = table.getPageCount();
7433 | 
7434 |   return (
7435 |     <DataTable
7436 |       ariaLabel="Diagnoses"
7437 |       emptyMessage="No diagnoses recorded for this visit yet."
7438 |       errorDescription={
7439 |         query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
7440 |       }
7441 |       errorTitle="Could Not Load Diagnoses"
7442 |       outOfRange={
7443 |         all.length > 0 && page > pageCount
7444 |           ? {
7445 |               backTo: () => (
7446 |                 <Link
7447 |                   className={buttonVariants()}
7448 |                   params={{ visitId } as never}
7449 |                   to={route?.fullPath ?? ("/app/visits/$visitId" as never)}
7450 |                 >
7451 |                   Back To First Page
7452 |                 </Link>
7453 |               ),
7454 |             }
7455 |           : undefined
7456 |       }
7457 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
7458 |       query={query}
7459 |       skeletonRowCount={Math.min(size, 3)}
7460 |       table={table}
7461 |     />
7462 |   );
7463 | }

7578 | ```ts
7579 | // src/features/diagnosis/api.ts
7580 | import { queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
7581 | import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
7582 | // src/features/diagnosis/queries.ts — append
7583 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
7584 | 
7585 | import {
7586 |   fetchDiagnosesForPatient,
7587 |   fetchDiagnosesForVisit,
7588 |   fetchDiagnosisById,
7589 |   fetchTopDiagnoses,
7590 |   searchDiagnosesFn,
7591 | } from "./functions";
7592 | import { createDiagnosesFn, createDiagnosisFn } from "./functions";
7593 | 
7594 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7595 | // Mutation hooks
7596 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7597 | 
7598 | /**
7599 |  * Create one or more diagnoses for a visit.
7600 |  *
7601 |  * Both the single and bulk paths invalidate the same caches — the visit's
7602 |  * diagnosis list, the patient's diagnosis history, the visit detail, and
7603 |  * (indirectly) the patient page. The `bulk` choice is only about which
7604 |  * server function is called; the cache strategy is identical.
7605 |  */
7606 | export function useCreateDiagnosesMutation(args: { visitId: string; patientId?: string }) {
7607 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
7608 |   const createMany = useServerFn(createDiagnosesFn);
7609 |   const createOne = useServerFn(createDiagnosisFn);
7610 | 
7611 |   // Two mutations on the same hook — one per shape. React Query caches
7612 |   // mutations by `mutationKey`, so we tag them.
7613 |   const invalidate = () => {
7614 |     const promises: Array<unknown> = [
7615 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
7616 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
7617 |       }),
7618 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["visit", args.visitId] }),
7619 |     ];
7620 |     if (args.patientId) {
7621 |       promises.push(
7622 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
7623 |           queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byPatient(args.patientId),
7624 |         }),
7625 |       );
7626 |     }
7627 |     return Promise.all(promises);
7628 |   };
7629 | 
7630 |   const bulk = useMutation({
7631 |     mutationKey: ["diagnoses", "bulk", args.visitId],
7632 |     mutationFn: (rows: Parameters<typeof createMany>[0]["data"]["rows"]) =>
7633 |       createMany({ data: { rows } }),
7634 |     onSuccess: () => {
7635 |       void invalidate();
7636 |     },
7637 |   });
7638 | 
7639 |   const single = useMutation({
7640 |     mutationKey: ["diagnoses", "single", args.visitId],
7641 |     mutationFn: (row: Parameters<typeof createOne>[0]["data"]) => createOne({ data: row }),
7642 |     onSuccess: () => {
7643 |       void invalidate();
7644 |     },
7645 |   });
7646 | 
7647 |   return { bulk, single };
7648 | }
7649 | 
7650 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7651 | // Constants
7652 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7653 | 
7654 | const STALE_TIMES = {
7655 |   /** Single diagnosis detail. */
7656 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
7657 |   /** Diagnoses attached to one visit — changes when the visit is edited. */
7658 |   VISIT: 60_000,
7659 |   /** A patient's full diagnosis history. */
7660 |   PATIENT: 60_000,
7661 |   /** Clinic-wide search and aggregates. */
7662 |   CLINIC: 120_000,
7663 | } as const;
7664 | 
7665 | export const diagnosisKeys = {
7666 |   all: () => ["diagnoses"] as const,
7667 | 
7668 |   /** One diagnosis detail. */
7669 |   detail: (diagnosisId: string) => ["diagnoses", "detail", diagnosisId] as const,
7670 | 
7671 |   /** Diagnoses attached to one visit. */
7672 |   byVisit: (visitId: string) => ["diagnoses", "visit", visitId] as const,
7673 | 
7674 |   /** A patient's full diagnosis history. */
7675 |   byPatient: (patientId: string) => ["diagnoses", "patient", patientId] as const,
7676 | 
7677 |   /** Free-text search results within a clinic. */
7678 |   search: (clinicId: string, query: string) => ["diagnoses", "search", clinicId, query] as const,
7679 | 
7680 |   /** Top-N ICD codes for a clinic. */
7681 |   topForClinic: (clinicId: string, limit: number) => ["diagnoses", "top", clinicId, limit] as const,
7682 | } as const;
7683 | 
7684 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7685 | // Query options
7686 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7687 | 
7688 | export function diagnosisByIdQuery(diagnosisId: string) {
7689 |   return queryOptions({
7690 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.detail(diagnosisId),
7691 |     queryFn: () => fetchDiagnosisById({ data: { diagnosisId } }),
7692 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
7693 |   });
7694 | }
7695 | 
7696 | export function diagnosesForVisitQuery(visitId: string) {
7697 |   return queryOptions({
7698 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byVisit(visitId),
7699 |     queryFn: () => fetchDiagnosesForVisit({ data: { visitId } }),
7700 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.VISIT,
7701 |   });
7702 | }
7703 | 
7704 | export function diagnosesForPatientQuery(patientId: string) {
7705 |   return queryOptions({
7706 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byPatient(patientId),
7707 |     queryFn: () => fetchDiagnosesForPatient({ data: { patientId } }),
7708 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.PATIENT,
7709 |   });
7710 | }
7711 | 
7712 | export function searchDiagnosesQuery(clinicId: string, query: string) {
7713 |   return queryOptions({
7714 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.search(clinicId, query),
7715 |     queryFn: () => searchDiagnosesFn({ data: { clinicId, query } }),
7716 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
7717 |     // The caller should debounce `query`. When `query` is empty the server
7718 |     // rejects it (`.min(1)`), so callers must gate with `enabled: query.length > 0`.
7719 |     enabled: query.length > 0,
7720 |   });
7721 | }
7722 | 
7723 | export function topDiagnosesQuery(clinicId: string, limit = 20) {
7724 |   return queryOptions({
7725 |     queryKey: diagnosisKeys.topForClinic(clinicId, limit),
7726 |     queryFn: () => fetchTopDiagnoses({ data: { clinicId, limit } }),
7727 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
7728 |   });
7729 | }

7731 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7732 | // Invalidation helpers
7733 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7734 | 
7735 | /**
7736 |  * Call this after any diagnosis mutation succeeds. Invalidates the visit's
7737 |  * diagnoses list (which the diagnosis form saves into) and the patient's
7738 |  * history (which the patient page renders).
7739 |  *
7740 |  * The list of caches touched by a write is knowledge that belongs in one
7741 |  * place — not duplicated across every mutation's `onSuccess`.
7742 |  */
7743 | export function invalidateAfterDiagnosisChange(
7744 |   queryClient: {
7745 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
7746 |   },
7747 |   args: {
7748 |     visitId?: string;
7749 |     patientId?: string;
7750 |     diagnosisId?: string;
7751 |   },
7752 | ): Promise<unknown> {
7753 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [];
7754 | 
7755 |   if (args.diagnosisId) {
7756 |     promises.push(
7757 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
7758 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.detail(args.diagnosisId),
7759 |       }),
7760 |     );
7761 |   }
7762 | 
7763 |   if (args.visitId) {
7764 |     promises.push(
7765 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
7766 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
7767 |       }),
7768 |     );
7769 |   }
7770 | 
7771 |   if (args.patientId) {
7772 |     promises.push(
7773 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
7774 |         queryKey: diagnosisKeys.byPatient(args.patientId),
7775 |       }),
7776 |     );
7777 |   }
7778 | 
7779 |   return Promise.all(promises);
7780 | }

7849 | `features/growth/README.md`:
7850 | 
7851 | ```md
7852 | ## Growth charts — which chart is canonical
7853 | 
7854 | There are two chart components under `features/growth/components/`, and only
7855 | **one** is used by the patient-facing UI:
7856 | 
7857 | | Component                                      | Data source                                                                               | Used by                                                                              |
7858 | | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
7859 | | **`EgyptianGrowthChart.tsx`** _(canonical)_    | `ChartCurves` (Egyptian 2021 LMS) + optional `ChartBand` marker + patient `GrowthPoint[]` | `PatientGrowthPanel` — **the** growth screen                                         |
7860 | | `NewGrowthChart.tsx` (a.k.a. `WhoGrowthChart`) | `GrowthStandard[]` (WHO, day-indexed SD bands) + `ChildMeasurement[]`                     | `WhoGrowthPanel` — the _secondary_ WHO comparison chart shown below the Egyptian one |
7861 | 
7862 | ### Rules
7863 | 
7864 | 1. **Egyptian is primary.** Clinical decisions in this app are based on the
7865 |    Egyptian 2021 reference. `PatientGrowthPanel` renders
7866 |    `EgyptianGrowthChart`. The WHO panel is a secondary, comparative view
7867 |    and is intentionally _not_ the main chart.
7868 | 2. **Never reintroduce `GrowthChart.tsx`.** It was a parallel implementation
7869 |    built on `RendererChart` + `motion` + `d3-scale`/`d3-shape` and was
7870 |    deleted in favour of `EgyptianGrowthChart` (which uses the newer
7871 |    `@tanstack/charts` `defineChart`/`Chart` API, without the extra
7872 |    `d3-*` runtime dependencies). The test file
7873 |    `GrowthChart.test.tsx` now targets `EgyptianGrowthChart`.
7874 | 3. **State lives in the panel.** `PatientGrowthPanel` owns
7875 |    `indicator` / `flaggedOnly` / `formOpen` / `useCorrectedAge` in
7876 |    `useState`. There is no `growthStore` — a per-patient global `Map` was
7877 |    removed because it leaked across navigations and had no reset
7878 |    semantics. If cross-route persistence is ever required, model it as a
7879 |    **router search param**, not a module-level store.
7880 | 4. **Weight-for-length overlay.** The x-axis for WFL is length (cm). Each
7881 |    series row's `lengthCm` is derived server-side in
7882 |    `listIndicatorSeries` from the sibling `length-for-age` measurement at
7883 |    the same `visitId`. There is no `lengthCmAtMeasurement` column and no
7884 |    backfill: the derivation is retroactive and keeps a single source of
7885 |    truth.
7886 | 5. **Corrected age.** Preterm patients (`gestationalAgeWeeks < 37`) get a
7887 |    `Use corrected age` toggle. When enabled, the patient points' x-values
7888 |    are recomputed as `decimalMonthsBetween(dob, visitedAt) - weeksPreterm*7/30.4375`,
7889 |    and the x-axis label becomes `Corrected age (months)`. The reference
7890 |    curves themselves are unchanged — correction applies only to the
7891 |    patient overlay, which is the correct clinical convention.
7892 | 
7893 | ## Which chart is canonical?
7894 | 
7895 | - **`EgyptianGrowthChart.tsx`** — canonical growth chart. Uses `@tanstack/charts` `defineChart` / `Chart`, no `d3-scale` / `d3-shape` imports. Renders LMS reference curves plus optional patient overlay, optional band marker, optional `xAxisLabel` for corrected age.
7896 | - **`WhoGrowthChart.tsx`** (formerly `NewGrowthChart.tsx`) — secondary. Used only by `WhoGrowthPanel`. Uses `d3-scale` because the WHO standards are in a separate table (`growthStandards`) indexed by day and shown on a UTC axis.
7897 | - **`GrowthChart.tsx`** — deleted. It was a parallel implementation with `RendererChart` + `motion`. Do not resurrect.
7898 | 
7899 | State for the growth panel (`indicator`, `flaggedOnly`, `formOpen`, `useCorrectedAge`) lives in `PatientGrowthPanel` via `useState`. There is no store. If cross-route persistence is ever needed, use a router search param — not a module-level `Map`.
7900 | 
7901 | Weight-for-length overlay: `IndicatorSeriesRow.lengthCm` is derived server-side in `listIndicatorSeries` from the sibling `length-for-age` measurement at the same visit. No `lengthCmAtMeasurement` column exists; do not add one — it duplicates a value that already exists on the visit.
7902 | 
7903 | ```
7904 | `features/growth/components/EgyptianGrowthChart.tsx`:

7906 | ```tsx
7907 | // src/components/growth/EgyptianGrowthChart.tsx
7908 | 
7909 | import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
7910 | 
7911 | import { defineChart, dot, lineY } from "@tanstack/charts";

7988 |     case "bmi-for-age":
7989 |       return "BMI (kg/m²)";
