8000 | interface BandRow {
8001 |   x: number;
8002 |   sd3neg: number;
8003 |   sd2neg: number;
8004 |   sd1neg: number;
8005 |   median: number;
8006 |   sd1: number;
8007 |   sd2: number;
8008 |   sd3: number;
8009 | }
8010 | 
8011 | function toBandRows(points: ChartCurves["points"]): BandRow[] {
8012 |   return points.map((p) => ({
8013 |     x: p.x,
8014 |     sd3neg: p.sd3neg,
8015 |     sd2neg: p.sd2neg,
8016 |     sd1neg: p.sd1neg,
8017 |     median: p.median,
8018 |     sd1: p.sd1,
8019 |     sd2: p.sd2,
8020 |     sd3: p.sd3,
8021 |   }));
8022 | }
8023 | 
8024 | function isGrowthPoint(value: unknown): value is GrowthPoint {
8025 |   return (
8026 |     typeof value === "object" &&
8027 |     value !== null &&
8028 |     "x" in value &&
8029 |     typeof (value as { x: unknown }).x === "number" &&
8030 |     "y" in value &&
8031 |     typeof (value as { y: unknown }).y === "number"
8032 |   );
8033 | }
8034 | 
8035 | /**
8036 |  * TanStack Charts passes the *datum* to focus/select handlers. Older or
8037 |  * wrapped versions may pass `{ datum }`. Accept both shapes so `onSelect`
8038 |  * reliably fires.
8039 |  */
8040 | function datumFromEvent(value: unknown): GrowthPoint | null {
8041 |   if (isGrowthPoint(value)) return value;
8042 |   if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || !("datum" in value)) return null;
8043 |   return isGrowthPoint((value as { datum: unknown }).datum)
8044 |     ? (value as { datum: GrowthPoint }).datum
8045 |     : null;
8046 | }
8047 | 
8048 | export function EgyptianGrowthChart({
8049 |   indicator,
8050 |   sex,
8051 |   curves,
8052 |   points = EMPTY_POINTS,
8053 |   currentBand,
8054 |   height = 360,
8055 |   width,
8056 |   aspectRatio,
8057 |   ariaLabel,
8058 |   xAxisLabel,
8059 |   onFocusChange,
8060 |   onSelect,
8061 |   className,
8062 |   style,
8063 |   showTooltip = true,
8064 |   animate = true,
8065 | }: EgyptianGrowthChartProps) {
8066 |   const xAxis = curves.xAxis;
8067 |   const resolvedAriaLabel = ariaLabel ?? defaultAriaLabel(indicator, sex);
8068 | 
8069 |   const definition = useMemo(() => {
8070 |     if (
8071 |       process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" &&
8072 |       (curves.indicator !== indicator || curves.sex !== sex)
8073 |     ) {
8074 |       console.warn(
8075 |         `[EgyptianGrowthChart] curves (${curves.indicator}/${curves.sex}/${curves.xAxis}) ` +
8076 |           `do not match props (${indicator}/${sex}). Using curves for rendering.`,
8077 |       );
8078 |     }
8079 | 
8080 |     const rows = toBandRows(curves.points);
8081 | 
8082 |     const bandMarks = [
8083 |       lineY(rows, {
8084 |         x: "x",
8085 |         y: "sd3neg",
8086 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd3neg,
8087 |         strokeWidth: 1,
8088 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
8089 |       }),
8090 |       lineY(rows, {
8091 |         x: "x",
8092 |         y: "sd2neg",
8093 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd2neg,
8094 |         strokeWidth: 1.5,
8095 |       }),
8096 |       lineY(rows, {
8097 |         x: "x",
8098 |         y: "sd1neg",
8099 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd1neg,
8100 |         strokeWidth: 1,
8101 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
8102 |       }),
8103 |       lineY(rows, {
8104 |         x: "x",
8105 |         y: "median",
8106 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.median,
8107 |         strokeWidth: 2,
8108 |       }),
8109 |       lineY(rows, {
8110 |         x: "x",
8111 |         y: "sd1",
8112 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd1,
8113 |         strokeWidth: 1,
8114 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
8115 |       }),
8116 |       lineY(rows, {
8117 |         x: "x",
8118 |         y: "sd2",
8119 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd2,
8120 |         strokeWidth: 1.5,
8121 |       }),
8122 |       lineY(rows, {
8123 |         x: "x",
8124 |         y: "sd3",
8125 |         stroke: SERIES_COLORS.sd3,
8126 |         strokeWidth: 1,
8127 |         strokeDasharray: "4 3",
8128 |       }),
8129 |     ];
8130 | 
8131 |     // `dot` requires a mutable array; clone so we don't mutate the prop.
8132 |     const pointData: GrowthPoint[] = points.map((p) => ({ ...p }));
8133 |     const pointMarks =
8134 |       pointData.length > 0
8135 |         ? [
8136 |             dot(pointData, {
8137 |               x: "x",
8138 |               y: "y",
8139 |               fill: "var(--growth-patient)",
8140 |               r: 4,
8141 |               stroke: "#fff",
8142 |               strokeWidth: 1.5,
8143 |             }),
8144 |           ]
8145 |         : [];
8146 | 
8147 |     const marker =
8148 |       currentBand !== null && currentBand !== undefined
8149 |         ? [
8150 |             lineY(
8151 |               [
8152 |                 {
8153 |                   x: currentBand.x,
8154 |                   y: currentBand.sd3neg,
8155 |                 },
8156 |                 { x: currentBand.x, y: currentBand.sd3 },
8157 |               ],
8158 |               {
8159 |                 x: "x",
8160 |                 y: "y",
8161 |                 stroke: "var(--growth-marker, #0ea5e9)",
8162 |                 strokeWidth: 1.5,
8163 |                 strokeDasharray: "3 3",
8164 |               },
8165 |             ),
8166 |           ]
8167 |         : [];
8168 | 
8169 |     return defineChart({
8170 |       // Draw reference bands first, then the marker, then patient dots
8171 |       // on top so they're never occluded.
8172 |       marks: [...bandMarks, ...marker, ...pointMarks],
8173 |       scales: {
8174 |         x: {
8175 |           scale: scaleLinear,
8176 |           nice: true,
8177 |           grid: true,
8178 |           axis: { label: xAxisLabel ?? axisLabel(xAxis) },
8179 |         },
8180 |         y: {
8181 |           scale: scaleLinear,
8182 |           nice: true,
8183 |           grid: true,
8184 |           axis: { label: valueLabel(indicator) },
8185 |         },
8186 |       },
8187 |       ...(showTooltip ? { tooltip } : {}),
8188 |       ...(animate ? { svgAnimation: true } : {}),
8189 |       ariaLabel: resolvedAriaLabel,
8190 |     });
8191 |   }, [
8192 |     curves,
8193 |     points,
8194 |     currentBand,
8195 |     xAxis,
8196 |     indicator,
8197 |     sex,
8198 |     resolvedAriaLabel,
8199 |     xAxisLabel,
8200 |     showTooltip,
8201 |     animate,
8202 |   ]);
8203 | 
8204 |   const handleFocusChange = (point: unknown) => {
8205 |     if (!onFocusChange) return;
8206 |     onFocusChange(datumFromEvent(point));
8207 |   };
8208 | 
8209 |   const handleSelect = (point: unknown) => {
8210 |     if (!onSelect) return;
8211 |     const datum = datumFromEvent(point);
8212 |     if (datum) onSelect(datum);
8213 |   };
8214 | 
8215 |   return (
8216 |     <div className={className} style={style}>
8217 |       <Chart
8218 |         definition={definition}
8219 |         height={height}
8220 |         {...(width !== undefined ? { width } : {})}
8221 |         {...(width === undefined && aspectRatio !== undefined ? { aspectRatio } : {})}
8222 |         ariaLabel={resolvedAriaLabel}
8223 |         {...(onFocusChange ? { onFocusChange: handleFocusChange } : {})}
8224 |         {...(onSelect ? { onSelect: handleSelect } : {})}
8225 |       />
8226 |     </div>
8227 |   );
8228 | }
8229 |

8232 | }

8256 |         <span
8257 |           aria-hidden="true"

8259 |           style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--growth-patient)" }}
8260 |         />
8261 |         <span>Patient</span>
8262 |       </div>
8263 |     </div>
8264 |   );
8265 | }

8948 | // components/GrowthChart.tsx
8949 | import { areaY, defineChart, lineY } from "@tanstack/charts";
8950 | import { Chart } from "@tanstack/charts/react";
8951 | import { tooltip } from "@tanstack/charts/tooltip";
8952 | import { scaleLinear, scaleUtc } from "d3-scale";
8953 | import * as React from "react";
8954 | 
8955 | import type { ChildMeasurement, GrowthStandard } from "../types/types";
8956 | 
8957 | interface GrowthChartProps {
8958 |   standards: GrowthStandard[];
8959 |   measurements?: ChildMeasurement[];
8960 |   title: string;
8961 |   yLabel: string;
8962 |   metric: "lhfa" | "wfa";
8963 |   gender: "boys" | "girls";
8964 | }
8965 | 
8966 | // Build a single row per day holding the band edges
8967 | interface BandRow {
8968 |   child: number | null;
8969 |   day: number;
8970 |   date: Date;
8971 |   sd4neg: number;
8972 |   sd3neg: number;
8973 |   sd2neg: number;
8974 |   sd1neg: number;
8975 |   sd0: number;
8976 |   sd1: number;
8977 |   sd2: number;
8978 |   sd3: number;
8979 |   sd4: number;
8980 | }
8981 | 
8982 | // Convert day number to a representative date for scaleUtc
8983 | // Using a fixed epoch so all charts align
8984 | const EPOCH = Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1);
8985 | 
8986 | function dayToDate(day: number): Date {
8987 |   return new Date(EPOCH + day * 86_400_000);
8988 | }
8989 | 
8990 | // Merge standards with child measurements onto the same day grid
8991 | function mergeData(standards: GrowthStandard[], measurements: ChildMeasurement[]): BandRow[] {
8992 |   const childMap = new Map(measurements.map((m) => [m.day, m.value]));
8993 | 
8994 |   return standards.map((s) => ({
8995 |     day: s.day,
8996 |     date: dayToDate(s.day),
8997 |     sd4neg: s.sd4neg,
8998 |     sd3neg: s.sd3neg,
8999 |     sd2neg: s.sd2neg,
9000 |     sd1neg: s.sd1neg,
9001 |     sd0: s.sd0,
9002 |     sd1: s.sd1,
9003 |     sd2: s.sd2,
9004 |     sd3: s.sd3,
9005 |     sd4: s.sd4,
9006 |     // child value as a separate field for the line
9007 |     child: childMap.get(s.day) ?? null,
9008 |   }));
9009 | }
9010 | 
9011 | // Resolve the y domain from the reference range plus child values
9012 | function resolveDomain(rows: BandRow[]): [number, number] {
9013 |   if (rows.length === 0) return [0, 1];
9014 | 
9015 |   const values: number[] = [];
9016 |   for (const row of rows) {
9017 |     values.push(row.sd4neg, row.sd4, row.sd0);
9018 |     if (row.child !== null) values.push(row.child);
9019 |   }
9020 |   const finiteValues = values.filter(Number.isFinite);
9021 |   if (finiteValues.length === 0) return [0, 1];
9022 | 
9023 |   const min = Math.min(...finiteValues);
9024 |   const max = Math.max(...finiteValues);
9025 |   const padding = Math.max((max - min) * 0.1, Math.abs(max) * 0.02, 0.1);
9026 |   return [Math.floor(min - padding), Math.ceil(max + padding)];
9027 | }
9028 | 
9029 | // Resolve x domain based on visible day range
9030 | function resolveXDomain(rows: BandRow[]): [Date, Date] {
9031 |   if (rows.length === 0) return [dayToDate(0), dayToDate(365)];
9032 |   const first = rows[0].date;
9033 |   const last = rows[rows.length - 1].date;
9034 |   return first.getTime() === last.getTime() ? [first, dayToDate(rows[0].day + 1)] : [first, last];
9035 | }
9036 | 
9037 | export function WhoGrowthChart({
9038 |   standards,
9039 |   measurements = [],
9040 |   title,
9041 |   yLabel,
9042 |   metric,
9043 |   gender,
9044 | }: GrowthChartProps) {
9045 |   const rows = React.useMemo(() => mergeData(standards, measurements), [standards, measurements]);
9046 | 
9047 |   const domain = React.useMemo(() => resolveDomain(rows), [rows]);
9048 |   const xDomain = React.useMemo(() => resolveXDomain(rows), [rows]);
9049 | 
9050 |   const definition = React.useMemo(
9051 |     () =>
9052 |       defineChart({
9053 |         tooltip: {
9054 |           use: tooltip,
9055 |           placement: ["top", "right", "left"],
9056 |           format: (point) => {
9057 |             const day = point.datum.day;
9058 |             const month = Math.round(day / 30.44);
9059 |             const label = day < 30 ? `${day}d` : `${month}mo (${day}d)`;
9060 |             return `${label}\n${point.yValue.toFixed(1)} ${yLabel}`;
9061 |           },
9062 |         },
9063 |         marks: [
9064 |           areaY(rows, {
9065 |             id: "band-outer",
9066 |             x: "date",
9067 |             y1: "sd2neg",
9068 |             y2: "sd2",
9069 |             fill: "#dbeafe",
9070 |             fillOpacity: 0.55,
9071 |           }),
9072 |           areaY(rows, {
9073 |             id: "band-inner",
9074 |             x: "date",
9075 |             y1: "sd1neg",
9076 |             y2: "sd1",
9077 |             fill: "#93c5fd",
9078 |             fillOpacity: 0.45,
9079 |           }),
9080 |           // Median reference line
9081 |           lineY(rows, {
9082 |             id: "median",
9083 |             x: "date",
9084 |             y: "sd0",
9085 |             stroke: "#1d4ed8",
9086 |             strokeWidth: 2,
9087 |             strokeDasharray: "6 3",
9088 |           }),
9089 |           // ±2 SD boundary lines
9090 |           lineY(rows, {
9091 |             id: "sd2-upper",
9092 |             x: "date",
9093 |             y: "sd2",
9094 |             stroke: "#60a5fa",
9095 |             strokeWidth: 1.25,
9096 |           }),
9097 |           lineY(rows, {
9098 |             id: "sd2-lower",
9099 |             x: "date",
9100 |             y: "sd2neg",
9101 |             stroke: "#60a5fa",
9102 |             strokeWidth: 1.25,
9103 |           }),
9104 |           // Child measurements (only if provided)
9105 |           ...(measurements.length > 0
9106 |             ? [
9107 |                 lineY(rows, {
9108 |                   id: "child",
9109 |                   x: "date",
9110 |                   y: "child",
9111 |                   stroke: "#dc2626",
9112 |                   strokeWidth: 2.5,
9113 |                   points: true,
9114 |                 }),
9115 |               ]
9116 |             : []),
9117 |         ],
9118 |         scales: {
9119 |           x: {
9120 |             scale: scaleUtc().domain(xDomain),
9121 |             axis: {
9122 |               line: false,
9123 |               ticks: {
9124 |                 count: 6,
9125 |                 format: (d: Date) => {
9126 |                   const day = Math.round((d.getTime() - EPOCH) / 86_400_000);
9127 |                   const month = Math.round(day / 30.44);
9128 |                   return day < 30 ? `${day}d` : `${month}mo`;
9129 |                 },
9130 |                 size: 0,
9131 |                 padding: 8,
9132 |               },
9133 |               tickLabels: { thin: { priority: "ends", minGap: 24 } },
9134 |             },
9135 |           },
9136 |           y: {
9137 |             scale: scaleLinear().domain(domain),
9138 |             grid: true,
9139 |             axis: {
9140 |               line: false,

9523 | ```ts
9524 | import type { z } from "zod";
9525 | 
9526 | // src/features/growth/queries.ts
9527 | import { queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
9528 | 
9529 | import type { GrowthChartRequestSchema } from "./schema";
9530 | import type { RangeFor } from "./types/sheets";
9531 | import type { ChartBand, ChartCurves, Indicator, IndicatorSeriesRow, Sex } from "./types/types";
9532 | 
9533 | import {
9534 |   fetchChildMeasurementsFn,
9535 |   fetchGrowthChartBand,
9536 |   fetchGrowthChartCurves,
9537 |   fetchGrowthChartCurvesMany,
9538 |   fetchGrowthStandardsFn,
9539 |   fetchIndicatorSeries,
9540 |   fetchLatestPanel,
9541 | } from "./functions";
9542 | 
9543 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9544 | // Types
9545 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9546 | 
9547 | export type SeriesRow = IndicatorSeriesRow;
9548 | 
9549 | type Range = { xAxis: "age" | "length"; min: number; max: number };
9550 | 
9551 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9552 | // Query key factory
9553 | //
9554 | // Every key starts with a stable prefix:
9555 | //   - "curves", "band", "curves-many", "growth-standards"  → reference data
9556 | //   - "series", "latest"                                   → patient-scoped
9557 | //
9558 | // `band` and `curves` keys include the full range so two charts at different
9559 | // ranges don't share cache. `band` additionally rounds `x` to 0.1 so hovering
9560 | // 12.0 → 12.04 does not trigger a refetch.
9561 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9562 | 
9563 | export const growthKeys = {
9564 |   // ── Reference data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9565 |   standards: (metric: "lhfa" | "wfa", gender: "boys" | "girls") =>
9566 |     ["growth-standards", metric, gender] as const,
9567 | 
9568 |   curves: (indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex, r: Range) =>
9569 |     ["curves", indicator, sex, r.xAxis, r.min, r.max] as const,
9570 | 
9571 |   curvesMany: (keyedRequests: ReadonlyArray<string>) => ["curves-many", keyedRequests] as const,
9572 | 
9573 |   /**
9574 |    * Band at a specific x. `x` is rounded to one decimal so small hover
9575 |    * jitter doesn't invalidate the cache. `null` produces a `"disabled"`
9576 |    * segment that can never collide with a real (numeric) x.
9577 |    */
9578 |   band: (indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex, r: Range, x: number | null) =>
9579 |     x == null
9580 |       ? (["band", "disabled", indicator, sex, r.xAxis] as const)
9581 |       : (["band", indicator, sex, r.xAxis, r.min, r.max, Math.round(x * 10) / 10] as const),
9582 | 
9583 |   // ── Patient-scoped ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9584 |   series: (patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) => ["series", patientId, indicator] as const,
9585 | 
9586 |   seriesRoot: (patientId: string) => ["series", patientId] as const,
9587 | 
9588 |   latestPanel: (patientId: string) => ["latest", patientId] as const,
9589 | 
9590 |   childMeasurements: (patientId: string, metric: "lhfa" | "wfa") =>
9591 |     ["child-measurements", patientId, metric] as const,
9592 | } as const;
9593 | 
9594 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9595 | // Chart request helper
9596 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9597 | 
9598 | function toChartRequest<I extends Indicator>(
9599 |   indicator: I,
9600 |   sex: Sex,
9601 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
9602 | ): z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema> {
9603 |   if (indicator === "weight-for-length") {
9604 |     return {
9605 |       indicator: "weight-for-length",
9606 |       sex,
9607 |       range: range as { xAxis: "length"; min: number; max: number },
9608 |     } satisfies z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema>;
9609 |   }
9610 |   return {
9611 |     indicator: indicator as Exclude<Indicator, "weight-for-length">,
9612 |     sex,
9613 |     range: range as { xAxis: "age"; min: number; max: number },
9614 |   } satisfies z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema>;
9615 | }
9616 | 
9617 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9618 | // Reference data query options
9619 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9620 | 
9621 | /**
9622 |  * WHO reference tables for one metric+gender. Seed data — never changes
9623 |  * between deploys, so it lives in cache indefinitely.
9624 |  */
9625 | export function growthStandardsQuery(metric: "lhfa" | "wfa", gender: "boys" | "girls") {
9626 |   return queryOptions({
9627 |     queryKey: growthKeys.standards(metric, gender),
9628 |     queryFn: () => fetchGrowthStandardsFn({ data: { metric, gender } }),
9629 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
9630 |   });
9631 | }
9632 | 
9633 | export function getGrowthChartCurvesQuery<I extends Indicator>(
9634 |   indicator: I,
9635 |   sex: Sex,
9636 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
9637 | ) {
9638 |   return queryOptions<ChartCurves>({
9639 |     queryKey: growthKeys.curves(indicator, sex, range),
9640 |     queryFn: async (): Promise<ChartCurves> => {
9641 |       return fetchGrowthChartCurves({
9642 |         data: toChartRequest(indicator, sex, range),
9643 |       });
9644 |     },
9645 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
9646 |   });
9647 | }
9648 | 
9649 | /**
9650 |  * Fetch several curves in parallel. The key is sorted by request identity
9651 |  * so callers can pass `requests` in any order and still hit cache.
9652 |  */
9653 | export function manyCurvesQuery(requests: ReadonlyArray<z.infer<typeof GrowthChartRequestSchema>>) {
9654 |   const keyedRequests = requests
9655 |     .map((r) => ({
9656 |       indicator: r.indicator,
9657 |       sex: r.sex,
9658 |       xAxis: r.range.xAxis,
9659 |       min: r.range.min,
9660 |       max: r.range.max,
9661 |     }))
9662 |     .toSorted((a, b) => {
9663 |       const k = (v: typeof a) => `${v.indicator}|${v.sex}|${v.xAxis}|${v.min}|${v.max}`;
9664 |       return k(a).localeCompare(k(b));
9665 |     });
9666 | 
9667 |   return queryOptions({
9668 |     queryKey: growthKeys.curvesMany(keyedRequests.map((r) => JSON.stringify(r))),
9669 |     queryFn: async (): Promise<ChartCurves[]> => {
9670 |       return fetchGrowthChartCurvesMany({ data: { requests } });
9671 |     },
9672 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
9673 |   });
9674 | }
9675 | 
9676 | /**
9677 |  * Band for the current marker on a chart.
9678 |  *
9679 |  * Two branches, distinguished by whether `x` is known:
9680 |  *   - `x == null`: disabled query. The key includes a literal `"disabled"`
9681 |  *     segment so it can never collide with a real band key. The queryFn
9682 |  *     returns `null` so the caller gets a well-typed `data: null` while
9683 |  *     disabled.
9684 |  *   - `x != null`: the real band query, keyed on the rounded x.
9685 |  */
9686 | export function bandQuery<I extends Indicator>(
9687 |   indicator: I,
9688 |   sex: Sex,
9689 |   range: RangeFor<I>,
9690 |   x: number | null,
9691 | ) {
9692 |   if (x == null) {
9693 |     return queryOptions<ChartBand | null>({
9694 |       queryKey: growthKeys.band(indicator, sex, range, null),
9695 |       queryFn: async () => null,
9696 |       enabled: false as const,
9697 |       staleTime: 30 * 1000,
9698 |     });
9699 |   }
9700 |   return queryOptions<ChartBand | null>({
9701 |     queryKey: growthKeys.band(indicator, sex, range, x),
9702 |     queryFn: async (): Promise<ChartBand | null> => {
9703 |       return fetchGrowthChartBand({
9704 |         data: { ...toChartRequest(indicator, sex, range), x },
9705 |       });
9706 |     },
9707 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
9708 |   });
9709 | }
9710 | 
9711 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9712 | // Patient-scoped query options
9713 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9714 | 
9715 | export function seriesQuery(patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) {
9716 |   return queryOptions({

10089 | /**
10090 |  * Convert a continuous z-score into the nearest integer band key.
10091 |  * Clamps to [-3, 3] so out-of-range values still resolve to a band.
10092 |  */
10093 | export function zToBand(z: number): -3 | -2 | -1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 {
10094 |   if (z < -3) return -3;
10095 |   if (z < -2) return -2;
10096 |   if (z < -1) return -1;
10097 |   if (z < 1) return 0;
10098 |   if (z < 2) return 1;
10099 |   if (z < 3) return 2;
10100 |   return 3;
10101 | }

10103 | /**

10105 |  *
10106 |  * Every `Indicator` × band cell is populated, so the return type is
10107 |  * `GrowthBand` (not `GrowthBand | undefined`). If you add an indicator to
10108 |  * `Indicator` without adding it to `growthInterpretations`, this file
10109 |  * stops compiling — which is the correct behaviour.
10110 |  */
10111 | // inside getGrowthBand
10112 | export function getGrowthBand(indicator: Indicator, z: number): GrowthBand {
10113 |   const band = growthInterpretations[zToBand(z)][indicator];
10114 |   if (!band) {
10115 |     const severity: GrowthSeverity =
10116 |       indicator === "head-circumference-for-age" && z < -2
10117 |         ? "deficit"
10118 |         : indicator === "head-circumference-for-age" && z > 2
10119 |           ? "excess"
10120 |           : "normal";
10121 |     return {
10122 |       description: `${indicator} (${z.toFixed(1)} SD)`,
10123 |       image: "",
10124 |       color: "#6b7280",
10125 |       severity,
10126 |     };
10127 |   }

10180 | // src/types/growth/legacy.ts
10181 | //
10182 | // ⚠️  DEPRECATED — migrate to the functions in `./lms` and delete this file.
10183 | //
10184 | // These helpers predate the current `lms.ts` API. They work, but they
10185 | // duplicate concepts (z-score, percentile, classification, age) that have
10186 | // canonical implementations elsewhere. Every import from this module is a
10187 | // TODO. Grep for `from '~/types/growth/legacy'` to find them:
10188 | //
10189 | //   - `components/forms/VisitForm.tsx`              uses calculateExactAgeInMonths
10190 | //   - `components/tables/patients-table.tsx`        uses calculateExactAgeInMonths
10191 | //   - `db/seed.ts`                                   uses calculateExactAgeInMonths
10192 | //   - anything still using `calculateZScore` (it returns 0 on bad input,
10193 | //     unlike `zScoreForValue`, which throws — see the note below)
10194 | //
10195 | // Migration map:
10196 | //   calculateZScore(v, l, m, s)  → zScoreForValue({ l, m, s }, v)
10197 | //   zScoreToPercentile(z)         → percentileFromZ(z)
10198 | //   calculateExactAgeInMonths(d, a) → decimalMonthsBetween(d, a)
10199 | //   classifyZScore(ind, z)        → classify(indicatorFromLegacy(ind), z)
10200 | //
10201 | // `classifyZScore` takes the *legacy* indicator spellings (`weight_for_age`,
10202 | // `height_for_age`, `bmi_for_age`) — the canonical `Indicator` union uses
10203 | // kebab-case. Use `classify()` with the canonical spelling instead.
10204 | 
10205 | export interface LmsParameters {
10206 |   l: number;
10207 |   m: number;
10208 |   s: number;
10209 | }
10210 | 
10211 | export type ClinicalAlertSeverity = "critical" | "warning" | "normal";
10212 | 
10213 | export interface LegacyZScoreResult {
10214 |   zScore: number;
10215 |   percentile: number;
10216 |   classification: string;
10217 |   severity: ClinicalAlertSeverity;
10218 | }
10219 | 
10220 | /**
10221 |  * @deprecated Use `zScoreForValue` from `./lms`. That version throws on
10222 |  * invalid input (which surfaces data-integrity bugs at the call site);
10223 |  * this one returns `0` — silently misclassifying junk as "median".
10224 |  */
10225 | export function calculateZScore(value: number, l: number, m: number, s: number): number {
10226 |   if (value <= 0 || m <= 0 || s <= 0) return 0;
10227 | 
10228 |   let z: number;
10229 |   if (Math.abs(l) < 0.0001) {
10230 |     z = Math.log(value / m) / s;
10231 |   } else {
10232 |     z = ((value / m) ** l - 1) / (l * s);
10233 |   }
10234 |   return Number(z.toFixed(2));
10235 | }
10236 | 
10237 | /**
10238 |  * @deprecated Use `percentileFromZ` from `./lms`. That version uses the
10239 |  * same CDF but is documented against the Abramowitz & Stegun 26.2.17
10240 |  * coefficients this one is based on; the difference is that the canonical
10241 |  * one clamps to [0, 100] and this one returns raw `cdf * 100`.
10242 |  */
10243 | export function zScoreToPercentile(z: number): number {
10244 |   const p = 0.3275911;
10245 |   const a1 = 0.254829592;
10246 |   const a2 = -0.284496736;
10247 |   const a3 = 1.421413741;
10248 |   const a4 = -1.453152027;
10249 |   const a5 = 1.061405429;
10250 | 
10251 |   const sign = z < 0 ? -1 : 1;
10252 |   const x = Math.abs(z) / Math.SQRT2;
10253 |   const t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * x);
10254 |   const erf = 1.0 - ((((a5 * t + a4) * t + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-x * x);
10255 | 
10256 |   const cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + sign * erf);
10257 |   return Number((cdf * 100).toFixed(1));
10258 | }
10259 | 
10260 | /**
10261 |  * @deprecated Use `decimalMonthsBetween` from `./lms`. Same math, clearer
10262 |  * name. Kept only because three modules still import it by the old name;
10263 |  * migrate them and delete this.
10264 |  */
10265 | export function calculateExactAgeInMonths(dob: Date, atDate: Date): number {
10266 |   const diffMs = atDate.getTime() - dob.getTime();
10267 |   const days = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
10268 |   return Number((days / 30.4375).toFixed(2));
10269 | }
10270 | 
10271 | /**
10272 |  * @deprecated Use `classify` from `./lms` with a canonical `Indicator`
10273 |  * (`weight-for-age`, `length-for-age`, `bmi-for-age`). This version takes
10274 |  * the legacy spellings and returns a plain string rather than a
10275 |  * structured `Classification`.
10276 |  */
10277 | export function classifyZScore(
10278 |   indicator: "weight_for_age" | "height_for_age" | "bmi_for_age",
10279 |   z: number,

10281 |   if (indicator === "height_for_age") {
10282 |     if (z < -3) return { classification: "Severe Stunting", severity: "critical" };
10283 |     if (z < -2) return { classification: "Stunting", severity: "warning" };
10284 |     if (z > 3) return { classification: "Tall Stature", severity: "warning" };

10290 |     if (z < -2) return { classification: "Underweight / Wasting", severity: "warning" };
10291 |     if (z > 3) return { classification: "Severe Obesity", severity: "critical" };
10292 |     if (z > 2) return { classification: "Overweight / Obesity", severity: "warning" };
10293 |     if (z > 1)

10295 |         classification: "Possible Risk of Overweight",
10296 |         severity: "normal",
10297 |       };

24951 | // growth/types/lms.ts
24952 | 
24953 | import type { Classification, Indicator, LmsTriple } from "./types";
24954 | 
24955 | import { LmsDomainError } from "./types";
24956 | 
24957 | function assertLms(lms: LmsTriple): void {
24958 |   const { l, m, s } = lms;
24959 |   if (!Number.isFinite(l) || !Number.isFinite(m) || !Number.isFinite(s)) {
24960 |     throw new LmsDomainError("LMS parameters must be finite", { ...lms });
24961 |   }
24962 |   if (m <= 0) throw new LmsDomainError("LMS M must be > 0", { ...lms });
24963 |   if (s <= 0) throw new LmsDomainError("LMS S must be > 0", { ...lms });
24964 | }
24965 | 
24966 | export function valueAtZScore(lms: LmsTriple, z: number): number {
24967 |   assertLms(lms);
24968 |   if (!Number.isFinite(z)) throw new LmsDomainError("zScore must be finite", { z, ...lms });
24969 |   const { l, m, s } = lms;
24970 |   if (l === 0) return m * Math.exp(s * z);
24971 |   const base = 1 + l * s * z;
24972 |   if (base <= 0) {
24973 |     throw new LmsDomainError(`1 + L·S·Z must be > 0 (got L=${l}, S=${s}, Z=${z} → ${base})`, {
24974 |       ...lms,
24975 |       z,
24976 |       base,
24977 |     });
24978 |   }
24979 |   return m * base ** (1 / l);
24980 | }
24981 | 
24982 | export function zScoreForValue(lms: LmsTriple, value: number): number {
24983 |   assertLms(lms);
24984 |   if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
24985 |     throw new LmsDomainError("measured value must be > 0 and finite", {
24986 |       value,
24987 |       ...lms,
24988 |     });
24989 |   }
24990 |   const { l, m, s } = lms;
24991 |   if (l === 0) return Math.log(value / m) / s;
24992 |   return ((value / m) ** l - 1) / (l * s);
24993 | }
24994 | 
24995 | export function percentileFromZ(z: number): number {
24996 |   if (!Number.isFinite(z)) return z > 0 ? 100 : 0;
24997 |   if (z > 8) return 100;
24998 |   if (z < -8) return 0;
24999 |   const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(z));
25000 |   const d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp((-z * z) / 2);
25001 |   const p =
25002 |     d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
25003 |   const pct = z >= 0 ? (1 - p) * 100 : p * 100;
25004 |   return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, pct));
25005 | }
25006 | 
25007 | export function interpolateLms(
25008 |   targetX: number,
25009 |   lower: { x: number; l: number; m: number; s: number },
25010 |   upper: { x: number; l: number; m: number; s: number },
25011 | ): LmsTriple {
25012 |   if (!(lower.x < upper.x)) {
25013 |     throw new LmsDomainError("interpolateLms requires lower.x < upper.x", {
25014 |       lowerX: lower.x,
25015 |       upperX: upper.x,
25016 |     });
25017 |   }
25018 |   if (targetX < lower.x || targetX > upper.x) {
25019 |     throw new LmsDomainError("interpolateLms targetX is outside [lower.x, upper.x]", {
25020 |       targetX,
25021 |       lowerX: lower.x,
25022 |       upperX: upper.x,
25023 |     });
25024 |   }
25025 |   if (targetX === lower.x) return { l: lower.l, m: lower.m, s: lower.s };
25026 |   if (targetX === upper.x) return { l: upper.l, m: upper.m, s: upper.s };
25027 |   const f = (targetX - lower.x) / (upper.x - lower.x);
25028 |   return {
25029 |     l: lower.l + f * (upper.l - lower.l),
25030 |     m: lower.m + f * (upper.m - lower.m),
25031 |     s: lower.s + f * (upper.s - lower.s),
25032 |   };
25033 | }

26169 |     className: "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
26170 |     Icon: CheckIcon,
26171 |     label: "Given",
26172 |   },
26173 |   due: {
26174 |     className: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400",
26175 |     Icon: CircleIcon,
26176 |     label: "Due",
26177 |   },
26178 |   overdue: {
26179 |     className: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive ring-1 ring-destructive/40",
26180 |     Icon: CircleAlertIcon,
26181 |     label: "Overdue",
26182 |   },
26183 |   refused: {
26184 |     className: "bg-muted ",
26185 |     Icon: CircleIcon,
26186 |     label: "Refused",
26187 |   },
26188 | } as const;
26189 | 
26190 | // ── Column widths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26191 | //
26192 | // Tailwind needs static class names to generate CSS. `w-${12 + n * 3}`
26193 | // produces a string at runtime that Tailwind never generated, so those
26194 | // columns get no width and the table layout breaks. This map lists the
26195 | // widths we actually use, bucketed by dose count.
26196 | 
26197 | const DOSE_COLUMN_WIDTH: Record<number, string> = {
26198 |   0: "w-12",
26199 |   1: "w-14",
26200 |   2: "w-16",
26201 |   3: "w-18",
26202 |   4: "w-20",
26203 |   5: "w-24",
26204 | };
26205 | 
26206 | function doseColumnWidth(doses: number | undefined): string {
26207 |   return DOSE_COLUMN_WIDTH[doses ?? 0] ?? "w-24";
26208 | }
26209 | 
26210 | export function ImmunizationMatrix({ clinicId, ageBracket, onlyOverdue }: ImmunizationMatrixProps) {
26211 |   // ── read via factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────
26212 |   const query = useQuery(immunizationMatrixQuery(clinicId, { ageBracket, onlyOverdue }));
26213 | 
26214 |   if (query.isError) {
26215 |     return (
26216 |       <SectionState
26217 |         action={
26218 |           <button
26219 |             className="text-sm underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
26220 |             onClick={() => void query.refetch()}
26221 |             type="button"
26222 |           >
26223 |             Try again
26224 |           </button>
26225 |         }
26226 |         description={query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "Failed to load."}
26227 |         icon={CircleAlertIcon}
26228 |         title="Could not load immunization matrix"
26229 |       />
26230 |     );
26231 |   }
26232 | 
26233 |   if (query.isPending) {
26234 |     return <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full" />;
26235 |   }
26236 | 
26237 |   const { vaccines, rows } = query.data ?? { vaccines: [], rows: [] };
26238 |   if (rows.length === 0) {
26239 |     return (
26240 |       <div className=" rounded-md border border-dashed py-12 text-center text-sm">
26241 |         No patients match this filter.
26242 |       </div>
26243 |     );
26244 |   }
26245 | 
26246 |   return (
26247 |     <div className="relative overflow-x-auto rounded-md border">
26248 |       <Table aria-label="Immunization matrix" layout="fixed">

26323 | // src/features/immunizations/api.ts
26324 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
26325 | import { getRequest, setResponseStatus } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
26326 | import { z } from "zod";
26327 | 
26328 | import { and, db, eq } from "#/db/index.ts";
26329 | import { auditLog, idempotency, immunizationStatuses, immunizations } from "#/db/schema.ts";
26330 | import { clinicAccessMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/clinic-middleware";
26331 | import { freshAuthMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
26332 | 
26333 | import {
26334 |   getCoverage,
26335 |   getImmunizationMatrix,
26336 |   getPatientImmunizations,
26337 |   updateImmunization,
26338 | } from "../../db/queries/immunization.queries";
26339 | import { immunizationInputSchema, updateImmunizationInputSchema } from "./schema";
26340 | 
26341 | export const fetchPatientImmunizations = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
26342 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
26343 |   .validator(
26344 |     z.object({
26345 |       patientId: z.uuid(),
26346 |       // Optional ISO string. When omitted, the server derives age from
26347 |       // `patients.dateOfBirth` — pass it only to skip that read.
26348 |       patientDob: z.iso.datetime().optional(),
26349 |     }),
26350 |   )
26351 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {
26352 |     const dob = data.patientDob ? new Date(data.patientDob) : undefined;
26353 |     return getPatientImmunizations(data.patientId, dob);
26354 |   });
26355 | 
26356 | export const fetchImmunizationCoverage = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
26357 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
26358 |   .validator(z.object({ clinicId: z.uuid() }))
26359 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => getCoverage(data.clinicId));
26360 | 
26361 | export const fetchImmunizationMatrix = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
26362 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
26363 |   .validator(
26364 |     z.object({
26365 |       clinicId: z.uuid(),
26366 |       filter: z
26367 |         .object({
26368 |           ageBracket: z.enum(["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", ">24"]).optional(),
26369 |           onlyOverdue: z.boolean().optional(),
26370 |         })
26371 |         .optional(),
26372 |     }),
26373 |   )
26374 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => getImmunizationMatrix(data.clinicId, data.filter ?? {}));
26375 | 
26376 | export const updateImmunizationFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
26377 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
26378 |   .validator(
26379 |     z.object({
26380 |       id: z.uuid(),
26381 |       patch: updateImmunizationInputSchema,
26382 |     }),
26383 |   )
26384 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {
26385 |     const updated = await updateImmunization(data.id, data.patch);
26386 |     // Distinguish "row doesn't exist" from "row updated to empty", so the
26387 |     // caller can toast the right message.
26388 |     if (!updated) {
26389 |       throw new Error(`Immunization ${data.id} not found`);
26390 |     }
26391 |     return updated;
26392 |   });
26393 | 
26394 | export const RecordImmunizationInput = immunizationInputSchema
26395 |   .extend({
26396 |     status: z.enum(immunizationStatuses).default("given"),
26397 |     administeredDate: z.coerce.date().nullable().optional(),
26398 |     visitId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(),
26399 |   })
26400 |   .omit({ administeredById: true });
26401 | 
26402 | export type RecordImmunizationInput = z.infer<typeof RecordImmunizationInput>;
26403 | 
26404 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
26405 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
26406 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
26407 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
26408 | }
26409 | 
26410 | export const recordImmunizationFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
26411 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
26412 |   .validator(RecordImmunizationInput)
26413 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
26414 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
26415 |     const administeredDate = data.status === "given" ? (data.administeredDate ?? new Date()) : null;
26416 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
26417 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
26418 |           key: idempotencyKey,
26419 |           userId: context.user.id,
26420 |           data: { ...data, administeredDate },
26421 |         })
26422 |       : null;
26423 | 
26424 |     return db.transaction((tx) => {
26425 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
26426 |         const previous = tx
26427 |           .select()
26428 |           .from(idempotency)
26429 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
26430 |           .get();
26431 | 
26432 |         if (previous) {
26433 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
26434 |             setResponseStatus(409);
26435 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
26436 |           }
26437 | 
26438 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
26439 |           const previousId =
26440 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
26441 |             previousResult !== null &&
26442 |             "immunizationId" in previousResult &&
26443 |             typeof previousResult.immunizationId === "string"
26444 |               ? previousResult.immunizationId
26445 |               : null;
26446 | 
26447 |           if (!previousId) {
26448 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
26449 |           }
26450 | 
26451 |           const previousImmunization = tx
26452 |             .select()
26453 |             .from(immunizations)
26454 |             .where(eq(immunizations.id, previousId))
26455 |             .get();
26456 | 
26457 |           if (!previousImmunization) {
26458 |             throw new Error("The previously recorded immunization is missing.");
26459 |           }
26460 |           return previousImmunization;
26461 |         }
26462 |       }
26463 | 
26464 |       const existingDose = administeredDate
26465 |         ? tx
26466 |             .select()
26467 |             .from(immunizations)
26468 |             .where(
26469 |               and(
26470 |                 eq(immunizations.patientId, data.patientId),
26471 |                 eq(immunizations.vaccineKey, data.vaccineKey),
26472 |                 eq(immunizations.doseNumber, data.doseNumber),
26473 |                 eq(immunizations.administeredDate, administeredDate),
26474 |               ),
26475 |             )
26476 |             .get()
26477 |         : undefined;
26478 | 
26479 |       const row =
26480 |         existingDose ??
26481 |         tx
26482 |           .insert(immunizations)
26483 |           .values({
26484 |             patientId: data.patientId,
26485 |             visitId: data.visitId ?? null,
26486 |             vaccineKey: data.vaccineKey,
26487 |             vaccineName: data.vaccineName,
26488 |             doseNumber: data.doseNumber,
26489 |             targetAgeMonths: data.targetAgeMonths,
26490 |             status: data.status,
26491 |             administeredDate,
26492 |             lotNumber: data.lotNumber ?? null,
26493 |             site: data.site ?? null,
26494 |             administeredById: context.user.id,
26495 |             adverseEvents: data.adverseEvents ?? null,
26496 |             notes: data.notes ?? null,
26497 |           })
26498 |           .returning()
26499 |           .get();
26500 | 
26501 |       if (!row) {
26502 |         throw new Error("Failed to record immunization.");
26503 |       }
26504 | 
26505 |       if (!existingDose) {
26506 |         tx.insert(auditLog)
26507 |           .values({
26508 |             actorId: context.user.id,
26509 |             action: "create",
26510 |             entity: "Immunization",
26511 |             entityId: row.id,
26512 |             metadata: {
26513 |               patientId: row.patientId,
26514 |               vaccineKey: row.vaccineKey,
26515 |               doseNumber: row.doseNumber,
26516 |             },
26517 |           })
26518 |           .run();
26519 |       }
26520 | 
26521 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
26522 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
26523 |           .values({
26524 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
26525 |             key: idempotencyKey,
26526 |             requestHash,
26527 |             result: { immunizationId: row.id },
26528 |           })
26529 |           .run();
26530 |       }
26531 | 
26532 |       return row;
26533 |     });
26534 |   });
26535 |

26551 | // src/features/immunizations/api.ts
26552 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
26553 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
26554 | 
26555 | import {
26556 |   fetchImmunizationCoverage,
26557 |   fetchImmunizationMatrix,
26558 |   fetchPatientImmunizations,
26559 |   recordImmunizationFn,
26560 | } from "./functions";
26561 | 
26562 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26563 | // Query key factory
26564 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26565 | 
26566 | export const immunizationKeys = {
26567 |   all: () => ["immunizations"] as const,
26568 | 
26569 |   /** Per-patient subtree — invalidate when a dose is recorded. */
26570 |   patient: (patientId: string) => ["immunizations", "patient", patientId] as const,
26571 | 
26572 |   /** Per-clinic coverage stats. */
26573 |   coverage: (clinicId: string) => ["immunizations", "coverage", clinicId] as const,
26574 | 
26575 |   /** Clinic-wide matrix. The `filter` object is serialized into the key
26576 |    *  so different filter combinations are cached independently. */
26577 |   matrix: (clinicId: string, filter: { ageBracket?: string; onlyOverdue?: boolean } = {}) =>
26578 |     [
26579 |       "immunizations",
26580 |       "matrix",
26581 |       clinicId,
26582 |       filter.ageBracket ?? "all",
26583 |       filter.onlyOverdue ? "overdue" : "any",
26584 |     ] as const,
26585 | } as const;
26586 | 
26587 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26588 | // Query options
26589 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26590 | 
26591 | export function patientImmunizationsQuery(patientId: string, patientDob?: string) {
26592 |   return queryOptions({
26593 |     queryKey: immunizationKeys.patient(patientId),
26594 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientImmunizations({ data: { patientId, patientDob } }),
26595 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
26596 |   });
26597 | }
26598 | 
26599 | export function immunizationCoverageQuery(clinicId: string) {
26600 |   return queryOptions({
26601 |     queryKey: immunizationKeys.coverage(clinicId),
26602 |     queryFn: () => fetchImmunizationCoverage({ data: { clinicId } }),
26603 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
26604 |   });
26605 | }
26606 | 
26607 | export function immunizationMatrixQuery(
26608 |   clinicId: string,
26609 |   filter: {
26610 |     ageBracket?: "0-6" | "6-12" | "12-24" | ">24";
26611 |     onlyOverdue?: boolean;
26612 |   } = {},
26613 | ) {
26614 |   return queryOptions({
26615 |     queryKey: immunizationKeys.matrix(clinicId, filter),
26616 |     queryFn: () => fetchImmunizationMatrix({ data: { clinicId, filter } }),
26617 |     staleTime: 30 * 1000,
26618 |   });
26619 | }
26620 | 
26621 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26622 | // Invalidation helper
26623 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
26624 | 
26625 | /**
26626 |  * Invalidate every cache that a dose change affects. Call from `onSuccess`
26627 |  * of the mutation (or wrap the mutation and do it there):
26628 |  *
26629 |  *     onSuccess: () => invalidateImmunizationCaches(queryClient, patientId, clinicId)
26630 |  *
26631 |  * Note: this helper fires all invalidations in parallel and returns a
26632 |  * Promise that resolves when all queries finish invalidating. Callers that
26633 |  * need to *wait* for the refetch before navigating should `await` it;
26634 |  * callers that just want the invalidation dispatched can `void` it (as the
26635 |  * original did).
26636 |  */
26637 | export function invalidateImmunizationCaches(
26638 |   queryClient: {
26639 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
26640 |   },
26641 |   patientId: string,
26642 |   clinicId: string,
26643 | ): Promise<unknown> {
26644 |   return Promise.all([
26645 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
26646 |       queryKey: immunizationKeys.patient(patientId),
26647 |     }),
26648 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
26649 |       queryKey: immunizationKeys.coverage(clinicId),
26650 |     }),
26651 |     // Matches every matrix filter combination for this clinic.
26652 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
26653 |       queryKey: ["immunizations", "matrix", clinicId],
26654 |     }),
26655 |   ]);
26656 | }
26657 | export function useRecordImmunizationMutation() {
26658 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
26659 |   const record = useServerFn(recordImmunizationFn);
26660 | 
26661 |   return useMutation({
26662 |     mutationFn: record,
26663 |     onSuccess: async (_row, variables) => {
26664 |       const promises: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [
26665 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
26666 |           queryKey: immunizationKeys.patient(variables.data.patientId),
26667 |         }),
26668 |       ];
26669 | 
26670 |       // Coverage and matrix are clinic-scoped. The mutation input
26671 |       // doesn't carry clinicId, so invalidate by prefix — every
26672 |       // clinic's coverage/matrix cache will refetch, which is cheap
26673 |       // for typical clinic counts and safe if a user belongs to
26674 |       // multiple clinics.
26675 |       promises.push(
26676 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
26677 |           queryKey: ["immunizations", "coverage"],
26678 |         }),
26679 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
26680 |           queryKey: ["immunizations", "matrix"],
26681 |         }),
26682 |       );
26683 | 
26684 |       await Promise.all(promises);
26685 |     },
26686 |   });
26687 | }
26688 |

27035 | ```ts
27036 | // src/features/immunizations/use-record-immunization.ts
27037 | 
27038 | import type { OutboxEntry } from "@/features/outbox/store";
27039 | 
27040 | import { useQueueWrite } from "@/features/outbox/use-outbox";
27041 | 
27042 | import { type RecordImmunizationInput, recordImmunizationFn } from "./functions";
27043 | 
27044 | /**
27045 |  * Records an immunization. If online, calls the server directly. If
27046 |  * offline (or the call fails with a network error), queues to the outbox
27047 |  * so the flusher picks it up when connectivity returns.
27048 |  */
27049 | export function useRecordImmunization() {
27050 |   const queue = useQueueWrite();
27051 |   return {
27052 |     mutate: async (data: RecordImmunizationInput) => {
27053 |       if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.onLine) {
27054 |         try {
27055 |           return await recordImmunizationFn({ data });
27056 |         } catch (err) {
27057 |           // Network error → fall through to queue.
27058 |           if (!(err instanceof Error) || !/network|fetch/i.test(err.message)) throw err;
27059 |         }
27060 |       }
27061 |       const entry: OutboxEntry<RecordImmunizationInput> = {
27062 |         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
27063 |         kind: "record-immunization",
27064 |         entityId: data.patientId,
27065 |         payload: data,
27066 |         status: "queued",
27067 |         idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID(),
27068 |         optimisticSnapshot: data,
27069 |         createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
27070 |         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
27071 |         attempts: 0,
27072 |       };
27073 |       await queue.mutateAsync(entry);
27074 |       return { queued: true as const, entry };
27075 |     },
27076 |   };
27077 | }

27509 |   return rem === 0 ? `${years}y` : `${years}y ${rem}m`;
27510 | };
27511 | 
27512 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
27513 | // Formatting helpers
27514 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
27515 | 
27516 | function asNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
27517 |   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
27518 | }
27519 | 
27520 | function asDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
27521 |   if (value instanceof Date) {
27522 |     return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value;
27523 |   }
27524 |   if (typeof value === "string") {
27525 |     const d = new Date(value);
27526 |     return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
27527 |   }
27528 |   return null;
27529 | }
27530 | 
27531 | function zVariant(z: number | null): "success" | "warning" | "destructive" | "subtle" {
27532 |   if (z === null) return "subtle";
27533 |   const abs = Math.abs(z);
27534 |   if (abs >= 3) return "destructive";
27535 |   if (abs >= 2) return "warning";
27536 |   if (abs <= 1) return "success";
27537 |   return "subtle";
27538 | }
27539 | 
27540 | function zSeverityLabel(z: number): string {
27541 |   const abs = Math.abs(z);
27542 |   if (abs >= 3) return "severe";
27543 |   if (abs >= 2) return "moderate";
27544 |   if (abs <= 1) return "normal";
27545 |   return "mild";
27546 | }

27656 | interface MeasurementsTableProps<TRoute extends AnyRoute> {
27657 |   patientId: string;
27658 |   indicator: Indicator;
27659 |   page: number;
27660 |   size: PageSize;
27661 |   route?: TRoute;
27662 |   initialData?: IndicatorSeriesRow[];
27663 |   initialDataUpdatedAt?: number;
27664 | }
27665 | 
27666 | export function MeasurementsTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
27667 |   patientId,
27668 |   indicator,
27669 |   page,
27670 |   size,
27671 |   route,
27672 |   initialData,
27673 |   initialDataUpdatedAt,
27674 | }: MeasurementsTableProps<TRoute>) {
27675 |   // ── read via factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────
27676 |   const query = useQuery({
27677 |     ...seriesQuery(patientId, indicator),
27678 |     initialData,
27679 |     initialDataUpdatedAt,
27680 |   });
27681 | 
27682 |   const queryData = query.data;
27683 |   const all = queryData ?? [];
27684 |   const total = all.length;
27685 |   const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
27686 | 
27687 |   const pageRows = React.useMemo(
27688 |     () => (queryData ?? []).slice((page - 1) * size, page * size),
27689 |     [queryData, page, size],
27690 |   );
27691 | 
27692 |   const unit = INDICATOR_UNIT[indicator];
27693 |   const meta = React.useMemo<MeasurementsTableMeta>(() => ({ unit, indicator }), [unit, indicator]);
27694 | 
27695 |   const table = useTable({
27696 |     features,
27697 |     columns,
27698 |     data: pageRows,
27699 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
27700 |     manualPagination: true,
27701 |     rowCount: total,
27702 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
27703 |     meta,
27704 |   });
27705 | 
27706 |   return (
27707 |     <DataTable
27708 |       ariaLabel="Measurements"
27709 |       emptyMessage={
27710 |         <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
27711 |           <IconTile size="lg">
27712 |             <RulerIcon aria-hidden="true" />
27713 |           </IconTile>
27714 |           <p>No {INDICATOR_LABEL[indicator].toLowerCase()} measurements recorded yet.</p>
27715 |         </div>
27716 |       }
27717 |       errorDescription={
27718 |         query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "Check your connection and try again."
27719 |       }
27720 |       errorTitle="Could Not Load Measurements"
27721 |       outOfRange={
27722 |         page > pageCount && total > 0
27723 |           ? {
27724 |               backTo: () => (
27725 |                 <Link
27726 |                   className={buttonVariants()}
27727 |                   params={{ patientId }}
27728 |                   search={{ tab: "overview" }}
27729 |                   to="/app/patients/$patientId"
27730 |                 >
27731 |                   Back To First Page
27732 |                 </Link>
27733 |               ),
27734 |             }
27735 |           : undefined
27736 |       }
27737 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
27738 |       query={query}
27739 |       table={table}
27740 |     />
27741 |   );
27742 | }

28127 | // Conventions in this file (matching `patients/queries.ts`,
28128 | // `appointments/queries.ts`, `prescriptions/queries.ts`):
28129 | //
28130 | //   1. Query keys come from `measurementKeys` — never raw arrays.
28131 | //   2. `queryOptions` factories live in this file. Components call
28132 | //      `useQuery(measurementByIdQuery(id))`, not inline fetchers.
28133 | //   3. Mutations are hooks (`useCreateMeasurementsMutation`, …) that
28134 | //      call `useServerFn` + `useMutation` and **own their invalidation**.
28135 | //      Callers do not pass `onSuccess` to invalidate — the hook does.
28136 | //   4. `invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite` is the single source of truth
28137 | //      for what a measurement write touches. If you change the cache
28138 | //      graph, change it there.
28139 | //
28140 | // Measurement writes touch three feature trees: `measurements`
28141 | // (this file), `series` (growth charts) and `latest` (dashboard).
28142 | // All three are invalidated by `invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite`.
28143 | 
28144 | import type { z } from "zod";
28145 | 
28146 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
28147 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
28148 | 
28149 | import type { IndicatorSchema } from "./schema";
28150 | 
28151 | import {
28152 |   addMeasurementWithZScoreFn,
28153 |   createMeasurementsFn,
28154 |   createMeasurementsStandaloneFn,
28155 |   deleteMeasurementFn,
28156 |   fetchClassificationCounts,
28157 |   fetchFlaggedMeasurements,
28158 |   fetchIndicatorTrend,
28159 |   fetchMeasurementById,
28160 |   fetchMeasurementsForVisit,
28161 |   fetchSevereCases,
28162 |   updateMeasurementFn,
28163 | } from "./functions";
28164 | 
28165 | type Indicator = z.infer<typeof IndicatorSchema>;
28166 | 
28167 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28168 | // Constants
28169 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28170 | 
28171 | const STALE_TIMES = {
28172 |   /** Single measurement row. */
28173 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
28174 |   /** Measurements attached to one visit. */
28175 |   VISIT: 60_000,
28176 |   /** One patient's trend for one indicator (growth chart data). */
28177 |   TREND: 30_000,
28178 |   /** Latest panel — feeds the dashboard card and the composer. */
28179 |   LATEST: 30_000,
28180 |   /** Flagged measurements feed the referral queue. Shorter because
28181 |    *  concurrent prescribers add rows at unpredictable times. */
28182 |   FLAGGED: 15_000,
28183 |   /** Clinic-wide aggregates (classification counts, severe cases). */
28184 |   CLINIC: 120_000,
28185 | } as const;
28186 | 
28187 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28188 | // Query key factory
28189 | //
28190 | // Every key starts with "measurement". The growth feature's own keys
28191 | // (`series`, `band`) are separate trees by design — measurement writes
28192 | // invalidate both, but neither key lives here. That keeps the tree
28193 | // boundaries honest.
28194 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28195 | 
28196 | export const measurementKeys = {
28197 |   all: () => ["measurement"] as const,
28198 | 
28199 |   /** One measurement row. */
28200 |   detail: (measurementId: string) => ["measurement", "detail", measurementId] as const,
28201 | 
28202 |   /** All measurements attached to one visit. */
28203 |   byVisit: (visitId: string) => ["measurement", "visit", visitId] as const,
28204 | 
28205 |   /** Flagged measurements for a patient, keyed by threshold so a
28206 |    *  "show >2 SD" and "show >3 SD" view don't collide. */
28207 |   flagged: (patientId: string, zThreshold: number) =>
28208 |     ["measurement", "flagged", patientId, zThreshold] as const,
28209 | 
28210 |   /** One indicator's time series for one patient. */
28211 |   trend: (patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) =>
28212 |     ["measurement", "trend", patientId, indicator] as const,
28213 | 
28214 |   /** Latest measurement per indicator, for one patient. */
28215 |   latestPanel: (patientId: string) => ["measurement", "latest-panel", patientId] as const,
28216 | 
28217 |   /** Clinic-wide classification distribution. */
28218 |   classificationCounts: (clinicId: string) =>
28219 |     ["measurement", "classification-counts", clinicId] as const,
28220 | 
28221 |   /** Clinic-wide severe-case queue (|z| ≥ 3). */
28222 |   severeCases: (clinicId: string) => ["measurement", "severe-cases", clinicId] as const,
28223 | } as const;
28224 | 
28225 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28226 | // Query options
28227 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28228 | 
28229 | export function measurementByIdQuery(measurementId: string) {
28230 |   return queryOptions({
28231 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.detail(measurementId),
28232 |     queryFn: () => fetchMeasurementById({ data: { measurementId } }),
28233 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
28234 |   });
28235 | }
28236 | 
28237 | export function measurementsForVisitQuery(visitId: string) {
28238 |   return queryOptions({
28239 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.byVisit(visitId),
28240 |     queryFn: () => fetchMeasurementsForVisit({ data: { visitId } }),
28241 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.VISIT,
28242 |   });
28243 | }
28244 | 
28245 | export function flaggedMeasurementsQuery(patientId: string, zThreshold = 2) {
28246 |   return queryOptions({
28247 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.flagged(patientId, zThreshold),
28248 |     queryFn: () => fetchFlaggedMeasurements({ data: { patientId, zThreshold } }),
28249 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.FLAGGED,
28250 |   });
28251 | }
28252 | 
28253 | export function indicatorTrendQuery(patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) {
28254 |   return queryOptions({
28255 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.trend(patientId, indicator),
28256 |     queryFn: () => fetchIndicatorTrend({ data: { patientId, indicator } }),
28257 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.TREND,
28258 |   });
28259 | }
28260 | 
28261 | // export function latestPanelQuery(patientId: string) {
28262 | // 	return queryOptions({
28263 | // 		queryKey: measurementKeys.latestPanel(patientId),
28264 | // 		queryFn: () => fetchLatestPanelViaRelations({ data: { patientId } }),
28265 | // 		staleTime: STALE_TIMES.LATEST
28266 | // 	});
28267 | // }
28268 | 
28269 | export function classificationCountsQuery(clinicId: string) {
28270 |   return queryOptions({
28271 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.classificationCounts(clinicId),
28272 |     queryFn: () => fetchClassificationCounts({ data: { clinicId } }),
28273 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
28274 |   });
28275 | }
28276 | 
28277 | export function severeCasesQuery(clinicId: string) {
28278 |   return queryOptions({
28279 |     queryKey: measurementKeys.severeCases(clinicId),
28280 |     queryFn: () => fetchSevereCases({ data: { clinicId } }),
28281 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
28282 |   });

28284 | 
28285 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28286 | // Invalidation
28287 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28288 | //
28289 | // One helper, one list. A measurement write touches:
28290 | //
28291 | //   1. The measurement's own subtrees (detail, visit, trend, latest panel,
28292 | //      flagged at every threshold the UI might have cached).
28293 | //   2. The growth feature's `series` tree — the chart reads from a
28294 | //      different server fn than `indicatorTrend`, and both must refresh.
28295 | //   3. The growth feature's `band` tree — the current marker band
28296 | //      depends on the chart's latest x.
28297 | //   4. The dashboard's `latest` tree (aliased separately in older code).
28298 | //
28299 | // The clinic-wide aggregates (classification counts, severe cases) are
28300 | // NOT invalidated by default. They're an admin-facing report, they're
28301 | // expensive, and a fresh report is a click away. If you add a live
28302 | // clinic dashboard, extend the helper — don't add per-call invalidation
28303 | // at the mutation site.
28304 | 
28305 | interface InvalidationTarget {
28306 |   patientId: string;
28307 |   indicator?: Indicator;
28308 |   measurementId?: string;
28309 |   visitId?: string;
28310 | }
28311 | 
28312 | export function invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(
28313 |   queryClient: {
28314 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
28315 |   },
28316 |   args: InvalidationTarget,
28317 | ): Promise<unknown> {
28318 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
28319 |     // The patient's growth series (chart) — keyed in the growth feature.
28320 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["series", args.patientId] }),
28321 |     // The current band marker on the chart.
28322 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["band"] }),
28323 |     // Latest-panel card on the dashboard.
28324 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
28325 |       queryKey: measurementKeys.latestPanel(args.patientId),
28326 |     }),
28327 |     // Flagged lists at both thresholds the UI actually renders
28328 |     // (filtered flagged list uses 2, referral queue uses 3).
28329 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
28330 |       queryKey: measurementKeys.flagged(args.patientId, 2),
28331 |     }),
28332 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
28333 |       queryKey: measurementKeys.flagged(args.patientId, 3),
28334 |     }),
28335 |   ];
28336 | 
28337 |   if (args.indicator) {
28338 |     promises.push(
28339 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
28340 |         queryKey: measurementKeys.trend(args.patientId, args.indicator),
28341 |       }),
28342 |     );
28343 |   }
28344 |   if (args.measurementId) {
28345 |     promises.push(
28346 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
28347 |         queryKey: measurementKeys.detail(args.measurementId),
28348 |       }),
28349 |     );
28350 |   }
28351 |   if (args.visitId) {
28352 |     promises.push(
28353 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
28354 |         queryKey: measurementKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
28355 |       }),
28356 |     );
28357 |   }
28358 | 
28359 |   return Promise.all(promises);
28360 | }
28361 | 
28362 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28363 | // Mutations
28364 | //
28365 | // Each hook wraps `useServerFn` + `useMutation` and returns the standard
28366 | // React Query mutation object. `onSuccess` returns the invalidation
28367 | // promise so `isPending` stays `true` through the refetch — the submit
28368 | // button doesn't re-enable while stale data is still on screen.
28369 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28370 | 
28371 | /**
28372 |  * Create measurements against an existing visit.
28373 |  *
28374 |  * The caller passes the payload shape the server function accepts
28375 |  * (validated by `VisitRowsSchema`) plus the `patientId` so the hook
28376 |  * can invalidate the patient's growth caches.
28377 |  *
28378 |  * The `onSuccess` reads `variables.data.rows` to derive which
28379 |  * indicators to invalidate — the server function returns rows but
28380 |  * re-deriving from the request keeps the invalidation correct even if
28381 |  * the server drops some rows (e.g. dedupe).
28382 |  */
28383 | export function useCreateMeasurementsMutation(args: { patientId: string }) {
28384 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
28385 |   const createForVisit = useServerFn(createMeasurementsFn);
28386 | 
28387 |   return useMutation({
28388 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "create-visit", args.patientId],
28389 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof createForVisit>[0]) => createForVisit(input),
28390 |     onSuccess: async (_data, variables) => {
28391 |       const indicators = [...new Set(variables.data.rows.map((r) => r.indicator))] as Indicator[];
28392 | 
28393 |       await Promise.all(
28394 |         indicators.map((indicator) =>
28395 |           invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
28396 |             patientId: args.patientId,
28397 |             visitId: variables.data.visitId,
28398 |             indicator,
28399 |           }),
28400 |         ),
28401 |       );
28402 |     },
28403 |   });
28404 | }
28405 | 
28406 | /**
28407 |  * Create measurements standalone — the server creates a measurement-
28408 |  * only visit first, then inserts the rows.
28409 |  *
28410 |  * Because the server owns the new visit id, we cannot invalidate the
28411 |  * `byVisit` subtree here (no id to invalidate). We DO invalidate the
28412 |  * series, latest panel, and flagged lists — those are keyed by
28413 |  * patient, not visit.
28414 |  */
28415 | export function useCreateStandaloneMeasurementsMutation(args: { patientId: string }) {
28416 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
28417 |   const createStandalone = useServerFn(createMeasurementsStandaloneFn);
28418 | 
28419 |   return useMutation({
28420 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "create-standalone", args.patientId],
28421 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof createStandalone>[0]) => createStandalone(input),
28422 |     onSuccess: async (_data, variables) => {
28423 |       const indicators = [...new Set(variables.data.rows.map((r) => r.indicator))] as Indicator[];
28424 | 
28425 |       await Promise.all(
28426 |         indicators.map((indicator) =>
28427 |           invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
28428 |             patientId: args.patientId,
28429 |             indicator,
28430 |           }),
28431 |         ),
28432 |       );
28433 |     },
28434 |   });
28435 | }
28436 | 
28437 | /**
28438 |  * Add one measurement with a server-computed z-score.
28439 |  *
28440 |  * Used by the composer's vitals section, where the client doesn't have
28441 |  * LMS context and lets the server compute z, percentile, and
28442 |  * classification. The `indicator` is in the input, so the trend key
28443 |  * can be invalidated precisely.
28444 |  */
28445 | export function useAddMeasurementWithZScoreMutation(args: { patientId: string }) {
28446 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
28447 |   const addWithZ = useServerFn(addMeasurementWithZScoreFn);
28448 | 
28449 |   return useMutation({
28450 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "add-with-z", args.patientId],
28451 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof addWithZ>[0]) => addWithZ(input),
28452 |     onSuccess: async (row, variables) => {
28453 |       await invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
28454 |         patientId: args.patientId,
28455 |         visitId: variables.data.visitId,
28456 |         indicator: variables.data.indicator,
28457 |         // The server returns the new row — its id is safe to
28458 |         // invalidate even though the detail query probably
28459 |         // wasn't mounted.
28460 |         measurementId: row?.id,
28461 |       });
28462 |     },
28463 |   });
28464 | }
28465 | 
28466 | /**
28467 |  * Update one measurement (value, or the computed z/percentile/
28468 |  * classification columns).
28469 |  *
28470 |  * Update is rarer than create; the invalidation list is the same.
28471 |  * `indicator` is not in the input — the caller should pass it from
28472 |  * the row they're editing, or accept that only the coarse subtrees
28473 |  * (series, band, latest, flagged) refresh.
28474 |  */
28475 | export function useUpdateMeasurementMutation(args: { patientId: string; indicator?: Indicator }) {
28476 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
28477 |   const update = useServerFn(updateMeasurementFn);
28478 | 
28479 |   return useMutation({
28480 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "update", args.patientId],
28481 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof update>[0]) => update(input),
28482 |     onSuccess: async (_row, variables) => {
28483 |       await invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
28484 |         patientId: args.patientId,
28485 |         measurementId: variables.data.measurementId,
28486 |         indicator: args.indicator,
28487 |       });
28488 |     },
28489 |   });
28490 | }
28491 | 
28492 | /**
28493 |  * Delete one measurement.
28494 |  *
28495 |  * The server returns `{ ok: true }`, not the deleted row — so
28496 |  * `indicator` cannot be derived and must be passed by the caller
28497 |  * (they were rendering the row, they know it).
28498 |  */
28499 | export function useDeleteMeasurementMutation(args: {
28500 |   patientId: string;
28501 |   indicator?: Indicator;
28502 |   visitId?: string;
28503 | }) {
28504 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
28505 |   const remove = useServerFn(deleteMeasurementFn);
28506 | 
28507 |   return useMutation({
28508 |     mutationKey: ["measurement", "delete", args.patientId],
28509 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof remove>[0]) => remove(input),
28510 |     onSuccess: async (_result, variables) => {
28511 |       await invalidateAfterMeasurementWrite(queryClient, {
28512 |         patientId: args.patientId,
28513 |         measurementId: variables.data.measurementId,
28514 |         visitId: args.visitId,
28515 |         indicator: args.indicator,
28516 |       });
28517 |     },
28518 |   });
28519 | }

28937 | type SendResult =

28943 | /**

28955 |       });

28957 |     } catch (err) {
28958 |       return classifyServerError(err);
28959 |     }
28960 |   },

28965 |         data: entry.payload as never,

28967 |       });
28968 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };
28969 |     } catch (err) {

28971 |     }
28972 |   },

28979 |       });

28981 |     } catch (err) {

28983 |     }
28984 |   },

28987 |     try {

28991 |       });

28993 |     } catch (err) {

28995 |     }
28996 |   },

28999 |     try {
29000 |       const r = await createMeasurementFn({
29001 |         data: entry.payload as never,
29002 |         headers: { "Idempotency-Key": entry.idempotencyKey },
29003 |       });
29004 |       return { ok: true, serverSnapshot: r };

29010 | 
29011 | function classifyServerError(err: unknown): SendResult {
29012 |   const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
29013 |   if (/409|conflict/i.test(msg)) {
29014 |     // Server should return the winning record in the error body.
29015 |     const serverSnapshot = (err as { serverSnapshot?: unknown })?.serverSnapshot ?? null;
29016 |     return { ok: false, kind: "conflict", serverSnapshot };
29017 |   }
29018 |   if (/4\d\d/.test(msg)) return { ok: false, kind: "fatal", error: msg };
29019 |   return { ok: false, kind: "retry", error: msg };
29020 | }
29021 | 
29022 | let running = false;
29023 | 
29024 | export async function flushOutbox(): Promise<void> {
29025 |   if (running) return;
29026 |   if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && !navigator.onLine) return;
29027 |   running = true;
29028 |   try {
29029 |     // Drain in a loop so a burst of writes clears in one pass.
29030 |     // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
29031 |     while (true) {
29032 |       const entry = await outboxStore.claimNext();
29033 |       if (!entry) break;
29034 | 
29035 |       // Exponential backoff for previously-failed entries.
29036 |       const delay = Math.min(30_000, 500 * 2 ** (entry.attempts - 1));
29037 |       if (entry.attempts > 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay));
29038 | 
29039 |       const sender = senders[entry.kind];
29040 |       const result = await sender(entry);
29041 | 
29042 |       if (result.ok) {
29043 |         await outboxStore.put({
29044 |           ...entry,
29045 |           status: "synced",
29046 |           serverSnapshot: result.serverSnapshot,
29047 |           error: undefined,
29048 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
29049 |         });
29050 |       } else if (result.kind === "conflict") {
29051 |         await outboxStore.put({
29052 |           ...entry,
29053 |           status: "conflict",
29054 |           serverSnapshot: result.serverSnapshot,
29055 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
29056 |         });
29057 |       } else if (result.kind === "fatal") {
29058 |         await outboxStore.put({
29059 |           ...entry,
29060 |           status: "failed",
29061 |           error: result.error,
29062 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
29063 |         });
29064 |       } else {
29065 |         // retry — put back to queued so the next flush picks it up.
29066 |         await outboxStore.put({
29067 |           ...entry,
29068 |           status: "queued",
29069 |           error: result.error,
29070 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
29071 |         });
29072 |         // Stop draining — likely a network blip.
29073 |         break;
29074 |       }
29075 |     }
29076 |   } finally {
29077 |     running = false;
29078 |     // Housekeeping — remove synced entries older than 24h.
29079 |     await outboxStore.clearSyncedOlderThan(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
29080 |   }
29081 | }
29082 | 
29083 | /** Wire this once from `_auth/app/route.tsx`. */
29084 | export function installOutboxFlusher(): () => void {
29085 |   const onOnline = () => void flushOutbox();
29086 |   const onFocus = () => void flushOutbox();
29087 |   window.addEventListener("online", onOnline);
29088 |   window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
29089 |   // Drain once on install (in case the tab was closed mid-flight).
29090 |   void flushOutbox();
29091 |   const interval = setInterval(() => void flushOutbox(), 30_000);
29092 |   return () => {
29093 |     window.removeEventListener("online", onOnline);
29094 |     window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
29095 |     clearInterval(interval);
29096 |   };
29097 | }
