29102 | ```ts
29103 | // src/features/outbox/store.ts
29104 | export type OutboxStatus = "queued" | "syncing" | "synced" | "conflict" | "failed";
29105 | 
29106 | export type OutboxKind =
29107 |   | "record-immunization"
29108 |   | "save-visit"
29109 |   | "save-prescription"
29110 |   | "set-milestone"
29111 |   | "create-measurement";
29112 | 
29113 | export type OutboxEntry<T = unknown> = {
29114 |   id: string;
29115 |   kind: OutboxKind;
29116 |   entityId: string;
29117 |   payload: T;
29118 |   status: OutboxStatus;
29119 |   /** Stable per *logical write* — survives retries. Server dedupes on this. */
29120 |   idempotencyKey: string;
29121 |   /** Last known server version for optimistic-concurrency (ETag/updatedAt). */
29122 |   baseVersion?: string;
29123 |   /** Local optimistic snapshot so the UI can render before sync. */
29124 |   optimisticSnapshot?: unknown;
29125 |   createdAt: string;
29126 |   updatedAt: string;
29127 |   attempts: number;
29128 |   /** Server's canonical state when a 409 comes back. */
29129 |   serverSnapshot?: unknown;
29130 |   error?: string;
29131 | };
29132 | 
29133 | const DB_NAME = "g-tracker";
29134 | const DB_VERSION = 1;
29135 | const STORE = "outbox";
29136 | 
29137 | let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase> | null = null;
29138 | 
29139 | function open(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
29140 |   if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
29141 |   dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29142 |     const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
29143 |     req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
29144 |       const db = req.result;
29145 |       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) {
29146 |         const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
29147 |         store.createIndex("by-status", "status");
29148 |         store.createIndex("by-created", "createdAt");
29149 |       }
29150 |     };
29151 |     req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
29152 |     req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
29153 |   });
29154 |   return dbPromise;
29155 | }
29156 | 
29157 | export const outboxStore = {
29158 |   async list(): Promise<OutboxEntry[]> {
29159 |     const db = await open();
29160 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29161 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE).objectStore(STORE).getAll();
29162 |       req.onsuccess = () =>
29163 |         resolve(
29164 |           (req.result as OutboxEntry[]).sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt)),
29165 |         );
29166 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
29167 |     });
29168 |   },
29169 | 
29170 |   async byId(id: string): Promise<OutboxEntry | undefined> {
29171 |     const db = await open();
29172 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29173 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE).objectStore(STORE).get(id);
29174 |       req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result as OutboxEntry | undefined);
29175 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
29176 |     });
29177 |   },
29178 | 
29179 |   async put(entry: OutboxEntry): Promise<void> {
29180 |     const db = await open();
29181 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29182 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite").objectStore(STORE).put(entry);
29183 |       req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
29184 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
29185 |     });
29186 |   },
29187 | 
29188 |   async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
29189 |     const db = await open();
29190 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29191 |       const req = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite").objectStore(STORE).delete(id);
29192 |       req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
29193 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
29194 |     });
29195 |   },
29196 | 
29197 |   /**
29198 |    * Atomically claim the oldest `queued` entry and mark it `syncing`.
29199 |    * Uses a readwrite transaction so two tabs cannot claim the same row.
29200 |    */
29201 |   async claimNext(): Promise<OutboxEntry | undefined> {
29202 |     const db = await open();
29203 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29204 |       const tx = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
29205 |       const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
29206 |       const idx = store.index("by-status");
29207 |       const req = idx.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only("queued"));
29208 |       req.onsuccess = () => {
29209 |         const cursor = req.result;
29210 |         if (!cursor) return;
29211 |         const entry = cursor.value as OutboxEntry;
29212 |         const claimed: OutboxEntry = {
29213 |           ...entry,
29214 |           status: "syncing",
29215 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
29216 |           attempts: entry.attempts + 1,
29217 |         };
29218 |         cursor.update(claimed);
29219 |         cursor.continue();
29220 |         // Resolve after tx commit — closing over `claimed` is safe
29221 |         // because IndexedDB serialises the transaction.
29222 |         tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(claimed);
29223 |       };
29224 |       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
29225 |       tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
29226 |     });
29227 |   },
29228 | 
29229 |   async clearSyncedOlderThan(ms: number): Promise<void> {
29230 |     const db = await open();
29231 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29232 |       const tx = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
29233 |       const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
29234 |       const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - ms).toISOString();
29235 |       const idx = store.index("by-created");
29236 |       const req = idx.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.upperBound(cutoff));
29237 |       req.onsuccess = () => {
29238 |         const cursor = req.result;
29239 |         if (!cursor) return;
29240 |         const entry = cursor.value as OutboxEntry;
29241 |         if (entry.status === "synced") cursor.delete();
29242 |         cursor.continue();
29243 |       };
29244 |       tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
29245 |       tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
29246 |     });
29247 |   },
29248 | };

29346 | 
29347 | ```ts
29348 | // src/features/outbox/use-outbox.ts
29349 | import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
29350 | 
29351 | import { flushOutbox } from "./flusher";
29352 | import { type OutboxEntry, outboxStore } from "./store";
29353 | 
29354 | const key = ["outbox"] as const;
29355 | 
29356 | export function useOutbox() {
29357 |   return useQuery({
29358 |     queryKey: key,
29359 |     queryFn: () => outboxStore.list(),
29360 |     staleTime: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
29361 |     // Poll while anything is still in-flight so the banner updates.
29362 |     refetchInterval: (query) => {
29363 |       const data = query.state.data;
29364 |       return data?.some((e) => e.status === "queued" || e.status === "syncing") ? 2_000 : false;
29365 |     },
29366 |   });
29367 | }
29368 | 
29369 | export function useOutboxEntry(id: string) {
29370 |   return useQuery({
29371 |     queryKey: [...key, id],
29372 |     queryFn: () => outboxStore.byId(id),
29373 |     staleTime: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
29374 |   });
29375 | }
29376 | 
29377 | /**
29378 |  * Enqueue a write. Applies it optimistically to the outbox cache so the
29379 |  * banner and the per-item status badge update instantly.
29380 |  */
29381 | export function useQueueWrite() {
29382 |   const qc = useQueryClient();
29383 |   return useMutation({
29384 |     mutationFn: async (entry: OutboxEntry) => {
29385 |       await outboxStore.put(entry);
29386 |       void flushOutbox(); // kick the flusher
29387 |       return entry;
29388 |     },
29389 |     onMutate: async (entry) => {
29390 |       await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: key });
29391 |       const prev = qc.getQueryData<OutboxEntry[]>(key) ?? [];
29392 |       qc.setQueryData(key, [entry, ...prev]);
29393 |       return { prev };
29394 |     },
29395 |     onError: (_err, _entry, ctx) => {
29396 |       if (ctx) qc.setQueryData(key, ctx.prev);
29397 |     },
29398 |     onSettled: () => {
29399 |       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });
29400 |     },
29401 |   });
29402 | }
29403 | 
29404 | /**
29405 |  * Resolve a conflict. Caller picks which side wins.
29406 |  * - "keep-local": re-queue with a fresh idempotency key and the server's
29407 |  *   current `baseVersion`, so the server accepts the new write.
29408 |  * - "use-server": discard the local entry and refresh the relevant query.
29409 |  */
29410 | export function useResolveConflict() {
29411 |   const qc = useQueryClient();
29412 |   return useMutation({
29413 |     mutationFn: async ({
29414 |       id,
29415 |       resolution,
29416 |     }: {
29417 |       id: string;
29418 |       resolution: "keep-local" | "use-server";
29419 |     }) => {
29420 |       const entry = await outboxStore.byId(id);
29421 |       if (!entry) return;
29422 |       if (resolution === "use-server") {
29423 |         await outboxStore.delete(id);
29424 |       } else {
29425 |         await outboxStore.put({
29426 |           ...entry,
29427 |           status: "queued",
29428 |           idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID(),
29429 |           baseVersion: undefined,
29430 |           error: undefined,
29431 |           attempts: 0,
29432 |           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
29433 |         });
29434 |       }
29435 |       void flushOutbox();
29436 |     },
29437 |     onSettled: () => {
29438 |       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });
29439 |     },
29440 |   });
29441 | }

29914 | export function PatientsTable<TRoute extends AnyRoute>({
29915 |   route,

29917 |   page = 1,
29918 |   size = 20,
29919 |   initialData,

29928 |   const all = patients ?? query.data ?? EMPTY_PATIENTS;
29929 |   const total = all.length;
29930 |   const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
29931 |   const pageRows = useMemo(() => all.slice((page - 1) * size, page * size), [all, page, size]);
29932 | 
29933 |   const table = useTable(
29934 |     {
29935 |       key: "patients-table",
29936 |       features,
29937 |       columns,
29938 |       data: pageRows,
29939 |       getRowId: (patient) => patient.id,
29940 |       manualPagination: true,
29941 |       rowCount: total,
29942 |       state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
29943 |     },
29944 |     (state) => ({ pagination: state.pagination }),
29945 |   );
29946 | 
29947 |   return (
29948 |     <DataTable
29949 |       ariaLabel="Patients"
29950 |       emptyMessage="No patients registered in this clinic yet."
29951 |       errorDescription="The patient roster could not load. Check your connection and try again."
29952 |       errorTitle="Something Went Wrong"
29953 |       outOfRange={
29954 |         query.data && page > pageCount
29955 |           ? {
29956 |               backTo: () => (
29957 |                 <Link className={buttonVariants()} to={"/app/patients"}>
29958 |                   Back To First Page
29959 |                 </Link>
29960 |               ),
29961 |             }
29962 |           : undefined
29963 |       }
29964 |       pagination={{ page, pageCount, route, size }}
29965 |       query={query}
29966 |       table={table}
29967 |     />
29968 |   );
29969 | }

30303 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
30304 | // Invalidation helpers
30305 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
30306 | 
30307 | /**
30308 |  * Call this after a patient mutation succeeds. Invalidates the roster for
30309 |  * the clinic and, for updates/deletes, the patient's own detail subtree
30310 |  * (which covers composer, history, chart, and summary).
30311 |  *
30312 |  * `createPatientFn` doesn't know the new patient's id yet, so pass only
30313 |  * `clinicId` — the roster and any list view will refetch.
30314 |  *
30315 |  * `updatePatientFn` and `deletePatientFn` should pass both.
30316 |  */
30317 | export function invalidateAfterPatientMutation(
30318 |   queryClient: {
30319 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
30320 |   },
30321 |   args: {
30322 |     clinicId: string;
30323 |     patientId?: string;
30324 |   },
30325 | ): Promise<unknown> {
30326 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
30327 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
30328 |       queryKey: patientKeys.list(args.clinicId),
30329 |     }),
30330 |   ];
30331 | 
30332 |   if (args.patientId) {
30333 |     // `detail` is the parent of composer/history/chart/summary — one
30334 |     // invalidation drops all four.
30335 |     promises.push(
30336 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
30337 |         queryKey: patientKeys.detail(args.patientId),
30338 |       }),
30339 |     );
30340 |   }
30341 | 
30342 |   return Promise.all(promises);
30343 | }
30344 | // src/features/patients/queries.ts — append
30345 | 
30346 | /**
30347 |  * Update a patient.
30348 |  *
30349 |  * Invalidates:
30350 |  *   - the patient's detail subtree (composer, history, chart, summary)
30351 |  *   - the roster list for the patient's clinic
30352 |  *   - the patient search results (name changes invalidate the search)
30353 |  *
30354 |  * `patientId` is required; `clinicId` is optional because the mutation
30355 |  * input doesn't carry it — the caller usually has it from `useAuthSuspense`.
30356 |  */
30357 | export function useUpdatePatientMutation(args: { patientId: string; clinicId?: string }) {
30358 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
30359 |   const updatePatient = useServerFn(updatePatientFn);
30360 | 
30361 |   return useMutation({
30362 |     mutationFn: updatePatient,
30363 |     onSuccess: () => {
30364 |       void Promise.all([
30365 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
30366 |           queryKey: patientKeys.detail(args.patientId),
30367 |         }),
30368 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: patientKeys.all() }),
30369 |         ...(args.clinicId
30370 |           ? [
30371 |               queryClient.invalidateQueries({
30372 |                 queryKey: patientKeys.list(args.clinicId),
30373 |               }),
30374 |             ]
30375 |           : []),
30376 |       ]);
30377 |     },
30378 |   });
30379 | }
30380 | 
30381 | type CreatePatientInput = z.infer<typeof patientInsertSchema>;
30382 | 
30383 | export function useCreatePatientMutation(args: { clinicId?: string }) {
30384 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
30385 |   const createPatient = useServerFn(createPatientFn);
30386 | 
30387 |   return useMutation({
30388 |     mutationKey: ["patient", "create", args.clinicId ?? ""],
30389 |     mutationFn: (input: CreatePatientInput) => createPatient({ data: input }),
30390 |     onSuccess: (_patient, variables) => {
30391 |       // Roster for this clinic + any search results are now stale.
30392 |       void invalidateAfterPatientMutation(queryClient, {
30393 |         clinicId: variables.clinicId,
30394 |       });
30395 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: patientKeys.all() });
30396 |     },
30397 |   });
30398 | }

30422 | export const patientUpdateSchema = createUpdateSchema(patients, {
30423 |   mrn: (s) => s.min(1).max(32),
30424 |   firstName: (s) => s.min(1).max(80),
30425 |   lastName: (s) => s.min(1).max(80),
30426 |   weightKg: (s) => s.min(0.1).max(300), // NEW
30427 | });
30428 | export type Patient = typeof patients.$inferSelect;
30429 | export type NewPatient = typeof patients.$inferInsert;

30431 | export const patientCreateInputSchema = z.object({
30432 |   clinicId: z.string().trim().min(1),
30433 |   firstName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120),
30434 |   lastName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120),
30435 |   sex: z.enum(["male", "female"]),

30437 |   phone: z.string().nullable().optional(),

30440 |   gestationalAgeWeeks: z.number().min(22).max(44).nullable().optional(),
30441 | });

30444 | // cross-field refinement is ever added above, extract a plain `patientShape`
30445 | // first and follow the visit/measurement pattern.

30484 | const noteContentRefinement = <T extends z.ZodType>(schema: T) =>
30485 |   schema.refine(

32158 |   const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

32161 |     const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();

32163 |     return COMPOSER_DRUGS.filter(
32164 |       (d) =>
32165 |         d.genericName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
32166 |         d.brandNames.some((b) => b.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
32167 |         d.indication.toLowerCase().includes(q),
32168 |     ).slice(0, MAX_RESULTS);
32169 |   }, [query]);

32175 |       onSelect(drug);

32179 |     },

32188 |         event.preventDefault();

32198 |         return;

32201 |         setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
32202 |         return;

32205 |         setActiveIndex(0);

32210 |         return;

32212 |         event.preventDefault();

32627 | import type { ComposerDrug } from "../formulary";
32628 | import type { InteractionWarning } from "./SafetyRail";
32629 | 
32630 | export function computeInteractions(args: {
32631 |   drug: ComposerDrug | undefined;
32632 |   allergies: string | null;
32633 |   active: Array<{ medicationName: string }>;
32634 | }): InteractionWarning[] {
32635 |   const warnings: InteractionWarning[] = [];
32636 |   if (!args.drug) return warnings;
32637 | 
32638 |   const allergyList = (args.allergies ?? "")
32639 |     .split(",")
32640 |     .map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase())
32641 |     .filter(Boolean);
32642 | 
32643 |   // Red: allergy on the drug's contraindications list
32644 |   for (const c of args.drug.contraindications) {
32645 |     const lower = c.toLowerCase();
32646 |     if (allergyList.some((a) => lower.includes(a))) {
32647 |       warnings.push({
32648 |         severity: "red",
32649 |         title: `Contraindicated: ${c}`,
32650 |         detail: `Patient allergy matches a contraindication for ${args.drug.genericName}.`,
32651 |       });
32652 |     }
32653 |   }
32654 | 
32655 |   // Amber: currently active medication with a matching generic name
32656 |   for (const activeMed of args.active) {
32657 |     if (activeMed.medicationName.toLowerCase() === args.drug.genericName.toLowerCase()) {
32658 |       warnings.push({
32659 |         severity: "amber",
32660 |         title: `Already on ${args.drug.genericName}`,
32661 |         detail:
32662 |           "An active prescription for the same medication exists. Confirm this is intentional.",
32663 |       });
32664 |     }
32665 |   }
32666 | 
32667 |   return warnings;
32668 | }

32678 | 
32679 | // ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32680 | 
32681 | export interface ComposerConcentration {
32682 |   label: string;
32683 |   mg: number;
32684 |   ml: number;
32685 | }
32686 | 
32687 | export interface ComposerDrug {
32688 |   key: string;
32689 |   genericName: string;
32690 |   brandNames: string[];
32691 |   aware: "Access" | "Watch" | "Reserve" | "Not Applicable";
32692 |   indication: string;
32693 |   contraindications: string[];
32694 |   monitoring: string[];
32695 |   concentrations: ComposerConcentration[];
32696 |   dosing: {
32697 |     mgPerKgPerDay?: number;
32698 |     dosesPerDay: number;
32699 |     maxMgPerKgPerDay?: number;
32700 |     maxSingleDoseMg?: number;
32701 |     maxDailyDoseMg?: number;
32702 |   };
32703 |   crossReactivities: string[];
32704 | }
32705 | 
32706 | // ── Narrowing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32707 | 
32708 | /**
32709 |  * True iff both concentrations are present, finite, and strictly positive.
32710 |  * Returning a `value is T` type predicate narrows the *element* type, so
32711 |  * downstream `.map()` sees `number` instead of `number | undefined`.
32712 |  */
32713 | function hasUsableConcentration<P extends { concentrationMg?: number; volumeMl?: number }>(
32714 |   p: P,
32715 | ): p is P & { concentrationMg: number; volumeMl: number } {
32716 |   return (
32717 |     typeof p.concentrationMg === "number" &&
32718 |     Number.isFinite(p.concentrationMg) &&
32719 |     p.concentrationMg > 0 &&
32720 |     typeof p.volumeMl === "number" &&
32721 |     Number.isFinite(p.volumeMl) &&
32722 |     p.volumeMl > 0
32723 |   );
32724 | }
32725 | 
32726 | /**
32727 |  * Narrowing for the neonatal formulary's `DrugConcentration` shape — `mg`
32728 |  * and `ml` are required on the type but the codebase already guards against
32729 |  * `<= 0`, so we do the same.
32730 |  */
32731 | function hasUsableDrugConcentration<C extends { mg: number; ml: number }>(
32732 |   c: C,
32733 | ): c is C & { mg: number; ml: number } {
32734 |   return Number.isFinite(c.mg) && c.mg > 0 && Number.isFinite(c.ml) && c.ml > 0;
32735 | }
32736 | 
32737 | /**
32738 |  * Collect the non-empty strings out of a `safetyWarnings`-shaped object.
32739 |  * Values can be `string | undefined`; the predicate narrows to `string`.
32740 |  */
32741 | function definedStrings<T extends Record<string, string | undefined>>(obj: T): string[] {
32742 |   return Object.values(obj).filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v));
32743 | }
32744 | 
32745 | // ── Adapters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32746 | 
32747 | function fromEgyptian(d: (typeof EGYPTIAN_NATIONAL_FORMULARY)[number]): ComposerDrug {
32748 |   return {
32749 |     key: `eg:${d.id}`,
32750 |     genericName: d.genericName,
32751 |     brandNames: d.brandNamesEgypt,
32752 |     aware: d.awareClassification ?? "Not Applicable",
32753 |     indication: d.indications[0] ?? "",
32754 |     contraindications: d.contraindications,
32755 |     monitoring: d.monitoringParameters,
32756 |     concentrations: d.presentations
32757 |       .filter(hasUsableConcentration)
32758 |       .map<ComposerConcentration>((p) => ({
32759 |         label: p.strength,
32760 |         mg: p.concentrationMg,
32761 |         ml: p.volumeMl,
32762 |       })),
32763 |     dosing: {
32764 |       mgPerKgPerDay: d.pediatricDosing.standardDosePerKg,
32765 |       dosesPerDay: d.pediatricDosing.dosesPerDay,
32766 |       maxMgPerKgPerDay: d.pediatricDosing.maxDosePerKg,
32767 |       maxSingleDoseMg: d.pediatricDosing.maxSingleDoseMg,
32768 |       maxDailyDoseMg: d.pediatricDosing.maxDailyDoseMg,
32769 |     },
32770 |     crossReactivities: d.penicillinAllergyCrossReactive ? ["penicillin"] : [],
32771 |   };
32772 | }
32773 | 
32774 | function fromNeonatal(d: DrugFormularyItem): ComposerDrug {
32775 |   const safetyNotes = definedStrings(d.safetyWarnings);
32776 |   return {
32777 |     key: `neo:${d.id}`,
32778 |     genericName: d.genericName,
32779 |     brandNames: [],
32780 |     aware: "Not Applicable",

32782 |     contraindications: safetyNotes,
32783 |     monitoring: safetyNotes,

32788 |         mg: c.mg,
32789 |         ml: c.ml,

32791 |     dosing: {

32794 |       maxMgPerKgPerDay: d.maxDose,
32795 |       maxSingleDoseMg: d.maxSingleDoseMg,
32796 |       maxDailyDoseMg: d.maxDailyDoseMg,
32797 |     },
32798 |     crossReactivities: [],
32799 |   };

32801 | 
32802 | // ── Public surface ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32803 | 
32804 | export const COMPOSER_DRUGS: readonly ComposerDrug[] = [

32838 | //
32839 | // The composer's save path is different from the register's `createPrescriptionFn`
32840 | // because it accepts `strength`/`unit` and composes `dosage` server-side,
32841 | // and it can both create and update depending on whether `prescriptionId`

32844 | const SaveSchema = prescriptionComposerSchema.extend({

32849 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])

32856 |       medicationName: data.medicationName,
32857 |       dosage: `${data.strength} ${data.unit}`,
32858 |       frequency: data.frequency,
32859 |       durationDays: data.durationDays,
32860 |       instructions: data.instructions,
32861 |     });
32862 | 
32863 |     if (!row) {
32864 |       throw new Error("Failed to save prescription");
32865 |     }
32866 |     return row;

32874 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
32875 |   .validator(z.object({ prescriptionId: z.uuid() }))
32876 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => {

32909 | // query keys. That meant:
32910 | //   - the same patient context lived in two cache entries, and
32911 | //   - invalidating `["prescriptions", "patient", id]` from the
32912 | //     prescriptions register would NOT refresh the composer's
32913 | //     "previous prescriptions" rail.
32914 | //
32915 | // The fix is to reuse the shared queries from the parent features.
32916 | // These re-exports exist so the composer route has a single import
32917 | // surface — call them from the composer, they hit the shared cache.
32918 | 
32919 | export { getActivePrescriptionsQuery, getPatientForComposerQueryOptions };
32920 | 
32921 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32922 | // Mutations
32923 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32924 | //
32925 | // We export mutation hooks (not raw mutation objects) so the route
32926 | // doesn't have to re-specify `onSuccess` invalidation in every caller.
32927 | // The invalidation list is exactly the same whether the save comes
32928 | // from the composer or the register, so it lives here.
32929 | 
32930 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32931 | // Invalidation
32932 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
32933 | 
32934 | /**
32935 |  * The set of caches touched by a prescription write. Kept private to
32936 |  * this module — callers go through the mutation hooks above, which
32937 |  * call this for them.
32938 |  */
32939 | export async function invalidateAfterPrescriptionWrite(
32940 |   queryClient: QueryClient,
32941 |   args: { prescriptionId: string; patientId: string },
32942 | ): Promise<void> {
32943 |   await Promise.all([
32944 |     // The prescription itself.
32945 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32946 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "detail", args.prescriptionId],
32947 |     }),
32948 |     // The register list (any page/filter combination).
32949 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32950 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
32951 |     }),
32952 |     // The patient's full medication history — used by the safety rail
32953 |     // in any open composer tab.
32954 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32955 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "patient", args.patientId],
32956 |     }),
32957 |     // Visit-level prescription lists (the visit detail page).
32958 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32959 |       queryKey: ["prescriptions", "visit"],
32960 |     }),
32961 |   ]);
32962 | }
32963 | 
32964 | export function useSavePrescriptionMutation() {
32965 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
32966 |   const saveFn = useServerFn(savePrescription);
32967 | 
32968 |   return useMutation({
32969 |     mutationFn: (values: PrescriptionComposerValues & { prescriptionId?: string }) =>
32970 |       saveFn({ data: values }),
32971 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
32972 |       if (!row) return;
32973 |       void Promise.all([
32974 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32975 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "detail", row.id],
32976 |         }),
32977 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32978 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
32979 |         }),
32980 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32981 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "patient", row.patientId],
32982 |         }),
32983 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
32984 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "visit", row.visitId],
32985 |         }),
32986 |       ]);
32987 |     },
32988 |   });
32989 | }
32990 | 
32991 | export function useDiscontinuePrescriptionMutation() {
32992 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
32993 |   const discontinueFn = useServerFn(discontinuePrescription);
32994 | 
32995 |   return useMutation({
32996 |     mutationFn: (input: { prescriptionId: string }) => discontinueFn({ data: input }),
32997 |     onSuccess: (row) => {
32998 |       if (!row) return;
32999 |       void Promise.all([
33000 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
33001 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "detail", row.id],
33002 |         }),
33003 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
33004 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
33005 |         }),
33006 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
33007 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "patient", row.patientId],
33008 |         }),
33009 |         queryClient.invalidateQueries({
33010 |           queryKey: ["prescriptions", "visit", row.visitId],
33011 |         }),
33012 |       ]);
33013 |     },
33014 |   });
33015 | }

33237 | export const savePrescriptionFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
33238 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
33239 |   .validator(SavePrescriptionInput)
33240 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
33241 |     // ── 1. Pull idempotency key + hash the *exact* request ────────────
33242 |     //
33243 |     // The hash includes userId so two different doctors who happen to
33244 |     // generate the same key can't collide. It includes the full payload
33245 |     // so a reused key with different data is a hard 409 (matching
33246 |     // recordImmunizationFn's contract).
33247 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
33248 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
33249 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
33250 |           key: idempotencyKey,
33251 |           userId: context.user.id,
33252 |           data,
33253 |         })
33254 |       : null;
33255 | 
33256 |     // ── 2. Authorise + dose-check OUTSIDE the transaction ────────────
33257 |     //
33258 |     // The formulary check is pure — no DB reads, no side effects. Doing
33259 |     // it before opening a transaction keeps the transaction short.
33260 |     // If it fails, we never even touch the idempotency table, so a
33261 |     // retry with the same key after the clinician fixes the dose is
33262 |     // allowed to succeed.
33263 |     if (context.user.role !== "admin" && data.clinicId !== context.user.clinicId) {
33264 |       throw forbidden();
33265 |     }
33266 | 
33267 |     const patient = await db.query.patients.findFirst({
33268 |       where: {
33269 |         id: data.patientId,
33270 |         clinicId: data.clinicId,
33271 |       },
33272 |       columns: { id: true, weightKg: true, allergies: true },
33273 |     });
33274 |     if (!patient) throw forbidden();
33275 |     const visit = await db.query.visits.findFirst({
33276 |       where: {
33277 |         id: data.visitId,
33278 |         patientId: data.patientId,
33279 |         clinicId: data.clinicId,
33280 |       },
33281 |       columns: { id: true },
33282 |     });
33283 |     if (!visit) throw forbidden();
33284 | 
33285 |     const medicationName = data.medicationName.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
33286 |     const keyedFormulary = data.drugKey ? findComposerDrug(data.drugKey) : undefined;
33287 |     if (data.drugKey && !keyedFormulary) {
33288 |       setResponseStatus(422);
33289 |       throw new Error("Selected medication is not in the current formulary.");
33290 |     }
33291 |     const formulary =
33292 |       keyedFormulary ??
33293 |       COMPOSER_DRUGS.find(
33294 |         (drug) =>
33295 |           drug.genericName.toLocaleLowerCase() === medicationName ||
33296 |           drug.brandNames.some((brand) => brand.toLocaleLowerCase() === medicationName),
33297 |       );
33298 |     if (formulary) {
33299 |       const doseCheck = verifyDose(formulary, {
33300 |         weightKg: data.weightKg ?? patient.weightKg ?? 0,
33301 |         strength: data.strength,
33302 |         unit: data.unit,
33303 |         dosesPerDay: data.dosesPerDay ?? 1,
33304 |         mgPerKgPerDay: data.mgPerKgPerDay,
33305 |       });
33306 |       if (!doseCheck.ok) {
33307 |         // 422 — flusher marks `failed`, clinician must fix the dose.
33308 |         setResponseStatus(422);
33309 |         throw new Error(
33310 |           `Dose could not be verified for ${formulary.genericName}: ${doseCheck.reason}`,
33311 |         );
33312 |       }
33313 |       const allergyHit = checkAllergies(formulary, patient.allergies);
33314 |       if (allergyHit) {
33315 |         setResponseStatus(422);
33316 |         throw new Error(
33317 |           `Allergy conflict: recorded allergy "${allergyHit}" matches this medication.`,
33318 |         );
33319 |       }
33320 |     }
33321 | 
33322 |     // ── 3. Single transaction: idempotency check + create/update ─────
33323 |     //
33324 |     // Mirrors `recordImmunizationFn`. All reads and writes happen on
33325 |     // `tx`, so the idempotency-cache lookup, the version check, the
33326 |     // row write, and the audit log either all commit or all roll back.
33327 |     return db.transaction((tx) => {
33328 |       // 3a. Idempotency cache hit?
33329 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
33330 |         const previous = tx
33331 |           .select()
33332 |           .from(idempotency)
33333 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
33334 |           .get();
33335 | 
33336 |         if (previous) {
33337 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
33338 |             // Same key, different payload — client bug. 409.
33339 |             setResponseStatus(409);
33340 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
33341 |           }
33342 | 
33343 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
33344 |           const previousId =
33345 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
33346 |             previousResult !== null &&
33347 |             "prescriptionId" in previousResult &&
33348 |             typeof previousResult.prescriptionId === "string"
33349 |               ? previousResult.prescriptionId
33350 |               : null;
33351 | 
33352 |           if (!previousId) {
33353 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
33354 |           }
33355 | 
33356 |           const previousRow = tx
33357 |             .select()
33358 |             .from(prescriptions)
33359 |             .where(eq(prescriptions.id, previousId))
33360 |             .get();
33361 | 
33362 |           if (!previousRow) {
33363 |             throw new Error("The previously saved prescription is missing.");
33364 |           }
33365 |           return previousRow;
33366 |         }
33367 |       }
33368 | 
33369 |       // 3b. CREATE path.
33370 |       if (!data.prescriptionId) {
33371 |         const row = tx
33372 |           .insert(prescriptions)
33373 |           .values({
33374 |             patientId: data.patientId,
33375 |             visitId: data.visitId,
33376 |             medicationName: data.medicationName,
33377 |             dosage: `${data.strength} ${data.unit}`,
33378 |             frequency: data.frequency,
33379 |             durationDays: data.durationDays,
33380 |             instructions: data.instructions,
33381 |             prescribedById: context.user.id,
33382 |             prescribedAt: new Date(),
33383 |             status: "active",
33384 |           })
33385 |           .returning()
33386 |           .get();
33387 | 
33388 |         if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to save prescription.");
33389 | 
33390 |         tx.insert(auditLog)
33391 |           .values({
33392 |             actorId: context.user.id,
33393 |             action: "create",
33394 |             entity: "Prescription",
33395 |             entityId: row.id,
33396 |             metadata: {
33397 |               patientId: row.patientId,
33398 |               visitId: row.visitId,
33399 |               medicationName: row.medicationName,
33400 |             },
33401 |           })
33402 |           .run();
33403 | 
33404 |         if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
33405 |           tx.insert(idempotency)
33406 |             .values({
33407 |               id: crypto.randomUUID(),
33408 |               key: idempotencyKey,
33409 |               requestHash,
33410 |               result: { prescriptionId: row.id },
33411 |             })
33412 |             .run();
33413 |         }
33414 | 
33415 |         return row;
33416 |       }
33417 | 
33418 |       // 3c. UPDATE path.
33419 |       const current = tx
33420 |         .select()
33421 |         .from(prescriptions)
33422 |         .where(eq(prescriptions.id, data.prescriptionId))
33423 |         .get();
33424 | 
33425 |       if (!current) {
33426 |         setResponseStatus(404);
33427 |         throw new Error("Prescription not found.");
33428 |       }
33429 |       if (current.patientId !== data.patientId || current.visitId !== data.visitId) {
33430 |         setResponseStatus(403);
33431 |         throw new Error("Forbidden.");
33432 |       }
33433 | 
33434 |       // Optimistic concurrency — the client sends the version it
33435 |       // last saw. If the server moved on, return the current row so
33436 |       // the flusher can surface a conflict.
33437 |       if (data.baseVersion && current.updatedAt.toISOString() !== data.baseVersion) {
33438 |         setResponseStatus(409);
33439 |         throw Object.assign(new Error("Version conflict (409)."), {
33440 |           serverSnapshot: current,
33441 |         });
33442 |       }
33443 | 
33444 |       const row = tx
33445 |         .update(prescriptions)
33446 |         .set({
33447 |           medicationName: data.medicationName,
33448 |           dosage: `${data.strength} ${data.unit}`,
33449 |           frequency: data.frequency,
33450 |           durationDays: data.durationDays,
33451 |           instructions: data.instructions,
33452 |           updatedAt: new Date(),
33453 |         })
33454 |         .where(
33455 |           and(
33456 |             eq(prescriptions.id, data.prescriptionId),
33457 |             eq(prescriptions.patientId, data.patientId),
33458 |             eq(prescriptions.visitId, data.visitId),
33459 |           ),
33460 |         )
33461 |         .returning()
33462 |         .get();
33463 | 
33464 |       if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to update prescription.");
33465 | 
33466 |       tx.insert(auditLog)
33467 |         .values({
33468 |           actorId: context.user.id,
33469 |           action: "update",
33470 |           entity: "Prescription",
33471 |           entityId: row.id,
33472 |           metadata: {
33473 |             patientId: row.patientId,
33474 |             changes: {
33475 |               medicationName: {
33476 |                 from: current.medicationName,
33477 |                 to: row.medicationName,
33478 |               },
33479 |               dosage: { from: current.dosage, to: row.dosage },
33480 |               frequency: { from: current.frequency, to: row.frequency },
33481 |             },
33482 |           },
33483 |         })
33484 |         .run();
33485 | 
33486 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
33487 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
33488 |           .values({
33489 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
33490 |             key: idempotencyKey,
33491 |             requestHash,
33492 |             result: { prescriptionId: row.id },
33493 |           })
33494 |           .run();
33495 |       }

33497 |       return row;
33498 |     });
33499 |   });

33501 | // ─── Helpers (module-scope, all defined) ──────────────────────────────────

33503 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
33504 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
33505 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
33506 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
33507 | }
33508 | 
33509 | function verifyDose(
33510 |   drug: ComposerDrug,
33511 |   params: {
33512 |     weightKg: number;
33513 |     strength: number;
33514 |     unit: ComposerUnit;
33515 |     dosesPerDay: number;
33516 |     mgPerKgPerDay: number | null;
33517 |   },
33518 | ): { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: string } {
33519 |   if (params.weightKg <= 0) {
33520 |     return { ok: false, reason: "patient weight is required" };
33521 |   }
33522 | 
33523 |   let mgPerKg: number;
33524 |   let singleDoseMg: number;
33525 |   let dailyDoseMg: number;
33526 |   if (params.mgPerKgPerDay != null) {
33527 |     mgPerKg = params.mgPerKgPerDay;
33528 |     dailyDoseMg = mgPerKg * params.weightKg;
33529 |     singleDoseMg = dailyDoseMg / params.dosesPerDay;
33530 |   } else {
33531 |     const unitFactor =
33532 |       params.unit === "mg"
33533 |         ? 1
33534 |         : params.unit === "mcg"
33535 |           ? 0.001
33536 |           : params.unit === "g"
33537 |             ? 1000
33538 |             : undefined;
33539 |     if (unitFactor == null) {
33540 |       return {
33541 |         ok: false,
33542 |         reason: "dose units require a verified concentration before saving",
33543 |       };
33544 |     }
33545 |     singleDoseMg = params.strength * unitFactor;
33546 |     dailyDoseMg = singleDoseMg * params.dosesPerDay;
33547 |     mgPerKg = dailyDoseMg / params.weightKg;
33548 |   }
33549 | 
33550 |   const maximum = drug.dosing.maxMgPerKgPerDay;
33551 |   if (maximum != null && mgPerKg > maximum) {
33552 |     return {
33553 |       ok: false,
33554 |       reason: `${mgPerKg.toFixed(2)} mg/kg/day exceeds ${maximum} mg/kg/day`,
33555 |     };
33556 |   }
33557 |   if (drug.dosing.maxSingleDoseMg != null && singleDoseMg > drug.dosing.maxSingleDoseMg) {
33558 |     return {
33559 |       ok: false,
33560 |       reason: `single dose ${singleDoseMg.toFixed(2)} mg exceeds ${drug.dosing.maxSingleDoseMg} mg`,
33561 |     };
33562 |   }
33563 |   if (drug.dosing.maxDailyDoseMg != null && dailyDoseMg > drug.dosing.maxDailyDoseMg) {
33564 |     return {
33565 |       ok: false,
33566 |       reason: `daily dose ${dailyDoseMg.toFixed(2)} mg exceeds ${drug.dosing.maxDailyDoseMg} mg`,
33567 |     };
33568 |   }
33569 |   return { ok: true };
33570 | }
33571 | 
33572 | function checkAllergies(drug: ComposerDrug, allergies: string | null): string | null {
33573 |   if (!allergies) return null;
33574 |   const allergyList = allergies
33575 |     .split(",")
33576 |     .map((allergy) => allergy.trim().toLowerCase())
33577 |     .filter(Boolean);
33578 |   for (const contraindication of drug.contraindications) {
33579 |     const lowerContraindication = contraindication.toLowerCase();
33580 |     const matchedAllergy = allergyList.find((allergy) => lowerContraindication.includes(allergy));
33581 |     if (matchedAllergy) return matchedAllergy;
33582 |   }
33583 |   const crossReactiveAllergy = drug.crossReactivities.find((allergen) =>
33584 |     allergyList.some((allergy) => allergy.includes(allergen)),
33585 |   );
33586 |   if (crossReactiveAllergy) return crossReactiveAllergy;
33587 |   return (
33588 |     [drug.genericName, ...drug.brandNames].find((name) =>
33589 |       allergyList.some((allergy) => allergy.includes(name.toLowerCase())),
33590 |     ) ?? null
33591 |   );
33592 | }
33593 | 
33594 | function forbidden(): Error {
33595 |   setResponseStatus(403);
33596 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
33597 | }

33775 | export interface DosingCalculationResult {
33776 |   weightKg: number;
33777 |   mgPerSingleDose: number;
33778 |   mgPerDay: number;
33779 |   volumeMlPerDose: number;
33780 |   volumeMlPerDay: number;

33788 | export function calculatePediatricDose(params: {
33789 |   drug: PediatricDrugProfile;
33790 |   weightKg: number;
33791 |   concentrationIndex?: number;
33792 |   useHighDose?: boolean;
33793 | }): DosingCalculationResult {
33794 |   const { drug, weightKg, concentrationIndex = 0, useHighDose = false } = params;
33795 |   const concentration =
33796 |     drug.commonConcentrations[concentrationIndex] ?? drug.commonConcentrations[0];
33797 | 
33798 |   let singleDoseMg = 0;
33799 |   let totalDailyMg = 0;
33800 |   let isCapped = false;
33801 | 
33802 |   if (drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDose) {
33803 |     const rawDose = weightKg * drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDose.standard;
33804 |     const maxSingle = drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDose.maxSingleDoseMg;
33805 |     if (rawDose > maxSingle) {
33806 |       singleDoseMg = maxSingle;
33807 |       isCapped = true;
33808 |     } else {
33809 |       singleDoseMg = rawDose;
33810 |     }
33811 |     totalDailyMg = singleDoseMg * drug.dosesPerDay;
33812 |   } else if (drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay) {
33813 |     const targetMgPerKg =
33814 |       useHighDose && drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.high
33815 |         ? drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.high
33816 |         : drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.standard;
33817 | 
33818 |     const rawDaily = weightKg * targetMgPerKg;
33819 |     const maxDaily = drug.recommendedDoseMgPerKgPerDay.maxDailyMg;
33820 | 
33821 |     if (rawDaily > maxDaily) {
33822 |       totalDailyMg = maxDaily;
33823 |       isCapped = true;
33824 |     } else {
33825 |       totalDailyMg = rawDaily;
33826 |     }
33827 | 
33828 |     singleDoseMg = totalDailyMg / drug.dosesPerDay;
33829 |   }
33830 | 
33831 |   // Calculate volume in mL: (mgNeeded / concentrationMg) * concentrationMl
33832 |   const volumeMlPerDose = (singleDoseMg / concentration.mg) * concentration.ml;
33833 |   const volumeMlPerDay = volumeMlPerDose * drug.dosesPerDay;
33834 | 
33835 |   return {
33836 |     weightKg,
33837 |     mgPerSingleDose: Math.round(singleDoseMg * 10) / 10,
33838 |     mgPerDay: Math.round(totalDailyMg * 10) / 10,
33839 |     volumeMlPerDose: Math.round(volumeMlPerDose * 10) / 10,
33840 |     volumeMlPerDay: Math.round(volumeMlPerDay * 10) / 10,
33841 |     frequency: drug.defaultFrequency,
33842 |     dosesPerDay: drug.dosesPerDay,
33843 |     concentrationLabel: concentration.label,
33844 |     isMaxCapped: isCapped,
33845 |     notes: drug.indicationNotes,
33846 |   };
33847 | }

33853 | import type { DrugFormularyItem } from "@/features/medications/types";
33854 | 
33855 | export interface NeonatalDoseCalculation {
33856 |   dosePerKg: number;
33857 |   dosesPerDay: number;

33859 |   dailyDoseMg: number;
33860 |   volumeMlPerDose: number;

33864 | export function calculateNeonatalDose(input: {
33865 |   drug: DrugFormularyItem;
33866 |   weightKg: number;
33867 |   dosePerKg: number;
33868 |   dosesPerDay: number;
33869 |   concentration: DrugFormularyItem["concentrations"][number];
33870 | }): NeonatalDoseCalculation {
33871 |   const { drug, weightKg, dosePerKg, dosesPerDay, concentration } = input;
33872 | 
33873 |   if (!Number.isFinite(weightKg) || weightKg <= 0) {
33874 |     throw new Error("Enter a valid weight greater than zero.");
33875 |   }
33876 |   if (!Number.isFinite(dosePerKg) || dosePerKg <= 0) {
33877 |     throw new Error("Enter a valid dose greater than zero.");
33878 |   }
33879 |   if (dosePerKg < drug.minDose || dosePerKg > drug.maxDose) {
33880 |     throw new Error(
33881 |       `Dose must be within the formulary range of ${drug.minDose}–${drug.maxDose} ${drug.doseUnit}.`,
33882 |     );
33883 |   }
33884 |   if (
33885 |     !drug.concentrations.some(
33886 |       (item) => item.id === concentration.id && item.route === concentration.route,
33887 |     )
33888 |   ) {
33889 |     throw new Error("Select a formulation listed for this medication.");
33890 |   }
33891 |   if (
33892 |     !Number.isFinite(dosesPerDay) ||
33893 |     dosesPerDay <= 0 ||
33894 |     !Number.isFinite(concentration.mg) ||
33895 |     concentration.mg <= 0 ||
33896 |     !Number.isFinite(concentration.ml) ||
33897 |     concentration.ml <= 0
33898 |   ) {
33899 |     throw new Error("This medication does not have usable dose or concentration data.");
33900 |   }
33901 | 
33902 |   const isMicrogramDose = drug.doseUnit.startsWith("mcg/");
33903 |   const isPerDay = drug.doseUnit.endsWith("/day");
33904 |   if (!isMicrogramDose && !drug.doseUnit.startsWith("mg/")) {
33905 |     throw new Error(`Unsupported neonatal dose unit: ${drug.doseUnit}`);
33906 |   }
33907 | 
33908 |   const conversionToMg = isMicrogramDose ? 1 / 1000 : 1;
33909 |   let singleDoseMg = weightKg * dosePerKg * conversionToMg;
33910 |   if (isPerDay) singleDoseMg /= dosesPerDay;
33911 | 
33912 |   let dailyDoseMg = singleDoseMg * dosesPerDay;
33913 |   let isCapped = false;
33914 | 
33915 |   if (drug.maxDailyDoseMg !== undefined && dailyDoseMg > drug.maxDailyDoseMg) {
33916 |     dailyDoseMg = drug.maxDailyDoseMg;
33917 |     singleDoseMg = dailyDoseMg / dosesPerDay;
33918 |     isCapped = true;
33919 |   }
33920 |   if (drug.maxSingleDoseMg !== undefined && singleDoseMg > drug.maxSingleDoseMg) {
33921 |     singleDoseMg = drug.maxSingleDoseMg;
33922 |     dailyDoseMg = singleDoseMg * dosesPerDay;
33923 |     isCapped = true;
33924 |   }
33925 | 
33926 |   return {
33927 |     dosePerKg,
33928 |     dosesPerDay,
33929 |     singleDoseMg,
33930 |     dailyDoseMg,
33931 |     volumeMlPerDose: (singleDoseMg / concentration.mg) * concentration.ml,
33932 |     isCapped,
33933 |   };
33934 | }

34064 |     queryFn: () => fetchTopMedications({ data: { clinicId, limit } }),
34065 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
34066 |   });
34067 | }
34068 | 
34069 | export function patientPrescriptionCountQuery(patientId: string) {
34070 |   return queryOptions({
34071 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.patientCount(patientId),
34072 |     queryFn: () => fetchPatientPrescriptionCount({ data: { patientId } }),
34073 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
34074 |   });
34075 | }
34076 | 
34077 | export function prescriptionRegisterQuery(clinicId: string, search: PrescriptionRegisterSearch) {
34078 |   return queryOptions({
34079 |     queryKey: prescriptionKeys.register(clinicId, search),
34080 |     queryFn: () => fetchPrescriptionRegister({ data: { clinicId, search } }),

34084 | 
34085 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34086 | // Invalidation
34087 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34088 | 
34089 | interface PrescriptionInvalidationArgs {
34090 |   clinicId: string;
34091 |   patientId?: string;
34092 |   /**
34093 |    * When `visitId` is provided, the visit's prescription list is
34094 |    * invalidated. When it is not, the visit list may remain stale —
34095 |    * pass it whenever it's available. It is NOT derivable from
34096 |    * `prescriptionId` without an extra read.
34097 |    */
34098 |   visitId?: string;
34099 |   prescriptionId?: string;
34100 | }
34101 | 
34102 | export function invalidateAfterPrescriptionChange(
34103 |   queryClient: {
34104 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
34105 |   },
34106 |   args: PrescriptionInvalidationArgs,
34107 | ): Promise<unknown> {
34108 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
34109 |     // Prefix invalidation — matches every register page and filter
34110 |     // combination for this clinic.
34111 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
34112 |       queryKey: prescriptionKeys.registerRoot(args.clinicId),
34113 |     }),
34114 |   ];
34115 | 
34116 |   if (args.prescriptionId) {
34117 |     promises.push(
34118 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
34119 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.detail(args.prescriptionId),
34120 |       }),
34121 |     );
34122 |   }
34123 | 
34124 |   if (args.visitId) {
34125 |     promises.push(
34126 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
34127 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.byVisit(args.visitId),
34128 |       }),
34129 |     );
34130 |   }
34131 | 
34132 |   if (args.patientId) {
34133 |     // `byPatient` is the parent of `active` — one invalidation drops both.
34134 |     promises.push(
34135 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
34136 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.byPatient(args.patientId),
34137 |       }),
34138 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
34139 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.patientCount(args.patientId),
34140 |       }),
34141 |     );
34142 |   }
34143 | 
34144 |   return Promise.all(promises);
34145 | }
34146 | 
34147 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34148 | // Composer-facing queries
34149 | //
34150 | // TODO: move to `features/composer/queries.ts` so this file stays
34151 | // scoped to prescriptions. Until then, the re-exports live here so
34152 | // the composer route has one import path.
34153 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34154 | 
34155 | export const getActivePrescriptionsQuery = activePrescriptionsQuery;
34156 | 
34157 | export { getPatientForComposerQueryOptions } from "@/features/patients/queries";
34158 | 
34159 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34160 | // Mutations
34161 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34162 | 
34163 | /**
34164 |  * Create one or more prescriptions.
34165 |  *
34166 |  * `clinicId`, `patientId`, and `visitId` are supplied at hook
34167 |  * construction so `onSuccess` can invalidate the patient's cache
34168 |  * subtree and the visit's prescription list. If the caller doesn't
34169 |  * have these at construction time, they can still be passed via the
34170 |  * mutation variables and read from `variables` in `onSuccess` — but
34171 |  * the hook signature needs them to satisfy `invalidateAfterPrescriptionChange`.
34172 |  */
34173 | export function useCreatePrescriptionsMutation(args: {
34174 |   clinicId: string;
34175 |   patientId: string;
34176 |   visitId: string;
34177 | }) {
34178 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
34179 | 
34180 |   return useMutation({
34181 |     mutationKey: ["prescriptions", "create", args.visitId],
34182 |     mutationFn: (variables: Parameters<typeof createPrescriptionsFn>[0]) =>
34183 |       createPrescriptionsFn(variables),
34184 |     onSuccess: () =>
34185 |       invalidateAfterPrescriptionChange(queryClient, {
34186 |         clinicId: args.clinicId,
34187 |         patientId: args.patientId,
34188 |         visitId: args.visitId,
34189 |       }),
34190 |   });
34191 | }

34351 | function SearchCommand({

34431 |                   >

34548 |     // clinic from the session (context.clinicId) so a client can
34549 |     // never search another clinic's data.
34550 |     queryFn: () => globalSearchFn({ data: { q: query, categories } }),
34551 |     staleTime: STALE.ENCOUNTERS,
34552 |     enabled: query.trim().length >= 2 && Boolean(clinicId),

34625 | // src/features/shared/helpers.ts
34626 | //
34627 | // Shared validation schemas, date utilities, and helper functions.
34628 | 
34629 | import { z } from "zod";
34630 | 
34631 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34632 | // Validation schemas
34633 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34634 | 
34635 | export const uuidSchema = z.uuid("Must be a valid UUID");
34636 | 
34637 | /** Postgres `date` in `YYYY-MM-DD` (matches `date({ mode: "string" })`). */
34638 | export const isoDateSchema = z
34639 |   .string()
34640 |   .regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "Use YYYY-MM-DD")
34641 |   .refine((v) => {
34642 |     // Reject impossible dates like 2023-02-30
34643 |     const [y, m, d] = v.split("-").map(Number);
34644 |     const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
34645 |     return dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 && dt.getUTCDate() === d;
34646 |   }, "Invalid calendar date");
34647 | 
34648 | /** Timestamps (withTimezone, mode: date) accept Date or ISO string. */
34649 | export const timestampSchema = z.coerce.date();
34650 | 
34651 | /** Optional nullable text — normalizes "" to null for DB storage. */
34652 | export const optionalText = (max = 255) =>
34653 |   z
34654 |     .string()
34655 |     .trim()
34656 |     .max(max)
34657 |     .optional()
34658 |     .nullable()
34659 |     .transform((v) => (v === "" ? null : (v ?? null)));
34660 | 
34661 | export const requiredText = (max = 255, min = 1) => z.string().trim().min(min, "Required").max(max);
34662 | 
34663 | /** Optional positive-ish number used for LMS / scores. */
34664 | export const optionalFiniteNumber = z.number().optional().nullable();
34665 | 
34666 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

34668 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34669 | 
34670 | export const patientSexSchema = z.enum(["male", "female"]);
34671 | 
34672 | export const appointmentStatusSchema = z.enum(["scheduled", "completed", "cancelled", "no-show"]);

34697 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34698 | // Date utilities
34699 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34700 | 
34701 | const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;
34702 | const DAYS_PER_MONTH = 30.4375;
34703 | 
34704 | /**
34705 |  * Calculate age in months from date of birth to a reference date.
34706 |  * Returns decimal months for precise calculations.
34707 |  */
34708 | export function ageInMonths(dob: Date, referenceDate: Date = new Date()): number {
34709 |   const days = (referenceDate.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY;
34710 |   return days / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
34711 | }
34712 | 
34713 | export function decimalMonthsBetween(dob: Date, at: Date): number {
34714 |   const days = (at.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY;
34715 |   return days / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
34716 | }
34717 | 
34718 | /**
34719 |  * Calculate corrected age for premature infants (<37 weeks gestational age).
34720 |  * Standard pediatric formula:
34721 |  * Chronological Age (months) - ((40 - Gestational Weeks) * 7 / 30.4375)
34722 |  * For term infants (>=37 weeks), corrected age equals chronological age.
34723 |  */
34724 | export function calculateCorrectedAgeMonths(
34725 |   dob: Date,
34726 |   gestationalAgeWeeks?: number | null,
34727 |   referenceDate: Date = new Date(),
34728 | ): {
34729 |   chronologicalAgeMonths: number;
34730 |   correctedAgeMonths: number;
34731 |   isPreterm: boolean;
34732 |   weeksPremature: number;
34733 | } {
34734 |   const chronological = decimalMonthsBetween(dob, referenceDate);
34735 |   const ga = gestationalAgeWeeks ?? 40;
34736 |   const isPreterm = ga < 37;
34737 |   const weeksPremature = Math.max(0, 40 - ga);
34738 |   const correctionMonths = (weeksPremature * 7) / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
34739 |   const corrected = isPreterm ? Math.max(0, chronological - correctionMonths) : chronological;
34740 | 
34741 |   return {
34742 |     chronologicalAgeMonths: Math.round(chronological * 10) / 10,
34743 |     correctedAgeMonths: Math.round(corrected * 10) / 10,
34744 |     isPreterm,
34745 |     weeksPremature,
34746 |   };
34747 | }
34748 | 
34749 | /**
34750 |  * Whole calendar months between two dates (anniversary-based).
34751 |  *
34752 |  * `completedMonths(new Date('2020-01-31'), new Date('2020-02-29'))` → 0,
34753 |  * because 29 February is not the 31st. The `days < 0` branch handles
34754 |  * month-end rolling without overflowing into March.
34755 |  */
34756 | export function completedMonths(dob: Date, at: Date): number {
34757 |   const years = at.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
34758 |   const months = at.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
34759 |   const days = at.getDate() - dob.getDate();
34760 |   const raw = years * 12 + months;
34761 |   return days >= 0 ? raw : raw - 1;
34762 | }
34763 | 
34764 | /**
34765 |  * Format a date to a localized short date string.
34766 |  */
34767 | export function formatDate(date: Date, _locale = "en-US"): string {
34768 |   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
34769 |     year: "numeric",
34770 |     month: "short",
34771 |     day: "numeric",
34772 |   }).format(date);
34773 | }
34774 | 
34775 | /**
34776 |  * Format a date to include time.
34777 |  */
34778 | export function formatDateTime(date: Date, _locale = "en-US"): string {
34779 |   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
34780 |     year: "numeric",
34781 |     month: "short",
34782 |     day: "numeric",
34783 |     hour: "2-digit",
34784 |     minute: "2-digit",
34785 |   }).format(date);
34786 | }
34787 | 
34788 | /**
34789 |  * Check if a date is in the past.
34790 |  */
34791 | export function isPast(date: Date): boolean {
34792 |   return date < new Date();
34793 | }
34794 | 
34795 | /**
34796 |  * Check if a date is in the future.
34797 |  */
34798 | export function isFuture(date: Date): boolean {
34799 |   return date > new Date();
34800 | }
34801 | 
34802 | /**
34803 |  * Get the start of the day for a given date.
34804 |  */
34805 | export function startOfDay(date: Date): Date {
34806 |   const result = new Date(date);
34807 |   result.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
34808 |   return result;
34809 | }
34810 | 
34811 | /**
34812 |  * Get the end of the day for a given date.
34813 |  */
34814 | export function endOfDay(date: Date): Date {
34815 |   const result = new Date(date);
34816 |   result.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
34817 |   return result;
34818 | }

34820 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

34823 | 
34824 | /**
34825 |  * Capitalize the first letter of a string.
34826 |  */
34827 | export function capitalize(str: string): string {
34828 |   return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1).toLowerCase();
34829 | }
34830 | 
34831 | /**
34832 |  * Format a name as "First Last".
34833 |  */
34834 | export function formatName(firstName: string, lastName: string): string {
34835 |   return `${capitalize(firstName)} ${capitalize(lastName)}`;
34836 | }
34837 | 
34838 | /**
34839 |  * Truncate a string to a maximum length with ellipsis.
34840 |  */
34841 | export function truncate(str: string, maxLength: number): string {
34842 |   if (str.length <= maxLength) return str;
34843 |   return `${str.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...`;
34844 | }
34845 | 
34846 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34847 | // Number utilities
34848 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34849 | 
34850 | /**
34851 |  * Format a number with a specified number of decimal places.
34852 |  */
34853 | export function formatNumber(num: number, decimals = 2): string {
34854 |   return num.toFixed(decimals);
34855 | }
34856 | 
34857 | /**
34858 |  * Clamp a number between min and max values.
34859 |  */
34860 | export function clamp(num: number, min: number, max: number): number {
34861 |   return Math.min(Math.max(num, min), max);
34862 | }
34863 | 
34864 | /**
34865 |  * Round a number to a specified precision.
34866 |  */
34867 | export function round(num: number, precision = 2): number {
34868 |   const factor = 10 ** precision;
34869 |   return Math.round(num * factor) / factor;
34870 | }

34872 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34873 | // Validation helpers
34874 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34875 | 
34876 | /** Wrap any of the above to validate server-action input safely. */
34877 | export function parseOrThrow<T extends z.ZodType>(schema: T, data: unknown): z.infer<T> {
34878 |   const result = schema.safeParse(data);
34879 |   if (!result.success) {
34880 |     throw new z.ZodError(result.error.issues);
34881 |   }
34882 |   return result.data;
34883 | }
34884 | 
34885 | /** Form-action friendly: returns flattened errors instead of throwing. */
34886 | export function parseForm<T extends z.ZodType>(schema: T, formData: FormData) {
34887 |   const raw = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());
34888 |   const result = schema.safeParse(raw);
34889 |   return result.success
34890 |     ? ({ ok: true, data: result.data } as const)
34891 |     : ({ ok: false, errors: z.treeifyError(result.error) } as const);
34892 | }

35145 | // src/features/shared/queryKeys.queries.ts
35146 | //
35147 | // Centralised query-key factory. Two rules:
35148 | //   1. Every key is built from this object — no ad-hoc string arrays in
35149 | //      components.
35150 | //   2. The `curves` key includes (indicator, sex, min, max, xAxis) as
35151 | //      *primitives*, so structurally-equal range objects dedupe (React
35152 | //      Query hashes plain objects by shape, but being explicit here means
35153 | //      refetches survive a caller that re-creates the range each render).
35154 | 
35155 | import type { Indicator, Sex } from "../growth/types/types";
35156 | 
35157 | type Range = { xAxis: "age" | "length"; min: number; max: number };
35158 | 
35159 | export const qk = {
35160 |   // Growth and measurement keys
35161 |   curves: (indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex, r: Range) =>
35162 |     ["curves", indicator, sex, r.xAxis, r.min, r.max] as const,
35163 | 
35164 |   series: (patientId: string, indicator: Indicator) => ["series", patientId, indicator] as const,
35165 | 
35166 |   // NOTE: band intentionally keyed on the *rounded* x (0.1 precision) so
35167 |   // hovering 12.0 → 12.04 doesn't refetch.
35168 |   band: (indicator: Indicator, sex: Sex, r: Range, x: number) =>
35169 |     ["band", indicator, sex, r.xAxis, r.min, r.max, Math.round(x * 10) / 10] as const,
35170 | 
35171 |   flagged: (patientId: string, threshold = 2) => ["flagged", patientId, threshold] as const,
35172 | 
35173 |   // Patient keys
35174 |   patient: (patientId: string) => ["patient", patientId] as const,
35175 |   patients: () => ["patients"] as const,
35176 |   patientHistory: (patientId: string) => ["patient", patientId, "history"] as const,
35177 | 
35178 |   // Clinic keys
35179 |   clinic: (clinicId: string) => ["clinic", clinicId] as const,
35180 |   clinics: () => ["clinics"] as const,
35181 | 
35182 |   // Visit keys
35183 |   visit: (visitId: string) => ["visit", visitId] as const,
35184 |   visits: (patientId: string) => ["visits", patientId] as const,
35185 | 
35186 |   // Appointment keys
35187 |   appointment: (appointmentId: string) => ["appointment", appointmentId] as const,
35188 |   appointments: (patientId: string) => ["appointments", patientId] as const,
35189 |   appointmentsToday: (clinicId: string) => ["appointments", "today", clinicId] as const,
35190 |   appointmentsRange: (clinicId: string, from: string, to: string) =>
35191 |     ["appointments", "range", clinicId, from, to] as const,
35192 |   appointmentStatusCounts: (clinicId: string, from: string, to: string) =>
35193 |     ["appointments", "status-counts", clinicId, from, to] as const,
35194 | 
35195 |   // Prescription keys
35196 |   prescription: (prescriptionId: string) => ["prescription", prescriptionId] as const,
35197 |   prescriptions: (patientId: string) => ["prescriptions", patientId] as const,
35198 | 
35199 |   // Diagnosis keys
35200 |   diagnosis: (diagnosisId: string) => ["diagnosis", diagnosisId] as const,
35201 |   diagnoses: (patientId: string) => ["diagnoses", patientId] as const,
35202 | } as const;
35203 | 
35204 | export type QueryKey = ReturnType<(typeof qk)[keyof typeof qk]>;
35205 |

35282 | // (critical for Arabic/English code-switching); OpenAI accepts an ISO hint but
35283 | // detection still works with it omitted, so we omit for "auto".
35284 | function languageHint(language: Language): string | undefined {
35285 |   return language === "auto" ? undefined : language;
35286 | }
35287 | 
35288 | async function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> {
35289 |   let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
35290 |   const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
35291 |     timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`transcription timed out after ${ms}ms`)), ms);
35292 |   });
35293 |   try {
35294 |     return await Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
35295 |   } finally {
35296 |     clearTimeout(timer!);
35297 |   }
35298 | }
35299 | 
35300 | async function runProvider(
35301 |   provider: ProviderId,
35302 |   audio: File,
35303 |   seconds: number,
35304 |   language: Language,
35305 | ): Promise<TranscriberResult> {
35306 |   const started = Date.now();
35307 |   const result = await withTimeout(
35308 |     generateTranscription({
35309 |       adapter: adapterFor(provider),
35310 |       threadId: `transcribe-${audio.name}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
35311 |       audio,
35312 |       language: languageHint(language) as never,
35313 |     }),
35314 |     TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT_MS,
35315 |   );
35316 |   return {
35317 |     text: result.text,
35318 |     provider,
35319 |     costUsd: (RATES_PER_MINUTE[provider] * seconds) / 60,
35320 |     latencyMs: Date.now() - started,
35321 |   };
35322 | }
35323 | 
35324 | /**
35325 |  * Primary → fallback. Fallback only fires on *retryable* errors
35326 |  * (timeout, 429, 5xx, network). Auth/validation/unsupported-format errors
35327 |  * surface immediately — retrying those on another provider won't help.
35328 |  */
35329 | export async function transcribeWithFallback(
35330 |   audio: File,
35331 |   seconds: number,
35332 |   language: Language,
35333 | ): Promise<TranscriberResult> {
35334 |   const chain: ProviderId[] = ["gpt-4o-mini", "whisper-local"];
35335 |   let lastError: unknown;
35336 |   for (const provider of chain) {
35337 |     try {
35338 |       return await runProvider(provider, audio, seconds, language);
35339 |     } catch (err) {
35340 |       lastError = err;
35341 |       if (!isRetryable(err)) throw err;
35342 |     }
35343 |   }
35344 |   throw lastError ?? new Error("All transcription providers failed");
35345 | }
35346 | 
35347 | function isRetryable(err: unknown): boolean {
35348 |   const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message.toLowerCase() : String(err).toLowerCase();
35349 |   return /timeout|timed out|429|rate limit|5\d\d|network|econnreset|fetch failed/.test(msg);
35350 | }
35351 |

35355 | ```ts
35356 | // src/features/transcription/queries.ts
35357 | import "@tanstack/react-start/server-only";
35358 | import { withTransaction, eq } from "@/db";
35359 | import { auditLog, idempotency, medicalNotes, patients, visits } from "@/db/schema";
35360 | 
35361 | async function hashSaveRequest(args: {
35362 |   clinicId: string;
35363 |   patientId: string;
35364 |   visitId?: string;
35365 |   transcript: string;
35366 |   provider: string;
35367 |   costUsd: number;
35368 |   authorId: string;
35369 |   idempotencyKey: string;
35370 | }) {
35371 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(
35372 |     JSON.stringify({
35373 |       operation: "save-transcript",
35374 |       clinicId: args.clinicId,
35375 |       patientId: args.patientId,
35376 |       visitId: args.visitId ?? null,
35377 |       authorId: args.authorId,
35378 |       idempotencyKey: args.idempotencyKey,
35379 |     }),
35380 |   );
35381 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
35382 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
35383 | }
35384 | 
35385 | export async function saveTranscript(args: {
35386 |   clinicId: string;
35387 |   patientId: string;
35388 |   visitId?: string;
35389 |   transcript: string;
35390 |   provider: string;
35391 |   costUsd: number;
35392 |   authorId: string;
35393 |   idempotencyKey: string;
35394 | }) {
35395 |   const requestHash = await hashSaveRequest(args);
35396 | 
35397 |   return withTransaction((tx) => {
35398 |     const previous = tx
35399 |       .select()
35400 |       .from(idempotency)
35401 |       .where(eq(idempotency.key, args.idempotencyKey))
35402 |       .get();
35403 | 
35404 |     if (previous) {
35405 |       if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
35406 |         throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
35407 |       }
35408 | 
35409 |       const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
35410 |       const previousNoteId =
35411 |         typeof previousResult === "object" &&
35412 |         previousResult !== null &&
35413 |         "medicalNoteId" in previousResult &&
35414 |         typeof previousResult.medicalNoteId === "string"
35415 |           ? previousResult.medicalNoteId
35416 |           : null;
35417 |       if (!previousNoteId) {
35418 |         throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
35419 |       }
35420 | 
35421 |       const existingNote = tx
35422 |         .select()
35423 |         .from(medicalNotes)
35424 |         .where(eq(medicalNotes.id, previousNoteId))
35425 |         .get();
35426 |       if (!existingNote) {
35427 |         throw new Error("The previously saved transcription is missing.");
35428 |       }
35429 |       return existingNote;
35430 |     }
35431 | 
35432 |     const patient = tx
35433 |       .select({ clinicId: patients.clinicId })
35434 |       .from(patients)
35435 |       .where(eq(patients.id, args.patientId))
35436 |       .get();
35437 |     if (!patient || patient.clinicId !== args.clinicId) {
35438 |       throw new Error("Patient not found or outside the requested clinic.");
35439 |     }
35440 | 
35441 |     if (args.visitId) {
35442 |       const visit = tx
35443 |         .select({ patientId: visits.patientId, clinicId: visits.clinicId })
35444 |         .from(visits)
35445 |         .where(eq(visits.id, args.visitId))
35446 |         .get();
35447 |       if (!visit || visit.patientId !== args.patientId || visit.clinicId !== args.clinicId) {
35448 |         throw new Error("Visit not found or does not belong to the patient and clinic.");
35449 |       }
35450 |     }
35451 | 
35452 |     const note = tx
35453 |       .insert(medicalNotes)
35454 |       .values({
35455 |         patientId: args.patientId,
35456 |         visitId: args.visitId ?? null,
35457 |         authorId: args.authorId,
35458 |         title: "Voice transcription",
35459 |         body: args.transcript,
35460 |       })
35461 |       .returning()
35462 |       .get();
35463 | 
35464 |     if (!note) {
35465 |       throw new Error("Failed to insert medical note from transcription.");
35466 |     }
35467 | 
35468 |     tx.insert(auditLog)
35469 |       .values({
35470 |         actorId: args.authorId,
35471 |         entity: "medical_note",
35472 |         entityId: note.id,
35473 |         action: "create",
35474 |         metadata: {
35475 |           source: "voice_transcription",
35476 |           provider: args.provider,
35477 |           costUsd: args.costUsd,
35478 |           needsReview: true,
35479 |           idempotencyKey: args.idempotencyKey,
35480 |         },
35481 |       })
35482 |       .run();
35483 | 
35484 |     tx.insert(idempotency)
35485 |       .values({
35486 |         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
35487 |         key: args.idempotencyKey,
35488 |         requestHash,
35489 |         result: { medicalNoteId: note.id },
35490 |       })
35491 |       .run();
35492 | 
35493 |     return note;
35494 |   });
35495 | }

35535 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
35536 | import { setResponseStatus } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
35537 | 
35538 | import { clinicAccessMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/clinic-middleware";
35539 | 
35540 | import { transcribeWithFallback } from "./providers";
35541 | import { saveTranscript } from "./queries";
35542 | import { transcribeInputSchema, transcriptSchema } from "./schemas";
35543 | 
35544 | export const transcribe = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
35545 |   .validator((input) => transcribeInputSchema.parse(input))
35546 |   .middleware([clinicAccessMiddleware])
35547 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
35548 |     const result = await transcribeWithFallback(data.audio, data.seconds, data.language);
35549 |     const payload = transcriptSchema.parse({ ...result, needsReview: true });
35550 | 
35551 |     if (data.save) {
35552 |       try {
35553 |         await saveTranscript({
35554 |           clinicId: context.clinicId,
35555 |           patientId: data.patientId,
35556 |           visitId: data.visitId,
35557 |           transcript: payload.text,
35558 |           provider: payload.provider,
35559 |           costUsd: payload.costUsd,
35560 |           authorId: context.user.id,
35561 |           idempotencyKey: data.idempotencyKey,
35562 |         });
35563 |       } catch (error) {
35564 |         if (error instanceof Error && error.message.startsWith("Conflict (409):")) {
35565 |           setResponseStatus(409);
35566 |         }
35567 |         throw error;
35568 |       }
35569 |     }
35570 | 
35571 |     return payload;
35572 |   });
35573 |

35579 | import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

35594 |       }
35595 |       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: transcriptionKeys.forPatient(input.patientId) });
35596 |     },
35597 |   });

36128 | function WeightSparkline({ data }: { data: Array<{ value: number; at: Date }> }) {
36129 |   if (data.length < 2) return null;
36130 |   const values = data.map((d) => d.value);
36131 |   const min = Math.min(...values);
36132 |   const max = Math.max(...values);
36133 |   const range = max - min || 1;
36134 | 
36135 |   return (
36136 |     <svg
36137 |       aria-label="Weight trend"
36138 |       className="text-module-encounters"
36139 |       fill="none"
36140 |       height="40"
36141 |       stroke="currentColor"
36142 |       strokeWidth="1.5"
36143 |       viewBox={"0 0 100 40"}
36144 |       width="100%"
36145 |     >
36146 |       <polyline
36147 |         points={data
36148 |           .map((d, i) => {
36149 |             const x = (i / (data.length - 1)) * 100;
36150 |             const y = 40 - ((d.value - min) / range) * 36 - 2;
36151 |             return `${x},${y}`;
36152 |           })
36153 |           .join(" ")}
36154 |       />
36155 |     </svg>
36156 |   );
36157 | }
