36316 | // features/visits/composer/functions.ts
36317 | //
36318 | // Server functions for the visit composer. One level of indirection
36319 | // above `queries.ts`: everything here is safe to import from a
36320 | // `createServerFn` client because it doesn't pull in `#/db`.
36321 | 
36322 | import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
36323 | import { z } from "zod";
36324 | 
36325 | import {
36326 |   fetchActiveMedications,
36327 |   fetchPatientSnapshot,
36328 |   saveVisit,
36329 | } from "@/db/queries/visit-composer.queries";
36330 | import { authMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
36331 | 
36332 | import { type SaveVisitResult, visitComposerSchema } from "./schema";
36333 | 
36334 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36335 | // Reads
36336 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36337 | 
36338 | const patientIdInput = z.object({ patientId: z.string().min(1) });
36339 | 
36340 | export const getVisitSnapshot = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
36341 |   .validator(patientIdInput)
36342 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => fetchPatientSnapshot(data.patientId));
36343 | 
36344 | export const listActiveMedicationsForVisit = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
36345 |   .validator(patientIdInput)
36346 |   .handler(async ({ data }) => fetchActiveMedications(data.patientId));
36347 | 
36348 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36349 | // Save
36350 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36351 | 
36352 | const SaveVisitComposerSchema = visitComposerSchema.extend({
36353 |   visitId: z.uuid().optional(),
36354 |   doctorId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(),
36355 | });
36356 | 
36357 | export const saveVisitComposer = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
36358 |   .middleware([authMiddleware])
36359 |   .validator(SaveVisitComposerSchema)
36360 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }): Promise<SaveVisitResult> =>
36361 |     saveVisit(data, {
36362 |       id: context.user.id,
36363 |       role: context.user.role,
36364 |       clinicId: context.user.clinicId ?? null,
36365 |     }),
36366 |   );
36367 | 
36368 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36369 | // Derived types — reuse these in query-options.ts so the component layer
36370 | // never touches `#/db`.
36371 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36372 | 
36373 | export type VisitSnapshot = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getVisitSnapshot>>;
36374 | export type ActiveMedication = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listActiveMedicationsForVisit>>[number];

36377 | `features/visits/composer/queries.ts`:
36378 | 
36379 | ```ts
36380 | // features/visits/composer/query-options.ts
36381 | //
36382 | // The single import surface for the composer's React Query hooks.
36383 | // `use-visit-composer.ts` imports `useSaveVisitComposerMutation` from
36384 | // here and nothing else from the server layer.
36385 | 
36386 | import { queryOptions, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
36387 | import { useServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
36388 | 
36389 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "./schema";
36390 | 
36391 | import {
36392 |   getVisitSnapshot,
36393 |   listActiveMedicationsForVisit,
36394 |   saveVisitComposer,
36395 |   type VisitSnapshot,
36396 | } from "./functions";
36397 | 
36398 | export type { VisitSnapshot } from "./functions";
36399 | 
36400 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36401 | // Query keys
36402 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36403 | 
36404 | export const visitComposerKeys = {
36405 |   all: () => ["visit", "composer"] as const,
36406 | 
36407 |   snapshot: (patientId: string) => ["visit", "composer", "snapshot", patientId] as const,
36408 | 
36409 |   activeMeds: (patientId: string) => ["visit", "composer", "active-meds", patientId] as const,
36410 | } as const;
36411 | 
36412 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36413 | // Query options
36414 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36415 | 
36416 | const STALE_TIMES = {
36417 |   /** Snapshot feeds the patient card and the weight sparkline. */
36418 |   SNAPSHOT: 60_000,
36419 |   /** Active meds change whenever another prescriber writes — short TTL. */
36420 |   ACTIVE_MEDS: 15_000,
36421 | } as const;
36422 | 
36423 | export function visitSnapshotQuery(patientId: string) {
36424 |   return queryOptions<VisitSnapshot>({
36425 |     queryKey: visitComposerKeys.snapshot(patientId),
36426 |     queryFn: () => getVisitSnapshot({ data: { patientId } }),
36427 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.SNAPSHOT,
36428 |   });
36429 | }
36430 | 
36431 | export function visitActiveMedsQuery(patientId: string) {
36432 |   return queryOptions({
36433 |     queryKey: visitComposerKeys.activeMeds(patientId),
36434 |     queryFn: () => listActiveMedicationsForVisit({ data: { patientId } }),
36435 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.ACTIVE_MEDS,
36436 |   });
36437 | }
36438 | 
36439 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36440 | // Invalidation
36441 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36442 | 
36443 | /**
36444 |  * Everything a successful save touches. Kept private to this module so
36445 |  * callers can't accidentally forget one of the keys.
36446 |  */
36447 | function invalidateAfterSave(
36448 |   queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
36449 |   args: { visitId: string; patientId: string },
36450 | ): Promise<unknown> {
36451 |   return Promise.all([
36452 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
36453 |       queryKey: ["visit", args.visitId],
36454 |     }),
36455 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
36456 |       queryKey: ["visit", args.visitId, "details"],
36457 |     }),
36458 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["visits"] }),
36459 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
36460 |       queryKey: ["patient", args.patientId],
36461 |     }),
36462 |     // Measurement writes move the growth charts.
36463 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
36464 |       queryKey: ["series", args.patientId],
36465 |     }),
36466 |     // The composer's own snapshot cache should reflect the new state.
36467 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
36468 |       queryKey: visitComposerKeys.snapshot(args.patientId),
36469 |     }),
36470 |   ]);
36471 | }
36472 | 
36473 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36474 | // Mutation
36475 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36476 | 
36477 | /**
36478 |  * Save the composer. Callers pass `{ ...values, visitId }` — one object,
36479 |  * one mutation, one consistent invalidation list. `onSuccess` is the
36480 |  * caller's hook into the result; the hook here only handles the caches.
36481 |  */
36482 | export function useSaveVisitComposerMutation(options?: {
36483 |   onSuccess?: (data: { visitId: string }, values: VisitComposerValues) => void;
36484 |   onError?: (error: unknown) => void;
36485 | }) {
36486 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
36487 |   const saveFn = useServerFn(saveVisitComposer);
36488 | 
36489 |   return useMutation<{ visitId: string }, unknown, VisitComposerValues & { visitId?: string }>({
36490 |     mutationFn: (values: VisitComposerValues & { visitId?: string }) => saveFn({ data: values }),
36491 |     onSuccess: (data, values) => {
36492 |       void invalidateAfterSave(queryClient, {
36493 |         visitId: data.visitId,
36494 |         patientId: values.patientId,
36495 |       });
36496 |       options?.onSuccess?.(data, values);
36497 |     },
36498 |     onError: (err) => {
36499 |       options?.onError?.(err);
36500 |     },
36501 |   });
36502 | }
36503 | 
36504 | ```

36743 | import * as React from "react";
36744 | 
36745 | import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
36746 | import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

36749 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "../schema";
36750 | 
36751 | import { SYMPTOM_CHIPS } from "../schema";
36752 | 
36753 | // ── Datetime helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36754 | 
36755 | /**
36756 |  * Render `Date` → `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` **in local time**.
36757 |  *
36758 |  * `toISOString()` converts to UTC first, so a visit at 14:00 UTC+2 renders
36759 |  * as "12:00", and the round-trip through `<input type="datetime-local">`
36760 |  * (which parses as local) silently shifts the time on every save.
36761 |  */
36762 | function toLocalDateTimeValue(date: Date): string {
36763 |   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
36764 |   const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
36765 |   return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
36766 | }
36767 | 
36768 | /** Parse `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` (as emitted by `<input type="datetime-local">`) in local time. */
36769 | function fromLocalDateTimeValue(value: string): Date | null {
36770 |   if (!value) return null;
36771 |   const d = new Date(value);
36772 |   return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
36773 | }
36774 | 
36775 | // ── Chip helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36776 | 
36777 | function chipClass(selected: boolean, readOnly: boolean | undefined): string {
36778 |   return cn(
36779 |     "rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
36780 |     "focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none",
36781 |     selected ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "bg-muted ",
36782 |     !readOnly && !selected && "hover:bg-muted/80",
36783 |     readOnly && "opacity-60",
36784 |   );
36785 | }
36786 | 
36787 | function capitalize(value: string): string {
36788 |   return value.length === 0 ? value : value[0]?.toUpperCase() + value.slice(1);
36789 | }
36790 | 
36791 | // ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36792 | 
36793 | interface Props {
36794 |   values: VisitComposerValues;
36795 |   patch: (p: Partial<VisitComposerValues>) => void;

36797 |    * Display name of the clinic. When absent, falls back to a short id

36799 |    * meaningful instead of "a1b2c3d4".
36800 |    */
36801 |   clinicName?: string;
36802 |   /**
36803 |    * When provided, replaces the free-text doctor input with a selectable
36804 |    * list. Pass the clinic's user roster from the route.
36805 |    */
36806 |   doctors?: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string; name: string }>;
36807 |   readOnly?: boolean;
36808 | }

36817 |

36899 |             />

36901 |           {doctorError && (

36904 |             </p>
36905 |           )}
36906 |         </div>

37287 | function isFinitePositive(v: number | null | undefined): v is number {

37291 | /** Tailwind variants keyed by classification category. */

37484 | 
37485 | ```ts
37486 | // features/visits/composer/use-visit-composer.ts
37487 | //
37488 | // The composer's React-facing hook. Deliberately knows nothing about
37489 | // server functions or Drizzle — only about the mutation hook exported
37490 | // from `./queries`.
37491 | 
37492 | import * as React from "react";
37493 | 
37494 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "./schema";
37495 | 
37496 | import { useSaveVisitComposerMutation } from "./queries";
37497 | 
37498 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37499 | // Public types
37500 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37501 | 
37502 | export interface ComposerSaveState {
37503 |   saving: boolean;
37504 |   dirty: boolean;
37505 |   lastSavedAt: Date | null;
37506 |   error: string | null;
37507 | }
37508 | 
37509 | export type SaveOutcome = { ok: true; visitId: string } | { ok: false; error: string };
37510 | 
37511 | export interface VisitComposerHandle {
37512 |   state: ComposerSaveState & { values: VisitComposerValues };
37513 |   patch: (partial: Partial<VisitComposerValues>) => void;
37514 |   reset: () => void;
37515 |   save: () => Promise<SaveOutcome>;
37516 | }
37517 | 
37518 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37519 | // Serialisation
37520 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37521 | 
37522 | /**
37523 |  * The composer's value object is all JSON-safe. `JSON.stringify` is a
37524 |  * cheap structural signature. Two invariants make it correct:
37525 |  *
37526 |  *   1. Key insertion order is stable — `patch` always spreads into the
37527 |  *      existing object, and `initial`/`submittedValues` share one shape.
37528 |  *      Never construct `values` by spreading a differently-ordered object.
37529 |  *   2. Dates serialise as ISO strings, so same-instant Dates compare equal.
37530 |  *
37531 |  * If a field ever becomes non-JSON-safe (File, Map, …) this is the one
37532 |  * place to change.
37533 |  */
37534 | function signatureOf(values: VisitComposerValues): string {
37535 |   return JSON.stringify(values);
37536 | }
37537 | 
37538 | /** Structural key for an arbitrary JSON-safe value (used to detect prop changes). */
37539 | function stableKey(value: unknown): string {
37540 |   return JSON.stringify(value);
37541 | }
37542 | 
37543 | /**
37544 |  * Identity that, when it changes, means "load fresh data into the editor".
37545 |  * Includes `visitId` so navigating create → edit (or between visits on the
37546 |  * same route) resets the draft.
37547 |  */
37548 | function loadKey(initial: VisitComposerValues, visitId: string | undefined): string {
37549 |   return stableKey({ initial, visitId: visitId ?? null });
37550 | }
37551 | 
37552 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37553 | // State
37554 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37555 | 
37556 | type Snapshot = {
37557 |   /** Current draft the user is editing. */
37558 |   values: VisitComposerValues;
37559 |   /** Signature of the last successfully-saved (or loaded) values. */
37560 |   savedSignature: string;
37561 |   /** The last values known to be persisted — what `reset()` restores to. */
37562 |   lastPersisted: VisitComposerValues;
37563 |   lastSavedAt: Date | null;
37564 |   error: string | null;
37565 |   /** Identity of the incoming `(initial, visitId)` pair. */
37566 |   key: string;
37567 | };
37568 | 
37569 | function createSnapshot(
37570 |   initial: VisitComposerValues,
37571 |   visitId: string | undefined,
37572 |   key: string,
37573 | ): Snapshot {
37574 |   const signature = signatureOf(initial);
37575 |   return {
37576 |     values: initial,
37577 |     savedSignature: signature,
37578 |     lastPersisted: initial,
37579 |     // Only claim "last saved" on edit — a fresh create hasn't been saved yet.
37580 |     lastSavedAt: visitId ? new Date() : null,
37581 |     error: null,
37582 |     key,
37583 |   };
37584 | }
37585 | 
37586 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37587 | // Hook
37588 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37589 | 
37590 | export function useVisitComposer(
37591 |   initial: VisitComposerValues,
37592 |   visitId?: string,
37593 | ): VisitComposerHandle {
37594 |   const key = loadKey(initial, visitId);
37595 | 
37596 |   const [snap, setSnap] = React.useState<Snapshot>(() => createSnapshot(initial, visitId, key));
37597 | 
37598 |   // Derive-from-props reset: if the incoming identity changed, swap the
37599 |   // whole snapshot atomically. React discards this render's output and
37600 |   // re-renders immediately, so the old patient's values are never visible.
37601 |   if (snap.key !== key) {
37602 |     setSnap(createSnapshot(initial, visitId, key));
37603 |   }
37604 | 
37605 |   // Latest draft, mirrored OUTSIDE render so `save()` can read it from an
37606 |   // event handler without tripping the "no ref writes during render" rule.
37607 |   // Initialised from state, updated by `patch`/`reset`/`onSuccess` only.
37608 |   const latestValuesRef = React.useRef<VisitComposerValues>(snap.values);
37609 | 
37610 |   const currentSignature = React.useMemo(() => signatureOf(snap.values), [snap.values]);
37611 |   const dirty = currentSignature !== snap.savedSignature;
37612 | 
37613 |   const mutation = useSaveVisitComposerMutation({
37614 |     onSuccess: (_result, submittedValues) => {
37615 |       latestValuesRef.current = submittedValues;
37616 |       const signature = signatureOf(submittedValues);
37617 |       setSnap((prev) => ({
37618 |         ...prev,
37619 |         // Keep the user's live draft, only mark it saved.
37620 |         savedSignature: signature,
37621 |         lastPersisted: submittedValues,
37622 |         lastSavedAt: new Date(),
37623 |         error: null,
37624 |       }));
37625 |     },
37626 |     onError: (err) => {
37627 |       setSnap((prev) => ({
37628 |         ...prev,
37629 |         error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not save visit.",
37630 |       }));
37631 |     },
37632 |   });
37633 | 
37634 |   const { mutateAsync } = mutation;
37635 | 
37636 |   const patch = React.useCallback((partial: Partial<VisitComposerValues>) => {
37637 |     setSnap((prev) => {
37638 |       const nextValues = { ...prev.values, ...partial };
37639 |       latestValuesRef.current = nextValues;
37640 |       return { ...prev, values: nextValues };
37641 |     });
37642 |   }, []);
37643 | 
37644 |   const reset = React.useCallback(() => {
37645 |     setSnap((prev) => {
37646 |       const lastPersisted = prev.lastPersisted;
37647 |       latestValuesRef.current = lastPersisted;
37648 |       return {
37649 |         ...prev,
37650 |         values: lastPersisted,
37651 |         savedSignature: signatureOf(lastPersisted),
37652 |         error: null,
37653 |       };
37654 |     });
37655 |   }, []);
37656 | 
37657 |   const save = React.useCallback(async (): Promise<SaveOutcome> => {
37658 |     setSnap((prev) => ({ ...prev, error: null }));
37659 |     try {
37660 |       const submitted = latestValuesRef.current;
37661 |       const result = await mutateAsync({ ...submitted, visitId });
37662 |       return { ok: true, visitId: result.visitId };
37663 |     } catch (err) {
37664 |       // `onError` already wrote the message into state; mirror it here so
37665 |       // callers get a self-contained result without reading state.
37666 |       return {
37667 |         ok: false,
37668 |         error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not save visit.",
37669 |       };
37670 |     }
37671 |   }, [mutateAsync, visitId]);
37672 | 
37673 |   return {
37674 |     state: {
37675 |       values: snap.values,
37676 |       dirty,
37677 |       error: snap.error,
37678 |       lastSavedAt: snap.lastSavedAt,
37679 |       saving: mutation.isPending,
37680 |     },
37681 |     patch,
37682 |     reset,
37683 |     save,
37684 |   };
37685 | }
37686 |

37776 |         ctx.addIssue({
37777 |           code: "custom",

37789 | type SaveVisitValues = z.infer<typeof SaveVisitInput>;
37790 | type VisitTransaction = Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0];
37791 | type SaveVisitOutcome =
37792 |   | { kind: "ok"; visitId: string }

37795 | export const saveVisitFn = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
37796 |   .middleware([freshAuthMiddleware, clinicAccessMiddleware])
37797 |   .validator(SaveVisitInput)
37798 |   .handler(async ({ data, context }) => {
37799 |     const idempotencyKey = getRequest().headers.get("Idempotency-Key");
37800 |     const requestHash = idempotencyKey
37801 |       ? await hashIdempotentRequest({
37802 |           operation: "save-visit",
37803 |           key: idempotencyKey,
37804 |           userId: context.user.id,
37805 |           data,
37806 |         })
37807 |       : null;
37808 | 
37809 |     const result = db.transaction<SaveVisitOutcome>((tx) => {
37810 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
37811 |         const previous = tx
37812 |           .select()
37813 |           .from(idempotency)
37814 |           .where(eq(idempotency.key, idempotencyKey))
37815 |           .get();
37816 |         if (previous) {
37817 |           if (previous.requestHash !== requestHash) {
37818 |             setResponseStatus(409);
37819 |             throw new Error("Conflict (409): Idempotency key was reused with a different request.");
37820 |           }
37821 | 
37822 |           const previousResult: unknown = previous.result;
37823 |           if (
37824 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
37825 |             previousResult !== null &&
37826 |             "conflict" in previousResult &&
37827 |             previousResult.conflict === true &&
37828 |             "serverSnapshot" in previousResult
37829 |           ) {
37830 |             return {
37831 |               kind: "conflict",
37832 |               serverSnapshot: previousResult.serverSnapshot,
37833 |             };
37834 |           }
37835 | 
37836 |           const previousVisitId =
37837 |             typeof previousResult === "object" &&
37838 |             previousResult !== null &&
37839 |             "visitId" in previousResult &&
37840 |             typeof previousResult.visitId === "string"
37841 |               ? previousResult.visitId
37842 |               : null;
37843 |           if (!previousVisitId) {
37844 |             throw new Error("Stored idempotency result is invalid.");
37845 |           }
37846 |           return { kind: "ok", visitId: previousVisitId };
37847 |         }
37848 |       }
37849 | 
37850 |       const [patient] = tx
37851 |         .select({
37852 |           clinicId: patients.clinicId,
37853 |           dateOfBirth: patients.dateOfBirth,
37854 |         })
37855 |         .from(patients)
37856 |         .where(eq(patients.id, data.patientId))
37857 |         .limit(1)
37858 |         .all();
37859 |       if (!patient || patient.clinicId !== data.clinicId) {
37860 |         throw forbidden();
37861 |       }
37862 |       if (context.user.role !== "admin" && context.user.clinicId !== data.clinicId) {
37863 |         throw forbidden();
37864 |       }
37865 | 
37866 |       const dob = new Date(`${patient.dateOfBirth}T00:00:00Z`);
37867 |       if (!Number.isFinite(dob.getTime())) {
37868 |         throw new Error(`Patient ${data.patientId} has an invalid birth date.`);
37869 |       }
37870 |       const ageMonths = computeAgeMonths(data.visitedAt, dob);
37871 |       if (ageMonths < 0) {
37872 |         setResponseStatus(422);
37873 |         throw new Error("Visit date cannot be before the patient's birth.");
37874 |       }
37875 | 
37876 |       const current = data.visitId
37877 |         ? tx.select().from(visits).where(eq(visits.id, data.visitId)).get()
37878 |         : undefined;
37879 |       if (data.visitId && !current) throw notFound("Visit not found.");
37880 |       if (current && (current.patientId !== data.patientId || current.clinicId !== data.clinicId)) {
37881 |         throw forbidden();
37882 |       }
37883 | 
37884 |       if (current && data.baseVersion && current.updatedAt.toISOString() !== data.baseVersion) {
37885 |         const serverSnapshot = getVisitSnapshot(tx, current);
37886 |         if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
37887 |           tx.insert(idempotency)
37888 |             .values({
37889 |               id: crypto.randomUUID(),
37890 |               key: idempotencyKey,
37891 |               requestHash,
37892 |               result: { conflict: true, serverSnapshot },
37893 |             })
37894 |             .run();
37895 |         }
37896 |         return { kind: "conflict", serverSnapshot };
37897 |       }
37898 | 
37899 |       const now = new Date();
37900 |       const visitValues = {
37901 |         doctorId: data.doctorId,
37902 |         visitedAt: data.visitedAt,
37903 |         ageMonths,
37904 |         ageYears: Math.floor(ageMonths / 12),
37905 |         ageMonthsRemainder: Math.floor(ageMonths % 12),
37906 |         chiefComplaint: data.chiefComplaint,
37907 |         symptoms: data.symptoms.join(", "),
37908 |         physicalExam: data.examFindings,
37909 |         plan: data.plan,
37910 |         updatedAt: now,
37911 |       };
37912 |       const visit = current
37913 |         ? tx.update(visits).set(visitValues).where(eq(visits.id, current.id)).returning().get()
37914 |         : tx
37915 |             .insert(visits)
37916 |             .values({
37917 |               ...visitValues,
37918 |               patientId: data.patientId,
37919 |               clinicId: data.clinicId,
37920 |             })
37921 |             .returning()
37922 |             .get();
37923 |       if (!visit) throw new Error("Failed to save visit.");
37924 | 
37925 |       if (current) {
37926 |         syncMeasurements(tx, visit, data.measurements);
37927 |         syncDiagnoses(tx, visit.id, data.diagnoses);
37928 |         syncPrescriptions(tx, visit, data.prescriptions, context.user.id);
37929 |       } else {
37930 |         insertVisitChildren(tx, visit, data, context.user.id);
37931 |       }
37932 | 
37933 |       tx.insert(auditLog)
37934 |         .values({
37935 |           actorId: context.user.id,
37936 |           action: current ? "update" : "create",
37937 |           entity: "Visit",
37938 |           entityId: visit.id,
37939 |           metadata: {
37940 |             patientId: visit.patientId,
37941 |             clinicId: visit.clinicId,
37942 |             visitedAt: visit.visitedAt.toISOString(),
37943 |           },
37944 |         })
37945 |         .run();
37946 | 
37947 |       if (idempotencyKey && requestHash) {
37948 |         tx.insert(idempotency)
37949 |           .values({
37950 |             id: crypto.randomUUID(),
37951 |             key: idempotencyKey,
37952 |             requestHash,
37953 |             result: { visitId: visit.id },
37954 |           })
37955 |           .run();
37956 |       }
37957 | 
37958 |       return { kind: "ok", visitId: visit.id };
37959 |     });
37960 | 
37961 |     if (result.kind === "conflict") {
37962 |       throw conflict(result.serverSnapshot);
37963 |     }
37964 |     const savedVisit = await getVisitWithDetails(result.visitId);
37965 |     if (!savedVisit) throw notFound("Saved visit was not found.");
37966 |     return savedVisit;
37967 |   });

37969 | function insertVisitChildren(
37970 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
37971 |   visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect,
37972 |   data: SaveVisitValues,
37973 |   prescriberId: string,
37974 | ): void {
37975 |   if (data.measurements.length > 0) {
37976 |     tx.insert(measurements)
37977 |       .values(
37978 |         data.measurements.map((measurement) => ({
37979 |           visitId: visit.id,
37980 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
37981 |           measuredAt: visit.visitedAt,
37982 |           indicator: measurement.indicator,
37983 |           value: measurement.value,
37984 |           lengthCmAtMeasurement:
37985 |             measurement.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (measurement.lengthCm ?? null) : null,
37986 |         })),
37987 |       )
37988 |       .run();
37989 |   }
37990 |   if (data.diagnoses.length > 0) {
37991 |     tx.insert(diagnoses)
37992 |       .values(
37993 |         data.diagnoses.map((diagnosis) => ({
37994 |           visitId: visit.id,
37995 |           icdCode: diagnosis.icdCode,
37996 |           description: diagnosis.description,
37997 |           type: diagnosis.type,
37998 |         })),
37999 |       )
38000 |       .run();
38001 |   }
38002 |   if (data.prescriptions.length > 0) {
38003 |     tx.insert(prescriptions)
38004 |       .values(
38005 |         data.prescriptions.map((prescription) => ({
38006 |           visitId: visit.id,
38007 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
38008 |           prescribedById: prescriberId,
38009 |           medicationName: prescription.medicationName,
38010 |           dosage: prescription.dosage,
38011 |           frequency: prescription.frequency,
38012 |           durationDays: prescription.durationDays,
38013 |           instructions: prescription.instructions,
38014 |           prescribedAt: visit.visitedAt,
38015 |         })),
38016 |       )
38017 |       .run();
38018 |   }
38019 | }
38020 | 
38021 | function syncMeasurements(
38022 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
38023 |   visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect,
38024 |   incoming: SaveVisitValues["measurements"],
38025 | ): void {
38026 |   const existing = tx.select().from(measurements).where(eq(measurements.visitId, visit.id)).all();
38027 |   const byId = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
38028 |   const matchFor = (measurement: SaveVisitValues["measurements"][number]) =>
38029 |     (measurement.id ? byId.get(measurement.id) : undefined) ??
38030 |     existing.find((row) => row.indicator === measurement.indicator);
38031 |   const retainedIds = new Set(
38032 |     incoming
38033 |       .map(matchFor)
38034 |       .filter((row): row is (typeof existing)[number] => row !== undefined)
38035 |       .map((row) => row.id),
38036 |   );
38037 | 
38038 |   for (const row of existing) {
38039 |     if (!retainedIds.has(row.id)) {
38040 |       tx.delete(measurements).where(eq(measurements.id, row.id)).run();
38041 |     }
38042 |   }
38043 |   for (const measurement of incoming) {
38044 |     const existingRow = matchFor(measurement);
38045 |     const values = {
38046 |       indicator: measurement.indicator,
38047 |       value: measurement.value,
38048 |       measuredAt: visit.visitedAt,
38049 |       lengthCmAtMeasurement:
38050 |         measurement.indicator === "weight-for-length" ? (measurement.lengthCm ?? null) : null,
38051 |       updatedAt: new Date(),
38052 |     };
38053 |     if (existingRow) {
38054 |       tx.update(measurements).set(values).where(eq(measurements.id, existingRow.id)).run();
38055 |     } else {
38056 |       tx.insert(measurements)
38057 |         .values({
38058 |           ...values,
38059 |           visitId: visit.id,
38060 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
38061 |         })
38062 |         .run();
38063 |     }
38064 |   }
38065 | }
38066 |

38071 | ): void {
38072 |   const existing = tx.select().from(diagnoses).where(eq(diagnoses.visitId, visitId)).all();
38073 |   const byId = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
38074 |   const matchFor = (diagnosis: SaveVisitValues["diagnoses"][number]) =>
38075 |     (diagnosis.id ? byId.get(diagnosis.id) : undefined) ??
38076 |     existing.find((row) => row.icdCode === diagnosis.icdCode && row.type === diagnosis.type);
38077 |   const retainedIds = new Set(
38078 |     incoming
38079 |       .map(matchFor)
38080 |       .filter((row): row is (typeof existing)[number] => row !== undefined)
38081 |       .map((row) => row.id),
38082 |   );
38083 | 
38084 |   for (const row of existing) {
38085 |     if (!retainedIds.has(row.id)) {

38088 |   }
38089 |   for (const diagnosis of incoming) {

38094 |       type: diagnosis.type,
38095 |       updatedAt: new Date(),
38096 |     };
38097 |     if (existingRow) {
38098 |       tx.update(diagnoses).set(values).where(eq(diagnoses.id, existingRow.id)).run();
38099 |     } else {

38107 | function syncPrescriptions(
38108 |   tx: VisitTransaction,
38109 |   visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect,
38110 |   incoming: SaveVisitValues["prescriptions"],
38111 |   prescriberId: string,
38112 | ): void {
38113 |   const existing = tx.select().from(prescriptions).where(eq(prescriptions.visitId, visit.id)).all();
38114 |   const byId = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
38115 |   const matchFor = (prescription: SaveVisitValues["prescriptions"][number]) =>
38116 |     (prescription.id ? byId.get(prescription.id) : undefined) ??
38117 |     existing.find(
38118 |       (row) =>
38119 |         row.medicationName === prescription.medicationName &&
38120 |         row.dosage === prescription.dosage &&
38121 |         row.frequency === prescription.frequency &&
38122 |         row.durationDays === prescription.durationDays,
38123 |     );
38124 |   const retainedIds = new Set(
38125 |     incoming
38126 |       .map(matchFor)
38127 |       .filter((row): row is (typeof existing)[number] => row !== undefined)
38128 |       .map((row) => row.id),
38129 |   );
38130 | 
38131 |   for (const row of existing) {
38132 |     if (row.status === "active" && !retainedIds.has(row.id)) {
38133 |       tx.update(prescriptions)
38134 |         .set({
38135 |           status: "cancelled",
38136 |           statusChangedAt: new Date(),
38137 |           updatedAt: new Date(),
38138 |         })
38139 |         .where(eq(prescriptions.id, row.id))
38140 |         .run();
38141 |     }
38142 |   }
38143 |   for (const prescription of incoming) {
38144 |     const existingRow = matchFor(prescription);
38145 |     const values = {
38146 |       medicationName: prescription.medicationName,
38147 |       dosage: prescription.dosage,
38148 |       frequency: prescription.frequency,
38149 |       durationDays: prescription.durationDays,
38150 |       instructions: prescription.instructions,
38151 |       updatedAt: new Date(),
38152 |     };
38153 |     if (existingRow) {
38154 |       tx.update(prescriptions).set(values).where(eq(prescriptions.id, existingRow.id)).run();
38155 |     } else {
38156 |       tx.insert(prescriptions)
38157 |         .values({
38158 |           ...values,
38159 |           visitId: visit.id,
38160 |           patientId: visit.patientId,
38161 |           prescribedById: prescriberId,
38162 |           prescribedAt: visit.visitedAt,
38163 |         })
38164 |         .run();
38165 |     }
38166 |   }

38169 | function getVisitSnapshot(tx: VisitTransaction, visit: typeof visits.$inferSelect) {
38170 |   return {
38171 |     ...visit,
38172 |     measurements: tx.select().from(measurements).where(eq(measurements.visitId, visit.id)).all(),
38173 |     diagnoses: tx.select().from(diagnoses).where(eq(diagnoses.visitId, visit.id)).all(),
38174 |     prescriptions: tx.select().from(prescriptions).where(eq(prescriptions.visitId, visit.id)).all(),
38175 |   };

38178 | function computeAgeMonths(at: Date, dob: Date): number {
38179 |   return (at.getTime() - dob.getTime()) / (86_400_000 * 30.4375);
38180 | }
38181 | 
38182 | async function hashIdempotentRequest(value: unknown): Promise<string> {
38183 |   const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
38184 |   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
38185 |   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
38186 | }
38187 | 
38188 | function forbidden(): Error {
38189 |   setResponseStatus(403);
38190 |   return new Error("Forbidden.");
38191 | }
38192 | 
38193 | function notFound(message: string): Error {
38194 |   setResponseStatus(404);
38195 |   return new Error(message);
38196 | }
38197 | 
38198 | function conflict(serverSnapshot: unknown): Error {
38199 |   setResponseStatus(409);
38200 |   return Object.assign(new Error("Conflict (409): visit was updated elsewhere."), {
38201 |     serverSnapshot,
38202 |   });
38203 | }

38278 | //

38304 | // Stale times

38307 | const STALE_TIMES = {
38308 |   /** Single visit row. */
38309 |   DETAIL: 60_000,
38310 |   /** Visit with measurements, diagnoses, prescriptions — heavier query. */
38311 |   WITH_DETAILS: 30_000,
38312 |   /** Patient's visit history. */
38313 |   PATIENT: 60_000,
38314 |   /** Clinic's visit list. */
38315 |   CLINIC: 60_000,
38316 |   /** Global "recent visits" list — used by the top-level visits page. */
38317 |   ALL: 60_000,

38320 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38321 | // Query key factory
38322 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

38324 | type VisitSearch = z.infer<typeof visitSearchSchema>;
38325 | 
38326 | export const visitKeys = {
38327 |   all: () => ["visit"] as const,
38328 | 
38329 |   /** Global "recent visits" list (clinic-scoped). */
38330 |   recent: (clinicId: string) => ["visit", "recent", clinicId] as const,
38331 | 
38332 |   /** A clinic's visit list with the search/filter applied. */
38333 |   list: (clinicId: string, search: VisitSearch | undefined) =>
38334 |     [
38335 |       "visit",
38336 |       "list",
38337 |       clinicId,
38338 |       search?.page ?? 1,
38339 |       search?.pageSize ?? 25,
38340 |       search?.sort ?? "visitedAt",
38341 |       search?.dir ?? "desc",
38342 |       search?.doctorId ?? "any",
38343 |       search?.patientId ?? "any",
38344 |     ] as const,
38345 | 
38346 |   /** Per-patient subtree. */
38347 |   patient: (patientId: string) => ["visit", "patient", patientId] as const,
38348 | 
38349 |   /** Single visit row. */
38350 |   detail: (visitId: string) => ["visit", "detail", visitId] as const,
38351 | 
38352 |   /** Visit + measurements + diagnoses + prescriptions. */
38353 |   withDetails: (visitId: string) => ["visit", "detail", visitId, "details"] as const,
38354 | } as const;
38355 | 
38356 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38357 | // Query options
38358 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38359 | 
38360 | export function visitQuery(visitId: string) {
38361 |   return queryOptions({
38362 |     queryKey: visitKeys.detail(visitId),
38363 |     queryFn: () => fetchVisitById({ data: { visitId } }),
38364 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.DETAIL,
38365 |   });
38366 | }
38367 | 
38368 | export function visitWithDetailsQuery(visitId: string) {
38369 |   return queryOptions({
38370 |     queryKey: visitKeys.withDetails(visitId),
38371 |     queryFn: () => fetchVisitWithDetails({ data: { visitId } }),
38372 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.WITH_DETAILS,
38373 |   });
38374 | }
38375 | 
38376 | export function patientVisitsQuery(patientId: string) {
38377 |   return queryOptions({
38378 |     queryKey: visitKeys.patient(patientId),
38379 |     queryFn: () => fetchVisitsForPatient({ data: { patientId } }),
38380 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.PATIENT,
38381 |   });
38382 | }
38383 | 
38384 | export function clinicVisitsQuery(clinicId: string, search?: VisitSearch) {
38385 |   return queryOptions({
38386 |     queryKey: visitKeys.list(clinicId, search),
38387 |     queryFn: () => fetchVisitsForClinic({ data: { clinicId, search } }),
38388 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.CLINIC,
38389 |   });
38390 | }
38391 | 
38392 | export function recentVisitsQuery(clinicId: string) {
38393 |   return queryOptions({
38394 |     queryKey: visitKeys.recent(clinicId),
38395 |     queryFn: () => fetchAllVisits({ data: { clinicId } }),
38396 |     staleTime: STALE_TIMES.ALL,
38397 |   });
38398 | }
38399 | 
38400 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38401 | // Invalidation
38402 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38403 | 
38404 | /**
38405 |  * Call after a visit mutation succeeds.
38406 |  *
38407 |  * A visit write touches:
38408 |  *   1. The visit's own detail entries (`visitKeys.detail(visitId)`).
38409 |  *   2. The patient's visit history (`visitKeys.patient(patientId)`).
38410 |  *   3. The clinic's visit list and recent list.
38411 |  *   4. The patient's growth series — visits feed measurements, and a
38412 |  *      measurement is always attached to a visit.
38413 |  *
38414 |  * `createVisitFn` doesn't know the new visit's id yet, so callers may omit
38415 |  * `visitId` when invalidating after a create.
38416 |  */
38417 | export function invalidateAfterVisitMutation(
38418 |   queryClient: {
38419 |     invalidateQueries: (opts: { queryKey: readonly unknown[] }) => unknown;
38420 |   },
38421 |   args: {
38422 |     clinicId: string;
38423 |     patientId: string;
38424 |     visitId?: string;
38425 |   },
38426 | ): Promise<unknown> {
38427 |   const promises: Array<unknown> = [
38428 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
38429 |       queryKey: visitKeys.patient(args.patientId),
38430 |     }),
38431 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
38432 |       queryKey: visitKeys.list(args.clinicId, undefined),
38433 |     }),
38434 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({
38435 |       queryKey: visitKeys.recent(args.clinicId),
38436 |     }),
38437 |     // Visits create measurements, so growth caches need to refetch.
38438 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["series", args.patientId] }),
38439 |     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["latest", args.patientId] }),
38440 |   ];
38441 | 
38442 |   if (args.visitId) {
38443 |     // `detail` is the parent of `withDetails`, so one invalidation
38444 |     // drops both the row query and the composed query.
38445 |     promises.push(
38446 |       queryClient.invalidateQueries({
38447 |         queryKey: visitKeys.detail(args.visitId),
38448 |       }),
38449 |     );
38450 |   }
38451 | 
38452 |   return Promise.all(promises);
38453 | }
38454 | 
38455 | export function useCreateVisitMutation() {
38456 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
38457 |   const createVisit = useServerFn(createVisitFn);
38458 | 
38459 |   return useMutation({
38460 |     mutationKey: ["visit", "create"],
38461 |     mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof createVisit>[0]["data"]) => createVisit({ data: input }),
38462 |     onSuccess: async (visit, input) => {
38463 |       await invalidateAfterVisitMutation(queryClient, {
38464 |         clinicId: input.clinicId,
38465 |         patientId: input.patientId,
38466 |         visitId: visit.id,
38467 |       });
38468 |     },
38469 |   });
38470 | }
38471 | 
38472 | export function useDeleteVisitMutation() {
38473 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
38474 |   const deleteVisit = useServerFn(deleteVisitFn);
38475 | 
38476 |   return useMutation({
38477 |     mutationKey: ["visit", "delete"],
38478 |     mutationFn: (input: { visitId: string; clinicId: string; patientId: string }) =>
38479 |       deleteVisit({ data: { visitId: input.visitId } }),
38480 |     onSuccess: async (_result, input) => {
38481 |       await invalidateAfterVisitMutation(queryClient, input);
38482 |     },
38483 |   });
38484 | }
38485 |

38534 | ```tsx
38535 | // src/routes/__root.tsx
38536 | 
38537 | import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
38538 | 
38539 | import { createRootRouteWithContext, HeadContent, Scripts } from "@tanstack/react-router";
38540 | import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
38541 | 
38542 | import { THEME_INIT_SCRIPT } from "#/lib/shadcn/theme-init.ts";
38543 | import { ThemeProvider } from "#/lib/shadcn/theme.tsx";
38544 | import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
38545 | 
38546 | import appCss from "../styles.css?url";
38547 | 
38548 | // ─── Router context ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
38549 | //
38550 | // The root route's context is what `beforeLoad` / `loader` receive
38551 | // under `context`. This interface is the *only* declaration of that
38552 | // shape on the routing side — `router.tsx`'s `Register` interface is
38553 | // the other half of the contract. If you add a field here, add it
38554 | // there too (and vice versa) until a compile-time link exists.
38555 | 
38556 | interface RouterContext {
38557 |   queryClient: QueryClient;
38558 | }
38559 | 
38560 | // ─── App metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
38561 | 
38562 | const APP = {
38563 |   title: "Smart Clinic · Pediatrics",
38564 |   description:
38565 |     "Pediatric clinic management: patients, encounters, growth tracking, prescriptions, and appointments.",
38566 |   themeColor: {
38567 |     light: "#f4f6fa" as `#${string}`,
38568 |     dark: "#0e1524" as `#${string}`,
38569 |   },
38570 | } as const;
38571 | 
38572 | // ─── Devtools (dev only, lazy) ─────────────────────────────────────
38573 | //
38574 | // `components/Devtools.tsx` guards against SSR via
38575 | // `useSyncExternalStore`, so `lazy()` is safe. The DEV ternary drops
38576 | // the dynamic import from the prod bundle — the fallback component
38577 | // never renders because `DevtoolsDeferred` early-returns below.
38578 | 
38579 | const Devtools = import.meta.env.DEV ? lazy(() => import("#/components/Devtools")) : () => null;
38580 | 
38581 | // `requestIdleCallback` is *non-optional* on `Window` in lib.dom, so
38582 | // `"requestIdleCallback" in window` narrows the else-branch to `never`
38583 | // and `window.setTimeout` becomes "does not exist on type 'never'".
38584 | // Declaring the property optional on a widened view of `window` makes
38585 | // the feature-detect a real one.
38586 | type WindowWithIdleCallback = Window & {
38587 |   requestIdleCallback?: (cb: () => void) => number;
38588 |   cancelIdleCallback?: (id: number) => void;
38589 | };
38590 | 
38591 | function DevtoolsDeferred() {
38592 |   const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
38593 | 
38594 |   useEffect(() => {
38595 |     if (!import.meta.env.DEV) return;
38596 |     const w = window as WindowWithIdleCallback;
38597 |     if (typeof w.requestIdleCallback === "function") {
38598 |       const id = w.requestIdleCallback(() => setReady(true));
38599 |       return () => w.cancelIdleCallback?.(id);
38600 |     }
38601 |     const id = window.setTimeout(() => setReady(true), 2000);
38602 |     return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
38603 |   }, []);
38604 | 
38605 |   if (!import.meta.env.DEV || !ready) return null;
38606 | 
38607 |   return (
38608 |     <Suspense fallback={null}>
38609 |       <Devtools />
38610 |     </Suspense>
38611 |   );
38612 | }
38613 | 
38614 | // ─── Root route ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38615 | 
38616 | export const Route = createRootRouteWithContext<RouterContext>()({
38617 |   head: () => ({
38618 |     meta: [
38619 |       { charSet: "utf-8" },
38620 |       { name: "viewport", content: "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" },
38621 |       { title: APP.title },
38622 |       { name: "description", content: APP.description },
38623 |       // Two declarative theme-color tags. The browser picks the one
38624 |       // matching `prefers-color-scheme` — first-paint correct with
38625 |       // no JS. If the user overrides their OS theme in-app, only
38626 |       // `<html style="color-scheme">` (set by the init script)
38627 |       // reflects that; browsers read it for scrollbar and form-
38628 |       // control tinting. To also correct the address-bar color on
38629 |       // user override, that logic belongs in `applyTheme` in
38630 |       // theme-utils.ts, not in the inline script.
38631 |       {
38632 |         name: "theme-color",
38633 |         content: APP.themeColor.light,
38634 |         media: "(prefers-color-scheme: light)",
38635 |       },
38636 |       {
38637 |         name: "theme-color",
38638 |         content: APP.themeColor.dark,
38639 |         media: "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)",
38640 |       },
38641 |     ],
38642 |     links: [{ rel: "stylesheet", href: appCss }],
38643 |     // Executed synchronously inside <head> by `<HeadContent />`,
38644 |     // before the body paints. See theme-init.ts for the contract.
38645 |     scripts: [{ children: THEME_INIT_SCRIPT }],
38646 |   }),
38647 |   shellComponent: RootDocument,
38648 | });
38649 | 
38650 | // ─── Shell ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38651 | //
38652 | // `suppressHydrationWarning` is on `<html>` because the `class`
38653 | // attribute legitimately differs between SSR and the first client
38654 | // render (init script vs. `matchMedia`). React has no per-attribute
38655 | // opt-out. The blast radius — also suppressing warnings for `lang`
38656 | // and `dir` — is accepted: those attributes are static today.
38657 | //
38658 | // `ThemeProvider` is mounted without `defaultTheme` (defaults to
38659 | // "system"). The first client render of any `useTheme()` consumer
38660 | // can disagree with SSR until `mounted` flips; the fix belongs in
38661 | // `lib/shadcn/theme.tsx` (gate `resolvedTheme` on `mounted`), not
38662 | // here. Do not paper over it with `defaultTheme="light"` — that
38663 | // breaks first paint for system-dark users.
38664 | 
38665 | function RootDocument({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
38666 |   return (
38667 |     <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
38668 |       <head>
38669 |         <HeadContent />
38670 |       </head>
38671 |       <body>
38672 |         <ThemeProvider>
38673 |           <TooltipProvider>{children}</TooltipProvider>
38674 |         </ThemeProvider>
38675 |         <DevtoolsDeferred />
38676 |         <Scripts />
38677 |       </body>
38678 |     </html>
38679 |   );
38680 | }

41391 |         <p className="text-destructive text-sm font-medium">
41392 |           {patientQuery.error instanceof Error
41393 |             ? patientQuery.error.message
41394 |             : "Could not load patient."}
41395 |         </p>
41396 |         <Button onClick={() => void patientQuery.refetch()} size="sm" variant="outline">
41397 |           Try Again
41398 |         </Button>
41399 |       </div>
41400 |     );
41401 |   }
41402 | 
41403 |   if (!patientQuery.data) {
41404 |     return (
41405 |       <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center">
41406 |         <p className=" text-sm">This patient no longer exists.</p>
41407 |         <Button onClick={onDone} size="sm" variant="outline">
41408 |           Back to patients
41409 |         </Button>
41410 |       </div>
41411 |     );
41412 |   }
41413 | 
41414 |   return <PatientEditForm clinicId={clinicId} onDone={onDone} patient={patientQuery.data} />;
41415 | }

41417 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
41418 | // Form
41419 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
41420 | 
41421 | interface EditablePatient {
41422 |   id: string;
41423 |   firstName: string;
41424 |   lastName: string;
41425 |   phone?: string | null;
41426 |   address?: string | null;
41427 |   parentName?: string | null;
41428 |   allergies?: string | null;
41429 |   updatedAt: string | Date;
41430 | }
41431 | 
41432 | function PatientEditForm({
41433 |   patient,
41434 |   clinicId,
41435 |   onDone,
41436 | }: {
41437 |   patient: EditablePatient;
41438 |   clinicId: string;
41439 |   onDone: () => void;
41440 | }) {
41441 |   const updateMutation = useUpdatePatientMutation({
41442 |     patientId: patient.id,
41443 |     clinicId,
41444 |   });
41445 | 
41446 |   const form = useForm({
41447 |     defaultValues: {
41448 |       firstName: patient.firstName,
41449 |       lastName: patient.lastName,
41450 |       phone: patient.phone ?? "",
41451 |       address: patient.address ?? "",
41452 |       parentName: patient.parentName ?? "",
41453 |       allergies: patient.allergies ?? "",
41454 |     },
41455 |     validators: { onSubmit: editSchema },
41456 |     onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
41457 |       const trimmed: EditFormValues = {
41458 |         firstName: value.firstName.trim(),
41459 |         lastName: value.lastName.trim(),
41460 |         phone: value.phone.trim(),
41461 |         address: value.address.trim(),
41462 |         parentName: value.parentName.trim(),
41463 |         allergies: value.allergies.trim(),
41464 |       };
41465 | 
41466 |       try {
41467 |         // Optimistic concurrency: send the timestamp we loaded so the
41468 |         // server rejects the write if someone else edited meanwhile.
41469 |         const baseVersion =
41470 |           typeof patient.updatedAt === "string"
41471 |             ? patient.updatedAt
41472 |             : patient.updatedAt.toISOString();
41473 | 
41474 |         await updateMutation.mutateAsync({
41475 |           data: {
41476 |             patientId: patient.id,
41477 |             baseVersion,
41478 |             patch: {
41479 |               firstName: trimmed.firstName,
41480 |               lastName: trimmed.lastName,
41481 |               phone: trimmed.phone || null,
41482 |               address: trimmed.address || null,
41483 |               parentName: trimmed.parentName || null,
41484 |               allergies: trimmed.allergies || null,
41485 |             },
41486 |           },
41487 |         });
41488 | 
41489 |         toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Patient updated" });
41490 |         onDone();
41491 |         return undefined;
41492 |       } catch (err) {
41493 |         return {
41494 |           form: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save patient",
41495 |         };
41496 |       }
41497 |     },
41498 |   });
41499 | 
41500 |   const submittingRef = React.useRef(false);
41501 | 
41502 |   return (
41503 |     <form
41504 |       className="grid gap-4"
41505 |       noValidate
41506 |       onSubmit={(event) => {
41507 |         event.preventDefault();
41508 |         event.stopPropagation();
41509 |         if (submittingRef.current) return;
41510 |         submittingRef.current = true;
41511 |         void form.handleSubmit().finally(() => {
41512 |           submittingRef.current = false;
41513 |         });
41514 |       }}
41515 |     >
41516 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
41517 |         <form.Field name="firstName">
41518 |           {(field) => (
41519 |             <FieldShell
41520 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
41521 |               id={field.name}
41522 |               label="First name"
41523 |             >
41524 |               <Input
41525 |                 autoComplete="given-name"
41526 |                 id={field.name}
41527 |                 maxLength={120}
41528 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
41529 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
41530 |                 required
41531 |                 value={field.state.value}
41532 |               />
41533 |             </FieldShell>
41534 |           )}
41535 |         </form.Field>
41536 | 
41537 |         <form.Field name="lastName">
41538 |           {(field) => (
41539 |             <FieldShell
41540 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
41541 |               id={field.name}
41542 |               label="Last name"
41543 |             >
41544 |               <Input
41545 |                 autoComplete="family-name"
41546 |                 id={field.name}
41547 |                 maxLength={120}
41548 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
41549 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
41550 |                 required
41551 |                 value={field.state.value}
41552 |               />
41553 |             </FieldShell>
41554 |           )}
41555 |         </form.Field>
41556 |       </div>
41557 | 
41558 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
41559 |         <form.Field name="parentName">
41560 |           {(field) => (
41561 |             <FieldShell
41562 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
41563 |               id={field.name}
41564 |               label="Parent / guardian"
41565 |             >
41566 |               <Input
41567 |                 autoComplete="name"
41568 |                 id={field.name}
41569 |                 maxLength={120}
41570 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
41571 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
41572 |                 value={field.state.value}
41573 |               />
41574 |             </FieldShell>
41575 |           )}
41576 |         </form.Field>
41577 | 
41578 |         <form.Field name="phone">
41579 |           {(field) => (
41580 |             <FieldShell
41581 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
41582 |               id={field.name}
41583 |               label="Phone"
41584 |             >
41585 |               <Input
41586 |                 autoComplete="tel"
41587 |                 id={field.name}
41588 |                 inputMode="tel"
41589 |                 maxLength={32}
41590 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
41591 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
41592 |                 type="tel"
41593 |                 value={field.state.value}
41594 |               />
41595 |             </FieldShell>
41596 |           )}
41597 |         </form.Field>
41598 |       </div>
41599 | 
41600 |       <form.Field name="address">
41601 |         {(field) => (
41602 |           <FieldShell
41603 |             error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
41604 |             id={field.name}
41605 |             label="Address"
41606 |           >
41607 |             <Textarea
41608 |               autoComplete="street-address"
41609 |               id={field.name}
41610 |               maxLength={500}
41611 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
41612 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
41613 |               rows={2}
41614 |               value={field.state.value}
41615 |             />
41616 |           </FieldShell>
41617 |         )}
41618 |       </form.Field>
41619 | 
41620 |       <form.Field name="allergies">
41621 |         {(field) => (
41622 |           <FieldShell
41623 |             error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
41624 |             hint="Comma-separated, e.g. penicillin, peanuts"
41625 |             id={field.name}
41626 |             label="Allergies"
41627 |           >
41628 |             <Textarea
41629 |               id={field.name}
41630 |               maxLength={500}
41631 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
41632 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
41633 |               rows={2}
41634 |               value={field.state.value}
41635 |             />
41636 |           </FieldShell>
41637 |         )}
41638 |       </form.Field>
41639 | 
41640 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.errorMap.onSubmit}>
41641 |         {(err) => {
41642 |           const message = fieldErrorMessage(err);
41643 |           return message ? (
41644 |             <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
41645 |               {message}
41646 |             </p>
41647 |           ) : null;
41648 |         }}
41649 |       </form.Subscribe>
41650 | 
41651 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.isSubmitting}>
41652 |         {(isSubmitting) => (
41653 |           <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
41654 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} onClick={onDone} type="button" variant="outline">
41655 |               Cancel
41656 |             </Button>
41657 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} type="submit">
41658 |               {isSubmitting ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes"}
41659 |             </Button>
41660 |           </div>
41661 |         )}
41662 |       </form.Subscribe>
41663 |     </form>
41664 |   );
41665 | }

41667 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
41668 | // Small shared field shell (unchanged)
41669 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
41670 | 
41671 | function FieldShell({
41672 |   id,
41673 |   label,
41674 |   error,
41675 |   hint,
41676 |   children,
41677 | }: {
41678 |   id: string;
41679 |   label: string;
41680 |   error?: string;
41681 |   hint?: string;
41682 |   children: React.ReactNode;
41683 | }) {
41684 |   const errorId = `${id}-error`;
41685 |   const hintId = `${id}-hint`;
41686 |   const describedBy =
41687 |     [error ? errorId : null, hint ? hintId : null].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
41688 | 
41689 |   return (
41690 |     <div className="grid gap-2">
41691 |       <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
41692 |       {React.isValidElement(children)
41693 |         ? React.cloneElement(
41694 |             children as React.ReactElement<{
41695 |               "aria-describedby"?: string;
41696 |               "aria-invalid"?: boolean;
41697 |             }>,
41698 |             {
41699 |               "aria-describedby": describedBy,
41700 |               "aria-invalid": Boolean(error),
41701 |             },
41702 |           )
41703 |         : children}
41704 |       {hint && (
41705 |         <p className=" text-[11px]" id={hintId}>
41706 |           {hint}
41707 |         </p>
41708 |       )}
41709 |       {error && (
41710 |         <p className="text-destructive text-sm" id={errorId} role="alert">
41711 |           {error}
41712 |         </p>
41713 |       )}
41714 |     </div>
41715 |   );
41716 | }

42006 | import { toast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
42007 | // ── composer components ───────────────────────────────────────────────
42008 | import { ComposerShell } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/components/ComposerShell";
42009 | import { computeInteractions } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/components/interactions";
42010 | import { findComposerDrug } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/formulary";
42011 | // ── mutations (hooks) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
42012 | import {
42013 |   useDiscontinuePrescriptionMutation,
42014 |   useSavePrescriptionMutation,
42015 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/queries";
42016 | // ── reads ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
42017 | import {
42018 |   activePrescriptionsQuery,
42019 |   getPatientForComposerQueryOptions,
42020 |   prescriptionByIdQuery,
42021 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/queries";
42022 | 
42023 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/prescriptions/$prescriptionId")({
42024 |   validateSearch: z.object({
42025 |     edit: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
42026 |     print: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),

42030 | 
42031 | // ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
42032 | 
42033 | /** Parsed dose: numeric value + canonical unit. */
42034 | interface ParsedDose {
42035 |   value: number;
42036 |   unit: ComposerUnit;
42037 | }
42038 | 
42039 | const DOSE_PATTERN = /^\s*([\d.]+)\s*(mg|mL|mcg|g|units?)\b/i;
42040 | 
42041 | /**
42042 |  * Parse a free-form dosage string ("2.5 mL", "10 mg", "0.5 mcg")
42043 |  * into { value, unit }. Falls back to { 0, "mg" } for unparseable
42044 |  * input so the composer still renders — but never silently assumes
42045 |  * "mg" when the source says something else.
42046 |  */
42047 | function parseDose(dosage: string): ParsedDose {
42048 |   const match = DOSE_PATTERN.exec(dosage);
42049 |   if (!match) return { value: 0, unit: "mg" };
42050 |   const value = Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
42051 |   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return { value: 0, unit: "mg" };
42052 |   const raw = match[2].toLowerCase();
42053 |   const unit: ParsedDose["unit"] =
42054 |     raw === "ml"
42055 |       ? "mL"
42056 |       : raw === "mcg"
42057 |         ? "mcg"
42058 |         : raw === "g"
42059 |           ? "g"
42060 |           : raw.startsWith("unit")
42061 |             ? "units"
42062 |             : "mg";
42063 |   return { value, unit };
42064 | }

42746 | function PrescriptionsTable({
42747 |   clinicId,
42748 |   search,
42749 | }: {
42750 |   clinicId: string;
42751 |   search: PrescriptionRegisterSearch;
42752 | }) {
42753 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
42754 |   const size: PageSize = isPageSize(String(search.size)) ? (search.size as PageSize) : 20;
42755 |   const page = search.page;
42756 | 
42757 |   // ── KEY CHANGE: use prescriptionRegisterQuery ───────────────────────────
42758 |   // Note: pass `search` as-is; the factory filters out page/size for the
42759 |   // key, but the queryFn gets the full search object (including page/size)
42760 |   // so the server returns the correct page. No manual destructuring needed.
42761 |   const query = useQuery(prescriptionRegisterQuery(clinicId, search));
42762 | 
42763 |   const rows = (query.data?.rows ?? []) as RegisterRow[];
42764 |   const total = query.data?.total ?? 0;
42765 |   const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
42766 | 
42767 |   const table = useTable({
42768 |     columns,
42769 |     data: rows,
42770 |     features,
42771 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
42772 |     manualPagination: true,
42773 |     rowCount: total,
42774 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
42775 |   });
42776 | 
42777 |   if (query.isError) {
42778 |     return (
42779 |       <SectionState
42780 |         action={
42781 |           <Button
42782 |             disabled={query.isFetching}
42783 |             onClick={() => void query.refetch()}
42784 |             variant="outline"
42785 |           >
42786 |             {query.isFetching ? "Retrying…" : "Try Again"}
42787 |           </Button>
42788 |         }
42789 |         description={
42790 |           query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
42791 |         }
42792 |         icon={CircleAlertIcon}
42793 |         title="Failed to Load Prescriptions"
42794 |       />
42795 |     );
42796 |   }
42797 | 
42798 |   if (!query.isLoading && total === 0) {
42799 |     return <PrescriptionsEmptyState />;
42800 |   }
42801 | 
42802 |   const leafColumnCount = table.getAllLeafColumns().length;
42803 |   const FlexRender = table.FlexRender;
42804 | 
42805 |   return (
42806 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
42807 |       <Table aria-busy={query.isFetching} aria-label="Prescriptions" layout="fixed">
42808 |         <TableColGroup columns={COLUMN_LAYOUT} />
42809 |         <TableHeader>
42810 |           {table.getHeaderGroups().map((group) => (
42811 |             <TableRow key={group.id}>
42812 |               {group.headers.map((header) => (
42813 |                 <TableHead
42814 |                   hideOnMobile={header.column.columnDef.meta?.hideOnMobile}
42815 |                   key={header.id}
42816 |                 >
42817 |                   <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
42818 |                     <FlexRender header={header} />
42819 |                   </div>
42820 |                 </TableHead>
42821 |               ))}
42822 |             </TableRow>
42823 |           ))}
42824 |         </TableHeader>
42825 |         <TableBody>
42826 |           {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
42827 |             <PrescriptionTableRow
42828 |               FlexRender={FlexRender}
42829 |               key={row.id}
42830 |               queryClient={queryClient}
42831 |               row={row}
42832 |             />
42833 |           ))}
42834 |           {query.isFetching &&
42835 |             Array.from({ length: Math.min(size, 5) }, (_, i) => (
42836 |               <TableRow key={`sk-${i}`}>
42837 |                 <TableCell colSpan={leafColumnCount}>
42838 |                   <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
42839 |                 </TableCell>
42840 |               </TableRow>
42841 |             ))}
42842 |         </TableBody>
42843 |       </Table>
42844 | 
42845 |       <div className="bg-background/95 sticky bottom-0 py-2 backdrop-blur max-sm:-mx-6 max-sm:px-6 max-sm:pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
42846 |         <TablePagination
42847 |           ariaLabel="Prescription Pages"
42848 |           page={page}
42849 |           pageCount={pageCount}
42850 |           route={Route}
42851 |           size={size}
42852 |         />
42853 |       </div>
42854 |     </div>
42855 |   );
42856 | }

42902 | // ── Renew mutation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
42903 | 
42904 | function RenewButton({
42905 |   prescriptionId,
42906 |   queryClient,
42907 | }: {
42908 |   prescriptionId: string;
42909 |   queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>;
42910 | }) {
42911 |   // ── KEY CHANGE: use useMutation + useServerFn instead of calling
42912 |   // the server function directly from onClick. This gives us:
42913 |   //   - isPending state for a proper loading indicator
42914 |   //   - onSuccess hook for invalidation
42915 |   //   - error handling through the standard mutation API
42916 |   const renew = useServerFn(renewPrescriptionFn);
42917 | 
42918 |   const mutation = useMutation({
42919 |     mutationFn: () => renew({ data: { prescriptionId } }),
42920 |     onSuccess: (newRow) => {
42921 |       toast.add({
42922 |         type: "success",
42923 |         description: `Prescription renewed${newRow?.id ? ` (${newRow.id.slice(0, 8)})` : ""}`,
42924 |       });
42925 |       // Invalidate the whole register subtree — the new row must appear.
42926 |       // The `clinic` segment isn't in this query's key, so invalidate
42927 |       // by the register prefix instead.
42928 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
42929 |         queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
42930 |       });
42931 |       // Also invalidate the specific prescription if anyone has it open.
42932 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
42933 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.detail(prescriptionId),
42934 |       });
42935 |     },
42936 |     onError: (err: unknown) => {
42937 |       toast.add({
42938 |         type: "destructive",
42939 |         description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to renew",
42940 |       });
42941 |     },
42942 |   });
42943 | 
42944 |   return (
42945 |     <div className="opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/cell:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100">
42946 |       <Button
42947 |         disabled={mutation.isPending}
42948 |         nativeButton
42949 |         onClick={(e) => {
42950 |           e.preventDefault();
42951 |           e.stopPropagation();
42952 |           mutation.mutate();
42953 |         }}
42954 |         size="xs"
42955 |         variant="ghost"
42956 |       >
42957 |         <RefreshCwIcon aria-hidden="true" className={mutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
42958 |         {mutation.isPending ? "Renewing…" : "Renew"}
42959 |       </Button>
42960 |     </div>
42961 |   );
42962 | }

43104 | function NewPrescriptionPage() {
43105 |   const { patientId, visitId } = Route.useSearch();
43106 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
43107 | 
43108 |   // ── reads ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
43109 |   const patientQ = useQuery(getPatientForComposerQueryOptions(patientId));
43110 |   const activeQ = useQuery(activePrescriptionsQuery(patientId));

43119 |     visitId,
43120 |   });

43122 |   // Pre-fill weight from the patient record, but never clobber a value the
43123 |   // user typed. Runs once per loaded patient.

43128 |     if (lastPrefilledPatientRef.current === patientId) return;

43130 |     setValues((v) => (v.weightKg == null ? { ...v, weightKg: weight } : v));

43143 |         }

43147 |   }

43167 |       });

43183 |           search: shouldPrint ? { print: true } : undefined,
43184 |         });
43185 |       },

43190 |         });
43191 |       },

43199 |       mode="create"
43200 |       onChange={onChange}
43201 |       onSave={() => runSave(false)}
43202 |       onSaveAndPrint={() => runSave(true)}
43203 |       patient={patientQ.data}
43204 |       previous={[]}
43205 |       subtitle="Write a new prescription. Weight, dosing, and interactions update live."
43206 |       title="New prescription"
43207 |       values={values}
43208 |       warnings={warnings}
43209 |     />
43210 |   );
43211 | }

43410 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
43411 | import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
43412 | 
43413 | import type { VisitComposerValues } from "@/features/visits/composer/schema";
43414 | 
43415 | import { PageHeader } from "@/components/blocks/page-header";
43416 | import { toast } from "@/components/ui/toast";

43418 | import { VisitComposer } from "@/features/visits/composer/VisitComposer";
43419 | import { useDeleteVisitMutation, visitWithDetailsQuery } from "@/features/visits/queries";
43420 | 
43421 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/visits/$visitId/edit")({
43422 |   component: EditVisitPage,
43423 | });
43424 | 
43425 | function EditVisitPage() {
43426 |   const { visitId } = Route.useParams();
43427 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
43428 |   const deleteVisit = useDeleteVisitMutation();
43429 | 
43430 |   const detail = useQuery(visitWithDetailsQuery(visitId));
43431 |   const snapshotQ = useQuery({
43432 |     ...visitSnapshotQuery(detail.data?.patientId ?? ""),
43433 |     enabled: Boolean(detail.data?.patientId),
43434 |   });
43435 | 
43436 |   if (detail.isLoading || snapshotQ.isLoading) {
43437 |     return <PageHeader description="Loading…" title="Edit visit" />;
43438 |   }
43439 |   if (!detail.data || !snapshotQ.data) {
43440 |     return <PageHeader description="Not found." title="Edit visit" />;
43441 |   }
43442 | 
43443 |   const d = detail.data;
43444 |   const initial: VisitComposerValues = {
43445 |     patientId: d.patientId,
43446 |     clinicId: d.clinicId,
43447 |     doctorId: d.doctorId,
43448 |     visitedAt: new Date(d.visitedAt),
43449 |     chiefComplaint: d.chiefComplaint ?? "",
43450 |     symptoms: (d.symptoms ?? "")
43451 |       .split(",")
43452 |       .map((s) => s.trim())
43453 |       .filter(Boolean) as never,
43454 |     examFindings: d.physicalExam ?? "",
43455 |     template: null,
43456 |     measurements: (d.measurements ?? []).map((m) => ({
43457 |       draftId: `m-${m.id}`,
43458 |       indicator: m.indicator as never,
43459 |       value: m.value,
43460 |     })),
43461 |     diagnoses: (d.diagnoses ?? []).map((dx) => ({
43462 |       draftId: `dx-${dx.id}`,
43463 |       icdCode: dx.icdCode,
43464 |       description: dx.description,
43465 |       type: dx.type as never,
43466 |     })),
43467 |     prescriptions: (d.prescriptions ?? []).map((rx) => ({
43468 |       draftId: `rx-${rx.id}`,
43469 |       medicationName: rx.medicationName,
43470 |       dosage: rx.dosage,
43471 |       frequency: rx.frequency,
43472 |       durationDays: rx.durationDays,
43473 |       instructions: rx.instructions ?? "",
43474 |     })),
43475 |     plan: d.plan ?? "",
43476 |     followUpWeeks: 4,
43477 |   };
43478 | 
43479 |   return (
43480 |     <VisitComposer
43481 |       initial={initial}
43482 |       mode="edit"
43483 |       onDelete={async () => {
43484 |         try {
43485 |           await deleteVisit.mutateAsync({
43486 |             visitId,
43487 |             clinicId: d.clinicId,
43488 |             patientId: d.patientId,
43489 |           });
43490 |           toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Visit deleted" });
43491 |           void navigate({ to: "/app/visits" });
43492 |         } catch (err) {
43493 |           toast.add({
43494 |             type: "destructive",
43495 |             description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to delete",
43496 |           });
43497 |         }
43498 |       }}
43499 |       onSuccess={() => void navigate({ to: "/app/visits/$visitId", params: { visitId } })}
43500 |       snapshot={snapshotQ.data}
43501 |       visitId={visitId}
43502 |     />
43503 |   );
43504 | }
