43510 | // routes/_auth/app/visits/$visitId.tsx
43511 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
43512 | import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
43513 | import { ArrowLeftIcon } from "lucide-react";
43514 | 
43515 | import { PageHeader } from "#/components/blocks/page-header.tsx";
43516 | import { RouteError } from "#/components/blocks/route-error.tsx";
43517 | import { Section } from "#/components/blocks/section.tsx";
43518 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button.tsx";
43519 | import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "#/components/ui/card.tsx";
43520 | import { InfoRow } from "#/components/ui/info-row.tsx";
43521 | import { Skeleton } from "#/components/ui/skeleton.tsx";
43522 | import {
43523 |   DiagnosisForm,
43524 |   DiagnosisTable,
43525 |   MeasurementForm,
43526 |   MeasurementsTable,
43527 |   PrescriptionForm,
43528 |   PrescriptionTable,
43529 | } from "#/features/index.ts";
43530 | import { visitWithDetailsQuery } from "#/features/visits/queries.ts";
43531 | import { useAuthSuspense } from "#/lib/auth/hooks.ts";
43532 | import { Icons } from "@/components/icons";
43533 | 
43534 | // ─── Route ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
43535 | //
43536 | // `queryClient.query` isn't a thing on TanStack Router's QueryClient
43537 | // context — the deprecated-but-working method is `ensureQueryData`, and
43538 | // the supported replacement is `fetchQuery`. Use `fetchQuery` so the
43539 | // loader awaits, populates the cache, and surfaces errors to
43540 | // `errorComponent` instead of rejecting silently.
43541 | 
43542 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/visits/$visitId")({
43543 |   loader: ({ context, params }) =>
43544 |     context.queryClient.fetchQuery(visitWithDetailsQuery(params.visitId)),
43545 |   component: VisitDetailPage,
43546 |   errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
43547 |     <RouteError
43548 |       kind="unknown"
43549 |       message={errorMessage(error)}
43550 |       onRetry={reset}
43551 |       title="Couldn't load this visit"
43552 |     />
43553 |   ),
43554 |   pendingComponent: () => <VisitDetailSkeleton />,
43555 | });
43556 | 
43557 | // ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
43558 | 
43559 | function VisitDetailPage() {
43560 |   const { visitId } = Route.useParams();
43561 |   const { user } = useAuthSuspense();
43562 | 
43563 |   const query = useQuery(visitWithDetailsQuery(visitId));
43564 | 
43565 |   // Auth gate first — this is a *redirect* concern, not a data concern.
43566 |   // Note: `useAuthSuspense` already throws a redirect if not signed in,
43567 |   // so this branch only fires for signed-in users with no clinic.
43568 |   if (!user?.clinicId) {
43569 |     return (
43570 |       <PageHeader
43571 |         description="No clinic is assigned to your account. Ask an administrator to link you."
43572 |         title="Visit"
43573 |       />
43574 |     );
43575 |   }
43576 | 
43577 |   if (query.isPending) return <VisitDetailSkeleton />;
43578 | 
43579 |   if (query.isError || !query.data) {
43580 |     // `query.data === undefined` without `isError` means the query
43581 |     // resolved but the record doesn't exist — a genuine 404.
43582 |     if (!query.isError) {
43583 |       return <RouteNotFound title="Visit not found" />;
43584 |     }
43585 |     return (
43586 |       <RouteError
43587 |         kind="unknown"
43588 |         message={errorMessage(query.error)}
43589 |         onRetry={() => void query.refetch()}
43590 |         title="Couldn't load this visit"
43591 |       />
43592 |     );
43593 |   }
43594 | 
43595 |   const visit = query.data;
43596 |   const patient = visit.patient;
43597 | 
43598 |   return (
43599 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
43600 |       <Button
43601 |         className="w-fit"
43602 |         nativeButton={false}
43603 |         render={
43604 |           <Link
43605 |             params={{ patientId: visit.patientId }}
43606 |             search={{ tab: "visits" }}
43607 |             to="/app/patients/$patientId"
43608 |           />
43609 |         }
43610 |         size="sm"
43611 |         variant="ghost"
43612 |       >
43613 |         <ArrowLeftIcon aria-hidden="true" />
43614 |         Back to patient
43615 |       </Button>
43616 | 
43617 |       <PageHeader
43618 |         description={`Visit on ${new Date(visit.visitedAt).toLocaleString("en-US")}`}
43619 |         title={patient ? `${patient.firstName} ${patient.lastName}` : "Visit"}
43620 |       />
43621 | 
43622 |       <Card>
43623 |         <CardHeader>
43624 |           <CardTitle>Encounter</CardTitle>
43625 |         </CardHeader>
43626 |         <CardContent className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
43627 |           <InfoRow label="Age at visit" value={`${visit.ageMonths.toFixed(1)} months`} />
43628 |           <InfoRow label="Doctor" value={visit.doctor?.name ?? null} />
43629 |           <InfoRow label="MRN" value={patient?.mrn ?? null} />
43630 |         </CardContent>
43631 |       </Card>
43632 | 
43633 |       <Section
43634 |         action={
43635 |           <MeasurementForm
43636 |             patientId={visit.patientId}
43637 |             visitId={visitId}
43638 |             {...visitMeasurementCtx(visit, patient)}
43639 |           />
43640 |         }
43641 |         title="Measurements"
43642 |       >
43643 |         <MeasurementsTable
43644 |           indicator="weight-for-age"
43645 |           page={1}
43646 |           patientId={visit.patientId}
43647 |           size={10}
43648 |         />
43649 |       </Section>
43650 | 
43651 |       <Section action={<DiagnosisForm visitId={visitId} />} title="Diagnoses">
43652 |         <DiagnosisTable page={1} size={10} visitId={visitId} />
43653 |       </Section>
43654 | 
43655 |       <Section
43656 |         action={
43657 |           <PrescriptionForm
43658 |             clinicId={visit.clinicId}
43659 |             patientId={visit.patientId}
43660 |             visitId={visitId}
43661 |           />
43662 |         }
43663 |         title="Prescriptions"
43664 |       >
43665 |         <PrescriptionTable page={1} size={10} visitId={visitId} />
43666 |       </Section>
43667 |     </div>
43668 |   );
43669 | }
43670 | 
43671 | // ─── Sub-components ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
43672 | 
43673 | function RouteNotFound({ title }: { title: string }) {
43674 |   return (
43675 |     <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
43676 |       <Icons.alertCircle aria-hidden="true" className=" size-8" />

43679 |         Back to visits

43691 |         <Skeleton className="h-4 w-48" />

43693 |       <Card>
43694 |         <CardHeader>
43695 |           <Skeleton className="h-5 w-32" />
43696 |         </CardHeader>
43697 |         <CardContent className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
43698 |           {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (

45169 |     password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
45170 |     confirmPassword: z.string().min(8, "Please confirm your password"),
45171 |   })
45172 |   .refine((data) => data.password === data.confirmPassword, {
45173 |     message: "Passwords do not match",
45174 |     path: ["confirmPassword"],
45175 |   });
45176 | 
45177 | function ResetPasswordForm() {
45178 |   const { token, error: urlError } = Route.useSearch();
45179 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
45180 |   const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
45181 |   const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(
45182 |     urlError === "INVALID_TOKEN"
45183 |       ? "This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one."
45184 |       : null,
45185 |   );
45186 | 
45187 |   const form = useForm({
45188 |     defaultValues: { password: "", confirmPassword: "" },
45189 |     validators: { onSubmit: resetSchema },
45190 |     onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
45191 |       if (!token) {
45192 |         setError("Missing reset token. Request a new link from the login page.");
45193 |         return;
45194 |       }
45195 |       setError(null);
45196 |       setPending(true);
45197 |       try {
45198 |         const { error: authError } = await authClient.resetPassword({
45199 |           newPassword: value.password,
45200 |           token,
45201 |         });
45202 |         if (authError) {

45204 |         }
45205 |         toast.add({

45209 |         void navigate({ to: "/login", replace: true });

45212 |         setError(message);
45213 |         toast.add({ type: "error", description: message });
45214 |       } finally {
45215 |         setPending(false);
45216 |       }
45217 |     },
45218 |   });

45221 |   if (!token) {
45222 |     return (
45223 |       <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
45224 |         <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center">
45225 |           <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
45226 |             Reset link is invalid
45227 |           </h2>

45229 |             {error ??

45231 |           </p>

45243 |   }
45244 | 
45245 |   return (
45246 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
45247 |       <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center">

45249 |           Set a new password

45252 |           Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
45253 |         </p>
45254 |       </div>
45255 | 
45256 |       <form
45257 |         aria-busy={pending}
45258 |         className="space-y-6"
45259 |         noValidate
45260 |         onSubmit={(event) => {
45261 |           event.preventDefault();
45262 |           event.stopPropagation();
45263 |           if (pending) return;

45265 |         }}
45266 |       >

45272 |                 typeof err === "string"
45273 |                   ? err

45277 |               return (

46460 |  * debug and is trivial to avoid.

46466 |   }
46467 |   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
46468 |     day: "numeric",
46469 |     month: "long",

`routes/__root.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // src/routes/__root.tsx
   2 | 
   3 | import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   4 | 
   5 | import { createRootRouteWithContext, HeadContent, Scripts } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   6 | import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
   7 | 
   8 | import { THEME_INIT_SCRIPT } from "#/lib/shadcn/theme-init.ts";
   9 | import { ThemeProvider } from "#/lib/shadcn/theme.tsx";
  10 | import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
  11 | 
  12 | import appCss from "../styles.css?url";
  13 | 
  14 | // ─── Router context ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  15 | //
  16 | // The root route's context is what `beforeLoad` / `loader` receive
  17 | // under `context`. This interface is the *only* declaration of that
  18 | // shape on the routing side — `router.tsx`'s `Register` interface is
  19 | // the other half of the contract. If you add a field here, add it
  20 | // there too (and vice versa) until a compile-time link exists.
  21 | 
  22 | interface RouterContext {
  23 |   queryClient: QueryClient;
  24 | }
  25 | 
  26 | // ─── App metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  27 | 
  28 | const APP = {
  29 |   title: "Smart Clinic · Pediatrics",
  30 |   description:
  31 |     "Pediatric clinic management: patients, encounters, growth tracking, prescriptions, and appointments.",
  32 |   themeColor: {
  33 |     light: "#f4f6fa" as `#${string}`,
  34 |     dark: "#0e1524" as `#${string}`,
  35 |   },
  36 | } as const;
  37 | 
  38 | // ─── Devtools (dev only, lazy) ─────────────────────────────────────
  39 | //
  40 | // `components/Devtools.tsx` guards against SSR via
  41 | // `useSyncExternalStore`, so `lazy()` is safe. The DEV ternary drops
  42 | // the dynamic import from the prod bundle — the fallback component
  43 | // never renders because `DevtoolsDeferred` early-returns below.
  44 | 
  45 | const Devtools = import.meta.env.DEV ? lazy(() => import("#/components/Devtools")) : () => null;
  46 | 
  47 | // `requestIdleCallback` is *non-optional* on `Window` in lib.dom, so
  48 | // `"requestIdleCallback" in window` narrows the else-branch to `never`
  49 | // and `window.setTimeout` becomes "does not exist on type 'never'".
  50 | // Declaring the property optional on a widened view of `window` makes
  51 | // the feature-detect a real one.
  52 | type WindowWithIdleCallback = Window & {
  53 |   requestIdleCallback?: (cb: () => void) => number;
  54 |   cancelIdleCallback?: (id: number) => void;
  55 | };
  56 | 
  57 | function DevtoolsDeferred() {
  58 |   const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  59 | 
  60 |   useEffect(() => {
  61 |     if (!import.meta.env.DEV) return;
  62 |     const w = window as WindowWithIdleCallback;
  63 |     if (typeof w.requestIdleCallback === "function") {
  64 |       const id = w.requestIdleCallback(() => setReady(true));
  65 |       return () => w.cancelIdleCallback?.(id);
  66 |     }
  67 |     const id = window.setTimeout(() => setReady(true), 2000);
  68 |     return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  69 |   }, []);
  70 | 
  71 |   if (!import.meta.env.DEV || !ready) return null;
  72 | 
  73 |   return (
  74 |     <Suspense fallback={null}>
  75 |       <Devtools />
  76 |     </Suspense>
  77 |   );
  78 | }
  79 | 
  80 | // ─── Root route ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  81 | 
  82 | export const Route = createRootRouteWithContext<RouterContext>()({
  83 |   head: () => ({
  84 |     meta: [
  85 |       { charSet: "utf-8" },
  86 |       { name: "viewport", content: "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" },
  87 |       { title: APP.title },
  88 |       { name: "description", content: APP.description },
  89 |       // Two declarative theme-color tags. The browser picks the one
  90 |       // matching `prefers-color-scheme` — first-paint correct with
  91 |       // no JS. If the user overrides their OS theme in-app, only
  92 |       // `<html style="color-scheme">` (set by the init script)
  93 |       // reflects that; browsers read it for scrollbar and form-
  94 |       // control tinting. To also correct the address-bar color on
  95 |       // user override, that logic belongs in `applyTheme` in
  96 |       // theme-utils.ts, not in the inline script.
  97 |       {
  98 |         name: "theme-color",
  99 |         content: APP.themeColor.light,
 100 |         media: "(prefers-color-scheme: light)",
 101 |       },
 102 |       {
 103 |         name: "theme-color",
 104 |         content: APP.themeColor.dark,
 105 |         media: "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)",
 106 |       },
 107 |     ],
 108 |     links: [{ rel: "stylesheet", href: appCss }],
 109 |     // Executed synchronously inside <head> by `<HeadContent />`,
 110 |     // before the body paints. See theme-init.ts for the contract.
 111 |     scripts: [{ children: THEME_INIT_SCRIPT }],
 112 |   }),
 113 |   shellComponent: RootDocument,
 114 | });
 115 | 
 116 | // ─── Shell ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 117 | //
 118 | // `suppressHydrationWarning` is on `<html>` because the `class`
 119 | // attribute legitimately differs between SSR and the first client
 120 | // render (init script vs. `matchMedia`). React has no per-attribute
 121 | // opt-out. The blast radius — also suppressing warnings for `lang`
 122 | // and `dir` — is accepted: those attributes are static today.
 123 | //
 124 | // `ThemeProvider` is mounted without `defaultTheme` (defaults to
 125 | // "system"). The first client render of any `useTheme()` consumer
 126 | // can disagree with SSR until `mounted` flips; the fix belongs in
 127 | // `lib/shadcn/theme.tsx` (gate `resolvedTheme` on `mounted`), not
 128 | // here. Do not paper over it with `defaultTheme="light"` — that
 129 | // breaks first paint for system-dark users.
 130 | 
 131 | function RootDocument({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
 132 |   return (
 133 |     <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
 134 |       <head>
 135 |         <HeadContent />
 136 |       </head>
 137 |       <body>
 138 |         <ThemeProvider>
 139 |           <TooltipProvider>{children}</TooltipProvider>
 140 |         </ThemeProvider>
 141 |         <DevtoolsDeferred />
 142 |         <Scripts />
 143 |       </body>
 144 |     </html>
 145 |   );
 146 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   2 | 
   3 | import { PageHeader } from "#/components/blocks/page-header.tsx";
   4 | import { RouteError } from "#/components/blocks/route-error.tsx";
   5 | import { Skeleton } from "#/components/ui/skeleton.tsx";
   6 | import { AppointmentSheet } from "#/features/appointments/components/AppointmentSheet.tsx";
   7 | import { appointmentByIdQuery } from "#/features/appointments/queries.ts";
   8 | import { useAuthSuspense } from "#/lib/auth/hooks.ts";
   9 | import { authQueryOptions } from "#/lib/auth/queries.ts";
  10 | 
  11 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/appointments/$appointmentId")({
  12 |   loader: async ({ context, params }) => {
  13 |     const user = await context.queryClient.query({
  14 |       ...authQueryOptions(),
  15 |       staleTime: "static",
  16 |     });
  17 |     if (!user?.clinicId) return null;
  18 | 
  19 |     const appointment = await context.queryClient.fetchQuery(
  20 |       appointmentByIdQuery(params.appointmentId),
  21 |     );
  22 |     if (!appointment) throw new Error("Appointment not found.");
  23 |     return appointment;
  24 |   },
  25 |   component: AppointmentDetailPage,
  26 |   errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
  27 |     <RouteError
  28 |       kind="unknown"
  29 |       message={errorMessage(error)}
  30 |       onRetry={reset}
  31 |       title="Couldn't load this appointment"
  32 |     />
  33 |   ),
  34 |   pendingComponent: () => <AppointmentDetailSkeleton />,
  35 | });
  36 | 
  37 | function AppointmentDetailPage() {
  38 |   const { user } = useAuthSuspense();
  39 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  40 |   const { appointmentId } = Route.useParams();
  41 | 
  42 |   if (!user?.clinicId) {
  43 |     return (
  44 |       <PageHeader
  45 |         description="No clinic is assigned to your account. Ask an administrator to link you."
  46 |         title="Appointment"
  47 |       />
  48 |     );
  49 |   }
  50 | 
  51 |   return (
  52 |     <AppointmentSheet
  53 |       appointmentId={appointmentId}
  54 |       clinicId={user.clinicId}
  55 |       onOpenChange={(open) => {
  56 |         if (!open) {
  57 |           void navigate({ to: "/app/appointments" });
  58 |         }
  59 |       }}
  60 |       onSaved={() => void navigate({ to: "/app/appointments" })}
  61 |       open
  62 |     />
  63 |   );
  64 | }
  65 | 
  66 | function AppointmentDetailSkeleton() {
  67 |   return (
  68 |     <div aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading appointment" className="p-6">
  69 |       <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full" />
  70 |     </div>
  71 |   );
  72 | }
  73 | 
  74 | function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  75 |   if (error instanceof Error && error.message.length < 200) {
  76 |     if (!/^(error:|duplicate key|violates|relation|column|syntax)/i.test(error.message)) {
  77 |       return error.message;
  78 |     }
  79 |   }
  80 |   return "No changes were made. Check your connection and retry.";
  81 | }
```

```tsx
  19 | function SegmentedToggle({
  20 |   value,
  21 |   onChange,
  22 | }: {
  23 |   value: MobileView;
  24 |   onChange: (v: MobileView) => void;
  25 | }) {
  26 |   const options: { value: MobileView; label: string }[] = [
  27 |     { value: "today", label: "Today" },
  28 |     { value: "week", label: "Week" },
  29 |     { value: "all", label: "All" },
  30 |   ];
  31 | 
  32 |   return (
  33 |     <div
  34 |       aria-label="View mode"
  35 |       className="bg-muted flex w-full items-center rounded-xl p-1"
  36 |       role="tablist"
  37 |     >
  38 |       {options.map((opt) => (
  39 |         <button
  40 |           aria-selected={value === opt.value}
  41 |           className={`flex-1 rounded-lg py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase transition-colors ${
  42 |             value === opt.value
  43 |               ? "bg-background text-foreground shadow-sm"
  44 |               : " hover:text-foreground"
  45 |           }`}
  46 |           key={opt.value}
  47 |           onClick={() => onChange(opt.value)}
  48 |           role="tab"
  49 |           type="button"
  50 |         >
  51 |           {opt.label}
  52 |         </button>
  53 |       ))}
  54 |     </div>
  55 |   );
  56 | }
  57 | 
  58 | function AppointmentsPage() {
  59 |   const { user } = useAuthSuspense();
  60 |   const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = React.useState(false);
  61 |   const [editId, setEditId] = React.useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  62 |   const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = React.useState<Date | undefined>(undefined);
  63 |   const [mobileView, setMobileView] = React.useState<MobileView>("today");
  64 | 
  65 |   const openNew = React.useCallback(() => {
  66 |     setEditId(undefined);
  67 |     setSheetOpen(true);
  68 |   }, []);
  69 | 
  70 |   const openEdit = React.useCallback((id: string) => {
  71 |     setEditId(id);
  72 |     setSheetOpen(true);
  73 |   }, []);
  74 | 
  75 |   const handleSelectDate = React.useCallback(
  76 |     (date: Date) => {
  77 |       setSelectedDate(date);
  78 |       openNew();
  79 |     },
  80 |     [openNew],
  81 |   );
  82 | 
  83 |   if (!user?.clinicId) {
  84 |     return (
  85 |       <PageHeader
  86 |         description="No clinic is assigned to your account. Ask an administrator to link you."
  87 |         title="Appointments"
  88 |       />
  89 |     );
  90 |   }
  91 | 
  92 |   const clinicId = user.clinicId;
  93 | 
  94 |   return (
  95 |     <>
  96 |       <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
  97 |         <PageHeader
  98 |           actions={
  99 |             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 100 |               <Button
 101 |                 nativeButton={false}
 102 |                 render={<Link to="/app/appointments/calendar" />}
 103 |                 size="sm"
 104 |                 variant="outline"
 105 |               >
 106 |                 <CalendarIcon className="size-3.5" />
 107 |                 Calendar
 108 |               </Button>
 109 |               <Button onClick={() => openNew()} size="sm" title="New appointment (N)">
 110 |                 <PlusIcon className="size-3.5" />
 111 |                 New
 112 |               </Button>
 113 |             </div>
 114 |           }
 115 |           description="Today's schedule and weekly overview."
 116 |           title="Appointments"
 117 |         />
 118 | 
 119 |         <div className="md:hidden">
 120 |           <SegmentedToggle onChange={setMobileView} value={mobileView} />
 121 |         </div>
 122 | 
 123 |         {/* Desktop: three-column grid. Mobile: single column, driven by SegmentedToggle. */}
 124 |         <div className="gap-6 md:grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_240px] lg:grid-cols-[1fr_260px_220px]">
 125 |           {/* Today queue — shown on desktop and on mobile when "today" is active */}
 126 |           <div
 127 |             className={
 128 |               mobileView === "today"
 129 |                 ? "bg-card rounded-xl border p-5"
 130 |                 : "bg-card hidden rounded-xl border p-5 md:block"
 131 |             }
 132 |           >
 133 |             <TodayQueue clinicId={clinicId} onEdit={openEdit} onNew={() => openNew()} />
 134 |           </div>
 135 | 
 136 |           {/* Week strip — shown on desktop and on mobile when "week" is active */}
 137 |           <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
 138 |             <div
 139 |               className={
 140 |                 mobileView === "week"
 141 |                   ? "bg-card rounded-xl border p-5"
 142 |                   : "bg-card hidden rounded-xl border p-5 md:block"
 143 |               }
 144 |             >
 145 |               <WeekStrip
 146 |                 clinicId={clinicId}
 147 |                 onSelectDate={handleSelectDate}
 148 |                 selectedDate={selectedDate}
 149 |               />
 150 |             </div>
 151 |           </div>
 152 | 
 153 |           {/* Filters rail — shown on desktop (lg+) and on mobile when "all" is active */}
 154 |           <div
 155 |             className={
 156 |               mobileView === "all"
 157 |                 ? "bg-card rounded-xl border p-5"
 158 |                 : "bg-card hidden rounded-xl border p-5 lg:block"
 159 |             }
 160 |           >
 161 |             {/* Store-backed — no props. `doctors` left out until
 162 |                 the route has a roster to pass in. */}
 163 |             <FiltersRail />
 164 |           </div>
 165 |         </div>
 166 |       </div>
 167 | 
 168 |       <AppointmentSheet
 169 |         appointmentId={editId}
 170 |         clinicId={clinicId}
 171 |         onOpenChange={(open) => {
 172 |           setSheetOpen(open);
 173 |           if (!open) {
 174 |             setEditId(undefined);
 175 |           }
 176 |         }}
 177 |         onSaved={() => {

 179 |           setEditId(undefined);
 180 |           setSelectedDate(undefined);
 181 |         }}
 182 |         open={sheetOpen}
 183 |       />
 184 |     </>
 185 |   );
 186 | }
```

```tsx
 137 | function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {

 140 |       return error.message;
 141 |     }
```

```tsx
  24 | const updateSchema = z.object({
  25 |   name: z.string().trim().min(2, "Name is required").max(120),
  26 |   email: z.email("Invalid email").or(z.literal("")),
  27 |   phone: z
  28 |     .string()
  29 |     .trim()
  30 |     .min(7, "Phone must be at least 7 characters")
  31 |     .max(20, "Phone is too long")

  35 | 
  36 | function EditClinicPage() {
  37 |   const { clinicId } = Route.useParams();
  38 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  39 |   const { user } = useAuthSuspense();
  40 | 
  41 |   const cancel = () => void navigate({ to: "/app/clinics/$clinicId", params: { clinicId } });
  42 | 
  43 |   if (typeof user?.role !== "string" || user.role !== "admin") {
  44 |     return <PageHeader description="Only administrators can edit clinics." title="Edit Clinic" />;
  45 |   }
  46 | 
  47 |   return (
  48 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">

  53 |       <Card>

  57 |           </div>

  59 |       </Card>
  60 |     </div>
  61 |   );
  62 | }
  63 | 
  64 | function EditClinicForm({ clinicId, onDone }: { clinicId: string; onDone: () => void }) {
  65 |   const clinicQuery = useQuery(clinicByIdQuery(clinicId));
  66 | 
  67 |   if (clinicQuery.isPending) {
  68 |     return (
  69 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
  70 |         <Spinner />
  71 |       </div>
  72 |     );
  73 |   }
  74 | 
  75 |   if (clinicQuery.isError) {
  76 |     return (
  77 |       <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center">
  78 |         <p className="text-destructive text-sm font-medium">
  79 |           {clinicQuery.error instanceof Error
  80 |             ? clinicQuery.error.message
  81 |             : "Could not load clinic."}
  82 |         </p>
  83 |         <Button onClick={() => void clinicQuery.refetch()} size="sm" variant="outline">
  84 |           Try Again
  85 |         </Button>
  86 |       </div>
  87 |     );
  88 |   }
  89 | 
  90 |   if (!clinicQuery.data) {
  91 |     return <p className=" py-6 text-center text-sm">This clinic no longer exists.</p>;
  92 |   }
  93 | 
  94 |   return <ClinicEditFields clinic={clinicQuery.data} clinicId={clinicId} onDone={onDone} />;

  97 | function ClinicEditFields({

  99 |   clinic,
 100 |   onDone,

 102 |   clinicId: string;
 103 |   clinic: {
 104 |     name: string;

 106 |     phone: string | null;
 107 |     address: string | null;

 170 |               <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 171 |                 {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 172 |               </p>
 173 |             )}
 174 |           </Field>
 175 |         )}
 176 |       </form.Field>
 177 | 
 178 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

 187 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 188 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 189 |                 type="tel"
 190 |                 value={field.state.value}
 191 |               />
 192 |               {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (
 193 |                 <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 194 |                   {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 195 |                 </p>
 196 |               )}
 197 |             </Field>
 198 |           )}
 199 |         </form.Field>
 200 |

 202 |           {(field) => (
 203 |             <Field>

 205 |               <Input
 206 |                 aria-invalid={field.state.meta.errors.length > 0}
 207 |                 id="clinic-email"
 208 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 209 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 210 |                 type="email"
 211 |                 value={field.state.value}
 212 |               />
 213 |               {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (
 214 |                 <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 215 |                   {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 216 |                 </p>
 217 |               )}
 218 |             </Field>
 219 |           )}
 220 |         </form.Field>
 221 |       </div>
 222 | 
 223 |       <form.Field name="address">
 224 |         {(field) => (

 226 |             <FieldLabel htmlFor="clinic-address">Address</FieldLabel>
 227 |             <Textarea
 228 |               id="clinic-address"

 230 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 231 |               rows={2}

 233 |             />
 234 |             {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]) && (
 235 |               <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 236 |                 {fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 237 |               </p>
 238 |             )}
 239 |           </Field>
 240 |         )}
 241 |       </form.Field>
 242 | 
 243 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.errorMap.onSubmit}>
 244 |         {(err) => {
 245 |           const message = fieldErrorMessage(err);
 246 |           return message ? (
 247 |             <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 248 |               {message}
 249 |             </p>
 250 |           ) : null;
 251 |         }}
 252 |       </form.Subscribe>
 253 | 
 254 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.isSubmitting}>
 255 |         {(isSubmitting) => (
 256 |           <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
 257 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} onClick={onDone} type="button" variant="outline">
 258 |               Cancel
 259 |             </Button>
 260 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} type="submit">
 261 |               {isSubmitting ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes"}
 262 |             </Button>
 263 |           </div>
 264 |         )}
 265 |       </form.Subscribe>
 266 |     </form>
 267 |   );
 268 | }
```

`routes/_auth/app/conflicts/$conflictId.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | // src/routes/_auth/app/conflicts/$conflictId.tsx
   2 | import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | 
   4 | import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
   5 | import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
   6 | import { useOutboxEntry, useResolveConflict } from "@/features/outbox/use-outbox";
   7 | 
   8 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/conflicts/$conflictId")({
   9 |   component: ConflictDialog,
  10 | });
  11 | 
  12 | function ConflictDialog() {
  13 |   const { conflictId } = Route.useParams();
  14 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  15 |   const q = useOutboxEntry(conflictId);
  16 |   const resolve = useResolveConflict();
  17 | 
  18 |   const close = () => void navigate({ to: "/app" });
  19 |   const pick = (resolution: "keep-local" | "use-server") =>
  20 |     resolve.mutate({ id: conflictId, resolution }, { onSettled: close });
  21 | 
  22 |   return (
  23 |     <Dialog onOpenChange={(open) => !open && close()} open>
  24 |       <DialogContent aria-labelledby="conflict-title" className="sm:max-w-2xl">
  25 |         <DialogHeader>
  26 |           <DialogTitle id="conflict-title">Sync conflict needs review</DialogTitle>
  27 |         </DialogHeader>
  28 | 
  29 |         {!q.data ? (
  30 |           <p className=" text-sm">This conflict has already been resolved.</p>
  31 |         ) : (
  32 |           <>
  33 |             <p className=" text-sm">
  34 |               Someone else updated this record while you were offline. Pick which version to keep.
  35 |             </p>
  36 | 
  37 |             <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
  38 |               <SnapshotPanel data={q.data.optimisticSnapshot} label="Your change (offline)" />
  39 |               <SnapshotPanel data={q.data.serverSnapshot} label="Server version" />
  40 |             </div>
  41 | 
  42 |             <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
  43 |               <Button
  44 |                 disabled={resolve.isPending}
  45 |                 nativeButton
  46 |                 onClick={() => pick("use-server")}
  47 |                 variant="outline"
  48 |               >
  49 |                 Use server version
  50 |               </Button>
  51 |               <Button disabled={resolve.isPending} nativeButton onClick={() => pick("keep-local")}>
  52 |                 Keep my change
  53 |               </Button>
  54 |             </div>
  55 |           </>
  56 |         )}
  57 |       </DialogContent>
  58 |     </Dialog>
  59 |   );
  60 | }
  61 | 
  62 | function SnapshotPanel({ label, data }: { label: string; data: unknown }) {
  63 |   return (
  64 |     <div className="rounded-md border p-3">
  65 |       <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase">{label}</p>
  66 |       <pre className="max-h-64 overflow-auto text-[11px] leading-snug">
  67 |         {data ? JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) : "—"}
  68 |       </pre>
  69 |     </div>
  70 |   );
  71 | }
```

```tsx
  48 | function PatientDevelopmentPage() {

  52 |   // ── read: shared query factory ─────────────────────────────────────

  54 |

  57 | 
  58 |   const [selectedMilestoneId, setSelectedMilestoneId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  61 |     if (!query.data || !selectedMilestoneId) return null;
  62 |     return query.data.milestones.find((m) => m.id === selectedMilestoneId) ?? null;
  63 |   }, [query.data, selectedMilestoneId]);
  64 | 
  65 |   if (query.isPending) {

 109 |     return {

 351 | function MilestoneInspector({
 352 |   milestone,
 353 |   onSave,
 354 |   onClose,
 355 |   saving,

 357 |   milestone: PatientMilestone;
 358 |   onSave: (values: {

 361 |     notes?: string | null;

 364 |   saving: boolean;

 366 |   const [isAchieved, setIsAchieved] = React.useState(milestone.isAchieved);
 367 |   const [achievedDate, setAchievedDate] = React.useState(
 368 |     milestone.achievedDate ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
 369 |   );
 370 |   const [notes, setNotes] = React.useState(milestone.notes ?? "");
 371 | 
 372 |   const meta = DOMAIN_META[milestone.domain as MilestoneDomain];
 373 | 
 374 |   return (
 375 |     <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
 376 |       <SheetHeader>
 377 |         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 378 |           <span
 379 |             className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${meta.bg} ${meta.text}`}
 380 |           >

 383 |           {milestone.isRedFlagIfMissing && <Badge variant="destructive">Critical</Badge>}
 384 |         </div>

 397 |               : "border-border hover:bg-muted/50"

 405 |           ) : (

 418 |             />

 431 |           />
 432 |         </Field>
 433 |       </div>

 435 |       <div className="mt-auto flex gap-2 pt-6">

 437 |           Close

 440 |           className="flex-1"
 441 |           disabled={saving}
 442 |           onClick={() =>
 443 |             onSave({
 444 |               isAchieved,
 445 |               achievedDate: isAchieved ? achievedDate : null,
 446 |               notes: notes.trim() || null,
 447 |             })
 448 |           }
```

```tsx
  58 |   const records = query.data ?? [];
  59 |   const grouped = new Map<number, PatientVaccinationRecord[]>();
  60 |   for (const r of records) {

  62 |     const list = grouped.get(bucket) ?? [];
  63 |     list.push(r);
```

```tsx
   1 | import { skipToken, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   2 | import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | import { z } from "zod";
   4 | 
   5 | import { PageHeader } from "@/components/blocks/page-header";
   6 | import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

  10 | // ── read: query factory from queries.ts ────────────────────────────────
  11 | import { immunizationCoverageQuery } from "@/features/immunizations/queries";
  12 | import { useAuthSuspense } from "@/lib/auth/hooks";
  13 | 
  14 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  15 | // Constants
  16 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  17 | 
  18 | const IMMUNIZATIONS_PATH = "/app/immunizations" as const;
  19 | 
  20 | const AGE_BRACKETS = [
  21 |   { value: "0-6", label: "0–6m" },
  22 |   { value: "6-12", label: "6–12m" },
  23 |   { value: "12-24", label: "12–24m" },
  24 |   { value: ">24", label: ">24m" },
  25 | ] as const;
  26 | 
  27 | const searchSchema = z.object({
  28 |   age: z.enum(["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", ">24"]).optional(),
  29 |   overdue: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
  30 | });
  31 | 
  32 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/immunizations/")({
  33 |   validateSearch: searchSchema,
  34 |   component: ImmunizationRegisterPage,
  35 | });
  36 | 
  37 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  38 | // Page
  39 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  40 | 
  41 | function ImmunizationRegisterPage() {
  42 |   const { user } = useAuthSuspense();
  43 |   const search = Route.useSearch();
  44 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  45 | 
  46 |   // Clinic id is possibly null while auth resolves. Hooks must still run
  47 |   // unconditionally — the query is gated with `enabled`, not by an early
  48 |   // return before the hook.
  49 |   const clinicId = user?.clinicId ?? null;
  50 | 
  51 |   // Shared coverage query — same key as every other caller, so
  52 |   // `invalidateImmunizationCaches` from the record-immunization mutation
  53 |   // refreshes this automatically.
  54 |   const coverageQ = useQuery({
  55 |     ...(clinicId
  56 |       ? immunizationCoverageQuery(clinicId)
  57 |       : {
  58 |           queryKey: ["immunizations", "coverage", "skip"],
  59 |           queryFn: skipToken,
  60 |         }),
  61 |     enabled: Boolean(clinicId),
  62 |   });
  63 | 
  64 |   // Centralized search update — one place to reason about what's in the URL.
  65 |   const setSearch = (patch: Partial<z.infer<typeof searchSchema>>) => {
  66 |     void navigate({
  67 |       search: (prev) => {
  68 |         const next = { ...prev, ...patch };
  69 |         // Drop false / undefined so the URL stays clean and the
  70 |         // "on" state is encoded as presence, not a value.
  71 |         for (const key of Object.keys(next) as (keyof typeof next)[]) {
  72 |           if (next[key] === false || next[key] === undefined) {
  73 |             delete next[key];
  74 |           }
  75 |         }
  76 |         return next;
  77 |       },
  78 |       to: IMMUNIZATIONS_PATH,
  79 |     });
  80 |   };
  81 | 
  82 |   // ── Deferred render for the "no clinic" case ───────────────────────────
  83 |   //
  84 |   // This used to be a `return` before `useQuery`, which broke the rules
  85 |   // of hooks. Moving it after all hooks run keeps the hook order stable
  86 |   // and lets the page render the same hooks in every render pass.
  87 | 
  88 |   if (!user) {
  89 |     // Auth is still resolving. A skeleton prevents a flash of "no clinic".
  90 |     return <PageHeader description="Loading…" title="Immunizations" />;
  91 |   }
  92 | 
  93 |   if (!clinicId) {
  94 |     return (
  95 |       <PageHeader description="No clinic is assigned to your account." title="Immunizations" />
  96 |     );
  97 |   }
  98 | 
  99 |   return (
 100 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
 101 |       <PageHeader
 102 |         description="Clinic-wide immunization coverage and per-patient status."
 103 |         title="Immunizations"
 104 |       />
 105 | 
 106 |       <CoverageStrip data={coverageQ.data} isLoading={coverageQ.isLoading} />
 107 | 
 108 |       <div className="bg-background/95 sticky top-0 z-20 -mx-6 space-y-3 border-b px-6 py-3 backdrop-blur md:-mx-8 md:px-8">
 109 |         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
 110 |           <div aria-label="Filter by age bracket" className="flex flex-wrap gap-1" role="group">
 111 |             <AgeChip
 112 |               active={!search.age}
 113 |               label="All ages"
 114 |               onClick={() => setSearch({ age: undefined })}
 115 |             />
 116 |             {AGE_BRACKETS.map((bracket) => (
 117 |               <AgeChip
 118 |                 active={search.age === bracket.value}
 119 |                 key={bracket.value}
 120 |                 label={bracket.label}
 121 |                 onClick={() => setSearch({ age: bracket.value })}
 122 |               />
 123 |             ))}
 124 |           </div>
 125 | 
 126 |           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 127 |             <Switch
 128 |               checked={Boolean(search.overdue)}
 129 |               id="only-overdue"
 130 |               onCheckedChange={(v) => setSearch({ overdue: v || undefined })}
 131 |             />
 132 |             <Label htmlFor="only-overdue">Only overdue</Label>
 133 |           </div>
 134 |         </div>
 135 |       </div>
 136 | 
 137 |       <ImmunizationMatrix
 138 |         ageBracket={search.age}
 139 |         clinicId={clinicId}
 140 |         onlyOverdue={Boolean(search.overdue)}
 141 |       />
 142 |     </div>
 143 |   );
 144 | }
 145 | 
 146 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 147 | // Small presentational helpers
 148 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 149 | 
 150 | function AgeChip({
 151 |   active,
 152 |   label,
 153 |   onClick,
 154 | }: {
 155 |   active: boolean;
 156 |   label: string;
 157 |   onClick: () => void;
 158 | }) {
 159 |   return (
 160 |     <button
 161 |       aria-pressed={active}
 162 |       className={
 163 |         active
 164 |           ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium"
 165 |           : "bg-muted  hover:bg-muted/80 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium"
 166 |       }
 167 |       onClick={onClick}
 168 |       type="button"
 169 |     >
 170 |       {label}
 171 |     </button>
 172 |   );
 173 | }
```

```tsx
 103 | }
 104 | 
 105 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 106 | // Fields loader
 107 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 108 | 
 109 | function PatientEditFields({ patientId, onDone }: { patientId: string; onDone: () => void }) {
 110 |   const patientQuery = useQuery(getPatientQueryOptions(patientId));
 111 | 
 112 |   if (patientQuery.isPending) {
 113 |     return <Skeleton className="h-96" />;
 114 |   }
 115 | 
 116 |   if (patientQuery.isError) {
 117 |     return (
 118 |       <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center">
 119 |         <p className="text-destructive text-sm font-medium">
 120 |           {patientQuery.error instanceof Error
 121 |             ? patientQuery.error.message
 122 |             : "Could not load patient."}
 123 |         </p>
 124 |         <Button onClick={() => void patientQuery.refetch()} size="sm" variant="outline">
 125 |           Try Again
 126 |         </Button>
 127 |       </div>
 128 |     );
 129 |   }
 130 | 
 131 |   if (!patientQuery.data) {
 132 |     return (
 133 |       <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center">
 134 |         <p className=" text-sm">This patient no longer exists.</p>
 135 |         <Button onClick={onDone} size="sm" variant="outline">
 136 |           Back to patients
 137 |         </Button>
 138 |       </div>
 139 |     );
 140 |   }
 141 | 
 142 |   return <PatientEditForm onDone={onDone} patient={patientQuery.data} />;
 143 | }
 144 | 
 145 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 146 | // Form
 147 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 148 | 
 149 | interface EditablePatient {
 150 |   id: string;
 151 |   firstName: string;
 152 |   lastName: string;
 153 |   phone?: string | null;
 154 |   address?: string | null;
 155 |   parentName?: string | null;
 156 |   allergies?: string | null;
 157 |   updatedAt: string | Date;
 158 | }
 159 | 
 160 | function PatientEditForm({ patient, onDone }: { patient: EditablePatient; onDone: () => void }) {
 161 |   const updateMutation = useUpdatePatientMutation({
 162 |     patientId: patient.id,
 163 |   });
 164 | 
 165 |   const form = useForm({
 166 |     defaultValues: {
 167 |       firstName: patient.firstName,
 168 |       lastName: patient.lastName,
 169 |       phone: patient.phone ?? "",
 170 |       address: patient.address ?? "",
 171 |       parentName: patient.parentName ?? "",
 172 |       allergies: patient.allergies ?? "",
 173 |     },
 174 |     validators: { onSubmit: editSchema },
 175 |     onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
 176 |       const trimmed: EditFormValues = {
 177 |         firstName: value.firstName.trim(),
 178 |         lastName: value.lastName.trim(),
 179 |         phone: value.phone.trim(),
 180 |         address: value.address.trim(),
 181 |         parentName: value.parentName.trim(),
 182 |         allergies: value.allergies.trim(),
 183 |       };
 184 | 
 185 |       try {
 186 |         // Optimistic concurrency: send the timestamp we loaded so the
 187 |         // server rejects the write if someone else edited meanwhile.
 188 |         const baseVersion =
 189 |           typeof patient.updatedAt === "string"
 190 |             ? patient.updatedAt
 191 |             : patient.updatedAt.toISOString();
 192 | 
 193 |         await updateMutation.mutateAsync({
 194 |           data: {
 195 |             patientId: patient.id,
 196 |             baseVersion,
 197 |             patch: {
 198 |               firstName: trimmed.firstName,
 199 |               lastName: trimmed.lastName,
 200 |               phone: trimmed.phone || null,
 201 |               address: trimmed.address || null,
 202 |               parentName: trimmed.parentName || null,
 203 |               allergies: trimmed.allergies || null,
 204 |             },
 205 |           },
 206 |         });
 207 | 
 208 |         toast.add({ type: "success", description: "Patient updated" });
 209 |         onDone();
 210 |         return undefined;
 211 |       } catch (err) {
 212 |         const message =
 213 |           err instanceof Error
 214 |             ? err.message
 215 |             : typeof err === "string"
 216 |               ? err
 217 |               : "Failed to save patient";
 218 |         const status =
 219 |           typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "status" in err
 220 |             ? (err as { status?: unknown }).status
 221 |             : undefined;
 222 | 
 223 |         if (/conflict|409/i.test(message) || status === 409) {
 224 |           return {
 225 |             form: "Someone else edited this patient. Reload the page to see their changes.",
 226 |           };
 227 |         }
 228 | 
 229 |         return {
 230 |           form: message,
 231 |         };
 232 |       }
 233 |     },
 234 |   });
 235 | 
 236 |   return (
 237 |     <form
 238 |       className="grid gap-4"
 239 |       noValidate
 240 |       onSubmit={(event) => {
 241 |         event.preventDefault();
 242 |         event.stopPropagation();
 243 |         void form.handleSubmit();
 244 |       }}
 245 |     >
 246 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
 247 |         <form.Field name="firstName">
 248 |           {(field) => (
 249 |             <FieldShell
 250 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 251 |               id={field.name}
 252 |               label="First name"
 253 |             >
 254 |               <Input
 255 |                 autoComplete="given-name"
 256 |                 id={field.name}
 257 |                 maxLength={120}
 258 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 259 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 260 |                 required
 261 |                 value={field.state.value}
 262 |               />
 263 |             </FieldShell>
 264 |           )}
 265 |         </form.Field>
 266 | 
 267 |         <form.Field name="lastName">
 268 |           {(field) => (
 269 |             <FieldShell
 270 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 271 |               id={field.name}
 272 |               label="Last name"
 273 |             >
 274 |               <Input
 275 |                 autoComplete="family-name"
 276 |                 id={field.name}
 277 |                 maxLength={120}
 278 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 279 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 280 |                 required
 281 |                 value={field.state.value}
 282 |               />
 283 |             </FieldShell>
 284 |           )}
 285 |         </form.Field>
 286 |       </div>
 287 | 
 288 |       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
 289 |         <form.Field name="parentName">
 290 |           {(field) => (
 291 |             <FieldShell
 292 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 293 |               id={field.name}
 294 |               label="Parent / guardian"
 295 |             >
 296 |               <Input
 297 |                 autoComplete="name"
 298 |                 id={field.name}
 299 |                 maxLength={120}
 300 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 301 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 302 |                 value={field.state.value}
 303 |               />
 304 |             </FieldShell>
 305 |           )}
 306 |         </form.Field>
 307 | 
 308 |         <form.Field name="phone">
 309 |           {(field) => (
 310 |             <FieldShell
 311 |               error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 312 |               id={field.name}
 313 |               label="Phone"
 314 |             >
 315 |               <Input
 316 |                 autoComplete="tel"
 317 |                 id={field.name}
 318 |                 inputMode="tel"
 319 |                 maxLength={32}
 320 |                 onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 321 |                 onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 322 |                 type="tel"
 323 |                 value={field.state.value}
 324 |               />
 325 |             </FieldShell>
 326 |           )}
 327 |         </form.Field>
 328 |       </div>
 329 | 
 330 |       <form.Field name="address">
 331 |         {(field) => (
 332 |           <FieldShell
 333 |             error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 334 |             id={field.name}
 335 |             label="Address"
 336 |           >
 337 |             <Textarea
 338 |               autoComplete="street-address"
 339 |               id={field.name}
 340 |               maxLength={500}
 341 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 342 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 343 |               rows={2}
 344 |               value={field.state.value}
 345 |             />
 346 |           </FieldShell>
 347 |         )}
 348 |       </form.Field>
 349 | 
 350 |       <form.Field name="allergies">
 351 |         {(field) => (
 352 |           <FieldShell
 353 |             error={fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0])}
 354 |             hint="Comma-separated, e.g. penicillin, peanuts"
 355 |             id={field.name}
 356 |             label="Allergies"
 357 |           >
 358 |             <Textarea
 359 |               id={field.name}
 360 |               maxLength={500}
 361 |               onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 362 |               onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 363 |               rows={2}
 364 |               value={field.state.value}
 365 |             />
 366 |           </FieldShell>
 367 |         )}
 368 |       </form.Field>
 369 | 
 370 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.errorMap.onSubmit}>
 371 |         {(err) => {
 372 |           const message = fieldErrorMessage(err);
 373 |           return message ? (
 374 |             <p className="text-destructive text-sm" role="alert">
 375 |               {message}
 376 |             </p>
 377 |           ) : null;
 378 |         }}
 379 |       </form.Subscribe>
 380 | 
 381 |       <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => s.isSubmitting}>
 382 |         {(isSubmitting) => (
 383 |           <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
 384 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} onClick={onDone} type="button" variant="outline">
 385 |               Cancel
 386 |             </Button>
 387 |             <Button disabled={isSubmitting} type="submit">
 388 |               {isSubmitting ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes"}
 389 |             </Button>
 390 |           </div>
 391 |         )}
 392 |       </form.Subscribe>
 393 |     </form>
 394 |   );
 395 | }
 396 | 
 397 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 398 | // Small shared field shell (unchanged)
 399 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 400 | 
 401 | function FieldShell({
 402 |   id,
 403 |   label,
 404 |   error,
 405 |   hint,
 406 |   children,
 407 | }: {
 408 |   id: string;
 409 |   label: string;
 410 |   error?: string;
 411 |   hint?: string;
 412 |   children: React.ReactNode;
 413 | }) {
 414 |   const errorId = `${id}-error`;
 415 |   const hintId = `${id}-hint`;
 416 |   const describedBy =
 417 |     [error ? errorId : null, hint ? hintId : null].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
 418 | 
 419 |   return (
 420 |     <div className="grid gap-2">
 421 |       <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
 422 |       {React.isValidElement(children)
 423 |         ? React.cloneElement(
 424 |             children as React.ReactElement<{
 425 |               "aria-describedby"?: string;
 426 |               "aria-invalid"?: boolean;
 427 |             }>,
 428 |             {
 429 |               "aria-describedby": describedBy,
 430 |               "aria-invalid": Boolean(error),
 431 |             },
 432 |           )
 433 |         : children}
 434 |       {hint && (
 435 |         <p className=" text-[11px]" id={hintId}>
 436 |           {hint}
 437 |         </p>
 438 |       )}
 439 |       {error && (
 440 |         <p className="text-destructive text-sm" id={errorId} role="alert">
 441 |           {error}
 442 |         </p>
 443 |       )}
 444 |     </div>
 445 |   );
 446 | }
```

```tsx
   7 |   ComposerUnit,
   8 |   PrescriptionComposerValues,
   9 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/types";
  10 | 
  11 | import { PageHeader } from "@/components/blocks/page-header";
  12 | import { toast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
  13 | // ── composer components ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  14 | import { ComposerShell } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/components/ComposerShell";
  15 | import { computeInteractions } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/components/interactions";
  16 | import { findComposerDrug } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/formulary";
  17 | // ── mutations (hooks) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  18 | import {
  19 |   useDiscontinuePrescriptionMutation,
  20 |   useSavePrescriptionMutation,
  21 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/queries";
  22 | // ── reads ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  23 | import {
  24 |   activePrescriptionsQuery,
  25 |   getPatientForComposerQueryOptions,
  26 |   prescriptionByIdQuery,
  27 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/queries";
  28 | 
  29 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/prescriptions/$prescriptionId")({
  30 |   validateSearch: z.object({
  31 |     edit: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
  32 |     print: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
  33 |   }),
  34 |   component: PrescriptionDetailPage,
  35 | });
  36 | 
  37 | // ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  38 | 
  39 | /** Parsed dose: numeric value + canonical unit. */
  40 | interface ParsedDose {
  41 |   value: number;
  42 |   unit: ComposerUnit;
  43 | }
  44 | 
  45 | const DOSE_PATTERN = /^\s*([\d.]+)\s*(mg|mL|mcg|g|units?)\b/i;
  46 | 
  47 | /**
  48 |  * Parse a free-form dosage string ("2.5 mL", "10 mg", "0.5 mcg")
  49 |  * into { value, unit }. Falls back to { 0, "mg" } for unparseable
  50 |  * input so the composer still renders — but never silently assumes
  51 |  * "mg" when the source says something else.
  52 |  */
  53 | function parseDose(dosage: string): ParsedDose {
  54 |   const match = DOSE_PATTERN.exec(dosage);
  55 |   if (!match) return { value: 0, unit: "mg" };
  56 |   const value = Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
  57 |   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return { value: 0, unit: "mg" };
  58 |   const raw = match[2].toLowerCase();
  59 |   const unit: ParsedDose["unit"] =
  60 |     raw === "ml"
  61 |       ? "mL"
  62 |       : raw === "mcg"
  63 |         ? "mcg"
  64 |         : raw === "g"
  65 |           ? "g"
  66 |           : raw.startsWith("unit")
  67 |             ? "units"
  68 |             : "mg";
  69 |   return { value, unit };
  70 | }
  71 | 
  72 | function toComposerValues(row: {

 133 | 
 134 |   useEffect(() => {
 135 |     if (!detail.data) return;
 136 |     if (initializedFor.current === detail.data.id) return;
 137 |     initializedFor.current = detail.data.id;
 138 |     setValues(toComposerValues(detail.data));

 150 |       });
 151 |     });
 152 |     return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id);
 153 |   }, [print, edit, prescriptionId, navigate]);

 182 |   const warnings = computeInteractions({

 202 |           });
 203 |         },

 207 |             description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save",

 209 |         },

 213 | 
 214 |   const runDiscontinue = () => {

 217 |       {
 218 |         onSuccess: () => {

 220 |             type: "success",
 221 |             description: "Prescription discontinued",
 222 |           });
 223 |           void navigate({

 238 |   // ── render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 244 |         onChange={onChange}
 245 |         onDiscontinue={mode === "view" ? runDiscontinue : undefined}
 246 |         onSave={() => runSave(false)}
 247 |         onSaveAndPrint={() => runSave(true)}
 248 |         patient={patientQ.data}
 249 |         previous={(activeQ.data ?? []).filter((m) => m.id !== prescriptionId)}
 250 |         subtitle={`Prescription ${prescriptionId.slice(0, 8)} — ${mode === "edit" ? "editing" : "read-only"}.`}
 251 |         title={detail.data.medicationName}

 255 |       <footer className=" border-t pt-4 text-xs">

 258 |           {new Date(detail.data.prescribedAt).toLocaleString()}
 259 |         </p>
 260 |       </footer>
 261 |     </div>
 262 |   );
 263 | }
```

```tsx
 463 |               })
 464 |             }
 465 |             type="date"
 466 |             value={search.from ?? ""}
 467 |           />
 468 |           <span className=" text-xs">–</span>
 469 |           <input
 470 |             aria-label="Prescribed to"
 471 |             className="border-border bg-background h-8 rounded-md border px-2 text-xs"
 472 |             onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...search, to: e.target.value || undefined, page: 1 })}
 473 |             type="date"
 474 |             value={search.to ?? ""}
 475 |           />
 476 |         </div>
 477 |       </div>
 478 |     </div>
 479 |   );
 480 | }
 481 | 
 482 | // ── Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 483 | 
 484 | function PrescriptionsTable({
 485 |   clinicId,
 486 |   search,
 487 | }: {
 488 |   clinicId: string;
 489 |   search: PrescriptionRegisterSearch;
 490 | }) {
 491 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 492 |   const size: PageSize = isPageSize(String(search.size)) ? (search.size as PageSize) : 20;
 493 |   const page = search.page;
 494 | 
 495 |   // ── KEY CHANGE: use prescriptionRegisterQuery ───────────────────────────
 496 |   // Note: pass `search` as-is; the factory filters out page/size for the
 497 |   // key, but the queryFn gets the full search object (including page/size)
 498 |   // so the server returns the correct page. No manual destructuring needed.
 499 |   const query = useQuery(prescriptionRegisterQuery(clinicId, search));
 500 | 
 501 |   const rows = (query.data?.rows ?? []) as RegisterRow[];
 502 |   const total = query.data?.total ?? 0;
 503 |   const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
 504 | 
 505 |   const table = useTable({
 506 |     columns,
 507 |     data: rows,
 508 |     features,
 509 |     getRowId: (row) => row.id,
 510 |     manualPagination: true,
 511 |     rowCount: total,
 512 |     state: { pagination: { pageIndex: page - 1, pageSize: size } },
 513 |   });
 514 | 
 515 |   if (query.isError) {
 516 |     return (
 517 |       <SectionState
 518 |         action={
 519 |           <Button
 520 |             disabled={query.isFetching}
 521 |             onClick={() => void query.refetch()}
 522 |             variant="outline"
 523 |           >
 524 |             {query.isFetching ? "Retrying…" : "Try Again"}
 525 |           </Button>
 526 |         }
 527 |         description={
 528 |           query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : "An unexpected error occurred."
 529 |         }
 530 |         icon={CircleAlertIcon}
 531 |         title="Failed to Load Prescriptions"
 532 |       />
 533 |     );
 534 |   }
 535 | 
 536 |   if (!query.isLoading && total === 0) {
 537 |     return <PrescriptionsEmptyState />;
 538 |   }
 539 | 
 540 |   const leafColumnCount = table.getAllLeafColumns().length;
 541 |   const FlexRender = table.FlexRender;
 542 | 
 543 |   return (
 544 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
 545 |       <Table aria-busy={query.isFetching} aria-label="Prescriptions" layout="fixed">
 546 |         <TableColGroup columns={COLUMN_LAYOUT} />
 547 |         <TableHeader>
 548 |           {table.getHeaderGroups().map((group) => (
 549 |             <TableRow key={group.id}>
 550 |               {group.headers.map((header) => (
 551 |                 <TableHead
 552 |                   hideOnMobile={header.column.columnDef.meta?.hideOnMobile}
 553 |                   key={header.id}
 554 |                 >
 555 |                   <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
 556 |                     <FlexRender header={header} />
 557 |                   </div>
 558 |                 </TableHead>
 559 |               ))}
 560 |             </TableRow>
 561 |           ))}
 562 |         </TableHeader>
 563 |         <TableBody>
 564 |           {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
 565 |             <PrescriptionTableRow
 566 |               FlexRender={FlexRender}
 567 |               key={row.id}
 568 |               queryClient={queryClient}
 569 |               row={row}
 570 |             />
 571 |           ))}
 572 |           {query.isFetching &&
 573 |             Array.from({ length: Math.min(size, 5) }, (_, i) => (
 574 |               <TableRow key={`sk-${i}`}>
 575 |                 <TableCell colSpan={leafColumnCount}>
 576 |                   <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
 577 |                 </TableCell>
 578 |               </TableRow>
 579 |             ))}
 580 |         </TableBody>
 581 |       </Table>
 582 | 
 583 |       <div className="bg-background/95 sticky bottom-0 py-2 backdrop-blur max-sm:-mx-6 max-sm:px-6 max-sm:pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
 584 |         <TablePagination
 585 |           ariaLabel="Prescription Pages"
 586 |           page={page}
 587 |           pageCount={pageCount}
 588 |           route={Route}
 589 |           size={size}
 590 |         />
 591 |       </div>
 592 |     </div>
 593 |   );
 594 | }
 595 | 
 596 | function PrescriptionTableRow({
 597 |   row,
 598 |   FlexRender,
 599 |   queryClient,
 600 | }: {
 601 |   row: ReturnType<
 602 |     ReturnType<typeof useTable<typeof features, RegisterRow>>["getRowModel"]
 603 |   >["rows"][number];
 604 |   FlexRender: ReturnType<typeof useTable<typeof features, RegisterRow>>["FlexRender"];
 605 |   queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>;
 606 | }) {
 607 |   const flags = row.original.flagsInteraction;
 608 |   return (
 609 |     <TableRow
 610 |       className={
 611 |         flags
 612 |           ? "relative before:absolute before:inset-y-0 before:left-0 before:w-0.5 before:content-['']"
 613 |           : undefined
 614 |       }
 615 |     >
 616 |       {row.getAllCells().map((cell) => (
 617 |         <TableCell
 618 |           className={
 619 |             cell.column.id === "patient" || cell.column.id === "medicationName" ? "relative" : ""
 620 |           }
 621 |           hideOnMobile={cell.column.columnDef.meta?.hideOnMobile}
 622 |           key={cell.id}
 623 |         >
 624 |           {cell.column.id === "medicationName" ? (
 625 |             <div className="group/cell relative flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
 626 |               <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
 627 |                 <FlexRender cell={cell} />
 628 |               </div>
 629 |               <RenewButton prescriptionId={row.original.id} queryClient={queryClient} />
 630 |             </div>
 631 |           ) : (
 632 |             <FlexRender cell={cell} />
 633 |           )}
 634 |         </TableCell>
 635 |       ))}
 636 |     </TableRow>
 637 |   );
 638 | }
 639 | 
 640 | // ── Renew mutation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 641 | 
 642 | function RenewButton({
 643 |   prescriptionId,
 644 |   queryClient,
 645 | }: {
 646 |   prescriptionId: string;
 647 |   queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>;
 648 | }) {
 649 |   // ── KEY CHANGE: use useMutation + useServerFn instead of calling
 650 |   // the server function directly from onClick. This gives us:
 651 |   //   - isPending state for a proper loading indicator
 652 |   //   - onSuccess hook for invalidation
 653 |   //   - error handling through the standard mutation API
 654 |   const renew = useServerFn(renewPrescriptionFn);
 655 | 
 656 |   const mutation = useMutation({
 657 |     mutationFn: () => renew({ data: { prescriptionId } }),
 658 |     onSuccess: (newRow) => {
 659 |       toast.add({
 660 |         type: "success",
 661 |         description: `Prescription renewed${newRow?.id ? ` (${newRow.id.slice(0, 8)})` : ""}`,
 662 |       });
 663 |       // Invalidate the whole register subtree — the new row must appear.
 664 |       // The `clinic` segment isn't in this query's key, so invalidate
 665 |       // by the register prefix instead.
 666 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 667 |         queryKey: ["prescriptions", "register"],
 668 |       });
 669 |       // Also invalidate the specific prescription if anyone has it open.
 670 |       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({
 671 |         queryKey: prescriptionKeys.detail(prescriptionId),
 672 |       });
 673 |     },
 674 |     onError: (err: unknown) => {
 675 |       toast.add({
 676 |         type: "destructive",
 677 |         description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to renew",
 678 |       });
 679 |     },
 680 |   });
 681 | 
 682 |   return (
 683 |     <div className="opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/cell:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100">
 684 |       <Button
 685 |         disabled={mutation.isPending}
 686 |         nativeButton
 687 |         onClick={(e) => {
 688 |           e.preventDefault();
 689 |           e.stopPropagation();
 690 |           mutation.mutate();
 691 |         }}
 692 |         size="xs"
 693 |         variant="ghost"
 694 |       >
 695 |         <RefreshCwIcon aria-hidden="true" className={mutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
 696 |         {mutation.isPending ? "Renewing…" : "Renew"}
 697 |       </Button>
 698 |     </div>
 699 |   );
 700 | }
 701 | 
 702 | // ── Empty state (unchanged) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 703 | 
 704 | function PrescriptionsEmptyState() {
 705 |   return (
 706 |     <div className="grid gap-6 rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 md:grid-cols-[1fr_360px] md:p-10">
 707 |       <div className="flex flex-col justify-center gap-4">
 708 |         <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
 709 |           <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">No prescriptions yet</h2>
 710 |           <p className=" text-sm">
 711 |             Prescriptions written at this clinic will appear here, filterable by status, prescriber,
 712 |             and date.
 713 |           </p>
 714 |         </div>
 715 |         <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
 716 |           <Button
 717 |             nativeButton={false}
 718 |             render={<Link to="/app/prescriptions/neonatal-dose-calculator" />}
 719 |           >
 720 |             <PlusIcon aria-hidden="true" />
 721 |             Write a prescription
 722 |           </Button>
 723 |           <Button
 724 |             nativeButton={false}
 725 |             render={<Link to="/app/prescriptions/neonatal-dose-calculator" />}
 726 |             variant="outline"
 727 |           >
 728 |             <CalculatorIcon aria-hidden="true" />
 729 |             Browse formulary
 730 |           </Button>
 731 |         </div>
 732 |       </div>
 733 | 
 734 |       <aside className="bg-muted/40 flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border p-4 text-sm">
 735 |         <p className="text-foreground font-semibold">Pediatric dosing, in one line</p>
 736 |         <p className="">
 737 |           Doses are weight-based (mg/kg/dose or mg/kg/day). Use the NICU calculator for neonates —
 738 |           it accounts for gestational age and renal dosing. Always round to the smallest measurable
 739 |           volume for the prepared concentration.
 740 |         </p>
 741 |         <Link
 742 |           className="text-primary text-xs font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
 743 |           to="/app/prescriptions/neonatal-dose-calculator"
 744 |         >
 745 |           Open the dosing reference →
 746 |         </Link>
 747 |       </aside>
 748 |     </div>
 749 |   );
 750 | }
 751 | 
 752 | // ── Helpers (unchanged) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 753 | 
 754 | function startOfWeekISO(): string {
 755 |   const d = new Date();
 756 |   const day = d.getUTCDay() || 7; // Monday = 1
 757 |   d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - (day - 1));
 758 |   d.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
 759 |   return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 760 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   2 | import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   3 | import * as React from "react";
   4 | import { z } from "zod/v4";

   6 | import type { PrescriptionComposerValues } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/types";
   7 | 
   8 | import { PageHeader } from "@/components/blocks/page-header";
   9 | import { toast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
  10 | // ── composer components ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  11 | import { ComposerShell } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/components/ComposerShell";
  12 | import { computeInteractions } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/components/interactions";
  13 | import { findComposerDrug } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/formulary";
  14 | // ── mutation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  15 | import { useSavePrescriptionMutation } from "@/features/prescriptions/composer/queries";
  16 | // ── reads ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  17 | import {
  18 |   activePrescriptionsQuery,
  19 |   getPatientForComposerQueryOptions,
  20 | } from "@/features/prescriptions/queries";
  21 | 
  22 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/prescriptions/new")({
  23 |   validateSearch: z.object({
  24 |     patientId: z.uuid(),
  25 |     visitId: z.uuid(),
  26 |   }),
  27 |   component: NewPrescriptionPage,
  28 | });
  29 | 
  30 | const EMPTY: Omit<PrescriptionComposerValues, "patientId" | "visitId"> = {
  31 |   drugKey: "",
  32 |   medicationName: "",
  33 |   brandName: null,
  34 |   strength: 0,
  35 |   unit: "mg",
  36 |   frequency: "BID",
  37 |   durationDays: 5,
  38 |   instructions: null,
  39 |   mgPerKgPerDay: null,
  40 |   dosesPerDay: 2,
  41 |   weightKg: null,
  42 |   concentrationLabel: null,
  43 | };
  44 | 
  45 | function NewPrescriptionPage() {
  46 |   const { patientId, visitId } = Route.useSearch();
  47 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  48 | 
  49 |   // ── reads ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  50 |   const patientQ = useQuery(getPatientForComposerQueryOptions(patientId));
  51 |   const activeQ = useQuery(activePrescriptionsQuery(patientId));
  52 | 
  53 |   // ── mutation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  54 |   const saveMutation = useSavePrescriptionMutation();
  55 | 
  56 |   // ── composer state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  57 |   const [values, setValues] = React.useState<PrescriptionComposerValues>({
  58 |     ...EMPTY,
  59 |     patientId,
  60 |     visitId,
  61 |   });
  62 | 
  63 |   // Pre-fill weight from the patient record, but never clobber a value the
  64 |   // user typed. Runs once per loaded patient.
  65 |   const lastPrefilledPatientRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  66 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  67 |     const weight = patientQ.data?.weightKg;
  68 |     if (!weight) return;
  69 |     if (lastPrefilledPatientRef.current === patientId) return;
  70 |     lastPrefilledPatientRef.current = patientId;
  71 |     setValues((v) => (v.weightKg == null ? { ...v, weightKg: weight } : v));
  72 |   }, [patientQ.data, patientId]);
  73 | 
  74 |   // ── loading / error states ─────────────────────────────────────────
  75 |   if (patientQ.isPending) {
  76 |     return <PageHeader description="Loading patient…" title="New prescription" />;
  77 |   }
  78 | 
  79 |   if (patientQ.isError || !patientQ.data) {
  80 |     return (
  81 |       <PageHeader
  82 |         description={
  83 |           patientQ.error instanceof Error ? patientQ.error.message : "Patient not found."
  84 |         }
  85 |         title="New prescription"
  86 |       />
  87 |     );
  88 |   }
  89 | 
  90 |   // ── derived ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  91 |   const onChange = (next: Partial<PrescriptionComposerValues>) =>
  92 |     setValues((v) => ({ ...v, ...next }));
  93 | 
  94 |   const interactionsUnavailable = activeQ.isError;
  95 |   const warnings = interactionsUnavailable
  96 |     ? [
  97 |         {
  98 |           severity: "amber" as const,
  99 |           title: "Interaction check unavailable",
 100 |           detail:
 101 |             "The patient's active prescriptions could not be loaded. Verify interactions manually before saving.",
 102 |         },
 103 |       ]
 104 |     : computeInteractions({
 105 |         drug: values.drugKey ? findComposerDrug(values.drugKey) : undefined,
 106 |         allergies: patientQ.data.allergies,
 107 |         active: activeQ.data ?? [],
 108 |       });
 109 | 
 110 |   // ── handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 111 |   const runSave = (shouldPrint: boolean) => {
 112 |     saveMutation.mutate(values, {
 113 |       onSuccess: (row) => {
 114 |         toast.add({
 115 |           type: "success",
 116 |           description: "Prescription saved",
 117 |         });
 118 |         // Navigate first, then print from the detail page so the
 119 |         // print dialog shows the saved prescription, not the
 120 |         // composer.
 121 |         void navigate({
 122 |           to: "/app/prescriptions/$prescriptionId",
 123 |           params: { prescriptionId: row.id },
 124 |           search: shouldPrint ? { print: true } : undefined,
 125 |         });
 126 |       },
 127 |       onError: (err: unknown) => {
 128 |         toast.add({
 129 |           type: "destructive",
 130 |           description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save prescription",
 131 |         });
 132 |       },
 133 |     });
 134 |   };
 135 | 
 136 |   // ── render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 137 |   return (
 138 |     <ComposerShell
 139 |       isSaving={saveMutation.isPending}
 140 |       mode="create"
 141 |       onChange={onChange}
 142 |       onSave={() => runSave(false)}
 143 |       onSaveAndPrint={() => runSave(true)}
 144 |       patient={patientQ.data}
 145 |       previous={[]}
 146 |       subtitle="Write a new prescription. Weight, dosing, and interactions update live."
 147 |       title="New prescription"
 148 |       values={values}
 149 |       warnings={warnings}
 150 |     />
 151 |   );
 152 | }
```

```tsx
  31 | // `errorComponent` instead of rejecting silently.

  33 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_auth/app/visits/$visitId")({
  34 |   loader: ({ context, params }) =>

  39 |       kind="unknown"
  40 |       message={errorMessage(error)}
  41 |       onRetry={reset}
  42 |       title="Couldn't load this visit"

  70 |   if (query.isError || !query.data) {
  71 |     // `query.data === undefined` without `isError` means the query
  72 |     // resolved but the record doesn't exist — a genuine 404.
```

```tsx
  21 | function NewVisitPage() {

  23 |   const { patientId } = Route.useSearch();
  24 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  25 | 
  26 |   const snapshotQ = useQuery(visitSnapshotQuery(patientId));

  40 |   }

  43 |

  46 |       initial={initial}

  53 |       }
```
