   1 | // src/routes/_guest/forgot-password.tsx
   2 | import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   3 | import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   4 | import { ArrowLeftIcon, LoaderCircleIcon, MailIcon } from "lucide-react";
   5 | import * as React from "react";
   6 | import { z } from "zod";
   7 | 
   8 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button.tsx";
   9 | import { Field, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field.tsx";
  10 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input.tsx";
  11 | import { toast } from "#/components/ui/toast.tsx";
  12 | import { authClient } from "#/lib/auth-client.ts";
  13 | 
  14 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_guest/forgot-password")({
  15 |   component: ForgotPasswordForm,
  16 | });
  17 | 
  18 | const forgotSchema = z.object({
  19 |   email: z.email("Invalid email address"),
  20 | });
  21 | 
  22 | /**
  23 |  * Better Auth sends the reset link to `redirectTo`, appending `?token=…`.
  24 |  * The link in the email must point at a route inside this app, e.g.
  25 |  * `/reset-password?token=abc`.
  26 |  */
  27 | const RESET_PAGE_PATH = "/reset-password";
  28 | 
  29 | function ForgotPasswordForm() {
  30 |   const [submitted, setSubmitted] = React.useState(false);
  31 |   const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  32 |   const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  33 | 
  34 |   const form = useForm({
  35 |     defaultValues: { email: "" },
  36 |     validators: { onSubmit: forgotSchema },
  37 |     onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
  38 |       setError(null);
  39 |       setPending(true);
  40 |       try {
  41 |         const { error: authError } = await authClient.requestPasswordReset({
  42 |           email: value.email.trim(),
  43 |           redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}${RESET_PAGE_PATH}`,
  44 |         });
  45 |         if (authError) {
  46 |           throw new Error(authError.message || "Could not send the reset email.");
  47 |         }
  48 |         setSubmitted(true);
  49 |         toast.add({
  50 |           type: "success",
  51 |           description: "Check your inbox for a reset link.",
  52 |         });
  53 |       } catch (err) {
  54 |         const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not send the reset email.";
  55 |         setError(message);
  56 |         toast.add({ type: "error", description: message });
  57 |       } finally {
  58 |         setPending(false);
  59 |       }
  60 |     },
  61 |   });
  62 | 
  63 |   if (submitted) {
  64 |     return (
  65 |       <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
  66 |         <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center">
  67 |           <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
  68 |             Check your email
  69 |           </h2>
  70 |           <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
  71 |             If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in
  72 |             15 minutes.
  73 |           </p>
  74 |         </div>
  75 |         <Button className="h-11 w-full" nativeButton={false} render={<Link to="/login" />}>
  76 |           <ArrowLeftIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
  77 |           Back to sign in
  78 |         </Button>
  79 |       </div>
  80 |     );
  81 |   }
  82 | 
  83 |   return (
  84 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
  85 |       <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center">
  86 |         <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
  87 |           Forgot password?
  88 |         </h2>
  89 |         <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
  90 |           Enter the email you signed up with and we&apos;ll send a reset link.
  91 |         </p>
  92 |       </div>
  93 | 
  94 |       <form
  95 |         aria-busy={pending}
  96 |         className="space-y-6"
  97 |         noValidate
  98 |         onSubmit={(event) => {
  99 |           event.preventDefault();
 100 |           event.stopPropagation();
 101 |           if (pending) return;
 102 |           void form.handleSubmit();
 103 |         }}
 104 |       >
 105 |         <form.Field name="email">
 106 |           {(field) => {
 107 |             const err = field.state.meta.errors[0];
 108 |             const message =
 109 |               typeof err === "string"
 110 |                 ? err
 111 |                 : err && typeof err === "object" && "message" in err
 112 |                   ? String((err as { message: unknown }).message)
 113 |                   : undefined;
 114 |             return (
 115 |               <Field>
 116 |                 <FieldLabel htmlFor="forgot-email">Email address</FieldLabel>
 117 |                 <Input
 118 |                   aria-describedby={message ? "forgot-email-error" : undefined}
 119 |                   aria-invalid={Boolean(message) || Boolean(error)}
 120 |                   autoComplete="email"
 121 |                   className="h-11"
 122 |                   id="forgot-email"
 123 |                   name={field.name}
 124 |                   onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 125 |                   onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 126 |                   placeholder="doctor@clinic.com"
 127 |                   readOnly={pending}
 128 |                   required
 129 |                   type="email"
 130 |                   value={field.state.value}
 131 |                 />
 132 |                 {message && (
 133 |                   <p className="text-destructive text-sm" id="forgot-email-error" role="alert">
 134 |                     {message}
 135 |                   </p>
 136 |                 )}
 137 |               </Field>
 138 |             );
 139 |           }}
 140 |         </form.Field>
 141 | 
 142 |         {error && (
 143 |           <p className="text-destructive text-sm font-medium" role="alert">
 144 |             {error}
 145 |           </p>
 146 |         )}
 147 | 
 148 |         <Button className="h-11 w-full" disabled={pending} type="submit">
 149 |           {pending ? (
 150 |             <LoaderCircleIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 animate-spin" />
 151 |           ) : (
 152 |             <MailIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
 153 |           )}
 154 |           {pending ? "Sending…" : "Send reset link"}
 155 |         </Button>
 156 |       </form>
 157 | 
 158 |       <p className="text-center text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
 159 |         Remembered it?{" "}
 160 |         <Link className="text-primary font-semibold hover:underline" to="/login">
 161 |           Sign in
 162 |         </Link>
 163 |       </p>
 164 |     </div>
 165 |   );
 166 | }

   1 | // src/routes/_guest/login.tsx
   2 | import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   3 | import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   4 | import { createFileRoute, Link, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   5 | import { ArrowRight, EyeIcon, EyeOffIcon, LoaderCircleIcon } from "lucide-react";
   6 | import * as React from "react";
   7 | import { z } from "zod";
   8 | 
   9 | import { SocialSignInButtons } from "#/components/sign-in-social-buttons.tsx";

  12 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input.tsx";
  13 | import { toast } from "#/components/ui/toast.tsx";
  14 | import { authClient } from "#/lib/auth-client.ts";
  15 | import { authQueryOptions } from "#/lib/auth/queries.ts";
  16 | import { fieldErrorMessage } from "@/components/forms/field-error";
  17 | 
  18 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_guest/login")({
  19 |   component: LoginForm,
  20 | });
  21 | 
  22 | const loginSchema = z.object({
  23 |   email: z.email("Enter a valid email address"),
  24 |   password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
  25 | });
  26 | 
  27 | 
  28 | function LoginForm() {
  29 |   const { redirectUrl } = Route.useRouteContext();
  30 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  31 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  32 |   const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  33 |   const [capsLock, setCapsLock] = React.useState(false);
  34 |   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
  35 |   const errorId = React.useId();
  36 | 
  37 |   const login = useMutation({
  38 |     mutationFn: async (data: { email: string; password: string }) => {
  39 |       const { error: authError } = await authClient.signIn.email({
  40 |         ...data,
  41 |         callbackURL: redirectUrl,
  42 |       });
  43 |       if (authError) {
  44 |         throw new Error(authError.message || "Invalid email or password.");
  45 |       }
  46 |     },
  47 |     onSuccess: async () => {
  48 |       // Invalidate AND refetch so the session is live before we navigate.
  49 |       // If this fails, we stay on /login with an error rather than
  50 |       // bouncing between /login -> /app -> /login.
  51 |       await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  52 |         queryKey: authQueryOptions().queryKey,
  53 |       });
  54 |       const user = await queryClient.query(authQueryOptions());
  55 |       if (!user) {
  56 |         throw new Error("Signed in, but the session could not be loaded. Try refreshing the page.");
  57 |       }
  58 |       void navigate({ to: redirectUrl || "/app", replace: true });
  59 |     },
  60 |     onError: (err: unknown) => {
  61 |       const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid email or password.";
  62 |       setError(message);
  63 |       toast.add({ type: "error", description: message });
  64 |     },
  65 |   });
  66 | 
  67 |   const form = useForm({
  68 |     defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" },
  69 |     validators: { onSubmit: loginSchema },
  70 |     onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
  71 |       setError(null);
  72 |       await login.mutateAsync(value);
  73 |     },
  74 |   });
  75 | 
  76 |   const isPending = login.isPending;
  77 | 
  78 |   return (
  79 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
  80 |       <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center">
  81 |         <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
  82 |           Welcome back
  83 |         </h2>
  84 |         <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Sign in to manage your clinic.</p>
  85 |       </div>
  86 | 
  87 |       <form
  88 |         aria-busy={isPending}
  89 |         className="space-y-6"
  90 |         noValidate
  91 |         onSubmit={(event) => {
  92 |           event.preventDefault();
  93 |           event.stopPropagation();
  94 |           if (isPending) return;
  95 |           void form.handleSubmit();
  96 |         }}
  97 |       >
  98 |         <div className="space-y-4">
  99 |           <form.Field name="email">
 100 |             {(field) => {
 101 |               const message = fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]);
 102 |               return (
 103 |                 <Field>
 104 |                   <FieldLabel htmlFor="email">Email address</FieldLabel>
 105 |                   <Input
 106 |                     aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
 107 |                     aria-invalid={Boolean(message) || Boolean(error)}
 108 |                     autoComplete="email"
 109 |                     className="h-11"
 110 |                     id="email"
 111 |                     name={field.name}
 112 |                     onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 113 |                     onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 114 |                     placeholder="doctor@clinic.com"
 115 |                     readOnly={isPending}
 116 |                     required
 117 |                     type="email"
 118 |                     value={field.state.value}
 119 |                   />
 120 |                   {message && (
 121 |                     <p className="text-destructive text-xs" role="alert">
 122 |                       {message}
 123 |                     </p>
 124 |                   )}
 125 |                 </Field>
 126 |               );
 127 |             }}
 128 |           </form.Field>
 129 | 
 130 |           <form.Field name="password">
 131 |             {(field) => {
 132 |               const message = fieldErrorMessage(field.state.meta.errors[0]);
 133 |               const describedBy =
 134 |                 [
 135 |                   error ? errorId : null,
 136 |                   capsLock ? "login-caps-lock" : null,
 137 |                   message ? "login-password-error" : null,
 138 |                 ]
 139 |                   .filter(Boolean)
 140 |                   .join(" ") || undefined;
 141 | 
 142 |               return (
 143 |                 <Field>
 144 |                   <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 145 |                     <FieldLabel htmlFor="password">Password</FieldLabel>
 146 |                     <Link
 147 |                       className="text-primary text-xs font-medium hover:underline"
 148 |                       to="/forgot-password"
 149 |                     >

 151 |                     </Link>
 152 |                   </div>
 153 | 
 154 |                   {/* Flex wrapper: input fills the row, eye button sits on the right edge. */}
 155 |                   <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
 156 |                     <Input
 157 |                       aria-describedby={describedBy}
 158 |                       aria-invalid={Boolean(message) || Boolean(error)}
 159 |                       autoComplete="current-password"
 160 |                       id="password"
 161 |                       name={field.name}
 162 |                       onBlur={field.handleBlur}
 163 |                       onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
 164 |                       onKeyUp={(e) => setCapsLock(e.getModifierState?.("CapsLock") ?? false)}
 165 |                       placeholder="••••••••"
 166 |                       readOnly={isPending}
 167 |                       required

 169 |                       value={field.state.value}
 170 |                     />
 171 | 
 172 |                     <button

 174 |                       aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
 175 |                       aria-pressed={showPassword}
 176 |                       className=" hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-background shrink-0 rounded-md p-2 transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50"
 177 |                       disabled={isPending}
 178 |                       onClick={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
 179 |                       tabIndex={-1}
 180 |                       type="button"
 181 |                     >
 182 |                       {showPassword ? (
 183 |                         <EyeOffIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
 184 |                       ) : (

 186 |                       )}
 187 |                     </button>
 188 |                   </div>
 189 | 
 190 |                   {capsLock && (

 192 |                       Caps Lock is on.
 193 |                     </p>
 194 |                   )}
 195 | 
 196 |                   {message && (

 198 |                       {message}
 199 |                     </p>
 200 |                   )}
 201 |                 </Field>
 202 |               );
 203 |             }}
 204 |           </form.Field>
 205 | 
 206 |           {error && (

 208 |               className="animate-in text-destructive fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 text-sm font-medium"
 209 |               id={errorId}
 210 |               role="alert"
 211 |             >
 212 |               {error}
 213 |             </p>
 214 |           )}
 215 | 
 216 |           <Button className="mt-2 h-11 w-full" disabled={isPending} type="submit">
 217 |             {isPending ? (
 218 |               <LoaderCircleIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 animate-spin" />
 219 |             ) : (
 220 |               <ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
 221 |             )}
 222 |             {isPending ? "Signing in..." : "Sign In"}
 223 |           </Button>
 224 |         </div>
 225 | 
 226 |         <SocialSignInButtons callbackURL={redirectUrl} disabled={isPending} />
 227 |       </form>
 228 | 
 229 |       <p className="text-center text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
 230 |         Don&apos;t have an account?{" "}
 231 |         <Link className="text-primary font-semibold hover:underline" to="/signup">
 232 |           Create one
 233 |         </Link>
 234 |       </p>
 235 |     </div>
 236 |   );
 237 | }

  14 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_guest/reset-password")({
  15 |   validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
  16 |     token: typeof search.token === "string" ? search.token : undefined,
  17 |     // Better Auth may append `?error=INVALID_TOKEN` when the link is bad.
  18 |     error: typeof search.error === "string" ? search.error : undefined,
  19 |   }),
  20 |   component: ResetPasswordForm,
  21 | });
  22 | 
  23 | const resetSchema = z
  24 |   .object({
  25 |     password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
  26 |     confirmPassword: z.string().min(8, "Please confirm your password"),
  27 |   })
  28 |   .refine((data) => data.password === data.confirmPassword, {
  29 |     message: "Passwords do not match",
  30 |     path: ["confirmPassword"],
  31 |   });
  32 | 
  33 | function ResetPasswordForm() {
  34 |   const { token, error: urlError } = Route.useSearch();
  35 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  36 |   const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  37 |   const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(
  38 |     urlError === "INVALID_TOKEN"
  39 |       ? "This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one."
  40 |       : null,
  41 |   );

  48 |         setError("Missing reset token. Request a new link from the login page.");
  49 |         return;
  50 |       }
  51 |       setError(null);
  52 |       setPending(true);
  53 |       try {
  54 |         const { error: authError } = await authClient.resetPassword({
  55 |           newPassword: value.password,
  56 |           token,
  57 |         });
  58 |         if (authError) {
  59 |           throw new Error(authError.message || "Could not reset the password.");
  60 |         }
  61 |         toast.add({
  62 |           type: "success",
  63 |           description: "Password updated. Please sign in.",
  64 |         });
  65 |         void navigate({ to: "/login", replace: true });
  66 |       } catch (err) {
  67 |         const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not reset the password.";
  68 |         setError(message);
  69 |         toast.add({ type: "error", description: message });
  70 |       } finally {
  71 |         setPending(false);
  72 |       }
  73 |     },
  74 |   });
  75 | 
  76 |   // Missing / bad token — no point showing the form.
  77 |   if (!token) {
  78 |     return (
  79 |       <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">

  82 |             Reset link is invalid
  83 |           </h2>
  84 |           <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
  85 |             {error ??
  86 |               "This link is missing a reset token. Request a new one from the sign-in page."}
  87 |           </p>
  88 |         </div>
  89 |         <Button

  91 |           nativeButton={false}
  92 |           render={<Link to="/forgot-password" />}
  93 |           size="lg"
  94 |         >
  95 |           Request a new link
  96 |         </Button>
  97 |       </div>
  98 |     );
  99 |   }
 100 | 
 101 |   return (
 102 |     <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
 103 |       <div className="space-y-1.5 text-center">
 104 |         <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
 105 |           Set a new password
 106 |         </h2>
 107 |         <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
 108 |           Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
 109 |         </p>
 110 |       </div>
 111 |

 113 |         aria-busy={pending}
 114 |         className="space-y-6"
 115 |         noValidate
 116 |         onSubmit={(event) => {

 120 |           void form.handleSubmit();
 121 |         }}
 122 |       >

 191 |                     </p>

 193 |                 </div>
 194 |               );
 195 |             }}
 196 |           </form.Field>
 197 | 
 198 |           {error && (
 199 |             <p className="text-destructive text-sm font-medium" role="alert">
 200 |               {error}
 201 |             </p>
 202 |           )}
 203 | 
 204 |           <Button className="w-full" disabled={pending} size="lg" type="submit">
 205 |             {pending ? (
 206 |               <LoaderCircleIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 animate-spin" />
 207 |             ) : (
 208 |               <ShieldCheckIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
 209 |             )}
 210 |             {pending ? "Updating…" : "Update password"}
 211 |           </Button>
 212 |         </div>
 213 |       </form>
 214 | 
 215 |       <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
 216 |         <Link
 217 |           className=" hover:text-foreground inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline"
 218 |           to="/login"
 219 |         >
 220 |           <ArrowLeftIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" />
 221 |           Back to sign in
 222 |         </Link>
 223 |         <Link className=" hover:text-foreground hover:underline" to="/forgot-password">
 224 |           Request new link
 225 |         </Link>
 226 |       </div>
 227 |     </div>
 228 |   );
 229 | }

   1 | // src/routes/_guest/signup.tsx
   2 | import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   3 | import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
   4 | import { createFileRoute, Link, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   5 | import { EyeIcon, EyeOffIcon, LoaderCircleIcon, UserPlus } from "lucide-react";
   6 | import * as React from "react";
   7 | import { z } from "zod";
   8 | 
   9 | import { SocialSignInButtons } from "#/components/sign-in-social-buttons.tsx";
  10 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button.tsx";
  11 | import { Field, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field.tsx";
  12 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input.tsx";
  13 | import { toast } from "#/components/ui/toast.tsx";
  14 | import { authClient } from "#/lib/auth-client.ts";
  15 | import { authQueryOptions } from "#/lib/auth/queries.ts";
  16 | 
  17 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/_guest/signup")({
  18 |   component: SignupForm,
  19 | });
  20 | 
  21 | const signupSchema = z
  22 |   .object({
  23 |     name: z.string().trim().min(1, "Name is required"),
  24 |     email: z.email("Invalid email address"),
  25 |     password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
  26 |     confirmPassword: z.string().min(8, "Please confirm your password"),
  27 |   })
  28 |   .refine((data) => data.password === data.confirmPassword, {
  29 |     message: "Passwords do not match",
  30 |     path: ["confirmPassword"],
  31 |   });
  32 | 
  33 | /** TanStack Form hands back `unknown[]`; pull a readable string out. */
  34 | function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  35 |   if (typeof err === "string") return err;
  36 |   if (err && typeof err === "object" && "message" in err) {
  37 |     const m = (err as { message: unknown }).message;
  38 |     if (typeof m === "string") return m;
  39 |   }
  40 |   return "Invalid value";
  41 | }
  42 | 
  43 | function SignupForm() {
  44 |   const { redirectUrl } = Route.useRouteContext();
  45 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  46 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
  47 |   const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  48 |   const [capsLock, setCapsLock] = React.useState(false);
  49 |   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
  50 |   const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = React.useState(false);
  51 |   const errorId = React.useId();
  52 | 
  53 |   // Declare the mutation BEFORE the form so `onSubmit` can reference it.
  54 |   const signup = useMutation({
  55 |     mutationFn: async (data: { name: string; email: string; password: string }) => {
  56 |       const { error: authError } = await authClient.signUp.email({
  57 |         ...data,
  58 |         callbackURL: redirectUrl,
  59 |       });
  60 |       if (authError) {
  61 |         throw new Error(authError.message || "An error occurred while creating your account.");
  62 |       }
  63 |     },
  64 |     onSuccess: async () => {
  65 |       await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
  66 |         queryKey: authQueryOptions().queryKey,
  67 |       });
  68 |       try {
  69 |         const user = await queryClient.query(authQueryOptions());
  70 |         if (user) {
  71 |           toast.add({
  72 |             type: "success",
  73 |             description: "Account created successfully!",
  74 |           });
  75 |           void navigate({ to: redirectUrl || "/app", replace: true });
  76 |           return;
  77 |         }
  78 |       } catch {
  79 |         // Query resolution failed, fallback to login page smoothly
  80 |       }
  81 | 
  82 |       // If the session cookie is not active yet, route smoothly to login
  83 |       toast.add({
  84 |         type: "success",
  85 |         description: "Account created successfully! Please sign in with your credentials.",
  86 |       });
  87 |       void navigate({ to: "/login", replace: true });
  88 |     },

 272 | /**
 273 |  * Format an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) as a long, locale-stable string
 274 |  * ("January 1, 2026").
 275 |  *
 276 |  * Uses `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with an explicit `en-US` locale and UTC
 277 |  * timezone so the output is identical on the server and client — a
 278 |  * hydration mismatch on the "Last updated" line would be annoying to
 279 |  * debug and is trivial to avoid.
 280 |  */
 281 | function formatLongDate(isoDate: string): string {
 282 |   const parsed = new Date(`${isoDate}T00:00:00Z`);
 283 |   if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
 284 |     return isoDate;
 285 |   }
 286 |   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
 287 |     day: "numeric",
 288 |     month: "long",
 289 |     timeZone: "UTC",
 290 |     year: "numeric",
 291 |   }).format(parsed);
 292 | }

  39 |   for (;;) {
  40 |     const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  41 |     if (done) break;
  42 |     totalBytes += value.byteLength;
  43 |     if (totalBytes > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES) {
  44 |       await reader.cancel();
  45 |       throw new AssistantRequestError("Request body is too large", 413);
  46 |     }
  47 |     chunks.push(value);
  48 |   }
  49 | 
  50 |   const bytes = new Uint8Array(totalBytes);
  51 |   let offset = 0;
  52 |   for (const chunk of chunks) {
  53 |     bytes.set(chunk, offset);
  54 |     offset += chunk.byteLength;
  55 |   }
  56 | 
  57 |   try {
  58 |     return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
  59 |   } catch (error) {
  60 |     if (error instanceof SyntaxError) {
  61 |       throw new AssistantRequestError("Request body must be valid JSON", 400);
  62 |     }
  63 |     throw error;
  64 |   }
  65 | }
  66 | 
  67 | function errorResponse(message: string, status: number): Response {
  68 |   return Response.json({ error: message }, { status });
  69 | }
  70 | 
  71 | export const Route = createFileRoute("/api/assistant")({
  72 |   server: {
  73 |     handlers: {
  74 |       POST: async ({ request }) => {
  75 |         if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.includes("application/json")) {
  76 |           return errorResponse("Content-Type must be application/json", 400);
  77 |         }
  78 | 
  79 |         let body: unknown;
  80 |         try {
  81 |           body = await readJsonBody(request);
  82 |         } catch (error) {
  83 |           if (error instanceof AssistantRequestError) {
  84 |             return errorResponse(error.message, error.status);
  85 |           }
  86 |           throw error;
  87 |         }
  88 | 
  89 |         const parsed = assistantRequestSchema.safeParse(body);
  90 |         if (!parsed.success) {
  91 |           return errorResponse("Invalid assistant request", 400);
  92 |         }
  93 | 
  94 |         const patientId = parsed.data.patientId ?? parsed.data.forwardedProps?.patientId;
  95 |         const modelMessages = toAssistantModelMessages(parsed.data.messages);
  96 |         const latestUserMessage = modelMessages.at(-1);
  97 |         if (
  98 |           latestUserMessage?.role === "user" &&
  99 |           typeof latestUserMessage.content === "string" &&
 100 |           requestsMedicationAdvice(latestUserMessage.content)
 101 |         ) {
 102 |           return errorResponse(
 103 |             "Medication recommendations and dose calculations must be reviewed by a licensed clinician.",
 104 |             422,
 105 |           );
 106 |         }
 107 | 
 108 |         const user = await _getUserImpl();
 109 |         if (!user) return errorResponse("Unauthorized", 401);
 110 |         if (!canUseAssistantRole(user.role)) return errorResponse("Forbidden", 403);
 111 | 
 112 |         let patientClinicId: string | null | undefined;
 113 |         if (patientId) {
 114 |           const [patient] = await db
 115 |             .select({ clinicId: patients.clinicId })
 116 |             .from(patients)
 117 |             .where(eq(patients.id, patientId))
 118 |             .limit(1);
 119 |           if (!patient?.clinicId) return errorResponse("Patient not found", 404);
 120 |           patientClinicId = patient.clinicId;
 121 |         }
 122 | 
 123 |         const clinicId = resolveAssistantClinicId(user.role, user.clinicId, patientClinicId);
 124 |         if (!clinicId) return errorResponse("Forbidden", 403);
 125 | 
 126 |         const controller = new AbortController();
 127 |         const onRequestAbort = () => controller.abort(request.signal.reason);
 128 |         request.signal.addEventListener("abort", onRequestAbort, { once: true });
 129 |         if (request.signal.aborted) onRequestAbort();
 130 | 
 131 |         let inputTokens = 0;
 132 |         let outputTokens = 0;
 133 |         let cleanedUp = false;
 134 |         const startedAt = Date.now();
 135 |         const cleanup = () => {
 136 |           if (cleanedUp) return;
 137 |           cleanedUp = true;
 138 |           clearTimeout(timeout);
 139 |           request.signal.removeEventListener("abort", onRequestAbort);
 140 |         };
 141 |         const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
 142 |           controller.abort(new Error("Assistant request timed out"));
 143 |         }, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
 144 | 
 145 |         const telemetry: ChatMiddleware = {
 146 |           name: "assistant-telemetry",
 147 |           onUsage(_context, usage) {
 148 |             inputTokens += usage.promptTokens ?? 0;
 149 |             outputTokens += usage.completionTokens ?? 0;
 150 |           },
 151 |           onAfterToolCall(context, info) {
 152 |             console.info(
 153 |               JSON.stringify({
 154 |                 event: "assistant.tool",
 155 |                 requestId: context.requestId,
 156 |                 toolName: info.toolName,
 157 |                 toolCallId: info.toolCallId,
 158 |                 succeeded: info.ok,
 159 |                 durationMs: info.duration,
 160 |               }),
 161 |             );
 162 |           },
 163 |           onFinish(context, info) {
 164 |             cleanup();
 165 |             console.info(
 166 |               JSON.stringify({
 167 |                 event: "assistant.completed",
 168 |                 requestId: context.requestId,
 169 |                 provider: assistantProvider,
 170 |                 model: assistantModelName,
 171 |                 durationMs: info.duration,
 172 |                 inputTokens,
 173 |                 outputTokens,
 174 |                 finishReason: info.finishReason,
 175 |               }),
 176 |             );
 177 |           },
 178 |           onAbort(context, info) {
 179 |             cleanup();
 180 |             console.warn(
 181 |               JSON.stringify({
 182 |                 event: "assistant.aborted",
 183 |                 requestId: context.requestId,
 184 |                 provider: assistantProvider,
 185 |                 model: assistantModelName,
 186 |                 durationMs: info.duration,
 187 |               }),
 188 |             );
 189 |           },
 190 |           onError(context, info) {
 191 |             cleanup();
 192 |             console.error(
 193 |               JSON.stringify({
 194 |                 event: "assistant.failed",
 195 |                 requestId: context.requestId,
 196 |                 provider: assistantProvider,
 197 |                 model: assistantModelName,
 198 |                 durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
 199 |                 errorType: info.error instanceof Error ? info.error.name : "UnknownError",
 200 |               }),
 201 |             );
 202 |           },
 203 |         };
 204 | 
 205 |         const stream = chat({
 206 |           adapter: createAssistantAdapter(),
 207 |           systemPrompts: [assistantSystemPrompt()],
 208 |           messages: modelMessages,
 209 |           tools: createAssistantTools(clinicId, patientId),
 210 |           threadId: parsed.data.threadId ?? `assistant:${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 211 |           ...(parsed.data.runId ? { runId: parsed.data.runId } : {}),
 212 |           agentLoopStrategy: maxIterations(4),
 213 |           middleware: [telemetry],
 214 |           abortController: controller,
 215 |         });
 216 | 
 217 |         return toServerSentEventsResponse(stream, { abortController: controller });
 218 |       },
 219 |     },
 220 |   },
 221 | });

 394 |     animation-delay: calc(var(--stagger-step, 35ms) * var(--i, 0));
 395 |     animation-fill-mode: both;
 396 |   }
 397 | }
 398 | 
 399 | /* ── Reduced motion ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 400 |    Neuter every entrance/exit/ambient animation. Backgrounds that
 401 |    shimmer get a static fallback so the element doesn't look broken.
 402 |    ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
 403 | @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
 404 |   [class*="animate-"],
 405 |   .rise-in,
 406 |   .stagger-children > *,
 407 |   .stagger-children-fast > * {
 408 |     animation: none !important;
 409 |   }
 410 |   .animate-shimmer {
 411 |     background: var(--muted);
 412 |   }
 413 |   .animate-shimmer-wave::after {
 414 |     display: none;
 415 |   }
 416 | }

 435 |   }
 436 |   .btn-glow:hover {
 437 |     box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), var(--glow-card-hover);
 438 |     transform: translateY(-2px);
 439 |   }
 440 | 
 441 |   .btn-glow-accent {
 442 |     color: var(--accent-foreground);
 443 |     background: var(--gradient-accent);
 444 |     border: none;
 445 |     border-radius: var(--radius-md);
 446 |     box-shadow: var(--shadow-md), var(--glow-accent);
 447 |     transition:
 448 |       box-shadow var(--transition-base),
 449 |       transform var(--transition-base);
 450 |   }
 451 |   .btn-glow-accent:hover {
 452 |     box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), var(--glow-accent);
 453 |     transform: translateY(-2px);
 454 |   }
 455 | 
 456 |   /* ─── Module icon badges ──────────────────────────────────────── */
 457 |   .module-badge {
 458 |     display: flex;
 459 |     align-items: center;
 460 |     justify-content: center;
 461 |     width: 2.75rem;
 462 |     height: 2.75rem;
 463 |     color: var(--module-color);
 464 |     background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--module-color) 14%, transparent);
 465 |     border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
 466 |     box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--module-color) 22%, transparent);
 467 |     transition: box-shadow var(--transition-base);
 468 |   }
 469 |   .module-badge:hover {
 470 |     box-shadow:
 471 |       0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--module-color) 40%, transparent),
 472 |       0 0 16px color-mix(in oklab, var(--module-color) 28%, transparent);
 473 |   }
 474 |   .module-badge--patients {
 475 |     --module-color: var(--module-patients);
 476 |   }
 477 |   .module-badge--encounters {
 478 |     --module-color: var(--module-encounters);
 479 |   }
 480 |   .module-badge--growth {
 481 |     --module-color: var(--module-growth);
 482 |   }
 483 |   .module-badge--immunizations {
 484 |     --module-color: var(--module-immunizations);
 485 |   }
 486 |   .module-badge--prescriptions {
 487 |     --module-color: var(--module-prescriptions);
 488 |   }
 489 |   .module-badge--labs {
 490 |     --module-color: var(--module-labs);
 491 |   }
 492 | 
 493 |   /* ─── Dividers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
 494 |   .divider-gradient {
 495 |     height: 1px;
 496 |     margin-block: 0.5rem;
 497 |     background: linear-gradient(
 498 |       90deg,
 499 |       transparent 0%,
 500 |       var(--line-strong) 20%,
 501 |       var(--color-brand-primary-glow) 50%,
 502 |       var(--line-strong) 80%,
 503 |       transparent 100%
 504 |     );
 505 |     border: none;
 506 |   }
 507 |   .divider-dashed {
 508 |     height: 1px;
 509 |     background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
 510 |       90deg,
 511 |       var(--line-strong) 0,
 512 |       var(--line-strong) 6px,
 513 |       transparent 6px,
 514 |       transparent 14px
 515 |     );
 516 |     border: none;
 517 |   }
 518 |   .section-divider {
 519 |     display: flex;
 520 |     gap: 0.75rem;
 521 |     align-items: center;
 522 |     font-size: 0.7rem;
 523 |     font-weight: 700;
 524 |     color: var(--muted-foreground);
 525 |     text-transform: uppercase;
 526 |     letter-spacing: 0.14em;
 527 |   }
 528 |   .section-divider::before,
 529 |   .section-divider::after {
 530 |     flex: 1;
 531 |     height: 1px;
 532 |     content: "";
 533 |     background: var(--line-strong);
 534 |   }
 535 | 
 536 |   /* ─── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
 537 |   .site-footer {
 538 |     contain: layout style;
 539 |     background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--header-bg) 84%, transparent 16%);
 540 |     border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
 541 |     backdrop-filter: var(--backdrop-filter);
 542 |   }
 543 | 
 544 |   /* ─── Skeleton ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
 545 |   .skeleton {
 546 |     position: relative;
 547 |     overflow: hidden;
 548 |     background: var(--muted);
 549 |     border-radius: var(--radius-md);
 550 |   }
 551 |   .skeleton::after {
 552 |     position: absolute;
 553 |     inset: 0;
 554 |     content: "";
 555 |     background: linear-gradient(
 556 |       105deg,
 557 |       transparent 40%,
 558 |       color-mix(in oklab, var(--inset-glint) 60%, transparent) 50%,
 559 |       transparent 60%
 560 |     );
 561 |     animation: shimmer-wave 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
 562 |   }
 563 |   .skeleton--text {
 564 |     width: 100%;
 565 |     height: 0.875rem;
 566 |     border-radius: 4px;
 567 |   }
 568 |   .skeleton--circle {
 569 |     border-radius: 9999px;
 570 |   }
 571 | 
 572 |   /* ─── Tooltip ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
 573 |   .tooltip-glass {
 574 |     background: var(--surface-frosted);
 575 |     border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
 576 |     border-radius: var(--radius-md);
 577 |     box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), var(--glow-card);
 578 |     backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
 579 |   }
 580 | }
 581 | 
 582 | /* ─── Mobile — kill backdrop-filter at token level (Action #30) ──── */
 583 | @media (max-width: 640px) {
 584 |   :root {
 585 |     --backdrop-filter: none;
 586 |   }
 587 | }

  20 | // happy-dom doesn't implement scrollTo. TanStack Router calls it after

 101 | /**
 102 |  * True iff `v` is an array whose every element is a `File` instance.
 103 |  *
 104 |  * Uses `instanceof File` rather than a duck-typed check so that a plain
 105 |  * object shaped like a File (`{ name, size, type, ... }`) is rejected. Only
 106 |  * actual File/Blob-derived objects (from `<input type="file">`, drag-drop,
 107 |  * or the clipboard) pass.
 108 |  *
 109 |  * The `File` global is available in browsers and in Node 20+. If this guard
 110 |  * is ever called in an older Node runtime, replace the check with a duck-typed
 111 |  * fallback:
 112 |  *
 113 |  *     typeof item === "object" && item !== null
 114 |  *     && "name" in item && "size" in item && "type" in item
 115 |  *     && "arrayBuffer" in item
 116 |  */
 117 | export function isFileArray(v: unknown): v is File[] {
 118 |   return Array.isArray(v) && v.every((item) => item instanceof File);
 119 | }

   1 | /** Shape of the callback the compiler passes to `generateFunctionId`. */
   2 | export interface ServerFnIdInput {
   3 |   /**
   4 |    * Relative path of the source file (e.g. `src/features/patients/api.ts`).
   5 |    * Supplied by the compiler; only used for diagnostics and collision
   6 |    * detection — not part of the id.
   7 |    */
   8 |   filename: string;
   9 |   /**
  10 |    * The exported binding name as it appears in source. The compiler appends
  11 |    * `_createServerFn_handler` to the compiled handler, so this is what the
  12 |    * hook receives.
  13 |    */
  14 |   functionName: string;
  15 | }
  16 | 
  17 | /** Callback signature expected by `tanstackStart({ serverFns })`. */
  18 | export type GenerateFunctionId = (input: ServerFnIdInput) => string;
  19 | 
  20 | /**
  21 |  * Thrown when two different files (or two different bindings in the same
  22 |  * file) produce the same id.
  23 |  *
  24 |  * Exported so tests and build tooling can branch on it explicitly rather
  25 |  * than string-matching the message.
  26 |  */
  27 | export class DuplicateServerFunctionIdError extends Error {
  28 |   readonly id: string;
  29 |   readonly firstOwner: string;
  30 |   readonly secondOwner: string;
  31 | 
  32 |   constructor(id: string, firstOwner: string, secondOwner: string) {
  33 |     super(
  34 |       `Duplicate server function id "${id}" produced by ` +
  35 |         `"${firstOwner}" and "${secondOwner}". ` +
  36 |         "Server function ids are the variable name alone, so the name " +
  37 |         "must be unique across the codebase. Rename one of the two " +
  38 |         "exports, or pass a `salt` to `createServerFnIdGenerator` to " +
  39 |         "namespace the ids.",
  40 |     );
  41 |     this.name = "DuplicateServerFunctionIdError";
  42 |     this.id = id;
  43 |     this.firstOwner = firstOwner;
  44 |     this.secondOwner = secondOwner;
  45 |   }
  46 | }
  47 | 
  48 | /** Matches the compiler-generated handler suffix the hook receives. */
  49 | const HANDLER_SUFFIX = "_createServerFn_handler";
  50 | 
  51 | /**
  52 |  * Strip the compiler's `_createServerFn_handler` suffix, but only when the
  53 |  * remaining part would still be a valid identifier. A user-authored export
  54 |  * named `foo_createServerFn_handler` would survive this and be treated as a
  55 |  * distinct id — that's intentional: the compiler never generates that shape
  56 |  * from a user-authored name, so treating it as an error would be hostile to
  57 |  * a user who happens to name a server fn that way.
  58 |  */
  59 | function stripHandlerSuffix(functionName: string): string {
  60 |   if (!functionName.endsWith(HANDLER_SUFFIX)) return functionName;
  61 |   return functionName.slice(0, -HANDLER_SUFFIX.length);
  62 | }
  63 | 
  64 | /** Options accepted by `createServerFnIdGenerator`. */
  65 | export interface CreateServerFnIdGeneratorOptions {
  66 |   /**
  67 |    * Optional namespace prepended to every id, e.g. `"web"` →
  68 |    * `web_fetchPatientsByClinic`. Only useful if you build multiple bundles
  69 |    * from the same source tree and want their ids to be disjoint. Leave
  70 |    * unset for the common case (single app build).
  71 |    */
  72 |   salt?: string;
  73 | }
  74 | 
  75 | /**
  76 |  * Factory — call once per build. Each call owns an independent "already
  77 |  * claimed" registry, so a Vite reload gets a fresh map (correct — the
  78 |  * previous build's claims are irrelevant).
  79 |  */
  80 | export function createServerFnIdGenerator(
  81 |   options: CreateServerFnIdGeneratorOptions = {},
  82 | ): GenerateFunctionId {
  83 |   const { salt } = options;
  84 |   const prefix = salt === undefined || salt === "" ? "" : `${salt}_`;
  85 | 
  86 |   // id -> the filename that first produced it. Two different files with the
  87 |   // same function name would otherwise be silently deduplicated by the
  88 |   // compiler (it appends `_1`, whose ordering isn't stable across builds).
  89 |   // We make the collision a **build failure** instead, so it can never
  90 |   // silently reorder ids between builds.
  91 |   const owners = new Map<string, string>();
  92 | 
  93 |   return ({ filename, functionName }) => {
  94 |     const base = stripHandlerSuffix(functionName);
  95 |     if (base.length === 0) {
  96 |       throw new DuplicateServerFunctionIdError(`<empty: ${functionName}>`, filename, filename);
  97 |     }
  98 | 
  99 |     const id = `${prefix}${base}`;
 100 |     const owner = owners.get(id);
 101 | 
 102 |     if (owner === undefined) {
 103 |       owners.set(id, filename);
 104 |       return id;
 105 |     }
 106 | 
 107 |     if (owner === filename) {
 108 |       // Same file, same name — the compiler is asking twice. Idempotent.
 109 |       return id;
 110 |     }
 111 | 
 112 |     // Same id, different file — genuine collision.
 113 |     throw new DuplicateServerFunctionIdError(id, owner, filename);
 114 |   };
 115 | }
 116 | 
 117 | /**
 118 |  * Convenience: a pre-built generator with no salt. Use only if you're sure
 119 |  * `vite.config.ts` will never need the factory form (it usually will, to
 120 |  * configure the salt from an env var).
 121 |  */
 122 | export const generateServerFnId: GenerateFunctionId = createServerFnIdGenerator();
